name: Aura
description: A regional concentration of one of the Realms of Power that affects magic within it; magic is opposed by both Divine and Infernal auras, and a covenant's Magical aura can fade or strengthen. A Dominion aura can spring up where holiness accumulates.

name: House Flambeau
description: A foundational Hermetic magus who devised the Parma Magica; the wizard who trained the wizard who trained Bonisagus is said to have created a shield that defends against all magic, and the cave where Bonisagus devised the Parma Magica can be an object of a quest.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The organization of Hermetic magi that ties magi together through Tribunals, Quaesitors, Redcaps, and the Peripheral Code. It is the central institution of Ars Magica, living within Mythic Europe alongside the mundane world.

name: The Gift
description: The supernatural capacity that enables a person to work Hermetic magic; its scarcity, combined with Platonic philosophy, has led the Order of Hermes toward a position of equity. The Blatant Gift variant makes mundane people instinctively distrust the magus.

name: Infernal Realm
description: One of the four supernatural realms, manifesting as Infernal auras and powering demonic entities like Bishop Hatto and the Mauseturm mice; one possible source of the Curse via Rudiaria's pact.

name: House Mercere
description: Messengers of the Order of Hermes; the Redcap Virtue may substitute for any trader Social Status Virtue, and Redcaps change roles at the whim of their House. They are always in attendance at St. Giles' Fair, Winchester.

name: Vis
description: The physical, magical essence (counted in pawns) used to power Hermetic ritual magic and enchantments; a reliable vis source is the greatest treasure for a covenant. Creatures of the Divine yield pawns of vis of particular Arts.

name: Code of Hermes
description: The legal code of the Order of Hermes, designed to help suspension of disbelief by stopping magi from interfering and changing history. It forbids magi from swearing fealty to mundane lords, scrying, or attacking another magus without declaring Wizard's War.

name: House Guernicus
description: A Hermetic official concerned with the Code of Hermes; a Failed Apprentice with clarity on the Code might become a valued clerk to one, and feuding Verditius magi avoid bringing vendettas before the Quaesitores.

name: House Jerbiton
description: A House of the Order interested in mundane arts; the magus Enumerus was a Jerbiton, and members champion illumination and book-craft, possibly transmitting librarianship to the Church and nobility.

name: Covenant
description: The communal home and secure base of a group of magi in Ars Magica, where they study, improve, and create magical wonders; classified by the Order into the four seasons of Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter.

name: Twilight
description: A reaction unique to Hermetic magi when they accumulate Warping Points, in which a maga enters an altered, dreamlike state she must comprehend to escape; it marks her with a Twilight Scar and can be beneficial or harmful.

name: Mentem
description: The Hermetic Form governing minds; Iacob is a master of Mentem magics and has invented spells implanting thoughts, and Xantippes used Mentem magics on the inhabitants of Trier.

name: Corpus
description: The Hermetic Form governing the human body; Daimons such as Dietrich and Honos and ghosts like Sir Giles have Corpus Might, and Corpus vis and Donning the Corporeal Veil involve it.

name: Creo
description: The Hermetic Technique of creation; in Criamon cosmology it reflects the universal force of harmony, and it is the appropriate vis for Initiating increases to inner heartbeast Characteristics.

name: Animal
description: The Hermetic Form governing animals; the appropriate vis for Initiating new Qualities of the inner heartbeast and the Form normally affecting a Bjornaer in heartbeast shape.

name: Certamen
description: A magus's personal magical signature that influences the appearance of his magic (e.g. the styling of conjured armor); it can be suppressed or altered via the Cult of Mercury's Disguised Casting ability.

name: Rego
description: A Hermetic Technique meaning 'I control', used to control and move things; appears as the Technique for Rego Herbam, Rego Ignem, and Rego Imaginem spells and as a requisite.

name: Vim
description: The Hermetic Form governing magical power itself; the appropriate vis for Initiating Virtues onto the inner heartbeast, and in Criamon cosmology it reflects the energy released as harmony yields to strife.

name: Intellego
description: The Hermetic Technique meaning 'I perceive'; Intellego spells are not affected by Target size, and Intellego Vim Lab Totals are used to investigate enchantments and assess apprentices' abilities.

name: Terram
description: A Hermetic Form governing earth, stone, and metal; appears as a requisite for trapping fire in a hard object (Trapping the Fire) and as the material Form of writing.

name: Ignem
description: A Hermetic Form governing fire; used in Creo Ignem certamen contests and Faerie Magic Fire-duration spells, and unaffected by fevers per the Criamon Path of the Body.

name: Imaginem
description: A Hermetic Form of sensations and illusion meaning 'image', used to create, transform, perceive, destroy, and control images and species affecting the senses; cannot affect light, which is Ignem.

name: Perdo
description: The Hermetic Technique of destruction; used in spells such as Swift Knives, Invisible and as a possible laboratory Specialization, often associated with dark, decaying labs.

name: Magic Theory
description: The core Hermetic Ability used in laboratory activities; it limits shape-and-material bonuses, lets helpers contribute to a Lab Total, and is required (at least score 1) to write or copy Laboratory Texts.

name: Warping
description: The accumulation of Warping Points from exposure to supernatural power; gained from Realms, auras, Longevity Rituals, and miracles, and affected by Susceptibility to Warping and Raised from the Dead.

name: Aquam
description: A Hermetic Form governing water. Sources such as the Purest Stream and St. Swithin's Soupbowl yield Aquam vis, and a Hermetic rune for Aquam appears on a stone.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting of Ars Magica: a version of medieval Europe (canonically up to 1220) where myth and history mix, populated by historical kings and bishops as well as wizards, faeries, and other mystical creatures.

name: Arcane Connection
description: A magical link to a target (such as a strand of hair or a body part) that extends spell Range and boosts Penetration; its duration depends on the connection's nature and can be fixed in the laboratory.

name: Parma Magica
description: A Hermetic magical defense that contributes to a magus's Magic Resistance (Form + Parma Magica x 5 + Aura) and must be extended to cover an apprentice; subtracting spell level before Penetration makes it much more effective in Fifth Edition.

name: Auram
description: A Hermetic Form governing air and weather; referenced as a possible requisite when smoke is present and in spells that defeat the lie-detecting Frosty Breath of the Spoken Lie.

name: Demon
description: Infernal beings made of the essence of deception; summoning and dealing with them is forbidden in the Order, they cannot be reliably detected, and they can be fought with Vim magic.

name: Magic Resistance
description: A character's or creature's protection against magic, altered by aura modifiers; for creatures it equals Might Score plus aura modifier, and for those with True Faith it equals True Faith Score times ten.

name: Muto
description: The Hermetic Technique of transformation; Muto spells can change other Forms into species, treating them as a slightly unnatural solid, liquid, or gas with an Imaginem requisite.

name: Herbam
description: The Hermetic Form governing plants; Leonardo's golden section applies to Herbam magic and a substance's passion of being burned would directly be a Herbam spell.

name: House Tremere
description: A Founder whom Tytalus styled his "little brother" and never forgave for betrayal; Tytalus named his black dog familiar after him in spite, and his followers are derided as "wolves" by Tytalan magi.

name: Penetration
description: The measure of how strongly a spell or power overcomes Magic Resistance, computed from a casting total plus a Penetration Bonus (Penetration Ability x multiplier) minus spell level plus aura modifiers.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: The Tribunal of Mythic Germany covering the Rhineland and Eastern Marches into Bohemia; its covenants include Durenmar, Crintera, Fengheld, Irencillia, and Roznov, and it borders the Novgorod and Transylvanian Tribunals.

name: Second Sight
description: A supernatural Ability for seeing through illusions and the supernatural; True Sight Criamon magi may use Enigmatic Wisdom as if it were Second Sight, and spectral travelers can be seen by it.

name: Order of Hermes Lore
description: A General Ability covering knowledge of the legends, history, structure, operation, and goals of a specified organization; Order of Hermes Lore is a notable example.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: A Rego Vim ritual spell that wards a covenant, making participants and certain items 'native' while excluding foreign supernatural effects and creatures with Might. Created by Notatus, it incorporates Mercurian rituals and is based on the same breakthrough as Parma Magica.

name: Artes Liberales
description: An academic Ability covering the liberal arts (including the specialty of Rhetoric) favored by the Sophists; used as an Attack Ability in debate and taught to Tytalan apprentices.

name: Regio
description: A supernatural layered area whose 'upper' levels can be entered from the mundane level; the Resting Place of Mars has a Magical level ranked five and Saint Aquila a Divine level ranked seven.

name: Roman Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal spanning the Italian peninsula, Corsica, Sardinia, Sicily, the southern Alps and northern Africa; a land of intrigue, corruption and conflict among Magi.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: A Societas House gathering many magi from different, not fully Hermetic traditions; members gain a free Minor Hermetic Virtue, a free Major non-Hermetic Virtue, and a compulsory Major Hermetic Flaw.

name: Leadership
description: An Ability for commanding others; women raised to manage holdings always have Leadership scores, and the angel Seferiel has Leadership 7 with a specialty in magi.

name: House Verditius
description: A Mystery Cult House of magical crafters who incorporate craft into enchantment, are afflicted with the Hubris Flaw through their Inner Mysteries, and require casting tools to cast Formulaic spells.

name: Schism War
description: A Hermetic war (also called the Sundering/Domination) during which a pagan-filled House was annihilated and a tyrannical House (Tremere) was shattered; House Jerbiton withdrew and later aided reconstruction.

name: Tribunal
description: Regional governing assemblies of the Order of Hermes that enforce the Code, register covenants and magi, and serve as social and political gatherings. Sagas often pick a Tribunal as the setting for a covenant.

name: Longevity Ritual
description: A powerful supernatural effect always designed for a specific target that slows aging; it grants one Warping Point per year as a continuing effect and is effective until a crisis spends its power.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House whose domus magna, Fudarus, is in the Normandy Tribunal; drawn to the region's conflict and suffered a Corruption in the late ninth century.

name: Concentration
description: An Ability used to maintain concentration on spells and against disruptions such as sneezing; rolled to release individuals from Coils of the Entangling Plants.

name: House Diedne
description: One of the Twelve Founders, a woman cast out from the druid religion, who brought spontaneous magic to Bonisagus and founded House Diedne; in modern accounts her name is sometimes replaced with Trianoma's.

name: Durenmar
description: A leading Rhine covenant in the Black Forest that sponsors new covenants; it offered resources to bring Roznov into the Rhine, its leadership decides to recolonize the Rhine Gorge, and its Forum hosts initiations into the Order.

name: Awareness
description: The Ability used for noticing things; combined with Perception it determines the Form of a magical effect (Perception + Awareness vs. 15 - effect magnitude).

name: True Faith
description: A Divine blessing limited to beings not already part of the Divine Realm; creatures with Divine Might cannot have it, and Baal-Peor's vomit cannot touch those who possess it.

name: Finesse
description: A Hermetic Ability used to control the precise rearrangement of materials in Rego craft magic and to substitute for mundane craft rolls when using craft spells and devices.

name: Normandy Tribunal
description: A regional Tribunal of the Order where House Tytalus amassed political power and disputed Schism War vis sources with House Flambeau; site of legal institutions for distributing magical resources.

name: Familiar
description: A magical companion bonded to a maga through Merinita's enchantment using three cords; Merinita summoned the first familiar, a great stag, and faerie familiars have special powers and decaying cords.

name: Skinchanger
description: A Virtue gained by stronger supernatural members of werewolf families (often women/witches), granting shapeshifting plus other magical abilities; Bjornaer the Founder was one such witch.

name: Faerie Lore
description: An Ability representing knowledge of faeries; used to navigate faerie regiones in Initiations and combined with Magic Lore to inform Faerie Magic.

name: Philosophiae
description: A Hermetic Academic Ability measuring philosophical understanding, added to Verditius Lab Totals when carving Verditius runes and limiting Items of Quality bonuses.

name: Brawl
description: The combat Ability used for unarmed and natural-weapon attacks; all natural weapons (teeth, claws, hooves) use Brawl, and bulls have an Affinity with it.

name: Cult of Mercury
description: An ancient cult whose powerful rituals are sought as Hermetic treasures; a fallen temple of Mercury still contains details of some of its rituals, and recovering its lost rituals can be an object of a quest.

name: Grand Tribunal
description: The supreme Tribunal of the Order of Hermes that can modify the Code as practiced in all Tribunals; it ended the Tytalus-Flambeau conflict in 1063 and sponsored joint covenants.

name: Magic Lore
description: An Ability concerning knowledge of magical creatures and phenomena; used to resist Vulnerable-to-Folk-Tradition magi and to attempt re-entry against Banishing.

name: Folk Ken
description: An Ability used (with Awareness) to recognize hidden social or behavioral patterns, such as identifying the mushroom circle as dance steps.

name: Wizard's War
description: A formally declared state of legal conflict between magi under the Code of Hermes; threatened against Roznov's pagan magi and declared in Tribunal records between Flambeau, Tremere, and Diedne magi.

name: Athletics
description: Athletics: Ability used by holy or divine characters in this text, e.g. in Abbas the Hunted's or the Chalkydri's statistics or divine rules.

name: Charm
description: Casting aids made by magi who study Faerie Magic that identify a magical effect through sympathetic magic; they may be objects, performances, or pronouncements, and can boost Penetration and Casting Totals.

name: Minor Magical Focus
description: A Hermetic Virtue narrowing and strengthening a magus's magic; the range of a Supernatural Ability is meant to approximate one, and it is required for the Beast Masters tradition.

name: Initiation
description: The ritual process by which a magus acquires a Mystery Virtue, governed by an Ease Factor, Script Bonus, Quest, Ordeal, and Sacrifice; central to Bjornaer's heartbeast Mysteries and Criamon's stations.

name: Hedge Wizard
description: A practitioner of non-Hermetic magic who cannot be taught Hermetic Virtues but whose traditions can serve as sources of insight for Integration into Hermetic theory.

name: Area Lore
description: A Lore Ability whose score governs knowledge of local lacunae and familiarity with the similes of objects occurring in an area; can be specialized in lacunae.

name: Mystery Cult
description: Organizations that teach a mystery; four Houses of the Order of Hermes (Bjornaer, Criamon, Merinita, Verditius) are Mystery Cults whose members are Initiated into Outer and deeper Inner Mysteries.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: A Minor Virtue granting extra Characteristic points, particularly appropriate for predators; large beasts gain proportionally more points.

name: Intrigue
description: An Ability factors use to hire skilled criminals and to find allies or spread gossip against noble targets; combined with Communication or Intelligence in skullduggery and indirect action.

name: Premonitions
description: A supernatural Virtue granting forewarning of danger; Lord Robert Schonburg uses Premonitions to know when he is in trouble or about to be exposed.

name: Greater Alps Tribunal
description: A favored Hermetic Tribunal of House Jerbiton containing its domus magna Valnastium; the Code's provision against meddling with mundanes is virtually unenforceable there.

name: Talisman
description: Falke's talisman, a silver anklet-ring of watery crystal and amber attuned for +5 water effects and +3 Corpus, enchanted with Perceive the Change, Change Size, and Perceive Motives effects.

name: The Church
description: The dominant religious institution of Mythic Europe, headed by the Pope, the Bishop of Rome, and backed by the Divine. It structures medieval life around the seven sacraments, canon law, and a hierarchy of bishops, priests, monasteries, and parishes.

name: Gauntlet
description: The test, set by the parens and normally administered after fifteen years, that an apprentice must pass to become a full magus; Quaesitores set it after three failures.

name: Greater Immunity
description: A Major Virtue that a Bjornaer inner heartbeast may acquire (Ease Factor 30), also listed as a beast Virtue (e.g., immunity to fire or poison for a lizard).

name: Hunt
aliases: the Capture of the Wild Hunt
description: A group of faeries that terrorized Wales and the Marches in the early twelfth century, sweeping down on moonless nights; trapped behind enchanted cold-iron doors near Blackthorn by Flumen in 1154.

name: Civil and Canon Law
description: The Academic Ability covering legal knowledge, required at score 3 for the Town Magistrate Virtue and usable to quickly resolve court cases via a Communication roll.

name: House Merinita
description: Faerie-focused House whose magi may bring humans and faeries together to enforce binding agreements, and may use the Bloodline target.

name: Enchanting Music
description: A performance Ability; a Music score of six or higher is required for Imaginem vis to accumulate in Reginald's Rebec, and the rebec grants a +3 bonus to Music rolls.

name: Faerie Blood
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue granting natural longevity, faerie eyes (Second Sight and sight in darkness), Faerie Lore, and the benefits of a particular type of fay heritage; cannot be combined with Faerie Blood.

name: Stealth
description: The Ability governing hiding and moving unseen; gains large bonuses from invisibility for hiding, contested in opposed rolls to locate invisible characters.

name: Trianoma
description: The maga and apprentice of Bonisagus who traveled widely to recruit wizards and negotiate the Oath of Hermes, becoming the driving force behind the founding of the Order. She declined to be one of the twelve Founders.

name: Wizard's March
description: The ultimate sanction casting an offender from the Order, depriving him of the Code's protection so other magi may hunt and slay him; the target is called a renounced magus.

name: Bargain
description: A trade-related Ability in which factors are skilled and which can benefit from Affinity, Cautious, Puissant, or Vernacular Education; central to merchant negotiations.

name: Lab Text
description: A written record allowing magi to research magical creations, most commonly to invent a Formulaic spell, far more quickly than without assistance; a key covenant library resource.

name: Guile
description: An Ability governing deception and disguise used by Tytalan magi; rolled for disguises and serving as a Defense Ability in debate (supporting fabrication of the truth).

name: Heartbeast
description: The House Bjornaer mystery and Ability allowing a magus to transform into a single mundane animal that reflects her nature; the change is total so she is affected by Animal rather than Corpus or Mentem magic.

name: Latin
description: The scholarly language ability; a magus can rewrite up to Latin x 20 levels of Laboratory Texts per season to make them usable by others, and literacy in Latin is required to write or copy Lab Texts.

name: Novgorod Tribunal
description: A Tribunal bordering Pomerania to which Livonia and (officially) Denmark/Scandinavia belong; a region of contention with the Rhine over Pomerania and Baltic vis sites.

name: Constantinople
description: The great trading city at the gateway between Europe and the Orient, founded as Byzantium in 658 BC and renamed by Emperor Constantine; captured by the Fourth Crusade in 1204 to become the Latin Empire's seat.

name: Survival
description: A General Ability covering finding food, water, shelter, routes, and safety in the wilderness, including building fires and cooking without implements.

name: Hibernia Tribunal
description: A region where the Daughters of Echo league's leader lives near Burnfoot and where The Single Ocean's headquarters are technically located.

name: Provençal Tribunal
description: Tribunal to the south of Normandy, bordered at the River Dordogne; its border with Normandy is decided on linguistic grounds (langue d'oc vs langue d'oeil).

name: Teaching
description: An Ability that adds to the Source Quality when a character teaches; the maximum number of students equals the teacher's Teaching score times five.

name: Giant's Dance
description: The great stone circle Merlin magically moved from Mount Killaraus in Ireland to Britain, erecting it around the tomb of those slain at Ambrius (Stonehenge).

name: Medicine
description: The academic Ability for establishing preventative health regimes and curing diseases, requiring knowledge of anatomy, physiology, and the non-naturals; used for diagnosis and prognosis.

name: Primus
description: The titular head of a House of the Order; in House Tytalus the Primus is merely the most skilled member rather than a true leader, holding the office because the Order expects it.

name: Theology
description: The highest-ranked Academic Ability concerning religious doctrine, with faith-specific variants (Christian, Islamic, Judaic) used for writing books and disputationes against other faiths.

name: Animal Handling
description: The Ability used to command and teach tamed animals; a Master of the Pack uses Animal Handling instead of Leadership to control dogs, and instead of Teaching to give beasts experience.

name: Dark Secret
description: A Flaw gained at the lupellis Initiation, reflecting membership in a secret murderous cult; for magi it represents knowingly flouting the Hermetic Oath.

name: Single Weapon
description: Single Weapon: Ability used by holy or divine characters in this text, e.g. in Abbas the Hunted's or the Chalkydri's statistics or divine rules.

name: Confidence
description: A pool of points a character can spend to add +3 per point to a roll after seeing the result; points are awarded for achievements and good roleplaying.

name: Entrancement
description: A Supernatural Ability (always Range Eye, Duration Special, Target Individual) using Rego Mentem guidelines to control a human's emotions and thoughts; the defining magic of the Malocchi.

name: Spell Mastery
description: A Hermetic system allowing magi to gain special abilities for known spells (such as Rebuttal, Still Casting, and Unravelling) and reduce botch dice; mastery can be studied from books.

name: Transylvanian Tribunal
description: Tribunal where one covenant occupies a mountain valley and maintains a visitors' pavilion at the valley's mouth, two miles from the covenant's library.

name: Chirurgy
description: A healing Ability practiced by chirurgeons; the Surgical Empiricus Flaw restricts the character to a single specialization, halving the score for other applications.

name: Educated
description: A Minor General Virtue for education in a beit ha-midrash or yeshivah, granting Academic Abilities and 50 experience points in Hebrew, Aramaic, and Judaic studies.

name: Holy Roman Empire
description: Holy Roman Emperor, tutored by Honorius III and crowned by him in 1220; his delays on crusade hamper recovery of the Holy Land and he is deposed at Lyons in 1245 if history is followed.

name: Magic Sensitivity
description: A supernatural Virtue that lets a character sense magical auras and presences; held by the Scribe template and offered as an option for the Minstrel.

name: Tough
description: A Minor Virtue acquirable by a Bjornaer inner heartbeast and suitable for beasts such as the bear, boar, and wolf; stacks with Thick Fur and Tough Hide for Protection.

name: Wealthy
description: A Virtue representing greater than average wealth for a trader of a given type; a Wealthy character could declare independence from a company and found a new business.

name: Animal Ken
description: A Virtue allowing communication with and influence over animals; possessed by Crintera's Horse Clan and useful for werewolves to calm animals' fearful reactions.

name: Dominion Lore
description: A supernatural Ability covering knowledge of the Divine realm; the angels Seferiel (Divine Lore 10) and Nasir (Dominion Lore 8) both have it with a specialty in angels.

name: Inspirational
description: A Minor, General Virtue making a character a stirring speaker or heroic figure, granting targets +3 to appropriate Personality Trait rolls.

name: Loch Leglean Tribunal
description: The Hermetic tribunal covering Scotland north of Hadrian's Wall, named for Pralix's winter camp; the largest tribunal by number of magi, dominated by House Ex Miscellanea.

name: Lycanthrope
description: A Flaw causing loss of control over an inner heartbeast for a few nights each month; some Great Beasts inflict it on their Initiates, and it is a major hindrance within House Bjornaer.

name: Puissant Art
description: A Virtue granting a bonus to an Art or Ability, applied in Hephaestion's Terram (Puissant Art) and Craft Metalsmith (Puissant Ability) Lab Total examples.

name: University of Paris
description: An influential medieval university that in 1220 has banned teaching the New Aristotle under threat of excommunication, with its bans echoing throughout northern Europe.

name: Affinity
description: A natural principle by which secondary qualities of a person transfer to an object (and can repel opposite qualities as antipathy), underlying many Shape and Material bonuses.

name: Etiquette
description: The Ability central to Jerbiton 'tasteful living,' used to convey symbolic messages, make individual impressions at events, and force rivals into faux pas.

name: Social Contacts
description: A Virtue providing useful social connections; gained temporarily by a marriage broker, and possessed by smugglers and their suppliers because many people sympathize with them.

name: Visions
description: A Flaw that gives the bearer prophetic dreams or visions; Maria has it to predict the volcano, Adranus can grant it, and Valkyries possess it to know where worthy men will die.

name: Aura of Rightful Authority
description: A Penetration 0 aura extending to Voice Range possessed by Divine-protected religious and secular leaders such as the Pope, cardinals, archbishops, and crowned kings.

name: Companion
description: Noteworthy non-grog, non-magus characters who may be played alongside magi; suggested examples include foresters, merchants, priests, and figures like Torven and David ben David.

name: Enigmatic Wisdom
description: A House Criamon Ability that grants far-reaching perception of strange phenomena, aids comprehension of Wizard's Twilight (while making it more likely), and can substitute for Chirurgy and Medicine on the Path of the Body.

name: Faerie Magic
aliases: the Outer Mystery of Faerie Magic
description: An Arcane Ability and the Outer Mystery learned by Merinitae representing how their magic differs from normal Hermetic magic, governing charms, faerie vis, and faerie-magic botches.

name: Ghost
description: The disembodied spirit of a dead person, associated with Mentem; ghosts can be warded against, summoned, coerced, or controlled by Mentem magic.

name: Infernal Lore
description: An Arcane Ability concerning knowledge of the Infernal; the Diabolic Past Flaw permits its purchase even when Arcane Abilities are normally restricted.

name: True Love
description: A Minor General Virtue: the character has found the one person meant for them, giving +3 to appropriate Personality Trait rolls; the True Love must be another player character with this Virtue.

name: Craft
description: The skill governing a craftsman's production; a character's Craft Ability score determines Workshop Totals and how many items can be produced in a season.

name: Dragon
description: A class of predominantly faerie dragons ('worms'): vast venomous snakes that crave vital things such as cows' milk or virgins and often poison their surroundings.

name: Hoplite
description: An informal group of combat magi, many from House Flambeau, who work with the Quaesitores to hunt down and slay magi cast out of the Order for crimes.

name: Iberia
description: The region where Ramius joined House Flambeau's struggle against the Moorish wizards and perfected his combat method.

name: Free Expression
description: A Minor Virtue prized by artistic Jerbiton magi; can be granted or doubled by a muse and grants familiarity bonuses with depicted objects.

name: Pralix
description: The founder of the Lineage and the Ordo Miscellanea who defeated Damhan-Allaidh, learned a Supernatural Ability from an ancient wizard, and integrated her order into the Order of Hermes.

name: Proud
description: A Personality Flaw that automatically increases a Verditius magus's Hubris score (by 1 for Minor, 3 for Major); also gained as a Personality Trait by magi converted into the House.

name: Wilderness Sense
description: A Supernatural Ability granting mystical attunement to the wilderness, allowing a roll to determine north, weather, or the presence of natural hazards or resources.

name: Carouse
description: A General Ability for enjoying oneself without adverse effects, such as consuming alcohol without passing out and gaining friends among the lower classes.

name: Disfigured
description: A Flaw earned by a single visible tattoo, considered uglier than a scar by medieval people; commonly afflicting tattooed Criamon magi.

name: Mythic Companion
description: A powerful tier of player character that may take up to 10 points of Flaws and twice the normal Virtues, defined by a Free Virtue specifying which type of Mythic Companion they are.

name: Peripheral Code
description: Body of Tribunal rulings interpreting the Code, which differs between Tribunals and governs matters like Wizard War and mundane involvement.

name: Relic
description: Physical objects housing part of the power of the Divine, often parts of saints' bodies; they grant Faith Points, Divine Might, Magic Resistance, and an aura hostile to Infernal creatures.

name: Ride
description: An Ability used when employing an animal as a mount, which can substitute for Animal Handling and adds to Attack and Defense in mounted combat.

name: Ritual Magic
description: A type of elaborate spell that always requires botch dice (unless mastered) and whose effects cannot be placed in enchantments unless they are Ritual only due to level over 50.

name: Arthur
description: A claimant given into Hubert de Burgh's custody by King John, who ordered him killed; Hubert refused and feigned it, but John later took Arthur and he was never seen alive again.

name: Cathars
description: A heresy spreading in southern France (Languedoc) against which Brother Julian preaches and which the Church combats through the faculties of theology.

name: Charlemagne
description: The Frankish ruler who attempted (and failed) to dig a canal linking the Main and Danube, and whose late-eighth-century monetary reforms fixed the pound-of-silver system used in Mythic Europe in 1220.

name: Deficient Technique
description: A Hermetic Flaw weakening a magus in a particular Form; Philippus Niger is deficient in Imaginem and Imanitos Mendax in Animal and Ignem.

name: Demon's Eternal Oblivion
description: A Perdo Vim spell known by Philippus Niger that destroys demonic Might; basis for his variants Dreadful Bane of the Fae and Sap the Griffin's Strength.

name: England
description: A kingdom of Mythic Europe where women have fewer rights than in most other parts (partly an effect of the Norman Conquest) and large areas are set aside as noble hunting ranges; its king has sworn fealty to the king of France for mainland possessions.

name: Jerusalem
description: A major city of Mythic Europe suggested as a covenant location; casting a spell in its Church of the Holy Sepulcher carries the maximum botch dice.

name: Levant Tribunal
description: Tribunal existing since shortly after the Order's founding that gained attention during the crusades; home of the Covenant of Al Arama.

name: Mercer House
description: Powerful permanent magical gateways crafted by House Mercere, enchanted with the Hermes Portal effect; each connects to one matching pair, with hubs at Harco and Durenmar.

name: Self-Confident
description: A Virtue shared by all magi who survive a Tytalan apprenticeship, earned upon defeating one's master in the Apprentice's Gauntlet.

name: Swim
description: A General Ability for propelling oneself through water quickly and efficiently, with specialties in long distances, diving, and underwater maneuvering.

name: The Leap of Homecoming
description: A teleportation spell; each Redcap carries an enchanted item casting a higher-level version once per day to return himself and his horse to Mercer House.

name: Giant
description: Huge humanoid faeries (giants, ogres, trolls) that typically guard spaces in faerie stories; unlike Magical giants they are drawn to humans, harvest vitality through terror, and regenerate.

name: Holy Land
description: The region of the Crusades where Saracen wizards practice and some Flambeau magi fight non-Hermetic wizards.

name: King John
description: The late king of England, Henry III's father, remembered for arbitrary rule, the loss of Normandy, the interdict, and his volatility; he submitted England as a vassal of the Holy See.

name: Pilum of Fire
description: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 20) that flings a spear-shaped jet of fire from the caster's palms, doing +15 damage to the individual it hits.

name: Sense Holiness and Unholiness
description: A Supernatural Ability granted by the Divine realm to feel the presence of good and evil in areas, persons, or objects, including detecting demons and angels.

name: Ars Goetia
description: A sorcerous tradition dealing with the summoning, binding, commanding, ablating, and punishment of spiritual entities of all realms except the Divine; practiced by Guorna and Tytalus and socially tainted.

name: Domus Magna
description: The principal covenant of a Hermetic House, many of which have excellent libraries focused on their House's interests; examples include Durenmar and the Cave of Twisting Shadows.

name: Fragile Constitution
description: A Minor General Flaw making the character sickly with a -3 penalty on rolls to recover from wounds and diseases.

name: Great Weapon
description: A combat Ability used for large two-handed weapons such as the cudgel, pole arm, great sword, long spear, and warhammer.

name: Hibernian Tribunal
description: Frontier Tribunal to which young Alpine magi may emigrate; Kentigern's beast-mage tradition comes from Hibernia.

name: Long-Winded
description: A Minor Virtue acquirable by a Bjornaer inner heartbeast and suitable for beasts such as the wild goat, horse, and wolf.

name: Order of Odin
description: Supposed order of Scandinavian wizards feared by Hermetic magi; in truth Norse magicians have no formal order, and quaesitores treat claims it is false as evidence of collusion.

name: Piercing Gaze
description: A Minor General Virtue letting a character unsettle people with an intent stare and gain +3 to intimidation rolls; faeries and demons are unaffected.

name: Reputation
description: A game trait representing how a character is known in society; deep cover disguises establish a Reputation that grows like an Ability and offsets the social penalty of The Gift.

name: Susceptibility to Infernal Power
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character is especially vulnerable to dark powers, risking illness in Infernal auras and having halved Magic Resistance against infernal effects.

name: Theban Tribunal
description: A Tribunal founded in the 9th century and later given separate recognition, which sponsored a covenant in the Slavic lands during the eastward expansion.

name: Archmage
description: A free Social Status Virtue applicable to any Tribunal, granting the title archimagus, a high Hermetic Reputation, and an additional proxy vote in the Rhine.

name: Bologna
description: A famous student-run university in northern Italy, the finest legal school in Mythic Europe, organized around student nations and faculties of Law and of Arts and Medicine.

name: Elemental
description: Magical creatures composed of pure elemental matter (earth, water, air, or fire) formed through rarefication under a magical impetus; not truly alive, they do not age, eat, or reproduce and recover Might only slowly in a Magic aura.

name: Good Teacher
description: A Virtue improving the quality of works a character produces; Hildegard of Bingen's Good Teacher Virtue contributes to the exceptional Quality of her writings.

name: Lame
description: A Minor General Flaw in which both of the character's legs are severely damaged, requiring crutches and heavily penalizing movement and combat.

name: Poor
description: A Flaw representing less than average wealth for a trader; can be combined with Employed by a Company given troupe approval, and reduces a local carrier to a single pack animal's goods.

name: Subtle Magic
description: A Hermetic Virtue letting a magus cast spells without gestures, exemplified by the Sorcerous Musician Orlando who can cast while playing or singing.

name: Theurgy
description: A Hermetic Mystery of summoning and dealing with spirits, including Aspects of Daimons, requiring synthemata and long invocations; ordinary Hermetic magic cannot summon a Daimon's Aspect without it.

name: Ways of the Forest
description: Virtue representing an elemental's intuitive understanding of the environment that spawned it, e.g. Ways of the Cavern, River, Storm, Forest Fire.

name: Well-Traveled
description: A Minor General Virtue: the character has journeyed extensively, gaining 50 bonus experience points for living languages, Area Lores, and social abilities.

name: Daimon
description: Ancient, named individual spirits dwelling deep in the Magic Realm, being the spirits of heroes, ancient pagan deities, or sacred groves; they cannot enter the material world but project Aspects of themselves as agents on Earth.

name: Harco
description: Domus Magnus of House Mercere in the hills of Piedmont, founded 776/778, a wealthy mercantile covenant controlling Hermes Portals and messages across the Order.

name: Knights Templar
aliases: Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon
description: A military order of monk-knights founded by Hugh de Payns and Godfrey of St. Omer in 1118, notable for banking and building round churches including one in London.

name: Legerdemain
description: An Ability used by a thieving performer to pick a victim's pocket via a Dexterity + Legerdemain roll while the crowd is captivated.

name: Noncombatant
description: A Flaw making a creature unwilling or unable to fight; possessed by the courser horse and the caladrius and listed among Flaws suitable for beasts.

name: Quiet Magic
description: A Virtue (also called Quiet Magic) that the Silent Ones league seeks to integrate into standard Hermetic practice for casting inconspicuously in cities.

name: Semita Errabunda
description: An established example covenant of six magi (including Darius, Carolus, Mari, Moratamis, Tillitus, and the unGifted Redcap Victor) used to illustrate Prevailing Loyalty calculations.

name: Sharp Ears
description: Virtue possessed by the Black Dog of the Moor and White Stag; incompatible with Weak or Sensitive Hearing.

name: Wizard's Communion
description: A Hermetic ritual spell cast cooperatively by between three and twelve magi; a life-sized diagram for it appears in the biggest codex of the Durenmar Library, and it may be led dangerously from a casting tablet.

name: Angel
description: Creatures of the Divine Might who act on behalf of God; genderless beings who can manifest in mortal flesh via their Angelic Mantle and are never bothered by The Gift.

name: Favors
description: A Story Flaw representing being an agent who is periodically contacted by a principal or factor to provide information or assistance; also a minor inconvenient flaw on the Resistance table.

name: Iberian Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose over-competitive team in 1151 earned 13th place in the Tourney, giving rise to the Siege of Shame.

name: Large
description: Minor General Virtue that changes a magic character's Size without modifying Strength or Quickness; for Beasts of Virtue it gives -1 Quickness and +2 Strength.

name: Necessary Condition
description: A Flaw imposed as a Great Beast's Ordeal requiring a condition for magic (e.g., a bull chimera touching the ground); also a common Bjornaer flaw when in human or heartbeast form.

name: Plagued by Supernatural Entity
description: A Major Flaw gained by a new magister luperci: the Daimon sends a creature of judgment to watch him and punish him when he acts inappropriately.

name: Puissant Mentem
description: Virtue adding to an Ability score; can be replaced during transitions (e.g. Puissant Latin, Puissant Craft).

name: Satan
description: The tempter who led Adam and Eve to sin in the Garden of Eden, bringing about Original Sin; the devil to whom an evil lord might sell his soul for infernal powers.

name: Sicily
description: The Mediterranean island beneath whose Mount Etna the fire spirit Adranus dwells, whose inhabitants once worshipped him as a god of fire.

name: Small Frame
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is of lighter-than-average build with Size reduced to -1; incompatible with Giant Blood, Large, or Dwarf.

name: Temporal Influence
description: A minor general Virtue granting influence in mundane government or institutions; raises an agent's Resistance Strength, as with the merchant Godfroi.

name: The Chirurgeon's Healing Touch
description: A Creo Corpus spell (CrCo20) that magically closes wounds; under Unnatural Magic, wounds it closes reopen because the magic lasts only a moment.

name: Thebes Tribunal
description: A Tribunal where vis is scarce and magical animals plentiful, where Verditius magi developed the Bind Magical Creatures Mystery.

name: Warrior
description: A Minor General Virtue: the character is trained to fight, may acquire Martial Abilities at creation, and gains 50 experience points spent on Martial Abilities.

name: Accelerated Expiry
description: Form-specific Magic Defenses gruagachan receive for each Gruagach Art they possess, such as Magical Fortitude (Give) against Corpus effects and Strength of Form (Shape) against Corpus or Animal effects.

name: Close Family Ties
description: A Minor Story Flaw: the character's family is one of the most important things in their life and supports them even at personal risk, but requires help in return.

name: Dominicans
description: An orthodox religious Order whose friars at Paris live in private hospices, strictly adhere to papal authority, and criticize teachers of possibly heretical ideas.

name: Dowsing
description: A Supernatural Ability to find things nearby using a dowsing rod and an intuitive sense, requiring a sympathetic connection to the thing sought.

name: Giant Blood
description: A Virtue indicating descent from giants, cited as a possible background Virtue for an Ex Miscellanea magus and common among the Damhadh-Duidsan.

name: Henry II
description: A former king of England whose reign featured William Marshal's early career, the Henry of Essex duel, and afforestations later restricted by the Charter of the Forest.

name: Lesser Malediction
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character has been cursed by a supernatural power, with effects about as bad as other Minor General Flaws.

name: Merlin
description: The greatest mage in the history of the tribunal, of mysterious birth and fate, connected with Arthur's rise; Hermetic opinion holds he was half fay, and he raised Stonehenge and enabled Arthur's conception.

name: Profession: Scribe
description: A profession Ability; in one season a character can copy Profession: Scribe x 60 levels of Laboratory Texts that are already written understandably.

name: Reserves of Strength
description: A Minor General Virtue letting a character once per day add +3 to effective Strength for an action, requiring two Fatigue rolls afterward.

name: Scotland
description: The realm covered by the Loch Leglean Tribunal, settled over centuries by Broch-builders, Picts, Scots, Vikings, Britons and Saxons.

name: Seekers
description: A loose organization of competitive magi searching for ancient magic and arcane artifacts, detailed in Houses of Hermes: True Lineages.

name: Spontaneous Magic
description: Magic producing effects not corresponding to a spell the magus knows, decided at the moment of casting; can be fatiguing or non-fatiguing.

name: Strong-Willed
description: A Minor General Virtue giving +3 on any roll requiring strength of will; the character cannot easily be coerced into activities, beliefs, or feelings.

name: Venice
description: The dominant north Italian city-state of Mythic Europe, controlling trade with Constantinople and the Levant and monopolies on alum and potash; its Doge annually weds the sea with a vis-bearing ring.

name: Vow
description: A Minor Personality Flaw representing a solemn religious obligation, taken by priests for celibacy and by Cathar Perfecti and Mazdean priests for ritual purity.

name: gruagachan
description: A loose association of Pictish wizards (singular gruagach) who use the Pictish language in their magic and focus on affecting themselves and individuals; accepted into House Ex Miscellanea despite being unable to learn parma magica.

name: Apprentice
description: A magus-in-training whose Arts are opened by a master over a season; the master must extend Parma Magica to cover the apprentice and meet score requirements to avoid Deficiencies.

name: Arcane Lore
description: A Minor General Virtue letting a character take Arcane Abilities and gain 50 experience points spent on them; required to learn lores like Infernal or Dominion Lore unless otherwise allowed.

name: Berserk
description: A Virtue causing a creature to fight with reckless fury for greater attack at the cost of defense; possessed by the wild boar and an earth elemental.

name: Ceremony
description: Virtue and Ability allowing a leader to combine the efforts of several practitioners, granting a Ceremony bonus when awakening golems or seeking True Names.

name: Clear Thinker
description: A Virtue that decreases the penalties for reduced Fatigue Levels in debate by one point and is recommended for politically minded Tytalan magi.

name: Dutybound
description: A Flaw binding a character to a sense of duty; those with this Flaw who partake of Honos' Centurions' Feast are instantly cured of Light and Medium Wounds.

name: Enduring Constitution
description: A Minor, General Virtue allowing a character to withstand pain and fatigue, reducing Fatigue and wound penalties and granting +3 to resist pain.

name: Faerie Friend
description: A Flaw taken as an Ordeal in the sample Line of Quendalon Initiation, representing a befriended faerie appropriate to the Initiate's highest Technique and Form.

name: Formulaic Magic
description: A category of Hermetic spell with fixed parameters, distinct from Spontaneous and Ritual magic, affected by Virtues like Boosted and Flexible Formulaic Magic.

name: Greedy
description: A Minor Personality Flaw driving a character toward acquisitiveness; the Nephilim must take it due to their enormous appetite.

name: Infamous
description: A minor Flaw representing a damaging reputation, likely to inconvenience a principal and lower an agent's Resistance Strength.

name: Italy
description: Peninsula comprising the Roman Tribunal, divided among communes, Papal States and the Kingdom of Sicily.

name: Jesus Christ
description: The Son of God who became human, whose death (the Crucifixion) paid the penalty for all human sins and who rose from the dead in the Resurrection; in the Mass the bread and wine become His Body and Blood.

name: Keen Vision
description: A Minor Virtue acquirable by a Bjornaer inner heartbeast, appropriate for an eagle heartbeast and possessed by crows, eagles, and wild goats.

name: Learned Magicians
description: Magicians who influence luck, health, and magic with protective devices and trade in protecting buildings against magical siege engines.

name: Michael
description: A minor demon (Might 10, Corpus) who tempts people to wrath through elaborate, painful practical jokes disguised as the victim's friends, taking the name of the famous angel.

name: Mystagogue
description: A charismatic Mystery Cult figure who commands a probationer and grants Initiation; Criamon usually use guides instead, though the Paths of Mirror and Strife use formal Mystagogues.

name: Personal Vis Source
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue granting exclusive access to a supply of raw vis yielding about one tenth of the player covenant's expected annual gathering.

name: Privileged Upbringing
description: A Minor General Virtue giving 50 extra experience points spendable on General, Academic, or Martial Abilities from a childhood with teachers and study time.

name: True Name
description: A secret name expressing a being's spiritual essence, serving as an indefinite-duration Arcane Connection; demons, angels, jinn, and Daimons all have one, learned at a cost of 5 experience points.

name: Byzantine Empire
description: The empire against which Sikelgaita of Sicily's husband fought; Norman conquests in Byzantium were lost after the war turned against her family.

name: Circle of Beast Warding
description: A Rego Animal spell (Level 5) in which the caster inscribes a circle that no normal beast will cross.

name: Circular Ward Against Demons
description: A Rego Vim spell (R: Touch, D: Ring, T: Circle) that prevents creatures with Infernal Might equal to or less than its level from entering a circle or harming those within; at night it may appear as a silver-hued dome.

name: Cistercian Order
description: A monastic order founded by Robert of Molesme at Cîteaux and spread by Bernard of Clairvaux, the white monks who farm sheep in isolated areas and drive out inhabitants of acquired lands.

name: Damhan-Allaidh
description: Scottish wizard ('the Spider') who practiced blood and sacrifice magic, refused to join the Order, and fought Pralix; his body vanished after his defeat and he is thought to survive.

name: Faerie Sight
description: The ability to read glamour, allowing the holder to see magical things and tell what other faeries want simply by looking at them.

name: Frosty Breath of the Spoken Lie
description: An Intellego Mentem spell (Level 20) that makes a target exhale misty breath with each spoken lie; House Guernicus brought it to the Order and it is essential to Quaesitors.

name: Fudarus
description: The domus magna of House Tytalus, where the memory of Kalliste is ritually cursed each midwinter; it is currently occupied by both rival Primi and maintains an immense spy network.

name: Glamour
description: The intricate mystical rules (a corruption of 'grammar') a faerie must follow, defining its nature, powers, appearance and how it seeks vitality; faeries have glamour instead of a soul.

name: Hermes Portal
description: A high-level Rego Terram ritual that creates a magical portal for near-instantaneous travel between two locations, cast simultaneously at both.

name: Higher Purpose
description: A Personality Flaw of dedication to a cause, suggested for Mithraic characters and milites who take the Code of Garus seriously.

name: Jinn
description: A Free Virtue marking a category of spirits associated with the Islamic lands, who are all vulnerable to Sahir magic and may belong to the Magic, Faerie, or Infernal realms.

name: Lesser Power
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting a limited power designed as a Lesser power; activation costs Fatigue levels based on Might cost. Also a Magic Quality.

name: Magvillus
description: Domus Magnus of House Quaesitor in the mountains of the Kingdom of Sicily, founded A.D. 830; heart of Hermetic law, riven between Traditionalists and Transitionalists.

name: Praeco
description: The presiding senior officer of a tribunal who calls magi forward, sets the order of business, and convenes tribunals; normally the oldest maga but in Stonehenge held by Talion of Blackthorn.

name: St Paul
description: A grog used in the complex combat example, on patrol with Gerard and Ignatio into a faerie forest where faeries create duplicates of them.

name: Supernatural Nuisance
description: A Major Story Flaw in which supernatural entities interfere in the character's life in minor ways, without long-term plans, whenever he is around them.

name: Tainted with Evil
description: A Minor General Flaw in which an air of corruption surrounds the character, making others ill at ease and making positive Reputation impossible.

name: Thrown Weapon
description: The missile-combat Ability used for thrown weapons such as the throwing axe, javelin, knife, and sling.

name: Valnastium
description: The domus magna of House Jerbiton, a secluded valley covenant in the Greater Alps founded by Iconophiles to store icons and relics; filled with alien ancient art and home to the cats of the Black Lineage.

name: Wise One
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a member of a broad class of mystics, seers, and healers, well regarded in the community.

name: (Living Language)
description: A General Ability representing fluency in a particular living language, measured on a fluency scale from point-and-grunt to elegant.

name: Compulsion
description: A Personality Flaw driving a creature toward a behavior; wolves have Compulsion (killing) reflecting their bloodthirsty medieval perception.

name: Custos
description: A social-status Virtue denoting a trusted covenant servant or guard, taken by the glass-blower, lore-master, and political agent templates.

name: Divine Ascent
description: Unique form of Warping experienced by holy characters, codified by Dionysus the Areopagite, taking the forms Divine Gloom, Divine Form or Divine Unity.

name: Driven
description: A Personality Flaw compelling a character to pursue a particular goal relentlessly; Darius is Driven to hunt enemies of the Order.

name: Fear
description: A Minor Personality Flaw gained as an Ordeal in the sample Wayfarers Arcadian Travel Initiation, representing dread of something encountered on the path.

name: Ferocity
description: A Minor Virtue for beasts only, granting confidence points usable when the animal's natural ferocity is triggered, such as defending its den; possessed by many of the Beasts of Legend.

name: Franciscan Order
description: A mendicant order of friars founded in Italy in 1209, found preaching in market places and public squares, which had not yet spread beyond Italy and France.

name: Genius Locus
description: A spirit embodying and protecting a particular forest, formed from the fragmentation of the great Hercynian Forest spirit; each has a Might score, Personality Traits, and Special Powers.

name: Ghostly Warder
description: A bound ghost covenfolk template with Magic Might 10 (Mentem), insubstantial and invisible, that stands watch over a covenant; bound magically rather than haunting.

name: Greater Malediction
description: A Major Supernatural Flaw in which the character has been cursed by a supernatural power in a way comparable to other Major Flaws.

name: Greater Purifying Touch
description: A Supernatural Virtue (Greater or Lesser) cited as a possible Major Virtue for a magus Ex Miscellanea and common among the Scinnfolk.

name: Henry III
description: The twelve-year-old king of England in 1220 (born 1207, crowned 1216), a minor under the regency triumvirate; pious, devoted to St. Edward the Confessor, with a love of hunting and luxury.

name: Hex
description: A Supernatural Ability to bring injury or ruin upon enemies via eye contact, occult signs, or sympathetic magic, often a false power tainted by the Infernal.

name: Holy Magic
description: Supernatural Ability, analogous to Magic Theory, letting a magus use magic harmoniously with the Divine, invoked by prayer instead of Hermetic words and gestures.

name: Initiation Ordeal
description: A terrible rite such as branding or walking through fire that permanently marks the Initiate with a new Flaw and reduces Target Levels of later Initiations.

name: Inventive Genius
description: A laboratory Virtue that, when held by an assistant or researcher, applies to the primary researcher's efforts; it also adds three to insight-investigation rolls.

name: Knight
description: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for a member of the noble warrior class who may have high-quality weapons, armor, and a horse, and take Martial Abilities.

name: Landed Noble
description: A Major Social Status Virtue granting a character an agency prior to play; listed with a Resistance of 3 on the Resistance of Agents Table.

name: Monastic Vows
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character has taken vows of poverty, chastity, and obedience to a religious superior, as a friar, monk, or nun.

name: Nocturnal
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character's body rhythms keep him sleeping until noon, giving -1 on all rolls between dawn and midday but ease at night.

name: Oath of Fealty
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character has sworn loyalty and support to someone outside the covenant; magi are forbidden from such oaths by the Hermetic Code.

name: Obsession
description: A demonic power tied to a particular sin which the demon may impose upon a mortal indulging in a venial sin, granting the victim a sinful Personality Trait.

name: Outsider
description: Social Status Flaw (Minor or Major) for members of distrusted groups such as Jews, Saracens, or Moors, giving a bad Reputation; required of Jewish grogs (Minor) and companions (Major).

name: Philip Augustus
description: King of France, called Augustus, who annexed Normandy and rules with divine mandate; target of several plots.

name: Picts
description: Ancient tattooed people of Caledonia from whose priesthood the gruagachan descend; they ceased to exist as an independent tribe after the Battle of the False Sun.

name: Pope Innocent III
description: The pope who established Dominic's Order in 1216, sanctioned the Franciscans, recognized subdeacons as a major order, and was himself a university man.

name: Posing the Silent Question
description: An Intellego Mentem spell (Level 20) that lets the caster ask one silent mental question of a target and detect the answer, limited by the target's knowledge.

name: Profession
description: A Craft-like Ability for an artist's trade; performance maestros use Communication + Profession Ability + Form when instilling effects.

name: Prohibition
description: A gruagach Duration imposing a magical prohibition whose violation triggers a curse; its magnitude depends on whether the prohibition is sweeping, general or specific.

name: Queen of the Faeries
description: A faerie ruler from whom Tytalus claimed he would win his "heart's desire" in the Maddenhofen Woods; rumors say Tytalus may one day win free from her and return.

name: Sanctum
description: An area, usually a magus's laboratory and living quarters, designated under Hermetic law; by a ruling of the Grand Tribunal of 997 it must be marked by a circle inscribed in a square with diagonals.

name: Social Handicap
description: A Minor General Flaw in which some trait keeps the character from interacting easily with people, causing -3 on appropriate rolls.

name: Summoning
description: Faerie bargaining art/Virtue for calling faeries and holding them in attendance to bargain; Summoning Total is stress die + Presence + Summoning + Faerie Rank + aura.

name: Traditional Ward
description: A taboo that a faerie may not touch with its glamour; it cannot regenerate Might in the ward's presence and is harmed if forced to touch it.

name: Weakness
description: A Personality Flaw giving a character an irresistible attraction to something (e.g. books or good food); held by the Spying Maid and Lord of the Manor.

name: Arcane Discovery
description: The process by which magi expand Hermetic magic, accumulating breakthrough points toward Minor, Major, or Hermetic Breakthroughs through experimentation or integration.

name: Chapter House
description: A small dependent covenant founded at a valuable site far from a covenant's main holding, tending to agitate for independence from its motherhouse.

name: Clerk
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a literate professional such as a scribe, accountant, lawyer, or functionary, possibly in minor or holy orders.

name: Decrepitude
description: A score that increases like an Ability as a character accumulates Aging Points; at 4 the character is frail and must roll on the Crisis Table, and at 5 is bedridden.

name: Deleterious Circumstances
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw that halves all of the magus's magic totals (excluding Magic Resistance) under certain uncommon circumstances of state, target, or place.

name: Fengheld
description: One of the two most powerful Rhine covenants, founded in the Harz Mountains in 1039 by veteran Tremere and Flambeau magi; rival to Durenmar and keen to found a chapter house in the Rhine Gorge.

name: Feud
description: A major Flaw representing an ongoing feud likely to inconvenience a principal, lowering an agent's Resistance Strength.

name: Focus Power
description: A Major, Supernatural Virtue granting a supernatural power with a narrow range of effects, like a magical focus, with a 25-point pool for effect level and Penetration.

name: Great Presence
description: Virtue increasing a Characteristic such as Great Strength; stacking limits count Mutable versions twice.

name: Greater Power
description: A Major, Supernatural Virtue granting an at-will supernatural power equivalent to a Formulaic Hermetic spell of level 50 or lower.

name: Heir
description: A Minor Story Flaw in which the character stands to inherit land and money, but others may try to remove him from the line of succession.

name: Irencillia
description: The domus magna of House Merinita, an Autumn covenant hidden deep in faerie woods of the Bohemian Forest, founded by Quendalon; it appears differently to each visitor due to faerie glamour and has a patchy Faerie aura.

name: Lightning Reflexes
description: A Virtue granting superior reflexes, cited in connection with the adder's reflexive attacks and listed as suitable for beasts.

name: Magister in Artibus
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for one who has incepted Master of Arts at a European university and completed compulsory teaching, entitling them to teach anywhere in Europe.

name: Mass
description: Around two thousand landvaettir attending the current guardian of Iceland, able to heal it, grant it Might, shapeshift and cast spell effects.

name: Meditation
description: Method of entering an ecstatic state through mundane activity to gain insight into God's Will; usually Intelligence-based.

name: Mentor
description: A useful minor Flaw representing a guiding patron; also noted as a relationship through which a character may be considered part of another's agency.

name: Mercurian Magic
description: A Major Hermetic Virtue whose magical lineage descends from the Roman priests of Mercury, granting skill with Ritual Magic, free Wizard's Vigil, and halved vis requirements for Ritual spells.

name: Murion
description: Prima of House Bonisagus and Praeco of the Rhine Tribunal, a powerful and overbearing archmagus who presents her plan to recolonize the Rhine Gorge to the new magi at the Forum of Durenmar.

name: Mythic Blood
description: A Virtue marking descent from a supernatural ancestor such as Birna or a Great Beast, granting a magical feat spell, a Minor Magical Focus, and a hereditary Personality Flaw.

name: Narrowly Cognizant
description: A Free Virtue indicating a faerie is aware of its faerie nature in a limited way; it tries to play its role accurately and cannot break role even unto death.

name: Overconfident
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character has unshakable faith in his own abilities and cannot imagine failure.

name: Pagan
description: Major Supernatural Story Flaw for a character who does not follow the Church, has never been baptized, and may suffer supernatural consequences from Christian worship.

name: Personality Trait
description: Short descriptors of a character's personality with scores from -3 to +3 (e.g., Brave, Loyal), used as roleplaying guides and for some rolls.

name: Pious
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character is a fervent follower of his religion, avoiding what it prohibits and doing what it commands.

name: Reckless
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character fails to notice threatening situations and charges right in.

name: Study Requirement
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw in which the character cannot study magic from books or vis alone, but must study in the presence of the appropriate Art.

name: Veil of Invisibility
description: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 20) that makes the target completely undetectable to normal sight regardless of what it does, though it still casts a shadow.

name: Virgin Mary
description: By far the most important saint, the mother of God, believed to have particularly strong influence in interceding with God; Margaret of Beverley was rescued by her grace.

name: Wind of Mundane Silence
description: A Perdo Vim spell that raises a metaphorical breeze canceling the effects of spells in an area, and can dispel Parma Magica if it penetrates strongly enough.

name: Aura of Ennobled Presence
description: A spell that changes a magus's image so he appears more convincing, granting a +3 bonus to debating Defense Totals using Leadership; basis for related Tytalan debating spells.

name: Ball of Abysmal Flame
description: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 35) that shoots a ball of flame to strike a single target for +30 damage; Marius of Tremere's version makes a loud bang on impact.

name: Beasts of Virtue
description: Magical animals that resemble fine specimens of mundane creatures but possess hidden or surprising abilities suited to their kind; the most obvious magical creatures.

name: Benedictine Order
description: The oldest and most important monastic order, founded on the rule of Benedict of Nursia, whose monks are known as black monks and number around 3,800 in England.

name: Black Forest
description: The largest forest in western Europe in the south-west of the Rhine Tribunal, an impenetrable sinister faerie wilderness with a Faerie aura, ruled by the King of the Black Mountain.

name: Carolus
description: A scatterbrained young magus of Oculus Septentrionalis posing as an eccentric scholar; his raven familiar was blinded by Caprea of Bjornaer at Crintera after being mistaken for a spy.

name: Cave of Twisting Shadows
aliases: Covenant of the Cave of Twisting Shadows
description: A labyrinthine covenant serving as the domus magna of House Criamon, the largest and perhaps unfinished Great Work, whose structures embody the quest for the Enigma; its ghosts teach the Arts.

name: Common Sense
description: A Virtue whose effects are granted by Familiarity with the Fae, but only in situations pertaining to faeries.

name: Curse of Venus
description: A Major Story Flaw: the character is attractive to unwanted people and falls in love with inappropriate people in inappropriate circumstances.

name: Cyclic Magic
description: A Hermetic Virtue/Flaw making a magus's power wax and wane with a cycle; Felicia has Cyclic Magic (Positive) in winter and (Negative) in summer.

name: Delusion
description: A Flaw representing false belief; Criamon magi do not have it because their cosmological errors cannot be demonstrated within the game setting.

name: Dependant
description: A minor Flaw representing someone who depends on the character; can be used as a hostage or leverage to dominate an agent.

name: Divine Lore
description: Lore Ability for a specific realm that caps Magic Theory when inventing realm-aligned spells and reduces botch dice.

name: Dwarf
description: Faeries living in communities guarding the entrances to the earth (caves, barrows, mines); cunning smiths with access to the Earth's treasures who can grant External Vis to other faeries.

name: Faerie Speech
description: A faerie ability to converse in the language of one's audience, speaking any language someone has used to speak to them without needing to Penetrate.

name: Julius Caesar
description: Roman figure who in a Jerbiton parable accidentally destroyed the library of Alexandria.

name: London
description: The principal English city whose ruling aldermen seek to increase the freedoms of the city; a center of specialized crafts and home to round churches and vagabond clerks.

name: Nephilim
description: A Mythic Companion type: divine giants and heroes of ancient myth, descended from angels, who age very slowly and dwell mostly in divine regiones. They require the Blood of the Nephilim and related Divine-aligned Virtues.

name: Nightwalkers
description: Nightwalkers of northeast Italy, born with a caul, who battle the stregoni in dreams with fennel swords using powers of the same Infernal realm.

name: Panic of the Trembling Heart
description: A Creo Mentem spell cited as an example of a base-level-4 spell creating emotion directed at a particular person or object.

name: Priest
description: A Social Status Virtue for a medical character in holy orders, usually attached to a monastic house; compatible with Magister in Medicina.

name: Purgatory
description: Place of purification for souls not good enough for heaven nor bad enough for hell; time there may be reduced by saints, prayers, Masses and perhaps indulgences.

name: Quendalon
description: A figure who at the beginning of the ninth century defeated the followers of Merinita and allegedly slew both Merinita and Myanar to claim leadership of the cult of Diana; he is said to hide in Arcadia and is the target of the Huntress's pagan messiah.

name: Restriction
description: A Flaw preventing magic under a circumstance (e.g., at sea, or in bright light as suffered by Ulf); imposed as a Great Beast Ordeal and a common Bjornaer flaw.

name: The Inexorable Search
description: A spell that uses an arcane connection such as a lock of hair to locate someone; library vouchers act as arcane connections for it, and other library-location spells are based on it.

name: Tractatus
description: A short book conveying an author's insights on a subject, studied once for experience; breakthroughs and encyclopedia volumes are disseminated as tractatus.

name: Unaging
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue: the character does not suffer the effects of age, with aging points only building up Decrepitude points rather than reducing Characteristics.

name: Verdi
description: The domus magna of House Verditius on the island of Sardinia, built over the Forge of Hephaestus, consisting of a squat central tower surrounded by six taller towers amid nuraghi.

name: Verditius Magic
description: The Outer Mystery of House Verditius allowing magi to incorporate craft Abilities into enchantment, add Verditius Runes for bonuses, and reduce vis costs, but requiring casting tools to cast Formulaic and Ritual spells.

name: Water Elemental
description: An elemental being of water that can be created via Creo Aquam ritual and whose Might can be reduced or controlled by Aquam spells.

name: Weak Magic Resistance
description: A Flaw under which those knowing a magus's secret name need not subtract spell level from Penetration; acquired as a minor Ordeal in the Secret Name Initiation.

name: Zeus
description: The god who raised Orpheus's lyre into the stars, taken by the Orphic cult as a sign of Orpheus's apotheosis.

name: Andru
description: The current Primus of House Jerbiton, a charming, effective middle-aged leader who has rallied the House around interventionism and ancient values after the fall of Constantinople.

name: Aristotle
description: The ancient Greek philosopher whose newly translated works, the New Aristotle, were central to scholastic learning and embraced by Muslim scholars.

name: Aspect
description: An agent projected onto Earth by a Daimon, functioning as an independent spirit with its own Might pool that is dispelled when exhausted and returns to the parent Daimon.

name: Book Learner
description: A Virtue that modifies the Source Quality from books when calculating a character's Advancement Total.

name: Brittany
description: A region off whose coast lies the Isle of Ushant; Tytalus made his home there and was likely responsible for its annexation by the Frankish Empire.

name: Confusion of the Numbed Will
description: A spell that confuses a person, who must make an Intelligence roll to take direct action and always strikes last in combat.

name: Darius
description: A magus of House Flambeau with a Warping Score of 6 who, while hunting a Renounced magus, botches a spell, enters Twilight, and gains a Twilight Scar making dead meat he touches seem rotten.

name: Diana
description: The mater of Theoderic; the last magus to attempt to reach the Lunar Sphere, she was blasted into fragments of glass in a laboratory accident, and a Fallen Temple at the covenant is dedicated to her.

name: Divination and Augury
description: Separate Mystery magic replacing Augury, where several methods share one Divination Ability; Lasa Vegoia helps initiate it.

name: Eleanor of Aquitaine
description: Overlord of Aquitaine who attended the Second Crusade with a guard of female knights dressed as Amazons; her scandalous behavior led to a Papal Bull barring women from the Third Crusade. An example of inheritance-based female power.

name: Enfeebled
description: A Major General Flaw preventing the character from exerting himself for more than a few seconds, rendering him helpless in combat or chases.

name: Flanders
description: Densely populated industrial province of the Normandy Tribunal famed for woollen cloth.

name: Flexible Formulaic Magic
description: A Major, Hermetic Virtue allowing slight variation of Formulaic spell parameters (Range, Duration, Target) while still casting known magic.

name: France
description: A kingdom of Mythic Europe whose king the king of England owes fealty for mainland possessions; home to Cluny, the Champagne fairs, and Laon, and which can be saved from demons in a saga.

name: Frederick Barbarossa
description: The emperor who in 1190 granted Bolognese scholars freedom of movement throughout the Holy Roman Empire and safe residences, the root of universities' political autonomy.

name: Fury
description: A Major Story Flaw in which a violent temper overwhelms the character, sending him into uncontrollable rage.

name: Gossip
description: A minor general Virtue making a character a fount of rumor and information; listed as a resource increasing an agent's Resistance Strength.

name: Guardian Angel
description: A Major, General Virtue giving a character a divine watcher who offers spiritual advice and can grant +5 Soak and Magic Resistance 15.

name: Incognizant
description: A faerie trait indicating it does not even know it is a faerie, following its role because it has no potential to understand any other option.

name: Intervention
description: Confrontation by a powerful realm entity when a learned magician gains 2+ Warping Points from a botch; may yield boons or punishments.

name: Intuition
description: A Minor, General Virtue giving a natural sensitivity to make the right luck-based decisions on a secret die roll of 6+.

name: Invested Device
description: An enchanted item prepared with Vim vis and then instilled with magical effects in the laboratory; variants include lesser enchanted devices and charged items, and an invested device lasts years as an Arcane Connection.

name: Lamp without Flame
description: A Creo Ignem spell that creates a steady daylight-bright light with no apparent source, illuminating about ten paces across a point that may be a mobile item.

name: Lay to Rest the Haunting Spirit
description: A Perdo Mentem (General) spell that reduces a ghost or spirit's Might by the spell's level if it penetrates, causing the spirit to vanish if its Might reaches zero.

name: Life Boost
description: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue letting a magus boost Formulaic or Ritual spell casting totals by +5 per additional Fatigue level spent, risking damage.

name: Luck
description: A Minor General Virtue granting +1 to +3 on rolls in situations governed by luck rather than skill, making the character do well at games of chance.

name: Moses
description: Led the Hebrews from Egypt and commanded Rahab to part the Red Sea; God parted it Himself when Moses' power was insufficient.

name: Notatus
description: The first Hermetic apprentice of Bonisagus, chosen as Primus of House Bonisagus and thereby the first Praeco of the Rhine after Bonisagus; his sigil is held by Murion.

name: Painful Magic
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw in which casting spells causes the equivalent of one Fatigue level in pain per spell, applying a cumulative penalty to actions.

name: Perfect Balance
description: A Minor General Virtue granting +6 to rolls to avoid falling or tripping, especially on narrow ledges or tightropes.

name: Plato
description: The philosopher whose advocacy of training women for all duties of the state, including warfare, underlies the Order of Hermes's position of equity for women.

name: Poor Eyesight
