description: A Minor General Flaw in which bleary vision gives -3 to rolls involving sight, including attack and defense; can combine with Missing Eye.

name: Possession
description: A demonic power by which a demon places Might into a human host (an energumen), taking direct control of the victim and able to use powers through them.

name: Purity
description: Holy Virtue/Ability favored by the Neriusians and required of Perfecti; used for ceremonial casting of The Neriusian Portal.

name: Slow Caster
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw given to Confraternity of Irene Initiates, whose spellcasting mimics the long time it takes to paint or sculpt.

name: Solomon
description: The Wizard-king who commanded demons in the service of God, binding the seven Spirits of Solomon with his seal to build his temple.

name: St. Augustine of Canterbury
description: The Benedictine monk who came to convert the Saxons and founded the monastery and abbey at Canterbury that bears his name.

name: Summa
description: One of the two types of study books in Ars Magica, providing repeatable study of an Art or Ability up to a level; restricting summae limits a covenant's power advancement.

name: Synthemata
description: Signs, symbols, or passwords that link a magician to a supernatural creature, used in theurgic incantations; any being with a Might score has them.

name: The Shrouded Glen
description: A Mentem spell that conceals a location from discovery; because it affects minds and not animals, a hunted deer could lead hunters to a covenant protected by it.

name: The Wound that Weeps
description: A Perdo Corpus spell (PeCo15) cited to illustrate how the Harmless Magic Flaw makes a wound briefly bleed then close again.

name: Underworld
description: The realm where the gods of the dead imprisoned the titans, the resentful spirits Tytalus sought out and forged pacts with to oppose Guorna.

name: Waddenzee
description: A Rhine covenant whose piracy thwarts Oculus Septentrionalis's mercantile ambitions; some members are Ash Gild members who exterminate non-Hermetic Norse wizards, and it figures in demon Gymir's plans.

name: William Marshal
description: The greatest knight in Europe (1147-1219), earl of Pembroke and regent of England after King John's death, who rose from a minor lord's younger son.

name: Wrathful
description: A Personality Flaw making a character prone to anger; held by the Berserker grog and Flambeau template magus.

name: Ability Block
description: A Minor General Flaw: the character is completely unable to learn a certain class of Abilities, such as Martial Abilities or languages other than the native tongue.

name: Acre
description: The major port in the Kingdom of Jerusalem and center of Christian activity in Outremer, a dangerous city contested by Muslim and Crusader forces and home to the military orders.

name: Adam
description: The first man, created by God in his likeness; tempted via Eve to eat the forbidden fruit, and later took the demoness Lilith as consort.

name: Afflicted Tongue
description: A Minor General Flaw: a speech impediment giving -2 to voice rolls and Casting Scores using words, plus an extra botch die for magi.

name: Age Quickly
description: A Major Supernatural Flaw: due to a curse or magical disaster, the character ages twice as fast as normal and makes two aging rolls each year.

name: Agony of the Beast
description: A Perdo Animal spell (Level 15) that causes a beast to lash about wildly and howl in great pain, hindering its actions.

name: Blessing
description: A gruagach Form that temporarily grants Virtues, Ability bonuses and Characteristic improvements; Take Blessing removes them. All Blessing spells use the Limit Duration.

name: Busybody
description: A useful minor Flaw representing a character compelled to meddle in others' affairs; listed as a resource increasing an agent's Resistance Strength.

name: Cautious Sorcerer
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus roll three fewer botch dice when casting spells or working in the laboratory.

name: Coagulation
description: A demonic power allowing demons to manufacture a solid body from ambient unformed matter; in Christian lands demons must abandon coagulated form on Holy Saturday.

name: Cologne
description: The largest city of the Holy Roman Empire north of the Alps and the most important trading city in Germany, ruled by its powerful archbishop, home to the relics of the Three Magi.

name: Constantine
description: Roman emperor who supported Sol Invictus early, then converted to Christianity after seeing a glowing cross in 312 and made it the Empire's religion.

name: Difficult Underlings
description: A Story Flaw representing a fractured relationship with one's agents; acquired when a non-magus principal recruits an agent of higher social standing, applying to dealings with that agent.

name: Earth Elemental
description: An ancient elemental summoned by a now-fallen covenant to tend a cavern rock garden; mourning his lost water-elemental love, he yearly carries an engraved rock outside that yields Aquam and Terram vis.

name: Egypt
description: A region of Mythic Europe near the Pyramids and the great Sphinx where magi established a desert laboratory.

name: Envisioning
description: Demonic Power to appear in dreams or cause waking visions; the only way a spiritual demon communicates.

name: Flawless Magic
description: A Major, Hermetic Virtue that automatically masters every spell learned at Spell Mastery 1 and doubles Spell Mastery Advancement Totals.

name: Fourth Lateran Council
description: A Church council of 1215 that forbade clergy from cautery or surgical incision and obliged physicians to require patients to summon a confessor before treatment.

name: Hermetic Breakthrough
description: The research achievement of expanding the limits of Hermetic Theory; minor or major breakthroughs (e.g. Aristotelian or Platonic Magic Theory) are accumulated via Breakthrough Points and disseminated in a tractatus.

name: Highlands
description: Hilly, thickly wooded lands where clans rule and bow to no king; home to giants in their further reaches and to the Scottish Church's abbeys.

name: Humanoid Faerie
description: Virtue granting a glamoured faerie body; must be taken before Increased Might and requires a Traditional Ward.

name: Incantation
description: An Infernal Supernatural Ability granting the Unholy Method: Incantation, described in David of Dinant's heretical book Quaternuli with a Quality of 13.

name: Increased Faerie Might
description: Virtue or creature Quality listed for a being (Anne, Minerva Sulis, Balneator) or setting feature described here.

name: Lecherous
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character seeks sexual contact with as many people as possible.

name: Legion of Mithras
description: A 13th-century mystery cult reconstruction of the ancient Cult of Mithras that teaches additional powers via Initiation; Castra Solis's shield grogs may serve it as Auxiliaries.

name: Lesser Purifying Touch
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue letting a character heal a specific minor or self-recovering illness with a touch and a Fatigue level.

name: Lotharingian Tribunal
description: A proposed separate Tribunal sought by members of the Apple Gild to cover the Low Countries in the north and west of the Rhine Tribunal, to be proposed at the Grand Tribunal of 1228.

name: Magical Monster
description: Major Social Status Flaw for a magical being with no strong connection to human society; most Beasts of Virtue have it.

name: Mendicant Friar
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a follower of St. Francis or St. Dominic who wanders among rich and poor spreading the word of God.

name: Monstrous Appearance
description: Major Social Interaction Flaw giving -6 in social situations where appearance matters.

name: Mortal Sin
description: An act that assists the Infernal or does not serve God, staining the soul; divided into mortal (major) and venial (minor) sins.

name: Mount Etna
description: A volcano on the island of Sicily beneath which the fire spirit Adranus slumbers; believed by the ancients to hold a gateway to the Underworld, it last erupted in 1194.

name: Odin
description: Father of the Norse gods, who first discovered the power of the runes; symbolized by Ansuz.

name: Oversensitive
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character finds intolerable something others find merely unpleasant.

name: Palsied Hands
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character's hands shake uncontrollably, giving -2 to rolls involving holding or wielding objects and an extra botch die when casting.

name: Parens
description: A magus's master/teacher within the Order; the parens trains the apprentice, sets the gauntlet, and conventionally is regarded as a superior throughout life.

name: Peering into the Mortal Mind
description: An Intellego Mentem spell (Level 30) that lets the caster thoroughly probe and understand the contents of the target's mind, including motives, strengths, and weaknesses.

name: Personal Power
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue giving the character an at-will supernatural power equivalent to a Formulaic Hermetic spell of level 25 or lower.

name: Poor Hearing
description: A Minor General Flaw subtracting 3 from rolls involving hearing and making hard-to-understand speech nearly impossible to follow.

name: Pope Honorius III
description: The pope in 1220, born Cencio Savelli in Rome in the 1140s, elected in 1216; former tutor of Frederick II, determined to reform the Church and recover the Holy Land.

name: Puissant Perdo
description: A Virtue granting bonus effectiveness with an Art or Ability; House Flambeau offers a choice of Puissant Perdo or Puissant Ignem as its House Virtue.

name: Reclusive
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character dislikes being disturbed or interrupted and is reluctant to enter public places or group activities.

name: Saracens
description: Muslims to whom Francis sought to preach; the Franciscans in Morocco stirred dissent between Christians and Saracens.

name: Short Attention Span
description: A Minor Flaw that affected covenfolk may acquire after a year under the Instant Loyalty of the Rebellious Turb ritual.

name: Simple-Minded
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character can only think about one thing at a time and becomes easily confused without clear instructions.

name: Stone Tell of the Mind that Sits
description: A spell that allows a magus to converse with a rock, invoked in debates over whether inanimate objects possess minds.

name: Sufi
description: Minor Social Status or Supernatural Virtue for a Muslim mystic belonging to a Sufi tariqa led by a shaykh; includes the Mentor Flaw and access to Theology: Islam, Islamic Law and Dominion Lore.

name: The Call to Slumber
description: A Hermetic spell, cited in Touch/Eye Range versions as a subtle urban spell and as a template for spells that manipulate mental states.

name: The Incantation of Lightning
description: A 6th-magnitude or greater Hermetic spell cited as an example of magic that, cast in a Magic aura, can inflict the final Warping point needed to rarefy an elemental.

name: Trust of Childlike Faith
description: A Perdo Mentem spell that destroys adult judgment regarding truth and falsity, used as a template for spells diminishing other mental capacities.

name: Understanding
description: Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability gained by a vision before a Byzantine crucifix at Saint Damien.

name: Urgen
description: An Archmage of House Bjornaer (heartbeast of a bear) holding the Seat of the Bear at Crintera; former Primus (1165-1203), leader of the Hawthorn Gild and the most influential Wilderist.

name: Warped Magic
description: A Hermetic Flaw causing a magus' magic to display an unusual side effect; Balastor's causes his features to take on a savage, feral cast.

name: Weird Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw making a magus's control over magic loose, adding an extra strange botch die on stressed casting rolls.

name: Whispers Through the Black Gate
description: An Intellego Corpus spell (Level 15) with a Mentem requisite that lets you speak through the barrier between living and dead to one undecayed corpse.

name: Wielding the Invisible Sling
description: A Rego Terram spell (ReTe 10) that hurls any nearby throwable object at a target within range, doing up to +5 damage but resisted by Magic Resistance.

name: 'Alim
description: Minor Social Status Virtue for members of the Muslim religious elite, such as mu'adhdhin, imam, mufti or qadi; allows purchase of Academic Abilities and is male-only.

name: Adjuration
description: Power to summon, control and banish supernatural creatures and dispel their powers; used with Invocation and Purity.

name: Apple Gild
description: A Rhine political gild founded by western covenants seeking to push the limits of the Code through mundane dealings; described disparagingly as a front for mundane meddling.

name: Art of Memory
description: An Ability that aids recall; a victim of Chnoubis' bite may add Art of Memory to a Stamina roll to remember what transpired while affected.

name: Atramentum Renatus
description: Vassal covenant of Fudarus whose magi were ruined by guild politics in Le Conquet and later evicted.

name: Branded Criminal
description: A Minor Social Status Flaw: a mark burned into the cheek as punishment for a past crime that hampers functioning in society; cannot take Wealthy.

name: British Isles
description: Roman Britain, south of Caledonia; Pralix came to the British Isles to fight Damhan-Allaidh.

name: Buliste
description: The ninth Prima of House Tytalus who entered a protracted Twilight, was declared dead, and on recovery in 1198 contested leadership with Harpax; her loyalists wear royal purple.

name: Ceremonial Magic
description: A method of increasing spellcasting power using natural correspondences, props, and prepared spaces, with casting time reduced by prepared spaces and the Mystical Choreography Virtue.

name: Champagne
description: The pre-eminent fair cycle of Mythic Europe and a financial center, comprising fairs at Lagny, Bar-sur-Aube, Provins, and Troyes, guaranteed safe by the counts of Champagne.

name: Clan Ilfetu
description: A clan within House Bjornaer that gives extra ritual training and teaches the Divination method of haemagmomancy (divination by the blood splatters of wounded animals).

name: Clumsy
description: A Minor General Flaw: the character is ungraceful, at -3 on related rolls and rolling an extra botch die on Dexterity actions.

name: Cluny
description: An abbey in France that heads the Cluniac Order, a group of monasteries spread across Europe, and which is rich and powerful.

name: Columbae
description: A tradition of Welsh hedge wizards within House Ex Miscellanea famous for ward-magic (the Warding Ability); they introduced Ring/Circle warding spells to the Order.

name: Commanding Aura
description: A Free Supernatural Virtue granted by the pope or the Divine, giving a Church officer a power like Aura of Rightful Authority plus Magic Resistance and Soak scaled by rank.

name: Compassionate
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw: the character helps anyone wounded or in trouble and cannot bear to see suffering in others.

name: Conjuring the Mystic Tower
description: A Creo spell that conjures a stone tower, allowing the caster to determine the layout of its chambers; can also be used by a magus to construct a lab building.

name: Constance
description: Lesser Secundus of House Jerbiton at Valnastium, over 130 years old, trained as a Verditius follower and a leading Crafter who builds grand laboratories.

name: Crintera
description: The domus magna of House Bjornaer, located on the island of Rügen in the Eastern Marches, organized around six council seats of Elders and divided into six clans. Its turb is the fiercest and most bestial of the Rhine covenants.

name: Cunfin
description: Covenant of magi and Cistercian monks in Champagne, a Mercer House with a Magic regio and Portal to Dragon's Rest.

name: Cursing
description: Major Supernatural Virtue / Supernatural Ability letting a folk witch cast curses via fetishes or potions; Form depends on the curse.

name: Death Prophecy
description: A Major General Virtue placing a supernatural condition on a character's death so that, until met, they cannot die of wounds or old age.

name: Eastern Church
description: The Eastern Church centered in Constantinople and Jerusalem, holding sway only on the eastern peripheries of Mythic Europe.

name: Falke
description: The Prima of House Bjornaer who seeks to end animosity with non-Hermetic shapeshifters and admit them to the House; leader of the Harmonist faction who becomes besieged on Rügen during the Crintera Schism.

name: Famous
description: A Virtue that cannot be used for an Artist Reputation, since characters with Famous are known for something other than their artwork.

name: Fenicil
description: The Primus of House Guernicus and the Order's most famous historian, who claimed the tradition of magic was eternal and reputedly rediscovered some lost Mercurian rituals.

name: Florence
description: A great Italian city founded by Julius Caesar in 59 BC, with a developed cloth and banking industry, dominated by noble tower societies and the feud between the Guelphs and Ghibellines.

name: Gabriel, the Archangel of Prophecy
description: A Divine creature (Might 100, Mentem), the chief messenger of God known for teaching the prophet Daniel, announcing Christ's incarnation to Mary, and bringing the Qur'an to Muhammad.

name: Glastonbury Abbey
description: The oldest and richest monastery in England, identified with the isle of Avalon and the burial place of Arthur, standing near Glastonbury Tor in the Somerset fens.

name: Hariste
description: Tytalus's cherished filia and the first Prima of House Tytalus; she collated his sayings into the Analects of Tytalus and founded the leper magi lineage when she contracted leprosy.

name: Harpax
description: Buliste's younger Hermetic brother who became the tenth Primus of House Tytalus after she entered Twilight, then refused to relinquish leadership when she recovered; his supporters wear revolutionary green.

name: Hildegard of Bingen
description: Renowned Rhineland mystic and scholar (d. 1179), abbess at Rupertsberg, who recorded her visions in books like Scivias and wrote on medicine, music and natural history. Rumored to have been adopted into House Jerbiton despite being unGifted.

name: Improved Powers
description: A Virtue or Magic Quality named among the traits of magical animals or dragons in this text.

name: Incompatible Arts
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character is completely unable to use two specified combinations of Techniques and Forms.

name: Judaism
description: One of the three Divine religions in Mythic Europe; Jews live within a Dominion aura, and a scattering of magi are Jewish.

name: Legend Lore
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Lesser Limits of Hermetic Magic
description: The boundaries of what Hermetic magic can achieve, resulting from Bonisagus' unfinished theory; the forest paths each lead to overcoming one of these limits.

name: Loss of But a Moment's Memory
description: A spell that removes up to five continuous minutes from a target's memory, leaving a blank focused on a specific event or time.

name: Luctatio
description: Spring covenant of competitive Tytalus founded 1172 in Lombardy, with holdings in Milan, Pavia and Venice, playing a manipulative game with those cities and the Tribunal.

name: Magna Carta
description: The great written charter of English liberties, settled at Runnymede; its 1217 reissue is enforceable in court even against the king and constrains royal power.

name: Meddler
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character wastes time and energy trying to fix other people's lives, who usually resent it.

name: Merovech
description: A powerful 5th-century Frankish chieftain and wizard, namesake of the Merovingian dynasty, said to have two fathers and a magical bloodline; helped repel Attila at Chalons.

name: Montverte
description: A covenant in the Normandy Tribunal occupying a castle with curtain walls and mural towers, which it shares with its mundane lord and uses as a base for raiding permitted by that tribunal's Peripheral Code.

name: Mythic Germany
description: The magic-soaked lands of medieval Germany within the Holy Roman Empire, birthplace of the Order of Hermes and setting of the Rhine Tribunal.

name: Nature Lore
description: A Mystery (Virtue) Initiated by the Vestals with the unique focus of lares (household spirits), letting them interact with the faeries of a settlement as nature magi do with the wilderness.

name: North Africa
description: Region outside the Order's territory once within the late Roman Republic.

name: Obese
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is large due to fat, giving -1 to rolls involving quick or graceful movement and -3 to Fatigue rolls.

name: Obsessed
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character is fixated on a prized object, action, or ideal that interferes with more immediate tasks.

name: Occult Lore
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Oculus Septentrionalis
description: A Rhine Tribunal covenant based in Lubeck, dominated by Jerbiton magi and merchants and lacking a Magic aura at its city site; deeply involved in commerce and the genesis of the Hanseatic League.

name: Offensive to Animals
description: Flaw possessed by Jean the Wise; also a Minor Hermetic Flaw for gruagachan.

name: Performance Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus conceal spellcasting by substituting the actions or words of a specified Ability for normal Hermetic gestures and words.

name: Pliny
description: The Roman author cited as mentioning an ancient mariner who circumnavigated Africa and found the place where much of Europe's gold originates.

name: Potent Magic
description: Minor or Major Hermetic Virtue attuning magic to a narrow field like a Magical Focus, granting +3/+6 to Lab Totals and Casting Score and allowing design of Potent spells.

name: Protection
description: A Minor General Virtue placing the character under the aegis of a powerful noble or Church official, granting a Reputation of level 3.

name: Richard the Lionheart
description: King of England who spent most of his reign on Crusade and at war in France, repeatedly demanding money from England; died of an infected arrow wound in 1199.

name: Saint Francis
description: Founder of the Franciscans, born 1181 to a cloth-merchant family, who embraced absolute poverty and preaching; possesses True Faith and supernatural Abilities.

name: Scandinavia
description: Northern lands where hunters pursue reindeer and gyrfalcons live; produces fine rounceys.

name: Scribe Latin
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Senior Clergy
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for an archbishop, bishop, abbot, abbess, or other senior Church member with access to Church resources and a Reputation of level 4.

name: Sense the Nature of Vis
description: An Intellego Vim spell that reveals which Art a supply of raw vis is connected to, shown by a color-coded aura.

name: Sight of the True Form
description: An Intellego Corpus spell (General) that lets you see the true, original form of any person whose form has been changed or masked.

name: Skilled Parens
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue reflecting a more powerful or better-teaching parens, granting 60 extra experience points and 30 spell levels during apprenticeship.

name: Societates
description: One of the three groupings of Hermetic Houses; the fourth Societas, House Ex Miscellanea, is a special case in how its members gain House Virtues.

name: Soft-Hearted
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character cannot bear to witness suffering and avoids danger, valuing life and health above important goals.

name: Sovereign Ward
description: A faerie's weakness condition; e.g. Red Ettin can be killed by one who answers his riddles, Wivere cannot harm naked people. Also a Major Flaw.

name: Special Circumstances
description: A Minor Virtue boosting magic under certain conditions; the Malocchi take it for eye contact and the Donatores' Minor Magical Focus relates similarly.

name: Spiritual Pact
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue for a character who has made a pact with a powerful Magical spirit, gaining access to a Might Pool from the spirit by spending Confidence.

name: St Nerius
description: Criamon magus who reconciled his power with God and became St Nerius, patron saint of Christian magi (Divine Might 50), martyred at Fudarus in 1039.

name: Story Flaw
description: A category of Flaw that draws characters into stories, such as family displeasure over Paid Rights or a female knight's unusual background.

name: Student of (Realm)
description: A Minor General Virtue giving training in the mystical aspects of one of the four realms of power, with a +2 bonus on uses of the appropriate Lore.

name: Teutonic Knights
aliases: Order of the Teutonic Knights of Saint Mary
description: German crusading order formed around 1198 from the German hospital of Saint Mary, famed for strict discipline and turning toward the pagan lands of Eastern Europe.

name: The Crystal Dart
description: A Muto Terram spell (with Rego requisite) that transforms a stone into a 10-inch crystal dart that flies at a target for +5 damage.

name: The Donatores Requietis Aeternae
description: A young, secretive necromantic tradition of House Ex Miscellanea with religious backgrounds who ensure the spirits of the dead reach their final rest using the Banishing Ability.

name: The Invisible Eye Revealed
description: A spell that allows a magus to magically recognize an Intangible Tunnel and cast spells back through it.

name: Triamore
description: A covenant holding a castle and manorial estate by the river Meuse on the edge of the Ardennes at the western fringe of the Rhine Tribunal; led by Daria la Gris and embroiled in mundane politics.

name: Trolls
description: A term with divergent meanings: a barrow-faerie ancestral spirit, a shaggy solitary giant of northern Scandinavia turned to stone by sunlight, or a small social faerie of southern Scandinavia.

name: True Lineages
description: One of the three groups of Hermetic Houses (Bonisagus, Guernicus, Mercere, Tremere) made up entirely of those descended in training from a single Founder; cannot be joined later.

name: Unaffected by The Gift
description: A Minor General Virtue: the character is not affected by the negative effects of The Gift or Magical Air in others, even a Blatant Gift.

name: Vikings
description: Raiders repelled by Crun Clach in the late 10th century; Danish Viking descendants live in the Islands and northern Highlands.

name: Voice of the Lake
description: An Intellego Aquam spell (Level 25) that lets the caster hold a conversation with a body of water about things in contact with it.

name: Wales
description: A poorer, more pastoral land west of England, split in 1220 between Anglo-Norman marcher lords in the south and native Welsh princes in the north.

name: Ward Against Heat and Flames
description: A Rego Ignem spell (Level 25) that keeps heat and fire at bay, granting the target a +15 Soak against fire-related damage so weaker fires cannot penetrate the ward.

name: Weak Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which a magus's magic is poor at penetrating Magic Resistance, halving the Penetration Total for all spells.

name: Weak Parens
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw representing a less powerful or worse-teaching parens, giving fewer experience points and spell levels from apprenticeship.

name: Weak-Willed
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character looks to others for guidance rather than himself.

name: Weight of a Thousand Hells
description: A Creo Mentem spell (Level 25) that makes the victim feel the despair and pain of a thousand sinners in Hell, sapping motivation and imposing penalties on thought and Personality Trait rolls.

name: Ablating
description: Major Goetic Art Virtue that opens the Ablating Art at 0; combined with Summoning it lets a sorcerer leech away the power of a demon or spirit.

name: Air Elemental
description: An elemental being associated with Auram that can be reduced in Might by Perdo Auram or completely controlled by Rego Auram.

name: Albigensian Crusade
description: A crusade aimed at the heretical Cathars in Languedoc that is effectively destroying the tradition of southern troubadours.

name: Alexander II
description: The king of Scotland who fought on Louis's side and presses for reconsideration of Anglo-Scottish treaties; Louis promised him three northern English counties.

name: Alexandria
description: An Egyptian city whose lighthouse holds a source of fire from which an Initiate must steal a brand during the Automata Initiation.

name: Antioch
description: City on the pilgrim route to Jerusalem; Templars there are described.

name: Babylon
description: Rumored headquarters of the Magoi of the Star visited by Initiates of the Degree of Mercury.

name: Beadle
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character employed as an assistant to a university dean who carries the university's insignia, collects dues, and announces disputationes.

name: Black Sheep
description: A minor Flaw representing estrangement from one's family or social group, likely to inconvenience a principal and lower an agent's Resistance Strength.

name: Blind
description: A Major General Flaw: the character has little or no sight, making missile weapons futile and reading impossible; blind magi cannot aim spells without magical aid.

name: Botch
description: A mistake on a spell roll cast under stress that produces unintended, usually detrimental effects and a Casting Total of zero; the number of zeros on the botch dice determines severity.

name: Bow
description: The missile-combat Ability used for ranged weapons such as the long bow and short bow.

name: Brownie
description: Domestic faeries like shaggy foot-tall men, often nude, that do household work and stop serving if given clothes.

name: Build Points
description: Points spent during covenant creation; realia collections cost Build Points scaling with quality, and Great Works cost the Build Points of an equivalent book.

name: Cad Gadu
description: The domus magna of House Ex Miscellanea on an island in a Welsh lake within a strong magical regio; site of the final battle against Damhan-Allaidh, formerly home of the Columbae.

name: Canterbury
description: Capital of Kent and metropolitan see of the English church; site of Becket's martyrdom and his shrine, the fourth main pilgrimage site in Europe.

name: Careless Sorcerer
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw: the magus is slapdash with magical power and must roll two more botch dice than normal when casting spells.

name: Casting Tablet
description: A variant Laboratory Text containing fixed instructions for casting a particular spell, usable by magi who have not learned the spell but dangerous and inflexible.

name: Charge of the Angry Winds
description: An Auram spell whose effect is duplicated by an air elemental power of the same name, adding the elemental's Strength to Ease Factors for acting within the wind.

name: City of God
description: Planned perfect settlement ruled by the Church, likely with a high Dominion aura; the Hospitallers founded one near Confluensis.

name: Clan Mac Gruagach
description: Highland clan ('children of the son of the wizard') of long magical association, led by chief Donncadh Mac Calum, of which the covenant is a part.

name: Clovis
description: A Gifted descendant of Merovech who rose to become the first Christian Frankish king and founder of the Merovingian dynasty, whose magical lineage endured after his death.

name: Coeris
description: The domus magna of House Tremere in the Transylvanian Tribunal, to which Gifted children identified at the Prague slave market are delivered.

name: Commanding
description: Major Goetic Art Virtue opening the Commanding Art, allowing a sorcerer combined with Summoning to make summoned demons obey him.

name: Covenant of Calebais
description: A covenant that fell under mysterious circumstances and has lain undisturbed since, suggested as a place to explore (referenced via the supplement Calebais: The Broken Covenant).

name: Dankmar
description: A wilderness Rhine covenant occupied by Aschlaranda and her apprentice Schadrit; recognized as a Rhine covenant in 1067 and later accused Durenmar of faerie molestation.

name: David of Dinant
description: A heretic Paris master whose pantheistic, infernal teachings were discovered in 1215; author of the Quaternuli describing the Infernal Virtue Incantation, who fled the city.

name: Diabolic Past
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character was once associated with diabolists and is still haunted and watched by former associates.

name: Diedne Magic
description: A Major Hermetic Virtue from the druidic House Diedne lineage granting superior Spontaneous magic, requiring the lineage to be hidden via a Major Story Flaw.

name: Disguise of the Transformed Image
description: A spell useful for creating a persona with specific physical characteristics such as a particular sex, hair color, or stature.

name: Doissetep
description: A powerful covenant in the Provençal Tribunal where the dark Jerbiton magus Imanitos Mendax was apprenticed.

name: Edge of the Razor
description: A spell that sharpens a weapon to improve attacks; disfavored by the School of Ramius because Magic Resistance can stop the enchanted weapon. Its damage bonus can combine with Hardness of Adamantine.

name: Elder Gild
description: A gild that split from the Hawthorn Gild to pursue a fae-focused agenda, concentrating on preserving faeries and friendly contact with them; led by Iacob of Irencillia and made up mostly of Merinita magi.

name: Enchantment of the Scrying Pool
description: An Intellego Aquam Ritual spell (Level 30) with an Imaginem requisite that turns a body of water into a scrying pool; an old Mercurian ritual known throughout the Order.

name: Endurance of the Berserkers
description: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 15) that makes the caster's body act as though unwounded and unfatigued while concentrating, with deferred Fatigue loss.

name: External Vis
description: Minor or Major Supernatural Virtue placing the faerie's anchor in a traditional prop that can be carried far from its body.

name: Eyes of the Cat
description: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 5) with an Animal requisite that gives the target a cat's eyes, allowing sight in near darkness.

name: Faerie Doctor
description: A Mythic Companion type: a faerie-trained healer who removes blights, banes, and diseases via Curse-Throwing, dowses for water and lost things, and keeps a faerie companion. They swear oaths to remain apart from humanity.

name: Faerie Knight
description: Faerie warriors (Might 10, Corpus or Terram) bound to the rules of chivalry, found on lonely roads and guarding bridges, who seek defeat by humans to gain additional combat Pretenses.

name: Faerie Upbringing
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character was raised by faeries, gaining enhanced understanding of magic and faeries but finding human society bizarre.

name: Failed Apprentice
description: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for someone once apprenticed to a mage who never completed studies, familiar with magi's lives and possibly retaining Supernatural Abilities.

name: False Gods
description: Demonic order usurping God's name by demanding worship; appear as pleasing human forms accompanied by an animal; Might up to 30.

name: Feral Upbringing
description: A Flaw representing a wild, untamed childhood; a required Flaw of all Beast Masters due to their abandonment in the wilderness.

name: Fire Elemental
description: An elemental being of fire that can be created from elemental matter via a Creo Ignem ritual and controlled, transformed, or destroyed via Ignem magic by reducing its Might.

name: Flawed Parma Magica
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character's Parma Magica provides only half the normal Magic Resistance against a certain Form.

name: Folk Witch
description: A hedge wizard tradition of (mostly female) witches who brew potions, bind familiars, and organize into covens; both Gifted and unGifted members exist.

name: Fourth Crusade
description: A late-12th-century crusade for which the Venetians built a fleet; unable to pay, the Crusaders were forced to sack Constantinople in 1204, and many cycled-out Venetian warships later mysteriously disappeared.

name: Free Study
description: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue adding +3 to Source Quality when studying from raw vis.

name: Garden of Eden
description: Often equated with the Earthly Paradise; optionally lies within it in a Celestial regio of level 10, guarded by cherubim.

name: Gather the Essence of the Beast
description: A Touch-range, Momentary Vim spell that concentrates the raw vis in a corpse into one removable part, letting a magus gather vis without carrying entire corpses.

name: Gift of the Bear's Fortitude
description: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 25) that makes the caster's flesh resistant to physical damage (+3 Soak) but insensitive to touch.

name: Gnostics
description: Varied religious groups of the first millennium teaching that the world is Hell and the Old Testament God was the Devil; credited by the Church with spreading devil-worship.

name: Goetic Art of Binding
description: Major Goetic Art Virtue opening the Binding Art, used with Summoning to force a demon or incorporeal spirit into a physical object or person.

name: Goliard
description: The vigorous apparent leader of Blackthorn, nearly ninety, who controls a bound elemental spirit and seeks to restore the covenant's lost influence.

name: Great Intelligence
description: A Virtue that raises a character's Intelligence Characteristic beyond the normal limit; an example Great Characteristic Virtue.

name: Grip of the Choking Hand
description: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 25) that makes the target feel an invisible strangling hand on the throat, losing a Fatigue level each round.

name: Guorna the Fetid
description: Perhaps the greatest necromancer who ever lived, mater to Tytalus, Tremere, and Pralix; killed by her pupils after plotting to steal one of their bodies, cursing Tytalus with leprosy.

name: Handri
description: The Primus of House Merinita, an obsessively secretive man aged 81 who has turned his attentions to the faeries and a secret project to establish a religion in the name of the fae; his caricature is Rosmert, Queen of Irencillia's fae.

name: Hawthorn Gild
description: A political/philosophical gild of the Rhine Tribunal led by Urgen, with which Balastor's primal philosophy is in concordance; it argued for retaliatory strikes for Crintera.

name: Herbalism
description: A unique General Ability granted by the Herbalism Virtue that substitutes for Medicine in diagnosis, prognosis, and disease recovery, allowing cure of diseases without formal medical training.

name: Hermetic Prestige
description: A Virtue granting a magus a Hermetic Reputation; the free benefit of House Guernicus and taken by Darius to reflect his standing in the Order.

name: Highly Cognizant
description: A Virtue held by the most dangerous faeries, allowing them to adapt and change their roles to feed on human emotional energy.

name: Holy Influence
description: The ability of holy characters to instill Personality Traits in followers via personal or ceremonial influence (die + Presence + Leadership).

name: Incomprehensible
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is almost unable to convey knowledge, halving the Advancement or Lab Total of anyone learning from him or his books.

name: Lab Total
description: The core laboratory work measure (Technique + Form + Intelligence + Magic Theory + Aura Modifier) used for all lab activities such as inventing spells, enchanting items, and binding familiars.

name: Laboratory
description: A magus's workshop for magical experimentation; one standard laboratory exists per magus in the baseline covenant.

name: Life-Linked Spontaneous Magic
description: A Major, Hermetic Virtue letting a magus produce stronger spontaneous magic at the cost of declaring an effect level and spending Fatigue or taking wounds.

name: Light Touch
description: A Virtue improving fine manual work; held by the Craftsman template and offered as an alternative for the Spying Maid.

name: Lug
description: The Celtic and Gallic god of trade and commerce, also a sun deity associated with war, crafts, poetry, music, and magic, known as Lleu, Lugh, and Lugus.

name: Lübeck
description: The most important coastal port in Germany and a hub of Baltic trade, effectively founded in 1157 by Henry the Lion and home to the covenant Oculus Septentrionalis.

name: Magic Animal
description: Special Virtue for a magical animal, such as a Beast of Virtue, designed with Magic Might under the Magical Animal rules.

name: Magister in Medicina
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for a character who graduated from a higher university faculty; the highest educational license in Mythic Europe, granting 300 experience points and Academic Reputation 3.

name: Matilda
description: A noblewoman trained in warfare who championed the Pope during the Investiture Controversy and led armies that all but destroyed Imperial authority in Northern Italy; an example of political-success-based female power.

name: Michael Scot
description: Named court wizard of Frederick II, the Holy Roman Emperor, cited as a Greater example of profiting from wizardry.

name: Milan
description: A north Italian city near the iron mines of the southern Alps, famous for armaments and its capacity to produce enormous numbers of weapons to order.

name: Missing Eye
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character cannot judge close distances easily, penalizing missile, targeting, and melee attack rolls.

name: Mongols
description: Invaders against whom the 1245 council calls a crusade; can cause a diocese to be in partibus infidelium.

name: Moratamis of House Guernicus
description: A maga of House Guernicus who, suspicious of Carolus of Tytalus, challenges him to certamen but ultimately concedes; an Intellego and Mentem specialist in the certamen example.

name: Myanar
description: A figure who challenged Quendalon for leadership of the cult of Diana and was slain by him; his followers fled to House Bjornaer and founded the rival secret cult that became the Huntress.

name: Mythic Pound
description: The standardized currency unit used for prices in Ars Magica, equivalent to a pound of silver, a typical peasant's annual income, or a year's upkeep of an average Hermetic laboratory.

name: Necromancy
description: Originally conversing with the dead; by the 13th century covering evocation of spirits and demons.

name: Opening the Intangible Tunnel
description: A Rego Vim spell that opens a magical channel from the caster to a target, allowing spells of greater than Personal range to be cast through it, subject to Penetration of Magic Resistance.

name: Outcast
description: A Minor Social Status Flaw in which normal society rejects the character and he is not attached to a covenant; he may not take the Wealthy Virtue.

name: Outlaw
description: A Major Social Status Flaw in which the character has been outlawed and must live by his wits outside society, with a Reputation at level 2 for whatever got him outlawed.

name: Poor Memory
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character has a very hard time recalling one type of thing such as names, faces, or places.

name: Pope
description: The bishop of Rome and head of the Western Church, who crowns emperors and alone can create, divide, or suppress dioceses; has Commanding Aura with Magic Resistance 25.

name: Pretense
description: A faerie's skill in mimicking a particular human Ability through glamour; not quite the same as an Ability, a skilled observer may detect its use to reveal a faerie's nature.

name: Quarter Days
description: Feast of the Purification of the Virgin in mid-February, an excellent day for divination by hedge witches; Christmas greenery must be down before it.

name: Reims
description: Largest city in Picardy, seat of the most powerful French archbishopric and coronation site of French kings.

name: Rigid Magic
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw in which the character cannot use vis when casting spells, thus cannot boost spell rolls or cast Ritual magic, though vis can be used in the laboratory.

name: Rings of Solomon
description: Seven levels of Ars Notoria wisdom, each a combination of orations and notae, learned in order.

name: Rise of the Feathery Body
description: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 10) that allows the target to float vertically to any height carrying up to 50 pounds, but not move horizontally.

name: Ritual Power
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue giving an at-will supernatural power equivalent to a Ritual Hermetic spell of level 25 or lower, costing Fatigue and Confidence.

name: Saladin
description: Muslim leader said by Joachim to be the sixth of seven persecutors of the Church; some regard him as the Antichrist.

name: Schola Pythagoranis
description: A Hermetic covenant sited on the edge of Cambridge whose magi disguise themselves as a scholarly organization; it invited fleeing Oxford masters to Cambridge and was visited by Robert Grosseteste.

name: Scrying
description: Magical remote observation of others; the Haunt of the Living Ghost spell is noted as not constituting scrying by magic since others can see the caster.

name: Sefirot
description: The ten emanations described in the Sefer Yetzirah, the knowable aspects of creation, studied in Kabbalah from Malchut to Keter.

name: Siegfried
description: The legendary hero of the Nibelungenlied who slew the dragon Fafnir, won the Nibelung treasure, became invulnerable except for one spot, and was treacherously slain by Hagen.

name: St Peter
description: Chief apostle and first bishop of Rome, greater saint (Divine Might 75) and patron of the Church, popes, and fishermen.

name: St. Thomas Becket
description: The martyred Archbishop of Canterbury whose shrine is the great pilgrimage site at Canterbury and whose death won benefit of clergy; killed in a dispute over jurisdictions.

name: Study Bonus
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue granting bonuses to study an Art from books or raw vis when in the presence of a sufficient physical manifestation of that Form or Technique.

name: Summon Animals
description: A Major Non-Hermetic Virtue/Supernatural Ability of the Beast Masters allowing them to summon mundane animals over long distances with an audible call, breaking the Limit of Arcane Connection.

name: Susceptibility to Faerie Power
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character is especially susceptible to the fay, becoming disoriented in Faerie auras and having Magic Resistance halved against faerie effects.

name: Tempters
description: Ninth and largest demonic order, evil spirits propagating sins of incontinence, the rank-and-file of Hell; Might up to 20.

name: The Bountiful Feast
description: A Creo Herbam ritual (Level 35) cast at noon the day after the winter solstice to ensure crops within its target grow healthy and fruitful.

name: The Titans
description: Primordial spirits who, per House Tytalus belief, created the world and man before being imprisoned by the gods of Olympus; Tytalus contacted their shades and employed them against Guorna.

name: The Walking Corpse
description: A spell that animates a corpse into an automaton; such corpses use a revenant's physical statistics but are not supernatural and have no Might score or Magic Resistance.

name: Traditionalists
description: Faction within House Guernicus holding that local Tribunals govern only their Peripheral Code, that the Order is a loose society of equals, and likely opposing a Fourth Estate.

name: Transcendence
description: Power bringing spiritual changes to mind and body, allowing spirit travel and bodily endurance; used with Meditation and Purity.

name: Transitionalists
description: A philosophical faction within House Guernicus, started by Simprim, that believes the Code should be revised and seeks greater legal powers for the Quaesitores.

name: Trier
description: The oldest German city (Roman Augusta Treverorum), ruled by its archbishop; site of Roman remains, the Porta Nigra, the Cathedral of St. Peter, and the underground former covenant of Treverorum.

name: Unseen Arm
description: A Rego Terram spell (ReTe 5) used to hold an object in the air without concentration; moving the object still requires concentration.

name: Venus' Blessing
description: A Minor General Virtue giving +3 on Communication and Presence rolls with sexually compatible characters in appropriate situations.

name: Viea
description: Trianoma's jealous twin sister who interpreted her visions, then stole valuable texts and fled; her fate remains unknown.

name: Vulnerability
description: Weaknesses of demons such as Abhorrent Material, Vulnerability, Protected Group, Ordering and Compulsiveness.

name: Watching Ward
description: A Rego Vim ritual that holds another spell on a target in suspension until triggered by a specified condition; Flambeau and Tytalus magi commonly use it for vengeance spells.

name: Wizard's Sidestep
description: A Rego Imaginem spell in which the caster's image appears up to a pace from their actual position so attacks miss; once the image is struck the caster gains a +9 bonus to Defense.

name: Zoroastrians
description: Mystery cult of Christian astrologers, the Order of Hermes' greatest astrologers, who use astrology to overcome planetary influence and exercise free will; organized into seven degrees.

name: Ambitious
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw: the character wants to be the most successful or powerful person in some respect and avoids distractions from that ambition.

name: Apothecary
description: A General Ability allowing a character to identify, cultivate, and prepare herbs, animal parts and minerals into medicinal remedies; an adjunct to Medicine.

name: Apt Student
description: A Minor General Virtue adding five to Source Quality when being taught or trained.

name: Aquitaine
description: Region in the south of the Normandy Tribunal where Nidi and Atsingani lie and Brabançons roam.

name: Arc of Fiery Ribbons
description: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 25) in which a dozen multi-hued ribbons of flame leap from the caster's hands covering a 60-degree arc, dealing +10 damage to all in the arc.

name: Arliandus
description: A magus of House Tremere whose intact sanctum beneath Trier, specialized in Mentem study, was protected by his enchanted Door of Deimos and held Hermetic treasures.

name: Arthritis
description: A Minor General Flaw: stiff, painful joints giving -3 to rolls involving repetitive sustained movement, with botches potentially locking up a limb.

name: Ash Gild
description: A Rhine Tribunal gild dominated by Flambeau magi who wish to strike aggressively against the Norse wizards beyond the Baltic; led by Philippus Niger and behind the creation of Oculus Septentrionalis.

name: Avalon
description: Manannan's realm, the Land of Promise, also called Emain Ablach, the Isle of Apples or Avalon.

name: Avaricious
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw: the character hoards money or physical things rather than spending or using them.

name: Awaken the Slumbering Corpse
description: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 25) that causes a corpse to function at simple verbal commands; the corpse cannot have been buried by Church ceremony.

name: Bartholomew
description: A demon (Might 50, Mentem) appearing as a successful merchant who gives good business advice backed by blessings and curses, subtly leading merchants into sin while winning souls for Hell.

name: Bavaria
description: A large duchy through which the Danube flows, ruled by Louis of Wittelsbach; only its smaller part north of the Danube belongs to the Rhine Tribunal.

name: Beguines
description: Holy women living religious lives outside formal convents; connected to hermits, with male equivalents called Beghards.

name: Bernard of Clairvaux
description: Saint and founding abbot of Clairvaux Abbey (1090-1153), a dominant Cistercian Church leader who preached the Second Crusade, supported the military orders and opposed heresy.

name: Bilera
description: The Prima of House Guernicus, an Archmaga with a neutral stance on the Traditionalist/Transitionalist debate, residing at Magvillus.

name: Bind Wound
description: A Creo Corpus spell (Level 10) that binds the target's wounds so activity does not worsen them, though wound penalties and inability to heal naturally remain.

name: Blackthorn
description: A powerful covenant in caves under the Black Mountains of south Wales that long dominated the tribunal; home of praeco Talion and seat of recent Stonehenge tribunals.

name: Blessing of Childlike Bliss
description: A spell that reduces an adult mind to a child's level, so the target reasons and expresses emotion as a three-year-old and cannot cast spells.

name: Blood of the Nephilim
aliases: Major Virtue Blood of the Nephilim
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue granting angelic descent, increased Size, very slow aging, and Dominion Lore, but heavy food requirements and many restrictions.

name: Bohemia
description: A subject kingdom of the Rhine Tribunal's southeastern lands, ruled by the Premyslid dynasty; a land of forested plains crossed by the River Elbe with few great cities.

name: Broom of the Winds
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 15) that whips up violent swirling winds around a target who must make rolls to remain standing.

name: Burgundy
description: Region in Normandy Tribunal suggested for the truffle regio near Dijon.

name: Calm the Motion of the Heart
description: A spell that removes one emotion from the target until it appears again naturally, such as making an angry person stop being angry.

name: Cambridge
description: A medium-sized port town on the edge of the Fens with a young university and an unusual number of natural magicians, owing to the influence of Schola Pythagoranis.

name: Cathedral of Chartres
description: A cathedral nearing completion in 1220 where the Dreux and Capetian families compete to fund the most beautiful south-transept window.

name: Charged Item
description: An enchanted item costing no vis that can be used a limited number of times, gaining one charge per five points the Lab Total exceeds the effect level.

name: Cluniac Order
description: Movement within the Benedictines, effectively an independent order, famed for masses for the dead; possibly corrupted by the Infernal through necromancy and Goetia.

name: Confluensis
description: Quaesitorial covenant of the Normandy Tribunal, founded in 810, which moved to the Orchard of Sour Apples in 1051 and opposes the creation of a Lotharingian Tribunal.

name: Corrupt Beast
description: A compulsory Minor Supernatural Flaw for corrupt beasts granting Infernal Might 5, a sinful Personality Trait at +6, a repellent appearance, and the Tainted with Evil Flaw.

name: Covenant Upbringing
description: A Flaw (and background) reflecting a character raised within a covenant, granting Latin and Order of Hermes Lore; held by the Scribe, Minstrel, Washer-woman, and Weapons Instructor templates.

name: Craft Magic
description: The Major Non-Hermetic Virtue of the Rusticani that lets a character build spells and enchanted devices through craft work rather than words and gestures.

name: Craftsman
description: A free Social Status Virtue for a general craftsman practicing a trade not represented by a guild, who may be male or female and live rurally or in town.

name: Curse of Circe
description: A transformation spell that turns a target into a pig; cited as an example whose effect could be modified by experimentation to turn the target into a goat instead.

name: Curse of the Unportended Plague
description: A Perdo Corpus ritual (Level 55) that starts a plague within a city or boundary; its use or transcription is rigorously discouraged by most of the Order of Hermes.

name: Debauchery
description: Unholy Method requiring the infernalist to corrupt her body through sin, suffering Fatigue or a Wound; uses Stamina.

name: Diablerie
description: Unholy Power over supernatural realms and creatures, used to summon, resist and command demons.

name: Discern the Images of Truth and Falsehood
description: An Intellego Imaginem (General) spell that lets the caster tell whether an image was created or altered by a spell, seeing both original and false images.

name: Disguise of the New Visage
description: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 15) that transforms the target's facial features to any approximately human configuration the caster chooses.

name: Dragon's Rest
description: Mercer House vassal of Confluensis on its original Seine site, hub of the Tribunal's Mercere Portal network.

name: Elemental Magic
description: A Major, Hermetic Virtue letting a magus manipulate the elemental Forms (Aquam, Auram, Ignem, Terram) as a connected whole, sharing experience among them.

name: Elementalist
description: Hedge tradition that controls the four elements through Elementalist Techniques and Forms; in 1220 they tend to look like academics.

name: Empedocles
description: An ancient philosopher whose teaching underlies Criamon thought; the Gorgiastics are named for a student who turned against him, and one Sufi school reveres him as a hierophant.

name: Essential Traits
description: Traits possessed by some creatures of the Magic Realm that are part of their essential nature, marked with an asterisk; magic cannot make such creatures act against them.

name: Etzel
description: The king of the Huns in the Nibelungenlied, who marries Kriemhild; historically Attila, the dreaded chieftain checked at the Battle of Chalons.

name: Excommunication
description: Cursing of those who fail to pay tithes; its widespread use calls demons to an area seeking an easy harvest of souls.

name: Experimentation
description: Risky laboratory practice of pushing beyond known limits, adding a simple die to the Lab Total but requiring a roll on the Extraordinary Results Chart each season.

name: External Soul
description: A soul kept outside the body; a gruagach dies if it is scratched, while kolduni can learn to have one that must be destroyed in a specific way.

name: Factor
description: A minor Social Status Virtue for a character who manages the interests of a trading house in a single city; also used for independent traders with capital but lacking other-city connections.

name: Fafnir
description: The great dragon slain by the hero Siegfried at Drachenfels, in whose blood Siegfried bathed to become invulnerable; his brood or his brother Regin's may still endure.

name: False Power
description: A Major (or repeatable Minor) Supernatural Tainted Flaw in which one of the character's Supernatural Virtues is also associated with the Infernal realm, making it appear unholy.

name: Fast Caster
description: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue granting +3 to Initiative for casting spells in combat and +3 to fast-casting speed rolls.

name: Fatigue
description: A measure of tiredness with six named levels (Fresh, Winded, Weary, Tired, Dazed, Unconscious), lost through strenuous activity and recovered with rest.

name: Faun
description: Lustful faeries; twisted fauns prowl the borders of Infernal spaces and are virtually indistinguishable from demons; they hold bacchanalian parties with nymphs.

name: Favored Abilities
description: The few Abilities, usually Methods and Powers, that a holy tradition favors; characters with True Faith may study them without the Supernatural Ability penalty.

name: Flight
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue / Supernatural Ability to fly, using Stamina and Auram, via fetish (broom) or potion.

name: Florum
description: A Normandy Tribunal covenant in Ghent disguised as a suburb owned by the fictional de Spinnen family; it employs the Spinnen and leads support for the Lotharingian Tribunal.

name: Furies
description: Order of demons of wrath including Architectus, Bael, the Demons of the Fifth Trump, dibbukim and Sabaoth; led by Abaddon.

name: Genoa
description: A north Italian city-state whose merchants rival Venice's and who have seeded the East with trading colonies that act as resupply points and friendly wartime ports.

name: Gentleman
description: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for a minor member of a noble family treated as their own and addressed as Lord or Lady, though without inheritance.

name: Gerbert of Aurillac
description: A scholar said in legend to have stolen a book of magic from a Saracen wizard and made a golden oracular head; Hermetic seekers covet his rumored treasures.

name: Golden Cord
description: The three mystical cords forged when binding a familiar: golden (magic), silver (mind), and bronze (body), each rated 0 to +5 and granting specific benefits.

name: Great Beast
description: Powerful ancestral beast-spirits of House Bjornaer who set quests and trials for magi seeking the Inner Heartbeast Mysteries and who act as Mystagogues during their Initiation.

name: Great Strength
description: Great Strength: Virtue listed among the Virtues of example divine beings or holy characters in Realms of Power: The Divine.

name: Harmonists
description: A faction within House Bjornaer led by Falke that becomes dominant at Crintera and, in the Schism, remains besieged on Rügen claiming to be the true domus magna.

name: Harnessed Magic
description: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue giving great control over one's spells, allowing the magus to cancel his own spells and magic items by concentrating.

name: Haunt of the Living Ghost
description: A Creo Imaginem spell (Level 35) with an Intellego requisite that projects the caster's image and voice to a place to which they have an Arcane Connection, often used to attend inter-covenant councils remotely.

name: Henri de Tours
description: A skilled diplomat and famous merchant associated with Oculus Septentrionalis, who may play a leading role in negotiating the Treaty of Lubeck and Hamburg and rising to become Alderman of the Hanseatic League.

name: Heorot
description: A covenant recently founded on Zealand to discover more about the wizards of the North; closely allied to Oculus Septentrionalis and in conflict with the martial Waddenzee.

name: Hera
description: Greek goddess and parthenogenetic mother of Hephaestus, who retrieved him to Olympus and was tortured by Zeus in a mechanized chair.

name: Hercynius
description: A Bonisagus magus whose lineage, the Hercynian magi of the Waldherz chapter, maintained harmony with the Black Forest fae before being exiled and eradicated during the Schism War.

name: Hermes History
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Hermetic Arts
description: The fifteen Techniques and Forms of Hermetic magic, which can be opened in a character with The Gift and advanced through study from vis, books, or teaching but not by simple practice.

name: Hermetic Numerology
description: Minor Mystery Virtue letting a magus devise Rotes and enchant a Numerologist's Book; prerequisite for Divination (Numerology).

name: Hermetic Tourney
description: A Normandy Tribunal contest through which covenants win vis; Lapis Crudus has not participated since its sealing.

name: High Crime
description: A serious category of offense under the Code of Hermes, of which a Pralician obtaining excess scrying information could be convicted.

name: Horsingas
description: A covenant in the Loch Leglean Tribunal founded by Saxon magi determined to oppose the Normans, using Mentem magic to cover their tracks.

name: Hunchback
description: A Minor General Flaw giving the character a deformed body with a grotesque appearance and penalties to agility, balance, and looks.

name: Image Phantom
description: Faerie power letting a non-principal faerie coat an object with illusion to seem another thing of similar size and shape, modelled on the spell of the same name.

name: Initiation Quest
description: A story-based requirement of an Initiation Script involving a journey, danger, and challenges; takes at least one season.

name: Initiation Sacrifice
description: The least taxing Initiation requirement: a sacrifice of time, wealth, books, a talisman, or even an apprentice or familiar.

name: Inoffensive to Animals
description: A Virtue often possessed by Donatores who received a vision from Saint Gertrude of Nivelles.

name: Insatella
description: The Prima of House Mercere, an unGifted Redcap who inherited the role from her father and manages the House from Harco in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Inscription on the Soul
description: Spirit Magic Mystery (Chapter 8) letting a magus use body or spirit as talisman; it can substitute for Great Talisman as prerequisite to Consummate Talisman.

name: Insight
description: A way to convert vis gained in the Magic Realm into knowledge of a single Magic Realm effect.

name: Invisibility of the Standing Wizard
description: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 15) that makes the target invisible, but the spell breaks if the target moves and the target still casts a shadow.

name: Invocation
description: Method of calling holy effects by addressing God and His servants by name; usually Communication-based and requires investing Confidence.

name: Isle of Man
description: Island of which Manannan was god until cast out by Saint Patrick; subject of a Grand Tribunal ruling on Tribunal membership.

name: Jupiter's Resounding Blow
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 10) that creates a thunderclap that may deafen anyone directly underneath.

name: Kabbalah
description: Supernatural Ability, the Jewish form of the Invocation Divine Method, and the mystical understanding of creation used to make golems; also the Jewish occult tradition as a whole.

name: Lapis Crudus
description: Once-great covenant founded 1064 to heal the Flambeau–Tytalus rift, trapped in a faerie regio in Fontainebleau for eighty years by Candidus.

name: Larta
description: A category of unGifted person afforded protection and tutelage by a Hermetic House; Hildegard of Bingen is cited as a Larta maga of House Jerbiton.

name: Leprosy
description: A Major General Flaw representing the divine disease; it gives a permanent -2 Living Condition modifier and an extra Heavy Wound during Aging Crises, and prevents gaining a positive reputation.

name: Lesser Benediction
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue granting a minor blessing from a supernatural power, with examples like Gift of the Gab, Green Fingers, and Pricking Thumbs.

name: Linden Gild
description: A peace-striving go-between gild founded by former magi of Fengheld after the Schism War, seeking cooperation between magi and covenants; led by Occultes of Durenmar.

name: Lost Love
description: A Flaw often developed by Path of Strife magi who lose the spouses they married in the ritual at the Station That Repels and Attracts Elements.

name: Lunar Sphere
description: The lowest of the celestial spheres carrying the heavenly bodies around the stationary Earth in Mythic Europe's medieval physics; it is also the limit of the power of Hermetic magic.

name: Magic Spirit
description: Special Virtue for a mind, memory, image or idea brought to life by Magic; insubstantial and always having the Magical Air Flaw.

name: Magic Thing
description: Inherited Virtue of magical beings that are things rather than creatures, such as the mandrake, Amiculum, kelpies and elementals.

name: Magical Animal Companion
description: A useful minor Flaw giving a character a magical animal companion; listed as a resource increasing an agent's Resistance Strength.

name: Magical Warder
description: A Major General Virtue giving the character a magical being, such as a ghost, that watches over him and comes to no harm; designed as a magic character.

name: Major Breakthrough
description: A significant advance in Hermetic theory; the Aegis of the Hearth was a Major Breakthrough, while inventing variant parameters of it would require at least a Minor Breakthrough.

name: Maleficia
description: Infernal effects resembling Hermetic spells, cast with a Method plus a Power: stress die + Characteristic + Method + Power + aura.

name: Mari Amwithig
description: An example Merinita maga used to illustrate Charm Magic, Story Magic, and Symbolic Magic, who modifies spells with charms and tricks faerie lords out of their treasures.

name: Merovingians
description: A dynasty of Christian wizard-kings descended from the Holy-Grail-bearing Merovech and the Gifted Clovis; their corruption within seven decades is one proposed Divine cause of the Curse.

name: Merrows
description: Faeries human from the waist up living in clans beneath the waters where fishing is good; some gain their tails by magical red caps.

name: Montpellier
description: A famed southern medical school where Gilles de Corbeil taught before leaving amid feuding with the faculty; one of the schools granting the Magister in Medicina.

name: Motion Sickness
description: A Minor General Flaw causing the character to become violently ill when riding a horse, in a cart, or sailing, doubling fatigue loss on long journeys.

name: Muse
description: A title for any supernatural entity from the four realms that attaches itself to a prominent artist, granting Virtues, powers, and Warping in exchange for promoting its interests, eventually carrying the artist to its home realm.

name: Names of Power
description: Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue of name magic; Names of Power add bonuses to Casting Score for spells matching their scope, limited by Magic Theory.

name: Nidi
description: A small covenant near Bergerac, vassal of Oleron, that hides behind the nobleman Henri and exploits niches in urbanizing land; its name changes with each leader and now means starling.

name: No Fatigue
description: Virtue or creature Quality listed for a being (Anne, Minerva Sulis, Balneator) or setting feature described here.

name: No Sense of Direction
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is completely unable to follow directions and frequently gets lost; incompatible with the Well Traveled Virtue.

name: Normans
description: Immigrants gaining control over the Scots; many Norman families live in the Lowlands, and demons have come with them.

name: Occultes
description: A Follower of Bonisagus and figurehead of the outward-looking faction favoring hedge wizardry; former librarian and now leader of the Linden Gild who secretly hoards restricted texts.

name: Oleron
description: A powerful, self-reliant Autumn covenant in a faerie regio that exchanges surplus vis with vassals; liege of Nidi.

name: Oxford
description: A master-run English university closely modeled on Paris, with four faculties and two student nations, governed via a chancellor appointed by the Bishop of Lincoln.

name: Pains of the Perpetual Worry
description: A Creo Mentem spell (Level 20) that gives someone a nagging, painful recurrent emotion of anxiety and fear; described as truly a curse.

name: Patron
description: A sponsor who agrees to support an artist for an undetermined length of time, funding all of his work; losing one costs 12 Artist Reputation experience points.

name: Persia
description: The land of the Magians, original priestly caste, and home to most Mazdean communities, lying east of Mythic Europe.

name: Piercing the Faerie Veil
description: An Intellego Vim spell that lets the caster see through the boundaries of Faerie regiones and find the path to the next level.

name: Potentates
description: Supernatural Abilities (Adjuration, Blessing, Cursing, Intervention, Transcendence, Understanding, Wonders) producing miraculous effects.

name: Prying Eyes
description: An Intellego Imaginem spell that lets the caster see inside a room as long as they touch one of its walls, changing viewpoint within during the duration.

name: Pythagoras
description: Mystic of Samos, founder of the Society at Croton; claimed past life of the Blessed One and inspiration of the Fraternity of Samos.

name: Qualities
description: Traits purchased by magical creatures (including Minor Virtues); cats may have only 10 points of them.

name: Rabbinic Law
description: An Academic Ability, the Jewish version of Civil & Canon Law, drawn from the Talmud, the Oral Torah, and the Responsa of the Geonim.

name: Rapid Convalescence
description: Rapid Convalescence: Virtue listed among the Virtues of example divine beings or holy characters in Realms of Power: The Divine.

name: Reconquista
description: The Christian conquest of Muslim Iberia, which shaped Iberian noble and town systems.

name: Religious
description: The vocation of monks and nuns; 'religious' is the technical term for monks and nuns, who observe the canonical hours, prayer and service to God.

name: Rheinstein
description: A former covenant founded 1123 AD on the island of Pfalz in the Rhine Gorge; attacked and destroyed in 1200 AD by an army of irate mundanes led by the archbishop of Trier.

name: Richard de Marsh
description: King Richard, more at home in Normandy than England, who offered to sell London at the start of the Third Crusade, executed 3,000 men at Acre, and fought Philip II with a paid army.

name: Roznov
description: An Autumn covenant in eastern Moravia combining two traditions: a pagan priesthood of Radegast (House Ex Miscellanea at Roznov Castle) and an archconservative House Tremere stronghold (at Roznov Fort).

name: Rune Magic
description: Magic of the Order of Odin that might be integrated into the Children of Odin's repertoire.

name: Sacraments
description: Seven holy ceremonies with supernatural effects that often impart Faith Points and only affect willing participants.

name: Sailor's Foretaste of the Morrow
description: An Intellego Auram spell (Level 15) that tells the caster precisely tomorrow's weather and gives a general impression of the week ahead at the casting location.

name: Salerno
description: A southern center of medical learning whose school accepts female students and is the source of secret Theriacs such as the Cataplasm of Mandrake and Soporific Sponge.

name: Scutage
description: Fee paid by vassals instead of mustering, allowing the lord to hire mercenaries; kings also demand scutage from lords.

name: Selkies
description: Human-shaped faeries living beneath the waters who change into seal shape; if their seal skins are stolen they may be forced to become spouses.

name: Sense Passions
description: A Supernatural Ability to sense the personality and desires of an intelligent being by reading the tarnish on its soul, often a false power or Infernally associated.

name: Sight of the Transparent Motive
description: An Intellego Mentem spell (Level 10) that detects the general motive most powerfully influencing the target at the moment, such as fear, anger, or greed.

name: Speak Latin
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Spirit Away
description: Greater Faerie Power (Vim) letting a faerie add Threshold points to mortals at 1 Might per point, or send them out of Faerie.

name: Steed of Vengeance
description: A Muto Animal spell (Level 35) that turns a horse into a ferocious magical mount with a black coat, fiery eyes, fangs, and razor-sharp hooves.

name: Steward of the House
description: The lord's representative on the manor, acting for him at manorial courts and accounting annually for the fief's business; master of the other manorial servants.

name: Strong Angelic Heritage
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue requiring Blood of the Nephilim; it grants a Divine Might (Corpus) score, Magic Resistance, immunity to Warping, and levels of holy powers invoked by spending Might points.

name: Summoning the Distant Image
description: An Intellego Imaginem spell that lets the caster see and hear what is happening in a distant place via an Arcane Connection to the location or a person there.

name: Sympathetic Connection
description: A magical relationship drawn from symbolic correspondences, used in charms and Synthemata Magic; severed and invalidated against a magus by the Secret Name Mystery.

name: Tasgillia
description: The fourth Prima of House Tytalus, despised for her selfish nature and puissant in spirit magic; she was executed for diabolism in 961 AD after summoning demons using Guorna's lore.

name: The Betrayal
description: The event in 961 AD when Kalliste exposed Tasgillia's diabolism publicly, shaming House Tytalus; Tytali view it as Kalliste betraying the Founder's principle of putting nature before custom.

name: The Fallen Temple of Mercury
description: Large ruined Roman temple complex built by Augustus, the size of a small town, lying in a Magic regio whose entrance can be in any former Roman territory; a source of Mercurian rituals.

name: Theology: Islam
description: An Ability a Mamluk character may take even without the Educated Virtue, reflecting his religious education in a military school.

name: Third Crusade
description: Crusade at whose start English lords sold manumissions and land cheaply, and King Richard said he would sell London.

name: Thoughts within Babble
description: An Intellego Mentem spell (Level 25) that lets the caster understand the speech of those within the target area, including misused language.

name: Tours
description: City on the Loire with the Basilica of St. Martin, site of the Redcap Mercer House Alcuin's Auberge.

name: Tracks of the Faerie Glow
description: A spell used in a Performance Magic example; its Hunter's variant is cast by Harold using Performance Magic (Hunt) to gain magically enhanced vision while hunting.

name: Unicorn
description: A legendary horned beast whose horn provides Shape and Material bonuses to healing (+8), poison detection (+10), and fertility (+11).

name: Uther Pendragon
description: Brother of King Aurelius who led fifteen thousand knights to Ireland with Merlin to fetch the stones of the Giant's Ring; he later fathered Arthur at Tintagel while magically disguised as Gorlois.

name: Venus's Blessing
description: A suitable Free Virtue for Jerbiton magi, preferred for characters desiring weaker emotional attachments.

name: Victor of Mercere
description: A famous magus of House Mercere from Semita Errabunda; a faerie dell named Victor Valley after him might be inhabited by a faerie sharing his reputed qualities.

name: Vinaria
description: An archmage and former Prima of House Merinita who stepped down after being outmaneuvered by Handri; she returned after seven years of claimed Faerie Twilight with a new inner strength that frightens Handri, and is strong in the raw elemental arts.

name: Vitality
