description: Human energy borrowed by faeries that lets them feel, grow, learn and change; roused by emotion, art, offerings and life transitions.

name: Walpurgis Night
description: Celebration beginning May with fires, dancing and leaping; peasants run cattle between two May Day fires against hedge witch curses.

name: Weak Characteristics
description: A Minor General Flaw giving the character three fewer points to spend buying Characteristics.

name: Whistle Up The Wind
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue granting a score of 1 in the Supernatural Ability Whistle Up The Wind, letting the character create winds by whistling.

name: Wilderists
description: A philosophy within House Bjornaer favoring the wilderness; the Hawthorn Gild is populated primarily by Bjornaer with a Wilderist philosophy, including Schwall.

name: William the Conqueror
description: Duke of Normandy who conquered England after the Battle of Hastings in 1066, built the Tower of London, and commissioned the Domesday Book.

name: Worms
description: A famed Rhine city linked to the Nibelungenlied as the Royal Fortress of the Nibelung, ruled by its prince-bishop, with a great cathedral and the largest Jewish settlement in Germany.

name: Abbot
description: Ruler and spiritual father of a monastery, elected for life and often very powerful.

name: Accusers
description: Order of demons including Andrew, Bordelon, the Miser's Pot and Nithael, with Powers Betrayal of the Heart and Whispers Behind the Back.

name: Anjou
description: Region of the counties of Anjou, Touraine and Maine, formerly Angevin, now held by the French crown.

name: Apromor
description: A Flambeau magus and founder of a major lineage and the School of Apromor, focused on the Technique of Perdo; Boreas was descended from Flambeau through his line.

name: Arae Flaviae
description: An early Rhine Tribunal covenant, established in 780, that was among the first to mix magi of several Houses; its model democratic charter is widely copied across the Order.

name: Ars Notoria
description: Academic, Arcane, Supernatural Ability of divine orations and rituals descended from King Solomon, granting divine wisdom through rings of recitation.

name: Astrolabe of Jerbiton
description: Possibly the most brilliant magus in the tribunal, a Jerbiton at Schola Pythagoranis devoted to natural philosophy who critiques magic theory's physics.

name: Atlanteans
description: A people native to a magic regio; an exiled Atlantean tainted by the surface world cannot return, as detailed in Realms of Power: Magic.

name: Atsingani
description: A small mobile Spring covenant, vassal of Montverte, of Brabançon mercenaries in wagons and tents living by brigandage in southern Normandy Tribunal.

name: Automata
description: A Major House Mystery for constructing mechanized beasts and men of wood, stone, or metal, imbued with Magic Might and enchanted to perform tasks like servants.

name: Avengers of Evil
description: Demonic order claiming to be Angels of Punishment doing God's work, appearing as immense angels of fiery chains; Might up to 25.

name: Avicenna
aliases: Abu Ali al-Hussain Ibn Abdallah Ibn Sina
description: Abu Ali al-Hussain Ibn Abdallah Ibn Sina (b. 980 near Bukhara), Gifted physician and founder of the Tulab Ibn Sina; entombed in Hamadan.

name: Axis Magica
description: The great pole around which the world's tides of magical energy circle; it is the Founder Criamon himself transformed into a living bridge keeping open the Twilight Road.

name: Baneful Circumstances
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw: the character's supernatural nature weakens him in common circumstances, preventing recovery of Fatigue, healing, or Might at those times.

name: Baptism
description: Sacrament cleansing original sin, driving away possessing spirits and canceling non-Divine supernatural effects; baptismal names cannot be True Names.

name: Barbegazi
description: All-male dwarfs of the snows living in mountaintop burrows, with icicle beards and broad feet; their cries cause avalanches.

name: Basel
description: A city on the Upper Rhine, the highest navigable point of the river, where Redcaps make frequent use of the Copper Rooster Inn maintained by House Mercere.

name: Basilisk
description: A magical lizard whose gaze can kill; Philippus Niger tracked a female basilisk and obtained one of her eggs to hatch his familiar Sordus.

name: Beast of Outlandish Size
description: A Muto Animal spell that enlarges a creature; the appendix notes its description is slightly amended so Initiative is reduced along with the listed effects.

name: Bee King
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue from faerie blood letting a character command and understand bees, never be stung, and not age, but die exactly a century after birth.

name: Boundary
description: The border outlining a location in the Magic Realm, level 0-10, aligned to a Form, granting magic bonuses, botch dice, and vis, and allowing travel.

name: Bows
description: Weapon Ability used for bows, composite bows, horse bows and longbows.

name: Cailleach
description: An evil faerie hag that plagues the covenant of Circulus Ruber, unable to breach its Aegis of the Hearth and taking out its frustration on travelers.

name: Capo
description: A game-defined merchant role: the leader of a merchant company who sets grand strategy, appoints factors, and engages in politics; characters must take the Capo Social Status Virtue.

name: Carmine
description: Follower of Flambeau of Iberian ancestry, Andru's model, mistress and wife, the only non-Jerbiton magus living permanently at Valnastium; a member of the lineage of Abydaros.

name: Celestial Magic
description: Major Mystery Virtue replacing Planetary Magic; widens Laboratory Horoscopes, adds celestial Durations, favorable spellcasting hours and astrologically linked enchantments.

name: Ceremonial Influence
description: The ability of infernalists to inspire sinful Personality Traits in others via personal or ceremonial influence (simple die + Presence + Leadership).

name: Chaotic Magic
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw: the magus's spontaneous magic is wild, and if it falls short of or exceeds the desired level by more than one, the storyguide decides the uncontrolled results.

name: Charles Martel
description: The Frankish King who repulsed the Moorish army at the Battle of Tours in 732, the historical event that destroyed Flambeau's family estate.

name: Charm against Putrefaction
description: A Creo Corpus spell (Level 10) that prevents decay of a human corpse or severed body part; used by necromancers to preserve revived corpses.

name: Chase
description: Land reserved for a lord's hunting; Nidi declares its key sites a chase to deter trespass and prevent the Dominion from spreading.

name: Circling Winds of Protection
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 20) with a Rego requisite that surrounds the caster with fast-circling winds that obscure and penalize attacks against them.

name: Clenching Grasp of the Crushed Heart
description: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 40) that, with a clenching motion of the hand, causes the victim to double over and die at once.

name: Climb
description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

name: Clouds of Rain and Thunder
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 25) that creates a small but severe rainstorm with lightning and winds while the caster concentrates.

name: Communication
description: Characteristic combined with Leadership to shorten group training time.

name: Converse with Plant and Tree
description: An Intellego Herbam spell (Level 25) that lets you speak with a plant for one conversation, with detail depending on the plant's type.

name: Corruption of House Tytalus
description: A recent infernal fall within House Tytalus that reminds the Order how easily magic slips into Infernal sorcery.

name: Corsica
description: The island where Verditius was born; site of his blood feud and capture, and where the Rings of Verditius were possibly lost.

name: Cow and Calf Oath
description: An agreement, originating in a Hibernia Tribunal ruling, under which a book purchaser will not sell or freely give copies without the seller's permission.

name: Crafter of (Form)
description: Power duplicating any Creo or Rego Aquam spell of level 35 or below at 1 Might per magnitude; possessed by Phorcys and the Elemental Spirit of the Waves.

name: Cripple the Howling Wolf
description: A Perdo Animal spell (Level 25) that cleanly breaks one of a target animal's legs, with damage healing as a Medium Wound.

name: Crun Clach
description: Covenant in a faerie hill in Kintyre, won at shinty from the Prince of the Grey Jerkin, led by Caitlin and inhabited largely by faerie retainers.

name: Cult of Diana
description: A struggling pagan cult of the goddess Diana that absorbed the rites of Vesta and survived the Fall of Rome in the wilderness; Merinita is said to have been one of its high priestesses.

name: Cult of Mithras
description: An ancient Roman mystery cult worshiping the savior-god Mithras; a remnant magical lineage founded by Kaeso forms the Mithraic tradition within House Flambeau.

name: Curse of the Desert
description: A Perdo Aquam spell that removes virtually all fluid from a target's body, dealing damage that armor does not protect against; the target must drink within minutes or die.

name: Curse of the Leprous Flesh
description: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 25) that inflicts leprosy on the target, causing an Incapacitating Wound and loss of Stamina as the flesh rots.

name: Curse-Throwing
description: A cultural variant of Curse-Throwing in which a sin-eater takes on the sins of the dying via a ritual meal, preventing the spirit from becoming a ghost; common among Saxon-descended cultures.

name: Cîteaux
description: The mother house of the Cistercian Order in France where the abbots meet annually in September; founded by Robert of Molesme in 1098.

name: Deft Form
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue removing Casting Total penalties for non-standard voice/gestures with one Form.

name: Devil Child
description: A type of Mythic Companion created by powerful demons as weapons in the conflict between Heaven and Hell; tragic figures with Hellish powers but free will.

name: Disorientating Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw requiring the magus to spend a round recovering his mental faculties after casting a spell.

name: Dream Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue allowing magi to travel spiritually into dreams and cast dream spells; the first degree of the Volshebnii Mechtateli.

name: Eboris
description: A small neutral covenant in Paris, the House of the Ivory Carvers, led by Mathieus, hosting young Jerbiton magi and the Itinerarium rather than research.

name: Effusion
description: Unholy Power Ability wielding power over the physical world, inorganic materials and natural forces.

name: Elysium
description: The world of the Faerie Realm holding myths and tales of great deeds, where characters meet heroes, villains and faerie gods; reached by the Path of Destiny.

name: Empyreal Aura
description: A Divine aura untouched by worldly matters, radiating from relics, saints, miracle sites or divine creatures rather than a congregation; manifests as a sphere.

name: Enchantment of Detachment
description: A spell that calms and greatly lowers the intensity of the target's current emotions.

name: Envious
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character believes others undeservedly have it better and tries to ruin their lives.

name: Exspectatio
description: Vassal of Fudarus in the Arrée Mountains, occupied by six Tytalan magi who left Fudarus during the Primi feud.

name: Eyes of the Past
description: Scrying spell that runs into anti-scrying defenses in the Mac Gruagach murder story.

name: Faerie Power
description: Supernatural Ability describing a faerie rite's effect, each vulnerable to a chosen uncommon circumstance; examples Beguile, Conjure, Dream, Grant, Portage, Ware, Weal, Woe.

name: Famuli
description: Least of the False Gods, demonic familiars given to diabolists, appearing as small animals containing a detachable homunculus; they hide the taint of Infernal Powers.

name: Fenistal
description: The hidden 'covenant' base of the exsules, located in the southern Bohemian Forest in the upper level of a powerful magic regio (aura 8); the original temple of Diana where Merinita served, occupied by renegade House Merinita exiles.

name: Fist of Shattering
description: A Perdo Terram spell that breaks apart an object of stone or weaker material, cited as an example affected by the Harmless Magic Flaw.

name: French
description: Living Language of most of the Tribunal (Langues d'Oil), with dialects Orleanais, Norman, Picard, Walloon, Champenois, Bourguignon, Lorrain, Poitevin.

name: Gender Shift
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue letting a character change genders each midnight, with consistent male and female forms.

name: Generous
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character willingly gives away property to anyone who desires it.

name: Ghent
description: A place near which the Spinnen Blood family line of the Faerie Blood Virtue originated.

name: Gigantic
description: A Virtue or Magic Quality named among the traits of magical animals or dragons in this text.

name: Gorgiastic
description: Former House Criamon magi (or their descendants) who rejected the quest for the answer; named for a student of Empedocles, most found in Houses Ex Miscellanea and Jerbiton.

name: Great Communication
description: A Virtue held by Brogo giving him exceptional Communication, contributing to his songs' Aesthetic Quality.

name: Great Lezi
description: A powerful faerie (Might 40, Herbam) of Slavic lands appearing as a tall pale bearded man who commands woodland animals and can change into any plant or animal and vary its size enormously.

name: Greek Fire
description: A sticky, flammable substance that cannot be extinguished by water, used by the Byzantine navy from siphons and catapult pots to incinerate enemy vessels; its manufacture is a closely guarded secret.

name: Griffin
description: A famous legendary chimera; also a Mythic Blood lineage granting the Panic of the Elephant's Mouse feat and a Focus in Courage.

name: Guide
description: Greater Power (ReMe 30) subtly influencing a group toward a course of action.

name: Healing
description: Major Supernatural Virtue / Supernatural Ability for true healing of wounds and Fatigue, breaking the Limit of Energy at a Corpus vis cost.

name: Heartbeast Temperament
description: The classification of heartbeasts into four classical temperaments (sanguine, choleric, melancholic, phlegmatic), which may be pure or aspected.

name: Heat of the Searing Forge
description: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 10) that heats a piece of metal too hot to touch, doing decreasing damage over rounds to anyone in skin contact with it.

name: Hercynian Forest
description: The vast primeval forest of Germany described by Caesar and Pliny; its single powerful spirit was fragmented by the Cult of Mercury and St. Boniface into many genii loci.

name: Heresy
description: Heretical belief, prompting more frequent visitation; magi's views are likely heretical to the Church.

name: Hermetic Architecture
description: Minor Mystery Virtue for large-scale enchantment of rooms, buildings, stone circles, paths and gateways through linked component devices, and for manipulating auras and regiones.

name: Hermetic Dream Interpreter
description: Major Supernatural Mystery Virtue: a specialized method of Hermetic Divination through interpreting dreams, with Dream Calling and symbolic interpretation.

name: Hermetic Geometry
description: Minor Mystery Virtue using Euclid's postulates for sympathetic magic, granting casting bonuses for perfect figures and new Line Range, Arcane Circle Target and Arcane Ring Duration.

name: Hierarchy Score
description: A measure of an infernalist's or demon's repute in Hell, which protects against failed maleficia and modifies Goetic totals.

name: Holy Tradition
description: A group of like-minded holy people organized around favored divine Abilities, through which Methods and Powers are learned.

name: Homing Instinct
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue letting a character always know the way to a number of known locations and have fixed Arcane Connections to them.

name: Horoscope
description: The natal chart of an Electus Initiate, kept by the Initiators; together with a lock of hair it gives a Penetration bonus against the Initiate.

name: Hubris
description: A Minor Personality Flaw inflicted on Verditius magi through Inner Mystery Ordeals; it grows like an Ability with success and is mystically coupled to a Verditius's Gift to boost enchantment Lab Totals.

name: Huge
description: Major General Virtue (faeries only) making the character far larger, adjusting Size, Characteristics and Body levels.

name: Human Form
description: Virtue or creature Quality listed for a being (Anne, Minerva Sulis, Balneator) or setting feature described here.

name: Hungary
description: Kingdom known for the quality of its riding horses such as palfreys and jennets.

name: Hybrid Form
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue giving a body mixing human and animal elements.

name: Iceland
description: Remote Norse colony guarded by ancients, target of the Hermetic crusade.

name: Immortal Magi
description: Magi who became beings of a supernatural realm; they have Might, no longer age and cannot learn without binding it into a talisman.

name: Infelicitas
description: Covenant raided by Jacinth of Oleron, whose upper story collapsed destroying two laboratories.

name: Interdict
description: Act in which the hero is issued a command by an authority figure which is then violated, sending him on adventure.

name: Invocation Magic
description: Major Mystery Virtue requiring Names of Power, letting a magus cast Names of Power as Muto Vim spells to boost a following spellcasting, limited by Magic Theory.

name: Islam
description: One of the three Divine religions in Mythic Europe; Muslims live within a Dominion aura indistinguishable from the Church's, and a significant number of magi are Muslims.

name: Islamic Law
description: An Academic Ability, the Muslim version of Civil & Canon Law, drawn from the Qur'an and the Sunna.

name: Islands
description: The islands west of Scotland, called the Sudreys by the Norse, divided into the Outer and Inner Hebrides.

name: Joseph of Arimathea
description: The companion who came to Britain with Christ and later carried Christ's blood in a vessel, traveling west with eleven companions to found the first church at Glastonbury.

name: Judged Unfairly
description: A Minor General Flaw in which people universally distrust and underestimate the character, preventing him from gaining a positive Reputation.

name: Julia
description: The de facto leader of Voluntas and one of the tribunal's best politicians, a mature Jerbiton maga specializing in Corpus and Mentem who orchestrated the breaking of Blackthorn's dominance at the 1201 tribunal.

name: Kalliste
description: Filia of Tasgillia who exposed her mater's diabolism and became the fifth Prima of House Tytalus; Tytali regard her exposure of Tasgillia as the "Betrayal" of the Founder's principles.

name: Karaites
description: A tradition of Karaite Jews with The Gift who practice Holy Magic and may join the Order so long as their magic comes directly from God.

name: Keen Sense of Smell
description: A Minor General Virtue giving a +3 bonus to all rolls involving the sense of smell, including tracking with the Hunt Ability.

name: King of the Black Mountain
aliases: King Fir of the Black Forest
description: The dread faerie ruler of the Black Forest with Faerie Might 90, dwelling atop the Feldberg; born from a rebellious splinter of the original genius locus and seeking the destruction of Durenmar.

name: Latin Empire
description: The crusader-created state ruling Constantinople after the 1204 sack, the weakest of four powers feuding over the Balkans, whose Latin Emperor cares more for his home Flanders than the City.

name: Legatus a latere
description: Closest advisors of the pope, appointed by him, who aid him in Rome and act as legates; up to 53 at a time in three ranks.

name: Lesser Enchanted Item
description: A category of enchanted device requiring the Lab Total to be at least double the effect's modified level and to which Effect Expiry cannot be applied.

name: Lifting the Dangling Puppet
description: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 15) that lifts a person of Size +1 or less vertically into the air.

name: Limit of the Divine
description: One of the two fundamental limits of Hermetic magic: magic cannot affect the Divine, with most lesser limits believed to derive from it.

name: Living Ghost
description: Major Hermetic Mystery Virtue in which a magus is bound to a Haunt and ritually killed to become a free-willed immortal ghost.

name: Low Self-Esteem
description: A Flaw common among Bjornaer magi who were catuli (apprentices ordered around) for most of their apprenticeships.

name: Lowlands
description: English in culture and law, with many English and Norman families; ruled by the Roman Church.

name: Maddenhofen Woods
description: A stretch of woods on the northwestern fringe of the Bohemian Forest protected by House Merinita; site of Tytalus's 807 AD disappearance and home of a powerful faerie who grants Heart's Desire at a price.

name: Magic Human
description: Special Virtue for a magical human born with Magic Might and the Monstrous Appearance Inferiority, possibly descended from ancient magical beings.

name: Magical Affinity
description: Virtue granting affinity with an Art (Domnhull's Vim); unavailable to gruagachan.

name: Magical Champion
description: Minor Social Status Virtue for magic characters regarded as the particular representative of a small group due to their magical nature.

name: Magical Friend
description: Minor Social Status Flaw: the character is considered less than human but favored by a human, e.g. as pet or familiar.

name: Maintaining the Demanding Spell
description: A Rego Vim spell that automatically maintains a concentration-requiring spell already cast for the duration of this spell, without the caster needing to concentrate.

name: Malediction
description: A Flaw a sahir might acquire from botched dealings with jinn during apprenticeship.

name: Manifestation
description: Faerie power manifesting consciousness among animals and plants within its glamour, simulating CrAn, ReAn, CrHe or ReHe effects.

name: Master of (Form) Creatures
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a character tame animals and unintelligent beings whose Magic Might is aligned with a particular Form.

name: Mercenary Captain
description: A Social Status Virtue that grants a character an agency prior to play and appears as a minor social status example on the Resistance of Agents Table.

name: Merchant
description: A Free Social Status Virtue for a character who lives by buying and selling goods, whether peddler, shopkeeper, or traveling merchant.

name: Mesnie
description: The military household servants of a lord, knights expected to be loyal while the lord maintains their standard of living and dignity.

name: Moors
description: Moorish lands where Giacomo met charm casters; they hold alchemical texts.

name: Mute
description: A Major General Flaw in which the character cannot speak; magi with this Flaw take a -10 penalty to all spellcasting unless offset by the Quiet Magic Virtue.

name: Mythic Herbalism
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability that lets a character create healing unguents, poultices, virulent poisons, and physical-bonus potions.

name: Natural Magician
description: A practitioner of non-Hermetic natural magic; Amabel the Learned is one, as powerful as many Hermetic magi, and some churchmen have begun employing such magicians.

name: North Sea
description: The preferred location for the magical island, surrounded by kingdoms experiencing population growth and trade.

name: Oak Gild
description: A political gild of the Rhine Tribunal that, in the Crintera Schism, aligns with the Harmonist Bjornaer to start a territorial dispute with Novgorod; Roznov's other magi belong to the Ash or Oak Gilds.

name: Obliteration of the Metallic Barrier
description: A Perdo Terram spell (with Rego requisite) that shatters a metal or stone barrier up to one foot thick, harming those on the far side.

name: Odysseus
description: The legendary hero whose famous tale of resisting the sirens illustrates how the Seirenes' magic could be defeated.

name: Palm of Flame
description: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 5) in which a flame leaps up in the caster's upturned palm, casting torch-like light and igniting flammable items without burning or damaging the caster.

name: Pandulf
description: The Papal Legate in England, elected bishop of Norwich in 1215 but not yet consecrated, who serves as regent for the young king and in theory outranks both king and archbishop.

name: Papal States
description: Central Italian lands ruled by the Pope, including Rome, Florence and Bologna.

name: Peasant
description: A Free Social Status Virtue for a free (non-serf) character who lives by working the land, possibly controlling and hiring labor if wealthy.

name: Peregrinator
description: The wandering magi of the Rhine Tribunal, typically journeymen, who travel from covenant to covenant relying on the Laws of Hospitality; about a sixth of Rhine magi are peregrinatores.

name: Persona
description: A Supernatural Ability and deep-cover disguise technique allowing a magus to flawlessly alter his appearance and mannerisms to adopt a distinct identity; a subtle form of Muto Corpus magic.

name: Phantasm
description: Major Unholy Power Virtue granting the Supernatural Ability Phantasm at 1.

name: Phoenix
description: A legendary bird whose ashes provide a powerful Shape and Material bonus (+11) to rejuvenation and regeneration enchantments.

name: Phthisis
description: A Major Phlegmatic, epidemic Disease that pollutes the vital faculty with phlegm and spreads via putrid breath.

name: Pietro
description: Archmagus and most senior hoplite of the Tribunal, originally Tytalus, who won entry to House Flambeau with lightning and founded the Pietrine lineage; rumored to be the Antares.

name: Planetary Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue granting a Lab Total bonus to enchant devices by invoking a governing planet's astral influence via a Laboratory Horoscope.

name: Presence
description: Constant spirit power granting awareness of everything within a chosen domain, making the spirit coterminous with its landscape feature; possessed by all genii loci and many ghosts.

name: Preternatural Growth and Shrinking
description: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 15) that adds +1 to the target's Size or decreases it by up to 2 points.

name: Profession: Steward
description: A Profession Ability for managing a household or manor; held by the Spying Maid, Lord of the Manor, and Lady of the Manor, and used to calculate a Steward specialist's loyalty bonus.

name: Psychomachia
description: Major Unholy Power Virtue granting the Supernatural Ability Psychomachia at 1.

name: Rabbi
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for an ordained Rabbi, teacher and wise man of the Jewish community, who must take the Educated (Hebrew) Virtue.

name: Radegast
description: An archetypal Slavic god of chieftainship, war, fertility, and harvest worshipped at Rethra and Mount Radhost; in saga material revealed as a powerful demon controlling the Slavic lands and a willing source of vis through human sacrifice.

name: Requies Aeterna
description: A small Winter covenant of Donatores at the ruins of Nesle, vassal of Florum, holding a noted library of Donatores lore.

name: Restricted Power
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw limiting the use of a normally at-will supernatural power, requiring a ceremony or restricting it to certain targets or circumstances.

name: Revenant
description: A restless dead being whose only form is an animate material corpse, animated by a spirit and connected to the living world through an overwhelming personal need; difficult to harm with weapons and immune to Incapacitation.

name: Rising Ire
description: A Creo Mentem spell (Level 15) that makes the target furious at someone or something of the caster's choice; an appropriate Personality Trait roll can hold the anger in check.

name: Roland
description: A great Frankish knight, one of Charlemagne's 12 peers, slain at the Battle of Roncesvals in 778, who wielded the magic sword Durendal forged by Wayland with Verditius as apprentice.

name: Roman Empire
description: The ancient empire whose legionaries garrisoned the temple town; its records can be studied as Organization Lore: Roman Empire.

name: Ruach
description: Evil spirits (imps) of the Tempters causing misfortune and ill luck, appearing as vermin with twisted human faces; one is released with every freely committed sin.

name: Rudiaria
description: A former covenant affiliated to House Flambeau, founded 892 AD on the right bank of the Rhine opposite Bingen; charged with diabolism and destroyed in 969 AD by an apparent catastrophic magical accident.

name: Rule of Saint Benedict
description: The most widespread monastic rule in Mythic Europe, laying down detailed regulations and a daily timetable for monks and nuns; most religious orders follow variants of it.

name: Rusted Decay of Ten-Score Years
description: A Perdo Terram spell that thoroughly rusts the metal of the target so it breaks under any demanding use and loses its sharpness.

name: Sahir
description: A type of non-Hermetic wizard of the Mythic Middle East; an Infernally-aligned sahir bound the Buran of Yenghissar within his ancestral sword using the Goetic Art of Binding.

name: Saint Gallen
description: Place whose abbots own a palace near Rorschach; Valnastium has a chapter there and the abbot is an ally of Valnastium.

name: Salamander
description: A small poisonous magical salamander that seeks warmth, extinguishing fires, and can pass through a weak Aegis of the Hearth.

name: Samhain
description: Sabbat on 31 October/1 November, also All Hallow's Eve; the Stonehenge grand sabbat is held then.

name: Satyr
description: Smaller, cowardly faun-like faeries with donkey ears and horse tails, notorious for sexual violence.

name: Scales of the Magical Weight
description: An Intellego Vim spell used to weigh an unknown amount of vis against a known amount to determine the number of pawns present.

name: Scent of Peaceful Slumber
description: A spell that makes everyone in a room fall asleep over a few seconds, with the smell of lilacs in their nostrils.

name: Schadrit
description: The ancient maga of Ex Miscellanea who leads Dankmar with malice; a former Bonisagus apprentice cast out with her mistress Aschlaranda, she is an expert in Faerie Magic.

name: Schwall
description: An eccentric elderly Bjornaer magus and Wilderist of the Hawthorn Gild, formerly of Rheinstein, living at the Rhinefalls; he plots to release the Rhine elemental and merge with its spirit.

name: Scottish Church
description: The Celtic Church of Scotland, independent of Rome, emphasizing Love; its sites generate a calming Divine aura that augments rather than hinders magic.

name: Second Crusade
description: Crusade after the fall of Edessa in 1144 that accomplished little besides the capture of Lisbon.

name: Seeker
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character is a self-proclaimed member of the Seekers, a loose organization of competitive magi searching for ancient magic and arcane artifacts.

name: Seelie Court
description: The nobility of the faerie race, who live in knowes, love mortal music and poetry, ride in rades, and sometimes kidnap mortal musicians.

name: Seine
description: River through Normandy and Paris; site of the Ships of Flame regiones and of Confluensis' earlier site and Dragon's Rest.

name: Seven League Stride
description: ReCo 35 travel spell used by Ragoneda, placed in Cymena's lickstone and the Standard of the Shadowy Men.

name: Shadchan
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a marriage arranger trusted by parents to find the best matrimonial match for their children.

name: Shape and Material Bonuses
description: Bonuses to magical and philosophical lab work derived from natural principles of affinity, similarity and sympathy; provided by ingredients and used by both magi and philosophers.

name: Shape of the Woodland Prowler
description: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 25) with an Animal requisite that transforms the target into a wolf via a wolf skin; the target may change back at will.

name: Shetland Islands
description: Northern islands owned by Norway, where domestic animals are enchanted to half size.

name: Short-Ranged Magic
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw halving Casting Totals when not touching the target and halving Lab Total for effects with range greater than Touch.

name: Sight of the Active Magics
description: An Intellego Vim spell that lets the caster see spells as colored, shaped auras around things and people, indicating Form and Technique.

name: Sinews of Knowledge
aliases: Covenant of the Sinews of Knowledge
description: Pre-Hermetic covenant in caves behind a waterfall in the Bavarian Alps, home of the Longevity Project and famous as the home of the finest longevity potion maker.

name: Sofer
description: A Free Social Status Virtue for the scribe who creates or repairs a Sefer Torah, requiring the ability to read and write Hebrew and the Educated (Hebrew) Virtue.

name: Spell Improvisation
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus add the magnitude of a known Formulaic spell as a bonus to his Casting Total when spontaneously casting a similar spell.

name: Spider's Palace
description: Vassal covenant of Florum at its original site, a faded faerie palace built by the spider prince, two days north of Ghent, with excellent laboratories.

name: Spirit Familiar
description: Virtue from Chapter 8 (Spirit Magic) allowing a spirit to be bound as a familiar; a spirit familiar automatically stays with an ascending magus.

name: Spirit Votary
description: A Mythic Companion type: a devoted worshiper of a magical spirit who in pre-Christian days would have been a high priest forming a venerating cult, now typically a solitary pagan figure opposing the Dominion.

name: Spirits of Deceit
description: Demonic order that is the source of all lies, appearing as serpents or dragons and skilled shapeshifters; Might up to 30.

name: St. Martin of Tours
description: Soldier turned bishop of Tours; area saint (Divine Might 50), patron of soldiers, horses and beggars.

name: Stag of Virtue
description: A noble Magical stag (Might 17, Animal) and great enemy of serpents that can heal its own wounds, neutralize poison, and live forever; its right antler has sought-after healing powers.

name: Stellatus, the Dragon
description: An ancient dragon (Might 50, Ignem) able to assume human form, instill loyalty, breathe fire, and control fire; he regards himself as superior to all Hermetic magi and once killed a Tytalus maga.

name: Stench of Twenty Corpses
description: CrAu 10 Potent spell, Potency 6, green turquoise and a pin feather.

name: Supernatural Ability
description: Non-Hermetic magical abilities that many Gifted children possess; they raise the Intellego Vim Lab Total needed to Open the Arts and can be destroyed, kept, or converted into Hermetic Virtues.

name: Susceptible to Deprivation
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the faerie suffers human consequences without air, food and water.

name: Tartarus
description: Scriptural term for Hell as a place of hell-fire and brimstone and eternal torment; named after the Vale of Hinnom.

name: Tempestaria
description: A tradition of Saxon-associated weather witches within House Ex Miscellanea who summon rain, fog, and especially wind beyond Hermetic capacity, using sympathetic tools.

name: The Earth Split Asunder
description: A Rego Terram (ReTe 30) spell opening a chasm; Magic Resistance does not protect against falling in, but does against being crushed when it closes.

name: The Earth's Carbuncle
description: A Rego Terram spell (with Muto requisite) that turns a 1-pace circle of ground into jagged stone that bursts upward, throwing those standing on it.

name: The Enigma's Gift
description: A Creo Vim spell that inflicts four Warping Points on a target and forces a Hermetic magus to check for Twilight.

name: The Holy Grail
description: The sacred relic brought to Gaul by Mary Magdalene and revealed by Clovis to the Frankish kingdom, later lost when the Merovingian dynasty fell from grace.

name: The Lineage of Pralix
description: An Ex Miscellanea tradition descended from Pralix that inducts hedge wizards into the Order, jointly trains apprentices, and grants the Comprehend Magic virtue.

name: The Milites
description: A Minor Story Flaw for a House Flambeau character who is a member of the milites, granting brotherhood and 5 House Acclaim points but binding the character to obey the Primus.

name: The Old Ones
description: Ancient beings of enormous power whose civilization was destroyed by Tarhutis; they fled to human lands, were worshipped as gods, and now sleep in hidden places.

name: The Rusticani
description: An obscure tradition of folk magicians in House Ex Miscellanea who build spells and enchanted devices from mundane objects and live among common people.

name: Toledo
description: A Spanish town whose charter requires a man's wife to live permanently in the town for him to gain citizenship, preventing itinerant merchants from claiming multiple citizenships.

name: Touch of Midas
description: A ritual Creo Terram spell that creates a roughly spherical lump of gold about six inches across, enough wealth for a peasant family for centuries.

name: Trackless Step
description: A Rego Terram spell that leaves no tracks in the earth until the caster stops; draws on pre-Hermetic traditions.

name: Trained Group
description: A group that has practiced fighting together for a season (or less with accelerated training) and functions with the trained group rules.

name: Tunis
description: Place near which the last Hermetic covenant in North Africa was founded.

name: Twilight Void
description: A part of the Magic Realm fundamentally different from the rest, a timeless place connecting other places, reached through boundaries or vestiges and divided into provinces by Form.

name: Tzadik Nistar
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character is one of the Tzadikim Nistarim, the 36 hidden righteous on whom the world's continuation relies, destined to face a moment of moral decision.

name: Unpredictable Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character always rolls a stress die when using magic and must always roll at least one botch die, even with Mastered spells.

name: Uriel, the Angel of Punishment
description: The 'fire (or light) of God', a Seraph and Archangel of the Presence, Patron of Prophecy and Angel of Punishment who watches over the torments of Hell; removed from the Western Church's list by Pope Zachary in 745.

name: Valkyrie
description: Faerie minor goddesses of the Norse pantheon (Might 20) who ride wolves above battlefields to select the worthy dead for transformation into einherjar; they also serve as maids in Valhalla.

name: Vardian's Tomb
description: Unrecognized covenant in a forgotten catacomb south of Rome near the Tiber, fractured between Jerbiton founders and Ex Miscellanea necromancers.

name: Verditius Elder Runes
description: A Verditius Inner Mystery and set of philosophically-grounded runes, derived from Wayland's rune magic and refined by Boethius's philosophy, carved to add power to enchantments.

name: Verona
description: Veronese magi of Castro Selvaggio who used illusory Veronese soldiers to fool the Milanese.

name: Vis Prava
description: The most vile Infernal vis, found in strong Infernal auras or powerful demons; any roll using it is automatically a zero for non-Infernal users.

name: Watchers
description: The Watchers, the tenth Choir who stayed neutral in the War in Heaven, were cast to Earth, bred with mortals and now wander as masters of lore, trapped in their Mantles.

name: William de Longespee
description: Earl of Salisbury since 1198 and a bastard son of Henry II; a close counselor of King John and a ruthless opportunist disputing Lincoln with Nicola de Hay.

name: Wings of the Soaring Wind
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 30) with a Rego requisite that generates a gust supporting and propelling the caster through the air at up to 40 mph.

name: Wizard's Boost
description: A Vim spell example that is not eligible for the Rebuttal Mastery special ability because it does not affect a spell used by another being.

name: Wolf's Court
description: The remnants of a Roman shrine to vengeance at the Wolf's Court; they are not essential to the Court, and if destroyed the She-Wolf may move to another Magic aura.

name: Wonders
description: Major Supernatural Power Virtue to conjure holy items, creatures and elements; grants Wonders 1.

name: Yorkshire
description: Region with a tale that revenants are destroyed by stakes through their hearts.

name: (Form) Resistance
description: Supernatural Ability for characters with Magic Might, adding to Soak and Magic Resistance against a Form; e.g. Vim, Ignem, Animal, Terram Resistance.

name: Aachen
description: A city founded by Charlemagne over Roman thermal springs; its cathedral houses his tomb, holy relics, and the throne where the German king is crowned. Its Divine aura sapped a local forest spirit.

name: Adept Laboratory Student
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue granting +6 to Lab Totals when working from others' lab texts.

name: Adranus, the Spirit of Mount Etna
description: A powerful Magic spirit (Might 50, Ignem) coterminous with Mount Etna, able to duplicate Creo/Rego/Muto/Perdo Ignem and Terram spells and grant Flaws such as Visions, Simple-Minded, and Wrathful.

name: Adriatic Sea
description: Sea where the Tremere fleet is active; griffin vultures live along its coast.

name: Aerial Powers
description: Order of elemental demons including aethnici, fictiles, lucifuges, Fimus, Morrighu, Rahab and Xaphan, sharing Elemental Control and Recalcitrance Powers.

name: Aesthetic Quality
description: A score determining how aesthetically pleasing a piece of artwork is, calculated from Dexterity + Craft or Communication + Profession plus bonuses, analogous to a book's Quality.

name: Aging
description: Characters in the Faerie Realm make aging rolls based on time spent in Faerie, not real-world time.

name: Aging Roll
description: A periodic roll determining a character's aging, modified by Healthy or Unhealthy environmental features at a covenant.

name: Agnes
description: A Merinita apprentice who in 1158 claimed to have learned nature magic from a lady in green in Bohemia and was hailed as a True Merinitae having learned Nature Lore from the Founder.

name: Airy Spirits
description: Spirits native to the material world, swarming in Magic auras and often unnoticed.

name: Albertus Magnus
description: Born 1206 in Bavaria, the most talented natural magician and philosopher of his time and a Dominican; potentially recruitable into the Order of Hermes and a future saint.

name: Alchemy
description: Science of refining substances and seeking transmutation and the elixir, introduced to Europe from the Arabic world.

name: Allure
description: Faerie power (Mentem) granting +3 to impress or convince others.

name: Aloof
description: Minor General Flaw: the faerie finds humans uninteresting and rarely increases Pretenses.

name: Amulet
description: Protective or aiding object crafted with Craft Amulets, Minor (for an individual, lasting days or weeks) or Major (taking seasons to create).

name: Anchorite
description: Woman enclosed in a cell attached to a church, respected and able to interact through her window, served by female servants.

name: Angevin Dynasty
description: Dynasty of Anjou ruling England and Aquitaine, symbolized by three gold lions; legendarily descended from Melusine.

name: Anne Kors
aliases: Anne, a Lady Not Noble But Suitable
description: Companion template: Nolwenn of Finistere, who took the name Anne and lives as a hermit in a woodland cave guided by her Guardian Angel.

name: Aonaranan
description: Highland hermit magi, some of whom attend Calum's court; hermits hold full tribunal votes.

name: Archbishop
description: A bishop (metropolitan) with responsibility over up to a dozen neighboring dioceses forming a province; receives the pallium and Commanding Aura.

name: Ars Magica
description: The tabletop roleplaying game system in which this Rhine Tribunal supplement is set; rules references point to Ars Magica 5th Edition.

name: Aschlaranda
description: A maga exiled from Durenmar and House Bonisagus during the Schism War who founded Dankmar in 1052 to oppose Durenmar, bringing her apprentice Schadrit with her.

name: Athena
description: Guernicus Intéllego specialist and chief Quaesitor of the Alps, who coordinates the Midsummer Fair and favors a greater role for the Tremere.

name: Atlantis
description: Legendary realm reported by the Greeks and ruled by Poseidon, which Rumael claims to have created and destroyed.

name: Austria
description: Region of Luciferans and Vagi Scholares.

name: Autocrat
description: A single covenant official combining two specialist roles (commonly steward and chamberlain), contributing the loyalty points of both.

name: Ba'al Shem
description: Jewish itinerant folk magicians, 'masters of the Divine name', who craft amulets and deliver blessings for pay; favored Abilities Adjuration, Blessing, Craft Amulets and Invocation.

name: Baden
description: A Swabian town named Aquae by the Romans for its hot springs, whose ruined upper part retains a Magic aura of 2 and is owned by Durenmar, which harvests vis from the springs.

name: Baghdad
description: City of the Muqta' who protects the Radhanite merchant.

name: Baiocassium
description: Diedne-dominated covenant near Bayeux, raided by Vikings, destroyed in the Schism War after destroying Pagus.

name: Bane of the Decrepit Body
description: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 25) that ages the target 5 years; does not work on children younger than 16.

name: Bayeux
description: Town, once Gallic Baiocasses, with Bayeux Cathedral and mills; rumored to hide the regio of Baiocassium Minor.

name: Bear Island
description: Peninsula off Anatolia on the southern shore of the Sea of Marmara in the Thebes Tribunal, visited by Jason and the Argonauts; home to the Gegenees, the Idaian Daktyls and the bound titaness Dindyméné.

name: Belin
description: Mercere's last apprentice, renowned for her devotion to the Order and dedication to delivering messages despite having no Gift; held up as an ideal in House Mercere.

name: Beloved Rival
description: A formally declared lifelong rivalry within House Tytalus, ceremonially issued with a spiral drawn in blood, persisting until the death of one opponent; also a Minor Story Flaw.

name: Benedict
description: Saint whose Rule the monastic orders follow; those devoted to him are protected from Patarus.

name: Betrayal of the Heart
description: Iurgator power revealing a secret fact about a target.

name: Bibracte
description: Vassal of Fudarus (822-969) on Mount Beauvray that revived a cult of Vercingetorix and was destroyed by Wizard Wars from Montverte magi.

name: Black Lineage
description: An intelligent lineage of cats descended from House Jerbiton's Founder's familiar that understand human language, often have Second Sight, live around 40 years, and have a parliament that elects a monarch (the King of the Cats).

name: Blackmail
description: A Flaw used to represent coercion of an agent by a principal, such as a priest controlling a knight through blackmail or other leverage.

name: Blade of the Virulent Flame
description: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 15) that forms fire along a metal blade, doubling the weapon's damage (or adding +5) and starting fires; repeated castings can melt the blade.

name: Bomburkhan
description: A minor imp demon (Might 5, Vim) appearing as a jet-black bat with a human face who punctures the egos of the prideful by granting talents that contradict boasts; released after the fall of Jerusalem.

name: Bordelon, a Personal Tormentor
description: A demon (Might 15, Corpus) appearing as a stern governess who chooses a child as her personal tormentor, crushing ambition and meekness through punishment whenever the child distinguishes himself.

name: Borders
description: Border region between England and Scotland, lawless and raided by families on both sides.

name: Brawling
description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

name: Brethren of the Free Spirit
description: A heretical pantheistic cult emerging at the start of the 13th century from Paris theologians and spreading in Cologne, equating God to primary matter and holding that there is no sin.

name: Bridge of Wood
description: A Creo Herbam spell (Level 15) that creates a bridge of living leaves, vines, and wood up to 20 paces long supporting creatures up to Size +4.

name: Broch-builders
description: Ancient people of the Western Isles conquered by the Picts; possibly builders of the stone monuments.

name: Bury St. Edmund's
description: A wealthy abbey town in West Suffolk wholly under the abbey's control, founded in 633 by King Sigebert and home to the tomb of St. Edmund, a major pilgrimage site.

name: Cabal Legacy
description: Flaw that for the Fraternity merely means badgering by would-be Initiates.

name: Caecilius
description: A Quaesitor of Durenmar and a contender for the oldest magus in the Tribunal, who ruled firmly that no wilderness had been invaded in the Crintera/Guardians of the Forests dispute.

name: Calabria
description: Covenant in southern Italy weakened by a Verdi-instigated Mussulman invasion; its Magi fled to Novgorod.

name: Caladrius
description: A magnificent all-white mystical bird of the Magic Realm, sought by royal households, which can draw a non-fatal disease out of a sick person into itself and burn it away by flying toward the sun.

name: Capetian Dynasty
description: French royal dynasty descended from Hugh Capet, noted for piety, symbolized by gold lilies on blue.

name: Carefree
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Carnac
description: Stone monument site in Brittany to which the stones may allow travel.

name: Carthage
description: Ancient city whose men worshiped Adramelech as Moloch.

name: Catacombs of Rome
description: Catacombs where Vespillo searched for the tombs of the Mercurian priesthood; his companions died there.

name: Cato of Bonisagus
description: A spectral Criamon Primus who was a Bonisagus magus before joining; he believes Criamon magi create the majority of all adulterations.

name: Cercistum
description: A Primus of House Tremere during the Schism War, quoted observing that the Tytali fought a different battle on the Plain of Wolves than the Tremere pretended to.

name: Change Form
description: Spirits of Deceit Power to change their shape to human or animal forms.

name: Changeling
description: A story-seed faerie who comes regularly to a market for human food to sustain a stolen human child raised by her group living in nearby woodland.

name: Chaos of the Angry Waves
description: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 30) that causes water to churn wildly in a circular area, overturning small craft and penalizing Swim rolls.

name: Cherbourg
description: Town on the Cotentin near the ruined covenant Pagus, with a Fengheld chapterhouse.

name: Christianity
description: One of the three most important Divine religions in Mythic Europe; many magi are Christians and its relics are most common.

name: Chrétien de Troyes
description: Author of epic poems about the Knights of the Round Table in which giants appear as brutish villains.

name: Cloak of Mist
description: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 40) with an Auram requisite that turns the caster into a human-sized cohesive mist able to float and seep through cracks.

name: Clouds of Summer Snow
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 25) that creates clouds dropping snow over an area about half a mile across without affecting temperature.

name: Clutch
description: A study group of the Criamon magi within a single Tribunal, originally living as a covenant following a single path; the Cave of Twisting Shadows holds the Central Clutch.

name: Conciatta
description: Maga of House Bonisagus who expanded Hermetic understanding across the four realms; author of The Application of Vim to the Supernatural Humors, whose lost research may reduce aura penalties including the Dominion.

name: Consors
description: An acknowledged asset of the covenant, as which a companion lord may receive magical support.

name: Consummate Talisman
description: Major Hermetic Mystery Virtue allowing Muto Vim effects and Names of Power to be enchanted into a talisman to affect the magus's own spellcasting.

name: Contagious Obsession
description: Vessels of Iniquity Power making Obsession victims carriers who spread it.

name: Continence
description: A Minor Personality Flaw: the character does not engage in sexual activity, due to a vow of celibacy or personal choice.

name: Corrupted Abilities
description: A Minor Supernatural Tainted Flaw: one or more Abilities was taught by a demon, giving +3 for selfish use and -3 for selfless use, with use sensed by Divine Powers.

name: Cotentin Peninsula
description: Lightly settled, swampy region of Normandy containing Confluensis and the ruins of Pagus.

name: Court of Bright Winter
description: A Seelie faerie court associated with light, snow, cold, and the hunt, found in midwinter among the high hills of the Westerwald; rival to Dark Summer.

name: Coven
description: A group of folk witches (usually three to a dozen) dispersed over a locale, the folk witch equivalent of a Hermetic covenant.

name: Covenant Where Journeys End
description: Merinita and Bjornaer covenant in a frigid faerie regio on Mont Joux, founded 817, known for kidnapping travelers and its ice-distorted covenfolk.

name: Covenant of Tarragon Vale
description: Unterwalden covenant of metaphysical geographers whose four magi and covenfolk vanished twenty-two years ago; its vis income is held by the Quaesitores.

name: Covenant of the Icy North
description: A covenant founded in 771 by magi of different Houses, now a loose affiliation of nine autonomous chapters across the Alps that meet annually at the Motherhouse in Bavaria.

name: Craft Amulets
description: Supernatural Ability used by the Ba'al Shem with Holy Methods and Powers to create Minor and Major amulets of Touch range and Worn duration.

name: Crafter's Healing
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue letting a character magically heal wounds by touching them with the tools of his trade; it grants the Crafter's Healing Ability and is a power Hermetic magi cannot understand.

name: Creative Block
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw: the magus has problems creating new things in the lab, taking -3 to Lab Totals unless using a Laboratory Text or being taught.

name: Crystals of Montjoux
description: Quartz and fluorite crystals found embedded together at Montjoux, with magical form and effect bonuses.

name: Curate
description: Local priest appointed by the bishop to care for souls in a parish; temporary curates serve perpetual curates.

name: Cyclopes
description: Giant one-eyed race of eastern Sicily who departed centuries ago, leaving Polyphemus.

name: Cyprus
description: Island bought by the Templars from King Richard, ruled by the Lusignans.

name: Damascus
description: Syrian city claiming the head of John the Baptist.

name: Damhadh-Duidsan
description: A tradition of House Ex Miscellanea descended from Damhadh-Duidas who carve Ogam runes to curse, wound, and heal; they try to escape their Infernal past, with Giant Blood common.

name: Danu
description: A faerie elemental spirit of the River Danube, formerly worshiped as a goddess by many peoples before the Romans; her presence remains strong at the river's source.

name: Danube
description: A river embodied in ancient times as a faerie goddess whose nymphs guard treasure grottos and gateways to Arcadia.

name: Deficiency
description: A Hermetic Flaw imposed when a master opens an apprentice's Arts while having a score below five in an Art; inflicting it is normally a Low Crime.

name: Deluders
description: Order of demons, appearing as slashes of darkness filled with eyes and teeth, who make magic seem stronger; includes Aqrab, enervators, Watchers and the Spirits of Solomon.

name: Depressed
description: A Minor Personality Flaw giving the character a dark outlook on life, seeing little point in acting and taking no pleasure in events.

name: Deprivation
description: Rules for lack of food or air (ArM5 p.180) invoked for besieged characters and constriction victims.

name: Dietrich of Bern
description: A Daimon (Magic Might 35, Corpus) of the German hero and boy-king of Bern, whose tomb in the Lessini Mountains holds dragon-blood-enchanted arms; he animates his corpse to test those who enter.

name: Disenchant
description: A Perdo Vim ritual that permanently strips a Hermetic magic item of all its powers, destroying its enchantment and invested vis.

name: Disputatio
description: A formal academic debate resolved much like certamen, using paired totals (Attack, Defense, Weakening, Resistance) and symbolic Fatigue Levels to determine a winner across deliberative, epideictic, and forensic forms.

name: Divine Warping
description: Warping from Divine sources such as auras, powerful Divine effects and Divine botches, producing visions, stigmata and angelic transfigurations.

name: Dodge
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Donning the Corporeal Veil
description: She-Wolf power creating and animating a physical she-wolf body for the spirit.

name: Duresca Scrolls
description: Letters purportedly between Guernicus and his filii revealing a plan to dominate the Order, declared fraudulent by the Iberian Tribunal.

name: Earth That Breaks No More
description: A Muto Terram spell that turns a volume of packed dirt up to ten cubic paces into stone.

name: Easter
description: The most important Christian holy day, celebrating Christ's resurrection, on the first Sunday after the first full moon after the spring equinox.

name: Ebroin
description: The relatively young current Primus of House Ex Miscellanea, elected after Immanola entered Final Twilight, with ambitions to revitalize the House from Cad Gadu.

name: Embitterment
description: A Major Non-Hermetic Supernatural Ability of the Nemthengacha allowing a speaker, through conversation, to make a listener hostile to a chosen target, up to the level of murder.

name: Emir
description: A Minor, Social Status Virtue equivalent to Knight but for Muslim emirs, who are skilled in hunting, religious teachings, and culture as well as martial pursuits.

name: End of the Mighty Castle
description: A Perdo Terram (PeTe 25) spell that collapses a building; since non-magical stone falls due to gravity, Magic Resistance does not protect against it.

name: Energumen
description: A human possessed by a demon, targeted by Exorcise the Filthy Spirit.

name: Enrichment
description: The process of treating a Thing of Virtue (herb, object, tree) through a ritual procedure, usually over a season, so it confers a Virtue or power instead of being harvested for vis.

name: Enthrallment
description: Special gruagach ability of Damhan-allaidh. Like Rego and Perdo Mentem; used to take over minds of nobles, magi or churchmen.

name: Enticer of Multitudes
description: A Minor, General, Tainted Virtue giving a corrupt version of Inspirational usable only to manipulate people toward evil acts.

name: Entreat the Powers
description: Major Supernatural Virtue letting a learned magician minimize negative effects of Divine or Infernal auras on magic.

name: Ephesus
description: A site in the Theban Tribunal holding a statue of Diana that Huntress initiates may anoint with sacred oil during the Eumolpid initiation.

name: Eremite
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: exploring the divine alone, unable to learn Supernatural Abilities from any tradition; requires True Faith.

name: Essential Virtue
description: Virtue granting a beneficial Essential Trait; every Beast of Virtue must take one to represent how it typifies its species.

name: Eve
description: The first woman, whom Satan caused to eat the forbidden fruit, bringing about man's fall.

name: Exceptional Talent
description: Class of Virtues representing supernatural talents; gruagach magic is represented by them.

name: Faerie Court
description: Gatherings of faeries usually located in semi-settled land between wilderness and Dominion, sometimes near vis sources.

name: Faerie Hounds
description: Huge faerie dogs (Might 5, Animal) that haunt the roads of Mythic Europe, terrifying and sometimes killing travelers, often with shining eyes and powers like Enthralling Sound and Fearful Flaming Eyes.

name: Faerie Sympathy
description: A Trait describing a character's faerie relationship to a class of subjects, usable as a specialization bonus; negative Traits impose penalties and botch dice.

name: Fantastic Beast Lore
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Feast of the Dead
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a faerie recover 2 Might after draining a Long Term Fatigue level or causing a Medium Wound to a human.

name: Fimus, Warrior Demon
description: A warrior demon (Might 10, Terram) made of solid rock with one eye, controlling earth and exploding on death; one of many identical brother-demons used as foot-soldiers by other demons.

name: Forceless Casting
description: A technique of deliberately casting a spell with Penetration Total of 0 so it cannot affect a magus's Magic Resistance, used in tournaments and group spellcasting.

name: Forked Tongue of the Serpent
description: Neqael's power making the target believe any lie until relating it to someone else.

name: Fountain of Youth
description: A magical fountain deep in the forest sought by Alexander of Jerbiton; drinking from it infused his blood with the power of youth, enhancing his longevity rituals.

name: Gaelic
description: Predominant language of the Highlands brought by the Scotti from Ireland.

name: Gematria
description: Supernatural Ability, the Jewish form of the Meditation Divine Method; also a divination method revealing hidden numeric meanings in the Torah and the basis of Shinnui Shem.

name: Gender Nonconforming
description: A Personality Flaw (Major or Minor) representing a character who does not conform to societal gender expectations; common among Faerie Doctors.

name: Geneva
description: City where Valnastium has a small chapter.

name: Geoffrey of Monmouth
description: Historian (c. 1100-1154) who wrote the History of the Kings of Britain and claimed giants were Britain's original inhabitants.

name: God
description: Rules Mythic Europe in majesty, served by the angelic hosts; the object of Church worship.

name: Golden Fleece
description: The treasure the Argonauts voyaged to retrieve, during which Orpheus saved them from the sirens.

name: Golias of Tytalus
description: An old Tytalus magus at Blackthorn who feigns being newly gauntleted; the covenant's best political dealer, with unknown magical interests.

name: Great Noble
description: Virtue worth two Major Virtues, or one for supporting characters, that represents greater barons and higher ranks.

name: Great Stamina
description: Great Stamina: Virtue listed among the Virtues of example divine beings or holy characters in Realms of Power: The Divine.

name: Greece
description: Place where people paint eyes as a charm against the evil eye.

name: Gregory of Tours
description: Historical author of the History of the Franks, listed among the period works.

name: Gruagach Lore
description: Organization Lore of the gruagachan, covering their magic, members and initiation rites.

name: Gunther
description: The Burgundian king of Worms in the Nibelungenlied, who marries Brünhild with Siegfried's help and is later beheaded by Kriemhild in Hungary.

name: Hall of Heroes
description: Place of power of Daimons and remnant pagan pantheon, perhaps beyond the Lunar Sphere, to which apotheosis leads.

name: Hands of the Grasping Earth
description: A Rego Terram spell where earthen hands rise from the ground to grasp the target's ankles, requiring a Strength roll to break free.

name: Hanseatic League
description: A trade confederation of towns whose formation Oculus Septentrionalis becomes centrally involved in; its spread is encouraged by the demon Radegast and exploited by Imanitos Mendax.

name: Harmless Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw whereby the character's non-ritual Perdo spells cannot permanently destroy anything, merely disrupting targets temporarily like a Muto effect.

name: Helios
description: Planetary spirit of the sun and one of the Theoi, ruling royalty and healing.

name: Herakles
description: Hero said to have killed the lindworm near Klagenfurt.

name: Hermetic Astrology
description: Mystery school working astrological influences into general Hermetic magic.

name: Hermetic Empowerment
description: Minor Mystery Virtue allowing a device to power Ritual/vis-requiring effects by draining a bound spirit's Might.

name: Hermetic Spirit Magic
description: Hermetic school of summoning and binding minor spirits into magical workings; preferred term over necromancy.

name: Heroic Virtues
description: A category of Virtues (with associated Flaws) from Houses of Hermes: True Lineages that maestros may also choose.

name: Himinis the Mad
description: An 11th-century Verditius magus who developed the Inner Mystery of making cursed items and founded the Confraternity of Himinis the Mad.

name: Hippocrates
description: The ancient physician associated with naming epilepsy the 'sacred disease' (the Falling Evil).

name: Hippogriff
description: A faerie beast gifted by the queen Titania to the King of England, housed at the Tower of London, which is poisoned by the Divine aura of London's many churches.

name: Holy Vehm
description: An organization whose pious leader, the archbishop of Cologne, is murdered in 1225, which the demon Gymir is infiltrating and corrupting to use as a surrogate against Radegast's pagan followers.

name: Horst
description: A 68-year-old master Redcap of House Mercere at Fengheld, a famed encyclopedic author (despite having no Gift) and the senior Redcap of the Rhine Tribunal.

name: Hospitallers
aliases: Order of the Knights of Saint John
description: The Order of the Knights of Saint John, a crusading order that began as a charitable hospital for pilgrims in Jerusalem; rivals and allies of the Templars.

name: Hound
description: Faerie power letting a faerie know the direction and distance to its human quarry; Lamia's version detects unattended babies.

name: House Acclaim
description: An informal Hermetic Reputation system by which Flambeau magi measure relative prestige, gained for deeds of valor and lost for ignoble acts or inactivity.

name: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages
description: An Ars Magica sourcebook referenced for fuller treatment of the use of magic to support the Redcap network.

name: Hubert de Burgh
description: The justiciar (since 1215) and third member of the regency, responsible for day-to-day administration; an astute politician and brave military leader who defended Dover and won the sea battle against Eustace.

name: Hugh Capet
description: Took Laon from the Carolingians and established his capital in Paris.

name: Idris
description: Once the patriarch Enoch, now the angel of the Face of the Lord, King of Angels and Chancellor of Heaven, a being of living flame with 36 pairs of wings.

name: Ile de France
description: The rich central region of the Normandy Tribunal and seat of French royal power, including Paris.

name: Improved Soak
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue increasing Soak by 2; may be taken more than once.

name: Ink of Hermes
description: An alchemical ink mentioned in many alchemical texts, made from myrrh, Karian figs, Nikolaus dates, pine cones, wormwood, wings of the Hermaic ibis, and spring water.

name: Inoffensive to (Beings)
description: A Minor General Virtue whereby the character's Gift does not bother a chosen class of beings (animals, faeries, or magical beings); known among Merinitae as the Bronze, Silver, and Golden Gifts.

name: Jove
description: A pagan deity cited as an example of an earth-shakingly important figure with a Might score in the 51-60 range.

name: Jupiter Pennius
description: Celtic deity of Alpine storms after whom Mont Joux was named; the magi think he was a powerful faerie whose death closed the regio.

name: Kerberos
description: Merinita term for fearsome monster Guardians of the Threshold, always restrained and bypassable by trickery or courage.

name: King William Rufus
description: A king of England who summoned Eadric Wilde and his faerie wife to London out of a wish to look upon them.

name: Kingdom of Denmark
description: Homeland of Ogier, of interest to Rhineland and Norman magi who see potential to colonize it.

name: Knack
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Koldun
description: Shamanic wizards from the Novgorod Tribunal who abandoned their pagan priesthood for sorcery; a Witches of Thessaly variant tradition.

name: Kosmokrators
description: A rank of primal spirit used to model primeval giants, beings the size of mountain ranges or larger.

name: Lady of the Lake
description: Faerie Lady of the Lake who enchanted Merlin and lives at Lake Comper; queen of the korrigan.

name: Lake Constance
description: Lake on which the trade village of Rorschach stands.

name: Laon
description: Hilltop city, former Carolingian capital, with a famous cathedral school and where Norlanus lives.

name: Latent Magic Ability
description: A Minor, General Virtue indicating an unmanifested magical quality, more limited than The Gift, that may appear spontaneously.

name: Legacy
description: Minor Story Flaw: the character descends from a legendary magus or Redcap and is accorded respect but given harder tasks.

name: Leper Magi
description: A small lineage within House Tytalus descended from Hariste and Epimetheus who draw magical strength from leprosy; powerful healers and longevity experts who are inevitably specialized in Corpus magics.

name: Leper Magus
description: A Major Hermetic Virtue exclusive to House Tytalus describing the mystic legacy of leprosy passed from Tytalus through Hariste's line; grants Life Boost and lets the magus mortify his flesh to produce vis.

name: Leviathan
description: Vast ancient being of the Aquam province of the Twilight Void tethered to Big Harcar, which desires the destruction of certain ships; Osgood's master.

name: Limit of the Lunar Sphere
description: A boundary of Hermetic magic at the orbit of the moon; magic cannot affect the moon or the ethereal region beyond it, and it stunts spells reaching toward the heavens.

name: Literatus
description: Scholarly covenant of the Roman Tribunal whose magi must always keep an apprentice and take mundane pupils in Bologna; long an opponent of Magvillus at Tribunal.

name: Little
description: Major General Flaw (faeries only) making the character far smaller.

name: Lixivia
description: Vassal of Florum (1021-1124) in Champagne of Redcaps and Gentle Gifted magi acting as intermediary with merchants; disbanded in poverty.

name: Loire
description: A river near whose mouth an island was a college for Druidic priestesses in the years before the formation of the Order.

name: Lombardy
description: Region of northern Italy whose plains hold the Resting Place of Mars and which has been plagued by unrest for a millennium.

name: Loreley
description: A beautiful, malevolent water faerie (Faerie Might 30, Aquam) who lures sailors to their deaths from the cliffs of the Rhine Gorge with her song; daughter of the Rhine Spirit.

name: Low Crime
description: A lesser Hermetic offense, such as keeping a Gifted lab assistant, fostering without instruction, or abandoning an apprentice.

name: Luperci
description: A secret Mystery Cult linked to the She-Wolf that punishes the guilty when ordinary justice fails, usually by having them killed by a wolf.

name: Magic Addiction
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw in which the magus craves casting magic and struggles to stop casting spells until he drops from exhaustion.

name: Magic Items
description: A Minor General Virtue granting a Redcap 25 extra starting levels of magic items plus accelerated improvement, reflecting devotion to the House.

name: Magical Master
description: Major Social Status Virtue: the magic character is recognized as a higher power by a large group, which may venerate it.

name: Magical Meditation
description: Supernatural Ability for Magic Might characters: a trance to recover Might Points and resist Acclimation in a Magic aura.

name: Major Magic Deficiency
description: Flaw appearing in character statistics or rules in this text.

name: Mamluk
description: Minor Social Status Virtue for a former military slave trained at a military school, educated in Islam and freed at adulthood; grants Martial Abilities and Theology: Islam.

name: Marie de France
description: A twelfth-century poet whose twelve lais are the best-known examples of that form of courtly-love poem.

name: Masking the Odor of Magic
description: A spell of magical concealment that hides the traces of magic, which Tabanus's Reveal the Magical Deception is designed to overcome.

name: Mastering the Unruly Beast
description: A Rego Animal spell (Level 25) allowing the caster to command an animal to perform any act it is capable of by touching it.

name: Mecca
description: Native city of Muhammad and site of the haram and Ka'ba; its Dominion auras are one point stronger.

name: Melusine
description: Faerie or demon maiden who married a lord of Anjou and fled Mass; ancestress of the Angevins.

name: Merkavah
description: Supernatural Ability, the Jewish form of the Purity Divine Method, and the study of the names of angels, demons and other creatures to learn their True Names.

name: Midsummer Fair
description: Annual gathering held at the Motherhouse of the Covenant of the Icy North where Alpine magi trade and socialize, coinciding with informal and Quaesitorial tribunals.

name: Mighty Torrent of Water
description: A Creo Aquam spell (Level 20) that sprays a jet of water at a target, dealing damage and potentially sending them flying back.

name: Mirror of Opposition
description: A Muto Vim spell cast on another spell being cast, causing it to have the exact opposite of its normal effects; ten Form-specific versions exist.

name: Missing Hand
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character has lost a hand, penalizing climbing, combat, and activities requiring both hands.

name: Mistaken Identity
description: A Major Story Flaw in which someone who looks exactly like the character commits violent or embarrassing acts, forcing him to deal with the consequences.

name: Mithras
description: A luminous Persian-origin sun god worshiped by the Cult of Mithras as savior of Creation and divine Bull-Slayer; Castra Solis is named for his sun-god aspect.

name: Muscaria
description: Practical Criamon maga who developed the Cave's mushroom farms; her predecessors expect her to become the next Prima.

name: Mystery of Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
aliases: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
Mystery Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
description: Major Hermetic Mystery Virtue requiring Hermetic Theurgy, teaching a path of apotheosis by which a hierarch ascends as a Daimon to the Hall of Heroes with the aid of celebrants.

name: Mystical Choreography
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus perform Ceremonial Magic faster (five minutes per magnitude, or one minute in a prepared space) through skilled body movement.

name: Nasir
description: A minor angel of the Divine realm (Divine Might 25, Corpus) charged with the safety of pious travellers, who aids those in need before vanishing. He has powers such as Calming Touch, Spirit Form, Steadying Hand, and Subtle Form.

name: Nauche-Fleur
description: Covenant accused in 1095 of feudal obligation to a baron via an unGifted companion; found innocent.

name: Oakdell
description: A former covenant founded 934 AD by magi of House Diedne in the Westerwald; razed to the ground with all its Diedne magi slain during the Schism War in 1016 AD.

name: Offensive to (Beings)
description: A Minor General Flaw causing a chosen class of beings (humans, demons, or divine beings) to react badly to the character; known among Merinitae as the Tin, Iron, and Leaden Gifts.

name: Opening the Arts
description: The process by which a parens opens a Gifted apprentice to the Hermetic Arts; apprenticeship legally begins only once it is done, and it may destroy, maintain, or convert the apprentice's Supernatural Abilities.

name: Opening the Tome of the Animal's Mind
description: An Intellego Animal spell (Level 25) that lets the caster read an animal's memories of the past day by touching its head.

name: Optimistic
description: A Personality Flaw making a character habitually optimistic; held by the Scribe template, swappable for Carefree or Pessimistic.

name: Orchard of Sour Apples
description: Island (the Orchard) northeast of Coutances, once a vassal covenant, with an Intellego vis orchard of sour apples.

name: Order of the Green Cockerel
description: Secret Hermetic Mystery Cult of alchemists pursuing the Great Work (Elixir Vitae), in secret contact with Islamic wizards; has seven degrees.

name: Original Research
description: The pursuit of advancing Hermetic theory through novel investigation, which Pralicians are especially likely to undertake.

name: Orpheus
description: The legendary Thracian poet, musician, and magician taught by Hermes, regarded by his cult as the first user of Hermetic magic and who descended to the Underworld for Eurydice.

name: Outlaw Leader
description: A minor Social Status Flaw that grants a character an agency of criminal underlings prior to play; listed with a Resistance of -1 on the Resistance of Agents Table.

name: Pagus
description: Vassal of Confluensis (840-1008) at a Roman outpost near Cherbourg, damaged by Vikings and destroyed in the Schism War.

name: Paid Rights
description: A Virtue that is a game-mechanical way to acknowledge that an exceptional woman who holds public power in Mythic Europe is genuinely exceptional.

name: Palermo
description: Intellectual centre of Sicily with libraries and Auras of Reason; besieged 1199.

name: Panic of the Elephant's Mouse
description: A Rego Animal spell (Level 15) that makes an animal afraid of the target, causing it to flee by the quickest means.

name: Papal Curia
