description: The papal court, enlarged and streamlined under Innocent III and Honorius III; receives up to 2,000 petitions yearly and is the final court of appeal.

name: Pavia
description: Imperialist commune and former Lombard capital full of family towers.

name: Perception of the Conflicting Motives
description: An Intellego Mentem spell (Level 15) that detects the conflicting motives behind a target's actions, often cast before a Muto or Rego spell to change emotions.

name: Perceval
description: A Redcap in his late forties contemplating retirement; tall, thin, balding, married to Lucy, with a brooch that makes him and his horse invisible.

name: Peter Abelard
description: A famous scholastic logician who taught at the cathedral school of St Geneviève in Paris; held two heretical theories condemned by Bernard of Clairvaux and exemplifies both good and bad Academic Reputation.

name: Petrus of Verdun
description: A tenth-century Primus of House Jerbiton who advocated magi living within mundane communities as wealthy citizens, abandoning multi-House covenants.

name: Phantasm of the Human Form
description: A Creo Imaginem spell (Level 25) that makes an image of a clothed, equipped person that can move, speak, and behave as a human under the caster's unspoken command.

name: Philippus Niger
description: An Archmage of Durenmar who uses the Holy Vehm to execute hedge magicians and at least one Marched magus, and promotes spread of the Vehmgerichte as a tool against hedge wizards.

name: Philosophic Alchemy
description: Minor and Major Mystery Virtue building on Hermetic Alchemy; vis extraction digests on its own or produces ready-opened enchantment devices.

name: Physician's Eye
description: An Intellego Corpus spell (Level 5) that determines the general health of a person, showing afflictions as yellow coloration on the body.

name: Picardy
description: A relatively poor region bordering Flanders, Normandy, Ile de France and Champagne, under the influence of King Philip.

name: Pit of the Gaping Earth
description: A Perdo Terram (PeTe 15) spell that opens a pit beneath a target's feet; no one can resist it, so it bypasses Magic Resistance, and it can also create defensive trenches.

name: Place of Power
description: Virtue or creature Quality listed for a being (Anne, Minerva Sulis, Balneator) or setting feature described here.

name: Poena
description: The Prima of House Tremere at the domus magna Coeris in the Transylvanian Tribunal, said to know the names and strengths of every member of her House.

name: Polandrus
description: A demon (Might 20, Animal) appearing as an extremely large jet-black wolf with red eyes who dominates wolves and targets livestock farmers, gradually coercing them into sin.

name: Pomerania
description: A sparsely-populated realm of Slavic peoples between the Baltic Sea and Poland, bordering the Novgorod Tribunal; part of the Holy Roman Empire since 1181 and a region of contention with werewolves and the Knights of the Sword.

name: Pope Gregory IX
description: Cardinal-bishop Ugolino (born 1170), trusted ally of Honorius III famed as papal legate, who succeeds him as pope in 1227 if the saga follows history.

name: Poseidon
description: Olympian sea god, ally and possibly foster-son of the telechines, who usurped Phorcys' kingdom.

name: Positive Folktales
description: Minor Social Interaction Virtue: the faerie type is in local folklore and treated with respect and caution.

name: Potency
description: Score of a Potent spell equal to the sum of its Casting Item bonuses, limited by Magic Theory.

name: Presiding Quaesitor
description: The Quaesitor elected by local Quaesitors to preside over a Tribunal, set penalties and hold a veto; aided by two advisers.

name: Prester John
description: Legendary realm of medieval fable used as a tonal model for an island-of-magicians saga.

name: Prometheus
description: Titan who stole fire from the gods and hid it in a fennel stalk.

name: Protector
description: An honorary Durenmar title for the magus responsible for the covenant's martial defense, traditionally a Flambeau; currently held by Philippus Niger.

name: Public Vis Source
description: +2 variant of Secret Vis Source recorded in the Peripheral Code: 12 pawns and an automatic chair.

name: Puissant Craft
description: A Virtue granting a bonus to a Craft Ability such as Painting or Baking, used by several covenfolk templates.

name: Puissant Finesse
description: A recommended Virtue for the School of Vilano that boosts the magus's effective Finesse Ability for aiming indirect attacks.

name: Puissant Intrigue
description: A Virtue granting a bonus to the Intrigue Ability, taken by the Political Agent template.

name: Puissant Leadership
description: Minor General Virtue granted by an Enriched Topaz of Virtue.

name: Punish the Sinner
description: Avengers of Evil Power inflicting wounds commensurate with the target's sin.

name: Purification of the Festering Wounds
description: A Creo Corpus spell (Level 20) granting a +9 bonus to Recovery rolls if maintained throughout the recovery interval.

name: Push of the Gentle Wave
description: Core spell (ArM5 p.124) that several faerie powers resemble, moving boats or swimmers with a current.

name: Pyrenees
description: The mountain range between France and Spain where Flambeau hid in a cave, founded Val-Negra, and where his lost talisman is thought to lie.

name: Raised from the Dead
description: A Major Story Supernatural Flaw in which the character died and was brought back through a holy miracle, beginning with at least three Warping points plus more over time.

name: Realm Interaction Table
description: A rules table modifying how the prevailing Aura affects power recovery; Jumayl recovers Might per hour equal to the prevailing Aura as modified by it.

name: Recollection of Memories Never Quite Lived
description: A Muto Mentem spell (Level 4) that changes the target's memory of a detail into a similar but different memory the target cannot distinguish from the authentic one.

name: Restless Dead
description: Corporeal dead rising from graves and ghostly visitations that terrorize Mythic Europe; the Donatores combat or quiet them, distinguishing Infernal from Magic or Faerie origins.

name: Restricted Might
description: Major or Minor Supernatural Flaw rendering the faerie nearly powerless under certain conditions.

name: Rethra
description: A former great Slavic pagan fortress-temple housing the Oracle of the god Radegast; once a covenant of Slavic magi-priests, it was abolished by the Tribunal in 1207 and retains a Faerie aura of 4 (secretly Infernal).

name: Ritual of Twelve Years
description: A House Bjornaer rite of passage after which a magus gains the Heartbeast Ability; experiencing it early in apprenticeship can grant Self-Confident or the Uswaurpa reputation.

name: Rorschach Chapter
description: A tiny chapter house of the Covenant of the Icy North near Rorschach, home to two Mercere magi and linked by Hermes Portal to the Motherhouse.

name: Rotomagus
description: Covenant near Rouen (875-892) founded by apprentices of Sinapis and destroyed when Vikings sacked Rouen.

name: Rouen
description: Capital of Normandy on the Seine, Roman Rotomagus, captured by Philip II in 1203; has a cathedral and a declining Jewish community.

name: Rügen
description: An island in the Eastern Marches that is home to the covenant of Crintera and a focus of the Crintera Schism; the spread of the Church there makes recruiting difficult.

name: Sabbat
description: A meeting of a folk witch coven held on traditional festival dates, used to trade vis, brew potions cooperatively, Open the Gift and perform initiations.

name: Sabina of the Seine
description: A relatively young maga who leads the Viticulturalists league and keeps its collection of casting tablets for agricultural rituals.

name: Saint
description: Holy dead accepted into heaven who intercede and grant miracles; greater, area and local saints.

name: Saint Paul
description: An apostle cited regarding slavery, counseling slaves to obey their masters while requiring masters not to abuse them.

name: Sardinia
description: The Mediterranean island, dotted with nuraghi and magic auras, where Hephaestus built his famous forge and House Verditius's domus magna Verdi stands.

name: Scitalis
description: A large slow-moving Magical serpent (Might 5, Animal) with spectacularly colored scales that can stupefy onlookers with its Dazzling Appearance and whose fangs drip venom; its hot blood keeps it active in winter.

name: Scots
description: Irish tribe (Scotti) that settled in the southwest and conquered the Picts, giving their name to Scotland.

name: Secondary Insight
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue making magical study versatile, granting bonus experience in several Forms when studying a Technique, and in Techniques when studying a Form.

name: Seferiel
description: An angel of the Divine realm (Divine Might 50, Corpus) with special responsibility for Hermetic magi, sometimes drawing them closer to God and sometimes acting as the instrument of God's vengeance. He can duplicate any Hermetic effect and is the suggested antagonist for the Plagued by Angel Story Flaw.

name: Selene
description: Succubus named for the Greek goddess, summoned by the Daughters in the rite of drawing down the moon.

name: Selkie King
description: Faerie king of the selkies who holds court under Staple Island; his hidden name, which is external vis, was stolen by Brown Wullie.

name: Seraphim
description: Most exalted Choir, Glowing Ones with six wings who praise God; Divine Might no less than 35.

name: Seven-League Stride
description: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 30) that transports the caster to any place within seven leagues that they can see or have an Arcane Connection with.

name: Shape and Material Bonus
description: Bonus table for enchanting, expanded here with amber, human skull, lead, mirror, opal and rhodocrosite.

name: Short-Lived Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character's spells do not last as long as they should, with each duration category reduced.

name: Shriek of the Impending Shafts
description: An Intellego Herbam spell (Level 15) that warns of incoming wooden objects via a shriek, granting +9 Defense against wooden weapons.

name: Shroud the Stench of the Pit
description: Godhead's power disguising his infernal powers and taint from Hermetic detection.

name: Side Effect
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue giving a magus's magic an incidental, generally useful feature whose intensity scales with spell level, such as a temporary Presence bonus after casting.

name: Sight Beyond Sight
description: Personal power letting all five senses operate at a distance as far as the creature can see.

name: Simple Minded
description: A Flaw possessed by all Rottweiler grogs reflecting limited intellect.

name: Sinapis
description: Powerful covenant founded in 855 at Tavant, abandoned in 1063; parent of Aedes Salii, Lapis Crudus and Rothomagus.

name: Slow Power
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which one of the character's supernatural powers requires an additional round of preparation to activate.

name: Speak Italian
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Spell Foci
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a rustic magus incorporate a small casting tool into spells to add a shape/material bonus to the Casting Total.

name: St. Cuthbert
description: A saint whose shrine is at Durham cathedral; in a vision he told Godric to settle at Finchale near Durham, and pilgrims visit Godric's shrine as part of visiting Cuthbert's.

name: St. Denis
description: Third-century missionary to Paris beheaded at Montmartre; patron saint of France.

name: St. Patrick
description: A holy man who came from Ireland to Glastonbury and was made abbot, bringing the monks under a rule of life just before the time of Arthur.

name: Stentorius
description: A powerful older House Tremere Archmagus, leader of Fengheld in the Rhine Tribunal, who holds three-fifths of the Tremere sigils there and commands the House in that Tribunal.

name: Strong Willed
description: A Virtue gained through Clan Sirnas's Trial of Self Control, alongside Deleterious Circumstances when hungry.

name: Succubus
description: An Infernal entity that sometimes poses as a faerie partner, making intercourse with it worse than the mortal sin of faerie bestiality.

name: Summoner
description: A Mythic Companion versed in the Goetic Art of Summoning, often living as a hermit with ghostly servants and a ghostly warder.

name: Supernatural Beauty
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue of mystical beauty that calls royal power, folk magic, and heroism to its defense, letting the player request a fortunate coincidence once per story.

name: Susceptible to Divine Power
description: Flaw appearing in character statistics or rules in this text.

name: Taltos
description: Wizards among the Magyar people of Hungary who use herbcraft to boost their physical characteristics and martial skills and to heal; many have Skinchanger; a Pharmocopoeian variant.

name: Taste of the Spices and Herbs
description: A Muto Imaginem spell (Level 5) that makes a setting's worth of food or drink taste and smell exactly as the caster designates.

name: Temper
description: A particular aspect of the divine invoked into a Dominion aura as a Personality Trait, aiding compatible acts and hindering opposed ones.

name: Temperate
description: Flaw typical of Ikhwan as-Safa' or Tulab Ibn Sina members owing to their devotion.

name: Temporary Might
description: Magic Inferiority always possessed by Magic Things: spent Might recovers slowly and injury separates Might as vis.

name: The Baltic Sea
description: The sea across which Baltic trade ceases each winter when the Queen of Winter freezes it; a ritual at Arkona must be performed to thaw the ice.

name: The Bible
description: Christian Scriptures of Old and New Testaments; a Summa on Theology (Level 10, Quality 3) and Church Lore (Level 3, Quality 3).

name: The Captive Voice
description: An Imaginem spell that a magus can vary to collect a poet's spoken poem, the captured words acting as an Arcane Connection to the poet until the spell ends.

name: The Carnal Wolf
description: An adulteration caged within the Cave of Twisting Shadows, a great wolf with jaws too large to close, embodying the carnal urges of Demetrius; used to teach apprentices about spiritual impurity.

name: The Faithful Made Whole
description: A sample relic power (4 points, Init +15, Corpus) that cures the recipient of all disease and heals all physical wounds.

name: The Forum of Hermes
description: An enclosed miniature amphitheater at Durenmar, built on a Roman temple and flanked by statues of the Twelve Founders, where Rhine and Grand Tribunals meet.

name: The Gift of Reason
description: A Creo Mentem ritual (Level 35) that permanently increases the target's Intelligence by 1 point, to no higher than 0.

name: The Hounds
description: Immense insubstantial grey dogs of the Wild Hunt (Faerie Might 10) whose howls are arctic winds and whose bites inflict an effect similar to Talons of the Winds.

name: The Limit of Time
description: Hermetic limit preventing true knowledge of the future; considered Divine by the Magoi and constraining Hermetic Divination.

name: The Mysteries Revised Edition
description: An Ars Magica supplement detailing Mysteries such as Hermetic Theurgy, Names of Power, Invocation Magic, Hermetic Synthemata, Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes, and the Inscription on the Soul Virtue.

name: The Pharmacopoeians
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus collect magical ingredients to reduce the vis cost of healing Rituals; defining Virtue of the Pharmacopoeians.

name: The Rhine Gorge
description: The narrow, castle-lined stretch of the Rhine between Bingen and Koblenz where nobles enforce tolls; the focus of the saga and supposedly cursed, with all its covenants failing within seven decades.

name: The Serpent's Oracle
description: Neqael's power duplicating any Intellego spell or understanding the immediate consequences of an act.

name: The Three Faerie Cords
description: Three additional negative cords (leaden, iron, tin) discovered by Farrago Bonisagi that permanently bind a faerie familiar by hindering the maga's mind, body, and spirit to offset cord decay.

name: Theology: Judaism
description: An Academic Ability that is the Jewish equivalent of Theology: Christian, drawing on the Torah, Nevi'im, and Kutuvim.

name: Thessaly
description: Ancient region where the original centaurs fought the Lapiths.

name: Theurgic Spirit Familiar
description: Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue essentially identical to Spirit Familiar but part of name magic; a powerful maga may bind an Aspect of a Daimon as familiar.

name: Titanoi
description: A Mystery Cult lineage within House Tytalus, heirs to the goetic and spirit-summoning magical tradition of Guorna and Tytalus; nearly destroyed during the Betrayal and revived after the Schism War.

name: Titanomachy
description: The war of the Titans and Greek Gods; a place of power from before it holds magical weapons.

name: Torah
description: First five books of the Tanakh transcribed by Moses; a Summa on Theology: Judaism, Judaic Lore and Rabbinic Law.

name: Tormenting Master
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character's master does not believe he passed the apprentice's gauntlet and periodically troubles him with political moves; applicable to magi.

name: Transformation
description: The gruagach equivalent of Wizard's Twilight, replacing normal Warping rules; accumulated Warping slowly turns a gruagach into a troll, complete at Warping Score 10.

name: Treverorum
description: A former covenant in the city of Trier dedicated to recovering lost Roman secrets, approved in 1095 AD; abolished in 1172 AD after its magi repeatedly meddled in the affairs of mundanes and the Church.

name: Trollsynir
description: Wizards said to live in Scandinavia and Iceland who claim descent from giants and bear the power to curse their enemies; a Damhadh-Duidsan variant.

name: Tropaeum
description: Normandy legal category of vis source, such as the Grove of St. Lie.

name: Troubadours
description: A type of minstrel from southern France whose courtly love poetry, inspired by Arabic neighbors, is being destroyed by the Albigensian Crusade.

name: Trow
description: Faerie beings who live below the earth and cannot return home if caught above ground at sunrise; they may cast spontaneous Terram spells.

name: True Sight of the Air
description: An Intellego Auram spell (Level 15) that lets the caster see clearly through smoke, fog, and dust, even if magical.

name: Trust of the Innocent
description: A demonic Mentem power making the victim believe a single plausible lie until contrary evidence appears.

name: University of Salamanca
description: A royal Spanish university founded by Alfonso IX of León in 1218, notable for offering a music degree and admitting women scholars.

name: Vampire
description: A type of dark faerie found in the Transylvania Tribunal that returns from the grave, fathers dhampirs, and has varied vulnerabilities such as crossroads and church bells.

name: Variable Power
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue: one of the character's magic powers grows more powerful over time based on age, Might, Warping, or an Ability score.

name: Venomous Bite
description: Adder power inflicting adder venom if its Attack Advantage exceeds armor Protection.

name: Venus
description: The goddess who dwells in the subterranean Venusberg, where the knight Tannhäuser worshiped her for a year.

name: Verditius Cult Lore
description: Cult Lore texts of House Verditius; Infernal agents may arrange deliveries of these to propel young magi along their hubristic path.

name: Vessels of Iniquity
description: Order of demons whose natural forms are indescribable embodiments of sin; includes Golab, Gourmand, Merry Devils, Reveners and Naonhaithya.

name: Vienna
description: City where Valnastium keeps a chapter; basilisks are common near it.

name: Vis Extraction
description: The laboratory activity of distilling raw vis, appearing as a lab Specialization aided by superior equipment, stills, and certain Features.

name: Vis Infesta
description: The least dangerous Infernal vis, formed when vis lies a year in an Infernal aura or from minor demons; botches are more severe.

name: Vision of Heat's Light
description: An Intellego Ignem spell (Level 20) that lets the caster see the heat of objects of human body temperature or hotter, useful in the dark though not giving true vision.

name: Vision of the Haunting Spirits
description: A Muto Mentem spell (Level 40) with an Imaginem requisite that makes all spirits within a target area visible, including the spirits of living people.

name: Vitkir
description: Norse rune wizards (singular vitki) who work magic by carving runes; considered by many magi to be the Order of Odin.

name: Vituperation
description: Infernal backlash when an infernalist gains 2+ Warping Points or loses control of Infernal power, tormenting him as if in Hell.

name: Volshebnii Mechtateli
description: Mystery cult of dream magi founded on Raisa's dream magic ('Magical Dreamers' in Russian), feared as dream witches, meeting in the lands of dream.

name: Voluntas
description: A vigorous covenant near the village of Wilton, founded by Norman magi, that has led the anti-Blackthorn opposition for over a century and is famed for its library.

name: Vulgar Alchemy
description: Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue derived from hedge alchemy, letting a maga discover new Shape and Material Bonuses through Arcane Experimentation.

name: Vulnerable Casting
description: A Hermetic Flaw causing extra Fatigue loss when casting, gained from Ordeals or bad Twilight effects; cannot be started with alongside Withstand Casting.

name: Vulnerable to Folk Tradition
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw that makes a magus's magic susceptible to folk-remedies, granting aware targets Magic Resistance based on Magic Lore and allowing enchantments to be broken.

name: Waiting Spell
description: A version of Watching Ward with target Room, well known in the Order, which can contain spells up to the level of the Waiting Spell minus 10 and is also a Ritual.

name: Wanderer
description: A free Social Status Virtue recommended for performance artists and held by Brogo, marking an itinerant performer.

name: Ward Against Faeries of the Water
aliases: Ward Against Faeries of the Waters
description: A Rego Aquam General ward spell preventing water faeries whose Faerie Might is at or below the spell level from affecting those targeted.

name: Ward Against Rain
description: A Rego Auram spell (Level 10) ensuring no rain falls on the caster regardless of the weather.

name: Ward against the Beasts of Legend
description: A Rego Animal General ward spell that prevents any magical beast whose Magic Might is at or below the spell level from affecting those within a circle.

name: Waster of Vis
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw causing the character to waste a quarter of the raw vis pawns he uses in any application of vis.

name: Weak Spontaneous Magic
description: The Major Hermetic Flaw of the Rusticani; they cannot fatigue themselves to boost spontaneous magic, making them dependent on formulaic spells.

name: Weather Sense
description: Minor Virtue granting an intuitive understanding of the weather, identical in effect to Sailor's Foretaste of the Morrow, without a roll.

name: Whispering Winds
description: An Intellego Auram unique spell (Level 15) letting the caster hear words spoken by any group within line of sight; an adaptation of an effect known to Bjornaer the Founder.

name: Whispers Behind the Back
description: Accuser demon power giving a victim nagging worry about secret sins; used by corrupt Cluniacs.

name: Whitburh Frithowebba
description: The only quaesitor in Loch Leglean, co-leader of Horsingas who hides its crimes and collects blackmail.

name: Wild Boar
description: Giant Magic boar (Might 20) who guards the entrance level of the Truffle Matron's regio and protects its inhabitants.

name: Winter's Icy Touch
description: A Perdo Ignem spell (Level 10) that causes the target to feel a chill and lose body heat, costing them a Fatigue level.

name: Witches of Thessaly
description: A tradition descended from reclusive Thessalian worshipers of underworld gods who practiced sorcery and necromancy; Trianoma was a member, and some remain in contact with the Daughters of Erictho.

name: Withstand Casting
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus lose fewer Fatigue levels (minimum 1) when casting spells; can be taken multiple times for greater effect.

name: Wizard's Vigil
description: A Ritual spell known free by Mercurian Magic magi at a level equal to their highest Ritual spell, enabling collaborative casting that raises effective spell level.

name: Woden
description: The Norse god who oversaw trade and commerce under the title Farmagud (god of cargoes); a fickle god of magic whose symbols are the spear, raven, and wolf.

name: Wolf of Virtue
description: A magical wolf aligned to the Magic Realm that embodies wolfhood. Trained by the She-Wolf, it often leads a pack and has the Transfix power.

name: Xaphan
description: Forge-man of Hell and chief stoker of Hell's fires, an Aerial Power of brass with bellows, who suggested burning Heaven during the rebellion.

name: Ymir
description: The Protogonos of the Norse lands, a primordial giant slain by the gods whose body formed the world; progenitor of two races of kosmokrators.

name: Zahid
description: Mythic Companions who are exceptionally ascetic Sufis, often shaykhs, able to work miraculous karamas and synchronize followers' efforts.

name: (Dead Language)
description: An Academic Ability for speaking a language no longer used natively, such as Latin, available only to educated characters.

name: (Form) Monstrosity
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw, mainly for animal characters, giving a monstrous feature corresponding to a magical Form, from which Muto vis may be extracted.

name: Abaddon
description: One of the Maskim, of the Furies; the 'angel of the abyss' of Revelation who will emerge at the fifth trump to destroy mankind.

name: Abdkypris
description: A recent Criamon Primus who traveled through Muslim Iberia, North Africa, and the Levant, introducing Sufi wisdom and the Path of Walking Backwards into the House.

name: Aberdeen
description: East coast town marking the northern extent of the Lowlands.

name: Academic Concentration
description: A General, Minor Virtue: the character concentrates in one of the seven Artes Liberales subjects for +3 to that subject but -1 to the others; incompatible with Puissant Artes Liberales.

name: Acclimation
description: Process by which magic characters lose Magic Qualities unless they remain in auras, consume vis or maintain magical effects; not suffered in the Twilight Void.

name: Adulteration
description: Impurities from magi's minds made solid by mystical forces, often created during Final Twilight, embodying unresolved psychological issues as creatures or places; the greatest are called malignancies.

name: Aedes Salii
description: Vassal of Sinapis on Jersey (998-1063) founded to coordinate the Schism War, named after the Salii.

name: Africa
description: Largely unclaimed by the Order; possible expansion target.

name: Aging Crisis
description: Aging event ending a Longevity Ritual's and Lesser Elixir's effectiveness.

name: Air's Ghostly Form
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 5) that forms a thick fog around the magus extending outward several paces.

name: Alberich
description: A faerie that, according to a Tytalan rumor, Bonisagus really was; the same one as in the Nibelungenlied.

name: Alcuin of York
description: The Englishman and most famous teacher of Charlemagne's Palatine School, whose ghost is said to haunt the Paris classrooms and whose lost works scholars seek at Aachen.

name: Alcuin's Auberge
description: Vassal of Florum (1124-1197), a small Mercer House in Tours founded by Redcaps from Lixivia.

name: Alertness
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Algiz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Elk" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of protection associated with the elk; used to ward targets and increase Soak.

name: Alluring to (Beings)
description: A Minor General Virtue making animals, faeries, or magical beings strangely drawn to the character, granting +3 to Communication and Presence rolls to affect them.

name: Amaranth
description: Rare purple faerie flower containing Creo vis; it halts apparent aging and is an addictive drug for magi, banned by the tribunal.

name: Amberitus
description: Arch-Mage of Jerbiton and leader and coven master of Literatus, with strongest Infernal ties.

name: Amiens
description: Historical capital of Picardy with relics of St. Martin's cloak and John the Baptist's head.

name: Analects of Tytalus
description: A book collating Tytalus's wisdom, speeches, and sayings, compiled by Hariste; every member of House Tytalus owns a copy and apprentices copy it during apprenticeship.

name: Andalusia
description: Region of Iberia from which many destrier stallions come.

name: Aneirin the Bard
description: A Daimon (Magic Might 15, Imaginem) of one of the five great Welsh poets, famous for the poem Y Gododdin, whose spirit wanders the Cambrian Mountains and can teach Names of Power.

name: Angelic Choirs
description: The nine (or ten) orders of angels in the Heavenly Hierarchy, sometimes equated with hierarchies in mortal society.

name: Anglo-Saxon Futhorc
description: An expanded rune alphabet of up to 33 characters developed in England, weaker than the Elder Futhark.

name: Ansuz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Mouth" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of the mouth and speech, associated with the Aesir and Odin; targets sounds (Imaginem), minds through speech (Mentem), and intelligent beings.

name: Antichrist
description: Prophesied figure identified variously by Joachimites as a future pope, Frederick II or Saladin.

name: Apennine Mountains
description: Italian mountains hiding mythic places and the Graveyard of the Arch-Magi.

name: Apollo
description: Greek god whom Aristeas serves, accompanied by ravens in Arcadia.

name: Apparition
description: Saint power creating a physical but invulnerable manifestation of the saint.

name: Aptitude for (Sin)
description: Minor General Tainted Virtue granting +3 to rolls in a narrow circumstance linked to a demon's Obsession, such as picking pockets or poisoning.

name: Arabic
description: Language Ability required for Ikhwan as-Safa' grades and Tulab Ibn Sina.

name: Arcadian Travel
description: A Minor Arcadian Mystery (Virtue) that lets a maga travel between Faerie and the mortal world via trods and open temporary gateways to Arcadia using charms.

name: Arcane Experimentation
description: ArM5 experiment rules providing an Experimentation Bonus; used by Vulgar Alchemy.

name: Archangels
description: The Host of Archangels, ruling angels of the Choirs and Heaven's vanguard; Divine Glory manifest who will war against Hell on Judgment Day.

name: Argonauts
description: Jason's crew aboard the Argo who were saved from the sirens by Orpheus's lyre during the quest for the Golden Fleece.

name: Aristotelian Training
description: A General, Minor Virtue: the character was trained in the New Aristotle, gaining +1 to Artes Liberales rolls for grammar, logic, rhetoric, +1 to Disputatio Totals, and (for magi) +1 to relevant Lab Totals.

name: Ark of the Covenant
description: Relic built to carry the tablets of the Law, lost since 587 BC; Faith 10 for Jews and Divine Might 100.

name: Armagh
description: Irish town, home of the motherhouse of the canons guarding Lough Dearg and a required stop for pilgrims to the Purgatory.

name: Armenia
description: Kingdom in conflict with the Templars.

name: Arthur of Brittany
description: Son of Geoffrey with a strong claim to England; vanished at Rouen in 1203, rumored to be Gifted and apprenticed.

name: Asinara
description: Small island north of Sardinia, site of Rellantali's nearly abandoned fortress.

name: Assassins
description: Nizari Isma'ili sect founded by Hasan-i Sabbah at Alamut, hierarchically organized and known for political assassination.

name: Assisi
description: Italian town where Francis and Clare were born and the Franciscans are centered.

name: Astrology
description: The natural principle that the celestial figure of planets at a thing's creation determines its qualities; employed by magi in ceremonial casting and lab work ordering.

name: Atlantean Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue from exiled Atlantean magic granting the special Range Water-way, Duration Storm, and Target Body-of-water.

name: Auctus
description: Former Sardinian covenant founded by a Bonisagus, a Criamon and a Merinita to unite Enigmatic, Faerie and Hermetic magic; destroyed by Verdi in 937.

name: Augustan Brotherhood
description: Magical organization embedded within the courts of Mythic Europe providing intelligence and service to nobility; could be brought into the Order as a new House.

name: Augustina
description: Ragoneda's apprentice of eight years, a bone maga working in Animál who seeks adventure.

name: Augustinian Canons
description: Regular canons following the Rule of St. Augustine of Hippo who, unlike monks, are not sequestered from the world and undertake pastoral duties.

name: Auvergne
description: Upland region in eastern Aquitaine where Atsingani currently camps and where the Capuchonnes massacred brigands.

name: Avarret
description: Magus elevated to Primus of House Bonisagus in 1191, returning the House to conservative refinement of Hermetic theory; selected Murion as successor before Final Twilight.

name: Aventine Hill
description: Hill in Rome near which Bonisagus found a cache of Cult of Mercury rituals.

name: Averse to Risk
description: A Minor Ordeal Flaw making a Verditius magus reluctant to undertake risky laboratory activities, forbidding experimentation; incompatible with Prone to Chance.

name: Awakened Trees
description: Trees in Magic auras that are aware and capable of limited movement; at aura 6+ they are fully awake, having Cunning but no Might.

name: Ba'al Ov
description: Ancient Jewish summoners and necromancers, 'spirit borrowers', considered the first sorcerers.

name: Baal-Peor, Lord of Filth
description: A demon of wealth and filth (Might 30, Corpus) who creates discord by moving mortal riches disruptively, sprays noxious vomit, and was worshipped as an embodiment of the desire to consume and defile.

name: Baiocassium Minor
description: Lost Diedne vassal covenant rumored to lie in a regio within the town of Bayeux.

name: Bamberg
description: A bishopric city elevated by Henry II and built on seven hills to rival Rome; its main export is beer, with over a dozen breweries including the ancient Bierhaus.

name: Bamburgh
description: Heavily garrisoned English fortress, former capital of Bernicia and Northumbria, whose constable holds wardship over the Farne Islands.

name: Banishing
description: A Major Supernatural Accelerated Ability of the Donatores that banishes any creature with a Might score from a designated area for a time; aligned with the Divine for the Donatores but possible with any realm.

name: Barcelona
description: County ruled by the same family as Provence, which claims to inherit the ancient margraviate.

name: Bard
description: A Free Social Status Virtue for a graduate of a Hibernian bardic school at the rank of Dos, with a Local Reputation among the Irish.

name: Barking Beast
description: Faerie beast that lives to be hunted, with the body of a leopard and a baying of hounds from its belly; the greatest test of a hunter's skill.

name: Battle of Bouvines
description: 1214 battle where Philip won and captured Count Ferdinand of Flanders.

name: Bavarian Common
description: The collective vis sources of the fallen covenant Highest Aspiration, harvested under Quaesitor oversight and divided annually among Alpine covenants.

name: Beast Masters
description: An Ex Miscellanea tradition whose apprentices are abandoned in the wilderness and develop the Summon Animals Virtue, Animal Ken, and a Minor Magical Focus with a specific group of animals.

name: Beelzebub
description: One of the Maskim, Chief of the False Gods; called Beelzebul (Lord of Heaven) as an angel and Beelzebub (Lord of the Dunghill) after the fall, often depicted as a monstrous fly.

name: Benefice
description: Church office income; senior clergy may hold several and employ curates.

name: Beowulf
description: The hero who slew the troll Grendel; Theoderich has been unable to find his remains.

name: Bergerac
description: A thriving port barely an hour's walk from Nidi.

name: Berkanan
description: Elder Futhark rune "Birch" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of the birch, associated with healing, fertility and youth; usually Herbam, Corpus or Animal as a target.

name: Bind Magical Creatures
description: A Major House Mystery developed in the Thebes Tribunal that binds a magical creature's life force to an enchanted device or binds one of its powers to the magus's Gift.

name: Bingen
description: A walled town at the southern edge of the Rhine Gorge where the Nahe meets the Rhine, guarded by Burg Klopp; near the Mouse Tower and home of Hildegard's Rupertsberg monastery.

name: Bishop
description: Head of a diocese, highest of the major orders; bishops are elected rather than examined and may grant petitions up to Ease Factor 15.

name: Black Dog of the Moor
description: A magical hound with tracking powers who frees mistreated hounds and is hunted by a local noble in a story seed.

name: Black Whisper
description: A spell in which the caster whispers a magic sentence into the target's ear; if completed, the target must resist a Stamina roll or go completely insane.

name: Bladud
description: Legendary Celtic prince and cthonic wizard-king who founded Bath and its hot springs, founded a university at Stamford, and died when his enchanted wings failed over the Temple of Apollo.

name: Blood of Heroes
description: Special free Virtue making a character a Mythic Companion descended from a hero; allows Heroic Virtues and Flaws.

name: Boating
description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

name: Bockman
description: A horrible goat-headed faerie that lurks on Black Forest paths to ambush travelers using its Unease of the Still Forest and Fear powers; physically weak and cowardly, with Animal and Mentem vis in its horns.

name: Botzberg
description: Battle site of AD 69 where ghosts can be called up.

name: Bound Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw: when the magus dies, all his spells end and any magic items he created cease to function.

name: Branugurix
description: Domus magna of House Diedne (791-1012) in a regio near Mount Dol, sealed by the Diedne Primus in the final battle of the Schism War.

name: Breath of Winter
description: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 15) that turns a circle of water up to five paces across into snow that will not melt until the spell expires.

name: Breath of the Open Sky
description: A Creo Auram Ritual spell (Level 40) that calls up a wind capable of devastating the countryside, toppling structures and trees.

name: Bremen
description: A port city on the north bank of the River Weser whose bishopric was founded in the 8th century by Charlemagne's missionary Willehad.

name: Bronwyn filia Astrolabe
description: Valnastium maga researching Hermetic phonotactics and metered spells, whose poetry is embarrassing doggerel.

name: Brother Knight
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a knight in a holy crusading order, sworn to obedience, poverty, and chastity.

name: Brude Deathless
description: The most powerful gruagach in Loch Leglean (Magic Resistance 60), who joined Pralix in the war against Damhan-allaidh, abducts children to train as gruagachan in his tower in Strathnavar, and lays Geasa and Curses.

name: Bruges
description: The greatest manufacturing center of the Flemish industrial region, where merchants may not buy land but may dress richly, noted for luxurious trousers.

name: Brutal Artist
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw available only to magi of House Jerbiton: the magus makes ugly art, suffering -3 on social rolls with Jerbiton magi and unable to gain a positive Reputation in the House.

name: Bureaucrat
description: Minor Social Status Virtue for a member of the Muslim civil administration, such as a katib or watha'iqi; allows Academic Abilities.

name: Burnham
description: An aloof covenant in the far northeast of the tribunal, a motte-and-bailey castle holding a grant of immunity from the crown; rarely sends representatives to tribunal.

name: Cabal of the Laden Cart
description: Tytalus cabal founded by Kybella to entrap Death, obsessed with the Ankeu.

name: Cailleach Magic
description: Gruagach Virtue allowing Spontaneous Magic like Diedne Magic; integrated as a teachable Virtue with the Hedge Wizard Flaw instead of Dark Secret.

name: Caithness
description: Northern province settled by Norsemen; site of a battle with Damhan-allaidh.

name: Caitlin Suil Uaine
description: Maga who leads the covenant of Crun Clach, won the hill from the Prince of the Grey Jerkin at shinty, keeps a stable of faerie horses and maintains diplomacy with sith and neighboring tribunals.

name: Calum
description: A 135-year-old gruagach and magus Ex Miscellanea, effective head of the covenant of Mac Gruagach, who seeks to integrate Highland gruagach magic with Hermetic magic; gnarled, fur-covered and smelling of rotting vegetation.

name: Canon
description: Member of a chapter of clergy serving an urban church who share common table and property.

name: Cantores
description: Primarily Christian holy tradition dedicated to worshipping God through music, gathering in cities and great abbeys; opposed to bawdy secular music.

name: Caput Capra
description: Easternmost Diedne covenant (981-1005) on the Loire near Fleury, first casualty of the Schism War in the Tribunal.

name: Carmelites
aliases: Order of Our Lady of Mount Carmel
description: Order of Our Lady of Mount Carmel, originating from hermits on Mount Carmel in the Holy Land devoted to solitude and penance.

name: Carolingian Dynasty
description: Frankish dynasty named after Charlemagne; its blood often carries the Mythic Presence Virtue.

name: Carolinus
description: Charlemagne's mage-smith, several of whose apprentices were adopted by the Founder Jerbiton.

name: Castile
description: A region of Mythic Europe with distinctive inheritance customs, including an example of a bride continuing to rule her own land except for her dowry, and where a widow may guard her son's lands.

name: Catalonia
description: Iberian region whose chivalry follows the French model, with condes, viscondes, valvasores, cavallers and sotcastlàs.

name: Celestial Immunity
description: Saint power making the recipient immune to physical damage while the threat lasts.

name: Centaur
description: Faerie composite of horse and human that acts as a mentor guiding the young hero to adulthood; modern hippocentaurs are faerie duplicates of the ancient centaurs.

name: Ceremony of Welcome
description: Hermetic or setting concept referenced in the description of the Mythic Locations sites.

name: Chamber of Spring Breezes
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 5) that creates a breeze of fresh air keeping a room's air breathable even if airtight.

name: Chancery
description: A branch of the royal court headed by the chancellor Richard de Marsh, responsible for issuing documents under the Great Seal and keeping government records such as the Pipe Rolls.

name: Charisma
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Charles the Bald
description: Carolingian king who endowed Laon and built the palace at Compiègne.

name: Cheating the Reaper
description: A Creo Corpus ritual (Level 30) that resolves a major or lesser aging crisis; each application causes Warping.

name: Cherubim
description: Angels with flaming swords guarding the entrances to Eden.

name: Childeric
description: Son of Merovech, king of the Salian Franks who besieged Paris in 464.

name: Chimera
description: A noble hybrid inner heartbeast combining features of two mundane creatures (such as a griffin, hippogriff, or unicorn), produced by the Mystery of the Chimera.

name: Chirurgeon
description: A practitioner of chirurgy (surgery, bone-setting, phlebotomy, cautery, midwifery), considered a craft; includes barber-surgeons who assist medici in therapeutic procedures.

name: Chnoubis the Serpent
description: A lion-headed serpent Daimon (Magic Might 30, Mentem) summoned for his abilities to scry and ferret out secrets, claiming to be a native of the Nile.

name: Church Knowledge
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Church of Saint Cyprian
description: A church within Valnastium valley whose presence creates a Divine aura up to 6 and has prevented the covenant's Magic aura from developing further.

name: Circe
description: Legendary figure claimed by some as an ancestor of Mercere.

name: City and Guild
description: An Ars Magica sourcebook covering craftsmen, guilds, and social statuses, referenced for rules on masons and on Social Status Virtues like Factor.

name: Clairvaux Abbey
description: Major Cistercian abbey founded by St. Bernard in 1115 with a Divine aura of 6.

name: Clare of Assisi
description: Noblewoman of Assisi, born 1194, who followed Francis, became abbess of the Poor Sisters at Saint Damian, and wrote the first rule by a woman.

name: Cloak of the Duck's Feathers
description: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 5) that makes water run off an object or creature, protecting it from dampness unless submerged.

name: Clumsy Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw: the magus has trouble targeting spells, with aiming rolls of 0 automatically botching and -3 to Finesse rolls.

name: Coat of Flame
description: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 25) with a Rego requisite that swathes the target in fire dealing +5 damage every round while the spell is in effect; the requisite keeps the fire from spreading.

name: Code of Hermes (Ability)
description: Ability used to judge whether a ruling clearly conflicts with the Code (Int + Code of Hermes roll).

name: Coerce the Spirits of the Night
description: A spell that makes a ghost obey the caster as long as it can be coerced with threats such as defiling its grave or banishing it to Hell.

name: Cognizant Within Role
description: Virtue appearing in faerie statistics in this text (Cognizant within Role).

name: Coils of the Entangling Plants
description: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 20) that animates grass and small plants in a field to grab and wrap around the people nearest them.

name: Commanding the Harnessed Beast
description: A Rego Animal spell (Level 30) that implants a complicated command into an animal, which it carries out to the best of its ability.

name: Comprehend Magic
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability (the defining power of the Lineage of Pralix) that lets a character see, analyze, and understand active magics without penalizing Magic Resistance.

name: Confidence Point
description: A point a character can spend (for example) to walk away from a situation that would otherwise increase a Verditius magus's Hubris score.

name: Conjuration of the Indubitable Cold
description: A Perdo Ignem spell (Level 25) that cools the air within ten paces below freezing, chilling nonliving things thoroughly and costing living things a Fatigue level while shrinking fires.

name: Controlling
description: Elementalist Technique based on Presence that lets an elementalist dictate the behavior of summoned or encountered targets via gesture and incantation.

name: Corinth
description: Site of an ancient shrine to Lamia and of Apollonios's wedding confrontation.

name: Cornwall
description: English county whose people paid King John 5,000 marks to be deforested.

name: Corpse Magic
description: A Supernatural Ability allowing the character to temporarily revive and command a relatively intact, unburied corpse.

name: Council of Elders
description: The six-magus governing body of House Bjornaer at Crintera, holding the Seats of the Bear, Wolf, Horse, Stag, Eagle, and Swan, with the Senior Elder holding the casting vote.

name: Courser
description: Swift light horse like the Andalusian used for hunting and travel, not trained for battle.

name: Crest of the Earth Wave
description: A Rego Terram spell that creates a wave in the earth traveling outward, tossing aside those caught in its path for +10 damage.

name: Crusade
description: Church-raised war; crusaders may gain freedom, and crusades are hugely expensive for lords and peasants.

name: Crusades
description: Church-sanctioned holy wars to regain the Holy Land, of which four have struck by 1220.

name: Crush
description: Obligatory Greater Power of earth elementals, a clubbing attack that can pin and damage equipment.

name: Culhwch Ex Miscellanea
description: A mature magus at Cad Gadu, Gwrhyr's former apprentice turned bully fond of tormenting mundanes; particularly skilled with Ignem.

name: Cult of Heroes
description: Societas Merceris seeking reborn heroes of antiquity to adopt as Redcaps and elevate through rituals.

name: Curse of the Rhine Gorge
description: A purported long-term doom causing every covenant and noble dynasty of the Rhine Gorge to fail within roughly seven decades; attributed to one of four supernatural realm causes.

name: Cursewood
description: A cursed forest in a barren valley in Pomerania, about 30 miles across, home of the daimon Wyzwanie and site of Regulus' sanctum, covered by a Malevolent Infernal aura of 5.

name: Cymena the Redcap
description: Nonmagical redcap living at Tarragon Vale, whose grandparents were from there; carries a lickstone and wears dragonette-skin boots.

name: Dachstein
description: Mountain home of the Frost Giants, allies of the Covenant Where Journeys End.

name: Dagaz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Day" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of the day, time and growth; affects aging and growth, rarely targeted as Imaginem or Ignem.

name: Dagobert I
description: Founder of the monastery of St. Denis in the 7th century.

name: Damaging Effect
description: Faerie power increasing the damage of a weapon or bite by +5, possessed by Auvekoejaks, icthyocentaurs and death sharks.

name: Damietta
description: A city whose fall to the Crusaders the previous year resulted in slaves purchased into Levantine and Theban Tribunal covenants.

name: Daniel
description: Biblical figure who fixed a weigh-in with the help of God, whose miracle the abbot hopes to repeat.

name: Debate
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Dedicated Vis
description: Rare vis tied to a Technique and Form combination, counting double for spells, study, and enchantment.

name: Deep Sleeper
description: Flaw appearing in character statistics or rules in this text.

name: Demetrius
description: An alchemist Criamon magus, teacher of the current Prima Muscaria, whose carnal urges are embodied in the captured adulteration called the Carnal Wolf.

name: Demonic Steed
description: A corrupt beast (Might 7, Animal) appearing as a fearsome black stallion with iron hooves, unimpeded by poor terrain; one of three created by an Infernalist magus using a tainted Steed of Vengeance spell.

name: Demons of Futility
description: Evil spirit demons (Infernal Might 5 Aquam) imprisoned on Megstone who drown sailors and encourage despair; appear as short black hooded creatures riding goats.

name: Deodand
description: A stolen donkey that caused a death and holds a fragment of the dead man's angry ghost, able to turn into a spectral centaur-like creature with donkey hindquarters.

name: Devotion
description: Theological virtue (normally called Faith); at True Faith 2 grants Premonitions and the ability to dispel illusions and glamour with a Faith Point.

name: Dhimmi
description: A Minor General Flaw marking a non-Muslim living under Muslim rule, who must pay the jizya head tax and abide by social restrictions in return for tolerance and protection.

name: Difficult Spontaneous Magic
description: A Hermetic Flaw referenced as combinable with Weak Spontaneous Magic to create a magus who cannot cast spontaneous magic at all.

name: Dindyméné
description: A titaness and kosmokrator Daimon of the Magic Realm, mother of Zeus, imprisoned asleep beneath Mount Dindymon; embodies fertility, mountains and wild beasts, with Magic Might 75.

name: Diocese
description: Ecclesiastical territory of a bishop; about 800 in Mythic Europe, grouped into provinces and split into archdeaconries and deaneries.

name: Dionysus the Areopagite
description: Authority who lists the archangels as Michael, Gabriel, Raphael, Uriel, Chamuel, Zadkiel and Jophiel.

name: Diplomacy
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Direction Sense
description: Minor magical talent a Redcap's apprentice might show.

name: Disguise of the Putrid Aroma
description: A Rego Animal spell (Level 5) that makes a targeted animal take no interest in the caster as long as concentration is maintained.

name: Divination & Augury
description: A supernatural Virtue allowing the performance of auguries; Chnoubis' Augury power functions as this Virtue, granting ten levels of success per Might point.

name: Divine Form
description: Form of Divine Ascent transforming the character toward pure holiness, functioning like The Commanding Aura but punishing sin severely.

name: Divining
description: Elementalist Technique based on Perception used to locate and commune with elements and elemental targets; costs no Fatigue.

name: Dogrose School
description: A regio covenant claimed by House Bonisagus that draws Gifted children via their possessed toys and teaches them before sending them to masters.

name: Dolomites
description: Region in whose inaccessible valleys lies Jerbiton's family villa, now Valnastium.

name: Domus Magnus
description: The central covenant of a House; Harco, Magvillus and Verdi are Domus Magni.

name: Doublet of Impenetrable Silk
description: A Muto Animal spell (Level 15) that changes an item of silk, wool, or leather so it cannot be cut or penetrated by weapons, granting a Soak bonus.

name: Dream
description: A realm of the sleeper's mind where navigation is associative, time is non-linear, and magic is governed by Imaginem for spiritual travelers.

name: Dream Interpretation
description: Method of divination by interpreting dreams, popular but of mixed repute; basis of Hermetic Dream Interpreter.

name: Drown
description: Elemental Spirit of the Waves power to engulf a smaller target after a melee hit, forcing deprivation rolls.

name: Durham
description: The site of the cathedral of St. Cuthbert on a high hill in a loop of the river Wear; a palatinate center of pilgrimage and resistance to the Normans.

name: Earth Shock
description: A Terram spell that mimics an earthquake, cited as an example where the material cause (earth) determines the Hermetic Form.

name: Edinburgh
description: Capital of Scotland, a royal burgh with about 1,500 inhabitants.

name: Edward of Milton
aliases: Edward of Milton, follower of Jerbiton
description: A Jerbiton archmagus and nominated head of the covenant Schola Pythagoranis in Cambridge, friend and former teacher of the scholar Robert Grosseteste.

name: Ehwaz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Horse" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of the horse, mobility in combat and the bond of horse and rider; associated with Animal.

name: Eidolon
description: Common spirit power used to create illusions and communicate, e.g. an oasis illusion or phantom noises.

name: Ekstasis
description: The magical power defining nightwalker traditions, also called straying, which lets a magician send forth his spirit while unconscious; it has no corresponding Ability.

name: Elf
description: Possible baby thief who forgot to leave a changeling.

name: Elizabeth of Schönau
description: Benedictine nun and mystic (born 1129) at Schönau who recorded her visions in the Books of Visions and corresponded with Hildegard.

name: Empathy
description: Faerie Method (Stamina) drawing Faerie power within the caster through a trance ritual costing Fatigue, doubling Sympathy for effect limits.

name: Enchanting (Ability)
description: A Minor Supernatural Ability Virtue applying to a particular artistic expression (dance, drawing, storytelling, craftwork) that in Faerie auras can control events through art.

name: Enchantment
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab itself has been enchanted as a magic item, granting Virtues, Flaws, or Specialization changes.

name: Encumbrance
description: A penalty derived from the Load of carried equipment, calculated through Burden and offset by Strength, that subtracts from athletic and spellcasting rolls.

name: Enduring Magic
description: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue causing the magus's spells to last longer than usual, with the storyguide secretly multiplying durations by a die roll.

name: Enslave the Mortal Mind
description: A spell that lets the caster completely control the loyalty, emotions, desires, and activities of any person.

name: Enthralling Sound
description: Faerie power producing fear or infatuation through sound, used by Lamashtu, gorgons and the Lesser Nymph.

name: Envied Beauty
description: A Major Story Flaw whose character's beauty draws revulsion and jealousy, especially from vain persons of the character's gender.

name: Environmental Sensitivity
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is unusually sensitive to an uncommon environmental feature, suffering a Stamina penalty when exposed.

name: Essential Flaw
description: Major or Minor General Flaw giving a detrimental Essential Trait tied to a Characteristic.

name: Essential Nature
description: A character's intrinsic, magically defining nature, which can make certain Flaws impossible to remove even with Hermetic magic.

name: Ethiopia
description: The location of a cave complex that is the perfect site for the Microcosm ritual on the Path of the Body, discovered in North Africa.

name: Eudokia
description: The world of the Faerie Realm where one's personal story, moral dilemma, or life transition is told; reached by the Path of Choice.

name: Eule
description: An aged master of House Bjornaer at Fengheld with the heartbeast of an owl and the honorary rank of Quaesitor; she may have entered Final Twilight and her wisdom is faked by Gunther.

name: Eunuch
description: Minor General Flaw for a castrated male character, often made so for work in a harem or military school; grants freedom of movement among the sexes.

name: Evil Eye
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the uncontrolled potential to harm others; those making stress rolls in the character's presence roll an extra botch die, warded off by amulets, rituals, or magic resistance.

name: Exiled Atlantean
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw marking the character as an Atlantean tainted by contact with the surface world and unable to return to her native magic regio.

name: Exorcism
description: Christian rite costing a Confidence or Faith point that helps a possessed person break free of infernal influence.

name: Exotic Casting
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue allowing a magus to cast Hermetic spells using non-Hermetic methods, making it hard for others to recognize the spell being cast.

name: Experimental Philosophy
description: A system of 'natural' magic that produces wondrous effects through the intrinsic power of the subject rather than any arcane force, using contagion, affinity, similarity, hidden virtues, astrology, ligatures and formulae.

name: Extended Glamour
description: Personal power granting awareness of everything within a domain; the faerie is coterminous with its landscape feature and extends an aura.

name: Eyes of the Eagle
description: An Intellego Imaginem spell (Level 25) that lets the caster see distant things clearly, making out details as if they were a foot away while still judging distance accurately.

name: Fable Points
description: Measures accumulated vitality spent in Faerie; determines time dilation and warping on leaving and lets characters swap Virtues and Flaws for faerie ones.

name: Fachan
description: One-eyed, one-armed, one-legged faerie of distant lochs and valleys in Ireland and Scotland that hates humans and fights with club or poisoned flail.

name: Faerie Beast
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue: the character appears to be an animal with all advantages of a faerie body.

name: Faerie Heritage
description: Story Flaw a player taking Brown Wullie as character would have.

name: Faerie Wolf
description: Creature of local superstition said to lick a newborn left in a clearing and bequeath supernatural powers.

name: Faerie-Raised Magic
description: A Major Hermetic Virtue conditioning a character to invent spells very quickly, allowing self-teaching of spells outside the lab; common in the Line of Quendalon.

name: Failed Monk
description: A Minor Social Status Flaw in which the character was cast out of a cloistered order, gaining a poor reputation but freedom from monastic vows.

name: False Gift
description: Corrupted version of The Gift, described in Chapter 12: Black Magic, for apprentices or magi marked by Hell.

name: Fehu
description: Elder Futhark rune "Wealth" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of common wealth such as cattle, silver and grain; as a target it is associated with Animal or Terram (domesticated animals).

name: Feral Scent
description: A Minor General Flaw giving a character the strong natural smell of a wild animal, imposing a social penalty and an Unclean Reputation but doubling Scent Target spell areas if Sensory Magic is Initiated.

name: Feritel
description: Unrecognized independent covenant founded 1117, officially a subject commune of Genoa, whose magi live as nobility and aid the Genoese.

name: Ferramentum of Verditius
description: A magus of House Verditius whose wizard's sigil makes his spells very orderly, seen in his versions of The Cloudless Sky Returned and Curse of the Rotted Wood.

name: Fertility Battles
description: Battles in spirit form that nightwalkers fight, usually four times a year, determining the harvest, hunting and fishing of their area.

name: Fetch
description: The gruagach's spirit companion, sent out by Vision spells to scout; visible to those with Second Sight. Trollsynir call it a fylgja.

name: Fettered Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw making all of the character's spells and activated magic item effects Arcane Connections to him.

name: First Crusade
description: Crusade from 1095 that found the Holy Lance, took Jerusalem and founded the Latin Kingdom of Jerusalem.

name: Flash of the Scarlet Flames
description: A Creo Ignem spell that explodes a brilliant red flash in the air, able to temporarily or permanently blind a target who fails a Stamina roll; Rose of Jerbiton's version smells of roses.

name: Flawed Powers
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw applying the effects of a Major Hermetic Flaw (such as Restriction or Necessary Condition) to a character's Supernatural Virtues rather than to Hermetic magic.

name: Florae
description: Airy Spirits attending plants, appearing female with vegetative features; also called nymphae.

name: Forfeit Immunity
description: Loss of legal protection under Hermetic Law, e.g. during Wizard War, when committing a crime, or when intruding in a sanctum.

name: Forge-Companion
description: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for an unGifted craftsman attached to a Verditius magus and working in his lab, with extra experience for Crafts.

name: Forgery
description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

name: Form of Man
description: Vessels of Iniquity Power to shapeshift into any human after Form of Wickedness.

name: Form of Wickedness
description: Vessels of Iniquity variant of Coagulation, a shapeless form of visible sin overwhelming viewers.

name: Fortunam
description: Learned-magician Form; Fortunam charms influence luck and actions of others.

name: Fosterage
description: Covenant Hook: magi educate a young noble, potentially spreading acceptance of Hermetic magic; also a way to seal supernatural alliances.

name: Franks
description: Historical Germanic people whose history, by Gregory of Tours, is a cited period source.

name: Freeing the Striding Tree
description: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 30) like Lord of the Trees but enabling the tree to walk half as fast as a human; a botched Concentration roll causes the tree to attack the caster.

name: Frightful Presence
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue letting a character instill dread or awe, forcing witnesses to make Brave Personality rolls.

name: Gabai
description: A Minor Social Status Flaw marking the character as the local Jewish tax collector appointed by the community council, with a negative Tax Collector Reputation.

name: Galen
description: The ancient authority on medicine since whom chirurgy has held a less prestigious position; quoted on the distinction between knowledge by experience and by reason.

name: Garus
description: The current Primus of House Flambeau in 1220, an aging former soldier-of-fortune and tournament champion who leads the milites and authored the Code of Garus.

name: Gate of Countless Vistas
description: A stone arched doorway enchanted for instant transport to connected locations, keyed to individual users.

name: Gathering of Twelve Years
description: A periodic gathering of House Bjornaer (the Swan Clan performs a special ritual role at it); held in 1227 and figures in the Crintera Schism as each rival faction holds its own.

name: Gathering of the Stormy Might
description: A Rego Auram spell (Level 40) like Clouds of Thunderous Might but producing a larger storm that can cover the entire visible sky.

name: Gebo
description: Elder Futhark rune "Gift" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of gifts, generosity and obligation; targets objects given as gifts and people in the vitki's debt.

name: Geirlaug
description: A notable contemporary House Flambeau Archmaga of Montverte covenant in the Normandy Tribunal, renowned for her great age, power, and mastery of Ignem.

name: Ghibellines
description: One of the two factions feuding over Florence since 1216, splitting the city along with the Guelphs.

name: Ghula
description: Rapacious wasteland faeries of the Arabic world whose unions with human men produce ghula daughters or ghul-blooded sons.

name: Gift of Speech
description: A Virtue or Magic Quality named among the traits of magical animals or dragons in this text.

name: Glanconer
description: Handsome male faerie who courts girls until they pine to death.

name: Glastonbury Tor
description: A commanding hill near Glastonbury where St. Collen confronted Gwynn ab Nudd's faerie castle.

name: Gloom of Evening
description: A Perdo Ignem spell (Level 10) that substantially drops the level of light in a target room, making it gloomy with deep shadows.

name: Goblin
description: General term for a subterranean faerie of destructive bent found in caves or mines, or a malicious faerie of short stature; prone to taking children for changelings.

name: Golem
description: Clay figure brought to life by Divine energies through Kabbalah, usually in human form as protector of a community; has Divine Might and may be empowered, go mad, or be destroyed.

name: Grand Silesia
description: A covenant founded between the Oder and Warta rivers in Poland by magi from Rethra and Crintera (993-1009); it split to form the New Slavonic Tribunal and was destroyed in the Schism War.

name: Grant
description: Faerie Power to bless or curse a target with Warping Points, temporary Virtues/Flaws, or Sympathy Traits.

name: Grant (Major Virtue)
description: Ritual faerie power (Vim) imposing a named Major Virtue on a target, temporarily or permanently.

name: Grant Puissance in (Ability)
description: Spirit power granting Virtues to chosen humans, e.g. Grant Dowsing, Grant Puissance in (Ability).

name: Gratitude
description: A structured advancement system in which characters earn Gratitude points for exceptional service to their lord, redeemed for office, land, or goods.

name: Grazia filia Natura
description: Animál specialist who supervises Valnastium's stables, kennels and mews and is beginning to investigate taming griffins.

name: Great Elixir
description: Major Mystery Virtue letting an alchemist create and consume a potion that transforms him into an immortal being of the Magic realm; requires Unaging and Lesser Elixir.

name: Greater Benediction
description: A Major, Supernatural Virtue granting a major blessing from a supernatural power, with examples such as Flight, True Sight, and Universally Liked.

name: Grimgroth
description: Named in the book's trademark notice as a property of the Order of Hermes setting.

name: Guardians of the Forests
description: A Rhine Tribunal ruling permitting protection of wildernesses, which the Hawthorn Gild and Crintera unsuccessfully sought to invoke against the Danish invasion of Rugen.

name: Guelphs
description: One of the two factions feuding over Florence since 1216, splitting the city along with the Ghibellines.

name: Hagalaz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Hail" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of hail and the cruel side of nature, storms and missiles; associated with Auram, Aquam and missile weapons.

name: Hagen
description: Gunther's powerful and treacherous vassal in the Nibelungenlied who murders Siegfried, steals and sinks the Nibelung treasure, and is finally decapitated by Kriemhild.

name: Halcyon
description: A mythical magic sea bird serving Dindyméné that calms winds around the winter solstice and eats the Magic regio's Herbam vis; Magic Might 15 (Auram).

name: Hamr
description: Norse term for a corporeal phantasticum, an animal-shaped battle spirit of a trance warrior.

name: Hannibal
description: Commander whose three victories over the Romans in Italy Cercistum claimed he could raise as ghosts.

name: Harold
description: An example character who knows Performance Magic (Hunt) and casts Hunter's Tracks of the Faerie Glow while hunting.

name: Harut
description: One of two fallen angels who, per the Qur'an, taught sihr (magic) to mankind to tempt them from Islam.

name: Hatred
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character hates someone or some group so much that hurting them dominates his life.

name: Haunted
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab is home to a haunting spirit that occasionally disturbs the owner (+1 Warping, -1 Aesthetics, +2 Mentem).

name: Hebrew
description: Hebrew: Ability used by holy or divine characters in this text, e.g. in Abbas the Hunted's or the Chalkydri's statistics or divine rules.

name: Henry the Lion
description: The greatest Welf ruler in living memory, duke of both Saxony and Bavaria, stripped of most estates by Frederick Barbarossa; he beautified Brunswick.

name: Henry the Young King
description: Son of Henry II, who took five hundred knights to Lagny-sur-Marne in 1179 and was tutored by William Marshal.

name: Hephaestus
description: The lame Greek god of smiths and divine artificer, founder of the Cult of Hephaestus, who built sacred forges and crafted famous magical items for the gods.

name: Herbs of Virtue
description: Plants that naturally contain vis and can be Enriched into charms that grant Virtues or powers.

name: Herbwife
description: The poor man's answer to the apothecary; usually a woman who maintains a village's health with preserved garden products and often acts as local midwife.

name: Hercules
description: A god and hero of legendary strength, identified by the Romans with the Gaulish Ogmios and worshiped as protector of the magical springs at the Sanctuary of Hercules.

name: Hermes Trismegistus
description: The legendary sage to whom magi attribute the maxim 'As above, so below,' cited regarding astrology and the Stone of Death.

name: Hermetic Alchemy
description: Hermetic Minor Virtue letting a magus extract more vis from an aura or extract Form-specific vis, using Shape and Material Bonuses.

name: Hermetic Integration
description: Research projects to integrate folk witch practices into Hermetic magic via breakthroughs.

name: Hermetic Patron
description: A Minor Story Flaw, available to Redcaps or magi, in which an older magus or established Redcap watches over and aids the character in exchange for service.

name: Heron of Alexandria
description: Ancient inventor whose works inspired the wonderful steam-rotator machines powering an Unnatural Law covenant.

name: Hidden Shape
description: An aspect of the heartbeast whereby, due to the Limit of Essential Nature, a transformed Bjornaer appears as a mundane animal to magic.

name: High Crimes
description: Serious Hermetic charges that the pirates of Waddenzee would face if the mundane authorities moved against them with no Tribunal support.

name: Highest Aspiration
description: A covenant that previously held the Motherhouse site and was destroyed in the Sundering of Tremere, leaving its resources unclaimed.

name: Hildesheim
description: A splendid cathedral city of northern Germany famed for its civic buildings and churches, raised to greatness by St. Bernward, whose crypt lies in St. Michael's church.

name: Hipta the Nurse
description: A powerful shapechanger Daimon (Magic Might 15, Animal), the nurse of Dionysus, who favors the form of a dove and is invoked for forgiveness from curses and magical harm.

name: His Master's Voice
description: Rumael's power to summon lesser demons without controlling them.

name: Holy Connection
description: The holy equivalent of an Arcane Connection, formed through religious ceremonies, prayer, holy authority or consecration.

name: Holy Music
description: Ability of the Holy Method of Meditation allowing a supernatural state of mind by singing praises to God.

name: Holy Oil of Consecration
description: Ampoule of never-ending oil brought by a dove at Clovis's baptism, used to anoint French kings; a 3-point relic in Reims Cathedral.

name: Holy Societates
description: Traditions that teach Holy Magic as a favored Ability, typically associated with the Order of Hermes, which can train Gifted and unGifted holy magi.

name: Honos
description: A Roman Daimon (Magic Might 30, Corpus) of morality and military honor, appearing as a young warrior with a lance and cornucopia, able to instill Leadership and produce a magical feast.

name: Hooks
description: The story component that drags the characters into the action, often connected to a Story or Personality Flaw of a key character.

name: Hornet Fire
description: A Muto Ignem spell (Level 10) with a Rego requisite that turns a fire into a swarm of insect-sized fireballs that harass a target, imposing a penalty and extra botch dice without dealing real damage.

name: Horse Clan
description: A Crintera clan that maintains the covenant's wild steeds, possesses the Animal Ken Virtue, provides provisioning, and acts as a messenger service.

name: House Mysteries
description: The Bjornaer Mysteries (Heartbeast, Secret Name, Sensory Magic, Theriomorphy) Initiated by Clan Ilfetu that allow magi to emulate their ancestors.

name: House of Canmore
description: The royal line of Malcolm Canmore and Margaret that ruled Scotland in the 12th and 13th centuries.

name: Houses of Hermes: Societates
description: An Ars Magica sourcebook whose Tytalus chapter details House Tytalus' debate system.

name: Hugh de Lusignan
description: The count of Marche, a powerful vassal of the king in Poitou and husband of Queen Isabella.

name: Humanities
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Hunger for (Form) Magic
description: A Major Supernatural Flaw in which the character has become dependent on consuming 1 pawn of vis of a particular Form each season or lose Fatigue Levels.

name: Huns
description: Invaders from Asia whose last coming was presaged by trade disruption.

name: Hunt for the Wild Herb
description: An Intellego Herbam spell (Level 5) that lets you smell one sort of plant and follow its scent, requiring a sample of that plant.

name: Hygwald Veritas
description: A devious magus of House Tremere and co-founder of Waddenzee, a specialist in Rego Mentem who is scrupulously honest with the Quaesitores and aspires to join them.

name: Héloïse
description: Famous nun, disappointed lover of Peter Abelard, prioress at Argenteuil and abbess of the Paraclete.

name: Hérisson
description: A tenth-century Bjornaer magus who founded the Harmonist philosophy of living in harmony with nature, ridiculed in his own time.

name: Iaculus
description: A large venomous snake with feathered wings that flies from trees onto victims; one found dead drained of blood and vis.

name: Iblis
description: In Islamic cosmology, a jinn loyal to God who led the angels against the jinn, then refused to worship Adam out of pride and was cast into Hell; afterwards called Shaitan.

name: Ignatio
description: A grog used in combat examples, fighting with a shortsword and round shield, who defeats the Infernal wolf Polandrus and later fights his faerie duplicate.

name: Igor Rastvan
description: An archmage of House Ex Miscellanea and high priest of Radegast who leads Roznov's covenfolk in pagan worship and human sacrifice; his cursing magic draws on Slavic traditions and pagan ceremony, and his zeal may be unhinging him via Twilight.

name: Ihwaz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Yew" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of the yew tree, associated with death, witchcraft, trees, bows and spirits of the dead.

name: Illusion of the Misplaced Castle
description: A Rego Imaginem ritual (Level 50) that moves the image of any bounded structure the size of a castle or less up to one mile from its actual position.

name: Image from the Wizard Torn
description: A Rego Imaginem spell (Level 35) with an Intellego requisite that separates the caster's image from their body so it can speak and be seen through, leaving the caster invisible and silent.

name: Imanitos Mendax
description: A vain, treacherous magus of Oculus Septentrionalis with a focus in Mentem (and Imaginem for disguises); he runs a tavern, brothel, and extortion business in Lubeck and is secretly conspiring with the pirate covenant Waddenzee.

name: Imanitosi
description: Prima of House Verditius who succumbed to Final Twilight in September 1219 while experimenting in her laboratory.

name: Immanola
aliases: Immanola, prima of House Ex Miscellanea
description: The prima of House Ex Miscellanea and oldest maga in the tribunal, over 150 years old, gifted in prophecy; blocked from the praeco position by Blackthorn and now seen as Twilight-ridden.

name: Impious Friend
