description: A Minor Story Tainted Flaw in which a minor demon poses as a friend of the character to guide him toward a tragic destiny.

name: Improved Damage
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue enhancing a natural weapon by up to +5 Damage.

name: Improved Initiative
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue increasing a natural weapon's Initiative by 3.

name: Improved Might
description: Magic Quality increasing Might, taken by several Beasts of Virtue.

name: Incantation of the Milky Eyes
description: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 30) that blinds a target, leaving the eyes milky with cataracts; heals as a Heavy Wound.

name: Incompatible Hedge Arts
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw preventing use of one Technique-Form combination.

name: Indenture
description: A proposed period of required seasons of labor after apprenticeship to remunerate the Order, similar to a guild journeyman phase.

name: Infamous Master
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character's master was a diabolist or fool, causing other magi to treat the character with contempt.

name: Infernal Blessing
description: Major or Minor Supernatural Tainted Virtue granting 60 or 120 levels of beneficial unholy effects from a demon or Infernal tradition.

name: Infernal Ghost
description: A damned human soul allowed to roam the earth under arrangement with Hell; belongs to an order but lacks the Coagulation Power.

name: Infernal Reputation
description: Reputation among demons and infernalists of a demon's perceived power in Hell, affecting summoning.

name: Infernal Traditions
description: Optional groups of like-minded infernalists defined by Methods, Powers and Favored Abilities.

name: Infiltrator
description: Minor or Major Social Interaction Virtue for a faerie that lives as a human, costing as the mimicked Social Status.

name: Ingwaz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Lord" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of peace, family and a secure home; targets buildings and household members.

name: Intangible Flesh
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: the character is immaterial and cannot physically influence the world.

name: Intricacy Points
description: Points representing complex portions of a faerie's glamour, used to raise a power's Initiative or reduce its Might cost.

name: Intuition of the Forest
description: An Intellego Herbam spell (Level 10) giving an intuitive sense of how to get along in a forest, granting +3 to nature-oriented rolls there.

name: Invisibility
description: Ability/power of cu sith and Gliocas to vanish when followed.

name: Invisible Sling of Vilano
description: A popular indirect Rego Terram (ReTe 10) spell that hurls a stone as a projectile; bypasses Magic Resistance with a successful aiming roll, inflicting +5 damage.

name: Invocation of Weariness
description: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 20) that causes the target to lose a Fatigue level, often via singsong melodies that lull the victim into drowsiness.

name: Ioanna
description: A Redcap follower of Mercere murdered in the city of Trier in 1151 AD, prompting a Quaesitorial investigation; she had earlier recorded directions to Treverorum and Rheinstein.

name: Isa
description: Elder Futhark rune "Ice" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of ice, cold and cold emotions; associated with Aquam, Ignem or Mentem.

name: Isabelle
description: A woman living at the covenant of Semita Errabunda, named in an example command of a Psychomachia maleficium.

name: Isle of Ushant
description: A flat-topped island off Brittany with vertical cliffs and treacherous reefs, on which the Tytalus Domus Magna Fudarus is built.

name: Jason
description: The leader of the Argonauts who, on Chiron's advice, brought Orpheus on the voyage to retrieve the Golden Fleece.

name: Jera
description: Elder Futhark rune "Year" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of the harvest and year-long bounty; mostly associated with Herbam.

name: Joachim of Flora
description: Charismatic Sicilian-born Cistercian abbot and prophet (d. 1200) who taught the Three Ages of the World; some Trinitarian ideas were condemned by the Fourth Lateran Council.

name: John of Salisbury
description: Twelfth-century writer (1115-1180) whose Policraticus complains of diviners at court; he crystal-gazed as a pupil.

name: Journeyman
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a trained guild craftsman who may practice his trade in town under guild supervision and work for a master for a wage.

name: Judaic Lore
description: A General Ability covering knowledge of Jewish cultural practice such as poetry, folklore, and songs.

name: Julius
description: Archmagus of House Flambeau and Ignem specialist who, with Lavinia, leads the Hermetic crusade against Iceland and kills Biorn Egilsson.

name: Juno's Spire
description: Chapter house of the Covenant of the Icy North serving as the personal demesne of Archmagus Pietro, linked to the Motherhouse by a defended Hermes Portal.

name: Kalliope filia Bibliophilus
description: Middle-aged magus, latest in an intermittent line of librarian-magi at Valnastium.

name: Karaite Magic
description: Major Hermetic Flaw requiring all magic to be designed with Holy Magic, forbidding divination, astrology, and summoning spirits, and barring acceptance of non-Karaite magic or healing.

name: Kauno
description: Elder Futhark rune "Pain" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of torches, fever and burning pain; affects fire and heat (Ignem) as well as sores and sickness.

name: Kelpie
description: Carnivorous magical creature (Might 20 Aquam) of deep fresh-water pools, a mass of tentacles that can turn into a black stallion to lure and drown victims.

name: Kenneth MacAlpin
description: King of the Scots who stood on the Stone of Destiny in 834 and conquered the Picts with the aid of House Diedne.

name: Kerguntuil
description: Diedne vassal of Branugurix (920-1007) on the Rose Coast, interested in giant lore.

name: Kintyre
description: Peninsula added to the kingdom of Man by Magnus Barelegs in 1098; rich in stone alignments.

name: Knight Banneret
description: A knight who leads other knights under his own banner. The rank can be claimed by arriving with ten liveried knights or bestowed by a liege.

name: Knight Errant
description: +1 Background Virtue: you have been knighted and may bear arms and be addressed as sir, owing no fealty or service.

name: Knights Hospitaller
aliases: Knights of the Hospital of St. John of Jerusalem
description: A military order of monk-knights holding land across Christendom whose English houses gather funds and supplies for the Levant.

name: Knights of the Green Stone
description: A group of magi who believe the romances conceal the true story of the Grail and seek clues to a great artifact.

name: Knowe
description: Faerie hills where seelie faeries live; farmers avoid planting or grazing on them.

name: Kolazonta, the Chastiser
description: A Divine angel (Might 30, Ignem) tasked to chastise the faithful for their failings, appearing as a dark cloud or man of white fire; he brought the plague upon the Israelites for rebelling against Moses.

name: Kolossos
description: Stone buried in place of an absent body, acting as an Arcane Connection anchoring the spirit; Aristeas's is a statue with a raven emerging from his mouth.

name: La
description: Prima of House Criamon and Praeco, an elderly Rego specialist once called Lucia who murdered a priest under the Black Mark and is cursed by God.

name: Laguz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Water" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of water, especially the ocean; almost always associated with Aquam.

name: Lamia
description: Former queen of Libya, cursed by Hera, now a serpent-bodied faerie who eats children and steals eyes.

name: Languedoc
description: A region of central southern France where Brother Julian wanders and preaches against the spread of the Cathar heresy.

name: Latent Magical Ability
description: A Virtue granting uncontrolled magical talent; Torven's Latent Magical Ability causes wolf packs to come to his aid in the forest.

name: Learn From Mistakes
description: Mastery ability granting experience when botching or narrowly failing the spell.

name: Legendary Artist
description: An artist whose Reputation reaches 11 and is taken by his muse into a supernatural realm, becoming an immortal being with a Might score and supernatural powers based on his Craft or Profession.

name: Leprosy, Hermetic
description: A Critical Melancholic Disease caused by Hermetic spells, a rapid hideous wasting disease with a pungent rotting smell.

name: Lesser Charm
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: a Virtue activated by a secret ritual charm.

name: Lesser Elixir
description: Minor Mystery Virtue enhancing a Longevity Ritual with extra ingredients whose Elixir Points raise the Aging Bonus; requires Hermetic Alchemy.

name: Libellus
description: The newest and one of the largest covenants in the tribunal, founded and led by Stephen Eruditus of Jerbiton; an unknown quantity in tribunal politics.

name: License of Absence
description: A Major, General Virtue for a priest relieved of some duties, giving an extra free season each year; only available to Priest Social Status.

name: Lickspitten
description: A famulus in the form of a black cat with a star of white hairs on its belly, serving a witch by hiding the taint of her Powers.

name: Lickstone
description: Small metal plate attached to the palate carrying redcap spells; Cymena's contains Seven-League Stride.

name: Ligurio
description: Vassal of Fudarus (913-1011) in the Vendée, destroyed by giants presumed sent by Kerguntuil.

name: Lilin
description: Female Tempter night spirits giving nightmares and smothering children; their offspring with men are shedim and lilin.

name: Limit of Arcane Connections
description: A Hermetic limit concerning the use of Arcane Connections; a Touch-range spell on a room does not violate it even when affecting unseen people within.

name: Limits of Magic
description: The fundamental boundaries constraining Hermetic magic; Major Breakthroughs push them, Hermetic Breakthroughs break Lesser Limits such as the Limit of Magic Resistance.

name: Limoges
description: City divided between the Cité and the commercial center around the Abbey of St. Martial.

name: Living Conditions
description: Game modifier for living in a city or town, halved to +1 in the saga seed thanks to food preservation.

name: Living Conditions Modifier
description: Aging modifier that magic can indirectly improve at +1 per 40 levels of enchantment.

name: Lombards
description: Long-bearded barbarians who ruled Italy from Pavia until 774.

name: Lord Goulis
description: Diabolist seneschal of the Scottish king who built Monksend castle, hunting souls in the Borders with his demonic familiar and demon dogs.

name: Lord of the Trees
description: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 25) that causes a tree to move its branches and bend its trunk as mentally directed; a large tree gains Initiative, Attack, and Damage scores.

name: Lotharingia
description: The middle kingdom of the divided Carolingian empire that belonged to Lothar, later reabsorbed into Germany and divided into Upper and Lower Lorraine.

name: Louis VII
description: King of France, first husband of Eleanor, father of Philip Augustus.

name: Louis of France
description: The French prince who invaded England with an army in the civil war and controlled much of southern England before being driven out by William Marshal as regent.

name: Lower Lorraine
description: The lower half of the ancient kingdom of Lotharingia, fractured into counties and duchies including the rival duchies of Brabant and Limburg, with forested uplands of the Ardennes and Eifel.

name: Lucian
description: An elder House Merinita magus of the covenant of Aegea in the Theban Tribunal, renowned for knowledge of Byzantine and ancient Greek literature and rumored initiated into story magic.

name: Luciferans
description: A misguided Infernal tradition that worships Lucifer as a kinder, benevolent God; strongest in 1220 within the Church in Germany, Austria and Bohemia.

name: Lucifuges
description: Family of Aerial Powers (Might 20), Destroyers; Psellos' heliophobic demons who hate the sun and kill by breath or touch.

name: Lungs of the Fish
description: A Muto Aquam spell (Level 20) with an Auram requisite that turns water into air as it enters the lungs, allowing the caster to breathe water.

name: Lupercalia
description: A festival held from 13 to 15 February at which all luperci of a region may try to dispel curses laid on the community, drawing on the Daimon of Revenge.

name: Lupersus
description: A Divine creature (Might 20, Animal) appearing as a noble silver-gray wolf sent by God to guard a holy hermit, provide food, and lead those in need to him; not an angel.

name: Lyonesse
description: A drowned land that once stretched from Cornwall to the Scilly Isles, Tristan's birthplace, sunk by the anger of the Fair Folk; its town was called Lyon and its remains can be seen at low tide.

name: MacBeth
description: Mormaer of Moray who killed Duncan with the aid of Pictish wizards and renegade Ex Miscellanea magi, ruled seventeen years, and was killed by Malcolm Canmore.

name: Maggots
description: Tiny Tempter demons like winged apes that eat into victims' brains causing delusions; also called astasian and commanded by Beelzebub.

name: Magi Orbi
description: Magi who began in a different House but were exiled and found refuge in House Ex Miscellanea; they retain their former House's rules but lose its privileges and secrets.

name: Magical Armillary Sphere
description: An enchanted armillary sphere that continually tracks astrological time and planetary influences, halving the Ease Factor of Astrological Duration calculations.

name: Magical Blood
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue: exposure to the Magic realm improves the character's true form, giving -1 on Aging rolls, access to Magic Lore and a minor physical advantage; sometimes called faerie blood.

name: Magical Covenfolk
description: Free Social Status Virtue for a magical being accepted as an equal by the people of its covenant.

name: Magical Memory
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue allowing a magus to reproduce magical creations without keeping laboratory texts, getting the benefit of a Lab Text from memory.

name: Magical Mount
description: A Minor General Virtue granting a mount or beast-of-burden with Cunning and a Magic Might Score up to 25 that obeys simple verbal commands.

name: Magicam
description: Learned magician Form governing magic, protection from hostile magic and magical powers; corresponds most closely to Vim.

name: Magyars
description: Nomadic Hungarian raiders of northern Italy; small enclaves remain.

name: Maintain the Demanding Spell
description: A Vim spell cited as not eligible for the Rebuttal Mastery special ability.

name: Mainz
description: Formerly the Roman city Moguntiacum, raised to an archbishopric by St. Boniface; its archbishop is Archchancellor of the Empire and primas germaniae, and its see is a Holy See with a Divine aura of 7.

name: Majarida Mountains
description: The mountains around the Wolf's Court, home to unusually bold wolf packs that include Wolves of Virtue.

name: Malcolm Canmore
description: Duncan's son raised in England who killed MacBeth with the aid of two mysterious magi and brought English influence to Scotland.

name: Manannan Mac Lir
description: Irish faerie sovereign and wizard-king, once god of Irish sailors and the Isle of Man; a shapeshifter with Faerie Might 55.

name: Mandrake
description: Magic Thing root with Might 5 whose deadly scream kills those who hear it; may be Enriched to grant Premonitions or bonded as a homunculus familiar.

name: Mannaz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Man" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of mankind and cooperation; usually linked to Corpus and used to target persons with other runes.

name: Manufactured Ignorance
description: A Minor Story Tainted Flaw in which a group of minor demons sustains the tainted character's delusion by arranging supporting fortunate occurrences.

name: Marco
description: A disreputable Redcap, frequently described as a liar and charlatan, who reports many strange tales of covenants.

name: Marcus Navicularius
description: A Follower of Verditius (age 58) and the foremost shipwright in Lübeck, a master of Terram who enchants extremely large items such as ships for sale to other covenants.

name: Maria
description: A young woman near Mount Etna who has the Visions Flaw, feeling an empathy for fire and able to predict the volcano's eruptions through her dreams.

name: Marius of Tremere
description: A magus of House Tremere whose version of Ball of Abysmal Flame causes the ball to make a loud bang on impact; his magical sigil is a gaudiness in his spells.

name: Mars
description: The Roman war deity; the Resting Place of Mars is speculated to be the sleeping place of such a war god.

name: Mass Healing
description: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

name: Master of (Form)
description: Spirit power duplicating non-Ritual Muto or Perdo spells of a Form at a Might cost, e.g. Master of Water, Master of Earth, Master of Plants.

name: Memory of the Distant Dream
description: A Creo Mentem spell (Level 20) that inserts a full false memory into a person's mind, revealed as false on a successful Intelligence roll; the memory vanishes when the duration expires.

name: Mendalus
description: A hierophant of the Huntress who in 1129 proclaimed at the Grand Tribunal that the Order should follow Merinita's true path; crazed by Twilight and believing himself the messiah, he was slain by fellow hierophants via Wizard's War.

name: Mentored by Demons
description: A Minor General Tainted Virtue letting a character learn Abilities faster than possible with human teachers, though demons only teach what suits their plans.

name: Mercuralia
description: Festival of Mercury on May 15th, when the Priest sprinkles enchanted water on the Congregation's hands.

name: Merry Devils
description: Vessels of Iniquity who encourage young men to seek pleasure regardless of consequences, using intoxicants and illusions.

name: Miklos filius Kosma
description: Faerie-blooded young Jerbiton magus at Journeys End, a musician and enchanted tailor married to Lyndsay.

name: Milo
description: Second apprentice of Verditius who combined Boethius's philosophy with Germanic runes to invent Verditius Runes and discovered Hephaestus's torture chair at Ravenna.

name: Mind of the Beast
description: A Muto Mentem spell (Level 30) with an Animal requisite that turns the target's mind into that of an animal of the caster's choice, with the victim acting like that animal.

name: Minerva
description: A pagan goddess whose image in high relief is carved into rock just south of Chester and is said to continue to watch over the city.

name: Miniature
description: A Flaw or Inferiority named among the traits of magical animals or dragons in this text.

name: Ministeriales
description: Unfree German knights who served in exchange for upkeep and are being absorbed into the hereditary knightly class.

name: Minotaur
description: Immortal minotaur arena gladiator (Magic Might 10) lairing beneath the ruined amphitheater of the temple town.

name: Miracles
description: The direct intervention of God in the world, which can do anything, cannot fail, and cannot be resisted by any other power including creature Magic Resistance.

name: Miraculous Effects
description: Limited but reliable supernatural effects produced by holy characters by combining a Method and a Power, rolled against a target level.

name: Missing Ear
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character cannot accurately locate the direction of sounds, suffering a penalty to hearing rolls.

name: Moles Magna
description: Vassal of Oleron (1136-1182) built within a dam on the edge of the Morvan, destroyed when the dam burst.

name: Monastic Vows (Hermetic)
description: Major Hermetic Flaw: vows of poverty, chastity and obedience; the magus cannot own vis, possesses only functional magic devices, and may be barred from binding a familiar. All Neriusians take it.

name: Monstrous Blood
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character's essential nature has been changed through exposure to the Magic realm, giving her true form unfortunate supernatural properties and a visible deformity, while granting a -1 bonus to Aging rolls.

name: Mont Joux
description: The tallest summit in Europe, called Mons Iovis by the Romans after Jupiter Pennius; site of the Covenant Where Journeys End (later known as Mont Blanc).

name: Montmartre
description: Hill north of Paris named for the martyrdom of St. Denis, formerly Mons Mercurius.

name: Motherhouse of the Covenant of the Icy North
description: The Bavarian seat of the Covenant of the Icy North, effectively a Guernicus house covenant of Quaesitores who manage the Bavarian Common and host the Tribunal and the Midsummer Fair.

name: Mount Olympus
description: The mountain home of the Greek gods from which Hephaestus was twice cast out; also the location of an all-Verditius covenant and a Forge of Hephaestus.

name: Mount Pilatus
description: A mountain in the Alps where climbing can generate terrible storms, cited as an example of a Site of Weakness Hook.

name: Mount Sinai
description: Holy site with high Dominion (5-10) and terrestrial regiones.

name: Muhammad
description: Prophet of Islam born at Mecca c. 570, recipient of the Qur'an; the most revered holy forbear with Divine Might 100.

name: Muirgheal
description: A Quaesitor who led the Order's investigation into the Normandy restless-dead crisis and invited the Gifted Donatores to join the Order en masse.

name: Muqta
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for an important emir entrusted with an iqta', a feudal-like fief, following the Landed Noble rules.

name: Mutantum Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue for descendants of the Mutantes allowing Boosted, Harnessed and Tethered spells and items.

name: Mystic Fraternity of Samos
description: A Pythagorean Mystery Cult organized into degrees that teach planetary, geometric and theurgic Virtues; its Inner Order members run publicly known Schools.

name: Mythic Alchemists
description: Alternate learned tradition that creates potions, powders and pastilles rather than charms.

name: Mythic Alchemy
description: Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability allowing magical transmutation of substances, preparing superior craft materials and extracting vis.

name: Naples
description: A city whose catacombs harbored the necromancer Guorna the Fetid and her tradition, which Tytalus and Tremere destroyed.

name: Native Language
description: Ability used by young characters, e.g. in example childhoods and sample characters.

name: Natural Leader
description: A Minor General Virtue giving a +3 bonus to social situations where the dominant character takes the lead, partly overcoming the social penalty of The Gift.

name: Naudiz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Need" used as a vitkir Art. Very negative rune of hardship and need; can delay or bind other rune effects.

name: Negative Reaction
description: Minor Social Interaction Flaw giving -3 on all social rolls.

name: Neo-Mercurians
description: Mystery cult seeking to reconstruct authentic Mercurian magic within Hermetic theory, restoring ancient temples.

name: Neptune's Wrath
description: A Rego Aquam Ritual spell (Level 40) that creates a gigantic wave up to a mile wide capable of capsizing ships and devastating coastlines.

name: Nero
description: Roman emperor in whose last years Apollonius travelled through Rome and Iberia.

name: Nibelungenlied
description: The great epic poem of the tragic fate of the Burgundian people, immortalizing Siegfried, Kriemhild, Gunther, and Hagen, treated as true history in Mythic Germany.

name: Nicola de Hay
description: The elderly hereditary constable of Lincoln castle and sheriff of the shire who held the castle through a siege and is locked in a conflict with the earl of Salisbury over her position.

name: Nigrasaxa
description: A relatively new, large covenant of two shining black towers, founded by Maximianus of Bonisagus to break the cycle of invalid tribunals.

name: Nitibus
description: A shedeh (Tempter) and personal corrupter with two faces, who encourages his victim's habit of criticism and panders to his vanity.

name: No Hands
description: A Major General Flaw in which the character has no hands; magi take a -5 penalty to all Casting Scores, offset by the Subtle Magic Virtue or Still Casting.

name: Noah
description: Patriarch whose Ark carried two pious Nephilim.

name: Noble Reputation
description: A fourth style of Reputation alongside Local, Hermetic, and Ecclesiastic, allowing members of the landed class to know about each other.

name: Non-Lethal Combat
description: Optional replacement for ArM5 scuffling rules using Bruises instead of Fatigue loss.

name: Northumbria
description: Saxon kingdom, successor to Bernicia, with its capital at Bamburgh.

name: Notary
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a legal official employed by lords or towns who draws up contracts, witnesses charters, and affixes a seal.

name: Numerologist's Book
description: Enchanted book attuned to Numerological magic, lesser (+4) or greater (+8), adding a book bonus to Numerology, Rotes, Geometry and Architecture.

name: Obligation
description: Flaw appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Ogham
description: Pictish script used by gruagachan to write Lab Texts and initiation scripts on stone or wood.

name: Order of Miscellany
description: Pralix's group of wizards, spared from war and admitted as House Ex Miscellanea.

name: Order of Suleiman
description: A legendary organization of Islamic magi, rivals in power to the Order of Hermes, said to be the association of the non-Hermetic sahirs with close ties to Levantine rulers.

name: Ordo Vagorum
description: The 'Order of Vagrants', a mock religious order of wandering clerks (vagantes) that is an Infernal societas, with chapters in Paris, Austria and northern Italy.

name: Orkney Islands
description: Northern islands owned by Norway, rich in standing stones; once called the Orcades, Isles of the Dead.

name: Ostia
description: Cardinal-bishop town near Rome.

name: Othila
description: Elder Futhark rune "Inheritance" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of inherited property such as lands and heirlooms; most often tied to Terram.

name: Pact of Crun Clach
description: Pact of 1189 in which Scottish magi swore not to aid kings or invaders, regulating raids and theft.

name: Pallas
description: A maga whose death left her lover, a nymph of unmatched beauty, in inconsolable mourning, leaving a covenant tower unused for sixty years.

name: Panther of Virtue
description: A magical panther whose lure causes mysterious disappearances of animals and can ensnare incautious investigators.

name: Parish
description: Basic unit beneath deaneries where a priest conducts Mass; virtually every covenant lies in one.

name: Parting the Waves
description: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 30) that parts a body of water, revealing a dry path five paces wide along the bottom.

name: Pass the Unyielding Portal
description: A Muto Herbam spell (Level 5) that makes the wood of a door pliable, allowing the magus to bend it open regardless of most locks or bars.

name: Passion's Lost Feeling
description: A spell that renders the target unable to feel any emotion, leaving them listless and without motivation.

name: Past of Another
description: A Muto Mentem ritual (Level 35) that completely rewrites the target's memories so they cannot remember their actual life until the effect is dispelled or expires.

name: Pendule
description: A legendary Provençal hedge wizard who evaded the Founder Flambeau, took four Hermetic followers (two from House Merinita), taught illusion Mysteries, and died in 854 AD.

name: Pentecost
description: Feast 49 days after Easter with feasting, dancing and horse racing, often followed by a week of holidays.

name: Perceive the Magical Scent
description: Hermetic spell (InVi 20) in a Roman Tribunal magus vocation template.

name: Perfectus
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for one of the leaders of the Cathar heretics in southern France, sworn to preaching and ascetic abstinence.

name: Perpetuity
description: A Major Illusion Mystery of House Merinita granting three potentially-permanent spell durations (Might, Aura, Hidden); Merinitae usually gain the Unnatural Magic Flaw.

name: Persephone
description: The queen of the Greek Underworld who, with Hades, was moved by Orpheus's song; the sirens felt guilt at failing to save her from Hades.

name: Perseus
description: Fifth rank, senior Legion member of a Tribunal, carries a silver sickle and learns spirit familiars.

name: Personal Faerie Powers
description: Virtue appearing in faerie statistics in this text (Personal Faerie Powers).

name: Personality Flaw
description: Category of Flaw that can be connected to a story's hook, such as a widow appealing to a Compassionate character.

name: Perth
description: Elder Futhark rune "Cup" used as a vitkir Art. Mysterious rune of fate, chance and secrets; tied to Vim, it targets vis and supernatural effects.

name: Peter Abélard
description: Controversial philosopher and theologian who tutored and secretly wed Héloïse, was castrated, and later became a monk.

name: Phantasmal Animal
description: A Creo Imaginem spell (Level 20) that creates an image of any animal up to pony size that moves under mental command and makes appropriate noises and smells, but has no effect on touch.

name: Philomena filia Rafe
description: A swallow, sister-in-law of Tereus, who claimed in an interview recorded at Durenmar that Tereus' spire holds records of prayers.

name: Phylactery of the Cautious Maga
description: An invested device, a hollow wooden box with a silver lid holding an Arcane Connection to a safe place, that transports its wearer to safety.

name: Physician of Salerno
description: A Minor General Virtue indicating attendance at the famed School of Salerno, granting a Reputation, unique medical procedures like anesthetics, and 50 experience points.

name: Piedmont
description: Region in the Roman Tribunal where Harco lies.

name: Piercing Shaft of Wood
description: A Muto Herbam spell (Level 10) with a Rego requisite that turns a piece of wood into a barbed shaft that flies at a target and cannot miss but is resisted.

name: Piercing the Magical Veil
description: Spell (ArM5 p.158) allowing characters to see into and pass between regio levels.

name: Pilgrimage
description: Journey to a holy site; major and minor pilgrimages have Target Levels 30 and 18 and can grant Virtues or remove Flaws.

name: Pisa
description: A north Italian city of famed merchants, favored by the Holy Roman Emperor, which acts as the port for landlocked Florence.

name: Pixies
description: Minor faeries of Somerset, jovial and rarely malicious; called pisgies in Cornwall and Devon.

name: Plagued by a Demon
description: Story Flaw whose bearer is targeted by a personal demon such as Guazzo, Nitibus or Bordelon.

name: Poland
description: Area with German minorities where Hounds of God are found.

name: Pompeii
description: The Roman city where the high priest Plentarch gathered 38 Mercurians to teach them the ritual of concerted communion with their gods.

name: Poor Sisters
description: Community of women following Francis' ideals under Clare at Saint Damian, living in poverty without total enclosure.

name: Pope Innocent II
description: Pope under whom the Second Lateran Council of 1139 confirmed the ban on clerical marriage.

name: Portage
description: Faerie Power of instant travel via faerie trods, including across regio boundaries and into the Faerie Realm.

name: Portage of the Eagles
description: Spell or effect listed in the contents of Transforming Mythic Europe.

name: Portunes, Spirit of Safe Harbor
description: A Daimon spirit (Magic Might 25, Auram) charged with ports and harbors, keys and locks, worshipped as a god in Rome; summoned by throwing keys into a fire.

name: Postestas
description: Summer Tremere covenant founded 870, a fortress on Italy's east coast overlooking the Adriatic, secretly plotting to seize the Roman Tribunal for House Tremere.

name: Powerful Relic
description: A Major General Virtue granting ownership of an unusually powerful relic with a True Faith score of 3 and one agreed power.

name: Południca
description: A faerie (Might 10, Auram) appearing as a maiden, crone, or girl with a scythe who appears at noon on hot days, asking farmhands difficult questions and inflicting heatstroke if they fail to answer.

name: Prague
description: Bohemia's principal settlement, straddling the River Vltava, with Prague Castle, the Basilicas of St. George and St. Vitus, and a large slave market controlled by the Knights of the Sword.

name: Premonstratensians
description: Order founded by Saint Norbert with 12 disciples, following the Rule of Augustine; converted the Wends and admits only monks since 1198.

name: Priamitus
description: Son of Mercere who sought out hedge wizards of the Cult of Mercury and worked to reconstruct the Roman cult, bringing the Mercurians into House Flambeau.

name: Pripet Maior
description: A New Slavonic Tribunal covenant settled in 1052 by Bjornaer magi formerly of Grand Silesia; allied with Crintera.

name: Proctor
description: Ruthless Presiding Quaesitor of Normandy and leader of Confluensis, distrustful of Tytalus; his talisman is a fool's cap bell.

name: Profaning the Holy
description: Mystical abuse of a holy object to taint it and produce Infernal vis, costing a Confidence Point.

name: Profession (Merchant)
description: A Profession Ability in which traders and factors are skilled, eligible for Affinity, Cautious, Puissant, and other modifiers.

name: Profession: Boating
description: A Profession Ability for navigating rivers; needed (Ease Factor 9) to safely pass the treacherous Loreley stretch of the Rhine.

name: Prudentum
description: A Jerbiton magus and former leader of Oculus Septentrionalis who was slain in Wizard's War by Urgen of Bjornaer in 1179.

name: Puissant Awareness
description: A Virtue or Magic Quality named among the traits of magical animals or dragons in this text.

name: Puissant Stealth
description: Virtue granted by a cowl made from the Enriched hide of a Black Dog.

name: Pukis, Dragon of the Hearth
description: A lesser Daimon (Magic Might 10, Ignem) first summoned by Baltic wizards, taking the form of a small fire dragon that dwells in a hearth, leaving gifts but causing mischief if mistreated.

name: Purgatory of Saint Patrick
description: Irish pilgrimage site in the Hibernian Tribunal: a cave under an island in a lake, said to be a gate to Purgatory opened by Saint Patrick, leading onward to the Earthly Paradise or Hell.

name: Queen of Winter
description: A powerful supernatural being who holds the Baltic Sea in ice each winter; she is propitiated by the ritual spell Appease the Queen of Winter and opposed by the sun-god Svantovit.

name: Quinotaur
description: Supernatural creature with the fore parts of a bull and the hind of a great fish, a Magic creature of the Atlantic said to be ancestor of the Merovingians.

name: Qur'an
description: Muslim holy book compiled from revelations to Muhammad; a Summa of Theology: Islam and can be invoked for baraka.

name: Radhanites
description: Jewish merchants; the Radhanite merchant template serves the Muqta' of Baghdad.

name: Raido
description: Elder Futhark rune "Riding" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of riding, journeys and travel, possibly invoking Thor; targets carts, ships, wheels and harnesses.

name: Ramadan
description: Islamic month of fasting during which Infernal auras are reduced by two after the Night of Destiny.

name: Raphael
description: Best loved of angels ('God has healed'), Regent of the Sun, head of the guardian angels and of the Cherubim Choir, who protects humanity and heals the sick.

name: Ravenna
description: Canal city praised for the purity of its air.

name: Realm-Aligned Spells
description: Spells invented, as a Minor Breakthrough, to be 'flavored' to the Magic, Faerie or Infernal realm so they are unaffected by and botch less in that realm's aura.

name: Red Knight
description: Bringer of Requested Inundations: a demon (Lord of the Avengers of Evil, Infernal Might 30) who drowns victims and destroyed Ys and Lyonesse, but may only harm people after a treacherous mortal grants permission.

name: Reduced Power
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw subtracting 5 intricacy points from a faerie's powers.

name: Refining
description: Elementalist Technique taking a season of lab-like work to purify or break down a target, often yielding raw vis.

name: Reforging Enchanted Items
description: A Minor House Mystery of Verditius allowing a magus to repair, smelt, and reforge enchanted items to enhance their magical potential or extract vis.

name: Regin
description: An evil-hearted dwarf who coveted the magic ring of the Nibelungs and under whom Wayland apprenticed; played a part in the life of Siegfried.

name: Regular
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character lives according to a strict religious rule and must spend one free season on worship; suitable for monks and canons.

name: Rellantali
description: Autumn covenant founded 838 on the island of Asinara, nearly destroyed by Verdi; its magi now live in Venice and secretly run the city's thieves.

name: Remus
description: Example Quaesitor whose intentions to visit a covenant are the subject of a divination example.

name: Repel the Wooden Shafts
description: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 10) that deflects a single blow of any wooden weapon up to the size of a two-handed club, making the attack automatically miss.

name: Repellent
description: A Major General Tainted Flaw in which the character has a physical characteristic of his demonic creator, causing -6 to rolls requiring trust but granting a minor advantage.

name: Requisite
description: An additional Art required to cast certain spells, demanding greater knowledge of the caster and limiting the Arts usable; includes casting requisites.

name: Resist Temptation
description: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

name: Restoration of the Defiled Body
description: A Corpus spell that can remove any Flaws resulting from a disease, with a higher guideline needed to negate Flaws caused by life-saving surgery.

name: Revealed Flaws of Mortal Flesh
description: An Intellego Corpus spell (Level 10) that finds any medical defects in a person or being touched, more specific than Physician's Eye.

name: Ricardus Caespuus
description: A reclusive Follower of Bonisagus at Durenmar with a glass-walled laboratory specialized in Herbam, who cultivates many types of vis from exotic plants.

name: Righi
description: Alpine mountain where the magi of Journeys End wish to see giants return.

name: Ring of Warding Against Spirits
description: A Rego Mentem spell creating a ring that only ghosts and spirits with Magic Might higher than the spell's level can enter.

name: Rock of Viscid Clay
description: A Muto Terram spell that softens rock so it can be dug out, molded, and manipulated like hard river clay.

name: Rollo
description: Viking chieftain interred in Rouen Cathedral; distant relative of Haland and Harivald.

name: Romulus
description: Founder of Rome, suckled by a she-wolf, who slew his twin Remus.

name: Rosh Beth Din
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for the head who presides at the Beth Din rabbinic court, requiring high Hebrew, Rabbinic Law, and Theology: Judaism.

name: Rowan Gild
description: A secretive Rhine political gild formed by Diedne magi who split from the Hawthorn Gild, later joined by Waldherz Bonisagus; its members were exiled and largely destroyed in the Schism War.

name: Rumael
description: Demon posing as Neptune, creator and destroyer of Atlantis; Lord of the False Gods, patron of a kingdom that no longer exists; Infernal Might 40.

name: Saint Dominic
description: Founder of the Order of Preachers (Dominicans), a trained scholastic from the cathedral school of Palencia preaching against heresy in Lombardy; historically dies 6 August 1221.

name: Saint Maurice
description: Christian soldier martyred in 302 for refusing to worship Roman gods; his ring is a powerful relic.

name: Saint Odilo
description: The Abbot at Cluny who created the Feast of All Soul's Day and promoted the Truce of God; patron saint of souls in Purgatory who appeared to Donatores in holy orders.

name: Saint Patrick
description: Saint who banished the peist and all serpents from Ireland and was shown the entrance to Purgatory by Christ.

name: Salutem
description: Learned magician Form governing health of humans, animals and plants; broader yet narrower than Corpus.

name: Salzburg
description: City listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Samson
description: Hero of the Book of Judges, cited as an example of the hero role.

name: Samuil
description: Samuil, Angelic Guide, a Cherub who with Raguel transported Enoch through the Seven Heavens and now delivers visions to saints and prophets.

name: Sanctuary
description: The church, churchyard and cemetery are places where fugitives may shelter for up to 40 days.

name: Sansaron
description: Reclusive covenant founded 951 in carved passages under the ruins of Carthage, studying ancient Carthaginian magic and selling items to mundanes of Tunis.

name: Savoy
description: Region with many ruined Hermetic settlements.

name: Schools of Sebastian
description: A catch-all family of minor Flambeau combat schools that conjure harmful objects or substances using Forms other than Ignem; named for the hedge-wizard magus Sebastian.

name: Schwarzburg
description: A Rhine covenant in the Swabian Jura (857-885) that warred with neighboring Arae Flaviae, causing the Tribunal to abolish both covenants.

name: Scribes' Guild
description: The guild responsible for producing parchment for books, referenced in the seasonal production chart.

name: Seanachaidh
description: Clan storyteller and historian office, held by Lachlan Mac Calum.

name: Secundus
description: Fifth degree of the Fraternity of Samos, rumored to teach Inscription on the Soul, Hermetic Theurgy or Theurgic Spirit Familiar.

name: Seirenes
description: A tradition of female magae in House Ex Miscellanea who practice lyrical Siren Song magic taught to their founder by the sirens of legend.

name: Selena Tibicena
description: A necromancer maga of Treverorum whose Trier sanctum, hidden beneath a graveyard, contained skeletons; her grave conceals a stairway to her former sanctum.

name: Semitae
description: A covenant of traveling magi led by a Criamon, recorded at the 1151 tribunal; possibly the same wandering group recorded in Cad Gadu's records since the tribunal's founding.

name: Sense of Doom
description: Flaw appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Sensory Magic
description: A Hermetic Mystery, described in Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults, whose Initiation lets a magus with Feral Scent double the area of effect of spells with a Scent Target.

name: Serica
description: A distant eastern land the Romans called the source of the finest silks and spices, from which Europe imports luxuries by paying tons of silver through Arabic intermediaries.

name: Shadow Flambeau
description: Group purged within House Flambeau, during which the Rowan Sisterhood was founded.

name: Shamash
description: A Free Social Status Virtue for the servant of the synagogue responsible for its well-being, cleanliness, and announcements, requiring the Educated (Hebrew) Virtue.

name: She-Wolf
aliases: Aspect of the Daimon of Vengeance
description: Ancient Magic spirit, an Aspect of the Daimon of revenge, who dwells at the Wolf's Court and grants vengeance to petitioners by turning them into wolves.

name: Shift Human Shapes
description: Personal power letting the character change its appearance to any other human configuration, but not replicate a specific person.

name: Shinty
description: Highland stick-and-ball game played with the caman to the first goal; the Prince and Crun Clach play for the hill.

name: Sihr
description: The Major Non-Hermetic Virtue (an Accelerated Ability) of the sahirs used to summon jinn and empower bargains that bind them to service.

name: Simon Magus
description: Arch-heresiarch magician, father of Gnosticism, who fell from the air in Rome; claimed ancestor of the Philosophers of Rome.

name: Simony
description: Buying or selling spiritual things such as sacraments or offices.

name: Simprim of Guernicus
description: The mid-twelfth-century House Guernicus magus who started the Transitionalist movement seeking greater legal powers for the Quaesitores.

name: Sir Giles, a Ghostly Knight
description: A magical ghost (Magic Might 16, Mentem) of a prideful knight in black mail who haunts his former lands, able to materialize, turn invisible, and ride a phantom black destrier.

name: Sirens
description: Powerful magical creatures whose magical song lured sailors to drown; they taught Thelxiope their magic and turned to stone after Orpheus defeated them.

name: Sirocco filia Andru
description: Andru's filia, coordinating House Jerbiton's push into Islamic North Africa and investigating the fate of a lost covenant near Tunis.

name: Sluagh
description: Collective host of hundreds or thousands of undead spirits haunting the Highlands that can drive humans insane or frighten them to death.

name: Sol Invicti
description: A holy societas descended from a Roman monotheistic sun cult worshipping Deus Sol Invictus; its Gifted members joined House Jerbiton and practice holy magic in 1220.

name: Somerset
description: English county ('Land of Summer') with no winter faeries; contains the Mendip Hills.

name: Sourdine filia Bronwyn
aliases: Lord Roland of the Val Gardenia
description: House Jerbiton's finest spy, Gently Gifted and a silent caster, one of the Primus's closest confidants who can appear as Lord Roland of the Val Gardenia.

name: Sowilo
description: Elder Futhark rune "Sun" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of light and the sun, good over evil; part of Ignem, and can target the Divine as a subset of Vim.

name: Spain
description: Land where Moorish nobles fight bulls from horseback.

name: Spasms of the Uncontrolled Hand
description: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 5) that makes one of the target's hands spasm, causing them to drop whatever is held.

name: Speak German
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Species
description: The sensory emanations of objects manipulated by Imaginem magic; transforming species lets sounds be seen and changing species bouncing off a mirror changes mirror images.

name: Spell Binding
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue for binding spells into containers where a spirit is compelled to sustain the spell indefinitely.

name: Spirit
description: Minor spirits of Mythic Europe summoned by Invoke spells to cast spells as powers.

name: Spring Covenant
description: A young covenant in its first season; Atsingani is a small Spring covenant.

name: Sprite
description: Tiny humanoid courtly faeries with bows used as envoys and saboteurs, attacking in swarms.

name: Squire
description: Middle degree of the Knights of the Green Stone, which teaches Vulgar Alchemy, Hermetic Numerology and Consummate Talisman.

name: St. Boniface
description: An 8th-century missionary saint who miraculously felled the Donar Oak, fragmenting the primeval forest, and raised Mainz to an archbishopric, becoming its first archbishop.

name: St. Columba
description: Irish monk who came to Iona in 565 and baptized the Pictish king Brude Mac Maelchon.

name: St. Francis of Assisi
description: Founder of the Franciscan order of friars (the followers of St. Francis), founded in Italy in 1209; he visited Acre during the Crusades before departing for Venice in 1220.

name: St. Gildas
description: A saint and monk at Glastonbury Abbey who reconciled King Arthur with his brother Hueil, a king in Scotland who fought against Arthur.

name: St. Hubert
aliases: Our Lady of Haut healing saints
description: Saints petitioned at Our Lady of Haut: St. Mamertus, St. Livertin, St. Eugenia, St. Leobinus, St. Méen, St. Hubert, St. Houarniaule.

name: St. Vincent
description: Archmage follower of Criamon who seeks the Enigma through violent magic and is a fine certámen practitioner.

name: Stench of the Twenty Corpses
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 10) that creates a horrible stench of rotting corpses, penalizing and potentially incapacitating those nearby.

name: Stigmata
description: Intricate skin markings of Criamon magi representing spiritual development and progress toward enlightenment; they appear and migrate as Enigmatic Wisdom grows and cannot be removed by magic.

name: Stir the Slumbering Tree
description: A Muto Herbam spell (Level 25) with a Mentem requisite that raises a tree to human-like consciousness, able to see, hear, and rearrange its branches.

name: Stoorworm
description: A poisonous water serpent as long as a ship with poison breath; Magic Might 42.

name: Storytelling
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Stouritus
description: The current Primus of House Verditius and member of the covenant of Ingasia in the Theban Tribunal, who does not live at the domus magna Verdi.

name: Strathnavar
description: Remote region where the last Highland giants live; Navar River.

name: Strong Faith
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue granting a +2 to social rolls with faeries and Common Sense in faerie-related situations.

name: Student of Faerie
description: A Virtue representing study of faeries; very common among Faerie Doctors.

name: Styria
description: Region listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Subterfuge
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Succurro
description: Learned magician Technique ('I aid') enhancing pre-existing aspects of a target; closest to Hermetic Creo but cannot create from nothing.

name: Sufis
description: Holy tradition of Muslim mystics who gather in tariqas to seek God through communal dhikr and sama' meditation, led by a shaykh.

name: Summoning Circle
description: A laboratory Feature: an elaborate pentagram marked on the floor into which things are summoned, providing Experimentation, Spells, Creo, Rego, Animal, and Vim Specializations.

name: Supernatural Agility
description: Personal power allowing minor supernatural feats with the Athletics Pretense.

name: Suppressed Gift
description: A Major Hermetic Story Flaw in which the character has The Gift but cannot access its power, temporarily unable to perform Hermetic magic, improve Arts, or use Parma Magica.

name: Surgical Empiricus
description: A Minor Social Status Flaw for a chirurgeon trained in only a single aspect of Chirurgy, granting the usual +1 to that surgery but halving Chirurgy for any other application.

name: Syagrius
description: Roman king from whom Clovis took the Oriflamme at Soissons.

name: Sympathetic magic
description: Magic using connections and multipliers; Euclid's postulates provide it via Geometry.

name: Synthemata Magic
description: A Mystery whose practitioners, knowing a magus's secret name, gain an advantage when casting spells against him.

name: Tainted Treasure
description: A Minor General Tainted Virtue: the character has inherited or acquired vast cursed treasure that brings harm and only allows itself to be spent sinfully.

name: Tales of the Ashes
description: An Intellego Ignem spell (Level 5) that lets the caster see what touched ashes originally were and how and when the object was burned.

name: Talmud
description: Book of interpretations of Halakha and cultural wisdom; a Summa on Judaic Lore, Theology: Judaism and Rabbinic Law.

name: Tarlan the Wolf
description: A faerie wolf (Might 20, Animal) that exists to hunt people, marking them as quarry and harrying them to exhaustion; he cannot enter holy ground and never hunts children or the Gifted.

name: Tarnished Aura
description: An Infernal aura bearing a resonance for a particular sin, represented as a sinful Personality Trait affecting all within it.

name: Tartaran Regiones
description: Infernal regio reflecting the torment of Hell, filled with fuel-less hellfire whose damage increases with the victim's sinful traits.

name: Templar Prestige
description: A Minor General Virtue: a member of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon who enjoys great respect among fellow brothers, starting with a Reputation of level 4 within the Templars.

name: Temple of Solomon
description: Site on Temple Mount granted to the first Templars, source of their name.

name: Tethered Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus pass control of non-Ritual spells to others or tether them to objects, at the cost that all his spells become Arcane Connections to him.

name: The Annals of Mercury
description: Book recording the temple's history, ending 'We thought that we would go on forever.'

name: The Brocken
description: The highest peak of the Harz and one of Germany's most potent supernatural sites, topped by the Witches' Altar and a focus of Walpurgis Night witchcraft, with a Faerie aura.

name: The Conquest
description: The Norman Conquest of England. It shaped English nobility, reduced women's rights and led to the counties palatine and the marcher lords.

name: The Cult of Orpheus
description: A Mystery-Cult-like tradition of magi (magoi) descended from worshippers of Orpheus and Hermes, who practice emotionally-connected magic and revere the legend of Orpheus.

name: The Eastern Marches
description: The wild northeastern reaches of Germany between the Elbe and Oder, roamed by werewolves, witches, and giants, where pagan Slavic beliefs linger; claimed by the Rhine Tribunal.

name: The First Furrow Guides the Second
aliases: The Principal Aide to the Forger's Art
description: A Creo Imaginem 25 spell with Intellego requisite that lays a book page's image over a blank sheet so a scribe can trace it, creating identical copies and avoiding the scribing penalty.

name: The Forgiving Earth
description: A Rego Terram spell that loosens earth in a 15-by-15-pace area to a depth of one foot, making packed dirt as loose as plowed ground.

name: The Gentle Beast
description: A Rego Animal spell (Level 25) that calms an animal, making it nearly fearless and tolerant of being ridden or handled.

name: The Great Rot
description: A Perdo Herbam spell (Level 25) that rots and destroys a large amount of dead wood, up to that found in a wooden house or small inn.

name: The Greater Dream Grimoire
description: Minor Mystery Virtue requiring Dream Magic that teaches how to enter another's dream physically and extract real items from dream into the waking world.

name: The Harz Mountains
description: A desolate fifty-mile granite mountain range in northern Germany with gloomy forests, caves, and dwarflike folk; home to many supernatural sites.

name: The Huntress in the Wood
aliases: Esoteric Mystery Cult of the Huntress in the Wood
description: A secret society in the Order comprised mainly of followers of Bjornaer dedicated to preserving primal nature-oriented magic; unknowingly a pawn of Fenistal, guided toward seizing the Elder Gild and Irencillia.

name: The Instant Harvest
description: Spell or effect listed in the contents of Transforming Mythic Europe.

name: The Limit of Aging
description: A lesser limit of Hermetic magic: it cannot halt or reverse natural aging or remove Decrepitude, only slow it.

name: The Limit of Energy
description: A lesser limit of Hermetic magic: it cannot restore physical energy (Fatigue levels) or Confidence.

name: The Limit of Vis
description: A lesser limit of Hermetic magic: it cannot change the Art to which raw vis is attuned.

name: The Lotharingians
description: A faction of northwestern Rhine covenants seeking to secede from the Rhine Tribunal to deal more freely with mundanes, forming the proposed Lotharingian Tribunal.

name: The Lyceum
description: A Hermetic societas of about eight rationalist magi led by Venatus Trianomae, named after Aristotle's school; they promote the New Aristotle and the seven liberal arts and reject the empiricist Collegium.

name: The Miner's Keen Eye
description: An Intellego Terram spell that lets the caster see a specified type of mineral through up to 3 paces of intervening material.

name: The Mobile Infantry
description: ReCo 50 spell transporting 100 men up to seven leagues; its caster was executed in a Wizard's March.

name: The Nemthengacha
description: A sect of Ex Miscellanea magi found among Celtic and Scandinavian sorcerers who use the Embitterment power to create animosity and turn people against allies.

name: The Offices
description: Canonical hour of the Divine Office: First service of the day at midnight, the monks roused by the sacristan's bell.

name: The Path of Seeming
description: A Criamon path drawing on the insight that the Enigma's secrets are hidden in the distracting details of the world, searching for weak points in the circle of time.

name: The Path of the Body
description: A Criamon path focusing on the human form as a microcosm of the universe, with stations including the Perfect Tool, Spiritual Nourishment, Perfect Movement, the Microcosm, and Corporeal Repose.

name: The Rhinefalls
description: The greatest waterfalls in Europe near the southeastern edge of the Black Forest, with a central rocky island holding a Magic aura and a regio leading to the Rhine spirit's realm.

name: The Scrying Pool
description: InIm 20 Mercurian ritual for seeing a target via the Scrying Office pool.

name: The Sphinx
description: A legendary monument near the Pyramids in Egypt studied by magi who erected an open-desert laboratory beside it.

name: The Tempest
description: Final battle of the Schism War in 1012 destroying Branugurix.

name: The Treacherous Spear
description: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 25) that animates a wooden or wooden-hafted melee weapon in someone else's hand, making it attack its holder until the wielder dies or the weapon is destroyed.

name: The Unimpeded Traveler
description: Power of Boars of Virtue letting them run at full speed over any terrain.

name: The Unseen Porter
description: A Rego Terram spell like Unseen Arm that can carry large inanimate objects with the strength of a very strong person.

name: The Wealth of Nations
description: Rumael's power summoning up to 40 pounds of gold from wherever its absence causes most trouble.

name: The Wizard's Mount
description: A Creo Animal spell (Level 35) that creates a horse normal in every way except that it is not disturbed by The Gift.

name: Third Lateran Council
description: 1179 council decreeing bishop candidates be at least thirty, legitimate and worthy.

name: Thomas Verus
description: Redcap of House Mercere who migrated to Loch Leglean and wrote a letter describing it.

name: Thor
description: God to whom a tree was once sacred; on the Isle of Man it and a Thor's-hammer fishbone still ward off faeries.

name: Thurisaz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Ogre" used as a vitkir Art. Negative rune meaning giant or ogre (or thorn), used for shapeshifting and against supernatural creatures (Vim) and thorny plants (Herbam).

name: Tintagel
description: A near-island stronghold off the coast of Cornwall, the seat of Gorlois and later King Mark, and the site of Arthur's conception; it may be detached from the mundane world, with a chapel of St. Juliot helping keep it from reappearing.

name: Tip of the Tongue
description: A Perdo Mentem spell (Level 5) that causes the target to forget one word of the caster's choosing for the spell's duration.

name: Tiwaz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Tyr" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of Tyr, truth and battle; primarily associated with Mentem and justice.

name: Tobias
description: An example swineherd whose body Antigone inhabits during a psychodramatic Quest on the Avenue of the Unexpected Pages, charged with delivering a candlestick.

name: Tower of Ashes
description: Chapter house of the Covenant of the Icy North that is home to Archmaga Jacinta filia Nicoli of the line of Apromor.

name: Tower of London
description: A London fortress whose grounds contain the Royal Menagerie housing exotic animals gifted to the King of England, including the ailing faerie hippogriff.

name: Tragic Life
description: A Major Story Tainted Flaw in which the character's life has been manipulated by demons so that she will act to her own detriment at a pivotal moment of destiny.

name: Transform
description: +3 Gruagach Exceptional Talent allowing gruagachan to change the shape of others.

name: Transform into Human
description: Power for non-human faeries to take human shape; the Ghula uses it to switch between human and feasting form.

name: Transformation of the Ravenous Beast to the Torpid Toad
description: A Muto Animal (MuAn 25) spell known by the Bjornaer template magus that transforms an animal into a toad.

name: Transformed (Being)
description: Major Supernatural Virtue: the character is transformed by Magic into a supernatural being with Might 0, gaining Qualities by taking Inferiorities and an Essential Trait.

name: Trap of the Entwining Vines
description: A Creo Herbam (CrHe 15) indirect spell whose vines surround and prevent a maga from moving without completely immobilizing her.

name: Treaty of the Roman Tribunal
description: 1068 treaty regulating Roman magi's dealings with the mundane world; part of the Peripheral Code but with no force outside the Roman Tribunal.

name: Tremulous Vault of the Torch's Flame
description: A Rego Ignem spell (Level 5) that causes a fire to quiver and then leap up to 10 feet in any direction; a Targeting roll is required to hit a specific target.

name: Trods
description: Special pathways that lead into and out of Faerie, connecting regio levels to each other and the mundane world and even leading to Arcadia; Arcadian Travel lets Merinitae create them at will.

name: Troupe Upbringing
description: A Minor General Virtue for a character raised among entertainers, granting +2 to rolls involving abilities in a selected area such as acrobatics or storytelling.

name: Trouvères
description: A type of minstrel from northern France, concentrating on Arthurian poems, of whom Chrétien of Troyes is the most famous.

name: True Cross
description: Relic of which Henry I of Cyprus carries a fragment with 2 Faith Points.

name: Tuatha de Danu
description: The fair folk of Ireland, said to be the children of the faerie goddess embodied in the Danube.

name: Tueor
description: Learned magician Technique ('I guard/protect') whose charms defend a target from specific harms; loosely analogous to Hermetic Rego.

name: Twilight Scar
description: A lasting supernatural mark left on a magus by Twilight episodes; Philippus Niger bears many, including one that causes only male children to be born where he lives.

name: Two-headed Hound
description: A corrupt beast (Might 10, Animal) appearing as a huge two-headed dog whose heads hate each other; able to spit fire, created by a diabolist as a sanctum guard.

name: Ulf
description: An example Bjornaer magus with a wolf heartbeast who communicates with his Great Beast ancestor and is initiated into the Mystery of the Anima, gaining a shadow-wolf inner heartbeast.

name: Ultima Thule
description: A far-northern region where the walking dead are prevalent, leading Donatores there to concentrate on Corpus.

name: Ungulus
description: A declining 'Winter' covenant in a carved tower in the Lake District, founded by House Flambeau and later home to a productive Verditius line; filled with magical treasures.

name: Unimaginative Learner
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character has trouble figuring things out, subtracting 3 from rolls when studying from raw vis.

name: University of Naples
description: A planted university to be instituted by Frederick II of Naples in 1224, drawing masters from Salerno.

name: Unnatural Magic
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw in which none of the character's Creo rituals have permanent effect due to the illusory nature of his magic, and he cannot extract vis with Creo.

name: Unseelie
description: A dark faction of faeries; an Unseelie faerie lord holds a melancholy feast on the last day of winter at which a doomed mortal is danced to death, leaving footprints where destroying angel mushrooms grow.

name: Unstructured Caster
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw in which the character casts all Formulaic spells as Ritual spells (including needing vis) and may not learn Ritual spells, but casts Spontaneous spells normally.

name: Uruz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Auroch" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of the aurochs, symbolizing strength, stamina and the wild; targets wild or magical animals (Animal) and wild weather (Auram).

name: Usama ibn Munqidh
description: A historical author (d. 1188) quoted from The Book of Learning by Example describing an angelic rescue on a mountain, illustrating the angel Nasir.

name: Usurer
description: A Minor Social Status Flaw in which the character lends valuables at abusive interest rates, earning about ten pounds of silver yearly but holding a poor reputation at level 4.

name: Val Negra
description: A lost covenant of the Provençal Tribunal, one of the first covenants of the Order founded by Flambeau himself, which suffered in the Schism War and whose location is now lost.

name: Val-Negra
description: The original domus magna of House Flambeau in the Pyrenees, founded by Flambeau against the sahirs; it has since sunk deep into Winter and lost Elaine's library.

name: Valdemar II
description: The King of Denmark, relatively secure with Schleswig and Holstein under his control, who in the historical timeline grants Kolding a full charter in 1230.

name: Valefar
description: The Thief's Demon, a Tempter appearing as a large hairless lion with a man's head, who aids thieves, teaches making hands of glory, and hates Hermetic magi.

name: Vallumbrosans
description: Small, rigorously enclosed and ascetic order founded by Saint John Gualbert, with strong papal influence; possibly secretly diabolist.

name: Vatican
description: Papal residence where Francis requested an audience with Innocent III.

name: Vendetta
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the magus is engaged in one of House Verditius' vendettas, often inherited from his parens, against another Verditius magus; restricted to Verditius magi.

name: Venditor
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for a selling-agent who barters the goods of a Verditius maga to mundane parties, gaining bonus experience in social abilities.

name: Vendée
description: Thinly populated northwest corner of Aquitaine of forest, moor and marsh.

name: Vengeful Powers
description: A Major Story Tainted Flaw in which the Infernal realm has taken interest in the character's non-Infernal Powers, causing harmful side effects whenever they are used without sin.

name: Vercingetorix
description: Gallic chieftain worshipped by the Bibracte cult.

name: Vestige
description: A perfect, insubstantial illusion in the Magic Realm aligned with a Form and connected to something in the mundane world; usable for travel.

name: Vexatores
description: Vassal of Fudarus (1048-1064) founded 21 miles from Sinapis to provoke it during the Flambeau-Tytalus conflict.

name: Vexillation
description: Hermetic or setting concept referenced in the description of the Mythic Locations sites.

name: Viaticarus
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character survived after receiving Extreme Unction, leaving him immune to demonic temptation but increasingly corpse-like and unable to cross certain wards.

name: Viper's Gaze
description: A Rego Animal spell (Level 15) that holds an animal rigid as long as the caster maintains eye contact and concentrates.

name: Visitation
description: Annual inspection of parishes by the bishop or his deputies, using a checklist of about 100 articles.

name: Voice of the (Land)
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue letting the character speak with any creature whose natural habitat is a particular environment, without being perceived as threat or prey.

name: Volkhvy
description: Exclusively male pagan priests of Rugen who serve gods such as the Forest Brothers and Svantovit; nearly all have the Ways of the Forest Virtue and can open faerie gates.

name: Vortigern
description: The usurper king who invited the Saxons under Hengist and Horsa into Britain and consulted Merlin about his collapsing tower.

name: Vulnerable Magic
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw whereby the character's magic is automatically dispelled in certain uncommon circumstances (e.g. touching iron, crossing running water); often taken as an Ordeal in Glamour Initiation.

name: Vulnero
description: Learned magician Technique ('I harm') whose charms cause harm to a target; resembles Perdo, and such charms are often called curses.

name: Waldherz
description: A Black Forest covenant founded as a chapter house of Durenmar by the lineage of Hercynius, dedicated to overcoming Hermetic limits with primal magic; destroyed in the Schism War.

name: Wall of Protecting Stone
description: A Creo Terram spell that makes a wall of granite up to 25 paces wide, 4 paces high, and 1 pace thick.

name: Wanderlust
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character is compelled to travel and cannot spend more than a season in the same place.

name: Ward Against Beasts of Legend
description: A Rego Animal 25 warding effect enchanted into Philippus Niger's Subtle Chain.

name: Ward Against Faeries of the Air
description: A Rego Auram ward spell (General) protecting a magic circle against faeries of the air, who cannot break the circle or affect those within it.

name: Ward Against Faeries of the Wood
description: A Rego Herbam ward spell (General) protecting a magic circle against faeries of the wood, modeled on the Aquam version.

name: Warped Senses
description: A Minor General Flaw making a character overly sensitive to environmental conditions such as light, sound, taste, smell, cold, or heat, with variants like Sensitive (Sense) and Weak (Sense).

name: Waves of Drowning and Smashing
description: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 30) that raises a wave five feet high and thirty paces wide capable of submerging swimmers and overturning rowboats.

name: Wayland
description: An invisible smith dwelling at Wayland's Smithy who will shoe a horse left with a penny overnight; legend credits him with forging magical weapons and armor for great heroes.

name: Weak Scholar
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw giving a -6 penalty to Lab Totals when working from the Lab Texts of others, including re-inventing spells.

name: Wealth
description: Virtue appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Weaver's Trap of Webs
description: A Creo Animal (CrAn 35) indirect spell that surrounds and immobilizes a magus with webs without touching him, partly effective without penetrating Magic Resistance.

name: Westerwald
description: A broad hilly forest stretching east from the Rhine north of Koblenz, home to the hamlet of Waldheim, the former covenant of Oakdell, and the faerie Court of Bright Winter.

name: William of Newburgh
description: A medieval chronicler quoted in the Donatores history, author of Historia Rerum Anglicarum, who recorded accounts of cadavers leaving their tombs to wander among the living.

name: William the Bastard
description: Who disappeared eight years in childhood before claiming Normandy then England.

name: William the Lion
description: King of Scotland 1165-1214 who strengthened feudalism and bought back independence with the Quit-Claim of Canterbury.

name: Wise Owl of the Forest
description: A talkative magical owl who monitors the forest, questions its animals, and shares information about magical creatures, vis sources and regiones.

name: Witch Marks
description: A Minor General Tainted Flaw giving the character disfigurements recognized by folk lore as belonging to diabolists.

name: Wizard's Icy Grip
description: A Perdo Ignem spell (Level 30) that chills a single target for +20 damage, freezing it solid if killed; armor does not add to Soak against it.

name: Wizard's Reach
description: A Muto Vim spell that increases the range of a targeted spell by one category; ten Form-specific versions exist.

name: Wolfram von Eschenbach
description: A famous German minnesinger and poet at the court of Hermann I of Thuringia, author of Parzival; used as an example of a character with both Profession: Minnesinger and Craft: Poetry.

name: Wookey Hole Caves
description: A deep, partly flooded cave hung with stalactites, in which something is said to live, though local legends disagree about the details.

name: Words of the Flickering Flame
description: An Intellego Ignem spell (Level 35) that allows the caster to converse with a fire, which is commonly chaotic and distractible.

name: Wrath of Whirling Winds and Water
description: A Creo Auram Ritual spell (Level 65) that creates an immense hurricane-intensity storm 40 or more miles wide, causing massive damage along shorelines and inland.

name: Wreaths of Foul Smoke
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 10) that raises thick yellow sulfurous smoke that blocks sight and causes Fatigue or wound loss to those who breathe it.

name: Wunjo
description: Elder Futhark rune "Joy" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of comfort, bliss and joy, associated with Mentem and the emotions of intelligent beings.

name: Yom Kippur
description: Jewish holy day; atonement between it and Sukkot drives demons from a household for a year.

name: York
description: The largest town of northern England and seat of the second English archbishop, a port on the River Ouse, site of the 1190 massacre of the Jews.

name: Younger Futhark
description: A condensed 16-rune variant developed in Denmark and Germany; less versatile than the Elder Futhark.

name: Yselt filia Rosalia
description: Ice-distorted, faerie-blooded senior Merinita maga who leads the Covenant Where Journeys End and holds a veto; her sigil is the icicle.

name: Zwergenstimme
description: A Magic spirit of an echo (Might 15, Imaginem) that lurks in caves and ravines, can mimic sounds, hurl rocks, and collapse cave roofs; its name means 'dwarf voice' in German.

name: (Gild) Trained
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue representing training at Durenmar and induction into a Rhine political gild, granting extra experience points appropriate to the gild.

name: (Land) Regio Network
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue giving access to an extensive network of regiones (e.g. in lakes, sky, or caves) between which the character can travel quickly.

name: (Mystery Cult) Lore
description: An (Organization) Lore Ability for a particular Mystery Cult, covering its legends, history, structure, rites, secret passwords, and Initiation ceremonies.

name: A Bridge Without Wood
description: ReCo 20 spell transporting the target up to 50 paces to a visible point.

name: A Pestilence of Fleas
description: MuIm 4 sensory illusion making the target itchy, penalizing concentration and physical tasks by -1.

name: Aareschlucht
description: Aare Gorge near Meiringen, lair of the Tatzelwurmli.

name: Aaron
description: Moses' brother who, armed with a censer, defeated the fiery angel Kolazonta.

name: Abandoned Apprentice
description: A Major Story Flaw: the character was abandoned by his master midway through Hermetic training and is not a member of the Order of Hermes, though he knows Hermetic magic.

name: Abbas the Hunted
description: Nephilim giant, sole survivor of an infernal attack on his regio, seeking to avenge his family.

name: Abraham
description: Prophet and holy forbear (Divine Might 75), builder of the Ka'ba, buried at Hebron; a Greater Saint.

name: Abrigor
description: A demon, father of Malachi, who gains the service of demons freed through Malachi's quests; he is vulnerable to volcanic glass.

name: Acknowledgment of Evil
description: Saint power forcing any demon in voice range to declare its Infernal nature.

name: Adanos
description: Tytalus magus of Exspectatio with earth-spirit blood, supporter of Harpax.

name: Adaptive Casting
description: Mastery special ability for General spells letting mastery apply at different levels.

name: Adder
description: A small venomous snake of Mythic Europe, about a foot and a half long with diamond-shaped markings, possessing a Venomous Bite power that can poison victims based on attack advantage versus armor.

name: Adhere
description: Faerie power (Corpus) preventing a rider from dismounting a faerie animal, as with kelpies.

name: Adolescentia
description: The stage of life from 15 to 21, a time of service when an apprentice knows enough to assist his master in the lab.

name: Adrasteia of Tytalus
description: Quaesitor who roves the Tribunal borders laying traps for vis raiders, often with hoplites.

name: Aegir
description: A long-tailed skua seabird that serves as the familiar of Eric Ribecus of Waddenzee.

name: Aelfred of Little Downing
description: A local faerie doctor used in the example of Curse-Throwing to cure a young woman's barrenness.

name: Aelfric
description: An example agent of Carolus, an Outlaw Leader who runs a small team of bandits preying on local merchants and owes Carolus loyalty for protection from the law.

name: Aeolus
description: A talking magical horse (Magic Might 8, Animal), Magical Animal Companion of Victor of Mercere; vain, proud and lecherous.

name: Aesir
description: Norse gods who with the Vanir fought the Jotnar.

name: Aethelbald
description: A deputy among Waddenzee's pirate covenfolk who claims to be the Saxon heir to the Crown of England.

name: Aether
description: The fifth element posited by Aristotle that exists only above the Lunar Sphere, neither hot nor cold nor moist nor dry, composing the planetary spheres and planets.

name: Aetites
description: Rare eagle-stones mentioned by Pliny; the smaller pebble inside holds one pawn of Terram vis and gives a +5 Material bonus to fertility when used in an enchanted item or talisman.

name: Aett
description: A group of eight runes; the runes are organized into three aetts, usually written one per row.

name: Affinity with Auram
description: The Minor Hermetic Virtue of the Tempestaria tradition, granting an affinity with the Auram Art.

name: Affinity with Finesse
description: A Virtue granting Imanitos Mendax accelerated learning in Finesse, gained from Twilight.

name: Affinity with Heartbeast
description: A Virtue granting an affinity with the Heartbeast Ability, gained through Clan Midusulf's Trial of the Sacred Marriage at the cost of a Study Requirement.

name: Affinity with Medicine
description: A Virtue improving learning in the Medicine Ability, possessed by the sample physician Gilles de Corbeil.

name: Affinity with Vim
description: The Minor Hermetic Virtue of the Witches of Thessaly tradition, granting an affinity with the Vim Art.

name: Age of Aries
description: Hermetic reckoning of time beginning 139 B.C.

name: Age of Chaos
