description: Period of about 350 years after the Cult of Mercury's fall when Italian wizards lived in lawless fear and battle.

name: Agent
description: Directly controlled subordinates bound to a principal by emotional Bonds, limited in number by Presence and Intrigue or Leadership.

name: Ager Belli
description: CrIm 10 (Req Rego) illusion of a Roman soldier controlled by the caster, used by apprentices to play Bellum.

name: Agnes of Irencillia
description: A maga of Irencillia who in 1158 announced a sighting of the Founder Merinita in Bohemia, though little credence was paid to her claim.

name: Aita
description: Underworld deity whose priesthood (butterfly symbol) was House Tremere's first ancestral tradition.

name: Akousmatics
description: Members of the Fraternity of Samos below the Inner Order, who seek further knowledge and teaching at Schools.

name: Al Arama
description: Levant Tribunal covenant that trades vis to Rellantali, Verdi and Harco and is reachable by a Harco Hermes Portal.

name: Alchemical Separation of Brine
description: ReAq 4 effect of the Potent Salts converting salt water into pure salt.

name: Aldico
description: Primus of Mercere during the Schism War who helped negotiate peace.

name: Alectryomancy
description: Divinatory method using eating behavior of chickens, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Alexander III
description: Pope (1159-81) during whose pontificate a priest was suspended for calling up a demon.

name: Alexander the Great
description: Conqueror reminded he was not a god; a past life of the Blessed One.

name: Alfar
description: Beings referenced in the rune spell for sensing vis.

name: Alfonso the Wise
description: King of Castile and Leon, credited with writing a lapidary.

name: Alfred the Great
description: King of Wessex from 871 who drove back the Danes, established defensive burhs, and was a learned translator; subject of the legend of the burnt cakes.

name: Aligned Aura
description: A Magic aura with a special aspect, such as enhancing an emotion or aligning with a Hermetic Art, discernible by Intellego Vim.

name: Allod
description: Land held by descent from time immemorial rather than from a superior. Its holders need not swear fealty, and some covenants claim it.

name: Almohads
description: Current rulers of Muslim Spain and North Africa, whose doctrine blends Sunni, Shi'i and Mu'tazili elements; founded by Ibn Tumart.

name: Alsia
description: One of Merinita's first apprentices who later joined Quendalon and developed a spell allowing those with Faerie Magic to temporarily bind a familiar.

name: Am Balla
description: Being at Crun Clach who will gladly make stone containers for potions, provided the potions do not stain or corrode the rock.

name: Amazonia
description: Territory of the Amazons whose fall is imagined in a story seed.

name: Amazons
description: Warrior sorceresses from Amazonia described in Rival Magic whose tales reach the Order; in a story seed they join House Flambeau.

name: Ambrosius of Merinita
description: Son of the seer Emrys, adopted as Quendalon's apprentice; of strong faerie heritage, he became a master of symbolic prediction and founder of the Heirs to Merlin lineage.

name: Ambush on the Deserted Road
description: A PeIm 20 transparency spell that destroys the species a group emits in one direction, making a traveling party invisible from the direction of those they wish to ambush.

name: Amorphous
description: Major or Minor Supernatural Tainted Virtue letting the character take any non-specific human form, as his body has the almost-gaseous property of demonic flesh.

name: An Evening's Illumination
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: Anatolia
description: Region where Dindyméné is called Kubaba; also a suggested location for the Cursewood in the Theban variant.

name: Ancestor Site
description: A place strongly resonating with shapechanging and the Magic Realm that serves House Bjornaer; the Wolf's Court could be one.

name: Anchored to the (Land)
description: A Minor General Flaw: the character suffers loneliness and a -3 penalty when traveling through any environment other than a particular favored one.

name: Anchorhold
description: The cell of an anchoress, usually attached to a church with a window onto the altar and another onto the street.

name: Ancrene Riwle
description: The anchoress' rule, written in England in the early 13th century for three anchoresses, based on monastic rules but adapted to the anchoress' enclosed life.

name: Andresina
description: A ruined and abandoned Roman city southwest of Toul with a great temple to Apollo and a Magic aura of 2, a possible covenant site.

name: Andrew
description: An infernal ghost of the Accusers, a peasant hanged for murdering his wife and her lover, who now uncovers the crimes of unfaithful lovers.

name: Andrilikes
description: A theurgist magus of the Novgorod Tribunal who wrote a Hermetic ritual for summoning the lesser Daimon Pukis to his sanctum.

name: Angel Eyes Potion
description: MuAq(Im) 15 charged potion causing hallucinations.

name: Angel of Death
description: Angel who carries men away at death; Shinnui Shem hides a man from him by changing his name.

name: Angela filia Constance
description: Valnastium maga who crafts magical musical instruments, a Crafter, and acts as the covenant's factor at the Midsummer Fair.

name: Angelic Mantle
description: Angelic power (2 points, Corpus) to manifest in apparently mortal flesh, subject to natural law while in it.

name: Anglo-Saxon Rune Poem
description: Rune poem describing the runes, e.g. Kauno as a torch and Perth as a gaming piece; later edited by monks.

name: Animae Magic
description: A Major Arcadian Mystery (Virtue) that lets a maga transform inanimate objects into living faeries called animae or summon them, using new Creo/Muto spell guidelines.

name: Animal Companion
description: A Minor Story Flaw: the character is accompanied by a loyal, intelligent but mundane animal with whom they share a very close relationship.

name: Animal Healer
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting the Animal Healing Ability, which heals animals using Animal vis.

name: Animal Healing
description: Supernatural Ability granted by Animal Healer that heals animals using Animal vis.

name: Animals of Virtue
description: Magical animals such as snakes and eagles with mystical methods of rejuvenation.

name: Animus
description: Spirit that may function within beings; may become a Daimon through apotheosis.

name: Ankeu
description: Death personified in Brittany as a skeleton with a scythe driving a spectral cart.

name: Antrum
description: Faerie realm of earth and rock, associated with recumbent circles.

name: Aphrodite
description: A goddess of love, a variant of Aphrodite, said by Empedocles to be worshipped by the immortals; some Criamon claim to have met her.

name: Apollonios Rhodios
description: Author of the poem Argonautika.

name: Apollonius
description: Solomon's most ardent student, who recorded the Ars Notoria.

name: Apologia
description: Defensive text rebutting diatribes and strengthening the original argument.

name: Apostate
description: A Minor General Flaw: the character has converted from one faith or belief system to another, gaining a bad Reputation of 4 among their previous faith.

name: Apostles of Apollonius
description: Elementalist society teaching Theurgical Summoning and Controlling; ascetic, pious summoners rare but found across Mythic Europe in 1220.

name: Apotropaic Spells
description: Hermetic spells for combating demons, considered questionable by many magi.

name: Appenzell
description: Main village of Appenzellerland, known for wrestling.

name: Apples of Indigo Hue
description: Vis site: a single apple tree in an old orchard bearing blue apples with up to 4 pawns of Herbam vis sordida yearly.

name: Apprenticeship
description: The period during which a future magus is trained by a master until passing the gauntlet; Agricola was taken for apprenticeship late.

name: Aqrab the Conjurer
description: A Deluder active in Islamic lands, a cloud of blue smoke full of eyes, who masquerades as a sorceress or djinnja and teaches Diablerie, Incantation and the Goetic Arts.

name: Aquila of Bjornaer
description: An ancient Bjornaer maga of Ungulus who spends most of her time in eagle Heartbeast form over the Lake District and is near Final Twilight.

name: Arabic Instruction
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Archdeacon
description: The bishop's deputy over an archdeaconry; chief judge of canon law there, holding a travelling court and visitation rights; must be a deacon.

name: Archimagus
description: An elite rank of Hermetic magus; a Tremere Archimagus invented the Lightning-Bringer as his greatest achievement.

name: Archimagus Theoderic
description: The affable, encouraging Archimagus who governs the Devoted covenant dedicated to reaching the Lunar Sphere.

name: Ardea
description: A master maga of House Bjornaer holding the Seat of the Swan at Crintera, with a heron heartbeast; a quiet, contemplative seer famous for her foresight and divinatory powers.

name: Argenteuil
description: Nunnery near Paris to which Héloïse moved.

name: Argos
description: Legendary craftsman who built Jason's ship and carved the Xoanon of Dindyméné.

name: Argument Total
description: Score generated by polemics, apologia and diatribes, spent as experience for debate bonuses or penalties at Tribunal.

name: Aries of House Flambeau
description: Lapis Crudus magus who tricked Candidus into protecting the covenant; succumbed to Final Twilight five years ago.

name: Aristeas
description: Ancient Greek poet and powerful straying magician serving Apollo, who keeps returning from death via his kolossos.

name: Arithmetic Magic
description: Mystery working numerical influences into general Hermetic magic (Arithmetic Magic).

name: Arkona
description: A ruined Slavic fortress-temple on the northernmost headland of Rugen, one of the holiest pagan Baltic sites where Svantovit was worshipped; destroyed by Bishop Absolon in 1169.

name: Arm of the Infant
description: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 20) that shrinks a person's arm to half its length and makes it pudgy like an infant's.

name: Arma Magica
description: 'Magical defenses' based on Bonisagus's Parma Magica ritual, in which the Parma is folded upon itself to produce effects called folds; each fold is a Major Breakthrough.

name: Arno
description: Benandante companion, a young smith who fights with a club of fennel.

name: Ars Flambonis
description: A Summa on Ignem (Level 14, Quality 12) written by Elaine as a tribute to her pater Flambeau, sprinkled with anecdotes about his teachings.

name: Ars Notoria (Virtue)
description: Major Hermetic/Supernatural Virtue granting Ars Notoria 1, requiring scores of 4 in Artes Liberales and four languages.

name: Artakia
description: The Greek town on Bear Island whose citizens know of the faerie regio and whose spring has a Magic aura of 2.

name: Artificer
description: An honorary Durenmar title for the magus, traditionally a Verditius, charged with crafting items for the covenant; currently held by Gudrun Tigurina.

name: Artist Reputation
description: A flexible Reputation named after an artist's Craft or Profession Ability that grows with the quality of his work and sponsors, conferring social and supernatural benefits as it rises toward 11.

name: Artistic Renown
description: A Minor General Virtue granting an Artist Reputation of 2 (takeable twice); also a Major Supernatural Virtue version letting a non-Gifted artist study one Hermetic Form.

name: Artorius filius Celeres
description: Newly Gauntleted Bonisagus magus, Celeres' last apprentice.

name: Asgard
description: Home of the Norse gods, reached by the rainbow bridge Heimdall guards.

name: Ashenrise
description: A covenant founded in the Hibernian Tribunal in 1062 by the survivors of Tagelyn after Blackthorn drove them from their caves.

name: Asia Minor
description: Region whose coast holds the sinkholes Cennet and Cehennem.

name: Astra Planeta
description: The seven planetary spirits linking the celestial spheres to the Realm of Magic.

name: Astrological Duration
description: A spell duration tied to astrological conditions whose calculations can be eased by consulting a magical armillary sphere.

name: Asuryal
description: Asuryal, Herald of Deliverance, a Principality (Divine Might 10) who guards the domain of a mundane lord disguised as a minor advisor.

name: Ataf the Separator
description: A shapechanging Spirit of Deceit with a serpent's head who separates happily married couples; his Powers fail against True Lovers.

name: Atavism
description: The acquisition of ancestral characteristics by which a Bjornaer magus learns to adopt the form of a notable animal ancestor (the inner heartbeast).

name: Athlit
description: The Pilgrim's Castle, Templar fortress between Haifa and Acre with elevated Dominion ratings; formerly Destroit.

name: Atlantic Ocean
description: An alternative location for a magical island, averaging over 4000 paces deep.

name: Atlas Games
description: The publisher (Trident, Inc. d/b/a Atlas Games) of Ars Magica and this Covenants sourcebook.

name: Aufhocker
description: A faerie hound variant found in German-speaking areas that acts as a kelpie and clings to foes while goring them, adding to their combat Load.

name: Augsburg
description: Mining city with secret catacombs.

name: Augustus
description: Octavian, invested as Antistes Mercuria in 11 BC, who rebuilt the temple of Mercury as a massive complex.

name: Aura of Childlike Innocence
description: A MuIm 10 spell, a variant of Aura of Ennobled Presence, that makes the target appear more guileless and naive, granting bonuses to deflect suspicion and to Guile-based debate defenses.

name: Aura of Ice
description: Phenomenon mentioned in the bibliography, loosely based on beliefs of people near Mount Connor in Australia.

name: Austerius Trianomae
description: Elderly Bonisagus politician and scholar of the Code, one of the Trianomae, who ruthlessly opposes integrating the Order with mundane society and is close to Final Twilight.

name: Authorities
description: Angelic choir regulating Creation; Infernal regiones form where they no longer visit.

name: Autumn Covenant
description: A covenant in the mature/declining season of life; Oleron and its rivals are Autumn covenants whose battles focus on weak vassals.

name: Auxiliaries
description: Disciplined grogs and companions supporting the Legion, independently commanded.

name: Averna's Hogs
description: Small savage humanoid hog faeries with lead in their flesh.

name: Awakening
description: A Minor Nature Mystery letting nature magi awaken a natural intelligence and Magic Might within subjects of their region, basis for Merinita's familiar-binding ritual.

name: Azael
description: Fallen being to whom I Enoch ascribes all sin and whom the Apocalypse of Abraham condemns to dwell upon the earth.

name: Azrael
description: The Archangel of Death, chief angel of death and strongest of the angels, who extracts the souls of prophets and of the Islamic dead; Divine Might 90 and a poisoned long spear.

name: BaalBaruth
description: Demon duke of hell, a Spirit of Deceit and Corrupter of Monks, who supervises the corruption of the Cluniacs; appears as a great black serpent.

name: Baccalaureus
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character who completed a three-year university program earning a Bachelor of Arts, with 90 experience points in Latin and Artes Liberales.

name: Bael
description: Destroyer of Nations, Lord of the Furies with the heads of a toad, cat and man, who provokes wars between nations while lurking in royal courts.

name: Baghl, an Earth Jinni
description: An earth jinni (Magic Might 15, Terram) who haunts a dark cave in the Elbruz mountains, able to turn humans to stone and duplicate Perdo/Rego Terram spells; appears as an obese man with a mule's head.

name: Baker's Day
description: September 5th, Jerbiton's wedding anniversary, after which Hermetic marriages take place.

name: Balbina filia Havelock
description: Verditius maga with a stammering curse who repairs enchanted items and maintains Sinews' devices.

name: Baldwin IX
description: Count of Flanders crowned the first emperor of the Latin Empire of Constantinople in 1204, who mysteriously disappeared in 1205 during battle against King Ivan of Bulgaria.

name: Balor
description: Fabled opponent of Lugh with faerie versions.

name: Baltic
description: Region with a small village whose locals practiced dream magics unknown to the Order, inspiring Raisa.

name: Barathrum
description: One of the six known lands of Arcadia: the land of the dead, reached via the Ring of Brodgar.

name: Baron
description: Holder of a barony (baro), divided informally into greater and lesser barons. Greater barons have the Great Noble Virtue.

name: Baron Jurgen Schonburg
description: Baron of Sooneck/Oberwesel holding the Schonburg castle; father of the diabolist Robert and of Karlotte, descended from the fae of the Court of Dark Summer.

name: Basajaun
description: A gigantic red-furred faun variant of the Great Lezi found in the Basque country of Iberia, acting as agricultural faeries; the name also refers to a large wild faun in surrounding folklore.

name: Basic
description: A laboratory Flaw present after only the first season of a standard lab's setup, giving a –3 penalty to all Lab Totals until the second setup season removes it.

name: Basra
description: Persian city where Ikhwan as-Safa' was founded.

name: Bath
description: Town in Somerset, Stonehenge Tribunal, on the River Avon, famed since ancient times for healing hot springs founded by King Bladud; now dominated by the Church and its priory.

name: Battle of the False Sun
description: Monumental battle in which Pralix's army defeated Damhan-Allaidh's allies; a spell erased the Pictish language from nearly everyone's memory.

name: Battlefield Event
description: Massed-combat story event used to resolve escalades and sieges, rated with Man, Size and Enemy components and an Event Bonus.

name: Baudouin
description: A villager who says he killed an attacking wolf that turned into the corpse of his brother Guillot; he is accused of murder.

name: Bayeux Tapestry
description: Embroidery commissioned by Odo depicting Harold; magic woven into it gives a +2 Sympathetic Connection to the Duke of Normandy and King of England.

name: Bean-Spitting Day
description: May custom derived from Roman ghost-warding; Valnastium holds a bean feast.

name: Bear
description: Brown bear, a large shaggy beast of forests and mountains, ferocious when wounded.

name: Beast of Minuscule Proportions
description: A Muto Animal spell that shrinks a creature; the appendix notes its description is slightly amended so Initiative is increased along with the listed effects.

name: Becoming
description: A Major Arcadian Mystery (Virtue) teaching a maga how to irreversibly transform body, mind, and spirit to become a faerie, as Quendalon was reputed to have done.

name: Beech Tree of Virtue
description: Tree of Virtue with Vim vis in its beechnuts; its branches can be Enriched into an amulet granting the Luck Virtue.

name: Beechleaf
description: A green-skinned journeyman of House Merinita at Fengheld, apprenticed at Irencillia by Primus Handri, who was raised by a dryad and is strongly influenced by the fae.

name: Beguile
description: Faerie Power to command targets or alter their memories, perceptions, and emotions.

name: Beguine
description: Pious laywoman living chastely in prayer and good works without formal vows, alone, with family or in a beguinage.

name: Beholden
description: Covenant Hook: the covenant is beholden to nobles or clergy.

name: Bellum
description: A game invented by Casius in the 10th century where apprentices duel with illusionary Roman soldiers via Ager Belli.

name: Beloved Enemy
description: Flaw (usually -2) mixing the Enemy flaw and True Friend virtue: an enemy nurtured through conflict whom one never tries to destroy.

name: Berith the Ennobler
description: A Spirit of Deceit appearing as a red-clad crowned soldier on a red horse, who makes things seem nobler than they are and produces unworthy noblemen; popular with alchemists.

name: Bern
description: The city of which Dietrich was boy-king after the fall of Rome; conquered by his uncle Ermenrik and later retaken by Dietrich.

name: Berne
description: City founded 1191 by Berthold V, named for a bear.

name: Beserker Rage
description: Furies Power granting anyone the Berserk Virtue until they calm down.

name: Bethlehem
description: Pilgrimage destination and rumored cult headquarters of the Magoi of the Star.

name: Bigamist
description: A major Story Flaw where a merchant lives two entirely separate lives with two spouses and households in two cities, raising annual business costs.

name: Bind Curse
description: A Major Inner House Mystery of Verditius developed by Himinis the Mad for instilling powerful curses into items, requiring the Sever the Ties That Bind Ordeal.

name: Binding Oath
description: Ritual faerie power (Vim) enforcing a solemnly sworn oath; oathbreakers are warned and then suffer a Flaw.

name: Binding the Hermetic Codex
description: A Rego Animal 20 ritual variant of Binding the Mundane Codex that incorporates resonant materials into book bindings.

name: Binding the Mundane Codex
description: A Rego Animal 5 spell that binds up to 1,000 prepared bifolds into books and grants readers the +1 quality bonus for sound binding.

name: Bingen Hole
description: A hazardous stretch of the Rhine immediately downstream of Bingen, where rocks, accelerating flow, and treacherous eddies make navigation perilous.

name: Bird Bane
description: MuAn 44 harness giving a cat feathered wings.

name: Birds of Nephelococcygia
description: Intelligent birds inhabiting Nephelococcygia, not Beasts of Virtue, playable as magical characters with song-based powers.

name: Bishop Hatto
description: The demonic shade (Infernal Might 30, Mentem) of the greedy archbishop Hatto II of Mainz, who haunts the Mausturm island and attacks with a chilling touch and powers of fear.

name: Bishop of Speyer
description: Bishop who in 1084 granted land and rights to the Jewish community in exchange for annual rent.

name: Black Death
description: A demon appearing as a shrouded reaper, invisible to mundane senses, summoned by an Infernal ritual; it does not exist in 1220 Mythic Europe but arises in 1347 in Constantinople if the saga follows history.

name: Black Faced Hermes
description: Faerie that comes down the chimney to take away unnatural children, abducting the Gifted and leaving them at covenant doors.

name: Black Mass
description: Perversion of the Mass possibly practiced by corrupt Cluniacs.

name: Black Mountains
description: Mountains in south Wales where the covenant Blackthorn is hidden in a warren of caves and where Goliard once subdued an elemental spirit causing rockslides.

name: Black Sea
description: Sea between the Theban, Transylvanian and Novgorod Tribunals, with hundreds of faerie islands.

name: Black Terrors
description: Weakest faeries observed: dark shapes on children's walls with 1 Might.

name: Blatant Magical Air
description: A Major Supernatural Flaw for characters with a Magical Air or The Gift: a -6 penalty to social actions and being hated and feared by the mundane population.

name: Blindness
description: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

name: Blizzard demons
description: Alpine demons that cause blizzards, break travelers' faith and slay them.

name: Blizzard of Down
description: Miklos's CrAn 20 spell that blinds and buries a group in feathery down.

name: Blood Rights
description: Example case of a maga's claim to her own Gifted child against a magus's formal claim of apprenticeship.

name: Blue Apples of Twilight
description: Poisonous blue apples from a tree rising over a Roman slave grave 13 times a year; fermented, they yield Perdo vis.

name: Blunt the Viper's Fangs
description: A Perdo Animal spell (Level 20) that blunts the natural weapons (claws, teeth, talons) of a beast, halving their damage.

name: Blwchbardd
description: One of the five great Welsh poets believed by the Order to have left Daimons behind after death.

name: Boar King
description: A faerie once worshiped by the Gauls who dwells in a wooden fortress in a Faerie regio (aura 7) and claims the forests of the Normandy Tribunal; a former ally of House Diedne.

name: Boar Spear
description: Special spear with a bar across the haft for boar hunting.

name: Boethius
description: A Roman statesman, philosopher, and inventor whose notebooks Milo recovered; his philosophical principles were used to refine Verditius Runes, and a ritual was named after him.

name: Bologna Lore
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Bologna Scholar
description: Companion vocation: a University of Bologna student taught about the Order by the magi of Literatus.

name: Bond Qualities
description: Familiar bond powers such as Independence, Shared Senses and Unlimited Bond.

name: Bonding
description: Bargaining art forging a mystic bond with a faerie to share Characteristics, powers, enchantments, or protections.

name: Book of Revelation
description: Virtue, Method, Power or Supernatural Ability gained through a Spiritual Path or monistic integration.

name: Book of Solomon
description: Book whose copies teach the Notory Art.

name: Boons
description: Features that make a covenant better, costing points (Major three, Minor one, or Free Choices) in covenant creation.

name: Boosted Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus spend vis to boost Range, Duration, Target, or size of Formulaic spells by a magnitude.

name: Boot Burning
description: August 19th Jerbiton custom commemorating Jerbiton burning his shoes at Valnastium.

name: Border Rider
description: Grog template: a mounted cattle raider from the Borders wanted by the English.

name: Boris of Novgorod
aliases: Boris of Novgorod, Follower of Mercere
description: A well-traveled Russian Redcap of Oculus Septentrionalis who poses as an itinerant merchant, runs the Novgorod Inn in Lubeck, and trades books, items, and vis with magi.

name: Bound Casting Tools
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw: the magus's casting tools, as used by House Verditius, become lasting Arcane Connections to him.

name: Bound to Magic
description: A Flaw or Inferiority named among the traits of magical animals or dragons in this text.

name: Brabant
description: Duchy east of Flanders from which the Brabançons originate.

name: Branches of the Arts
description: The finest summae yet produced for eight of the Arts, given as gifts among covenants because their value cannot be met in kind; the Branch of Terram in 1220 is De Lapii.

name: Branoic
description: Young man who stumbled into the Faerie Realm on his stag night climbing Goat Hill.

name: Brave
description: Personality Trait; if all group members have a positive Brave score, the group adds the lowest score to Morale rolls.

name: Brazen Head
description: Infamous, supposedly Infernal scrying tool acquired by Sylvester II in Spain.

name: Break the Oncoming Wave
description: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 10) that breaks all waves and torrents of water, including magical ones, just before they touch the caster.

name: Brendan the Navigator
description: Saint whose baptismal font replaces the xoanon in the Hibernian variant.

name: Breton
description: Living Language of Brittany, related to Cornish and Welsh, hardly ever written.

name: Breviary
description: Liturgical book (Quality 6) held by the example Covenant Chapel.

name: Brew Potency
description: The strength of a folk witch potion, determining granted Ability scores, durations and its apparent magnitude to Hermetic detection.

name: Bride of Mithras
description: Second rank of the Legion; organizes Ravens and learns Clear Thinker; symbol a lamp.

name: Bring the Herd to Market
description: Spell or effect listed in the contents of Transforming Mythic Europe.

name: Britannian Tribunal
description: Original Tribunal that initially included Brittany; later divided into the Stonehenge, Loch Leglean, and Hibernian Tribunals.

name: Broch
description: Large thick-walled stone towers built by the Broch-builders.

name: Brocéliande
description: Mysterious Faerie forest west of Rennes.

name: Brollachan
description: A formless, boneless, fleshy dark faerie that lurks in crevices or abandoned houses and smothers and eats victims with pseudopods.

name: Brother Bressal
description: Augustinian canon and guardian of the Purgatory of Saint Patrick with True Faith and Divine Form, who opens the gate to Purgatory.

name: Brother Chaplain
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a priest of a crusading order, answerable only to the pope outside the order.

name: Brother Julian
description: A deformed Benedictine-raised mendicant friar and companion-level character, member of the Order of Preachers, who preaches against the Cathar heresy in Languedoc and craves academic learning.

name: Brother Sergeant
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a non-knightly member of a crusading order under vows of obedience, poverty, and chastity.

name: Brother-Knight
description: A Templar Social Status Virtue for a knight of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon; its effects are included in Templar Commander.

name: Brother-Priest
description: A Templar Status Virtue for a brother-priest of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon, replaceable by Templar Administrator.

name: Brother-Sergeant
description: A Templar Status Virtue for a brother-sergeant of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon, replaceable by Templar Administrator.

name: Brutus
description: The Trojan founder of Britain who named the island after himself and built New Troy on the Thames after a prophecy from Diana.

name: Brünhild
description: The legendarily strong queen of Iceland in the Nibelungenlied, won for Gunther through Siegfried's deception, whose humiliation leads her to conspire in Siegfried's murder.

name: Buckland Saint Mary
description: A town in Somerset never visited by faeries because pixies annihilated them in a war; valuable to magi researching the battlefield.

name: Bulgaria
description: Kingdom invaded by Byzantium in 1014 and later rebelling under the Asens.

name: Bull
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Burgos
description: Castilian diocese near Las Huelgas.

name: Burial Rights
description: Church Boon granting the church the right to bury the dead.

name: Byrek
description: A clumsy but tireless grog from the Horse Clan of Crintera who wears a magical horse-bone amulet said to make him as swift and tireless as a horse.

name: Byrek's magical amulet
description: A magical amulet carved of horse bone given to Byrek by his witch mother of the Horse Clan, said to make him as swift and tireless as a horse, though its true power is unknown.

name: Cabal
description: A coordinated group of House Tytalus followers who anonymously join to pursue a shared goal of changing society, using esoteric names and identifying symbols.

name: Cabal of Frankish Gold
description: Tytalan cabal supporting the Lotharingian Tribunal.

name: Cabal of the Crushed Viper
description: Tytalus cabal opposing the chivalric ideal, members taking Arthurian pseudonyms.

name: Cailleach Glioc
description: Companion template: an elderly Highland wise woman who makes small potions and amulets with conditions attached.

name: Cain
description: Faeries are said by some to be his descendants, gone to Arcadia when banished to Nod.

name: Call the Basilisk
description: Kentigern's CrAn(Re) 50 spell that creates a basilisk so he can study them safely.

name: Call the Flock
description: Power (ReAn 35) summoning a cloud of mundane birds to gather around the singer.

name: Calling the Council of the Trees
description: A Rego Herbam ritual (Level 45) that compels all magical and potentially mobile trees within a woodland to gather to hold meetings and summon ancient powers; trees remain animated for a month.

name: Calypso
description: Figure in The Odyssey who wants to keep Odysseus from going home.

name: Camargue
description: Large, flat, marshy delta region of the Rhône River, home of magical wild horses.

name: Cambrian Mountains
description: The mountain range in Wales where Aneirin's tomb lies and across which his spirit wanders, helping those who further his ideals and punishing those who oppose them.

name: Cambunian Mountains
description: Mountains on the northern border of Thessaly where the Daughters of Erictho dwell in cliffside caves near Faerie regiones.

name: Camuel
description: Camuel the Dark Angel, a Throne who wrestled with Jacob; once an archangel, he was reduced after trying to prevent Moses receiving the Torah and now mediates prayers of the faithful.

name: Canaanite Necromancy
description: Long-forgotten tradition of necromancy sought by a magus through an Elysian quest.

name: Canon Fulbert
description: Canon of Notre Dame and uncle of Héloïse who hired Abelard as her tutor.

name: Canoness
description: Woman who takes vows of chastity and obedience under a rule, usually Augustinian, but may own property and is more urban and active than nuns.

name: Canonization
description: Formal Church recognition of a saint, requiring two genuine miracles and a cultus.

name: Canons of Patrick's Island
description: Order of canons ('Black Canons') established on Inisphadraig by Saint Malachy who tend the Purgatory of Saint Patrick.

name: Cantations
description: A low-level formulaic spell, from the Latin cantamen (little spell), especially when cast by an apprentice; it usually succeeds.

name: Capra filia Bullfinch
description: Bjornaer maga with an ibex heartbeast, a faerie midwife who believes she is destined to raise the new Jupiter Pennius.

name: Caprea
description: A visiting Bjornaer maga who is a current guest at Crintera, working on a bestiary to present at the next Tribunal. She accidentally blinded the familiar of a visiting Jerbiton magus, Carolus.

name: Captivating
description: Bargaining art exchanging bodies with a faerie; warps the summoner but makes both immune to Faerie Calling.

name: Cara filia Sigurd
description: Bjornaer maga with a piest heartbeast who farms shellfish and lobsters in the lake beneath Sinews of Knowledge.

name: Carinthia
description: Region suitable for Hermetic settlement.

name: Carlisle
description: Town thirty miles southwest of Horsingas where the magi are wanted.

name: Carlo filius Innocu
description: Merinita magus of Journeys End born of ice-distorted parents, with barbegazi features and powers.

name: Carmentis
description: The Cumaean sibyl, a Christian Magic Human with vast knowledge who guards a gate into Purgatory at Cumae.

name: Carthaginian Magic
description: Ancient magic studied at Sansaron, more personal and possibly beyond Hermetic bounds.

name: Carthusians
description: Austere order of monks and nuns following the Statutes of Saint Bruno, living in individual cells in complete silence.

name: Cascade of Rocks
description: A Perdo Terram (PeTe 40) spell that can do great damage only if an opponent is on a steep hillside or cliff base, used by the School of Vilano; bypasses Magic Resistance.

name: Casting Tokens
description: Invested transport devices given to outer council members that serve as tokens for Magvillus's Aegis of the Hearth.

name: Casting Tools
description: Tools that Verditius magi must use to cast Formulaic and Ritual spells; they can be enchanted via an Inner House Mystery and become permanent Arcane Connections.

name: Casting Total
description: The total (Stamina + Form + Technique + Aura + stress die) determining whether a spell is cast, used notably when casting from a Casting Tablet.

name: Castle
description: Fortification serving as refuge, staging ground and statement of status; described by Garrison, Defenses and Supplies.

name: Castra Solis
description: The domus magna of House Flambeau in the Provençal Tribunal, a modest manor-house covenant founded by Kaeso atop a cave once sacred to Mithras, south of Bordeaux.

name: Castrum Antiquum
description: Covenant founded in 852 in the ruins of a Roman fort on Hadrian's Wall; vanished without trace around 1030/1; home of Agricola of Tytalus.

name: Cat
description: A covered mobile shelter protecting attackers as they move to the base of castle walls.

name: Cathedral School Master
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for a character who teaches at a cathedral school, requiring scores of 5 in Latin and Artes Liberales and granting 240 experience points.

name: Caudelix the Gaul
description: A ghostly gladiator (Magic Might 20) of the Trier amphitheater, a burly giant of a man wielding a long-handled great axe.

name: Cause Drowsiness
description: Faerie power (Corpus or Animal) causing a touched human to fall asleep.

name: Cause Fatigue
description: Faerie power causing a human to lose a fatigue level.

name: Cause Sickness
description: Faerie power (Corpus) causing a serious illness by touch or poisoning objects.

name: Caves of Naours
description: Underground village with a Magic aura of 2, protected by a pact with a cave genius loci.

name: Celeres of Bonisagus
description: A Bonisagus magus living at Cunfin who strives to live by the chivalric ideals of the romances; next in seniority for Praeco after Renita, which worries Proctor.

name: Celestial Disorientation
description: Overwhelming effect on mortals entering a celestial regio, resisted with Stamina + Dominion Lore against regio rating x3.

name: Cellarer
description: Official responsible for provision of food and drink.

name: Centaury of Virtue
description: Herb of Virtue listed with a +3 Flight shape and material bonus.

name: Ceremonial Spontaneous Magic
description: A Minor Flaw possessed by all known members of the Mercurian lineage as part of the Mercurian Magic Virtue.

name: Chaldeans
description: Ancient people whose secret lore was in Bonisagus's library.

name: Chamber of Invisibility
description: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 25) that makes a Group of creatures invisible; any affected character who moves or is touched makes everyone visible, and all still cast shadows.

name: Chancellor
description: Master of the king's correspondence and chief advisor on foreign relations and the Church, almost always a priest.

name: Change Size
description: A Muto Terram effect (MuTe 10) enchanted into Falke's talisman that turns it into a leg-band, triggered by Perceive the Change.

name: Chantry
description: Minor Church Boon: income from reciting Masses for the dead.

name: Chaos of the Angry Wave
description: Spell (ReAq 20) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Chapel That Cannot Sleep
description: A chapel raised on an ancient battlefield where mythic death-roads converge, disturbing the sleeping dead near an unfortunate covenant.

name: Chaplain
description: Priest serving a chapel, such as a covenant chapel.

name: Charger
description: A war horse from the Book of Mundane Beasts used as Aeolus's base.

name: Charity
description: Theological virtue of complete love of God; at True Faith 5 the character radiates an Empyreal aura.

name: Charles the Fat
description: Emperor who reunited Charlemagne's empire in 881, deposed 887.

name: Charlotte filia Lupina
description: Timid Merinita maga, daughter of a goose maiden, with latent skinchanging ability.

name: Charm (Ability)
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Charm Magic
description: A Minor Folk Inner Mystery (Virtue) allowing a Merinita to incorporate charms into her spells, granting Casting Total and Penetration bonuses through sympathetic magic.

name: Charmed Life
description: Virtue Sabastien may have and Andru has, which Andru wrongly attributes to his relic of Cyrian.

name: Chartae
description: Single-use learned magician device created quickly, whose single charge is expended upon creation.

name: Charter of the Forest
description: A charter issued in 1217 alongside the Magna Carta reissue, restricting the king's forest rights and limiting forest officials from imposing penalties of life or limb.

name: Chess
description: Game with Old, Prima and Expedition variants popular among Tremere.

name: Chester
description: A small walled city and capital of the palatine county of Cheshire where the earl of Chester is the highest authority, with a leather trade and a pagan shrine of Minerva carved into nearby rock.

name: Cheviot Hills
description: Hills along the Tyne where the covenant of Horsingas is located.

name: Childbed Fever Demon
description: A demon with Might 10 (Corpus) that attempts to enter a woman's body during birth, causing fever and rotting of the reproductive organs; its magical attack can be resisted with Magic Resistance.

name: Childermas
description: December 28th, when ghosts of dead apprentices are said to haunt their masters.

name: Children of Hermes
description: Messianic mystery cult led by Hermes the Blessed One, who claims apotheosis; proselytizing and obsessed with conspiracies in the Order.

name: Children of Odin
description: A new, secretive Mystery Cult led by Queen Skuld claiming the heritage of Viking magic and seeking to restore Normandy to Norman rule.

name: Chiron
description: The figure who warned Jason that the Argonauts would be lost unless Orpheus accompanied them, a prophecy fulfilled at the sirens' island.

name: Chloe
description: Valnastium's chief minstrel, a composer of ethereal choral prayers that are magical when performed by others; possibly a unique Natural Magician.

name: Chlotar
description: Son of Clovis under whom Soissons was the Frankish capital.

name: Christian Mysticism
description: Mystical state understood as a form of prayer imparting direct personal knowledge of God, with rules for play.

name: Christina of Markyate
description: Noble Anglo-Saxon girl from Huntingdon who vowed virginity and resisted her forced marriage to Burthred.

name: Christmas
description: Feast of Christ's nativity on December 25, beginning a twelve-day holy season during which realm boundaries blur.

name: Church of Saint Aquila
description: A first-century Jewish tentmaker converted by Saint Paul in Corinth whose Roman house became a church; he and his wife were martyred.

name: Church of the Holy Sepulcher
aliases: church of the Holy Sepulcher in Jerusalem
description: A holy site in Jerusalem with an extremely strong Divine aura; casting a spell there incurs the maximum example of botch dice.

name: Chytus Harbor
description: Man-made harbor on Bear Island's eastern tip where Herakles fought the Gegenees; Faerie aura 3, strewn with vis-bearing boulders.

name: Cian
description: One of the five great Welsh poets believed by the Order to have left Daimons behind after death.

name: Cinderella
description: Fairy-tale heroine whose slippers Charles Perrault changed to glass, creating a resonant image.

name: Cinquefoil of Virtue
description: Herb of Virtue listed with shape and material bonuses of +3 Leadership and +1 Rego Mentem.

name: Circulus Ruber
description: The oldest covenant in the Hibernian Tribunal, plagued by a Cailleach (an evil faerie hag) that cannot breach its Aegis of the Hearth.

name: Circum Perfico
description: Elderly Criamon maga who believes a Hermes Portal between the Cave and the North Pole would align the Earth's axis with its magical fields.

name: Cirque d'Annibal
description: Circle of ten monoliths where Hannibal held council; ill-omened.

name: Clan Arelie
description: The 'Remember' clan of House Bjornaer, the most outward-looking and Harmonist (pacifist), preserving stories and teaching of the ancestors.

name: Clan Maruhs
description: The 'Strive' clan of House Bjornaer, romantic, passionate Wilderists known for wildness and as poets and heroes.

name: Clan Midusulf
description: The 'Lead' clan of House Bjornaer, arch-conservative Wilderists most opposed to the Harmonists, with the deepest understanding of the Mystery of the Heartbeast.

name: Clan Sirnas
description: The 'Protect' clan of House Bjornaer, the most active Harmonist clan and protectors of all Bjornaer magi, which absorbed most ninth-century Merinita defectors.

name: Clan Wilkis
description: The 'Nourish' clan of House Bjornaer, Harmonists who strengthen the House, enforce Council decisions, and hunt down those who endanger the House.

name: Clansman
description: Grog template representing the typical armed Highland clansman and herdsman.

name: Claudius
description: Roman emperor who expelled all Jews from Rome.

name: Clenching Hand of the Crushed Heart
description: Spell; six vis-backed castings incapacitate Gull.

name: Cloak of Black Feathers
description: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 30) with an Animal requisite that transforms the caster into a raven via a cape of raven feathers.

name: Closing the Campfire
description: PeIg 5 cantation that extinguishes a fire the caster touches, popular with Flambeau apprentices.

name: Clouds of Thunderous Might
description: A Rego Auram spell (Level 30) that gathers pre-existing clouds and winds into a small storm under the caster's control while they can see it.

name: Cockerel of Virtue
description: Beast of Virtue whose crowing drives away nocturnal spirits; the only beast that cows Pentele.

name: Cocoon of the Mulberry Worm
description: Miklos's CrAn 30 spell wrapping a target in layers of silk.

name: Code of Garus
description: The written code of chivalric conduct for the milites, devised by Primus Garus and loosely based on Charlemagne's code for his knights.

name: Coenobium
description: Community of magi not meeting vis requirements to be a covenant.

name: Coenwulf
description: Bjornaer magus of Horsingas with a boar heartbeast and tusks, common-law husband of Ealwynn.

name: Coils of Entangling Plants
description: A Rego Herbam spell (ReHe 20) known by Ioannes Acer with Mastery in Fast Casting.

name: Colens Arcanorum
description: A House Bonisagus office, held by Andrus, jointly responsible for disseminating the House's knowledge and research.

name: Colomen
description: The leader of the Columbae tradition when it officially joined the Order, who with his wife Gwyndolen adapted their ward-powers to Hermetic magic and spread their spells.

name: Comfort of the Drenched Traveler
description: A Perdo Aquam spell (Level 5) that dries a person and their clothes.

name: Command Animals
description: Major Supernatural Tainted Virtue letting the character mentally command mundane animals of a species associated with the demon who tainted him.

name: Commencailles
description: Canonical hour of the Divine Office: 5 pm service marking the end of the day's labors.

name: Commune with Mercury
description: InVi 20 ritual to commune with the god Mercury.

name: Communes
description: Northern Italian city-republics independent of the Holy Roman Empire.

name: Composer of Power
description: A Virtue or Magic Quality named among the traits of magical animals or dragons in this text.

name: Concentrated Potions
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue allowing a folk witch to use up to four times her Folk Witch Magic Theory in vis when brewing.

name: Concordat of Worms
description: Charter signed in 1122 dividing rights between Pope Calixtus II and Emperor Henry V over investiture of bishops.

name: Confession of the Penitent
description: A Power held by the She-Wolf that a lupercus can acquire as a Lesser Power Virtue instead of Scales of the Heart.

name: Confirmation
description: Sacrament in which a Christian receives the Holy Spirit, granting a Faith Point.

name: Confusion of the Insane Vibrations
description: A Rego Imaginem spell (Level 30) that makes the target see everything vibrate and hear displaced sounds, imposing -3 on Attack and Defense and extra botch dice.

name: Conjure
description: Faerie Power producing solid glamours and transforming targets into glamours.

name: Consecration of Mercury's House
description: CrVi 55 ritual consecrating a temple to Mercury and creating a Magic aura 1.

name: Consumed Casting Tools
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw, only for Verditius magi: the magus's casting tools are magically consumed after use, taking an hour to remake.

name: Control Fertility
description: A Supernatural Ability that enhances or withdraws the vegetative spirits in living things, affecting fertility, milk yield, conception, and disease; the defining Virtue of the Scinnfolk.

name: Control Human
description: Typical spirit power of eidolons, lugra, and some genii loci.

name: Conversing with the Sea
description: Auvekoejak power allowing them to ask questions of their local part of the ocean.

name: Convoluted Mind
description: Minor General Tainted Virtue giving +3 to Infernal Lore rolls to predict demons and a Common Sense-like feeling when dealing with demons.

name: Copper Rooster Inn
description: An inn at Basel maintained by House Mercere, frequented by Redcaps traveling between the Alps, Rhine, and Normandy Tribunals.

name: Corrupted Arts
description: A Minor Hermetic Tainted Flaw: a Hermetic Art was studied from a corrupted source, giving +3 to Casting Total for sinful use and -3 for selfless use; tainted magic appears unholy.

name: Corrupted Knowledge
description: Watchers Power corrupting taught Abilities, granting the Corrupted (Ability) Flaw.

name: Corrupted Spells
description: A Minor Hermetic Tainted Flaw: at least 30 levels of formulaic spells learned from a corrupted source, giving +3 to Casting and Penetration for sinful use and -3 for selfless use.

name: Corvus of Bjornaer
description: A mature Bjornaer magus of Voluntas with a raven Heartbeast, specializing in Intellego magic and suspected of scrying on other magi.

name: Council of Troyes
description: Council where the Templars officially received their rule.

name: Count Gwyridden
description: A daoine sith count of the Crun Clach faerie court who has played shinty for centuries; proud and conceited, sworn to Caitlin, and a champion shinty player among faeries.

name: Court of Dark Summer
description: An Unseelie faerie court associated with dark, fire, warmth, and agriculture, found in midsummer in the swampy Hunsruck forest west of the Rhine Gorge; rival to Bright Winter.

name: Covenant Chapel
description: Example chapel built in a glen near a covenant tower on the site of a pagan temple, with a Divine aura of 3.

name: Covenant Lore
description: An Ability concerning knowledge of a covenant; under the Stuck in Your Ways Flaw the character uses the lower of an Ability and his current Covenant Lore for certain Stress Rolls.

name: Coventry
description: An English town near which the Redcaps' base, Mercer House, is situated.

name: Craft the Mechanism
description: Cr(In)Te 35 Ritual used to magically craft the mechanism of an armillary sphere, requiring design and Finesse rolls.

name: Craft: Goldsmith
description: A Craft Ability for goldsmithing whose higher scores represent more precise, time-consuming metalworking methods.

name: Craft: Runes
description: Ability to carve or inscribe runes, affecting durability and hiding.

name: Craft: Smith
description: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

name: Cralian of Tremere
description: A magus of House Tremere whose version of Disguise of the New Visage always produces a visage as unassuming as possible.

name: Creeping Chasm
description: A Rego Terram spell that creates a chasm running from the caster's feet toward a target, growing wider as it travels.

name: Creeping Oil
description: A Creo Aquam spell (Level 15) that saturates a porous material with flammable oil which, if ignited, causes fire damage.

name: Croatia
description: Part of the Transylvanian Tribunal.

name: Crossbow
description: Missile weapon spanned with a belt hook; Strength does not add to Damage.

name: Crossroads (Range)
description: Infernal Range letting the caster affect a target on a road intersecting his own; equal to Range Voice.

name: Crown of Forgetfulness
description: A crown Morgana placed on Ogier's head; dislodging it let him escape Avalon.

name: Crown of Thorns
description: Relic displayed flowering in the grand master's hands every Holy Thursday.

name: Crucifixio
description: Andru's black cat familiar, a member of the Black Lineage, who could talk before he was bound.

name: Crucifixo
description: The current Jerbiton Primus's familiar, a cat of the Black Lineage who is not yet the King of the Cats but may become so when the current king (his mentor) dies.

name: Crumstone Rock
description: Outer islet of the Farne Islands whose mysterious inhabitant is one of the archipelago's mysteries.

name: Crystal Geodes
description: Vis site: a cave under the highest hill where crystals grow, giving up to 4 pawns of Terram vis sordida yearly.

name: Cu (Greyhound)
description: The Scottish deerhound or greyhound, a slender sight-hunting dog kept by most Highland households to hunt and protect herds.

name: Cult of Saints
description: Christian veneration of saints in which relics play an important part.

name: Cum Delicti
description: Letter of approval from Pope Honorius commanding prelates to receive the Little Brothers as Catholic faithful.

name: Cunning-folk
description: Rural, mostly unGifted magicians close to faeries who use charms to aid peasants.

name: Cure Blindness
description: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

name: Curious Nun
description: Example character from Realms of Power: The Divine who could join a covenant as a refugee.

name: Curse of Thoth
description: Greater PeVi ritual cursing a magical group with misfortune and Twilight Prone; cast against Diedne in the Schism War.

name: Curse of the Baby's Bladder
description: ReCo 4 cantation that makes the target release his water; unfortunately popular with apprentices.

name: Cyclic Magic (negative)
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw: the magus's magic is attuned to a cycle of nature and is less potent at specific times, giving -3 to Lab Totals and Casting Scores then.

name: Cymar
description: Forked stick resembling a distaff carried by each member of House Diedne.

name: Cyrillus of Argentoratum
description: A ghostly gladiator (Magic Might 20) of the Trier amphitheater, a wiry retetarius armed with trident and net and wearing a mask of Poseidon.

name: Dalriada
description: The old kingdom in the West of Scotland where some people keep pigs.

name: Damaged
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is partially damaged, e.g. from an accident, taking one season to repair (-2 General Quality, -1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Damhadh-Duidas
description: A Gaelic hedge wizard from the same magical tradition as Damhan-Allaidh who joined Pralix's crusade against the warlock; eponym of the Damhadh-Duidsan tradition.

name: Daria la Gris
description: Co-leader of the Apple Gild and princeps of Triamore, a follower of House Tremere who favors forming the Lotharingian Tribunal; a stern 67-year-old Master.

name: Dark Faerie
description: Faeries of a dark kind, including vampires, not strictly infernal spirits, with widely varying vulnerabilities.

name: Dark Gnostics
description: Corrupt Infernal tradition of Gnostic heretics who preach that sinful acts have moral value, often using the serpent as their symbol.

name: Dark faeries
description: Malevolent faeries who care only that stories end in screaming and blood; can enter houses via holly invitation and hunt bean kings.

name: Daughter of Zephyrs
description: Kentigern's CrAn(Re) 45 spell creating a magical horse that gallops through the air.

name: Daughters of Erictho
description: Non-Hermetic Thessalian wizards who did not join the Order, dwelling in the Cambunian Mountains; suspected of diabolism and demon worship.

name: Daughters of Four Fathers
description: An all-female magical tradition found in north Africa, particularly associated with the Skinchanger (Dove) Virtue.

name: Dav'nalleous
description: The foe against whom Pralix waged war; her final battle with him was at the site where Cad Gadu was founded.

name: David I
description: King of Scotland from 1124 who molded the kingdom on the Anglo-Norman model, founded royal burghs and Melrose Abbey.

name: David ben David
description: A wealthy, devout Jewish merchant of Trier who manages a wine shop above the former covenant of Treverorum; suggested as a companion character.

name: Days of Trembling
description: February, when Alpine apprentices are tested and archmages declare which challenger they will receive.

name: De Lapii
description: The Branch of Terram in 1220, a Summa on Terram of Level 17 and Quality 14, written by Jeremias filius Guernicus.

name: De Theoria Magica
description: Bonisagus' authority on Magic Theory, often chosen as the basis of a Numerologist's Book.

name: Deacon
description: Major order symbolized by a stole over the left shoulder; serves as parish clerk, canon, or archdeacon.

name: Deaf
description: A Major General Flaw: the character cannot hear at all; magi with it roll two extra botch dice when casting spells with a spoken component.

name: Dean
description: Either a rural dean heading a deanery of up to two dozen parishes, or the head of a chapter of canons responsible for its discipline.

name: Debauched Aura
description: A corrupted aura arising from self-indulgence, tarnished with Sloth, Lust or Gluttony and seductive to mundanes.

name: Decani
description: Thirty-six Angels of Punishment of Master rank, demons of disease, three per zodiac sign, each balanced by a specific angel; listed in the Testament of Solomon.

name: Decem Libri Historiarum
description: History of the Franks by Gregory of Tours with several summae.

name: Decimus
description: A House Tytalus faction member who supports Harpax, the tenth Primus; Decimi wear revolutionary green as their badge.

name: Decreased Might
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the faerie has only 1 point of Might instead of 5.

name: Deficient Arts
description: A Hermetic Flaw afflicting Sebastian, who learned Hermetic magic despite several Deficient Arts, leading him to fight using his one strong Form, Aquam.

name: Della Torre
description: Milanese family, many corrupted by pacts with Peris, defeated by the Visconti in 1277.

name: Demeter
description: A powerful nature-oriented Greek deity whose name eumolpids of the Huntress may learn through the Mysteries of Names of Power and Invocation Magic.

name: Demonic Blood
description: A Major Supernatural Tainted Virtue making a character a half-demon with Infernal Might, Infernal Powers, no need to eat, immunity to Warping, and a drastically shortened lifespan.

name: Demonic Familiar
description: A Minor Story Flaw binding the character to a famulus, a familiar demon possessing an animal, which is not loyal and pursues its own goals.

name: Demonic Might
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue (requires Demonic Blood) increasing a character's Infernal Might by 2 points.

name: Demonic Powers
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue for demon-blooded characters granting an extra 20 levels of Infernal Powers.

name: Demons of the Fifth Trump
description: Elite Furies under Abaddon, horse-like with men's faces, bat wings and scorpion tails, who will burst forth at the End of Days.

name: Dependents
description: Flaw that ties a caballero villano to his town through his family.

name: Depiction of the Waking Dream
description: An InCrMeIm 35 enchanted effect in the Mirror of Dreams that makes a subject's thoughts visible as images around his head, aiding Mentem lab work.

name: Depraved
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw where the character seeks to undermine religion and avoid the Dominion whenever possible.

name: Despair of the Quivering Manacles
description: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 15) that makes the target shake vigorously side to side, penalizing physical movement and other rolls.

name: Destiny
description: Virtue appearing in character statistics or rules in this text.

name: Destrier
description: Noble warhorse of the highest status, often Spanish and often aligned with a realm.

name: Deteriorating Power
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw that reduces the effectiveness of one of the character's powers over time, linked to age, Might, or Warping Score.

name: Devil's Lane
description: A small Faerie regio (aura 6) housing a faerie toy market, whose central looping lane has many alleyway entrances to cities throughout Mythic Europe.

name: Devil's Lane Covenant
description: A Merinita covenant opposite Florence Avenue, founded by Bartholomew after his Gauntlet, home to him and Julia.

name: Devon
description: English county whose people paid King John 2,200 marks and 20 palfreys to be deforested.

name: Dexithea
description: A telechine, the last surviving of the titan smiths, who dwells deep in the sea and can craft magic items; Magic Might 45.

name: Diatribe
description: A text written to oppose a polemic, subtracting its Quality from the Argument Total.

name: Dibbukim
description: Disembodied human spirits from Jewish lore (Furies) that possess sinners and are exorcised through the little toe.

name: Difficult Longevity Ritual
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw making it difficult to create an effective Longevity Ritual for the character, halving the Lab Total of anyone who tries.

name: Dijon
description: Town near a small forest suggested for the truffle regio.

name: Dimicatio
description: A dangerous Flambeau tournament event where competitors cast real spells using forceless casting and fast-cast defenses, the first to reach the opponent's Parma winning.

name: Dionysus
description: A god originally worshipped alongside Hermes by Orpheus's society but who fell out of favor after Orpheus's death; the Maenads who killed Orpheus were devoted to him.

name: Disarm
description: Non-lethal special effect making the opponent's weapon fall; retrieving it requires an action and disengaging.

name: Disceptator
description: The chairman and spokesman of a covenant's Council of Members, a rotating mandatory office held by full members serving seven-year terms.

name: Discern Own Illusions
description: An Intellego Imaginem spell that makes the caster's own illusions appear largely transparent but still discernible.

name: Disciples of the Worm
description: A necromantic Mystery Cult founded by Vespillo that binds spirits into spells and seeks the tombs of ancient wizards.

name: Disguise
description: Ability appearing in character statistics in this text.

name: Disguised Casting
description: Cult of Mercury mastery ability to suppress or alter one's sigil.

name: Dismissing
description: Bargaining art undoing effects of beings with Might and releasing them from bargains.

name: Dissolving the Wall of Shields
description: A PeMe 20 spell that removes the procedural memories letting a group of soldiers fight as a unit, or destroys other simple group skills.

name: Distaff
description: Implement whose enchantment is rare due to anti-Druidic prejudice.

name: Divine Gloom
description: Form of Divine Ascent in which the character loses knowledge of the mundane while gaining comprehension of the Divine; akin to Hermetic Twilight.

name: Divine Heaven's Aspect
description: Spell used to learn astrological conditions at a distant location so the armillary sphere can be adjusted.

name: Djinn
description: Spirits accompanying Moslem sorcerers attacking Palermo.

name: Dog of Virtue
description: A magical dog that may heal wounds by licking them; its body parts are useful in warding.

name: Doge
description: The leader of the city of Venice, who annually casts a vis-bearing engagement ring into the sea to symbolize the city's espousal to and dominance over the waters.

name: Dome of the Rock
description: Shrine in Jerusalem housing the rock from which Muhammad ascended; Dominion aura 10.

name: Domleschg
description: Valley with 21 castles and a vis-bearing oak grove.

name: Donning the Mask of Another
description: A Tytalan MuMe 35 Ritual spell that creates a persona from the identity of a donor, granting the caster the donor's memories and personality as a deep cover disguise; it can also steal or transfer a persona.

name: Donor
description: Dramatic role of one who grants the hero a magical gift or power vital to his task, not necessarily willingly.

name: Doorkeeper
description: Lowest minor order, held by young boys training for the Church, who receive a pair of keys at ordination.

name: Dorana
description: A master maga of House Bonisagus at Fengheld, foremost of the lineage of Irmele filia Trianoma in the Tribunal, who argues for rationality but cannot stand her prima Murion.

name: Dousing
description: Exceptional Talent (MR) for finding water or lost objects.

name: Drachenfels
description: Dragon's Rock, a famous legendary site (Magic aura 3) with catacombs where the hero Siegfried slew the dragon Fafnir; crowned by Schloss Drachenfels owned by the archbishop of Cologne.

name: Drake
description: Misshapen, less intelligent caricatures of dragons with legs and often stunted wings and dangerous breath.

name: Dramatis Personae
description: The specific roles characters play in fairy tales and myths (hero, villain, donor, helper, princess, task-setter, false hero); one character can combine several roles.

name: Dream of the Mind That Sits
description: An Intellego Terram spell (with Creo requisite) that lets the caster probe and perfect the memories of a spirit within a natural stone object.

name: Dream vis
description: Vis found or existing within a dream; usable there but unable to sustain objects or effects outside the dream.

name: Dripstone
description: A brownish wax-feeling enchanted stone (chalcedonius) harvested from Pfalz Island; worn around the neck it lets the wearer perceive illusions, discern truth, and resist the Loreley's song, and is worth 1 pawn of Imaginem vis.

name: Driving Goal
description: Flaw, e.g. the Prince's to regain Crun Clach or Domnhull's to integrate gruagach magic.

name: Drowned Men
description: Sailors drowned and returned by a magical force as creatures of magic.

name: Druia
description: A succubus of the Tempters with Infernal Might 5 who appears as a young woman with beautiful long hair and works in the sex trade between missions.

name: Duke
description: The highest class of French vassal (dux, duc), sometimes more powerful than the king. The title is not used in Britain.

name: Dulia
description: Honor due to a man or power according to its dignity, such as veneration of a saint.

name: Dunkeld
description: Cattle market city with a large cathedral.

name: Duplicate the Magi's Spell
description: Deluder Powers duplicating Hermetic spells of a given Technique (Creation, Perception, Transformation).

name: Durendal
description: Roland's magic sword, forged by Wayland Smith with Verditius as apprentice, later stolen by Roscius and studied by the Confraternity of Roland; used in their Initiations.

name: Durenmar Lore
description: An Ability reflecting a magus' familiarity with the contents of the Great Library, addable to study rolls there with a cumulative penalty.

name: Duresca
description: Iberian covenant raided by Children of Hermes; rumored Guernicus conspiracy center.

name: Dust to Dust
description: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 15) that turns a dead body or mindless undead to dust in two rounds; does not affect undead possessed by spirits.

name: Each Sith
description: Faerie horse bred for high faeries of the seelie court, able to run over water; Caitlin keeps about a dozen at Crun Clach.

name: Each Uisge
description: The water horse, a dark faerie of beach and sea-loch that shifts between black horse and handsome man, with sticky skin that traps victims to be devoured.

name: Eadric Wilde
description: A lord who captured and married a faerie woman, becoming famous and being summoned to London by King William Rufus; he lost her when he reproached her about her sisters.

name: Ealwynn
description: Bjornaer maga of Horsingas with a stoat/ermine heartbeast whose arts shift with the seasons.

name: Earl
description: English and Scottish equivalent of a count (comes, comte). An earl has the Great Noble Virtue and spends at least 1000 pounds a year.

name: Earring of Whispering Voices
description: A silver earring scrying device letting its wearer hear a distant person's voice.

name: Ears of the Hare
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: Earthly Paradise
description: Home of the boni non valde where purged souls wait in bliss for Judgment Day; a Celestial regio of level 8 ruled by the Archangel Shamshiel.

name: Eastern Priest
description: Minor Status Virtue like Priest but without required celibacy.

name: Eastern Roman Empire
description: The cosmopolitan eastern realm ('Romania') whose Greek-cultured cities produced House Jerbiton's founding members and the League of Iconophiles.

name: Eccelino da Romano
description: Tyrant of Verona and Lombardy, possessed by the demon Peris until Magi drove it out in 1259.

name: Echo filia Gribbinus
description: Criamon Mentem specialist with an affinity for ghosts, secretly in love with a Criamon ghost three centuries dead.

name: Eden
description: The biblical paradise from which man was expelled; noxious plants are said to have acquired harmful qualities after the expulsion.

name: Edgar
description: The newest Redcap of the Stonehenge Tribunal, in his early twenties, good-looking with light brown hair and gray eyes, with no magical items yet.

name: Edgar Atheling
description: Saxon heir-apparent whom Horsingas originally sought to restore.

name: Educated (Islamic)
description: Minor General Virtue for characters educated in a mosque or Qur'an school, granting 50 experience points in Arabic, Persian, Greek, Latin, Theology: Islam, Islamic Law and Artes Liberales.

name: Edward the White of Jerbiton
description: A magus skilled in the magic of the sea, famed for unsuccessful attempts to find Atlantis, who leads The Single Ocean league from his enchanted ship.

name: Effigy of the Errant Image
description: A small wooden statue letting the user project his image to a connected location for two-way communication.

name: Eginhard filius Caspar
description: Bjornaer magus with a lammergeir heartbeast, pair-bonded to Kamilla; glacially patient schemer.

name: Eiael
description: Eiael, Aid to the Wise, an angel (Divine Might 20) tasked with guarding lovers of wisdom who pursue magical arts; he teaches practitioners of Ars Notoria and may be summoned via Psalm 36.

name: Eider Duck of Virtue
description: Magic Animal eider ducks aligned to both Magic and Divine, whose Quell the Savage Waves power calms waves.

name: Einherjar
description: Spiritual warriors awaiting Ragnarok, into whom Valkyries transform the worthy dead chosen from battle.

name: Einsiedeln
description: Benedictine abbey town, the tribunal's most important pilgrimage site.

name: Eirik Svennson
description: 29-year-old Norwegian warrior vitki serving the king of Norway under his uncle Sven Svennson, a member of the birkebeiners stationed near Trondheim.

name: Eisenstadt
description: Settlement marking the tribunal border.

name: Elaine
description: Flambeau's second apprentice, a Frankish girl who became a Hoplite, Archmage, and scholar; she trained four apprentices and authored several enduring books.

name: Elder Futhark
description: The original 24-rune alphabet used by the vitkir in their earliest spells, the strongest form of rune magic.

name: Elemental Control
description: Power common to all Aerial Powers controlling an element (fire, earth, air).

name: Elemental Medicine
description: Major background Virtue of elemental physicians; acquired through the Ritual of Improving the Physician's Character.

name: Elemental Philosopher
description: Elementalist of the Philosophical type who conjures natural phenomena, matter and animals.

name: Elemental Philosophiae
description: Major background Virtue of elemental philosophers, acquired through the Ritual of Making the Soul Actually Knowledgeable.

name: Elemental Physician
description: Elementalist of the Medicinal type who manipulates bodily humors.

name: Elemental Theurgist
description: Elementalist of the Theurgical type who summons and commands elementals.

name: Elemental Theurgy
description: Special background Virtue of elemental theurgists that could be converted into a Hermetic Virtue with a Minor Breakthrough.

name: Elemental spirit
description: A spirit that broke free of an ancient binding and caused rockslides in the Black Mountains in revenge on humanity; Goliard restored its binding and took control of it.

name: Elementalist Air
description: Difficult Elementalist Form of air, affecting sanguine humors, weather, birds and air elementals.

name: Elementalist Arts
description: The Techniques and Forms of elementalist magic, traditionally said to have been developed by Apollonius of Tyana and his followers.

name: Elementalist Earth
description: Difficult Elementalist Form of earth, affecting melancholic humors, minerals and earth elementals.

name: Elementalist Fire
description: Elementalist Form for fire; associated with choleric temperament and produces Ignem vis when Refining.

name: Elementalist Water
description: Difficult Elementalist Form of water, affecting phlegmatic humors, liquids and water elementals.

name: Elias Bonibarone
description: Minister General of the Little Brothers, born 1180 at Belvilia; handles active leadership as Francis' health fails and is tempted by acquiring land and money.

name: Elijah
description: Patriarch who almost destroyed the archangel Azrael.

name: Elisavet
description: Apostle of Apollonius elemental theurgist, 51, exiled daughter of a Hermetic advisor, living on a Mediterranean island with a bound air elemental.

name: Eliza
description: Old unGifted folk witch living in the Reims townhouse, a healer of the poor whose rooster is her familiar.

name: Eloi of Cunfin
description: Pious Jerbiton magus of Cunfin, Jerome's filius, liaison to the Church.

name: Ely
description: An abbey and bishopric, site of the tomb of St. Etheldreda and a pilgrimage destination; setting of Bricstan's miraculous deliverance.

name: Embrace of Boethius
description: A Perdo Mentem 35 ritual spell that damages a magus's mind, heart, and Gift, forcing reliance on casting tools, used to initiate other Hermetic magi into House Verditius.

name: Empiricus
description: A character specializing in one surgical or medical procedure, often itinerant; a derogatory term used by the literate medical profession for the unlearned.

name: Employed by Company
description: A minor Story Flaw for salaried employees answerable to an employer but backed by the company's resources; suits characters working primarily for a salary.

name: Empty
description: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab has a large amount of unused space, costlier to maintain; taken per two points by which Size exceeds occupied Size.

name: Encased Vis
description: The most common faerie vis: Magic vis over which a faerie has laid glamour to claim it.

name: Enchant Casting Tools
aliases: Enchant Casting Tools — Minor House Mystery
description: A Minor House Inner Mystery of Verditius allowing a magus to enchant his casting tools to mirror mastered spell effects and grant casting bonuses.

name: Enchantment of the Scrying Device
description: In(Forms) general Mystery effect enchanted into a divinatory device, giving a magical bonus of effect level/10 to divination.

name: Endurance of the Enraged
description: Furies Power ignoring wound penalties except on Defense.

name: Energy Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue from breaking the Limit of Energy, granting new Creo and Perdo Corpus Fatigue guidelines.

name: Enervators
description: Deluders that lurk around magicians making their magic appear stronger and promoting overconfidence, via the Deceiver's Boost Power.

name: English Channel
description: Northern boundary, with a regio of Viking wrecks.

name: Enliven the Gross Earth
description: Ritual power used by truffle daughters and the Matron to create an Earth Elemental.

name: Entisimon
description: A Primus of House Flambeau who rallied the House during the Schism War but was disgraced and forced to resign during the Normandy Crisis.

name: Environmental Magic Condition
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw halving all of the character's Casting and Lab Totals in certain common environmental conditions.

name: Epiphany
description: Feast ending the kallikantzaroi's time on the surface, with the Blessing of the Waters.

name: Epirus
description: Seat of a claimant to the Byzantine Empire.

name: Eric
description: A reckless magus of House Tytalus and co-founder of Waddenzee, a Danish generalist who favors Aquam and Auram and embraces the pirate lifestyle.

name: Eris
description: Figure in The Iliad who pitched the world into war for amusement.

name: Es-Sindibad
description: Sindbad of the Sea and of the Land from A Thousand and One Nights.

name: Esther filia Gribbinus
description: Criamon Imaginem specialist petrified by faeries whose ghost-like form may be a juno created by Twilight.

name: Esztergom
description: Future Templar site in Hungary.

name: Euclid
description: Greek philosopher whose teachings the Brethren of Purity combined in their encyclopedia.

name: Eurydice
description: Orpheus's beloved wife who died of a viper's bite and whom he tried to recover from the Underworld.

name: Evil Destiny
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the Infernal realm has taken an unexplained interest in the character, who must guard against dark forces.

name: Evocation
description: Faerie Method (Communication) that ritually calls on faerie gods, costing a Warping or Confidence Point, and allows spending vis on rites.

name: Excommunicate
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character has been cast out of the Church for crimes against God, gaining a bad reputation and losing access to the sacraments.

name: Expel Demons
description: Saint power expelling a demon back to Hell, like Demon's Eternal Oblivion.

name: Expert Potion Brewer
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue doubling the Supernatural Ability in the Lab Total when brewing potions.

name: Extended Glamor
description: Faerie power granting awareness of everything within a chosen domain and producing vis; lets faeries extend auras.

name: External vis source
description: Virtue or creature Quality listed for a being (Anne, Minerva Sulis, Balneator) or setting feature described here.

name: Extra Arts
description: Virtue appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Extractor of (Form) Vis
description: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue allowing a magus to extract vis of a chosen Form from a Magic aura whose features exemplify that Form.

name: Extraordinary Results
description: Chart used for botched spell-binding with Modified Effect, Side Effect and Disaster tables.

name: Extraordinary Vis
