description: Vis from places of great power that emulates a magical device or replicates a spell.

name: Extreme Unction
description: Last Rites absolving mortal sins and protecting the soul from supernatural powers for three days after death.

name: Eye of Hephaestus
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a craftsman innately tell the quality of a manufactured item by touch, including whether it is flawed or magical. Called the Eye of St Dunstan for Christian characters.

name: Eyes of the Bat
description: A Hermetic spell whose vision is mimicked by the Eyes of the Bat creature Quality, letting a beast see as magi do under that spell.

name: Eyes of the Treacherous Terrain
description: An Intellego Terram spell that lets the caster intuitively tell if any natural terrain they see is treacherous, such as a rock field prone to sliding.

name: Faerie Antipathy
description: Major or Minor Supernatural Flaw giving a negative Sympathy Trait.

name: Faerie Calling
description: Dream-like experience when a faerie-aligned character gains 2+ Warping Points at once; resolving it grants or reduces Sympathy Traits, and at high Faerie Rank the character is transformed and lost to Faerieland.

name: Faerie Doctor (Virtue)
description: The Free Mythic Companion Virtue defining a character as a faerie doctor, required of all faerie doctors.

name: Faerie Enmity
description: A Flaw cursing the exsules's line, stemming from Quendalon's ancient curse, causing faeries to instinctively hate them.

name: Faerie Eyes
description: Faerie ability that allows seeing through glamour, e.g. to find the door of Crun Clach.

name: Faerie Metamorphosis
description: Flaw required to acquire a glamour through Warping if the character experiences Warping through other means.

name: Faerie Method
description: Supernatural Ability describing what a faerie wizard does to draw upon Faerie power to perform a rite; examples are Evocation, Enchantment, and Empathy.

name: Faerie Noble
description: Faeries serving as monarchs of lesser courts or principal agents of great monarchs or pagan gods.

name: Faerie Queen
description: A vengeful faerie queen who curses a knight's fertility and lands for rejecting her in a story seed.

name: Faerie Rank
description: The character's highest positive Sympathy Trait modified by the lowest negative one, measuring strength of connection to Faerie.

name: Faerie Regio of Dindyméné
description: A Faerie regio (aura 6) above the temenos on Mount Dindymon, home to the ten Idaian Daktyls in stone and log huts.

name: Faerie Trods
description: Hermetic term for areas of space connecting places, like paths between regio levels, used by Portage.

name: Faerie Wizard
description: Characters with Faerie Sympathy who practice faerie rites or faerie bargaining, organized into traditions.

name: Failed Journeyman
description: A Minor Social Status Flaw for a character expelled from his guild for illegal practices, unable to practice his trade legally, with a bad Reputation of 2 in town.

name: Failed Master
description: A Minor Social Status Flaw for a character who ran his workshop into the ground and must work as a journeyman, with a bad Reputation of 4 in town.

name: Failed Student
description: A Minor Story Flaw for a character who studied for a university license but failed the final examination, gaining a Bad Academic Reputation of 2.

name: Falconer
description: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for a character who trains hawks and falcons for a noble patron, granting Profession: Falconer and extra experience points.

name: Falkes de Breaute
description: A powerful commoner-noble who professes loyalty to the king while disregarding central government; holds custody of the earl of Devon's lands and disputes manors with the earl of Pembroke.

name: False Hero
description: Infrequent dramatic role of one who tries to claim credit for the hero's actions, always uncovered in time.

name: Familiar Bond
description: A Hermetic enchantment binding a magus to a familiar; it can be dispelled by Perdo Vim and is automatically re-sustained when a magus enters an Aegis.

name: Farid al-Din 'Attar
description: Persian mystical poet and author of Tadhkirat al-Awliya'.

name: Farne Islands
description: Small archipelago in the Stonehenge Tribunal off Northumberland, with a saint's influence on the inner islands and wilder forces, selkie courts and demons on the outer ones.

name: Farrago Bonisagi
description: A maga of House Bonisagus in the late 1000s who joined House Merinita to research faerie powers and discovered the three faerie cords (leaden, iron, and tin) for binding faerie familiars.

name: Fascination
description: Caitlin's faerie power making people desire her praise and follow reasonable requests, equivalent to ReMe 25.

name: Fast Action
description: An optional combat action type; issuing orders, designating a vanguard, or shooting a loaded crossbow with Ready Missiles can be fast actions.

name: Fast Casting
description: Casting a spell as a reaction to resolve before an attack; an optional rule uses Action Priority as its Ease Factor.

name: Fasting
description: Penitential abstinence lasting a season, giving +1 to Petitioning a Saint but a constant Fatigue level.

name: Father Tino of Gradara
description: Aged Cistercian abbot and diabolist, illuminated while reading Joachim's books, who leads the secret Illuminati within the Cistercian order to immanentize the eschaton.

name: Fearful Flaming Eyes
description: Faerie power (Corpus) paralyzing a human who makes eye contact.

name: Feast of the Fae
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a faerie recover 5 Might by receiving traditional sacrifices from humans, once per day.

name: Felicia
description: A freshly Gauntleted journeyman maga, filia of Dorana of Fengheld and a descendant of Trianoma in the lineage of Irmele, who works weather magic and travels the Tribunal.

name: Fenicil's Rituals
description: The secret rituals of House Guernicus, translated from ancient Mercurian, Egyptian, Greek and Babylonian texts; one involved human sacrifice during the Schism War.

name: Fenistour
description: A figure who invented casting tools allowing Verditius magi to cast Formulaic spells; her filii later developed methods of enchanting those tools.

name: Fennel of Virtue
description: An herb of virtue containing 2 pawns of Vim vis; when Enriched its hardened stalk wielded as a wand drives away evil spirits as a Greater Power.

name: Fetiales
description: Redcaps from Rorschach traveling in threes to deliver declarations of Wizard's War, carrying salt, coal and the complaint.

name: Fickle Nature
description: A Minor Personality Flaw causing the character to swing between two directly opposite personality behaviors with no middle ground.

name: Fictiles
description: Aerial Power demons of wet clay that shapechange into domestic animals and corrupt families through minor calamities.

name: Fidaʾi
description: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for an assassin of the Nizari Isma'ilis trained in daggers and disguise, prepared to die on the sect's orders.

name: Fidelus
description: A House Tytalus faction member who is a loyalist of Buliste, the ninth Prima; Fideli wear royal purple as their badge.

name: Fifth Crusade
description: Crusade that set off in 1217, at Damietta in 1220.

name: Figurine Magic
description: An ancient non-Hermetic tradition, integrated via a Major Breakthrough as a Supernatural Ability, of enchanting wax or wood figurines for a specific recipient with Minor Virtues or Hermetic spells.

name: Fill the Capacious Silo
description: Spell or effect listed in the contents of Transforming Mythic Europe.

name: Fingerbone of Cyrian
description: Relic of Cyrian sewn into white silk, carried by Andru.

name: Finistere
description: Far western coast of Brittany where Nolwenn grew up.

name: Fire giants
description: Norse giants dwelling in Muspelheim with Greater Immunity to fire.

name: Flabbergast the Impertinent
description: A sample relic power (2 points, Init +3, Mentem) that curses the target into a deep, snoring sleep for the night from which no magic can prematurely wake them.

name: Fleury
description: Abbey on the Loire at a former druidic assembly grove, resting place of St. Benedict.

name: Fluctuating Fortune
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character alternates yearly between the Wealthy Virtue and the Poor Flaw in opposition to his needs.

name: Focus Character
description: The participant in an Infernal Ceremony who possesses the required Supernatural Ability.

name: Folk Magic
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue allowing minor magic via a chosen (Realm) Lore in one of four areas: Abjuration, Divination, Healing, or Evil Eye.

name: Folk Witch Magic Theory
description: The folk witch equivalent of Magic Theory, used to brew potions, investigate potions and open the Gift; familiars can also learn it.

name: Followers of Pendule
description: A House Merinita lineage and Mystery Cult descended from Pendule's followers who Initiate the illusion Mysteries of Spell Timing, Glamour, and Perpetuity.

name: Fomoire
description: The first inhabitants of Celtic lands, children of the chthonic titan Domnu.

name: Fomóir
description: Magic giant roused at the summit of the Isle of the Sleeping Fomóir.

name: Font of Knowledge
description: A Supernatural Ability allowing a creature to attempt a task with any untrained ability as if it had a score of 2 by succeeding in an Ability check.

name: Fontevrault
description: Abbey founded in 1100 by Robert of Arbrissel in the Forest of Bart, Anjou; a double house headed by an abbess and royal burial place.

name: Footsteps of Slippery Oil
description: A Creo Aquam spell (Level 5) creating nonflammable grease from the caster's footsteps, leaving a slick area that forces Dexterity rolls.

name: Forcas
description: A Watcher and Duke of the Deluders, Duke of Rhetoric, who teaches natural magicians and hedge wizards rhetoric, logic, mathematics and Unholy Powers while claiming to be an airy spirit.

name: Foreign Upbringing
description: A Minor Personality Flaw marking the character as a foreigner from a remote corner of Mythic Europe with odd customs and a foreign Native Language.

name: Foremen Elves
description: Four elves who command the worker elves.

name: Forest Paths
description: Mystical paths through the forests of the Rhine Tribunal that a magus may explore; ascending the Glade of the Seven Waterfalls grants deeper understanding of the Forest.

name: Forest Warden
description: Royal officer inspecting the king's woodland and fining overgathering and illegal clearances.

name: Forest of Cuise
description: A vast royal hunting forest south of Compiègne stretching to the Ardennes, with no known significant faerie presence.

name: Forest of Fontainebleau
description: Rocky forest south of Paris with druidic groves, a Faerie regio, and the covenant of Lapis Crudus.

name: Form of the Zephyr
description: MuCo(Au) 40 spell transforming the caster into a strong gale wind flying at 50 miles an hour.

name: Forsaken Duration
description: Infernal Duration lasting as long as the target is tainted by the Infernal; canceled by repentance; equal to Duration Year.

name: Fortuito filius Circum Perfico
description: Criamon Seeker who studies diviners and sends predictive letters to be delivered only after disasters.

name: Fortunatus of Jerbiton
description: A magus of House Jerbiton whose Creo Imaginem illusions often have a small religious icon worked into their structure due to how he invents his spells.

name: Fountains Abbey
description: A great Cistercian abbey in Yorkshire, founded in 1132 by monks from York and a daughter house of Clairvaux, motherhouse of a wide filiation.

name: Four Humors
description: Choleric, phlegmatic, sanguine and melancholic humors corresponding to the four elements and the signs.

name: Fourth Estate
description: Proposed end state in which the Order of Hermes becomes a recognized estate of society alongside clergy, nobility and commoners, with legal rights and obligations.

name: Frail
description: A Minor General Flaw making the character weak of build with a -3 penalty to Soak score.

name: François
description: Elderly, powerful Larta blacksmith of the Village of the Vale whose smithy is intensely magical and whose kin serve as grogs across the Order.

name: Frau Holle
description: A modest Holzfrau who in the nine days before Walpurgis Night travels the land on a rickety wagon, pursued by the Wild Hunt, before ascending the Brocken and revealing herself as the goddess Walpurga.

name: Free Peasant
description: Peasants who are personally free; less than ten percent of most manors' population, most common on royal manors, assarts and new towns.

name: Freiburg
description: The largest settlement around the Black Forest, founded in 1120 by Conrad Zähringen, lying in the valley of the River Dreisam with a cathedral under construction.

name: Freiceadanan
description: Covenant guards (grogs); at Crun Clach ten who hunt the Prince's monsters, at Mac Gruagach the entire clan.

name: Friar
description: Mendicant religious; friar characters take the Mendicant Friar Virtue.

name: Fribourg
description: Town founded in 1157 by Berthold IV.

name: Frog Prince
description: Fairy-tale figure who serves the princess, becomes a moral test, needs to be helped, and grants rewards.

name: Frustration Week
description: Late April when many Wizard's Wars begin; magi exchange gifts and vis treaties are delivered.

name: Furioso
description: A Sorcerous Musician who lacks Subtle Magic, used as a contrasting example to Orlando in Performance Magic.

name: Fylgja
description: Guardian spirit that warns a galdrakona of approaching danger.

name: Gaap
description: A demon of the False Gods who claims to be a great president and mighty prince of Hell commanding 66 legions; actually ineffectual but highly persuasive and knowledgeable of Hell's intrigues.

name: Gardens of Valnastium
description: Gardens laid out by Jerbiton with snails, dormice, bees, magical plants and funerary monuments.

name: Gargouille
description: Scaled magical beast from the Seine defeated in the seventh century by St. Romanus with the sign of the cross.

name: Garland of Prosperous Harvests
description: A pole with a wreath enchanted to grow plants rapidly and nourish orchards.

name: Garvil
description: Leader of Postestas who speaks of preserving order in the Tribunal.

name: Gascony
description: A region of southwestern France, the probable birthplace of Flambeau the Founder around 715 AD.

name: Gates of Hell
description: The entrance to Hell, guarded and rated as an Infernal aura of 9; some regiones are said to reach them.

name: Gavi
description: A dibbuk, the ghost of a greedy Jewish merchant, who possesses victims and forces them into mad acts of charity.

name: Gearr
description: Hare, favorite form for Scottish shapechangers; blue mountain hare and brown hare.

name: Geas (Flaw)
description: Variable Supernatural Flaw: a Geas has been cast on you and breaking it invokes its Curse.

name: Gegenees
description: A six-armed faerie giant living on Bear Island's forested slopes that attacks intruders at Chytus Harbor; Faerie Might 20 (Terram).

name: Genius Procellosus
description: Storm spirit of the elements (Magic Might 10 Auram) claiming a Farne rock and calling storms; appears as a seabird.

name: Gentle Touch of the Purified Body
description: A Corpus spell that, under these rules, heals a Minor disease instead of a Light Wound caused by disease.

name: Geonim
description: Jewish authorities whose responsa are a major source of Rabbinical Law.

name: Ghost Touch
description: Spirit power letting the Zwergenstimme hurl rocks at enemies at a Might cost per attack.

name: Giants' Blood
description: A heritage that makes its bearer unusually large and strong; Great William has giants' blood and stands just under eight feet tall.

name: Gift of Frog's Legs
description: Spell allowing the target to jump up to 5 paces, epitomizing travel in the blink of an eye.

name: Gift of Tongues
description: Minor Heroic Virtue letting the character understand and speak any language while communicating directly with a fluent speaker; granted by the Wise Owl's Enriched skull.

name: Gift of the Frog's Legs
description: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 15) that allows the target to leap up to 15 feet vertically or 25 feet horizontally.

name: Gifted Companion
description: A character type a hedge wizard may become if the opening of his Arts fails or he declines the risk, joining the Order without full magus status.

name: Gifted Companions
description: Hedge wizards new to the Order, or those resisting conversion to Hermetic magic, who have The Gift and one or more Supernatural Abilities but do not open their Arts; the Scinnfolk are an example.

name: Gilbertine Order
description: The order of St. Gilbert of Sempringham, confined to eastern England and unique in having both male (Augustinian canons) and female (Benedictine nuns) members.

name: Gilgamesh
description: Legendary hero whom the Cult of Heroes believes can be reborn.

name: Gilles de Corbeil
description: An 80-year-old master physician and archiater (chief physician) to King Philip Augustus of France, born in northern France in 1140, who trained at Salerno under Petrus Musandinus and wrote famous summae on urine and the pulse in hexameter verse.

name: Giselle filia Bertrand
description: Merinita maga whose father was a water elemental; practical, skilled in certámen, and often represents her covenant.

name: Give
description: Gruagach Technique for granting blessings, curses, shapes and visions, and imposing geasa.

name: Glam
description: A revenant of the walking dead from The Saga of Grettir the Strong who rode on house-tops by night and terrorized a district after his death.

name: Glebe
description: Farmland reserved for the maintenance of the Church and its servants, tilled by or rented out by the priest.

name: Gnome
description: Term not used in Mythic Europe except perhaps for earth elementals; gnome-like creatures with pointy red hats have various local names.

name: Godred Crovan
description: King of Man who seized the Sudreys and Dublin.

name: Golab
description: Foe of the Seraphim, a Vessel of Iniquity specializing in sedition against God through hatred, causing riots on holy days.

name: Gorgon
description: Nursery terror faerie with snake hair, tusks, brass claws and a petrifying gaze.

name: Gorlois
description: Lord whose stronghold was Tintagel and whose wife Ygerna Uther Pendragon desired; Uther was magically disguised as him to father Arthur.

name: Gothic shapeshifters
description: An Infernal Gothic witch-cult that enslaved ancestor-spirits to shapeshift; Birna's former tradition, surviving in secret in the forests of Pomerania and reviling Birna.

name: Gourmand the Sweet-Toothed
description: A Vessel of Iniquity and spice trader who seeks power over men through taste, promoting the Silk Road trade and sugar in European cuisine.

name: Granada
description: A region whose harried magi monitor the largest uncontrolled portal at the Pillars of Hercules for creatures that might harm Europe.

name: Grant (Major Flaw)
description: Ritual faerie power (Vim) imposing a named Major Flaw as a curse.

name: Grant (Minor Flaw)
description: Ritual faerie power (Vim) imposing a named Minor Flaw upon a victim.

name: Grant (Minor Virtue)
description: Ritual faerie power (Vim) imposing a named Minor Virtue; many faerie enchanted objects use it.

name: Grant Flaw
description: A special power of the Holm Oak of Romowe that inflicts the Depression Flaw upon anyone who breaks a branch or kills an animal in its grove.

name: Grant Might
description: CrVi Mystery Effect of the Great Elixir granting Magic Might equal to half (level-20).

name: Grant of Serenity
description: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

name: Gratian
description: A Benedictine monk at Bologna who completed the Decretum, a collection of ecclesiastical laws, contributing to Bologna's legal reputation.

name: Great Dexterity
description: A Virtue providing an exceptionally high Dexterity Characteristic, taken by the glass-blower and burglar templates.

name: Great Stallion of the Camargue
description: A magical stallion who knows the Camargue better than any other living creature and flees humans with his herd.

name: Great Work
description: Beautiful learning structures created as alternatives to books that embody their creators' values, studied as summae or tractatus, costing at least 100 Mythic Pounds to build.

name: Greater Alpine Tribunal Lore
description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

name: Greater Faerie Powers
description: Virtue appearing in faerie statistics in this text (Greater Faerie Powers).

name: Greater Infernal Power
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue for corrupted beasts adding 5 to Infernal Might and granting an Infernal Power requiring a Penetration total.

name: Greater Leadership
description: Major leadership virtue.

name: Greater Saint
description: Saints of Divine Might 75, typically apostles or Church fathers, venerated throughout Mythic Europe.

name: Green Flame Powder
description: MuIg 10 powder making fire burn lime green.

name: Gremlins
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab is home to deliberately disruptive creatures, spirits, or demons (-3 Safety, +1 Warping, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Grendel
description: A troll that terrorized King Hrothgar's hall until slain by Beowulf; its kin still haunt the bogs of Zealand and plague the covenant Heorot.

name: Grey Seal
description: Variegated seals that haul out on the Farnes to breed; statistics given for cow and bull seals.

name: Gribbinus
description: Magus referenced in the index as parens of Echo and Esther.

name: Growth of the Creeping Things
description: A Muto Animal spell (Level 15) causing a small creature like an insect, mouse, or toad to grow to four times its normal size, increasing any venom.

name: Gruagach Magic
description: Verbal, personal magic based on Exceptional Talents, rolled with stress dice, affecting one target within earshot.

name: Gruagach Wisdom
description: Gruagach knowledge used like Magic Theory to research new Exceptional Talents and understand Geasa, Gifts and Curses.

name: Grudge
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character holds a strong grudge against someone in his normal social circle and seeks to outdo them.

name: Guardian of Nature
description: A Mystery (Virtue) a Vestal may learn at her second level of Initiation, joining her spirit with a Faerie aura while she remains a virgin to become a civic deity.

name: Guardian of the Threshold
description: The first entity met on entering Faerie, testing travelers' resolve by offering a choice to go on or back; may be passive, animal, human or monstrous.

name: Guardians of the Forest ruling
description: A landmark Rhine Tribunal ruling of 1053 permitting magi to actively defend wilderness areas; cited in disputes over Crintera's defense of Rugen.

name: Guazzo
description: An Avenger of Evil who poses as a guardian angel to a character with the Plagued by a Demon Flaw, punishing his charge for every character flaw.

name: Gubich
description: A morose dwarflike spirit of the Harz who dwells in moss-covered caves, can control the weather, and sometimes leads travelers astray; possibly the dwarf king.

name: Gudrun Tigurina
description: A Verditius maga at Durenmar known as the inventor of the Crystal Custodian.

name: Guest of House Criamon
description: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue making a magus a political member of House Criamon while being created with another House's rules.

name: Guild Apprentice
description: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for a youth aged 10 to 20 learning a trade from a guild master or journeyman under contract.

name: Guild Dean
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for the ultimate authority of a guild who decides important guild matters and represents it politically.

name: Guild Master
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a guild master who may legally practice his trade, hire journeymen, and participate in guild activities.

name: Guillame de Bruyse
description: Bishop of St. Andrews and primate of the Church in Scotland.

name: Gullible
description: A Minor Personality Flaw giving a -3 penalty on Guile or Perception rolls to determine truth, from the character's isolation and inexperience.

name: Gullveig
description: Northern giantess breeding wolves and witches in the Ironwood; patron of the Muspelli.

name: Gunnar Von Falster
description: Danish knight of House Tytalus who founded the Knights of the Green Stone; rumored author of Parzival.

name: Gunther Lupus
description: A magus of House Bjornaer, filius of Eule, with the heartbeast of a wolf; he perpetuates the fraud of Eule's wisdom and forms a team with the hoplite Indulius hunting oath-breakers.

name: Gwrhyr Ex Miscellanea
description: An old, blustering Columbine magus who owns the Cad Gadu island, holds a seat on the Council of Four, and whose death threatens the covenant's land tenure.

name: Gydryty-kom the Giant
description: Albanian hail giant Daimon who swallows spells and hates being called away from his fight with a fog serpent.

name: Gymir
description: A powerful demon whose earthly fief is Scandinavia, warring against Radegast and against the Dominion's incursion into the Northlands; he uses natural catastrophes, the Norse people, and the corrupted Holy Vehm as weapons.

name: Gyongy
description: A sorceress and former fellow of Bjornaer's shapeshifting tradition who condemned Bjornaer for joining the new Order of Hermes.

name: Gyrfalcon
description: Largest and most prized falcon, from cold northern lands; the base template for hawks and falcons.

name: Hadrian's Wall
description: Roman wall between the Solway and Tyne, the southern border of the Loch Leglean Tribunal.

name: Hajj
description: Pilgrimage to Mecca granting a Muslim a year's immunity from direct Infernal Might.

name: Half Taltós
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue of a failed taltós candidate, granting limited Second Sight and spirit-harming weapons.

name: Hands of the Animal
description: Faerie power (2 points, constant) letting an animal manipulate and carry an item as if it had human hands with Strength +5.

name: Hanse Parisienne
description: Principal merchants' league of Paris with Montverte contacts.

name: Harold Godwinson
description: Anglo-Saxon King of England defeated at Hastings.

name: Hart
description: Red deer, favorite quarry of hunters, which flees to protect its herd.

name: Hastiludium
description: Norman Hermetic contests over resources; Cunfin's hastiludium team has won three times in a row.

name: Hat That Grants the Over-Anxious Father Peace of Mind
description: Magical toy sold at the faerie toy market.

name: Hazard
description: Terrain feature adding botch dice and making botches more serious.

name: Hazel Tree of Virtue
description: Tree with a symmetrical forked branch that can be Enriched into a Dowsing wand; contains 1 pawn of Intellego vis.

name: Heartbeast (Ability)
description: The Bjornaer Ability gained alongside the Heartbeast Virtue, scoring the strength of the transformation and added to Lab Totals for Sensory Magic.

name: Heater Shield
description: Shield used in the standard soldier's condensed-notation combat scores example.

name: Hedge Witch
description: Folk magic practitioner; one hangs holly to let dark faeries kill a noble child, and others curse cattle or divine at Candlemas.

name: Hedge Wizard (Flaw)
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw representing discrimination against hedge wizard converts.

name: Hedyosmos
description: A covenant in the Theban Tribunal built in a labyrinth of caves of increasing Magic aura, rumored to hold a gateway to the Magic Realm or Underworld, whose magi are famed for magic of earth, the dead, and curses.

name: Heiligenblut
description: Village holding a vial of Christ's blood.

name: Helm of Invisibility
description: A wondrous helmet made by an armorer that makes the wearer invisible (Craft Level 16).

name: Helvius
description: A paranoid magus of House Tremere specializing in ice magics who resides in an underground cavern lab by an underground lake.

name: Hen Dust
description: CrAn 40 dust making a chick hatch and grow to adult.

name: Henri of Toulouse
description: Wealthy merchant in an example petition who, after a holy vision, petitions the papal curia to found a monastery overlooking a river.

name: Henry I of Cyprus
description: Crowned king of Cyprus who carries a fragment of the True Cross, for a total Magic Resistance of 30.

name: Henry III of England
description: English king ambivalent toward Scotland.

name: Henry V
description: An emperor who deposed his father Henry IV, later sought his posthumous absolution, and was tormented on his deathbed by his betrayed father's apparition.

name: Hephaestion
description: An example Verditius magus, five years out of apprenticeship, used to illustrate enchanting casting tools for the spell The Crystal Dart.

name: Heracles
description: Legendary hero the Cult of Heroes believes descended from the gods and can be reborn.

name: Herbalism (Virtue)
description: A Minor General Virtue granting skill in folk remedies and natural magic via the unique Herbalism Ability, plus 50 experience points and the ability to make theriacs and ligatures.

name: Herculaneum
description: Ancient ruins destroyed (with Pompeii) by a volcanic eruption, traditionally used as the strife-saturated investiture site for the Station of Blood and Bronze on the Path of Strife.

name: Hermetic Crusade
description: The pro-war crusader faction and expedition led by Julius and Lavinia against Iceland's magicians.

name: Hermetic Evocation
description: Secrets of the Disciples of the Worm, taught to second-degree Initiates as spell binding.

name: Hermetic Haruspexes
description: An ancient Roman tradition of House Ex Miscellanea who reveal omens by inspecting entrails of sacrificed animals; produced Primi Basilicus and Immanola.

name: Hermetic Sacrifice
description: Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue allowing sacrifices on pagan altars to substitute for 1-6 pawns of vis in Ritual summoning.

name: Hermetic Speculum
description: A rock-crystal sphere or mirror scrying device for seeing distant individuals; spread into general and civic use.

name: Hermetic Virtues
description: Virtues tied to Hermetic magic; they can be taught by a parens who has them, with a Target Level of 15 for Minor and 21 for Major, and converted from Supernatural Abilities.

name: Hermit
description: One who renounces the world to live alone, celibate, observing the liturgical hours outside a formal monastic context.

name: Heroic Personality
description: Minor Heroic Flaw granting strong Personality traits and Confidence, but letting the storyguide sometimes dictate the character's heroic actions.

name: Hersfeld
description: A town dominated by a large imperial Benedictine abbey, whose springs are known for magical restorative powers.

name: Hesiod
description: Greek poet whose Theogony lists the children of Eris.

name: Hibernation
description: Ritual power of Adranus letting the spirit stay inactive for a year and save Might for its awakening.

name: Hidden Defect
description: A laboratory Flaw that may be gained on a botched Refinement roll or spotted and corrected on a sufficiently good roll while increasing Refinement.

name: Hierophant
description: Leader of a Mystery Cult; Queen Skuld is the Children of Odin's Hierophant.

name: Highly Organized
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab's contents are optimally arranged (+1 General Quality); gained by improving Refinement and lost in major accidents.

name: Holy Lance
description: Spear of Longinus found by the First Crusade in 1098 and lost in 1101; Faith 7, Divine Might 70, can invoke Celestial Immunity on ten people.

name: Holy Magus
description: Magus who has converted to holy magic, typically regarded as a hedge wizard by the Order.

name: Holy Methods
description: Divine abilities (e.g. Adjuration, Blessing, Invocation, Meditation, Purity) of which Jewish Abilities like Gematria, Kabbalah and Merkavah are forms.

name: Holy War
description: Christian doctrine of religiously sanctioned war, developing from Augustine's just war into crusade doctrine.

name: Holzfrau
description: German wood-wife faeries with Faerie Might 20, spirits of vegetation usually beneficial to mankind, able to control plants and heal; associated with particular plants like dryads.

name: Homunculus
description: Tiny faerie born from the dreams of magi, living on the boundary of Magic and Faerie, that bonds to the first person it sees and grants him faerie power in exchange for daily blood.

name: Homunculus Wizard
description: A hedge wizard whose faerie version of The Gift derives from a bond with a homunculus; experiences Faerie Calling rather than Twilight.

name: Hooks and Boons
description: Covenant-level story features (e.g. Castle, Road, Urban) that draw covenants into mundane affairs.

name: Hope
description: Theological virtue of unshakable confidence in divine providence; at True Faith 3 Faith Points add 6 and Magic Resistance against Mentem is doubled.

name: Horrifying Appearance
description: A Major Supernatural Flaw for corrupted beasts making the creature hideously deformed and unable to pass as a member of its original species.

name: Hosvir Goatlegs
description: A Clan Wilkis magus of the Sept of Orn obsessed with rebelling against the Norman nobility of England; trained Ealwynn and Coenwulf.

name: House Bjornaer Lore
description: The Organization Lore Ability giving knowledge of House Bjornaer's legends, history, structure, magics, and its Exoteric Mystery and Cult of Ancestors; primarily orally transmitted.

name: House Criamon Lore
description: An Ability quantifying a magus's understanding of House Criamon's task, strategy, paths, stations, and clutches; required at increasing scores to reach higher stations.

name: House of Savoy
description: Noble family of Savoy, rival of the Zähringers, which also founded new towns to attract settlers.

name: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults
description: The sourcebook covering the four magical Houses built around specific Mysteries (Bjornaer, Criamon, Merinita, Verditius).

name: Hubert filius Lorenz
description: Bonisagus magus researching hedge-magic longevity methods, such as inverting the familiar bond.

name: Hulikang
description: A Merry Devil (Vessel of Iniquity) and rabble rouser who turns public celebrations and sporting contests into violent mobs; captain of the Red Devils.

name: Humble
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character always believes others are more skilled and better than himself.

name: Humility of Caesar
description: Saint curse throwing a rider from his horse or felling him on his face.

name: Huon of Bordeaux
description: Hero of a song aided by Oberon.

name: Hurling the Droplet of Lye
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: Hutriel
description: The 'Rod of God', one of the Malakhe Habbalah (Avengers of Evil), forged from chains of fire, who punishes the profligate and those extravagant with wealth.

name: Hypnotic Gaze
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: Iacob
description: The most politically active magus of Irencillia, leader of the Elder Gild and apprentice of Handri; a master of Mentem magics running a secret project to establish a fae religion, identified as the Prophet of the God of Truth by his white crow caricature Nestor.

name: Iain
description: Vindolanda figure who can command the gate spirit to swallow the gatestone and seal off Scartaris from the mainland.

name: Ice of Drowning
description: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 35) that turns part of a body of water into jagged ice chunks that pound against anything on the surface, damaging swimmers and small boats.

name: Icilius the Traitor
description: A 12th-century Verditius magus of the Normandy Tribunal who released the Inner Mystery Automata to the Order of Hermes and was hunted down and slain by Wizard's War.

name: Idaian Daktyls
description: Ten faeries (five male smiths, five female healers) who act as intercessors between Dindyméné and her worshipers and guard her xoanon; Faerie Might 30.

name: Iernilus
description: Stubborn, fair-minded Quaesitor who drafted the Treaty of the Roman Tribunal, finalized in 1068.

name: Ikhwan as-Safa'
description: Brethren of Purity: secretive tenth-century Isma'ili fraternity from Basra teaching Philosophical Summoning and Refining through four grades.

name: Illegitimate Lineage
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw for a member of House Mercere not descended by blood from Mercere, giving a poor reputation and denying House benefits.

name: Illumination
description: Angelic mode of communication conveying the essence of a message directly to the soul, with Penetration zero.

name: Illusion of Cool Flames
description: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 10) that makes a source of heat seem to lose its heat and drop to surrounding temperature, while it still has its normal beneficial and harmful effects.

name: Illusion of the Shifted Image
description: A Rego Imaginem spell (Level 10) that makes any person or object appear a pace away from its actual position; the spell ends as soon as the original or image moves.

name: Illusionary Home
description: Faerie power using glamour to make a place look, sound, smell and feel like a suitable home for the faerie's role; used by the Ghula.

name: Image of the Beast
description: An Intellego Animal spell (Level 5) that gives a hazy mental image of an animal to which the caster has an Arcane Connection, useful for identifying an attacker.

name: Imbolc
description: Quarter day on February 1, the Feast of St. Bride.

name: Imbued with the Spirit of (Form)
description: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue letting a magus who absorbed an elemental's powers substitute Long-Term Fatigue for vis of the chosen Form.

name: Immortals
description: In House Criamon's cosmology, a perfect race of spiritual beings that fell into the material world; magi (or all people) are reincarnated immortals.

name: Immune to Disease
description: Major Supernatural Tainted Virtue marking the character as property of a powerful demon so that lesser disease demons refuse to harm him.

name: Impede the Impertinent Interloper
description: PeVi General spell cancelling instant transportation into or out of a circle.

name: Improved Abilities
description: Virtue or creature Quality listed for a being (Anne, Minerva Sulis, Balneator) or setting feature described here.

name: Improved Characteristic
description: A General Virtue from the core ArM5 rules listed as inappropriate for imbuing into a figurine via Figurine Magic.

name: Improved Voice Range
description: Gruagach ability to curse anyone within earshot without sensing them; integration would be a major breakthrough, suggested at +3 magnitudes.

name: Inanis
description: A spongy gray concretion formed from the residue of vis used in enchantment; it saps magical effects and the Might of supernatural creatures within its range. An optional rule for sagas exploring magical pollution.

name: Incantation of Summoning the Dead
description: A ritual Rego Mentem spell that calls up a person's ghost, requiring the place of death, the corpse, or knowledge of the ghost's full name.

name: Incantation of the Body Made Whole
description: A Creo Corpus ritual (Level 40) that heals all wounds to a human body, but not missing limbs, diseases, or poison damage.

name: Inconspicuousness
description: Personal cat power, a version of Invisibility of the Standing Wizard.

name: Inconstant Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw making the character's magic easily distracted and unresponsive, interrupting constant magic-item effects at sunrise and sunset and imposing a Finesse penalty.

name: Independent Magi
description: Magi and wizards in the Roman Tribunal outside recognized covenants, either naturalistic or living among mundanes, keeping quiet to avoid Hermetic prosecution.

name: Independent Study
description: A Minor General Virtue letting a character develop new skills extremely quickly on his own, adding bonuses to Practice and Adventure Source Quality.

name: India
description: Land where Pliny writes of magical bulls.

name: Induction
description: A Major, Supernatural Virtue granting the power to make people experience things that are not there, conferring the Induction Ability at 1.

name: Indulius
description: A magus of Fengheld and master of Richenda Spinosa, whose bungling scarred her Gift and left her unable to use fire magic.

name: Infantia
description: The period of an apprentice's life before being accepted by a master, meaning infancy.

name: Infatuation
description: Major or Minor Child Story Flaw: romantic attraction to someone with no chance of a relationship.

name: Infernal Dragons
description: Masters of the Spirits of Deceit taking the form of huge green-black dragons that haunt wilderness and provoke wars; harmless to the pure of heart.

name: Infernal Heirloom
description: A Minor, Supernatural, Tainted Virtue giving the character a magical item inherited from a diabolist, useful but drawing its owner toward a demon.

name: Infernal Protection
description: Infernal Minor Supernatural Virtue gained at Warping Score 5.

name: Infernal Taint
description: Taint afflicting a magus who takes a demon as spirit familiar.

name: Ingasia
description: A covenant in the Theban Tribunal of which Verditius Primus Stouritus is a member and which he would like to become the domus magna.

name: Ingolstadt
description: Town listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Inherited Virtues and Flaws
description: A Flaw chosen at character generation that develops later in the character's life, such as Suppressed Gift.

name: Initiation Total
description: Presence + (Mystery Cult) Lore + Script Bonus, compared against a Target Level (15/21 for known Minor/Major Virtues, 18/30 for new ones) with no die roll.

name: Inner Farne
description: The largest Farne island (16 acres), also called House Island, with Divine aura 2 rising to 4 in Saint Cuthbert's chapel and hermitage.

name: Inner Mysteries of House Bjornaer
description: Mysteries by which a Bjornaer magus, through atavism, gains an inner heartbeast (epitome, chimera, or anima) modeled on a Great Beast ancestor.

name: Inquisition
description: Newly formed Church body against heretics, strengthened by Frederick II.

name: Inscribed Shadow
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw causing a character's stigmata to be reflected as glowing symbols in their shadow, alarming nonmagicians and easing stigma-reading.

name: Inspirato
description: The flux of harmony and strife from which spiritually nourished Criamon magi draw sustenance instead of food, and through which path-of-seeming magi swim to view distant places.

name: Integration
description: Hermetic research incorporating aspects of hedge magic into Hermetic theory, measured in Breakthrough Points.

name: Interference
description: Meddling with mundanes that brings ruin on the Order, forbidden by the Code. Its definition varies by Tribunal.

name: Interlaken
description: Town between Lakes Thun and Brienz.

name: Interpretatio Romana
description: Roman practice of identifying native deities with Roman gods, which identified a Auvergne wolf goddess with Luperca.

name: Intervention Prone
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: the magician must resist intervention on a single botch rather than a double botch.

name: Intestinal Suffering
description: PeCo 40 arcane-range spell creating a lethal bone shard in the victim's intestines.

name: Intimidation
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Inverted Water Wheel
description: Magical toy sold at the faerie toy market.

name: Invoke the Pact of (Daimon)
description: ReVi Mystery Ritual forming a pact with a powerful named Daimon, which sends an Aspect to answer and perform services; grants the Daimon Daimon Points.

name: Invoking a Saint
description: Communication + Charm + Devotion Total roll vs 15 + die to have a saint use a Divine power on one's behalf.

name: Iona
description: Holy island where St. Columba founded his first church; has a Dominion aura of 8 of the Scottish temper.

name: Ipswich
description: The chief town of Suffolk with about 300 burgesses, granted a charter in 1200 by King John giving it a court, toll exemption, and a merchant guild monopoly on milling.

name: Irmele
description: The third filia of Trianoma, a tempestaria who recruited in German lands and founded the wandering weathermage lineage that still persists in the Rhine.

name: Ironwood
description: The traditional abode of the hag, filled with her wolfish children, in the Perilous Forest story element.

name: Isaac
description: A Jewish shopkeeper, nephew of David ben David, who runs the wine shop in Trier above the former Treverorum covenant and knows nothing of magi.

name: Isabella II
description: Seven-year-old Queen of Jerusalem in Outremer, a possible sovereign for the island.

name: Island of the Magicians
description: Artificial island in the North Sea created by Creo Terram rituals from a circular stone wall jacketing an earth infill, letting magi found their own country.

name: Isle of Arran
description: Island where a faerie once held Manannan's court; now claimed by a covenant of Criamon magi studying regiones.

name: Ismail
description: Son of Abraham whom he was prepared to sacrifice; ancestor of the Arabs.

name: Isolated from the Order
description: Flaw common among Highland magi.

name: Israel
description: Ruled by Abimelech for three years with Berith's help.

name: Israfel
description: Seraph and Angel of the Trumpet and of Last Judgement, who will end the world by blowing his trumpet in Jerusalem; recognised as an archangel in Islam.

name: Istria
description: The region in the Transylvanian Tribunal from which the Flambeau magus Vilano hailed.

name: Italian
description: Language Ability.

name: Item Attunement
description: A Major House Mystery letting a magus attune a greater enchanted item like a talisman, then sever the connection, leaving a Covet Device personality trait in the device.

name: Itinerarium
description: A House Jerbiton tradition of a sponsored tour undertaken by apprentices near the end of training, mirroring young Romans' tour of Greece, Ephesus, Troy, and Egypt; originated accidentally with Anna of Naples.

name: Iurgatores
description: Quarrelsome bullying demons of the order of Accusers who torment sinners in Purgatory.

name: Jacinta filia Nicoli
description: Archmaga of the line of Apromor, follower of Flambeau, the most competent Perdo magus in the Order and leader of the Rowan Sisterhood.

name: Jacob
description: Patriarch who wrestled through the night with an angel, identified as Camuel.

name: Jacobus de Voragine
description: Author of The Golden Legend.

name: Jaevert
description: Demon Duke of the Deluders (Watchers), Duke of the False Millennium, who appears as an angel of light to false prophets and is behind Tino's deception.

name: Jane, the Fifth Primus
description: Ghost of the fifth Primus of House Criamon at the Cave of Twisting Shadows, the youngest Primus who knew Criamon in life; friendly and willing to tutor outsiders.

name: Janine Kyteler
description: Older Gifted Kilkenny witch, merchant's wife who shapeshifts into a pig and seagull, rival of her cousin Anne.

name: Janus
description: A dead titanic god of doorways whose ghost pours wisdom into the ears of those who sleep on his grave, near a Merinita portal to Arcadia.

name: Jarane of Quaesitor
description: Highly respected Quaesitor who plans to lead a triad of Quaesitoris into Italy to fix the Roman Tribunal's problems.

name: Jart
description: The master of Tabanus and the leading Traditionalist within House Guernicus, favoring a strict interpretation of the Code.

name: Jasonian Way
description: A permanent path leading from the Temenos of Dindyméné to the Faerie regio through the faerie forest.

name: Jean the Wise
description: UnGifted Orleans witch and court clerk who uses Dowsing for the magistrate; his magic causes a ringing noise.

name: Jeremias filius Guernicus
description: A magus, author of De Lapii, the Branch of Terram summa, in 1220.

name: Jerome of Confluensis
description: Jerbiton magus, Tribunal liaison to French nobility who secretly rescues 'troublesome heirs'.

name: Jersey
description: Channel Island where Venelli relics and mercenary graves may be found.

name: Jizya
description: Head tax paid by adult male dhimmis.

name: Joachimites
description: Followers of Joachim of Flora who have adopted strange beliefs about the Antichrist and the end of the age in 1260.

name: John Balliol
description: King chosen by Edward of England who proved unpopular, sparking rebellions.

name: Join or Die
description: The Order's nominal policy toward other workers of magic, problematic because mundane authorities see such killings as murder.

name: Jon Haraldsson
description: Mormaer of Caithness and Earl of Orkney, holding land from Scotland and Norway; implicated in burning a bishop.

name: Joseph of Napoli
description: Reforming churchman from Antagonists keen to bring the Order into the Church; ideal counterpart for a Hermetic proctor at the papal curia.

name: Josephine
description: Larta magus chef at Valnastium from the Engadine valley, whose food is as good as magical.

name: Joust
description: Tourney's most dangerous event, a knightly joust between mounted magi.

name: Jovius
description: Filius of Bonisagus whom Bonisagus was forced to March in 812.

name: Judas Iscariot
description: Betrayer of Christ who hanged himself at Aceldama; his conspiracy is why Infernal auras rise the Wednesday before Easter.

name: Judgment Day
description: The Last Judgement, when archangels will war against Hell and Israfel will sound his trumpet.

name: Juliasta filia Criamon
description: Criamon's successor as Primus and the first follower of the Winding Path; she shared the House's knowledge with outsiders and prepared the House for its journey.

name: Jumayl, A Jinni Guide
description: A faerie jinni of the jann (Might 15, Vim), a mercenary caravan guide wandering the Levant and beyond, able to change into a white Bactrian camel and susceptible to mundane alcohol.

name: Jupiter's Tears
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: Jura Mountains
description: Forested range northwest of the French Alps.

name: Jurist
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character who is a judge, advocate, or procurator, able to purchase Latin, Artes Liberales, and Civil and Canon Law.

name: Just Temper
description: A temper of the Dominion that could favor the innocent in ordeals.

name: Justinian
description: Emperor whose sixth-century imperial adventure left cataphract ghosts in the West.

name: Kabbalist
description: Free Mythic Companion Social Status Virtue required of all kabbalists.

name: Kamillia filia Bamber
description: Bjornaer maga with a lammergeir heartbeast, the dominant partner of the pair-bonded couple with Eginhard.

name: Karamas
description: Miraculous acts worked by zahids through pious contemplation.

name: Karlotte
description: Red-haired daughter and heir of Baron Schonburg with strong faerie blood; she lies in a coma after being attacked, and the fae of the Court of Dark Summer hold her cure.

name: Katrina of Bjornaer
description: One of the Order's youngest hoplites, whose heartbeast is a wolverine; she serves the Quaesitores and allies with Adrasteia.

name: Kentigern of Ex Miscellanea
description: Quaesitor from a Hibernian beast-mage tradition with an affinity for dogs, controlling a pack of faerie hounds.

name: Keres
description: Leti of violent death, led by Ker.

name: Ketuvim
description: The Writings, final section of the Tanakh; a collection of tractatus.

name: Kiev
description: City where Nicolai met the wandering merchant-summoner who became his teacher.

name: King Herod
description: King who beheaded John the Baptist at Salome's request.

name: King Oak
description: The faerie ruler of the southern Oak Forest among the Courts of the Seasons, a regal and generous Summer King who battles King Holly; touchy of honor and takes words literally.

name: Kingdom of Jerusalem
description: The Crusader state of the Holy Land whose major port and nominal capital is Acre, constantly at risk from Muslim forces.

name: Kiss of Frost
description: Faerie power letting the person touched survive the cold above the snowline until he treads upon grass.

name: Kiss of the Mermaid
description: Faerie power letting the person kissed breathe under water until he walks upon dry land.

name: Klagenfurt
description: Town listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Kloster Maria Laach
description: A Benedictine monastery beside Laach Lake founded in 1093, with a Divine aura of 4 and a paradise-like gardened courtyard re-creating the Garden of Eden.

name: Kludie
description: The most powerful faerie hound variant, from Belgium, able to take large forms of dog, cat, bat, horse or frog, walking on its back legs and preceded by supernatural blue flames.

name: Klynoites
description: Pater of the magus who assassinated Prima Kalliste; he Marched his own filius and became the next Primus of House Tytalus, denouncing House Flambeau at Tribunal.

name: Knights of the Sword
description: A military order founded in 1202 by Albert von Buxhövden, bishop of Riga, to crusade against pagan tribes; based at Fellin in Livonia and active in Pomerania, they control the slave trade and are notoriously brutal.

name: Know the Heavens
description: InVi 29 constant enchantment in the magical armillary sphere that senses astrological time and the influence of the planets around it.

name: Koblenz
description: A fair-sized city where the Mosel joins the Rhine, owned by the archbishops of Trier; home to St. Kastor church and a Teutonic Knights chapter house.

name: Koilios
description: Magus of Montverte whose raid on Lapis Crudus established a precedent legalizing raiding.

name: Kolkrabus
description: The devious raven familiar of Murion that spied at Crintera and taunts Stentorius, believing he has usurped Murion's role as leader of the Oak Gild.

name: Kore
description: A nature-oriented deity whose name eumolpids of the Huntress may learn through the Mysteries of Names of Power and Invocation Magic.

name: Koshchey the Deathless
description: Powerful koldun whose soul is hidden in an egg in a duck in a hare in a chest under an oak on an island in a regio.

name: Krak des Chevaliers
description: A real fortress cited as a forebear of the Superior Engineering concentric-castle style.

name: Kresnik
description: Slavic nightwalkers, each a community's protector, fighting kudlaki with dappled phantastica.

name: Kriemhild
description: Sister of King Gunther and wife of Siegfried in the Nibelungenlied, who avenges Siegfried's murder by orchestrating the deaths of Gunther and Hagen.

name: Krios
description: An Elder Titan of leadership and father of Pallas the Titan of war-craft.

name: Kronos
description: The Greek representation of time in serpent form, whose coils appear as scaly marks on the wrists of some Criamon ghosts.

name: Kubu
description: Infant-sized faerie, a child who died unnamed, who lures children away to die.

name: Kudlaki
description: Slavic sorcerer nightwalkers who steal a community's fertility and become vampires after death.

name: Kybella
description: Tytalus theurgist of Exspectatio, Titanoi member, who maintains Fudarus's spirit enchantments and casts its Aegis.

name: Kyzikos
description: Legendary king whose slaying is mentioned in the Golden Fleece legend; his staters are said to be buried on Bear Island.

name: La Rochelle
description: Chartered port held by England with a Templar church.

name: Lab Mastery
description: Cult of Mercury mastery ability adding mastery to Lab Totals for similar effects.

name: Laboratory Magician
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: the character may cast charms only with the aid of a text.

name: Laborer
description: A free Social Status Virtue for a trained worker who provides a valuable service without producing a finished good, using a Profession Ability rather than a Craft.

name: Lack of Control
description: Flaw appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Lacuna
description: A 'hole' within an urban environment where the Dominion does not dominate, allowing magi to cast spells without realm interaction penalties; may carry other auras.

name: Lake Brienz
description: Steep-sided Alpine lake fed by the Aare.

name: Lamashtu
description: Ancient Babylonian goddess of stillbirth, a Might 45 faerie with lion head, donkey teeth and owl feet.

name: Lance
description: Weapon properly wielded only by a mounted character; dismounted it functions as a long spear.

name: Lancelot
description: Cabal of the Crushed Viper member who befriends and betrays Flambeau milites.

name: Landvaettir
description: Icelandic land spirits who watch the coasts, serve the guardians and bargain with galdramen; they pledge to avenge Biorn Egilsson.

name: Language
description: Ability used to find charms in formularies and write lab texts.

name: Lapis Maior
description: Level 15 Substantial alchemical reagent, a waxy red stone that transmutes up to 50 cubic inches of lead into gold.

name: Las Huelgas
description: Richest nunnery under the Cistercian Rule, near Burgos, founded in 1187; royal burial place.

name: Lasiq
description: A Major, Social Status Virtue for an experienced Nizari Isma'ili assassin who has completed seven murders and commands a small band of fida'is.

name: Lateran Basilica
description: Basilica Innocent III dreamt of as collapsing but propped up by a small ragged man.

name: Latria
description: Worship reserved for God alone; offering it to others is a terrible sin.

name: Latrunculus filius Aurelia
description: Criamon Terram magus and surveyor who believes the Great Ones are buried at Roman road intersections.

name: Lausanne
description: City listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Law
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Laylat al-Qadr
description: 27th of Ramadan, when all Infernal auras drop to zero until dawn.

name: Le Cité
description: Capital of Périgord, with the sacred spring Vésone and St. Stephen's Cathedral.

name: Leadership (Virtue)
description: Virtue +3 held by Mercatora.

name: Leadworker
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue descended from Aita cult necromancy, enabling crafting of katadesmoi and kolossoi containing fixed arcane connections; Leadworkers also supply Tremere magi with ghosts.

name: League of Iconophiles
description: The most powerful of the eastern Empire's transient magical leagues, formed to oppose Emperor Leo III's destruction of religious icons; its members are the ancestors of House Jerbiton.

name: Leap of the Fire
description: A Rego Ignem spell (Level 10) that causes a bonfire to leap up to 10 paces in any direction, catching if there is fuel; a Targeting roll lets it deal +10 damage to a target.

name: Legatus missus
description: Grade of papal legate (nuncio) given a particular mission, often priests or deacons from the capellani.

name: Legion of Mithras Lore
description: Organization Lore of the Legion used by Mystagogues.

name: Lent
description: Penitential season; a feast at its start uses up forbidden foods, and war is forbidden during it by the Truce of God.

name: Leo
description: Priest among the early Franciscans, known as Brother Lamb of God; Francis' confessor and scribe.

name: Lesser Faerie Powers
description: Virtue appearing in faerie statistics in this text (Lesser Faerie Powers).

name: Lesser Infernal Power
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue for corrupted beasts adding 2 to Infernal Might and granting an Infernal Power that cannot have a Penetration total.

name: Lessini Mountains
description: The mountains where the Alps cross into Italy, site of Dietrich Von Bern's ornate tomb filled with dragon-blood-enchanted arms.

name: Leti
description: Spirits of death, one of which Francis might call his sister Bodily Death.

name: Levy
description: Lowest, quickly drafted and poorly equipped soldiers who also provide siege labor.

name: Liar's Chime
description: InMe(Im) 25 modification of Frosty Breath of the Spoken Lie that sounds a bell when the target lies.

name: Liber de Compositione Alchemiae
description: Morienus Romanus' alchemical work, translated into Latin by Robert of Chester in 1144.

name: Liberalia
description: March Ceremony of Welcome for apprentices and its feasting, traditionally hosted by Tarragon Vale.

name: Library of Valnastium
description: Temple of the Muses moved from Greece; one of the Order's finest mundane libraries that invented the shelf.

name: Library of the Normandy Tribunal
description: Tribunal-owned book collection kept at Confluensis and leased as Tourney prizes.

name: Licho
description: One-eyed old woman faerie personifying ill-fortune, who clings to victims and tricks them into self-harm.

name: Lictor
description: Experienced hoplite chosen by the Greater Alpine Tribunal to coordinate Wizards' Marches; wears a leopard-edged sash.

name: Life Stages
description: Human transitions (birth, reason, adulthood, mastery, mortality) that attract faeries.

name: Light Sleeper
description: Virtue appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Lilith
description: Demoness of prostitution, wife of Iblis and concubine of Adam; Queen of Tempters sharing leadership of the ninth order, depicted as a naked woman with a serpent's tail, enemy of infants.

name: Lincoln
description: An important town and seat of a powerful bishop, left in poor material state by the battle of Lincoln in 1217; its castle is held by Nicola de Hay.

name: Lindorm
description: A huge legless bat-winged worm of German and Scandinavian tales that hoards treasure and takes hostages for ransom.

name: Linguist
description: A Minor, General Virtue increasing all Language Advancement Totals and character-generation language experience by a quarter.

name: Lion of Mithras
description: Fourth rank (Captain), learns Inscription on the Soul and spends seven years at the temple.

name: Livonian Order of the Knights of the Sword
description: A crusading military order formed in 1202 in Pomerania and Livonia to fight Baltic pagans; reprimanded and subsumed into the Teutonic Order in 1237.

name: Local Ally
description: Church Boon representing a local ally, such as a town guild master.

name: Lombard League
description: Alliance of Lombard communes formed at Pontida to defeat Frederick Barbarossa, reformed against Frederick II.

name: Long Melford
description: Parish used as an example of petitioning the Church.

name: Long Term Fatigue
description: Fatigue lost by nightwalkers after straying, recovered faster through spiritual nourishment and feasts.

name: Loosely Material
description: Faerie power allowing a generally immaterial faerie to take on a material body of flesh, wood or elemental matter; also taken by Lamashtu and Mormo.

name: Lord Marsyne
description: A faerie lord (Might 50, Aquam) ruling an ice castle in the far north, who entombs people in ice, grants youth, and always takes a beautiful young human wife who must come of her own free will.

name: Lord Robert Schonburg
description: Bastard son of Baron Schonburg and a diabolist who collects unjust tolls from Pfalz Island; an infernalist villain who casts ritual-like spells using Infernal Lore.

name: Lore of the Mathematici
description: (Organization) Lore of the Bologna learned-magician tradition, covering its charms, members, history and Initiation rites.

name: Lot
description: Biblical figure who escaped Sodom and Gomorrah.

name: Louis VI
description: 'The Fat', crowned in Orléans in 1108.

name: Louvre
description: Monolithic fortress of Philip II erected in 1190 west of Paris, housing his residence, treasury and arsenal.

name: Love Potion
description: ReMe 30 potion causing love for the first person seen.

name: Low Tolerance
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character cannot easily withstand pain and fatigue, increasing related penalties.

name: Loyal
description: Personality Trait; if all group members have a positive Loyal score, the group adds the lowest score to Discipline rolls.

name: Loyalty Test
description: Roll of Loyal Personality Trait plus stress die against an Ease Factor for commanding tamed creatures.

name: Lucca
description: A city in northern Italy granted a charter by Henry IV in 1081, overthrown in a commune revolt in 1115, which has since conquered neighboring lands and rivals Pisa.

name: Lucerne
description: Fishing village near Mount Pilatus rising with the Saint Gotthard Pass.

name: Lucid dreaming
description: A dreamer realizing she is dreaming and taking control to reshape the dream, rolled as Intelligence vs Ease Factor 9.

name: Ludold
description: The white-haired elder of Waldheim, a lesser hedge wizard and cunning man who creates minor potions and charms; father of Torven.

name: Lughnasa
description: August 1 celebration once honoring Lugh, marking the start of harvest.

name: Lukerbad
description: Hottest thermal pools in Europe, home of Sabina.

name: Lulach
description: MacBeth's stepson, last truly Scottish High King, slain after eight months.

name: Lumen of Jerbiton
description: A young Jerbiton maga and obsessive bibliophile responsible for Schola Pythagoranis's library, who owns a ring that makes her appear as a man.

name: Lupercus
description: The second grade of the Luperci, Initiated just after a vengeance killing. It grants Scales of the Heart or Confession of the Penitent as a Lesser Power, together with the Judged Unfairly Flaw.

name: Lupus (the Wolf)
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character employed by a university to ensure students speak only Latin, holding keys to the students' housing.

name: Lusignan Castle
description: Castle whose rulers descend from the undine Mélusine.

name: Lutisse
description: A very slight (Size -1) maga of House Ex Miscellanea who resides in a faerie-glamour-shrouded treehouse at the edge of a faerie forest.

name: Lykaia
description: A rite performed at Lupercalia by a prospective magister luperci: he eats a meal tainted with human flesh and must remain in wolf form for at least nine seasons.

name: Ma'aseh Merkavah
description: Ancient mystical tradition from which Merkavah and Goetic Summoning derive.

name: Magdeburg
description: A city on the Elbe favored by Otto the Great, seat of an archbishopric and center of missionary activity over the Eastern Marches; origin of the Magdeburg Law.

name: Magi Trianomae
description: Politically focused branch within House Bonisagus to which Austerius belongs.

name: Magi of Hermes
description: An Ars Magica supplement containing 15 fully statted magi at various ages, usable as NPCs or player characters.

name: Magian Lineage
description: A Minor or Major General Virtue making the character a true blood descendant of the Median tribe of Magians, the original priestly caste of Persia, granting bonuses to aging and disease resistance.

name: Magic Affinity
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Magic Kin
description: Families or groups of characters aligned with Magic sharing inherited qualities and powers.

name: Magic Regio of Dindyméné
description: An uninhabited Magic regio (aura 6) that is an enlarged copy of the temenos, producing Herbam and Terram vis annually and granting Calm +2 to visitors.

name: Magic character
description: A character with a Magic Might Score, created with Magic Character Creation rules or via a Virtue such as Transformed (Being).

name: Magical (Being) Companion
description: Minor Story Flaw: the character is accompanied by an intelligent magical being it must look after; generalizes Magical Animal Companion.

name: Magical Companion
description: Virtue listed in character statistics in this text.

name: Magical Defenses
description: Limited hedge defenses that grant a bonus or penalty in an area of specialty, equal to Art/5 or Ability score.

name: Magical Qualities and Inferiorities
description: Purchased features of magic characters; elementals' Characteristics are bought with matching Qualities and Inferiorities.

name: Magical Travel
description: Travel through boundaries or vestiges, requiring Magic Might or powers like Second Sight, rolled against a level-based Ease Factor minus Familiarity.

name: Magical Truffles
description: Truffles with Magic Might that guard truffles and trees in Magic forests; in the regio they come as workers, drones, daughters and the Matron.

name: Magnus Barelegs
description: King of Norway who acquired the Western Isles in 1098 by dragging a ship across Kintyre.

name: Magvillus Council
description: The governing council of House Guernicus with inner and outer tiers, which reviews vetoes, appeals of penalties and Quaesitorial conduct.

name: Mahonin
description: A maggot demon of the Tempters that deludes victims into eating inedible objects as luxurious food; driven away by fennel seeds.

name: Maimonides
description: A Jewish philosopher who wrote The Guide for the Perplexed in 1190, a great summa on Jewish philosophy infused with Aristotelian ideas, sparking the Maimonidean Controversy.

name: Major Rune Focus
description: Virtue giving a vitki a focus in a category of rune magic, e.g. Sigrunar.

name: Malachi
description: A nine-year-old devil child in a young man's body, son of the demon Abrigor, who travels Europe seeking objects of power while unknowingly releasing imprisoned demons.

name: Male Guild Sponsor
description: A free General Virtue allowing a female character to participate in any guild by attaching to a male relative's name on the roster.

name: Malevolent aura
description: A corrupted aura of sentient cruelty tarnished with sins of violence and perverted appetite, adding its strength to damage and botches.

name: Malocchi
description: A tradition of Italian magi within House Ex Miscellanea who practice the magic of Entrancement and are believed to bring terrible luck with their gaze.

name: Manor Court
description: Court dealing with lesser matters like assault, minor thefts and disputes between villeins, convened by the steward.

name: Manticore
description: A creature with which Demons of the Fifth Trump are often mistaken; manticores are not demons.

name: Many Marriageable Daughters
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character has many daughters and must participate in stories to marry them off suitably.

name: Marcelo of Verdi
description: Magus of Verdi who has long tried to fathom the magic of the Roman roads.

name: Marcus the Valiant
description: The ghostly gladiator leader (Magic Might 20) who haunts the Trier amphitheater, equipped as a hoplomachus and challenging visitors to duels to the death.

name: Margaret of Beverley
description: An English-born pilgrim who disguised herself as a man and helped defend the wall when Jerusalem fell to Saladin in 1187, later becoming a nun at Laon; an example of a woman warrior dressing as a man.

name: Margaret, Maid of Norway
description: Granddaughter and heir of Alexander III, who died crossing from Norway in 1290.

name: Marie of France
description: Poet who versified the tale of the knight Owein's journey through purgatory.

name: Marie of Oignes
description: One of the founders of the beguine movement (1176-1213), a mystic who lived in poverty near the priory of Oignes, conversed with her guardian angel and had insight into the hearts of others.

name: Market Guild
description: Guild of faerie merchants that sets and enforces the Devil's Lane market rules through a council.

name: Marriage
description: Sacrament joining two people against temptation, granting both a Faith Point and a holy connection.

name: Martigny
description: Site of the Queen of the Herd festival.

name: Masks
description: Mundane allies through which covenants act to avoid charges of meddling.

name: Master Bard
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for a character who has spent at least nine years at an Irish bardic school and is a master of the trade, called an Anruth.

name: Master of Animal Creatures
description: A Virtue the She-Wolf uses to train the magical wolves of the Majarida.

name: Master of Kennels
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character who manages the kennels of a noble patron, responsible for training, breeding, and health of the dogs.

name: Master of Skills
description: Faeries that seek out mortals at the peak of their profession to raise them up or cast them down, having the disputed Ability as a Pretense of at least 9.

name: Masterpiece
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue allowing a Verditius magus to keep the lesser enchanted item he made to pass his Gauntlet, with vis costs ignored.

name: Mastery points
description: Points spent to improve a power's Initiative, Might cost or related Abilities.

name: Mateos, the Faerie Butler
description: A child-sized faerie (Might 10, Herbam) who lives for drunken parties, serving intoxicating drinks from an endless barrel and encouraging people to embarrass themselves.

name: Material Anchor
description: Spirit power used to mark prey and intentionally form Arcane Connections; used by the Erinnyes.

name: Mathematicus of Bologna
description: Free Social Status marking membership in the Mathematici tradition; requires a Hedge Technique and Form and a mundane Social Status.

name: Mathematikoi
description: The Inner Order of the Fraternity of Samos, robed in black or white, who abstain from meat and beans and must teach new Initiates.

name: Mathieus of Constantinople
description: A contemporary House Jerbiton Archmagus trained in Constantinople but long resident in Paris, who gave up the study of magic but grew more active after Constantinople's fall.

name: Mattieus of Cherson
description: A historically important twelfth-century Primus of House Jerbiton who believed Jerbiton magi should serve as ambassadors to the mundanes.

name: Maximianus of Bonisagus
description: An ancient, widely respected Bonisagus master of Corpus magic and prolific author who founded Nigrasaxa to break the cycle of invalid tribunals.

name: May Day Eve
description: Night when magi retreat behind Aegises due to peasant purification festivals able to Hex magi.

name: Mazdean Priest
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for an ordained Mazdean priest, initiated as a mobed, who performs Zoroastrian rituals and tends sacred fires.

name: Mazzeru
description: Corsican nightwalker tradition that fights with asphodel and is compelled to hunt in dreams, killing animals representing villagers destined to die.

name: Mazzikim
description: Tempters of the wilderness, the harmers of man, shaped like wild animals standing on two legs with human chests; related to the shaitans.

name: Meadow
description: Grassy plain between Kyzikos and the Thracian Harbor, holding King Kyzikos' tumulus with an Infernal aura 4.

name: Mecklenburg
description: A region whose nobility still secretly come to Rethra to honor their god; its Slavic princes are drawn into the schemes of Radegast.

name: Meddling with mundanes
description: Code offense interpreted loosely in Normandy as requiring ruin to magi.

name: Medicus
description: A general term for a practitioner who may perform medicine or surgery but has no formal claim to the higher title of doctor; the majority of practicing physicians.

name: Mediterranean
description: Sea averaging 1630 paces deep, an alternative site for a magical island.

name: Megstone
description: Isolated rock with Infernal aura 1 where Saint Cuthbert imprisoned 144 demons, trapped at zero Might for centuries.

name: Melee
description: Tourney event in which grogs try to capture opponents' magical castles.

name: Melk
description: Benedictine abbey with an excellent library.

name: Memory Palace
description: A mnemonic structure of rooms and loci used in the Art of Memory, traditionally a square villa with a central courtyard; number of rooms equals Art of Memory score.

name: Men of Good Intent
description: Minor Spirits of Deceit, human-sized snakes with a man's head, who encourage spiritual laxity by peddling a single vice.

name: Mendip Hills
description: Hills in Somerset where Roman miners worked and where the Poisoned Battlefield lies.

name: Mengalaz the Rat
description: Bartholomew's faerie rat familiar, leader of the rat pack.

name: Merchant Adventurer
description: A minor Social Status Virtue for a character in command of a ship and crew with sufficient capital for a cargo, though possibly with substantial debts.

name: Mercury's Winged Sandals
description: ReCo 20 spell letting the caster fly as fast as a running horse, controlled with Intelligence + Finesse rolls.

name: Merinugalaudabila
description: A Novgorod maga leading a nomadic family of faerie Merinitae who delights in certamen as a sport and has fostered interest in magical competition and dueling styles within the House.

name: Meririm the Meridian Devil
description: One of the Maskim, Prince of the Powers of the Air and lord of thunder and lightning in Hell, called the meridian devil.

name: Metathiax
description: A decanus, Master of the Avengers of Evil, who inflicts diseases of the kidneys and rules the first third of Cancer's reign; he is thwarted by the angel Adonael.

name: Metempsychosis
description: Transmigration of souls believed by Children of Hermes and the Fraternity of Samos.

name: Method Caster
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue granting a +3 bonus to the Casting Total of any Formulaic or Ritual spell, lost if the caster varies from his precise method.

name: Methods and Powers
description: Infernal Methods associated with Powers; new Powers need a Method and Methods at least two Powers.

name: Metrodorus of Thebes
description: An elderly dream magus with a raven familiar used in examples; later described as a greater dream mage who physically enters the dream of Somnius.

name: Michael Psellos
description: Byzantine philosopher and theologian (d. 1079) known for his dialogue on demons, describing six types of Aerial Powers.

name: Michaelmas
description: 29 September, the day of reckoning for manorial taxes and the traditional deadline for the harvest; also the first day of the administrative year.

name: Midael
description: Midael, Captain of the Celestial Army, a Potentate under Michael who defends those persecuted by evil men, often appearing as a knight.

name: Midsummer
description: 24 June; Midsummer Eve, the night before the Feast of John the Baptist, is mystical, with fern seeds that summon the Devil and fires against dragons.

name: Mimic the Christ's Miracle
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: Mimicry
