description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Minnesingers
description: A type of German minstrel copying the northern French style with emphasis on knightly combat and sensual love, exemplified by Walther and Wolfram.

name: Minor Magical Deficiency
description: Flaw appearing in character statistics or rules in this text.

name: Minor Orders
description: Clerks such as porters, lectors, exorcists and acolytes who need not be ordained.

name: Miraculous Beer Mug
description: Magical toy sold at the faerie toy market.

name: Mircalla
description: Ghost of the Motherhouse, a mother murdered by a magus's grogs, immune to Hermetic magic and protective of mistreated apprentices.

name: Miriam
description: Flavius of Jerbiton's wife, of unclear cultural group and magical tradition; she attended the First Tribunal in an undescribed capacity and is buried beside Jerbiton.

name: Mirror of Souls
description: Mirror in the Abyssal Pit that reveals and scries anyone named or sympathetically connected, with Penetration 50; a source of insight for Original Research.

name: Miser's Pot
aliases: Miser's Pot, Bane of the Hoarder
description: An Accuser in the form of a small three-legged brass cauldron that punishes the greedy rich by stealing their wealth and dragging them to Hell.

name: Misfortune
description: Ruchin Power making the target suffer bad luck and a -2 penalty on luck-based rolls.

name: Missal
description: Tractatus in Church Lore and Music with the text for Mass; every church has one.

name: Mistress Greta
description: Elderly Gifted folk witch of Reims who escaped the stake by flying and now lives alone in a forest cave regio.

name: Mistridge
description: Provençal covenant, Windgraven's traditional enemy, whose Magi aided the Sicilian Vespers.

name: Mitigating Deadly Wounds
description: Optional rule letting a player reduce a wound's severity by accepting a new Flaw.

name: Mittenwald
description: Town listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Mitzvot
description: Religious commandment; commanding a golem to transgress one risks madness.

name: Mjollnir
description: Thor's hammer, a thunderbolt imprisoned in iron that inflicts +30 lightning damage.

name: Molech
description: Prince of the False Gods (Might 50, Ignem), King of Fire who first lit Hell's fires; worshiped in Tyre and Carthage as Moloch with child sacrifice.

name: Monk
description: Male religious living under a rule in a monastery.

name: Monksend Castle
description: Castle built by David Goulis from 1187 on Benedictine monastery lands, reputed haunted.

name: Mont St. Michael
description: Benedictine monastery founded by the archangel Michael; enters a Divine regio (aura 8) at high tide.

name: Montagne de Reims
description: Hilly forested limestone plateau south of Reims with chasms, wild beasts and vis sources.

name: Moonbeam
description: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 3) that causes a gentle reading-bright light to shine down and illuminate the area encircled by the caster's arms.

name: Morag
description: A giant driven from his mountain home by diabolists who has taken to robbery near a covenant, holding a captured knight hostage in a cave; he craves revenge against the diabolists.

name: Moravia
description: The eastern March of Bohemia bordered by the Carpathian Mountains and Hungary, through which flows the River Morava; home of the covenant of Roznov.

name: Morienus Romanus
description: Author of Liber de Compositione Alchemiae.

name: Mormo
description: Possessing faerie that bites naughty children, once a mother turned werewolf.

name: Moroi
description: Leti leading the doomed to fated demise, led by Moros.

name: Morrighu the Screech-Hag
description: The Screech-Hag, an Aerial Power demon of warfare with a crow's body and an old woman's upper parts, who claims to have been a Faerie goddess of victory.

name: Mortuary
description: A charge always levied on the dying to make things right between the Church and a dying thief (described in Chapter Six: Manorial Fiefs).

name: Mother Road
description: The source of all roads, identified with the Faerie Realm itself, used to traverse vast distances swiftly via trods.

name: Mount Dindymon
description: The mountain on Bear Island atop which the Temenos of Dindyméné lies and beneath which the titaness Dindyméné is bound.

name: Mount Radhost
description: A 3700-foot summit in Moravia, site of a crude stone temple to Radegast with a Magic aura of 6 (secretly Infernal), where a great festival fuelled by human sacrifice yields vis for Roznov's magi.

name: Mu'adhdhin
description: Mosque attendant who summons the faithful to prayer; basis of the Devout Mu'adhdhin grog template.

name: Mulhidun
description: Infernal tradition of devil-worshipers near Mosul and Seljuk lands who revere Enais, the Peacock Angel, and summon and command demons as servants.

name: Munich
description: City listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Munster
description: A prosperous market and episcopal city on the Munsterland plain, founded as a monastery in 805 to convert the Saxons.

name: Muspelli
description: Non-Hermetic tradition whose childhoods the book does not specifically address.

name: Mustard Plaster
description: A Theriac of Level 5, Potency Moderate, a linen cloth with ground mustard seeds that grants +3 to Wound Recovery rolls for Medium and Light Wounds by drawing out choler.

name: Mutable Gender
description: A demonic power allowing a demon to switch gender at will.

name: Mystery Houses
description: The four Houses of Criamon, Bjornaer, Merinita, and Verditius, the smallest of the 12 Houses, which tend to look inward.

name: Mystic
description: Those dedicating their lives to pursuit of the love of God through contemplative or monistic mysticism.

name: Nagging Curse
description: PeCo 20 spell cracking a tooth's enamel to cause distracting pain.

name: Naonhaithya
description: Lord of the Vessels of Iniquity, the Zoroastrian daeva of rebellion and irreverence who spreads anarchy and the corruption of good rulership.

name: Narisian
description: Head of Sansaron, abrupt and unwelcoming to Tamgor.

name: Narrative Map
description: Tarragon Vale's device displaying the underlying structures of mystical realms.

name: Natura Antiqua
description: A covenant of nature magi founded in the East Anglian fens in 1133, destroyed by Geoffrey de Mandeville during the Civil War in 1143.

name: Necromancer
description: Magus vocation (Ex Miscellanea) trained in the catacombs of Vardian's Tomb in necromancy.

name: Nemesis
description: Entity thought to be of the magic realm, hater of immoderation, called upon by the Call for Justice ritual.

name: Nephelococcygia
description: A mobile magic regio (aura 10) in the clouds inhabited by intelligent birds, containing a city of nine concentric walls; its entrance usually lies in the Thebes Tribunal.

name: Nephilim (Virtue)
description: The Free Mythic Companion Virtue defining a character as a Nephilim.

name: Neqael
aliases: The Lady of the Purple Bower
description: The Lady of the Purple Bower, Corrupter of Lyonesse: a demoness (Lady of the Spirits of Deceit, Infernal Might 40) who poses as a faerie-blooded noblewoman and corrupts courtly love and etiquette.

name: Neustria
description: Carolingian province that included Normandy and was overrun by Vikings in the ninth and tenth centuries.

name: Nevi'im
description: The Prophets, second section of the Tanakh; Tractatus on Theology: Judaism and Dream Interpretation.

name: Nicaea
description: Seat of a claimant to the Byzantine Empire.

name: Nicea
description: City reached by Turks and recaptured by crusaders.

name: Nike
description: The Daimon of victory in both battle and peaceful competition, daughter of Styx and Pallas, invoked in an Orphic Hymn used in eristic moots.

name: Nithael
description: The Great Leveller, Master of the Accusers and captain of a legion of corrupt priests, who preys on those who abuse the power of their offices.

name: Nizari Isma'ilis
description: An order of assassins, far from whose home fida'is and lasiqs are sent on missions; fida'i and lasiq Social Statuses are drawn from this sect.

name: No Magical Defenses
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw removing Magical Defense Bonuses.

name: No Sigil
description: Flaw appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: No Tattoo Magic
description: Flaw required of trollsynir and kolduni, who do not practice gruagach tattoo magic.

name: No Text Casting
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the character cannot cast charms from texts.

name: Norway
description: Kingdom whose king Eirik Svennson serves.

name: Notes of a Delightful Sound
description: A Muto Imaginem spell (Level 10) that causes all sounds in a room, particularly music, to be especially clear and sonorous.

name: Notre Dame de Paris
description: The Paris cathedral whose recently completed nave is 112 feet tall, with its chancellor wielding power over the university.

name: Nourish the Displaced Vines
description: CrHe 19 effect permitting plants to grow well regardless of climate and soil.

name: Numera
description: Example Hermetic Numerologist using a copy of De Theoria Magica as her numerologist's book.

name: Nun
description: Female religious living under a rule in a nunnery, usually of noble birth and strictly enclosed.

name: Nuntius
description: A Free Social Status Virtue for a messenger charged with delivering messages, mail, and donations between students and families, employed by a university nation.

name: Nur al-Din
description: Famous Muslim counter-crusader (d. 1174) said taught wondrous powers by Khidr; holy forbear with Divine Might 25.

name: Nátt-thel
description: 'Darkest part of night'; vitki equivalent of Twilight losing The Gift.

name: Oath-Swearing
description: Ritual Power enforcing a solemnly sworn oath with a Minor Flaw for violators.

name: Object of Increased Size
description: An enchanted item whose effect makes an object larger; a faculty's possession of one sparks a violent university debate over whether size is substance or quantity.

name: Objects of Virtue
description: Natural objects such as gems and formed stones that contain vis and can be Enriched to confer Virtues; rarely useful to magi due to zero Penetration and the Warping they cause.

name: Observant
description: Free choice: a typical faerie increasing Pretenses two seasons per year.

name: Odin's Sacrifice
description: A vitkir initiation; magi who undergo it may receive an automatic Discovery toward Hermetic Rune Magic.

name: Odo, Count of Paris
description: Chosen king of the Franks in 888 for resisting the Norse.

name: Odor of Lingering Magic
description: InVi 30 spell letting the magus smell active magic and fresh traces.

name: Odorpes
description: A maga of House Bjornaer and filia of Urgen, sole inhabitant of Fengheld's Lusatia chapter, who spends most of her time as a bear and hibernates all winter.

name: Oenghus
description: Mortal shinty champion of Crun Clach, warm and friendly, the only mortal living in the second level of the hill's regio; better at shinty than Count Gwyridden despite never practicing.

name: Ogam
description: Runes carved into trees and stones or written in ashes by the Damhadh-Duidsan to curse, steal life, inflict wounds, and heal.

name: Ogier the Dane
description: A mythic Danish hero kept by Morgana in Avalon for two hundred years; one of the Sleepers of Oleron may be a powerful faerie version of him.

name: Old Norse
description: Language Ability required for vitkar inscriptions.

name: Old Ways
description: Pagan religion some unGifted gruagachan follow after abandoning the Church.

name: Olympians
description: The Olympian gods who destroyed the telechines' fortress; faeries claiming Olympian descent hate telechines.

name: One Romantic Evening
description: CrHe 10 rose petal carpeting the ground with roses.

name: Ophiomancy
description: Divinatory method using behavior of serpents, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Oppidum
description: Transylvanian term for what other Tribunals call covenants; able to specialize with needs met by the state.

name: Oppositional Elements
description: Story obstacles of set values that each pilgrim must overcome, totaling the Pilgrimage Target Level.

name: Order of Calatrava
description: Iberian military order founded in Castile in 1158 as the military branch of a Cistercian order at the fortress of Calatrava, active in the Reconquista.

name: Order of Saint Lazarus
description: Military order originally composed entirely of lepers, formed in 1130 in Jerusalem's leper hospital; leprous brothers of other orders must join it.

name: Order of Saint Thomas at Acre
description: Minor order formed in Acre after the Third Crusade to care for the poor and sick and bury the dead, mainly attracting English pilgrims.

name: Order of Santiago
description: Iberian crusading order founded 1170 by Ferdinand II of Leon, involved in the Reconquista.

name: Order of the Hospitalers of St. Anthony
description: An order established in 1095 and named after a fourth-century Egyptian hermit; it knows a ritual to exorcise the St. Anthony's Fire demon and maintains houses across Europe with a chapter house in London.

name: Ordination
description: Ceremony marking each step through the orders, requiring an oral examination; also a Sacrament conducted by a bishop.

name: Organization Lore: Knights Templar
description: Knowledge of Templar rule, members, provinces, sign language and ciphers.

name: Organization Lore: Roman Empire
description: An Organization Lore Ability; Ovid's Fasti is a summa on it.

name: Origen
description: Early Church theologian and biblical scholar whose ideas on free will and the stars heavily influence the Magoi of the Star; his tomb is at Tyre.

name: Orlando
description: A musician and magus who knows Sorcerous Music and Subtle Magic, used as an example of casting spells while singing or playing his lute.

name: Orléans
description: City on the Loire, once Merovingian capital of Burgundy, famed for its cathedral school.

name: Orphan
description: Free Social Status Virtue: the child's parents are unknown or deceased.

name: Orphic Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue granting Orphic magoi access to the additional Range Adelphixis, using emotional connections as Arcane Connections.

name: Ostentatious
description: Major General Virtue: the faerie gains Pretense every season; multiplier 25.

name: Ostracism
description: Seven-yearly secret ballot using sherds; the magus with most votes must leave the Greater Alps or be Marched.

name: Oswald
aliases: Saint Oswald, King of the Northumbrians
description: A most Christian king of the Northumbrians (633-642) who raised a cross before battle and won; many miracles and healings occurred at the cross and at the sites of his death and burial.

name: Otto I
description: Son of Henry the Fowler, crowned at Aachen in 936, who defeated the Magyars at the Battle of the Lech (Lechfeld) in 955 and was crowned emperor in Rome in 962.

name: Otto III
description: German Emperor tutored by Gerbert, killed in a Roman revolt.

name: Outer Hebrides
description: The western group of the Western Islands, battered by Atlantic storms.

name: Ovid
description: The Roman poet whose Fasti is the best source on the She-Wolf's Roman history.

name: Owein son of Uryen
description: A figure at Arthur's court in the Dream of Rhonabwy who played gwyddbwyll with Arthur while his magical ravens battled Arthur's men.

name: Owl of Virtue
description: A Great Beast Mythic Blood lineage granting the Silence of the Smothered Sound feat, a Focus in Ghosts, and the Nocturnal flaw.

name: Pack Mentality / Follower
description: A Minor Personality Flaw making the character a follower rather than a leader who tends to stick with a decisive person.

name: Palfrey
description: Gentle-gaited riding horse, often for ladies or inexperienced riders.

name: Pan
description: Wild god of satyrs and faerie revelry whose supposed death left a void demons exploited.

name: Pan Caudarax
description: Dragon and first guardian of Iceland who destroyed Hadrianus's ship; he can shapeshift into a lindorm or kraken and commands an attendant host.

name: Pandius
description: Vessel of Iniquity demon who teaches secret poisoning; appears as a scorpion-man.

name: Pandora
description: A clay woman that Hephaestus made for Zeus, listed among his famous treasures.

name: Parching Wind
description: A Perdo Aquam spell (Level 20) that removes most water from an object, and with a Corpus or Animal requisite can damage humans or animals while making them thirsty.

name: Parish Priest
description: Representative of the Church in the parish, reciting the liturgy, distributing alms and caring for his congregation.

name: Parish Register
description: Book (Level 7) held by the example Village Parish.

name: Parmulae
description: A 'little shield': a lesser enchanted device such as a brooch granting its wearer Magic Resistance 30 for one year; a Minor Breakthrough based on Notatus's work.

name: Parsifal
description: Tractatus, Magic Lore, by Wolfram von Eschenbach placing the Grail at Munsalvaesche.

name: Partner
description: A major Social Status Virtue for a character with a large financial stake in a wealthy company, providing minor-noble-level income and the ability to act in any company role except capo.

name: Parzival
description: Wolfram von Eschenbach's epic poem, said to hide an allegory of the Knights and directions to their Grail Castle.

name: Pasiel
description: Duke of Purgatory, an angel of punishment treated as a demon (Infernal Might 40) who can manipulate time.

name: Passion (Target)
description: Faerie Target affecting a group through a particular emotion or desire; same level as Group.

name: Patarus
description: Demon of the Order of Accusers serving BaalBaruth, who appears as a thin horned monk in Cluniac garb and uses powers like Whispers Behind the Back.

name: Path of Aging
description: A forest path through which Alexander of Jerbiton sought to reverse aging, requiring sacrifices and a quest to drink from the Fountain of Youth, yielding the Immortality of the Forest Virtue.

name: Path of Chance
description: The route through the Faerie Realm that wends through Arcadia, a land of pure adventure among fragments of stories yet to be told.

name: Path of Choice
description: The path into Eudokia, embarked upon by those entering a Faerie Aura on the verge of a major life change.

name: Path of Destiny
description: The straighter route through Elysium, where characters relive allegorical stories whose outcomes are already established.

name: Patrick's Island
description: Largest island on Lough Dearg, named after Saint Patrick, home to an Augustinian chapter house with a Dominion aura of 3 (4 within the house).

name: Patrick, Count of Dunbar
description: Powerful noble with lands on both sides of the Anglo-Scottish border, claiming descent from Duncan.

name: Patron Saint
description: A saint a character may invoke for intercession, often of the local church, region or profession.

name: Paxon filius Valentin
description: Archmage of Verditius, the finest brewer of longevity potions in the Order, based at Sinews of Knowledge.

name: Pelagius
description: One of Jerbiton's allies who traveled Europe seeking further recruits for the expanding House.

name: Pelican of Virtue
description: A symbolic bird whose beak provides a Shape and Material bonus of +8 to healing and nurturing.

name: Pellam filius Cato
description: Young Criamon who believes ball sports are remnants of pagan rituals leading toward the Enigma.

name: Peloponnesus
description: Region ravens flew from, per Pliny, after the massacre of Median mercenaries.

name: Penance
description: Sacrament of confession and absolution that grants a Confidence Point and a holy connection to the confessor.

name: Pentele
description: A being who protects the Beasts of Virtue inhabiting a magical garden realm and may allow visitors to hunt there in exchange for favors.

name: Pepin the Short
description: Frankish ruler who restored the pope to power over the Papal States.

name: Perceive the Change
description: An InAn 14 constant enchantment effect detecting whether an item touches an animal, used to trigger linked size/shape effects when a Bjornaer transforms.

name: Perdo Vim
description: A Hermetic Technique-Form combination of destruction and magical power; Perdo Vim spells that reduce Might can kill a legendary artist.

name: Perfect Eye for (Commodity)
description: A minor general Virtue letting a character always accurately assess the value of one commodity and products made from it, granting extra Labor Points when trading exclusively in it.

name: Periapt
description: Minor Mystery Virtue allowing creation of astrological amulets as charged devices using a Periapt Horoscope as a single-use Lab Text.

name: Periapts
description: Virtue learned at the Degree of Mars of the Magoi of the Star.

name: Peris
description: Demon controlling many diabolists in northern Italy's cities, patron of the Della Torre, who took flesh as Eccelino da Romano.

name: Periwinkle of Virtue
description: Blue flower of virtue that when Enriched grants Venus's Blessing along with the Reckless Flaw; unenriched worth 1 pawn of Mentem vis.

name: Pernix of Merinita
description: Magus acquitted in 1179 after covertly healing a young nobleman.

name: Perpauca Bonisagi
description: Magus whose books became the first tomes of the Library of the Normandy Tribunal.

name: Personal Faerie Power
description: Virtue or creature Quality listed for a being (Anne, Minerva Sulis, Balneator) or setting feature described here.

name: Perthean Compact
description: Normandy Peripheral Code rulings drafted by Pertheus distributing vis sources as seisins, legacies, tropaea, and luctationes.

name: Pertheus of Tytalus
description: Magus of House Tytalus who proposed the right of conquest and the Perthean Compact.

name: Perugia
description: Town at war with Assisi in 1202 where Francis was taken captive.

name: Peter des Roches
aliases: Peter des Roches, Bishop of Winchester
description: The bishop of Winchester (since 1205) and member of the regency triumvirate, a wealthy French-born warrior-bishop and former tutor of the king, contemptuous of Magna Carta.

name: Peter of Montaigu
description: Grand Master of the Templars from 1219, elected at Damietta; rumored to seek independence even from the pope.

name: Peter the Lombard
description: Author of the Sententiae (Sentences), one of the authoritative sources for the Academic Ability Theology: Christian.

name: Petitioning the Church
description: Rule for seeking Church favor, with bonuses from Cluniac, Cistercian or Vallumbrosan support.

name: Petronilla of Leicester
description: A woman recorded as having armed herself as a knight and fought in battles during the reign of Henry II; a namesake later haggled the right to choose her own husband. An example of absence-based female power.

name: Pfalz Island
description: An island in the center of the Rhine that formerly housed the covenant of Rheinstein (Magic aura 2), with a ruined castle, a dripstone-bearing rocky spine, and currently occupied by Lord Robert Schonburg.

name: Pfeffers
description: Benedictine monastery with hot springs.

name: Phalene filia Innocu
description: Criamon who studies metamorphic animals and sees Twilight as a biological process.

name: Phantasm of the Talking Head
description: A Creo Imaginem spell (Level 10) that creates an illusory face on a wall or flat object that can speak during the spell's duration.

name: Phantasticum
description: The spiritual yet corporeal form that strays from a nightwalker's body, able to become corporeal, immaterial or invisible and to take human or animal shape.

name: Philip I
description: French king who bought Bourges in 1100.

name: Philip of France
description: The king of France who expelled John from Normandy in 1204 and besieged Ghent; forced to abandon plans to invade England after William de Longespee's naval action at Damme.

name: Philosophers of Rome
description: Secretive non-Christian cult claiming descent from Simon Magus, seeking apotheosis through sensual Gnosticism.

name: Philosophic Magic
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue adding Philosophiae to Kabbalah totals.

name: Phorcys
description: Lord of the Barren Sea before Poseidon, god of death in the sea and father of sea monsters; an Aspect of him is a Magic spirit of Might 40.

name: Physician's Sense
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: Pictland
description: Land of the Picts, conquered by Kenneth MacAlpin.

name: Pierce the Faerie Veil
description: Spell that detects the Faerie regio.

name: Pierce the Magic Veil
description: Variant spell highlighting the Magic regio.

name: Pierre de Beauvais
description: Medieval bestiary author quoted on the caladrius, lion, salamander and stag.

name: Pierres de Niton
description: Two rocks in Lake Léman linked to Díedne sacrifices.

name: Pietrine lineage
description: Flambeau lineage founded by Pietro specializing in Auram lightning magic; its members call themselves Jovians.

name: Pilgrim
description: A traveler journeying to a holy site or shrine, facing ordeals on the road.

name: Pillars of Hercules
description: Islands at the western edge of the known world near Granada, thought to contain uncontrolled gateways to Arcadia and the Magical realm.

name: Pine Away
description: Faerie power causing the target to lose the will to live and vitality, treated as a major disease; glanconers use an Arcane Connection version.

name: Plagued by Angel
description: A Story Flaw in which a character is troubled by the attention of an angel; held by the Priest companion and possible for Devil Children.

name: Plaustrum Pertinax
description: A heavily warped covenant wagon turned Magic Thing via the Transformed Thing Virtue, stubborn and disobedient towards magi.

name: Play
description: Ability appearing in character statistics in this text.

name: Play Shinty
description: Physical Skill covering shooting, dribbling and blocking with the caman in shinty.

name: Pleasant Clouds in the Mind
description: Merry Devils Power clouding a person or object in illusion.

name: Plentarch
description: An ancient Mercurian high priest who gathered 38 Mercurians at Pompeii and taught them a ritual allowing them to commune with their gods in concert.

name: Plotinus
description: Greek philosopher whose teachings the Brethren of Purity combined in their encyclopedia.

name: Po Valley
description: Northern valley occupied by the communes.

name: Podesta
description: Commune office created by Frederick Barbarossa, usually held by Infernally tainted outsiders.

name: Poetic Justice
description: Rule that a geas or curse fitting the victim's past acts is harder to resist, modifying the victim's Stamina roll from -6 to +9; also the core ethic of the gruagachan.

name: Poisoned Battlefield
description: Arsenic-poisoned site in the Mendip Hills, Stonehenge Tribunal, once haunted by an archnecromancer, druid ghosts and dead Roman miners.

name: Poisoned Sap
description: Vis site: the Old Oak oozes poisonous sap yielding Perdo vis sordida.

name: Polemic
description: Persuasive summa or tractatus explaining a philosophical position, circulated to build support before a Tribunal debate.

name: Pontius Pilate
description: Unquiet spirit for whom Mount Pilatus is named, who punishes climbers with terrible weather; harvesting vis from his ghost was outlawed.

name: Poor (Characteristic)
description: A Minor General Flaw lowering a Characteristic already at -3 or lower by one further point.

name: Poor Concentration
description: A Minor General Flaw giving the character a -3 penalty to Concentration rolls due to a short attention span.

name: Poor Reader
description: A common Flaw among the exsules, most of whom have studied from vis for their entire careers.

name: Poor Strength
description: A Flaw possessed by Brother Julian reflecting weak physical strength.

name: Poor Student
description: A Minor General Flaw subtracting 3 from Advancement Totals derived from teaching and books.

name: Pope Alexander III
description: Pope who issued an 1179 decree, followed by most communities, requiring the expulsion of lepers.

name: Pope Eugenius III
description: Pope who accepted the truth of Hildegard's visions in Scivias after Bernard of Clairvaux supported them.

name: Pope Gregory VII
description: A church reformer who decreed in 1079 that all cathedrals must make schooling compulsory for priests.

name: Pope Stephen II
description: Pope whose ruling about a 'seven generations' reprieve German nobles misunderstand.

name: Poplar Tree of Virtue
description: White poplar Tree of Virtue with Creo vis in its leaves; a crown of its leaves grants the Long-Winded Virtue.

name: Porphyrion
description: Powerful Archmage and eremite from the Rome Tribunal, a possible third contender for Tytalus Primus.

name: Portugal
description: Iberian kingdom where Templars received their earliest Iberian donations.

name: Portune
description: Tiny brownie-like faerie, half the size of a thumb, that roasts frogs on the fire while humans sleep.

name: Potent Salts
description: Charged Item of crystals that turn seawater into salt.

name: Potent Spells
description: Formulaic spell designed with Casting Items whose Shape and Material Bonuses give a Potency added to Casting Score.

name: Potion
description: Mythic alchemist creation using amulet mechanics, usable by anyone, requiring vis per 5 levels.

name: Powerful Ally
description: Church Boon representing a powerful patron, such as a bishop related to the curate.

name: Praeses Septentrionalis
description: The Northern Guard, a group of covenants formed by Pralix to watch for Damhan-allaidh's return; destroyed in 889.

name: Preaching
description: A Profession-type Ability used to emotionally influence an audience or teach Theology; in 1220 almost exclusively practiced by Dominican friars.

name: Premnemosyne
description: A Woman of Good Intent (Spirit of Deceit), a false prophetess and demon of acedia who spreads false prophecies; currently active in a small Rhineland town.

name: Presence (Range)
description: Holy magic Range letting the caster affect targets within an invisible divine aura sized by Presence; equal to Voice.

name: Preservative
description: A Level 10 alchemical Reagent, a tarry substance that when painted onto wood proofs it against rot, mold, and pests, making about two gallons.

name: Prestigious Student
description: A Minor General Virtue for the son of a nobleman or prosperous merchant matriculated at a university with retainers, trained in Artes Liberales and Latin by a private tutor.

name: Pretend
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Pretentious
description: Minor General Virtue: the faerie increases Pretense three seasons per year; multiplier 20.

name: Prevailing Loyalty
description: A game measure of how loyal a covenant's covenfolk are overall, derived from a Base Loyalty (driven by the magi's Gifts) modified by living conditions, treatment, and events.

name: Prevailing Wisdom
description: The established view a polemic seeks to change, which sets the argument's level.

name: Primogeniture Lineage
description: A Minor Story and Hermetic Flaw in which the character is in line for Primus of House Verditius, receiving undue attention and political enmity; only available to Verditius magi.

name: Primus Johannes
description: A non-magus notary who unexpectedly claimed Criamon Primacy; his ghost is the House expert in Hermetic legal precedent and he secured the Privileges of Criamon.

name: Prince of the Grey Jerkin
description: Faerie prince (Faerie Might 35) who lost his hill to Crun Clach at shinty, now a pauper who challenges the covenant to rematches every few decades and creates monsters to harass it.

name: Principalities
description: Angelic Choir to which Asuryal belongs; pious kings are placed among them.

name: Prior
description: Second in command to the abbot, or head of a priory, handling administration and outside relations.

name: Prison of Flames
description: A Muto Ignem spell (Level 20) that turns a bonfire into a prison shaped like a miniature castle; a person inside is unburned but takes +15 damage trying to escape.

name: Probe for Pure Silver
description: An Intellego Terram spell that lets the caster smell silver and follow the scent.

name: Proctor of Hermes
description: Story seed position: a magus Quaesitor representing the Order at the papal curia.

name: Profession: Marshal
description: A Profession Ability dealing with understanding, purchasing, and caring for horses, functioning like Medicine for veterinary treatment.

name: Profession: Master of Kennels
description: A Profession Ability governing the care of dogs, treatment of their diseases, and acquisition and breeding of hounds.

name: Profession: Storyteller
description: Ability used to make verbal offers to Faerie.

name: Prophet's Seal Ring
description: Silver seal ring of Muhammad lost down a well by 'Uthman; would be a relic of Faith 7 and Divine Might 70.

name: Protect the Herd
description: Power of the Wild Boar of the Woods granting him and his animal allies +5 Soak for Sun duration.

name: Protogonoi
description: Primal spirits whose children are the primeval giants; Ouranos, Ge and Ymir are examples.

name: Psychodrama
description: An allegorical story taking place in the mind of a meditating Criamon magus, amounting to spiritual combat against the self, used to dramatize introspective avenues.

name: Ptolemy
description: Greek philosopher whose teachings the Brethren of Purity combined in their encyclopedia.

name: Pueritia
description: The early stages of an apprentice's education, generally associated with childhood (ages 8 to 14).

name: Puffin Joker
description: Puffin warped by the magic of the Outer Farnes whose silly dance compels laughter.

name: Puissant Athletics
description: Virtue possessed by the Stag of Virtue.

name: Puissant Concentration
description: Virtue listed in this text (e.g. for Iasper or the Black Dog).

name: Puissant Corpus
description: The Minor Hermetic Virtue of the Damhadh-Duidsan tradition, granting bonus effective Corpus.

name: Puissant Hunt
description: Minor Virtue of the sample water elemental.

name: Puissant Medicine
description: A Virtue that enhances a character's effective Medicine Ability score.

name: Puissant Pretense
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue giving +2 to rolls with a particular Pretense.

name: Puissant Swim
description: Virtue boosting swimming, possessed by seals and demons of futility.

name: Pull of the Skybound Winds
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 30) that makes winds rise upward, pulling an object, creature, or person up to 50 feet into the sky before dropping it.

name: Pull of the Watery Grave
description: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 35) that creates a strong undertow pulling objects smaller than a rowboat 25 fathoms into the depths.

name: Pulla
description: Brown or black toga worn by magi as a sign of mourning.

name: Purification
description: CrCo 40 Mercurian ritual reducing Decrepitude and apparent age, cast in a consecrated temple of Mercury.

name: Pursuit Predator
description: Animal Quality listed in the seal statistics (Pursuit Predator).

name: Qlippot
description: The ten unholy spheres composing the Infernal realm in Kabbalah, perversions of the ten holy sefirot.

name: Quaesitor (Virtue)
description: Virtue listed in character statistics in this text.

name: Quaesitorial blindfold
description: Enchanted blindfold that aids detection of deception and clear reasoning.

name: Queen Skuld
description: Hierophant and Mystagogue of the Children of Odin; formerly a Tytalus maga of Atramentum who joined Ex Miscellanea, vanished toward Scandinavia, and returned in 1205.

name: Queen of Faerie
description: A faerie ruler in the Maddenhofen Woods of Bohemia whom the Founder Tytalus entered to challenge, never to be seen again.

name: Quick Charged Items
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus create single-use charged items in one hour per magnitude.

name: Quiet the Raging Winds
description: A Perdo Auram spell (Level 20) that stops all wind from blowing on the caster, leaving only calm air.

name: Quills of Arcane Correspondence
description: A pair of matched enchanted goose quills; whatever is written with one is copied by the other.

name: Quinquennial Games
description: Tribunal-wide games held every five years after a tribunal, culminating in a nude shielded race.

name: Rabi'a al-'Adawiyya
description: Early Muslim mystic of Basra, model for Sufis; holy forbear with Divine Might 50.

name: Rack of Thorns
description: Ragoneda's MuCo 20 spell growing bone thorns inside the target's ribcage.

name: Rade
description: Faerie ride of the good folk, with bells on horses' manes.

name: Ragnarok
description: The Norse doom to which the curse on the Rhine gold contributes.

name: Ragoneda filia Elisa
description: Young Tytalus Corpus specialist and bone maga, a long-term visitor and negotiator for Sinews of Knowledge.

name: Raguel
description: An angel who, together with Samuil, transported Enoch through the Seven Heavens.

name: Rahab
aliases: Rahab, Prince of the Primordial Sea
description: Prince of the Primordial Sea (sar shel yam), a Lord of the Aerial Powers, a fallen angel of the oceans struck down by God at the parting of the Red Sea.

name: Rain Parasol
description: CrAu 40 parasol creating a miniature storm.

name: Rain of Stones
description: A Muto Auram spell (Level 20) that turns falling rain into small stones causing minor damage; the stones revert to water when the spell expires.

name: Raise the Dead
description: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

name: Raising the Auxiliaries for a Day
description: CrMe 35 ritual granting up to 100 characters +1 Attack/Defense.

name: Rapacious Hand of the Highwayman
description: ReTe 35 spell transporting a wagon three miles, common in the Normandy Tribunal.

name: Rapunzel
description: Fairy tale girl stolen by a witch who develops magical healing tears; a likely source of Corpus or Creo vis.

name: Rarefication
description: The magical process by which pure physical matter takes on pseudo-life and self-organizes into an elemental, catalyzed by spells, botches, or spontaneous Warping in a Magic aura.

name: Rarefy the Crude Water
description: Creo Aquam 30 Ritual spell creating a water elemental from a pool of water.

name: Rauhnachte
description: Austrian festival in late October when some animals gain speech and powers; celebrated by familiars.

name: Raven of Mithras
description: First rank of the Legion; swears an oath gaining Dutybound and learns Strong-Willed.

name: Raven of Virtue
description: Bird of ill omen that foresees calamities and warns humans to cause anxiety.

name: Ready Missiles
description: Option letting an archer or crossbowman with a readied missile shoot as a fast action.

name: Realm of the Truffles
description: Three-level Creo-aligned Magic regio of the Truffle Matron, accessible only on solstices and equinoxes, containing the forest, truffle fields, and holt.

name: Realms of Power
description: The four Realms, against which a realistic mundane world can be contrasted in sagas.

name: Realms of Power: Magic
description: An Ars Magica sourcebook containing rules for training magical animals and for creating magic-realm characters such as legendary artists.

name: Realms of Power: The Divine
description: Supplement referenced for Divine spirits and the Dream Interpreter Virtue.

name: Rebuke the Unfaithful
description: Saint curse threatening death within thirty days unless the target mends his ways.

name: Rebuttal
description: A Mastered Spell special ability applicable to Muto or Rego Vim spells affecting another being's magic, adding three times Mastery score to the spell's effective level.

name: Recalcitrance
description: Aerial Powers Power making them one-and-a-half times harder to control.

name: Receipt
description: Act in which the hero gains a magical agent or token from a donor, on which completion of the story always depends.

name: Recognize Your Master
description: An InCo 5 enchanted effect in the Door of Deimos that checks whether a toucher matches an arcane connection and, if not, triggers the door's repelling effect.

name: Reconnaissance
description: Act in which the villain first appears and gathers information about the hero.

name: Recreating the Inner Sea
description: Ragoneda's CrAq(Co) 25 spell creating a liquid in which severed human flesh stays alive.

name: Rector
description: The priest who holds a parish benefice, resides in the parish and holds Mass there.

name: Rector/Proctor
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character is the representative leader of his faculty or nation at a university and is responsible for his colleagues' behavior.

name: Red-Hame
description: A faerie wolf with Faerie Might 12 and a ruddy neck and back; the messenger of the Winter Court who accompanies Torven and conveys the court's wishes to Waldheim.

name: Reduced Abilities
description: Minor Inferiority subtracting 50 experience points.

name: Reduced Initiative
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw decreasing a natural weapon's Initiative by 3.

name: Reduced Might
description: A Flaw or Inferiority named among the traits of magical animals or dragons in this text.

name: Reduced Soak
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw reducing Soak by 2 due to contact with a Ward.

name: Reeve
description: Manorial officer through whom the bailiff runs the manor; gives account up to Michaelmas and is replaced or reaffirmed on that day.

name: Refinement
description: A laboratory Characteristic representing its sophistication; together with Size it sets the space for Virtues, and is improved through seasons of work requiring Magic Theory.

name: Refrigerant Salt
description: A Level 10 Alteration Reagent whose salt-like crystals freeze water when scattered on its surface, creating a sheet of ice up to six paces in diameter.

name: Regensberg
description: Seat of the duke of Bavaria with an unfinished cathedral.

name: Regina filia Gribbinus
description: Magus trained as a follower of Bonisagus (by Dexter) who shifted to the Criamon; creates mystical spaces.

name: Reichenau
description: Place listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Remora of Virtue
description: A symbolic fish whose fins provide a Shape and Material bonus of +7 to slowing or halting a moving object.

name: Repel the Intruder
description: A CrMe 15 enchanted effect in the Door of Deimos that forces anyone who fails an Intelligence roll to flee in terror; has a high Penetration Total.

name: Repose
description: House Criamon's alternative to death, a paradisaical state of blessedness reached at the end of each path of Initiation, often delayed by magi out of compassion.

name: Reputation as Confidence
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue giving false Confidence points equal to the faerie's highest Reputation, spent on rolls supporting it.

name: Residual Power
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue automatically triggering a faerie power when the body is destroyed.

name: Resonance
description: The sympathetic link between a Hermetic book's construction materials and its subject; resonant materials add quality points to a book studied by magi.

name: Restore the Faded Threads
description: A Creo Vim spell that temporarily restores faded spell traces to a fresh state so they can be examined.

name: Retiarius
description: The certamen School of the Fisherman, which strikes swiftly, gains Initiative bonuses and evades damage.

name: Reveners
description: Vessels of Iniquity who reanimate corpses to spread fear, sharing the Obsession of Fear.

name: Rhaetia
description: Castle-strewn region centred on Chur.

name: Rhiannon
description: A timid maga named Prima of House Merinita at the Grand Tribunal of 997, four generations descended from Quendalon; she defended House Diedne during the Schism War and died of old age.

name: Rhine League
description: An alliance founded by Mainz and Worms (and joined by cities, archbishops, and nobles) to suppress unjust tolls by trade sanctions and destruction of robber-baron castles along the Rhine.

name: Rhine Lore
description: An Area Lore Ability covering the Rhine region; held by several characters including Lord Robert, Wolkan, and David ben David.

name: Rhinegold
description: The lost treasure of the Nibelungs, possibly located at the Rhinefalls and jealously guarded by the powerful Rhine elemental in revenge for his entrapment.

name: Rhodes
description: Home of the telechines, invaded by followers of Athena.

name: Richard, Duke of Cornwall
description: Teenage brother of Henry III, a gifted administrator who in real history buys the title of Holy Roman Emperor.

name: Ring/Circle Magic
description: The Minor Hermetic Virtue of the Columbae, letting them draw circles faster and treat any well-defined boundary as a Circle by marking it.

name: Ritual Items
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue allowing charged items with ritual effects, from integrating folk witch potion-brewing.

name: Ritual of Passing on the Power
description: Rite by which the She-Wolf solemnizes a grant of power, taking the petitioner's birth name and giving a secret name of vengeance.

name: Road (Range)
description: Range reaching anyone on the same road or path as the caster; equivalent to Voice.

name: Robert Grosseteste
description: A brilliant scholar and official of the bishop of Hereford, born 1170, who is an unGifted natural magician acquainted with the magi of Schola Pythagoranis though he declined to join.

name: Robert II
description: French king whose confidante was Abbo.

name: Robert de Courtenay
description: Sheriff of Devon who refused to surrender the shrievalty to Falkes de Bréauté, claiming he should have had the wardship of the heir.

name: Robert of Chester
description: Translated the Liber de Compositione Alchemiae into Latin in 1144.

name: Robert the Bruce
description: Grandson of the claimant Robert Bruce who leads armies against the English after 1298.

name: Robes of Dusty Dawn
description: Enchanted lavender-rose robes covered in chalk markings that protect against natural and supernatural threats; the symbol of the Primus Ex Miscellanea, given to Pralix by the Columbae.

name: Robyn Redcap
description: Demonic familiar of Lord Goulis in the form of a redcap, who keeps his cap red with fresh blood and guards Monksend.

name: Rod of the Primus
description: Enchanted rod of Fudarus controlling rooms' environment; symbol of House Tytalus leadership, held by Harpax.

name: Roger Bacon
description: Eight-year-old boy near Ilchester foreseen as a new Bonisagus.

name: Roots of the Arts
description: Basic summae texts for nine of the Arts, accepted as the preferred primers for a magus seeking competence to train an apprentice, widely and cheaply available.

name: Rose of Jerbiton
description: A magus of House Jerbiton credited with a version of Flash of the Scarlet Flames that leaves a faint odor of roses where the flash explodes.

name: Rosegarten
description: Place listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Rostock
description: An expanding Baltic trading town and port, chief town of the Mecklenburg dynasty of Sorbian princes, overshadowed by neighboring Lubeck.

name: Rote
description: Small numerological spell-like formula cast without die roll, as with Quiet and Still Casting.

name: Rothiger
description: Hound of God companion, an itinerant laborer werewolf with red hair who loves to kill in wolf form.

name: Rowan Sisterhood
description: Informal group led by Jacinta, founded during the purge of the Shadow Flambeau, watching for diabolic or vampiric corruption.

name: Rubaton Ex Miscellanea
description: One of the two heads of Vardian's Tomb, associated with its necromancer faction.

name: Rudesheim
description: A Rhine town on the right bank opposite Bingen, site of the ruined covenant of Rudiaria and the Bromserburg castle; named after the covenant or archbishop Rudbrecht.

name: Rufus
description: Example character who takes Inherited Virtue: Large to have a growth spurt around age 10.

name: Rule of Saint Augustine
description: Monastic rule followed by Augustinian canons, Premonstratensians and many canonesses; fashionable after 1215.

name: Running Water Weakness
description: A demonic weakness preventing the demon from crossing running fresh water deriving directly from the earth.

name: Russia
description: Cold northern land where the gyrfalcon lives.

name: Rusted Decay of Ten Score Years
description: Hermetic spell (PeTe 15) in a Roman Tribunal magus vocation template.

name: Sabaoth
description: A Fury in the form of an eagle-sized raven with mismatched eyes, able to split into a murder of crows, who ensures long-standing feuds continue.

name: Saint Bartholomew
description: Saint whose day is August 24th; example target of Devotion.

name: Saint Denis's Lendit Fair
description: A fair near Paris founded by King Dagobert in the seventh century for the benefit of the Abbey of St. Denis; once the most important fair in France until the Champagne cycle took over.

name: Saint Godric
description: A historical peddler, merchant, pirate, hermit, and saint of northeastern England who settled at Finchale near Durham; renowned for austerity, hymns, and prophecy, he died in 1170 at age 105.

name: Saint Gotthard Pass
description: New pass opened around 1220, its bridge said to be built by the Devil.

name: Saint Jerome
description: Saint after whom Bonosus named an island (Sveti Jerolim).

name: Saint John's Eve
description: Time when faerie hills and barrows open; characters climbing there usually return at dawn.

name: Saint Malachy
description: Irish Cistercian saint, friend of Bernard; obscure prophecies are falsely attributed to him.

name: Saint Mark's Square
description: Square in Venice above which a benandanti militia meets its rivals in immaterial form.

name: Saint Nicholas
description: A saint venerated in northwestern Mythic Europe for miraculously resuscitating three children murdered and pickled by an innkeeper; the planned Kolding church is dedicated to him.

name: Saint Pierre
description: Place listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Saint Severus of Ravenna
description: Married fourth-century archbishop of Ravenna chosen by God through a dove; a saint for married priests and their wives.

name: Saint Wolfgang
description: Priest who founded a church in the Abersee valley in 976 where his axe fell and defeated the Devil.

name: Saint's Island
description: Saint's Island on Lough Dearg, with an Empyreal aura of 4 and a small church whose crypt cell holds the entrance to Purgatory.

name: Salat
description: Ritual prayer five times daily; raises Islamic Dominion auras by one during prayer.

name: Salvirius
description: A subtle faerie courtier of the Boar King who can teach Virtues, including Diedne Magic, to the Boar King's magus allies.

name: Sanctuary of Virginity
description: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

name: Sandalphon
description: One of the three largest beings in existence, who carries the prayers of the faithful to Heaven; his tears fell to earth when Muhammad died.

name: Sanguine Humor's Blessing
description: A Major General Virtue granting bonuses to rolls based on a character's True Feeling Story Flaw, drawing on emotional bonds; the defining Virtue of Orphic magoi.

name: Santiago de Compostela
description: Site of the shrine and tomb of Saint James, a major pilgrimage destination.

name: Sapphire of Virtue
description: Gem containing 1 pawn of Intellego vis that can be Enriched by full moonlight to confer the Intuition Virtue.

name: Sardinia Lore
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Saxony
description: A large and important duchy of fertile lowlands and cities in the Rhine Tribunal, ancestral home of the Welf family and rival to the Hohenstaufens.

name: Scales of the Heart
description: A Power held by the She-Wolf that a lupercus can acquire as a Lesser Power Virtue. It costs one Fatigue level and needs no words or gestures.

name: Scan
description: Ability appearing in character or creature statistics in this text.

name: Scholae Magicae
description: Schools of magic for training apprentices, mostly failed attempts since the 10th century.

name: Scholomance
description: A covenant in the Transylvanian Tribunal that is a school for future apprentices, agents, and companions, set in an intermittently accessible regio and reputed to be a school for sorcerers run by the devil.

name: School of Apromor
description: A versatile school of magical combat within House Flambeau built on the Technique of Perdo, emphasizing destruction, indirect attacks, and multiple Forms; one of the most study-intensive schools.

name: School of Boreas
description: A narrowly defined Flambeau combat school relying on the single Perdo Ignem combination, using cold and darkness; developed by the magus Boreas to bridge the Flambeau and Apromor lineages.

name: School of Ramius
description: A Flambeau combat school that ignores Magic Resistance by using mundane physical attacks supported by magical enhancements, emphasizing defense and Parma Magica; created by Ramius.

name: School of Vilano
description: The most commonly used Flambeau combat school in the Order, relying on indirect attacks that bypass Magic Resistance; created by the magus Vilano and requiring no specific Arts.

name: School of the Founder
description: A Flambeau combat school based on the magic of Flambeau himself, broader than Boreas and favoring the Form of Ignem, requiring penetration of Magic Resistance.

name: Schooled in Crime
description: A Minor General Virtue granting 50 extra experience to spend on Abilities related to thievery such as Stealth, Legerdemain, and Guile.

name: Schwyz
description: Region near which Tarragon Vale lies.

name: Scilly Isles
description: Islands southwest of Land's End said to be the last sinking remnants of the drowned land of Lyonesse, settled by those who fled to the high ground.

name: Scinnfolk
description: Gifted Companions in the Order, herb-wives and faerie doctors with eclectic natural magic and faerie charms passed down orally; not a true systematic tradition.

name: Scottish Dominion
description: The Divine aura of Scottish Church sites, focused on the founder's bell and staff; it dampens Passions and Personality Traits and lets acclimated magi cast as if in a magic aura.

name: Scourging the Infernal
description: Relic Power radiating an aura harmful to demons whose Might is lower than the relic's Divine Might.

name: Scribe Greek
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Scrofula
description: A Serious Melancholic Disease from cold dry city winds; said to be cured by the touch of the Kings of England or France.

name: Scylla
description: A horrendous monster living in a rock off Italy.

name: Sea of Marmara
description: A busy sea near the western end of the Silk Road where Bear Island lies and where the halcyon's vis source is hidden in coves.

name: Seal the Earth
description: A Creo Terram spell that creates enough dirt to fill in a pit up to 6 paces across and 3 paces deep.

name: Season
description: Unit of time used for work and study; Tribunal meetings last about a Season.

name: Season (character)
description: Life-stage classification of magical characters (Spring, Summer, Winter) affecting experience.

name: Second Working
description: Scroll inscription in a strange language and mystical ink that can be cast and provides Insight.

name: Secret Hiding Place
description: Virtue appearing in faerie statistics in this text (Secret Hiding Place).

name: Secret Name
description: A Bjornaer Minor House Mystery that severs and reforges a magus's sympathetic name, expiring all old Arcane Connections and invalidating all Sympathetic Connections against him.

name: Secret Vis Source
description: Virtue appearing in character statistics or rules in this text.

name: Secretive
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character keeps secrets from his sodales, rarely explaining what he is doing or why.

name: See in Darkness
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a character see in complete darkness, though without more acute or longer-range eyesight than normal.

name: Sefer Yetzirah
description: Foundational kabbalistic text describing creation from numbers, writing and speech, and the ten Sefirot.

name: Seisin
description: Vis source within a day's return march of a covenant's council chamber, belonging to it automatically.

name: Selkie Blood
description: Virtue indicating descent from selkies, possibly from the selkie king.

name: Sempringham
description: The first and most important house of the Gilbertine order in eastern England.

name: Senior Bard
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character who spent five or six years at an Irish bardic school, ranked Cano or Cli, with a Local Reputation of 2.

name: Senior Master
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for a prosperous, authoritative guild master who may own multiple workshops, serve as a guild official, and govern guild affairs.

name: Sense Holy/Unholy
description: Supernatural Ability given as an example Holy Ability practiced by a monistic mystic.

name: Sense of Magical Power
description: An Intellego Vim spell that tells the caster whether he is currently in a Magic aura.

name: Sense of the Lingering Magic
description: An Intellego Vim spell that detects many magical residues, even from weak spells, and the presence and power of active spells.

name: Sense of the Mystic
description: Major Hermetic Virtue from studying Second Sight; Intellego sense effects need not penetrate sensed creatures' Magic Resistance.

name: Sense the Sleeping Hound
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: Sensitive
description: Flaw possessed by Count Gwyridden (dirty clothes).

name: Sentences
description: A work by Peter Lombard whose reading might lead to a breakthrough regarding the Divine realm's suppression of magic, per a story seed.

name: Serf
description: Unfree agricultural worker whose labor is owned by his lord in exchange for land; owes rent, week works and boon works.

name: Serlo Le Mercer
description: The mayor of London in 1220, holding all judicial and fiscal authority within the city.

name: Servant of the (Land)
description: A Major Story Flaw in which a powerful magical creature has saved the character and set him a difficult task, imposing a Prohibition until the task is complete.

name: Seven Deadly Sins
description: Model of vices (Proud, Wrathful, Envious, Slothful, Lustful, Greedy, Avaricious) used to categorize Personality Traits with opposing virtues.

name: Seven Heavens
description: The seven Heavens presided over by the seven ruling archangels, through which Enoch was transported.

name: Seventh Ring of Solomon
description: Grants perfect understanding; no botches and all simple rolls become stress rolls.

name: Shabbat
description: Jewish sabbath; Infernal auras in observant Jewish communities decline by one.

name: Shape
description: A gruagach Form that alters the physical shape of the caster or others, including into animals, plants or objects.

name: Shapechanging
description: A non-Hermetic Major Virtue option for the Damhadh-Duidsan tradition.

name: Shared Lab
description: A Free Outfitting laboratory Flaw for a lab too small for independent projects; -2 General Quality, -2 Safety.

name: Shared Senses
description: Bond quality letting magus and familiar use each other's senses.

name: Shattering Touch
description: PeTe 5 spell breaking apart a stone object up to a pace across; known by the sample Verditius apprentice.

name: Shaykh
description: Senior Sufi leading a tariqa; also a title of Assassin religious leaders.

name: Sheltered Upbringing
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character grew up isolated from society and cannot understand most human customs, barring several social Abilities at start.

name: Shiver of the Lycanthrope
description: An Intellego Animal spell (Level 10) that makes the caster feel a shiver when touching a person or beast that is a lycanthrope.

name: Shock of the Charge
description: Option where a mounted charge can knock a smaller target prone.

name: Short of Breath
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character quickly tires during extended physical activity, receiving -3 to Stamina rolls to avoid fatigue.

name: Short-Ranged Curses
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: curse fetishes only work within 100 yards of the target.

name: Shower of Needles
description: Ragoneda's CrCo(Re) 20 spell showering a target with bone needles.

name: Shroud Magic
description: Spell that causes an expiring magic's trace to show a fixed false sigil, possibly mimicking another magus's sigil.

name: Sibyl
description: Figure Hermas mistakenly believes the aged woman of his vision to be.

name: Sicero
description: A recently Gauntletted 23-year-old Journeyman follower of House Tremere at Triamore, filius of Goliard, who secured membership on his mater's recommendations.

name: Sidhe Blood
description: The most common Faerie Blood variety, from courtly faeries, granting a Presence bonus.

name: Siena
description: A north Italian city whose goldsmiths are renowned throughout Europe.

name: Sign Language
description: Ability covering the silent sign languages monks use when speech is forbidden; each monastery's version defaults with penalties to other houses and orders.

name: Significato
description: Magically occurring phenomena that illuminate truth and let magi generate study totals through mystical experiences instead of studying from vis.

name: Sikelgaita of Sicily
description: A Lombard princess and wife of the Duke of Apulia and Sicily who fought dressed as a knight, rallying troops at the Battle of Dyrrachium against the Byzantine Empire; an example of conquest-based female power.

name: Silence of the Smothered Sound
description: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 20) that makes one being or object incapable of producing sound; magi so affected suffer spellcasting penalties for being unable to speak their words.

name: Silent Motion
description: Personal power allowing the character to move without noise.

name: Silk Road
description: Trade route whose western end lies near the Sea of Marmara.

name: Silver Consensus
description: Optional Tribunal ruling that no covenant may create more than two Mythic Pounds of silver per member per year, with further principles regulating magical wealth.

name: Silver Lady
description: Faerie (Faerie Might 35 Corpus) Queen of the Lifeless Hills guarding the poisoned land, riding a lead hog and killing miners.

name: Simple Student
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a university student who has not yet taken a degree, gaining 30 experience points per finished year toward Latin or Artes Liberales.

name: Sing
description: Ability appearing in character statistics in this text.

name: Sinibaldus Fieschi
description: Master who becomes auditor litterarum contradictarum in 1225 and is elected pope Innocent IV in 1243.

name: Sinus Wodinis
description: A second covenant of Bjornaer magi on the southeast coast of Norway, presumed part of the Novgorod Tribunal, whose existence is known only to Crintera.

name: Siobhan filia Vespasian the Avaricious
description: Hibernian Criamon Vim specialist and the House's expert on faeries, who learned Faerie Magic from a Merinita.

name: Sir Lancelot
description: Knight raised by Viviane who first kissed Guinevere at the Bridge of Secrets.

name: Sirmium
description: The last Hermetic covenant in Meissen, destroyed in the 10th century by invading Magyars; its known vis sources were destroyed along with it.

name: Size
description: Score for body size affecting Characteristics and wound penalties; humanoid faeries choose from Size +2 to -3 normally.

name: Skilled Master
description: Minor General Virtue granting an extra 50 experience points for Arts, Abilities and charms.

name: Slap of Awakening
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: Slaying the Primus
description: Criamon ritual in which a magus of another House ritually murders the primus on the eighth regio level.

name: Sleepers
description: Faeries dwelling in the regio of Oleron, some predating Hermetic colonization, who defend the covenant and can be awakened.

name: Sleeping Vis
description: A material object with simple glamour but no vitality that may awaken as a faerie if given vitality; prized by House Merinita.

name: Slothful
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character is lazy and indolent, constantly seeking excuses to avoid work.

name: Slow Reflexes
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character does not react well to surprises, receiving -3 to Initiative in situations warranting a quick response.

name: Smite Evil
description: Seraphim power, as Demon's Eternal Oblivion, which also affects faeries.

name: Smithying
description: Focus power duplicating non-Ritual Creo, Muto, Rego or Perdo Terram spells, limited by motif.

name: Snap of Awakening
description: A spell that instantly awakens the target from sleep to alert consciousness when the caster snaps their fingers.

name: Social Status
description: Category of Virtue or Flaw every character needs; children usually take Son/Daughter of their parent's status.

name: Societas Merceris
description: Societies within House Mercere designed primarily for Redcaps, based on covenant, goals, family or creed.

name: Somerled
description: Norse-Gael rebel who defeated Godred of Man in 1156 and gained Islay and Mull.

name: Soothe Pains of the Beast
description: A Creo Animal Ritual spell (Level 20) that cures one Light Wound suffered by an animal, resembling a ritualistic laying-on of hands.

name: Soothe the Raging Flames
description: A Perdo Ignem spell (Level 20) that eradicates the heat of a bonfire so the flames do not spread or harm anything beyond what they already burned.

name: Southern France
description: Region where Kabbalah arose in the twelfth century.

name: Speak Arabic
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Speak Greek
description: Ability appearing in character statistics in this text.

name: Speak Romansch
description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

name: Spell Spirits
description: Spirits summoned by Hermetic Theurgy initiates that duplicate a specific spell or Form.

name: Spell Timing
description: A Minor Illusion Mystery of the Followers of Pendule granting new spell Durations (Held, Midday/Midnight, Season, While/Not/If Condition) and recurring spell effects.

name: Spell-Like Vis
description: Extraordinary vis mimicking a high-level spell, consumed at the end of the effect.

name: Spharios
description: The conscious sphere/mind of the universe at the moment of complete harmony, to which followers of the Path of Walking Backwards may ascend and rejoin in repose.

name: Spindle
description: Implement female magi carry to disguise magic items; has form and effect bonuses.

name: Spirit Form
description: A power (Vim) of the angels Nasir and Seferiel that lets them become a creature of pure spirit, unable to affect or be affected physically.

name: Spirit of the Rhine
description: A powerful water elemental spirit of the Rhine, pinioned at the Rhinefalls by a giant's rock; Schwall has served it through Quests and plots to release it.

name: Spirits of Solomon
description: Seven female Deluder spirits named Deception, Strife, Battle, Envy, Power, Error and Corruption, once bound by Solomon, who inflict curses.

name: Spiritual Anchor
description: A mundane object into which a faerie writes its glamour, around which its body agglomerates; it holds the faerie's vis.

name: Spontaneous Casting Tools
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character must use casting tools to cast spontaneous spells, with 15 tools one for each Art; only available to Verditius magi.

name: Spotless
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is impeccably clean, requiring a season's work and maintenance (+1 Health, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Creo).

name: Spreading a Mantle of Snow
description: Power coating the ground in ice and snow, used by the Cailleach Bheur and koerakoonlane war leaders.

name: Spring of Artakia
description: A spring near Artakia with a Magic aura of 2, the easiest site on Bear Island at which to found a covenant.

name: St Ambrose
description: Wrote that Mary first saw the Resurrection; greater saint, patron of bishops, learning and bees.

name: St Jerome
description: Churchman to whom some copies of the malleus epistula are attributed.

name: St Matthew
description: Apostle whose lost head-relic at St. Matthew's Point quells storms.

name: St-Gildas-de-Rhuys
description: Monastery on the Gulf of Morbihan where Abélard retreated.

name: St. Adalbert of Prague
description: A saint who defeated the spirit of Romowe, drove it back into the Holm Oak, and lit the fire that keeps it trapped; his relics are housed at the Basilica of St. Vitus in Prague.

name: St. Albans
description: An abbey whose immunities Falkes de Bréauté violated by killing a fleeing monk and extorting money, before later doing penance there.

name: St. Andrews
description: Bishopric whose bishop is primate of the Church in Scotland.

name: St. Benedict
description: The saint under whose monastic rule Bricstan wished to live; he appeared in a blaze of light and broke Bricstan's fetters in prison.

name: St. Bernard of Clairvaux
description: Great Cistercian churchman who founded Clairvaux and preached the Second Crusade at Vézelay.

name: St. Dunstan
description: Patron saint of metalworkers, locksmiths, and embroiderers; a tenth-century English Benedictine monk, Abbot of Glastonbury and later Archbishop of Canterbury, and namesake of the Eye of St Dunstan.

name: St. Edward the Confessor
description: Eleventh-century king of England who became a saint.

name: St. Geneviève
description: Peasant girl whose prayers saved Paris from Attila; patron saint of Paris.

name: St. Guinefort
description: A greyhound venerated as a local saint (Divine Might 25), patron of protecting local children.

name: St. John the Evangelist
description: Apostle whose apocalyptic revelations close the New Testament; greater saint and patron of Asia Minor, friendship, and writers.

name: St. Joseph
description: Patron saint of woodworkers; the foster father of the Son of God who lived in Judaea and died in the first century.

name: St. Louis
description: Louis IX, currently 5 years old, who historically ascends in 1226 and is canonized in 1297.

name: St. Maclou
description: Welsh founder of Breton Christianity commemorated at St. Malo; converted Gauls at Aleth.

name: St. Mungo
description: Saint whose Bell and Staff were carried north by a fleeing abbot.

name: St. Nicholas
description: A patron saint of merchants in general; the fourth-century Bishop of Myra in Turkey.

name: St. Oran
description: Monk of Columba's band buried alive at Iona's first church; prayers to Columba must go through him.

name: St. Wenceslaus
description: Bohemia's patron saint and former duke, murdered by his pagan brother Boleslav; it is foretold he will rise from the dead, take the sword of Bruncvik, and call forth his sleeping army at Mount Blanik.

name: Stalwart Casting
description: Cult of Mercury mastery ability reducing fatigue from casting.

name: Stance of the Patient Tree
description: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 35) with a Herbam requisite that turns the caster into a tree about 12 feet high; a tree branch lets the caster change back.

name: Standard of the Shadowy Men
description: Jerbiton item creating Group Seven League Stride, invisibility and grog enhancements, used against the Fanes.

name: Star of David
description: Six-pointed star symbolizing God with kabbalistic resonance.

name: Stasis
description: Ritual-like spirit power that closes off a Magic-aura area so that residents' aging points become Warping points instead.

name: Station
description: One of five grades of progress on a Criamon path - psychological states providing wisdom and supernatural Mystery Virtues, reached by following an avenue.

name: Statue of Bone
description: Ragoneda's MuCo 50 spell calcifying an enemy into a statue of bone.

name: Staubbach Fall
description: Waterfall near Lauterbrunnen yielding Imáginem vis.

name: Steal Judgment
description: Faerie power making the target believe almost any lie the faerie tells by diminishing his capacity for doubt; possessed by glanconers.

name: Stefano
description: Gifted mathematicus and master at Bologna, born in Rome to a jurist, specializing in Fortunam.

name: Steris
description: Youngest full member and spokesman of Verdi, aged 54, who investigates rumors and lost items.

name: Stigmatic Catalyst
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character's presence causes symbolic marks to appear on nearby people lacking Magic Resistance; normally found among House Criamon magi.

name: Still Casting
description: A Mastered Spell special ability allowing a maga to cast a spell without gestures at no penalty.

name: Stingy Master
description: Flaw appearing in character statistics or rules in this text.

name: Stockade Parma Magica
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character cannot suppress his Parma Magica once erected, so friendly spells must penetrate it as if hostile.

name: Stola
description: Roman women's dress worn by female magi, often with a palla.

name: Stone of Bacchus
description: A weathered finger of rock jutting from the Rhine near Baccharach on an island with a Magic aura of 2; locals believe touching it brings luck to the wine harvest, and its festival wine becomes hallucinogenic Muto vis.

name: Stone of Destiny
description: Ancient relic that cries out when the rightful king stands on it; taken by Edward I.

name: Story Magic
description: A Major Folk Mystery (Virtue) allowing a maga to influence the story of her own life through story charms that bring about myth-like circumstances.

name: Storyguide
description: The player running the game, who adjudicates actions, situations and optional rules.

name: Straighten the Crippled
description: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

name: Strigae
description: Misguided Infernal tradition of night witches who worship demons as pagan gods, gathering in covens of 13 led by a senior infernalist bound to a demon.

name: Strike of the Angered Branch
description: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 15) that causes a large tree branch to swing at a target repeatedly for +10 damage.

name: Strings of the Unwilling Marionette
description: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 25) that lets the caster control the physical movements of a conscious person.

name: Strong Amulet Magic
description: Major Supernatural Virtue giving +10 to Lab Totals for creating chartae and amulets.

name: Styx
description: The wife of Pallas, representing the underworld river upon which solemn oaths are sworn; her name means "hatred" and she bore the Daimons Zelos, Kratos, Peitho, Nike, and Bia.

name: Subdeacon
description: Lowest major order; receives paten, chalice, pitcher and basin; serves as parish clerks and canons.

name: Subinfeudation
description: The process by which tenants-in-chief divide estates into smaller parcels to support warriors, forming a pyramid of power down to the individual knight.

name: Subtle Form
description: A power (Corpus) of the angels Nasir and Seferiel that lets them change their appearance to look like any human being without changing their statistics.

name: Subtle Opening
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue from a breakthrough integrating folk witch Opening; no Arts penalty when learning Supernatural Abilities.

name: Suffusio
description: A Serious Melancholic Disease, a congregation of humor between lens and pupil obstructing sight; treated by 'couching'.

name: Sukkot
description: Jewish holy day ending the atonement period that banishes demons.

name: Summoning the Distant Images
description: Spell (InIm 35) known by Amberitus.

name: Sundering of House Tremere
description: Historical punishment of House Tremere questioned by Children of Hermes.

name: Sundering of Tremere
description: An event that reduced House Tremere's power, after which Blackthorn's influence in the tribunal was diminished.

name: Superb Scrinium
description: An enchanted walnut writing desk that copies and binds an entire book in hours.

name: Superior Armaments
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Suppressing the Wizard's Handiwork
description: A Rego Vim spell that cancels one of the caster's own active spells for as long as concentration is maintained, with effects returning when concentration breaks.

name: Sure Traveler
description: Minor Heroic Virtue: never lost on known routes and unhindered by travel conditions.

name: Sursum
description: Covenant founded in 875 on the north coast of Cornwall, destroyed during Athelstan's campaigns in 931 amid evidence of Tytalus diabolism.

name: Sutherland
description: Remote region where isolated clans speak Gaelic with Pictish elements.

name: Swabia
description: The duchy surrounding the Black Forest, extending to Bavaria and the Alps, whose recent history is dominated by the rival Zähringen and Hohenstaufen families.

name: Symbolic Magic
description: A Major Folk Mystery (Virtue) encompassing laboratory activities with charms and symbols, allowing charms in invested devices and talismans and new Symbol Range, Duration, and Target for ritual spells.

name: Sympathy
description: A combined natural principle of affinity and similarity through which objects resonate, e.g. a bloodstone resonating with wounds; basis of many Shape and Material bonuses.

name: Synthemata Magia
description: Major Supernatural Mystery Ability, the non-Hermetic predecessor of Hermetic Synthemata, letting a magus intuit a being's synthemata using (Realm) Lore.

name: Syria
description: Where Francis met crusaders and Elias led the Friars Minor in 1219.

name: Tabanus
description: A Quaesitor of House Guernicus, trained at Magvillus, sent to police the Rhine; a strict, meddlesome peregrinator who recently occupied a sanctum at Triamore.

name: Taboo
description: Rules within a faerie's glamour forbidding or requiring actions; humans breaking them owe redress. Detailed as Flaws.

name: Tagelyn
description: A covenant that, with Blackthorn, excavated caves in the Black Mountains over two centuries; its magi were driven out by Blackthorn and founded Ashenrise in Hibernia.

name: Tainted Characters
description: People whose conception or upbringing demons meddled with, making them tools for Infernal schemes.

name: Tainted Offspring
