description: A Major Story Tainted Flaw in which the character has a child marked for great but unpleasant things by a powerful demon, requiring struggle against the demon's servants.

name: Tainted Virtues and Flaws
description: A category of Virtues and Flaws associated with the Infernal realm, gained through demonic corruption; Supernatural abilities they grant are always Infernal powers.

name: Take
description: Gruagach Technique for removing things from a target, covering nearly every Hermetic Technique.

name: Talhaearn Tad Awen
description: One of the five great Welsh poets believed by the Order to have left Daimons behind after death.

name: Taliesin
description: One of the five great Welsh poets believed by the Order to have left Daimons behind after death.

name: Tallage
description: A lord's levy on his peasants, described in Chapter Six: Manorial Fiefs; lords demanded heavy tallage to fund crusades.

name: Talons of the Wind
description: MuAu 20 Potent spell, Potency 8, fan made from ship's sail.

name: Talons of the Winds
description: A Muto Auram spell (Level 20) that transforms a wind into an abrasive medium that tears at everything in its path, inflicting +4 damage from cuts; requires an existing breeze.

name: Tamed Magic
description: Major Hermetic Virtue granting Harnessed and Tethered Magic without drawbacks, usable with spontaneous spells; requires Mutantum Magic.

name: Tamgor of Quaesitor
description: Quaesitor who journeyed through the Roman Tribunal's covenants to gather information ahead of Jarane's triad, recording his findings in a journal.

name: Tanaiste
description: Heir-designate of a Highland clan chief, held by Raibert Mac Donncadh.

name: Tanakh
description: The Hebrew Bible, comprising Torah, Nevi'im and Ketuvim.

name: Tangential Magi
description: Criamon magi who have faded peacefully into Final Twilight and dwell in the Hypostasis outside time, sending visions through the Axis to their mortal successors.

name: Tangle of Wood and Thorns
description: A Rego Herbam (ReHe 15) indirect spell that immobilizes a magus with wood without touching him, completely effective in bypassing Magic Resistance.

name: Tartessos
description: An ancient rich port at the edge of the world whose faerie gods may rouse when a new rich port is built.

name: Tatzelwurmli
description: Monstrous limbless land dragon in the Aare Gorge whose lair no covenant can harvest.

name: Teaching Source Quality
description: Communication + Teaching + 3 + bonuses; compared to a Target Level when teaching a Hermetic Virtue.

name: Teeth of the Earth Mother
description: A Muto Terram spell that springs twenty sharp white marble pillars from the ground in a circle, able to cage, wall, or skewer enemies for +25 damage.

name: Temenos of Dindyméné
description: A sacred grove atop Mount Dindymon ringed by oaks and chestnuts, with a Magic aura of 3, leading to both a Faerie and a Magic regio.

name: Templar Administrator
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a brother of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon who administers the order's holdings rather than fighting; available only to male characters.

name: Templar Commander
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for a commander of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon with authority over a province or preceptory, also granting Temporal Influence.

name: Templar Confrere or Consoeur
description: A Free Social Status Virtue for an associate member of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon who has taken one or two Templar vows.

name: Templar Servant
description: A Free Social Status Virtue for a servant working at a Templar commandery, supported and protected by the order's papal bull.

name: Templar Specialist
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a skilled employee of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon filling a crucial role such as craftsman or translator.

name: Temple of Jupiter
description: Ruined temple at Montjoux, repeatedly ransacked during the barbarian invasions, which the maga Lucia sought.

name: Tenens Occultorum
description: A House Bonisagus office held by Tandaline, appointed by Murion, involving keeping written contact across the House.

name: Terentia
description: A powerful demon of rage and war whose diabolist followers slew Regulus with an infernal artifact.

name: Terrae-magi
description: A small earth-wizard lineage descended from a Mercurian priest, knowing spells of earth and metal conjuring; Guernicus was its last member.

name: Terrify the Unbeliever
description: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

name: Territorial Advantage
description: Difference between the two sides' Deployment Totals, added to Event Totals; magic affecting terrain adds its magnitude.

name: Terror of the Charging Boar
description: Power of the Wild Boar of the Woods that overwhelms anything he charges with mortal fear.

name: Test of the Cold Water
description: Most common ordeal: the accused is thrown into water and floats if innocent.

name: Thanatoi
description: Leti of peaceful death, led by Thanatos.

name: Thaphaboath
description: A mazzik (Tempter) with the head and hindquarters of a bear, typically drafted as 'muscle' for more powerful demons.

name: Thaumaturgical Transformation of Plants to Iron
description: A Muto Herbam spell (Level 20) with a Terram requisite that makes any plant as hard as iron, up to the size of a small tree.

name: The Abandoned Shrine
description: Scenery story element: a standing stone carved with glyphs where a slumbering god can be woken by innocent blood.

name: The Antigones
description: A new generation of interventionist Jerbiton magi ('those like their ancestors'), trained after the fall of Constantinople, who favor political engagement, aggression, and large House covenants.

name: The Apprentice's Delight
description: CrHe 3 cantation that creates a ripe apple lasting two minutes, sweet but not nourishing.

name: The Appropriate Attire
description: MuAn 4 cantation that changes the color and cut of leather, wool or fur clothing, giving +1 to Etiquette or Charm.

name: The Ash of Nortorf
description: An infernal entity (Infernal Might 15, potential 60) manifesting as an ash seedling in the churchyard of Nortorf; prophesied to grow into a tree that will bring a king with fell powers if a black horseman defeats the white horseman.

name: The Beast
description: The Beast from Beauty and the Beast, initially a threat, then needing help, then giving rewards.

name: The Beast Remade
description: A Muto Animal spell (Level 25) with a Corpus requisite that gives a land beast a human form while retaining its intellect and some animal feature.

name: The Bloodcaps
description: Societas Merceris lineage descended from a Mercere adoptee's daughter and a violent border faerie; they dye their caps in blood.

name: The Bohemian Forest
description: A massive forest, safe from man due to harsh climate and peat bogs, haunt of lynx, wolves, deer, and giants; home to Irencillia and (in its south) Fenistal.

name: The Book of Beasts
description: InAn 10 book whose pages are Arcane Connections to beasts.

name: The Buran of Yenghissar
description: An Infernal desert storm spirit and corrupt jinni (Might 25, Auram) that manifests as a vortex of black sand, plaguing the village of Yenghissar and now bound within a sahir's ancestral sword.

name: The Celestial Hierarchy
description: Summa on Dominion Lore describing the nine angelic choirs, attributed to Dionysius the Areopagite.

name: The Chameleon Cat
description: MuAn 5 cantation that changes a beast's color, even to unnatural colors; green cats are a favorite at Durenmar.

name: The Chariot of Zeus
description: MuCo(Au) 30 spell transforming the caster into a thunderbolt to travel instantly to any visible location.

name: The Cleric's Pate
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: The Collegium
description: A Hermetic societas of about a dozen Platonist magi from different Houses, founded by Xenophon of Bonisagus, dedicated to investigating the nature of magic through experimentation and Philosophiae.

name: The Cook's Revenge
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: The Copyist's Puissant Quill
description: ReAq 5 craft magic spell making ink form words and images on a page along guidelines.

name: The Couturier's Art
description: Miklos's spell creating a complete set of clothes with accessories.

name: The Crystal of a Hundred Candles
description: An enchanted crystal embedded in the ceiling of Arliandus's sanctum that blooms into light to illuminate the whole chamber when the door opens.

name: The Curse of Diana
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: The Dancer's Dame
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: The Donar Oak
description: A divine spirit (Divine Might 40) at Geismar, formerly the focal point of the pagan power of the Hercynian Forest; its acorns are worth Creo vis and can tame animals and forests.

name: The Door of Deimos
description: An enchanted iron door created by Arliandus and named after the son of Ares, embossed with faces and skulls and invested with effects that recognize and repel intruders.

name: The Dove Hat
description: Magical toy sold at the faerie toy market.

name: The Drudenbaum of Harberg
description: A mythical tree spirit (Magic Might 30) atop the Harberg near Nuremberg where wizards meet; its golden drops are Creo vis and its milk is Vim vis, and it possesses trees to assume its form.

name: The Dutiful Shepherd
description: Saint power sending an image of the saint to lead a lost petitioner to safety.

name: The Ear for Distant Voices
description: An Intellego Imaginem spell (Level 20) that lets the caster hear what is happening in a designated place to which they have an Arcane Connection.

name: The Ear for the Distant Voice
description: Spell (InIm 20) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: The Earth's Riches
description: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

name: The Elfin Baker
description: Spell or effect listed in the contents of Transforming Mythic Europe.

name: The Exsules
description: A small band of fewer than a dozen renegade House Merinita wizards based at Fenistal who rejected the Order; they know imperfect Hermetic magic and Parma Magica and prefer to turn nature against their enemies.

name: The Faerie Shade
description: Enchantment/Weal 50 ritual restoring a corpse to life, perhaps animated by a faerie spirit.

name: The Falling Evil
description: A Major General Flaw in which the character suffers random convulsions and blackouts, leaving him temporarily Incapacitated, often caused by demonic possession.

name: The Fane of the Founders
description: A powerful artifact in a hidden Black Forest glade, a twelve-sided stone slab into which the Cult of Mercury bound much of the forest's magical essence; site of the secret seven-yearly rite renewing the Founders' vows.

name: The Fanes
description: Enemies of Valnastium, fought in a battle where the Standard of the Shadowy Men was used.

name: The Foes of the Ibis
description: Kentigern's CrAn(Re) 40 spell creating a small flock of iaculii, winged snakes.

name: The Forest Brothers
description: Three pagan gods of Rugen, Rugevit, Porevit, and Porenitz, representing the Rowan, the Beech, and the Larch, still worshipped by male priests called volkhvy.

name: The Forest Giant
description: CrHe 40 acorn growing into an oak overnight.

name: The Furnace
description: Furnace beneath the House of Flames and Smoke, source of Purgatory's flames, which transmogrifies things burnt in it and grants insight into the Limits of Essential Nature and Vis.

name: The Gastronomers
description: A large Jerbiton league whose members take turns hosting annual lavish feasts and who organize the great feasts including the Tribunicals and Seculars.

name: The Gift (Virtue)
description: Referenced as a Virtue covered later in the rules that allows characters to learn Supernatural Abilities and is the most important exception to Ability-use restrictions.

name: The Gift of Vigor
description: A spell whose variants a magus attempts to use to transfer vital faculty (bodily energy such as fatigue) from a living being into a dead one.

name: The Glade of the Seven Waterfalls
description: A magical glade deep in the Black Forest with Magic Might 80, the remnant of the forest's original genius locus, whose peaceful spirit allows only those who complete Quests to ascend each of its seven waterfalls (regio levels).

name: The Golden Legend
description: Jacobus de Voragine's authoritative saints' lives, written around 1260.

name: The Guide for the Perplexed
description: A great summa on Jewish philosophy and theology written by Maimonides in 1190, infused with Aristotelian ideas, that sparked controversy among Jewish scholars.

name: The Heathen Witch Reborn
description: A general Perdo Vim spell invented by Philippus Niger that reverses any shapechanging spell or supernatural Ability if the spell level +10 beats the shapechange.

name: The Hidden Skin of the Serpent
description: MuCo 30 spell turning lower skin into osteoderm plates for +10 Soak.

name: The Holm Oak of Romowe
description: A malevolent magic spirit (Magic Might 45, currently 30 due to entrapment) bound within a massive evergreen oak in the sacred grove of Romowe; it can grant the Depression Flaw and possess those who take its branches.

name: The Humble Brethren
description: A Jerbiton league based in Rome that tries to influence the College of Cardinals to prevent an anti-magical Pope; includes mistresses of four Cardinals.

name: The Incombustible Shroud
description: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

name: The Inexorable Hunter
description: A magical power of the Virtuous Hound (Animal, 2 points) allowing it to flawlessly follow a creature's scent until it is located, despite the prey's ruses.

name: The Jongleur's Steps
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: The Laborer's Boon
description: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

name: The Laundress' Clothesline
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: The Leap of the Faithful
description: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

name: The Lector's Deft Hand
description: ReHe(An) 15 effect of the Superb Scrinium turning pages of the book being copied.

name: The Lightning Tree
description: Vis site: lightning-struck trees on a hilltop with glowing branches holding up to 4 pawns of Auram vis sordida yearly.

name: The Limit of Creation
description: A lesser limit of Hermetic magic: it cannot create anything permanently without raw vis.

name: The Limit of Magic Resistance
description: Apparent limit that no hedge tradition has general magic resistance; traditions breaking it would be eliminated by the Order.

name: The Limit of Warping
description: A lesser limit of Hermetic magic: it cannot affect warping changes once they have happened; Wizard's Twilight is one manifestation.

name: The Limit of the Infernal
description: A lesser limit of Hermetic magic: Intellego magic is almost useless against the Infernal, revealing only what demons want believed.

name: The Longest Step Made Short
description: Basic instant transportation effect of eighth magnitude, usable once per day.

name: The Lucid Dreamer
description: Dream magic spell referenced as allowing the magus himself to be the dreamer targeted by dream-entry spells.

name: The Magic Money Box
description: MuTe 45 box turning stones into gold coins.

name: The Margravate of Brandenburg
description: The only notable city of the Margravate east of the Elbe, occupying an old Wendish settlement across three islands in the River Havel, with a cathedral and the first bishopric east of the Elbe.

name: The Margravate of Meissen
description: The most civilized of the Eastern Marches, a rolling land ruled by the Wettin dynasty since 1089; the last Hermetic covenant here, Sirmium, was destroyed in the 10th century.

name: The Messenger's Shortcut
description: Spell or effect listed in the contents of Transforming Mythic Europe.

name: The Mice of the Mauseturm
description: Demonic mouse swarms (Infernal Might 10) with fiery teeth, immune to fire, that infest the Mouse Tower island and are spontaneously generated by its Infernal aura.

name: The Mirror of Dreams
description: An ornate gold-framed enchanted mirror in Arliandus's sanctum that visualizes a subject's thoughts to aid Mentem lab work, but causes Warping Points and disturbing dreams.

name: The Morvan
description: Burgundian wilderness with contested vis sources and dark faeries.

name: The Mouse Tower
description: The Mauseturm, a half-ruined slender tower on a small island at the mouth of the Bingen Hole built by Hatto II, now haunted by his demonic shade and infested with demonic mice (Infernal aura 3).

name: The Mundane
description: That which is not supernatural; areas not occupied by another realm, having no aura rating, consisting of ordinary people and places.

name: The Ninth Stitch
description: New spell (CrAn(He, Im) 10) listed in the Index of New Spells.

name: The Numbness of the Gift
description: InVi 20 spell making the caster's hand numb when touching a Gifted character; invented to detect Gifted hedge wizards.

name: The Path of Walking Backwards
description: A newer Criamon path brought by Abdkypris from the Sufi, involving complete surrender to the harmonic force to flee back to the Spharios; uses dancing/spinning meditation.

name: The Phantom Gift
description: A Creo Vim spell that makes the target appear tainted with magic as most magi are, causing beasts and people to react to him as a magus.

name: The Poor Performer's Reward
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: The Racing Rot
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: The Rat Pack
description: Vicious faerie-blooded rats forming the Devil's Lane rat pack.

name: The Rat Pipe
description: ReAn 55 pipe attracting all vermin in a building.

name: The Red Touch
description: Earth Elemental power that rusts metal it touches or is struck by into dust.

name: The Reward Delivered
description: ReTe 4 counterpart to The Poor Performer's Reward that hurls the ball of mud at a target.

name: The Scold's Bridle
description: Miklos's CrAn 20 spell creating a gag that forces magi to cast silently.

name: The Scrying Bowls
description: Magical toy sold at the faerie toy market.

name: The Severed Limb Made Whole
description: A Creo Corpus ritual (Level 25) that reattaches a detached limb, though decay on the severed limb persists after reattachment.

name: The Shadow of Human Life
description: A Creo Imaginem spell (Level 40) with a Mentem requisite that gives a human image (as in Phantasm of the Human Form) limited freedom and simulated intellect, functioning as a stupid independent human.

name: The Shadow of Life Renewed
description: A Creo Corpus ritual (Level 75) with a Mentem requisite that brings the semblance of life to a corpse; the closest the Order of Hermes has come to raising the dead.

name: The Siege of Constantinople
description: CrIm 15 animated tapestry of the 1204 siege.

name: The Silent Ones
description: A Jerbiton league dedicated to integrating the Silent Magic and Subtle Magic Virtues into standard Hermetic practice, led by a Bonisagus magus.

name: The Silent Vigil
description: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 45) with a Terram requisite that lets the caster move into and become part of a rock formation at least twice their size.

name: The Silver Fish
description: Vis site: a pool at the lake's edge whose fish yield up to 4 pawns of Aquam vis sordida yearly.

name: The Silvery Miraculous Daffodil Wand
description: Magical toy sold at the faerie toy market.

name: The Smokeless Campfire
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: The Studious Doppleganger
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: The Suffering of the Seer
description: MuCo 35 spell sliding bone plates over the victim's eyes, blinding them.

name: The Teufelsloch
description: A giant eroded hole in the hills west of Laach Lake with steep treacherous edges and an Infernal aura of 1, named the Devil's Hole by locals.

name: The Teufelsmoor
description: An extensive swampy peat wasteland northeast of Bremen with an ill reputation, almost always mist-covered and shunned by locals; a possible covenant location.

name: The Teutoburger Forest
description: A forested hill region in Saxony with powerful tree guardians (Magic Might 50), site of a famous victory over Roman legions, who remain trapped in a regio at its heart.

name: The Thief of Memory
description: PeMe 25 spell removing all memory of an individual, place or event; Quaesitores use it to tidy up after Hermetic criminals.

name: The Travels of Fedoso
description: An epic poem written by the Primus Verderis used by apprentices to learn Latin, claimed by many Criamon to be a prophetic map of the House's future.

name: The Trier Amphitheater
description: A large oval Roman amphitheater outside Trier's walls (Magic aura 1-2) on the Hermesstrasse, haunted by three ghostly gladiators who challenge visitors to duels and where Mentem vis can be harvested.

name: The Trumpet of Ghostly Summoning
description: A small enchanted silver trumpet from Arliandus's sanctum that, when blown, summons forth and reveals ghosts or spirits in the area.

name: The Unruffled Traveler
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: The Unsubtle Knife
description: A silver knife invented by Atrox of Tytalus to send orders to his agents via Arcane Connections.

name: The Wayfarers
description: A group of Merinitae who style themselves Arcadian experts, recording earthly gateway locations and guiding travelers into Faerie; they typically Initiate Arcadian Travel and rival House Mercere's Redcaps.

name: The Wedding Ring of Gaea
description: CrTe 35 ritual creating ten million cubic paces of stone as a circular wall about 94.5 miles long.

name: The Wooden Knights
description: Invested puppet knights with Read the Master's Thoughts and Move the Limbs.

name: The Wordless Conversation
description: Watchers Power to speak directly into a creature's mind.

name: Theban League
description: A military alliance formed by magi in the north of the Empire to resist the emperor, the Infernal, and House Tremere; they joined the Order under Jerbiton's nominal leadership and later founded the Tribunal of Thebes.

name: Theobald
description: A bishop of Gubbio in Umbria whose episcopal ring and thumb, carried by his loyal servant, miraculously rooted a staff into the ground in the Vosges, leading to the founding of Thann Chapel.

name: Theoderich of Augsburg
aliases: Theoderich of Augsburg, Follower of Jerbiton
description: A journeyman of House Jerbiton at Heorot, formerly of Oculus Septentrionalis, a necromancer and historian who raises ghosts to interrogate them about the past.

name: Theoi
description: Informal title for the most powerful Daimons, e.g. Helios, Prometheus, Pallas.

name: Thessalonica
description: Site of a great fair (the Demetria) rivaling Champagne in size and goods; its proximity to Constantinople makes eastern luxuries readily available.

name: Thieves of Venice
description: Network of Venetian thieves united by Renser of Tremere and controlled by Rellantali, some of whom are secretly Infernal agents.

name: Things of Virtue
description: Natural items with magical properties which folk witches may enrich using Realms of Power: Magic rules.

name: Thomas Aquinas
description: Pupil of Albertus Magnus rumored to have smashed the Brass Head; became the greatest theologian of the medieval Church.

name: Threshold
description: The simultaneous attraction and repulsion between Faerie and the mundane world; entering Faerie requires Threshold points equal to Threshold strength.

name: Threshold faerie
description: A faerie that mediates Eudokian stories governing a life transition and sends characters home with Spirit Away.

name: Thrones
description: Angelic Choir of Camuel, Munkar and Nakir; pious kings are placed among them.

name: Thrym
description: Villain of the Theft of Thor's Hammer, cited as an example of the villain role.

name: Tiber
description: River near which Vardian's Tomb lies.

name: Tiberius
description: Younger noble son guided by a demon posing as his grandfather's ghost, designed by Valefar as a snare for magi.

name: Tickling the Humors
description: Andru's cluster of CrMe variants of Rising Ire instilling other emotions.

name: Tierent
description: A 12th-century Verditius magus who adapted the Bind Magical Creatures Mystery to affect creatures with Faerie Might.

name: Tireless
description: Virtue or creature Quality listed for a being (Anne, Minerva Sulis, Balneator) or setting feature described here.

name: Tithe
description: One tenth of everything a person gets, owed to the Church; divided traditionally into quarters for rector, curate, church fabric and the poor, effectively taking twenty percent of peasant income.

name: To Know the Owner as Might His Hound
description: InAn 25 spell letting Kentigern sense what an animal senses.

name: Toga Praetexta
description: Seamless toga with a purple stripe worn by apprentices and Quaesitores on formal occasions.

name: Toga Virilis
description: Roman garment listed in the index alongside praetexta, stola, and trabea.

name: Tolosa Paratge
description: An ancient covenant in Toulouse in the Provencal Tribunal, completely split between two factions, the White and the Black, a rivalry that may bring it down.

name: Tomorrow's Bounty
description: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

name: Tonsure
description: The ring of hair left when a monk's head is shaved on taking vows.

name: Topaz of Virtue
description: Gem containing 1 pawn of Mentem vis that when Enriched grants Puissant Leadership.

name: Torrent from the Lungs
description: Faerie power, as Curse of the Desert, drawing water forth from the body for +15 damage.

name: Torven
description: A reclusive young hedge wizard of Waldheim with Latent Magical Ability who befriends forest creatures and is accompanied by the faerie wolf Red-Hame.

name: Touch of the Goose Feather
description: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 5) that causes the target to let out a loud sneeze, disrupting concentration and activities.

name: Touch of the Pearls
description: An Intellego Aquam spell (Level 5) that tells the caster whether a touched liquid is poisonous, like a pearl, without tasting it.

name: Toulouse
description: A location in the Provencal Tribunal where the covenant of Tolosa Paratge resides.

name: Tournament
description: Mock-war event of the 13th century offering experience, reputation, and ransom wealth.

name: Tower of Notatus
description: A tower at Durenmar conjured by and named after the first Primus of House Bonisagus; it houses most Bonisagus magi and Murion's sanctum.

name: Tower of Trianoma
description: The youngest of Durenmar's three towers, named in honor of Trianoma; its basement houses one of the Rhine's official Mercer Houses.

name: Tower of Whirling Water
description: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 35) that forms a waterspout under the caster's mental direction, damaging and potentially drowning those it hits.

name: Town Magistrate
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue granting a position of judicial responsibility in a town with a small staff of officials, requiring citizenship and a score of 3 in Civil and Canon Law (or Common Law).

name: Town Senex
description: Covenant closest to a town (by loudest church bells) with superior rights there.

name: Trabea
description: Purple imperial toga no Alpine magus will wear.

name: Tracing the Trail of Death's Stench
description: A spell used by Donatores to locate the corporeal remains of a spirit from the location of its death or gravesite.

name: Track
description: Ability appearing in character or creature statistics in this text.

name: Tragedy of Hubris
description: Consequence suffered by kabbalists who overreach, e.g. attempting to create a second golem for a community already protected; also triggers golem madness rolls.

name: Trained Assassin
description: A Minor General Virtue available only to characters with a Nizari Social Status Virtue, granting 50 experience points in Martial Abilities, Athletics, Guile, or Stealth.

name: Training
description: A method of instruction for Abilities only, not needing the Teaching Ability; counts as a season of one-on-one instruction.

name: Transference
description: Act in which the hero is transported, delivered, or led to the object of his quest, often by magical means.

name: Transform to Water
description: A spell whose constant effect is mimicked by the Water sample elemental form of a Bjornaer chimera or anima heartbeast.

name: Transformation of Flesh to Spirit
description: CrVi(Co) 60 ritual in which the caster kills herself to increase the aura.

name: Transformation of the Living Ghost
description: General Mystery Ritual defining a Living Ghost's Might Score, limited by the magus's best Arts.

name: Transformation of the Thorny Staff
description: A Muto Herbam spell (Level 10) that causes a length of wood to grow thick sharp thorns; adds +4 damage if cast on a staff.

name: Transformed Animal
description: An animal Warped by magic whose magical qualities relate to the transforming event; it gains no Magic Might.

name: Transylvanian Alps
description: Holdings granted to the Teutons in 1211.

name: Trapping the Fire
description: A Muto Ignem spell (Level 25) with a Terram requisite that turns the heat and flames of a large campfire into a small hard object such as a gem; breaking the object releases the flame.

name: Treading the Ashen Path
description: A Perdo Herbam spell (Level 30) that withers and destroys plant material in front of the caster as they walk up to 7 miles; invented by a magus of House Flambeau.

name: Treaty of Verdun
description: 843 treaty dividing Charlemagne's empire.

name: Trebizond
description: Tiny kingdom at the edge of the Hermetic world through which ivory enters Europe.

name: Tree of Virtue
description: Vis-bearing trees (beech, hazel, oak, poplar) in the truffle regio; each contains two pawns of vis whose Art depends on the tree type.

name: Tribunal Summons
description: A formal summons to a Hermetic tribunal that Redcaps must deliver at least six months before the tribunal takes place; rigorously enforced.

name: Trickery
description: Act in which the villain deceives his intended victim to take possession of him or his belongings.

name: Trinitarians
description: Order known as Red Friars, founded in 1198 in France to ransom Christian captives.

name: Trip
description: A Brawl maneuver wolves use to knock prey down during the kill.

name: Tristan
description: Lover in the romance of Tristan and Iseult, whose adultery brings disaster.

name: Trondheim
description: Norwegian archiepiscopal see, now Trondheim, claiming authority over Scottish bishops.

name: Troy
description: City destroyed by the Greeks in the war before Ulysses' voyage.

name: Troyes
description: Champagne fair city with Jewish community, home of Chrétien de Troyes and Rashi.

name: True Rest of the Injured Brute
description: A Creo Animal spell (Level 20) granting an injured animal target a +9 bonus to all Recovery rolls while the spell is in effect.

name: True form
description: A magic character's essential qualities and shape: animal, human, spirit or thing.

name: Truffle Matron
description: Awakened truffle of Magic Might 30 who rules the Magic creatures that cultivate truffles throughout Mythic Europe, holding council in her regio and rewarding helpers with vis.

name: Tuatha Dé Danann
description: Powerful faeries replacing the Idaian Daktyls in the Hibernian variant, enslaved by Conaing.

name: Tulab Ibn Sina
description: Students of Avicenna: elementalist tradition of accomplished Islamic physicians teaching Medicinal Summoning and Divining.

name: Turbulence
description: An uncontrolled magical outburst of a Gifted child's Gift caused by strong emotion or a botched magical activity.

name: Twilight Prone
description: Hermetic Flaw compared to the monistic mystic's susceptibility to Divine Ascent.

name: Twist of the Tongue
description: A Perdo Corpus spell that twists the target's tongue into a spiral, destroying the ability to speak; a grave offense to a magus.

name: Twisted Spine
description: A Minor Curse (Rego Corpus effect) that twists the victim's spine grotesquely, imposing -3 to social rolls.

name: Tyre
description: City where Origen's tomb is honored, a site of importance to the Magoi of the Star.

name: Tyrrhenian Sea
description: Sea into which Verdi's stream eventually flows.

name: Umno
description: Previous Primus of House Tremere, now governing the Burning Acorn Vexillation.

name: Unbaptized
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character is a Christian who has never been baptized, often due to a supernatural background, and does not benefit from the sacraments.

name: Unbearable to (Beings)
description: A Minor Hermetic or General Flaw in which one of three classes of beings is extremely disturbed by the character, adding -3 to social interactions; only for characters with The Gift or Magical Air.

name: Unbound Tongue
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue: when transformed into a non-human form, the character may speak any human languages he knows without impediment, and a magus may still cast spells with his voice.

name: Undine Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety from river courtly faeries granting underwater bonuses.

name: Unhappily Married
description: A major Story Flaw where a merchant has married for money rather than love and seeks solace outside the marital bed, hiding affairs from spouse and family.

name: Unholy Methods
description: The Infernal 'Techniques' of maleficia, Debauchery and Incantation, describing what the infernalist must do.

name: Unholy Powers
description: Category of Infernal Abilities (Consumption, Diablerie, Effusion, Malediction, Phantasm, Psychomachia).

name: University Dean
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character is the head of a university overseeing internal and external affairs; requires the Doctor in (Faculty) Virtue and age 40+.

name: University Grammar Teacher
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character employed by a university to teach grammar to younger members, able to purchase Latin and Artes Liberales.

name: University of Arezzo
description: A small student-run Italian university south of Florence, founded in 1215, offering faculties of law, medicine, and the arts.

name: University of Palencia
description: A royal Spanish university founded by King Alfonso VIII of Castile in 1208, with faculties of arts, canon law, and theology, overseen by the Bishop of Palencia.

name: University of Vicenza
description: A short-lived Italian university swarmed from Bologna, lasting from 1204 until scholars returned to Bologna in 1210.

name: Unruly Air
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character's presence subtly pushes others to extreme behavior in social situations; those with Magic Resistance are unaffected.

name: Unstable Magic
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: folk witch lab creations decay after a year and a day.

name: Upper Lorraine
description: A duchy that came into existence on the division of the Carolingian empire, a moderately populated rolling plain bounded by the Vosges, Rhine, Ardennes, and Argonne; its seat is Nancy.

name: Urban (Church Hook)
description: Covenant Hook: covenant based in a town, whose protections extend to mundane neighbors.

name: Urbastis cult
description: Cult known through Legend Lore to the familiar Crucifixio.

name: Usury
description: The Church's moral crime of charging interest on loans, which Redcaps avoid the appearance of when lending vis.

name: Vagrancy
description: The low crime of lacking a House or residential Tribunal, which can lead to a March if uncorrected.

name: Val Fanes
description: Faerie valley in Ticino where Andru fought a faerie king.

name: Valoran
description: Student/filius of St. Nerius, rumored founder of Cunfin's monastery and believed parens of Angelus.

name: Vanishing Away
description: The unexplained disappearance of Tarragon Vale's magi and covenfolk twenty-two years ago.

name: Vannes
description: Town used as a reference point for placing the Cursewood in the Normandy Tribunal.

name: Varriar
description: Demon Lord of the Avengers of Evil and Lord of Discipline behind the corrupt Vallumbrosans, posing as Abbot Curtaigne; true form a huge angel of blue flame with a whip.

name: Vassalage
description: Feudal bond between lord and vassal providing resources, advice, and warriors.

name: Vederis
description: A famous magus of House Criamon who wrote The Travels of Fedoso, a classic work of esoteric lore.

name: Veil of Fire
description: Carmine's sigil, an orange-red bridal veil embroidered with the hourglass of Flambeau, kept by Andru.

name: Venatores
description: A loose group of demon-hunting magi from any House who pass their knowledge through an advanced apprenticeship; poorly regarded in the Order.

name: Venice Lore
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Verditius Magic (Flaw)
description: Flaw appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Vernus
description: A weak, Struggling Spring covenant of six magi consisting of tents around a standing stone in a clearing within a faerie-forest magical regio, contesting its sole vis source with faeries.

name: Versatile Phantasticum
description: Virtue letting a nightwalker use an animal phantasticum outside fertility battles and spend experience on animal-form Abilities.

name: Versatile Sleeper
description: Virtue appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Vervay
description: Center of the Abbaye des Vignerons.

name: Vessel of the Clouds
description: ReHe 30 spell giving a small boat such as a coracle the power of flight with a Load of 50.

name: Villainy
description: Act in which the villain causes direct harm, or a lack becomes apparent, starting the action of the story.

name: Vindonossa
description: Ruined Roman fortress containing the castle of Hapsburg.

name: Vis Mastery
description: Major Quality letting the character expend its magic as vis.

name: Vis Sensitivity
description: Major Heroic Virtue allowing a character to sense raw vis by touch, gauge its pawns and identify its Art.

name: Viscus filius Circum Perfico
description: Criamon who seeks the Enigma through haruspicy on the entrails of magical animals; least popular magus among the redcaps.

name: Vision
description: A gruagach Form controlling perception of sight and sound, creating illusions, invisibility, sending the fetch to scout and granting glimpses of the future.

name: Visions Beatific
description: Andru's MuIm(Me) 30 spell making everything appear sublimely beautiful, incapacitating the target.

name: Vita Sancti Cuthberti
description: Hagiography of Saint Cuthbert, tractatus on Organization Lore: The Church; two versions by Bede.

name: Vulcan
description: The Roman god of fire and the forge after whom the Cult of Vulcan was renamed; Balento claimed descent from him and his Mysteries emphasized destructive fire.

name: Vulnerable to (Form)
description: Elementalist Flaw, e.g. Vulnerable to Elementalist Earth, possibly received from a flawed Opening of society Arts.

name: Waldensians
description: Heretics persecuted for teaching that sacraments from wicked priests were void, a belief encouraged by demons.

name: Waldheim
description: A tiny reclusive hamlet in a glade (Magic aura 2) deep in the Westerwald near the former covenant of Oakdell, inhabited by hedge wizards loyal to the Court of Bright Winter.

name: Wall of Thorns
description: A Creo Herbam spell (Level 15) that creates a straight wall of resilient thorny bushes up to 20 paces long and 4 paces high.

name: Walpurga
description: A powerful beneficent faerie lady (Faerie Might 50) of the Seelie Court representing summer and growth, who appears at the Witches' Altar on Walpurgis Night to summon summer.

name: Walter the Book Merchant
description: A faerie merchant-scribe on Devil's Lane selling glamour books and exercise slates.

name: Wand of Bestial Agony
description: A lesser enchanted wand belonging to Mari Amwithig that Hephaestion reforges in an example, with a Rego Vim power of effect level 20.

name: Wand of Dancing Flowers
description: Magical toy sold at the faerie toy market.

name: Wand of Horses
description: Magical toy sold at the faerie toy market.

name: Ward Against Demons
description: Arcane circle spell in which a summoned demon can be forced to appear.

name: Ward Against Faeries
description: Family of elemental wards against faeries, suggested as useful during island stories.

name: Ward against Faeries of the Mountain
description: A Rego Terram spell warding against faeries of earth and stone, working like Ward Against Faeries of the Waters.

name: Warders of Mystery
description: A society of Auditores who believe magic diminishes as knowledge of it spreads and work to keep magic secret.

name: Warding
description: An Accelerated Supernatural Ability of the Columbae for warding away natural things and supernatural beings with Might by inscribing arcane symbols into a circle; predates and was integrated into Hermetic magic.

name: Wards
description: Effects preventing a specified thing from touching or acting against the target; faerie wards via Ware.

name: Ware
description: Faerie Power of protection and warding, suppressing supernatural effects and warding against things tied to Sympathy Traits.

name: Watcher
description: Insubstantial warriors in full chain with great swords who attack anyone who takes a weapon from the Resting Place of Mars at the next new moon, until defeated or the weapon is returned.

name: Water sprites
description: Water spirits encountered by Hagen at the River Danube who foretell that all the Burgundians but one priest are doomed to die.

name: Water-way
description: Special Atlantean Range targeting anything on the same water-way as the caster; equal to Sight.

name: Waxing Tide of Humors
description: Furies Power causing passion to overcome sense.

name: Ways of the (Local Environment)
description: A supernatural Virtue possessed by the angel Nasir, tied to a local environment.

name: Weak Tattoo Magic
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw halving Lab Total for tattoos; gained via Shape initiation.

name: Weak Writer
description: Flaw appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Weal
description: Faerie Power affecting healing and aging, temporarily healing wounds and reducing apparent age.

name: Weight of Numbers
description: Bonus or penalty based on the ratio of army sizes, which also adjusts the size of combat groups in battlefield events.

name: Well without Light
description: A Perdo Ignem spell (Level 25) that removes light from a target structure so that only spells above level 25 can create light there; the light flows into the caster's clenched fist.

name: Well-known
description: Virtue appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Werfen
description: Place listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Western Roman Empire
description: Empire whose collapse around 480 AD marks the end of the ancient period for equipment availability.

name: Western Wall
description: Remnant of the Jewish Temple, with a Dominion aura of 10.

name: Whispering Fingers
description: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

name: White Stag of the Wood
description: A magical white stag who guards a forest and its deer, attacking grogs who poach there.

name: Whitlam
description: Magus two generations descended from Mercere who first enunciated the doctrine that magic items should be inheritable; Whitlam items are named after him.

name: Whitlams
description: Inheritable magic items held by redcaps on behalf of House Mercere; also a free virtue for mythic redcaps.

name: Wild Magic
description: Flaw appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Wilhelm Weiss
description: A Gentle-Gifted Jerbiton magus and master of Fengheld at the Rheingasse chapter in Cologne who poses as a wealthy merchant and co-leads the Apple Gild.

name: Wili
description: Dark faerie ghosts of maidens dead on their wedding day, used by Tremere as assassins.

name: Will Over Form
description: Ability to change into animal form.

name: Will-o-the-wisp
description: Beings allied with (or become by) the pixies who can lead characters through the forest.

name: William Fireheart of Flambeau
description: Ungulus's most infamous member at the end of the twelfth century, who caused trouble in northern France and lost a Wizard's War to a magus of Fudarus in 1220.

name: William Wallace
description: Scottish rebel who wins at Stirling Bridge in 1297 and is defeated at Falkirk in 1298.

name: Willow Maiden
description: The manipulative, uncaring faerie ruler of the eastern Willow Forest among the Courts of the Seasons, whose power waxes in autumn and who entraps the Alder Prince.

name: Winchester
description: A declined but important city, former capital of England, with two castles (the royal castle and Wolvesey Castle of the bishop) and the great St. Giles's Fair.

name: Windgraven
description: Covenant whose magi are predicted to enter the Roman Tribunal in 1266, sparking Provençal-Roman conflict.

name: Winterthur
description: Village near the Kyburgers' castle.

name: Witch of Wookey Hole
description: Blear-eyed hag faerie turned into a stalagmite by a Glastonbury monk; source of Perdo vis.

name: Witch's Kitchen
description: The folk witch's equivalent of a laboratory, where she brews potions.

name: Witch's Moon
description: The folk witch equivalent of Wizard's Twilight: a month-long fever during which she loses her Supernatural Abilities, afterward gaining a good or bad mark.

name: Witch-Hammers
description: Unusual Infernal tradition of overzealous inquisitors who unknowingly practice maleficia while persecuting other supposed witches and heretics, guided by the malleus epistula.

name: Witches' Altar
description: A mass of granite blocks atop the Brocken where, every Walpurgis Night, Walpurga summons the spirits of summer to defeat those of winter.

name: Withstand Magic
description: Virtue Initiated by Neo-Mercurians to bear the cost of Ritual spells.

name: Wizard's Autumn
description: A Perdo Herbam spell (Level 15) that makes all deciduous leaves on target plants turn brown and fall, affecting a small grove of trees.

name: Wizard's Initiation
description: CrVi(Co) 75 ritual meant to grant The Gift, which fails in the Age of Pisces.

name: Woe
description: Faerie Power to injure targets directly, with damage vanishing when the effect ends.

name: Wolf Mount
description: A faerie wolf the size of a horse (Might 20) made of the glamour of a Valkyrie, sharing her Might pool, which carries her and passengers through the sky.

name: Wolkan
description: A branded criminal freed by Lord Robert to help collect tolls on Pfalz Island; a skilled thief and boatman with criminal contacts up and down the Rhine.

name: Woolen Steed of Araby
description: ReAn 20 spell imbuing a woolen rug or pelt with the power of flight, carrying the caster.

name: Work of a Hundred Querns
description: Spell or effect listed in the contents of Transforming Mythic Europe.

name: Worker Elves
description: Identical faerie elves who create magic toys in the workshops.

name: Wrecked
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is very heavily damaged from a major accident, taking two seasons to repair (-5 General Quality, -2 Safety, -2 Aesthetics).

name: Wrest Weapon
description: Non-lethal action leaving the attacker holding the opponent's weapon or other item like a wizard's staff.

name: Wyzwanie
description: A powerful daimon and genius loci embodying the Cursewood's hostile forest, who tests intruders and guards the infernal artifact; Magic Might 40 (Herbam).

name: Wörthsee
description: Lake listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Xavier of House Mercere
description: Archivist of the Rhine Tribunal, attributed as the source of an in-world quotation about the Bingen Hole.

name: Xenophon of Bonisagus
description: The Bonisagus magus who founded the Platonist Hermetic societas the Collegium, believing the Founder had stripped Hermetic Theory of any inquiry into magic's nature or origin.

name: Xerxes
description: A hoplite magus who took Uwe as an apprentice and trained him to become Darius, a hunter of evils within the Order; he is now too frail for combat.

name: Xoanon of Dindyméné
description: A wooden effigy carved by Argos with Magic powers to create a bear or lion, command beasts, and summon a storm; required to wake or sleep Dindyméné.

name: Y Gododdin
description: The single famous poem by which the Welsh poet Aneirin is known, praising the war band of Mynyddawg Mwynfawr sent to recapture a Roman stronghold from the Saxons.

name: Ygerna
description: Gorlois's wife, sought by Uther; she received the disguised Uther into her bed at Tintagel and conceived Arthur.

name: Zelos
description: The Daimon of rivalry, envy, and competition, appearing as a winged Greek youth with a laurel crown; he propagates contention but never helps resolve conflicts.

name: Zodiac
description: The 12 great constellations whose signs, decans and houses form the basis of astrological correspondences.

name: Zurich
description: City listed in the Tribunal index.

name: al-Ghazali
description: An eleventh-century Islamic writer who firmly rejected the ideas of Aristotle, Plato, and Socrates in his book The Incoherence of the Philosophers.

name: al-Nasir
description: Current 'Abbasid caliph (acceded 1180) ruling vigorously from Baghdad.

name: de Spinnens
description: A fictional old farming family maintained by the magi of Florum as landlords and public face of the covenant.

name: 'A'isha
description: Probably Muhammad's favorite wife, in whose house he died.

name: 'Abbasid Caliphate
description: Religious authority in Baghdad whose caliph has Magic Resistance 25.

name: 'Abbasids
description: Caliphal dynasty ruling from 750 to the present from Baghdad; they received Dhu'l-Fiqar.

name: 'Ali ibn Abi Talib
description: Fourth caliph and son-in-law of Muhammad; first imam for the Shi'is, recipient of Dhu'l-Fiqar.

name: 'Arafat
description: Plain east of Mina where the 'standing' of the hajj occurs.

name: 'Ashura'
description: Day of fasting and mourning for al-Husayn.

name: 'Id al-Adha
description: Feast of sacrifice commemorating Abraham.

name: 'Umar
description: Second caliph, entombed at the Mosque of the Prophet.

name: 'Umar ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz
description: Umayyad caliph (r. 717-20) credited with the pact of the dhimmis.

name: 'Uthman
description: Third caliph who dropped the Prophet's seal ring down a well in 650 and was later assassinated.

name: (Gild) Enmity
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw representing the active enmity of one of the Rhine's political gilds, which seeks to thwart the character politically; Tabanus has Hawthorn Gild Enmity.

name: (Hedge Magic) Theory
description: Arcane Ability covering the technical details of a hedge tradition's magic.

name: (Immortal)'s Blessing
description: CrVi(Gen) Zoroastrian holy ritual granting a casting bonus to a following spell of a Form associated with one of seven Immortals, limited by a Personality trait.

name: (Lake) Regio Network
description: Inherited Virtue of Men of the Lake.

name: (Mental Characteristic) of the Followers
description: CrMe35 Ritual raising a mental Characteristic by one, to no more than 0.

name: (Mental Characteristic) of the Heroes
description: CrMe60 Ritual raising a mental Characteristic by one up to +5; subject is immersed in water.

name: (Physical Characteristic) of the Followers
description: CrCo35 Ritual permanently raising a physical Characteristic by one, to no more than 0.

name: (Physical Characteristic) of the Heroes
description: CrCo60 Ritual permanently raising a physical Characteristic by one up to +5; subject is buried under earth.

name: (Realm) Stigmatic
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character manifests physical phenomena and loses Fatigue when in a strong aura aligned to a chosen Realm of Power.

name: (Spirit) Summoning
description: Infernal-tainted Art calling an incorporeal spirit and binding it in a circle.

name: (Type) Controlling
description: Major or Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Controlling 0.

name: (Type) Divining
description: Major or Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Divining 0.

name: (Type) Refining
description: Major or Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Refining 0.

name: (Type) Summoning
description: Major or Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Summoning 0 for a type.

name: 40 (Duration)
description: Holy magic Duration of forty days and forty nights; equal to Moon.

name: A Careful Removal of a Perfect Landscape
description: ReTe 35 ritual with Boundary target that slices off a piece of countryside and floats it through the air at a running horse's speed.

name: A Commentary on Isaiah and Jeremiah
description: Tino's corrupt Theology tractatus.

name: A Deal with the Devil
description: A Major Story Flaw: the character has sold his soul to the devil and is destined for infernal damnation, with Hell's agents goading him; includes Plagued By Supernatural Entity.

name: A Father's Concern
description: An InCo 40 Orphic spell created by Anatol to periodically check on the physical condition of his daughters via the Adelphixis Range.

name: A Harvest By Morning
description: CrHe 50 spell bringing a group of plants to full maturity overnight, beginning at sundown.

name: A Harvest of Figs
description: CrHe 40 effect bringing a plant from seed to maturity in a day.

name: A Herd By Morning
description: CrAn 45 spell bringing up to a hundred animals to full maturity over a single night.

name: A Horse of a Different Color
description: Empathy/Conjure 20 rite giving a target animal colorful wings, making it a chimerical beast able to fly and sing.

name: A Little Hop, A Little Jump, A Little Skip
description: A demonic power letting a demon step through solid objects, remaining intangible for a round.

name: A Material Inspired by the Divine
description: Summa on Terram by Constantine Alexander of Jerbiton, Quality 13 Level 7.

name: A Moment's Reflection
description: A Creo Mentem spell that sparks conscience to remove the Obsession Personality Trait imposed by a demon's obsession power.

name: A Murder of Crows
description: Sabaoth's Power to shatter into up to twenty ravens.

name: A Network Reminiscent of Rome
description: CrTe 20 ritual that creates a permanent stone road based roughly on Roman road dimensions, up to 3.78 miles long.

name: A Pile of Rotting Beef
description: CrAn 35 spell creating ten cow carcasses of Sun duration, from whose decay natural bees are generated.

name: A Plague of Frogs
description: An Animal spell that spontaneously generates frogs, used as an example that the material cause (the frogs) determines its Form.

name: A Proper Blessing
description: Enchantment/Grant 40 ritual granting Puissant Faerie Lore as a Charmed Virtue while the target keeps a stone hidden.

name: A Signal of Intent
description: CrIm 8 effect making a brief sound at a connected location to signal use of a scrying device.

name: A Simple Charm for the Recovery of Misfiled Books
description: A Rego Animal 10 spell that makes a misplaced book fly to its lectern, bookcase, or the caster's hand, using an arcane connection such as the library catalog or the book's voucher.

name: A Simple Method for Rapid Vallation
description: Creo Terram level 35 spell creating a crenellated granite wall up to 500 paces wide; a botch during the Corruption of Tytalus put the walkway on the enemy side.

name: A Simple Test for the Completeness of Books
description: An Intellego Animal 15 spell with Herbam requisite that checks a book's physical condition and history and tests the quality of its plant-based inks.

name: A Spell for the Defense of the Realm Against Expected Invasion
description: MuCo 50 Boundary ritual adding +3 Soak to all humans on the island for a day or night.

name: A Spell to Kill Weeds
description: A PeHe 20 spell (Touch, Momentary, Group) that weeds out a touched plant and all similar plants within a 15-pace range.

name: A Spell to Milk Cattle
description: A ReAn 15 spell (Touch, Concentration, Group) that magically milks cows into nearby milkpails, substituting a Perception + Finesse roll for Animal Handling.

name: A System of Narrow Canals
description: CrTe 20 ritual creating a stone-lined canal network 2 paces deep and 5 wide, up to 1.26 miles long.

name: A Thousand and One Nights
description: Islamic story collection told by rawis, suitable for Elysian adventures.

name: A Useful Inculcator of Comments
description: A Rego Herbam 4 spell that lets librarians add catalog descriptions by sliding letters on a page aside to make space for new entries.

name: A Visible Demand for Repair
description: A MuIm 5 synaesthetic spell that transforms the groans and squeaks of damaged equipment into iconic species, granting +3 to Craft or Profession rolls to find flaws.

name: A Window of Singular Direction
description: Muto Terram level 15 spell by the Architects of Tremere making a circle of wall transparent from one side.

name: A Wizard's Ransom
description: Story seed about a young magus captured and ransomed who seeks the covenant's help to recover his talisman and good name.

name: A golden cup, full of abominations
description: Debauchery/Consumption 25 impregnating a woman with a man's seed.

name: Ab
description: Founding leader and owner of a Scottish monastery.

name: Abacus
description: The last apprentice of Austerius, seventy years old, who has the Tormenting Master Flaw and is eager to show his master up as a senile fool.

name: Abbat
description: The secular owner of a Scottish monastery.

name: Abbaye des Vignerons
description: Guild-like society of Vervay dedicated to viticulture, holding a festival every 15-20 years.

name: Abbey Church of St. Geneviève
description: Abbey church on a hill on the left bank of Paris.

name: Abbey Church of St. Germanus
description: Left-bank abbey church, burial place of most Merovingian kings.

name: Abbey du Relecq
description: Cistercian monastery.

name: Abbey of Fontevraud
description: Double abbey under an abbess housing the Plantagenet tombs; Eleanor of Aquitaine is buried there.

name: Abbey of Ligugé
description: Oldest monastery in the west, founded by St. Martin in 361.

name: Abbey of Ronceray
description: Abbey in Angers founded by Fulk Nerra.

name: Abbey of Saint Keyne
description: Abbey at Keynsham whose monks guard Saint Keyne's Well.

name: Abbey of Saint-Denis
description: Abbey church honoring St. Denis.

name: Abbey of Saints Peter and Paul
description: Mother house in Armagh of the Augustinian canons of Patrick's Island.

name: Abbey of St. Bavo
description: Monastery in Ghent founded by St. Amand.

name: Abbey of St. Peter at Solesmes
description: Abbey owning a Holy Thorn.

name: Abbey of St. Savior
description: Abbey at Redon established in 832.

name: Abbey of St. Vaast
description: Benedictine abbey at Arras founded by St. Aubert housing St. Vaast's relics.

name: Abbey of the Trinity
description: Powerful abbey in Vendôme founded by Geoffroy Martel.

name: Abbo
description: Scholar abbot of Fleury, confidante of Robert II, who expanded its library.

name: Abbot Blathmac
description: Abbot of Iona killed by Danes in 829 for refusing to reveal Columba's bones.

name: Abbot Geoffrey
description: Abbot of Hexham Priory, related by marriage to the Fitz-Huberts.

name: Abbot Hildebert
description: Abbot who began additions to Mont St. Michael in 1020.

name: Abbot Jordan
description: Abbot who began reconstruction of Mont St. Michael in 1210.

name: Abbot Maynard
description: Leader of the monks from St. Wandrille who colonized Mont St. Michael.

name: Abbot Suger
description: Abbot of St. Denis, regent for Louis VII, who built the basilica after a vision of the heavenly Bethlehem.

name: Abbot Thurstan
description: A Norman abbot installed at Glastonbury by the Conqueror who tried to impose foreign customs and the chant of William of Fécamp, leading his soldiers to massacre monks in the church.

name: Abbot of Cluny
description: Head of the Cluniac order holding supreme power over its houses; BaalBaruth can imitate his form.

name: Abbreviatores
description: Assistants to the papal notaries, two or three each.

name: Abd Al Raman
description: The Moorish emir whose invading army crossed the Pyrenees in 732 and whose outriders burned the young Flambeau's family estate.

name: Abduction
description: At Warping Score 7, a realm entity removes the magician to a regio or strips his magic, permanently at Warping Score 10.

name: Abers
description: Coastal region.

name: Abgal
description: Merfolk, possibly aligned with Magic, who tutored the earliest humans; modern mermen may be degenerate abgals.

name: Abhorrent Material/Circumstance
description: Weakness forcing a demon to flee a particular substance or circumstance.

name: Ability Block: Academic
description: Flaw covering the illiteracy of most beguines and penitents.

name: Abimelech
description: Biblical usurper whom Berith helped to rule over Israel for three years as if he were king, recorded in the Book of Judges.

name: Abjurer
description: A criminal of status forced to abjure the kingdom rather than face execution.

name: Ablation Points
description: Points gained by Ablating a spirit, spent on Confidence, Capability, Health, Immortality, Insight, Knowledge, Might, Power or Vis.

name: Ablative Slope
description: Slope of mud or sand at the base of a sea wall protecting it from wave erosion.

name: Abluere Magica
description: A Rego Herbam (Animal) 15 enchanted device of two hinged boards that cleans a soiled garment placed between them as a washerwoman would.

name: Absent Rector
description: Minor church Hook: the priest who collects the benefice does not live in the parish, and his duties fall to a curate.

name: Absolution
description: Divine sacrament that undoes hexes and can remove False Power.

name: Abstract Vis
description: A promise made solid: glamour on matter that seems enchanted but holds no real vis, honored by the faerie's servants.

name: Abu Bakr
description: First caliph, entombed at the Mosque of the Prophet; passed down the Prophet's seal ring.

name: Abu Hanifa
description: Founder of the Hanafi school (d. 767).

name: Abu Ma'shar
description: Author of the Greater Introduction to Astrology.

name: Abu Nasr al-Sarraj
description: Writer who formalized Sufi theory (d. 988).

name: Abyss
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab contains a magical void such as a bottomless well, which can become a Void Feature (-2 Safety, +2 Perdo).

name: Abyssal Bearer Vexillation
description: Continuing Tremere vexillation ensuring no Tremere magus is left unburied; led by the eldest-by-eldest descendant of Tremere.

name: Abyssal Pit
description: Field of Purgatory punishing pride with total sensory deprivation in an infinite fall.

name: Abyssal Regio
description: Infernal regio of privation from God that reduces all Characteristics and can inflict madness Flaws.

name: Ac
description: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Oak", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

name: Accelerated Abilities
description: Abilities that advance like Arts, counterpart to Difficult Arts.

name: Accelerated Group Training
description: Rule letting a leader shorten a group's training time with a Communication + Leadership + stress die roll against an Ease Factor based on time available.

name: Acclimation Prone
description: Major Inferiority doubling difficulty of avoiding Acclimation.

name: Accrued Vis
description: Vis formed when faeries end their roles, from fragments of glamour left in matter or shed accouterments.

name: Accursed Tower
description: External defense at the siege of Acre in 1191, example of an outlying fortification.

name: Accursius
description: A renowned legal commentator at Bologna and frontrunner to become rector of the Faculty of Law, racing his rival Odofredus to write a complete digest of civil law.

name: Aceldama
description: Field in the Vale of Hinnom where Judas hanged himself; Infernal aura 8 and portal to the highest regio level.

name: Achaean League
description: Greek league in which Polybius served as an officer.

name: Achelous
description: River in Greece bounding the lion's European range per Pliny.

name: Acolyte
description: Greatest of the minor orders, symbolized by an extinguished candlestick and empty vessel; often parish clerks, scribes, or messengers.

name: Acqua Claudia
description: Ruined aqueduct home to Giovanni of Matha.

name: Acquire the Connection
description: ReTe 15 effect of the Phylactery that transports a pinch of dirt or stone from around the magus into the Phylactery's empty compartment.

name: Acre Avenue
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city.

name: Action
description: Something a character does on his turn, such as attacking, casting or moving.

name: Action Priority Total
description: Quickness + Ability - Encumbrance + stress die, used to resolve interruptions.

name: Acts
description: Linked scenes in which dramatis personae of a fairy tale interact, such as Interdiction, Villainy, Receipt, Struggle, Ordeal, and Reconciliation.

name: Acts of St. Peter
description: Apocryphal text telling of Simon Magus' fall in Rome.

name: Acute Sense
description: A mastery ability for magical sense spells, available only to those with Quaesitorial training, that detects altered, hidden or destroyed traces.

name: Adalbero, Bishop of Laon
description: Author of the Poem to King Robert (c.1025) on the three orders of society.

name: Adalberon of Reims
description: Archbishop supporting Hugh Capet.

name: Adam and Eve
description: First humans whose Fall is the source of original sin.

name: Adanos Lutorum of Tytalus
description: Author of The Mole's Work.

name: Addled
description: A non-standard laboratory routine in which a maga works two extra hours daily by eccentric anti-fatigue means, gaining +3 to Lab Total but risking Warping, addiction, and botches.

name: Adela of Jerbiton
description: Maga acquitted in 885 of acting as court wizard to Louis III.

name: Adelheid Invigilix
description: The filia of Friderich Invigilor who now watches the Hohenstaufen dynasty for the Invigilor lineage of Tremere.

name: Adelphixis
description: A spell Range granted by Orphic Magic that targets anyone connected to the magos by an emotional Story Flaw, equivalent to Arcane Connection for spell level.

name: Adept Student
description: Virtue possessed by Calum and Domnhull.

name: Adhan
description: The Islamic call to prayer whispered into a newborn's ear during ritual purification.

name: Adinus
description: Angel named in Aldebert's heretical prayer.

name: Adjuration of the Hell-Sworn Spirit
description: ReVi 35 summoning a demon via its True Name.

name: Admiral
description: Officer who finds, provisions, crews, and commands a lord's vessels of war.

name: Admonish the Ferocious Animal
description: Abbas' power, as Circle of Beast Warding.

name: Adolv
description: Very old Count of Mecklenburg, his life sustained by spirits bound to his body.

name: Adonael
description: The angel who thwarts the decanus Metathiax; an amulet inscribed with his sigil is abhorrent to Metathiax.

name: Adoration of the Magical Isle
description: CrAq 50 Ritual permanently increasing an Aquam boundary in the Magic Realm by one, to a maximum of 5.

name: Adria of Quaesitor
description: Associate member of Magvillus and former apprentice of Ferilan, whom Traditionalists want sent away.

name: Adrianus of Montverte
description: Magus who proposed renaming the Tribunal of the West Franks as Normandy in 983.

name: Advanced Group Combat
description: Optional rules expanding ArM5 group combat with more tactical depth, including accelerated training and leader actions.

name: Advancement Requirements Table
description: Table listing the Gratitude, abilities, and costs required to rise from serf to freeman, warrior to knight, and through noble offices.

name: Advocate
description: Guernicus (or other) magi who serve as legal advocates for principals and broker out-of-court settlements.

name: Adèle of Champagne
description: Third wife of Louis VII and mother of Philip Augustus.

name: Aedes Mercurii
description: A powerful covenant in the Provençal Tribunal with two sites, one centered on a majestic stone edifice known as the Temple (Templum) and another carved out of the Pic du Midi d'Ossau.

name: Aegaea
description: A covenant in the Theban Tribunal located in a Faerie regio on the floor of the Aegean Sea, claimed by its members to be the palace of Poseidon and staffed largely by faerie tritones.

name: Aegea
description: A covenant on the floor of the Aegean Sea in the Theban Tribunal, home of the elder Merinita magus Lucian the Scholar.

name: Aegean
description: Basin Bonisagus roamed.

name: Aegis Token
description: Token allowing a spirit familiar to enter within an Aegis.

name: Aegis of Unbreakable Wood
description: A MuHe 15 spell that makes a wooden shield as strong as iron, increasing its Defense bonus by +1 while remaining susceptible to fire.

name: Aelfhere
description: A Friesian shipwright of Waddenzee whose shipbuilding ability is nothing short of magical; he secretly exchanges ideas with the Verditius shipwright Marcus.

name: Aeneas
description: Legendary figure whose travels are more popular than the Golden Fleece legend.

name: Aeromancy
description: Divinatory method using patterns in the air, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Aesc
description: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Ash", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

name: Aesculapius
description: The Greek god of healing, in whose temples (with snake nurseries and mineral springs) Crateuas may have hidden a copy of his herbal.

name: Aesfotedia
description: Substance found in demonic bodies such as Robyn Redcap and the demon dogs.

name: Aesop
description: Pagan writer who gave a threefold division of the ages of man and author of animal fables popular in 1220.

name: Aesop's Fables
description: Animal fables popular in 1220 whose supernatural animals can be adapted into adventures.

name: Aestas
description: A Summer covenant of medium power occupying a large castle and serving as Mundane Lord of the local village, keeping a low profile in Hermetic politics and offering generous hospitality to visiting magi and Redcaps.

name: Aetius
description: Roman general at the Catalaunian Fields.

name: Af
description: Angel of punishment who deals with murderers.

name: Affinity with (Rune)
description: Supernatural Virtue available to vitkir.

name: Affinity with Animál
description: Virtue appearing in character statistics or rules in this text.

name: Affinity with Brawl
description: Virtue of the bull, reflecting how quickly it learns to fight.

name: Affinity with Charm
description: Virtue listed in this text.

name: Affinity with Controlling
description: Virtue possessed by Elisavet improving her Controlling Art.

name: Affinity with Corporem
description: Virtue listed in character statistics in this text.

name: Affinity with Corpus
description: Virtue improving Corpus; held by Anacrôn.

name: Affinity with Craft or Profession Ability
description: A Minor Virtue a maestro may select at no cost, enhancing learning of a Craft or Profession Ability that is the artist's primary medium.

name: Affinity with Divine Lore
description: Virtue held by Stefano.

name: Affinity with Enchanting Music
description: A Virtue held by Brogo that boosts his Enchanting Music supernatural ability.

name: Affinity with Guile
description: A Virtue granting Imanitos Mendax accelerated learning in the Guile Ability.

name: Affinity with Ignem
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue granting affinity with the Form of fire, imparted to Initiates of the Confraternity of Balento.

name: Affinity with Intellego
description: The Minor Hermetic Virtue of the Hermetic Haruspexes tradition, granting an affinity with the Intellego Art.

name: Affinity with Intervention
description: Virtue referenced in this text.

name: Affinity with Magic Theory
description: Virtue possessed by Protinus.

name: Affinity with Mentem
description: A Virtue granting Imanitos Mendax accelerated learning in the Mentem Art.

name: Affinity with Penetration
description: A Virtue giving Philippus Niger accelerated learning in the Penetration Ability.

name: Affinity with Perdo
description: A Virtue giving Philippus Niger accelerated learning in the Perdo Art.

name: Affinity with Rego
description: Virtue possessed by Rotgiers de Gerberoy of House Tremere.

name: Affinity with Terram
description: Virtue possessed by Rotgiers de Gerberoy of House Tremere.

name: Affreux
description: A brindled mastiff, Anacrôn's familiar, able to create a ward repelling people and grow to bear size.

name: Afire
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab is engulfed in never-dying flames requiring protection, possibly blocking some lab work (+1 Upkeep, -3 Safety, +2 Warping, +2 Aesthetics, +3 Ignem).

name: Afonso, Count of Boulogne
description: Noble who will overthrow Sancho II of Portugal.

name: Agathocles' Recipe for Sending a Dream
description: Spell on a Gnostic papyrus showing early heretics experimented with dream magic.

name: Agatuzzo
description: Leader of the Shadow Senate, proud and arrogant, under whose house the senators were entombed.

name: Age of Pisces
description: Current astrological age in which Wizard's Initiation fails.

name: Agency
description: A network of mundane contacts (agents) that magi maintain to pursue goals without being implicated in meddling with mundane politics.

name: Agency Experience
description: Experience points earned alongside Adventure Experience, spent to recruit agents and maintain Bonds.

name: Agent Recruitment Table
description: Table giving the resistance of potential agents by social status, flaws, and resources.

name: Ages of Man
description: Medieval division of the life cycle; the first three ages, each seven years, are infantia, pueritia and adolescentia.

name: Aging Bonus
description: Bonus against aging from Longevity Ritual plus Elixir Level.

name: Aging Chart
description: Table giving Characteristic and Size modifiers for characters by age.

name: Aging Modifier
description: A modifier reflecting living conditions' effect on aging; covenfolk living conditions translate into loyalty point modifiers via this aging modifier.

name: Aging Table
description: Table for aging rolls; demon-blooded roll twice yearly after effective age 35.

name: Agistor
description: Knights guarding the king's rights over animals pastured in the forest.

name: Agnosia
description: A PeMe 10 spell that destroys familiarity with a category of object represented by a single noun, so the victim cannot recognize or use such things.

name: Agnès of Méranie
description: Third wife of Philip Augustus.

name: Agony of the Uncharitable Stranger
description: PeCo 30 talisman enchantment riddling the target with stabbing pains.

name: Agrat bat Mahlat
description: One of the four demon wives of Iblis, a demon of prostitution.

name: Agricola of Tytalus
description: A Tytalus magus of peasant stock at Castrum Antiquum who used Herbam, Auram and Animál magic to wring great harvests from poor northern land.

name: Ahl al-kitab
description: People of the book, permitted to live in Muslim lands as dhimmis.

name: Ahmad ibn Hanbal
description: Founder of the Hanbali school (d. 855).

name: Ahmen
description: One of Sansaron's five custos, who met and grudgingly hosted Tamgor.

name: Ahura Mazda
description: The one supreme, all-knowing God of Zoroastrianism, the 'Wise Lord'.

name: Aidan
description: Early king of the Scots buried at Relig Oran.

name: Aids
description: Taxes owed to a lord, theoretically voluntary gifts, for knighting, marriage, or ransom.

name: Ailettes
description: Boiled leather shoulder plates.

name: Aillwee
description: Might 20 Terram spirit of Aillwee Cave that hungers for shiny things.

name: Aillwee Cave
description: Cave system beneath the Burren in Hibernia, home of a spirit.

name: Aimon
description: Monk of Fleury who wrote the History of the Franks.

name: Aindread Ex Miscellanea
description: A reclusive mature magus at Burnham who never answers letters and has left the covenant only once; parens of Caitlin.

name: Aine
description: Caitlin's young daughter by Oenghus, trained by Alexander.

name: Air for Flying
description: Power (ReAu 35) keeping local weather calm while the bird sings, negating weak magical weather.

name: Airborne
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab flies upon the winds or clouds, requiring very powerful magic, often taken with Unstable.

name: Airitech
description: Irish figure whose three wolf-daughters dwelt in the Cave of Cruachan; possibly herself a spirit of retribution.

name: Akacritous Fortune
description: Magical defense adding the Magical Defense Bonus to Defense Total against aimed spells.

name: Aketon
description: Padded jacket worn under a mail hauberk.

name: Akhlys
description: Leader of the Akylides.

name: Akkala
description: Named spirit of Might 20 (named after a place in Finland) that casts Pilum of Fire for Gunnar.

name: Akrotiri
description: An ancient city buried in volcanic ash on the island of Thera that Andru discovered; rich in magical and technological secrets but now infested with vampires.

name: Akylides
description: Leti of poison and disease, led by Akhlys.

name: Al-Awar
description: Son of Iblis with dominion over debauchery.

name: Al-Qanun fil-Tibb
description: Ibn Sina's Canon of Medicine, summa on Medicine and Medicinal Divining.

name: Alacritous Fortune
description: Magic Defense from Tueor granting defense vs Terram effects.

name: Alain Barbe-Torte
description: Breton king (Crookbeard) who died in 952.

name: Alain Crookbeard
description: Breton king who established Nantes as the capital of the duchy.

name: Alain IV Fergent
description: Duke of Brittany who ended a century of disorder.

name: Alam
