description: A Criamon term for a mystical state so divorced from the mundane world that its alignment to the four realms is debatable; key examples are the Hypostasis and the counter-cyclical alam.

name: Alamut
description: Fortress in northern Persia seized by Hasan-i Sabbah, seat of the Assassins.

name: Alan
description: A ruffian who delays his action against Paul in a combat example.

name: Alan Durward
description: Justiciar who squabbled with the Comyns.

name: Alan Marcell
description: English Templar commander from 1220, chief advisor to Henry III and ally of Peter of Montaigu.

name: Alaron
description: Bladud's consort, after whom Geoffrey of Monmouth says the baths were named.

name: Alaunt
description: Powerful fighting hound (Great Dane) brought forward for the final kill.

name: Alba
description: City in Piedmont famed for white truffles.

name: Albanians
description: People who once honored Gydryty-kom.

name: Albano
description: Cardinal-bishop town.

name: Albanus
description: Tremere's oldest student and successor, First Primus, who spoke Tremere's eulogy and founded the Broken Mirrors Vexillation.

name: Albert
description: Example tainted merchant conceived under a demonic fever, guarded by a demon posing as the merchant Aldo.

name: Albert the Bear
description: A Saxon who founded the March of Brandenburg in 1150 and adopted the title of margrave after campaigns against the Wends; he rebuilt a cathedral in the city of Brandenburg.

name: Albert von Buxhövden
description: Bishop of Riga who founded the Knights of the Sword (Livonian Order) in 1202 and struggles in vain to control their excesses.

name: Albinus
description: Archmagus of House Ex Miscellanea and Theban spirit master whose spells can defeat the Icelandic guardians; he may join the crusade or side with the hreppur.

name: Alchemical Reagent
description: An experimental-philosophy product learned via Philosophiae: a natural substance made in the lab from minerals, botanicals and animal components that imposes a natural alteration on matter.

name: Alchemical Steel
description: A Level 20 Alteration Reagent producing a purified, harder form of iron; blades made of it gain +2 damage and armor gains +2 Protection.

name: Alchemical Sublimation
description: Silver Lady power melting base metals.

name: Alchemist's Revenge
description: A CrAq 25 spell that splashes a target with acid, inflicting +15 damage if it penetrates Magic Resistance and optionally damaging equipment.

name: Aldebert
description: Heretical 740s preacher in northern France who prayed to angels Uriel, Raguel, Tubuel and others.

name: Aldero
description: Elder member of Harco overseeing mercantile activities.

name: Aldo
description: Minor demon masquerading as a merchant friend of Albert.

name: Ale Runes
description: Vitkar magic focus carved on horn.

name: Ale Taster
description: Minor officer of the manorial court who ensures ale is not too watery.

name: Ale-taster
description: Officer, often a woman, ensuring ale brewed on the manor is fit for sale.

name: Alemanni
description: Tribe that settled the Alps roughly matching Bavaria, forming Alemmania.

name: Alembic
description: Distilling flask with narrow neck; alchemical equipment.

name: Alemquer
description: Friary where an angel brought bread to the brothers.

name: Alerion
description: Fabled bird with fire-colored, razor-sharp feathers that killed an iaculus.

name: Aleth
description: Settlement near St. Malo.

name: Aleuromancy
description: Divinatory method using burning or cooking flour, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Alexander I
description: King of Scotland 1107-1124.

name: Alexander Nixon
description: Chief of the Nixons, friend of Horsingas who takes tribute from raids.

name: Alexander of Jerbiton
description: A magus of House Jerbiton who walked the Path of Aging, plucking out his own eye, drinking from the Fountain of Youth, and disappearing into the forest after his mater's death.

name: Alexandros of Bonisagus
description: Author of the summa On Airy Spirits of Significant Places.

name: Alfonso VIII of Castile
description: King who with his wife Eleanor founded the nunnery of Las Huelgas near Burgos.

name: Alice de Vergy
description: Regent of Burgundy.

name: Alice of Brittany
description: Heiress of the former Breton ruling house, wife of Peter of Dreux.

name: Alienable Land
description: Covenant Hook: covenant lands may be sold or mortgaged to outsiders, drawing in the mundane world.

name: Alklha
description: A vast Siberian dragon that seems to swallow the Sun; sliced in half by shamans, its lower body hidden under a ward; it can dispel Sun duration effects by licking them.

name: All According to Plan
description: A Minor General Virtue letting a player reroll a botch die once per session by describing a prepared contingency.

name: All Hallows
description: October 31st, the eve on which Disciples of the Worm usually celebrate their rites.

name: All Saints' Day
description: Feast on 1 November remembering all the saints.

name: Allessandro
description: An example Donatore character with Banishing 18 who banishes the Infernal ghost of his former master from his covenant in a worked example.

name: Alleviate the Serpent's Bite
description: Stag of Virtue power neutralizing poison after drinking water.

name: Allhallow's Eve
description: Night when demons, witches and ghosts roam the earth, strengthening Infernal auras.

name: Allied Troops Table
description: Table giving the proportion by which a lord's core vassal force is multiplied based on his affinity roll.

name: Almogaten
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for the leader of a band of Almogavars in Iberia, commanding around a dozen men.

name: Almogavar
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a member of an Iberian band of mercenaries and raiders bound by a code of honor.

name: Almogavars
description: Aragonese quick, light skirmishers, example of Evasion-based fighters.

name: Almohad Caliphate
description: Rival caliphate whose caliph has Magic Resistance 25.

name: Almoner
description: Monk responsible for distributing surplus food to beggars at the gate.

name: Alms Land
description: Land given to the Church in perpetuity, still held from a major noble who keeps rights like knight service.

name: Alnoth
description: The son born to Eadric Wilde and his faerie wife, who grew up to be a good and holy man.

name: Alnwick
description: Where Malcolm Canmore was killed.

name: Alodia
description: The most remote of the three Nubian kingdoms on the southern reaches of the Nile, where Kassala is located.

name: Alomancy
description: Divinatory method using patterns in thrown salt, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Alpenstock
description: Walking stick with an iron spike, used as a quarterstaff.

name: Alphitomancy
description: Divinatory method using eating barley bread, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Alpine Dragon
description: Mythic dragon so large it eats other dragons, said to lie beneath the Alps.

name: Alpine dragonette
description: Small dragon of the Alps whose skin Cymena made into boots.

name: Alpine wrestling
description: Strength-based wrestling style of the Alps, covered by Brawling.

name: Alroy of Flambeau
description: Florum's elderly Flambeau champion, a Levant veteran training an apprentice and seeking to rekindle his spirit.

name: Altar
description: A laboratory Feature: an ornamental place of ritual worship such as a raised dais, providing Technique and Vim Specializations.

name: Altar of Apollo of Landings
description: Shrine built by Jason at City Harbor; Faerie aura 1 and terminus of the Jasonian Way.

name: Altar stone of Pagan's Hill
description: Limestone slab turning quicksilver into Intellego vis.

name: Alu
description: Word used in rune spells meaning 'protect me', perhaps referring to Algiz.

name: Always Hear the Waves
description: Selkie power knowing the way to the Palace of the Selkie King.

name: Alyssa
description: Example maga who enlarges a small magical regio for her mystery rites.

name: Amabael
description: Authority responsible for winter, Divine Might 40.

name: Amabel the Learned
description: A brilliant Natural Magician scholar at Schola Pythagoranis, nearly as powerful as the magi and treated as a member of the Order though she never joined.

name: Amalthea
description: Mythic goat that suckled Zeus; Capra sees herself as the new Amalthea.

name: Amaury de Bene
description: An unrepentant heretic and Paris master who taught a pantheistic philosophy with a substantial following; posthumously exhumed, excommunicated, and his bones cast into unhallowed ground.

name: Amazon
description: Amazon sorceresses, whose tussling could cost an apprentice the Gift.

name: Amber
description: Semiprecious stone suited to Rego, mined at Lycaneon.

name: Amber Eyes
description: Amber eyes given to over a thousand blinded Bulgars by a single Tremere ritual, inherited in Transylvania.

name: Ambidextrous
description: Virtue possessed by the Prince of the Grey Jerkin.

name: Ambrus
description: A Bonisagus archmage who led the complex negotiations for the founding of three covenants in the Slavic lands in the late 10th century.

name: Ambush Predator
description: Creature Quality of the peregrine falcon.

name: Amelie of Merinita
description: Oleron spokeswoman, focused on Aquam with river-nymph blood.

name: Amercement
description: A fine negotiated with a judge to avoid gruesome physical punishment.

name: Ameretat
description: One of the Zoroastrian Immortals (Amesha Spentas): 'Long Life', associated with Calm and Herbam in the Blessing ritual.

name: Amesbury
description: English daughter house of Fontrevrault founded by Henry II.

name: Amethyst of Virtue
description: Gem containing 1 pawn of Mentem vis that, when Enriched, confers Lesser Immunity to drunkenness while touching the drinker's skin.

name: Amiculum
description: An awakened white woolen cloak and former talisman of a Hermetic magus that returned from his Twilight as an independent magical being with Magic Might 5.

name: Amicus
description: A magus sworn in an oath of friendship to another, implying a lasting moral duty of support and vengeance.

name: Amphibious
description: Animal Quality listed in the seal statistics (Amphibious).

name: Amphitheater of the Temple Town
description: Ruined arena in the northwest of the temple town, whose labyrinth beneath houses the Maze Beast.

name: Amulet bearing the sigils of angels
description: Shape/material bonus item giving +7 to ward and banish demons.

name: Amulet for an Ample Harvest
description: SuSa 20 amulet with 2 charges protecting a field's crops, buried from Vernal to Autumnal Equinox.

name: Amulet of Longevity
description: SuSa 5 amulet with 4 charges giving +2 Living Conditions.

name: An Banrigh nam Eilan nam Crodh Beag
aliases: The Queen of the Island of Little Cattle
description: The Queen of the Island of Little Cattle, secretly a famhair a'falach in the Shetlands seeking her hidden heart so she can die.

name: An Bhoireann
description: Rocky wilderness in western Hibernia above Aillwee Cave.

name: An Caora Dubh
description: The Black Ram, a man-eating faerie monster (Faerie Might 24) created by the Prince of the Grey Jerkin to harass Crun Clach; vulnerable to rowan and bells.

name: An Ear for Distant Bells
description: InIm 15 spell to determine the distance and direction to a sound's source; invented by Quaesitor Fluvius.

name: An Enemy Awash in the Pure Sigil of the Magus
description: A CrIm 15 spell that washes a target's eyes with concentrated visible species based on the caster's sigil, blinding them for two minutes.

name: An Expansive & Permanent Wall of Protecting Stone
description: CrTe 30 ritual creating one million cubic paces of stone, enough for a wall nearly 9.5 miles long.

name: Anacron
description: Eremite magus who has collaborated with Montverte on raids on covenants' Paris storehouses.

name: Anacrôn
description: Eremite magus of House Ex Miscellanea and legless King of the Beggars of Paris, whose lineage's magic is founded on pain and infirmity.

name: Anacrôn's Talisman
description: A wand carved from a human leg bone inlaid with bloodstones, enchanted with Agony of the Uncharitable Stranger and Hobble the Foul-Mouthed Wretch.

name: Anafiel
description: An angel counted among the three largest beings in existence, alongside Metatron and Sandalphon.

name: Anagni
description: City visited by the Pope.

name: Anahel
description: Archangel ruling Shehaqin.

name: Anal Fistula
description: A Minor Melancholic Disease from excessive retention of melancholy on the fundament, requiring surgical removal of the fistula.

name: Ananke
description: The Greek goddess of inevitability whose bound wrists were depicted in House Criamon's older symbol; she was never worshipped because she could not grant favors.

name: Anastasia
description: Filia of Archmage Pietro, returning to join the Covenant of the Icy North.

name: Anatol
description: A magos formerly of House Jerbiton who created the spell A Father's Concern to check on his six estranged daughters.

name: Anaximander of Thebes
description: Organized the Fraternity of Samos in the early tenth century.

name: Ancestral Spirit
description: Faeries believing themselves the ancestor of all people within a family, taking on attributes from the family's history.

name: Anchored to the Baths
description: Flaw or Inferiority listed for Anne or Minerva Sulis of Bath.

name: Anchored to the Earth
description: Flaw of awakened truffles.

name: Anchorite (Church Boon)
description: Minor Church Boon: an anchorite's cell raising the Divine aura by 1.

name: Ancient Magic
description: Extinct traditions, discussed in a separate book, whose integration rules parallel hedge ones.

name: Ancient Rage
description: Boar King power that sends him into a frothing fury with bonuses to Attack and Soak.

name: And he causeth all to receive a mark
description: Debauchery/Diablerie 25 making an object an Arcane Connection to a creature.

name: And the dragon gave him his power
description: Incantation/Diablerie 40 Forsaken granting a Minor Virtue.

name: And the men had repented not of their deeds
description: Incantation/Psychomachia 10 sensing dominant emotion.

name: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great
description: Meditation/Understanding miraculous effect (Level 15) revealing whether to choose a lot.

name: Andabatus
description: Blind Fighting certamen school trading Defense for Attack.

name: Andrea
description: Grog Captain of Literatus, a skilled swordswoman.

name: Andreas
description: A magus of House Bonisagus who devised The Resolute Mind of the Tireless Researcher to combat his constant lapses of concentration.

name: Andreas Capellanus
description: Author in 1174 of De Amore, the definitive work on fin' amors, listing 12 Laws of Love.

name: Andrew II
description: King of Hungary whose conflicts with his nobles are being resolved; his daughter married John II in 1218.

name: Andrew of Hungary
description: Crusade leader of the Fifth Crusade; also referenced as Hungarian King Andrew II who granted the Teutons lands in Transylvania.

name: Andrew of Montbard
description: Grand Master (1153-1156).

name: Anemoi
description: Greek spirits of specific winds.

name: Angel of Light
description: Jaevert's power to appear as a shining angel.

name: Angelic Movement
description: A common automaton power (base effect 40, Creo Auram with Rego requisite) letting an automaton with a flight-capable form fly at the magus's direction.

name: Angelo
description: The old priest of Saint Aquila for 40 years, who has received visions and moves between the mundane and Divine regio.

name: Angelo Tancredi
description: Early follower of Francis from Rieti, a noble knight before joining.

name: Angelus of Ex Miscellanea
description: Holy hermit co-founder of Cunfin who believes Twilight is seeing the Face of God.

name: Angers
description: Capital of Anjou on the River Maine, center of Plantagenet power.

name: Angevin Domains
description: Lands where feudal grants of exclusive hunting rights (warrens and chases) are customary.

name: Anglesey
description: The island site of an ancient druidic shrine that the Díedne incorporated as the Nameless Covenant in 817.

name: Anglo-Norman
description: Dialect of England's ruling classes closely related to Norman French.

name: Anglo-Saxon rune wizards
description: Group of rune wizards who fought alongside Damhan-Allaidh and the gruagachan against Pralix.

name: Angoulême
description: Walled city with the castle of Isabella, Countess of Angoulême.

name: Angra Mainyu
description: The 'Destructive Spirit', opposite of Ahura Mazda, bringing disorder, falsehood and suffering.

name: Anguis
description: Verditius rumored to have learned magic from the dragon Siguson.

name: Animae
description: Temporary faeries created by Animae Magic from inanimate objects or summoned from Arcadia; they are intelligent, have Might-appropriate powers, and bargain for their aid.

name: Animal Ken (Ability)
description: The Supernatural Ability to communicate with animals, conferred by the Animal Ken Virtue at score 1.

name: Animal province
description: The Animal-aligned province of the Twilight Void: musky smells and brightly lit animals; sounds of creatures with Cunning transmit their thoughts.

name: Animalists
description: Suggested Mercere specialty of magi creating or healing mounts and useful animal materials.

name: Animated Branches
description: Corrupted tree power to wield branches as weapons.

name: Animated Tree
description: A tree made mobile by spells such as Lord of the Trees or by a spirit's Manifestation power; has no Might unless animated by Manifestation.

name: Animo
description: The Virgilian practice of creating objects with awakened spirits that move of their own volition and adapt to their surroundings, something impossible with Hermetic magic.

name: Anizy-le-Château
description: A town of 300 dominating fourteen smaller towns in Laonnoise southwest of Laon in France, long in conflict with its lord the Bishop of Laon over taxation and charters.

name: Anna of Naples
description: A tenth-century Jerbiton Archmage whose decision to take her apprentice and others to Constantinople for immersion accidentally created the first Itinerarium.

name: Annan
description: River west of which Lord Goulis rarely hunts.

name: Anne's House
description: Manor a few miles from Kilkenny with a lab outbuilding and a bog where a dying giant is pinned.

name: Annibaldi Family
description: One of Rome's great noble families.

name: Announce the Name of the Approaching Visitor
description: Creo Imágonem 10 effect in Gabricon's doormat.

name: Annwfn
description: The otherworld realm over which Gwynn ab Nudd reigns as king of the faeries.

name: Ansbach
description: Region in the Rhine Tribunal strongly associated with wolves.

name: Anselm of Laon
description: Scholar under whom Laon's cathedral school flourished.

name: Anson of Jerbiton
description: Member of Feritel (called Anson of Sansaron elsewhere) once trapped five years in the Faerie forest.

name: Antagonists
description: Ars Magica supplement presenting characters such as Giraud Le Cornu, Geoffroi D'Arques, Bishop Orris, Joseph of Napoli and Galatea.

name: Antar
description: Slave, warrior, and poet of Arabic legend.

name: Antares
description: Rumored supreme war leader appointed by the Council of Archmagi, named for a great ruby badge of office.

name: Antares ruby
description: Enormous ruby reputedly granting extraordinary powers, the badge of the Antares.

name: Antediluvian Age
description: The age before the Flood, era of the Nephilim.

name: Antelope of Virtue
description: A very wild beast with saw-like horns that can cut down trees.

name: Antho
description: Youngest Redcap of Harco, corrupt and politically ambitious, selling and forging letters.

name: Anthony of Padova
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Antigone of Criamon
description: An example Criamon maga (a follower of the Path of Seeming, skilled in Imaginem) who suffers Twilight incidents and adulterations such as a dragon embodying her violent temper.

name: Antillia
description: The Isle of Seven Cities, a rectangular Atlantic island opposite Iberia founded by seven bishops fleeing the Moors, perhaps built by a magus.

name: Antimedes of Tytalus
description: A magus of House Tytalus and member of the Lyceum who seeks to copy rare academic books and re-enter them into academic circles.

name: Antiphon
description: A Sophist quoted in the Analects of Tytalus who proposed that man is better off escaping convention and taught a life of refined intellectual hedonism.

name: Antistes Mercuria
description: Title of the high priest of Mercury held by Augustus and Tiberius.

name: Antonin of Dragon's Rest
description: Redcap robbed of horses by Pandion.

name: Antonine Wall
description: Roman wall between the Forth and Clyde.

name: Antonio (Shadow Senator)
description: Shadow Senator worried about his fate who may seek salvation.

name: Antonio (werewolf)
description: Old warrior leader of the Silver Fangs werewolves, able to sense corruption.

name: Antonius
description: Guernicus Primus during the Schism War who called the emergency Grand Tribunal and led Fenicil's sacrificial ritual.

name: Ants of Virtue
description: Dog-sized ants of Ethiopia that dig up gold and guard it fiercely.

name: Antwerp
description: Harbor city founded after Silvius Brabo defeated a giant.

name: Aonghus Lamh Iarran
description: Magus Ex Miscellanea and war leader of Clan Mac Gruagach, addicted to cattle raiding, who enchants his arms and armor and enjoys challenging visitors to certamen.

name: Aonghus Mac Dughal
description: Notorious cattle thief killed by the clansman template character.

name: Aoroi
description: The summonable restless dead of ancient Greece, waiting on the worldly side of the Styx; important for divination by the chthonic cult that led to Houses Tytalus and Tremere.

name: Apantomancy
description: Divinatory method using chance meetings with animals, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Apathy
description: Cold insubstantial faceless shadow demon dressed as a monk.

name: Ape of Virtue
description: A magical ape that loves to imitate men; apes in Europe are found only in Iberia near Gibraltar.

name: Apocalypse of Paul
description: Text quoted in this chapter.

name: Apollo of Landings
description: Aspect of Apollo revered by sailors.

name: Apollodorus
description: Author of the Library, which summarizes the Golden Fleece legend.

name: Apollonios of Tyana
description: Ancient magician who confronted a ghula in Corinth.

name: Apollonius of Tyana
description: First-century miracle worker whom elementalists believe first developed the Elementalist Arts.

name: Apoplexy
description: A Critical Sanguine Disease caused by a malicious faerie that damages the heart, causing immediate collapse.

name: Apostasy
description: Abandoning religious life; considered the worst sin, with fugitive nuns hunted and returned to the cloister.

name: Apostles of Apollonius Lore
description: Organization lore Ability possessed by Elisavet.

name: Apotropaic Mastery
description: Spell mastery ability adding Mastery Score x Hierarchy Score to spells targeting Infernal Might.

name: Appanage
description: Non-heritable sections of an estate given to younger sons for their lifetime.

name: Apparent Aging
description: Philomena's cosmetic effect that slows apparent aging in magi.

name: Apparitio Sancti Michaelis Archangelis in Monte Tumba
description: Anonymous Divine Lore tractatus (Quality 11) on the foundation of Mont St. Michael.

name: Apparitions
description: Lucid ghosts claiming to return from the afterlife, seeking help to pass on.

name: Appealing a Petition
description: Overturning another's petition requires original Petition Total + 3.

name: Appear Human
description: Personal power allowing a humanoid faerie of size -2 to +2 to look and feel human via illusion; used by the Man in Black with a Sack on His Back.

name: Appease the Queen of Winter
description: A Muto Aquam ritual spell (MuAq 60) learned by Falke with the volkhvy's aid, propitiating the Queen of Winter to thaw the Baltic Sea; gains a +10 bonus when cast at Arkona.

name: Apple Guild
description: Rhine Tribunal guild with which the Lotharingians sympathize.

name: Apple Mile
description: Faerie regio (aura 5) on Oleron island where the covenant lies, always summer.

name: Applecross
description: Site of the Monastery of St. Maelrubha, granted the earldom of Ross.

name: Apples of Hesperides
description: A golden-apple tree grown from a seed said to descend from Hera's wedding tree; it produces six golden apples a year, each containing Creo vis, whose flesh sustains a man and resists illness.

name: Apprentice Piece
description: Completed item a Verditius apprentice must forge for his Gauntlet.

name: Apprentice Snatching
description: House Bonisagus's right, granted at the First Tribunal, to take another magus's apprentice, with suggested restraints.

name: Apprentice of House Bonisagus
description: Sample eight-year-old girl just accepted into House Bonisagus, raised in the woods, with Apt Student.

name: Apprentices
description: An Ars Magica supplement providing rules for playing child characters and how their Virtues and Flaws change as they age.

name: Aptitude
description: Virtue listed in character statistics in this text.

name: Aptness
description: Moral correctness in House Criamon belief; living aptly is thought to slow the universe's fall into chaos and is required for entering the Hypostasis.

name: Apulia
description: Eastern southern Italian region.

name: Aqsa Mosque
description: Important mosque on the Temple Mount with a Dominion aura of 6.

name: Aquam province
description: The Aquam-aligned province of the Twilight Void: water and liquids shine out, and travelers can move through water or walk on it.

name: Aquarius
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Aqueduct (Temple of Mercury)
description: The dry, damaged aqueduct system of the temple town; its pipe is also a regio entrance and its source is a mountain spring that is an Aquam vis source.

name: Aquileia
description: Diocese where a priest was suspended for two years for summoning a demon.

name: Aquitaine Lore
description: Area lore of Aquitaine.

name: Arabian Peninsula
description: Birthplace of Islam, inhabited by oasis cultivators and nomads.

name: Arable
description: The most precious land, used to grow grain and legumes.

name: Araboth
description: The Seventh Heaven, location of God's Throne, ruled by Cassiel.

name: Aragon
description: Iberian kingdom where Templars have been present since 1130.

name: Aralim
description: Choir of fire and ice.

name: Aramaic
description: Language Ability of the sofer and kabbalist templates.

name: Aramin
description: An irascible magus, expert in Perdo and Corpus, whose vis source is a rare swamp plant (bitter cane) and who may have authored a plague.

name: Arasen
description: Hospitable Tytalus Magus who leads Luctatio.

name: Aratol
description: Apprentice at Verdi who created the Potent Pot of Tasty Tea.

name: Arawn
description: Faerie king of Man who controls the land.

name: Arbalest
description: Crossbow requiring a mechanical device such as a windlass to span.

name: Arbitration
description: Quaesitorial service mediating disputes between magi or covenants, ending in a formal witnessed agreement.

name: Arcadian Path
description: A path mentioned in House Merinita usually leading into the faerie realm of Arcadia and granting the Mystery of Faerie Magic; Serrifuloria discovered a unique variant within Arcadia itself.

name: Arcane Circle
description: New Hermetic Geometry Target equivalent to Part, linking a traced circle to a remote circle.

name: Arcane Connection Range
description: Range available to kolduni (+4 magnitudes) requiring the Arcane Connection to be submerged in water.

name: Arcane Ring
description: New Hermetic Geometry Duration equivalent to Moon, linking a traced ring to a remote circle.

name: Archbishop Thurstan
description: Archbishop of York who defeated David at the Battle of the Standard.

name: Archbishop Turpin
description: Heroic figure from The Song of Roland.

name: Archbishop Wichmann of Magdeburg
description: An archbishop who, following a vision of vast urban development, granted charters to many towns in Germany and Poland and used agents called locatores.

name: Archbishop of Bologna
description: Current archbishop hostile to Literatus but bound by Sylvester's agreement.

name: Archbishop of Mainz
description: Wrote to Pope Gregory IX in 1233 about abuses of inquisition.

name: Archdeacon Agent
description: Major Covenant Boon: the local archdeacon is an agent of the covenant.

name: Archdeaconry
description: Territorial subset of a diocese under an archdeacon.

name: Archdiocese of Rouen
description: Archdiocese whose borders nearly match the duchy of Normandy, raised to an archdiocese in 744.

name: Archieunuch
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for one of the most important eunuchs in the Byzantine empire, wielding significant influence and authority.

name: Archimaga Tisiphone
description: A renowned beauty and Archimaga able to evoke artistic talent in men, who lives within a regio and wears a red ribbon.

name: Archimagus Apollodarus
description: An Archimagus of the Monkey's Reed covenant whose beloved died in a fire he created, whom Bonisagus magi hope will become High Priest of the forming Temple.

name: Archisuppôts
description: Arch-thieves, usually from the dregs of the clergy, who teach the king's law and train apprentice beggars.

name: Architechtus
description: Demon perhaps summoned by the Ring of Solomon.

name: Architechus
description: Fury (Might 25), the Demon Builder; a Destroyer.

name: Architects
description: Tremere Terram specialists maintaining fortifications, roads and bridges.

name: Architectus
description: A Master of the Furies and demon builder who commands hosts of tiny demons to build roads and bridges overnight in exchange for deals with mortals.

name: Archpriest
description: Older title used by some rural deans.

name: Arduinna
description: Faerie villain who holds the Enchanted Priest captive; weakened by the Stone Drum.

name: Area Lore (Scottish Highlands)
description: Lore that may give a magus enough knowledge to dispel gruagach curses.

name: Area Lore: Cursewood
description: Area Lore covered by several books in Regulus' library.

name: Area Lore: Devil's Lane
description: Knowledge ability of Devil's Lane.

name: Area Lore: Pomerania
description: Ability rolled to know about Pomerania.

name: Area Lore: Purgatory
description: Ability referenced in this text.

name: Area Saint
description: Saints of Divine Might about 50 venerated over large areas.

name: Arelie
description: One of Birna's six apprentices, told to 'Remember,' an eagle from a Prussian tribe; founder of Clan Arelie.

name: Aretaeus the Cappadocian
description: The physician credited with naming diabetes after the Greek word for a siphon, due to its excessive discharge of urine.

name: Argantael
description: A vagabond faerie who assists the clothier Doolin, whispering to him about secret gatherings of wizards from across Mythic Europe.

name: Argentiera
description: Sardinian lead mine in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Argonautika
description: Poem of the Golden Fleece by Apollonios Rhodios (and a Latin version by Valerius Flaccus); tractati of Faerie Lore Quality 6.

name: Argot
description: Language of the Parisian beggars.

name: Argotiers
description: The beggars working for the King of the Beggars, licensed to beg in specific ways and speaking an argot.

name: Argotiers Lore
description: Knowledge of the argotiers.

name: Argument Success
description: Int + Ability + stress die vs 9 to gain petition modifiers.

name: Argyle
description: Western Scottish region with numerous stone alignments and pig-keeping, part of old Dalriada.

name: Arian Heresy
description: Heresy St Martin combated.

name: Arichis
description: Jerbiton magus of Literatus teaching at the University of Law.

name: Ariel of Flambeau
description: A young Flambeau magus among the members recruited to Nigrasaxa.

name: Aristaeus
description: A god who desired Eurydice and advanced on her, causing her to flee and step on the viper that killed her.

name: Aristarcus
description: Filius of Proctor, a Traditionalist Guernicus who argues cases before Tribunal; familiar a swan.

name: Aristophanes
description: Greek playwright whose play The Birds describes the founding of Nephelococcygia.

name: Arkliss
aliases: Arkliss, a Dragon of the Fens
description: A small but fierce true dragon lairing in a bog, able to dominate people with her gaze and breathe pestilence.

name: Arm of St. George
description: Relic with Faith score 2 at Vendôme.

name: Arming the Legion of the Dead
description: Muto Mentem level 70 Ritual (Terram requisite) making the metal gear of up to 10,000 ghosts solid, without granting control over them.

name: Armor of the Giant of Steenvoorde
description: Huge armor from Charlemagne, possibly magical.

name: Armorica
description: Roman province that became Brittany.

name: Arn cul-ri Eirin
description: Cairn on Iona marking where Columba found he could no longer see Ireland.

name: Arne de Spinnen
description: A childless former head of the de Spinnen family, himself not who he seemed, who accepted Petrus as his heir.

name: Arnev
description: Great Spirit of Ushant of stormy weather, a serpent with a horse's head.

name: Arnold of Torroja
description: Grand Master (1180-1184).

name: Arnold of Villanova
description: Stated that spirits could not be coerced and came voluntarily.

name: Aron
description: A Ba'al Shem who interprets Elizabeth's dreams in an example.

name: Arras
description: Seat of Artois, with the Abbey of St. Vaast and a tradition of trouvères.

name: Arrogant
description: Walter.

name: Arrée Mountains
description: Highest part of the duchy.

name: Ars Fabulosa
description: The 'fantastic art' of faerie bargaining, developed in the eastern parts of Mythic Europe from ancient spirit-summoning arts.

name: Ars Goetica
description: Infernal spirit magic rules referenced for gruagachan who command spirits.

name: Ars Grammatica
description: Book by Donatus (Artes Liberales Summa) held by the Reims coven.

name: Ars Notoria text
description: Apollonius's text in four languages, a Quality 20 tractatus, the only way to initially learn Ars Notoria.

name: Arsenic
description: Poison found in the soil of the battlefield; valuable to necromancers and a potential metal with Material Bonuses.

name: Arsenical Pseudoelemental
description: Earth spirit (Magic Might 20 Terram) made cruel by arsenic salts.

name: Arsenical Skeletons
description: Undead animated by Averna's Ritual, poisonous.

name: Arshaq ibn Kareem
description: Zahid with Faith Score 1 used as the example for Divine Form and Divine Unity.

name: Art & Academe
description: Supplement referenced for more details on elemental physics.

name: Art-Aligned Aura
description: An aura aligned with a Technique or Form that doubles the aura bonus for relevant spells and lab work and reduces power costs for aligned creatures.

name: Arte dei Mercanti
description: Merchant societies formed in Florence in 1182 in imitation of the noble tower societies, which spread to many other cities.

name: Artemis
description: The deity to whom Ophia Sirnaus Isle-Warden's shrine on her Aegean island is dedicated.

name: Artemis Lykeie
description: Thracian wolfish form of Artemis, a faerie known for tearing the sacrilegious apart.

name: Artes Mechanicae
description: The mechanical arts, elevated in the 13th century.

name: Arthur Among the Britons
description: Tractatus on Area Lore: Britain by Celeres of Welsh Arthur tales.

name: Arthurian Romances
description: Tractatus, Etiquette, collection of Chrétien's four poems.

name: Artificers
description: Tremere makers of ritual objects, banners, sigils and secret items.

name: Artillery Assault
description: Siege attack using groups of up to five mangonels or trebuchets against castle walls, resolved with Siege Weapon versus Profession Siege Engineer.

name: Artio
description: Bear goddess worshipped by the ancient Celts of the Berne region.

name: Artist
description: A covenfolk template for a fey, painter-craftsman in a highly magical environment, with Virtues like Free Expression and Second Sight.

name: Artur of Jerbiton
description: Rellantali magus who maintains relations with Venice.

name: Aréfast
description: Nobleman of northern France who exposed the Orléans heretics in 1022 using inquisitorial methods.

name: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him
description: Invocation Cursing effect imposing a penalty on all the target's actions.

name: As the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers
description: Debauchery/Malediction 15 Medium Wound.

name: Asaron of Flambeau
description: A magus of House Flambeau who believes his mission is to repopulate the world for more to kill; he spends seasons healing, and his sigil is a symbolic flame.

name: Ascendant
description: The sign rising over the eastern horizon at a given time and place, the starting point of a horoscope.

name: Ascendant Form of the Intendant Hierarch
description: Mystery Ritual in which the hierarch constructs a prototype ascendant form, manifesting his abilities in their strongest form during apotheosis.

name: Ascetics
description: Holy tradition favoring Adjuration, Cursing, Purity and Second Sight, practicing ritual purity of mind and body.

name: Asen
description: Elder of two brothers who rebelled against the Byzantine Empire in 1185, raiding Thrace and Macedonia.

name: Ash
description: A trusted Redcap from The Broken Covenant of Calebais who may secretly be a Loamwalker.

name: Ash Branch of Muto Vis
description: Ash-branch vis granting Reserves of Strength and Toughness in battle.

name: Asha Vahishta
description: One of the Zoroastrian Immortals (Amesha Spentas): 'Best Righteousness', associated with Brave and Ignem/Imaginem in the Blessing ritual.

name: Ashagalomancy
description: Divinatory method using casting bones, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Ashkenazim
description: Jews in Christian lands, mostly France and Germany, socially isolated and turned towards theology and mysticism.

name: Ashmodai
description: King of Tempters, co-leader of the ninth order with Lilith; eldest child of Adam and Lilith, winged and terrible in aspect.

name: Asiyah
description: Lowest of the Four Worlds (Action), the mundane material universe.

name: Asp of Virtue
description: A venomous serpent of several types, easily charmed by music, said to guard a balm-bearing tree or bear a carbuncle gem.

name: Asphodel
description: Plant connected to the dead, used as weapons by mazzeri and sacred to Persephone.

name: Assarting
description: Carving new cropland or meadow from fertile wasteland; can be done magically, alarming nearby lords.

name: Assembly of Birds
description: A mid-winter gathering that all Birds of Nephelococcygia must attend, at which new songs are performed and criticized.

name: Asses' Ears
description: A Minor Curse (Muto Corpus Animal effect) that turns the victim's ears into donkey ears, penalizing social interactions by -3.

name: Assessor
description: Tremere urban diplomats, merchants or spies with the Gentle Gift.

name: Assistant
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: a Gifted assistant such as a Hermetic apprentice helps in the lab, adding their Intelligence + Magic Theory to General Quality.

name: Associate Member
description: Status at Magvillus granting quarters and labs in return for vis and service.

name: Assume the Form of the Ancestors
description: GvSh 15 spell making the caster grow to giant size, +5 Size with Strength and Quickness adjustments.

name: Asta
description: Galdrakona wife of Gunnar Loftursson, targeted by the crusaders, who sustains a Biarg spirit with spell song to keep her daughter alive.

name: Astaroth
description: One of the Maskim, Prince of the Accusing Angels and once a seraph; Prime Minister of Hell and co-signatory of all diabolic pacts, appearing as an angel astride a dragon.

name: Astasians
description: Tiny messenger-demons that Imanitos Mendax can use to communicate with his subordinates, easily mistaken for 'airy spirits.'

name: Astera
description: Mystagogue of Stellus, born under Sagittarius.

name: Astra
description: Example maga using Laboratory Horoscopes.

name: Astralabe
description: Son of Abélard and Héloïse.

name: Astrological Ages
description: ~2160-year ages defined by vernal equinox sign.

name: Astrological Correspondences
description: Astrological reference material in the Hermetic Astrology chapter.

name: Astrological Cyclic Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue or Flaw whose cycles follow astrological periods (male/female, cardinal/fixed/mutable, or elemental signs), with bonus of 3, 5, or 6.

name: Astrological House
description: One of the astrological houses, e.g. Genitor (fourth) and Valetudo (sixth).

name: Astrological Houses
description: The 12 divisions of a horoscope chart (Vita, Lucrum, Frates, Genitor, Nati, Valetudo, Uxor, Mors, Pietas, Regnum, Benefacta, Carcer), each with its own province.

name: Astrological Inception
description: An experimental-philosophy formula learned via Artes Liberales consisting of an astrological chart designed to answer a specific question about a person, object, or event.

name: Astrological Magic
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue adding Artes Liberales to Kabbalah totals.

name: Astrological Magical Foci
description: Modified Hermetic Virtue referenced alongside Potent Magic in astrological Mysteries.

name: Astrological Modifier
description: Bonus (+1 to +5) to Lab Total or casting score from a successful horoscope roll.

name: Astrological Spell
description: Spell cast with benefit of Potent Magic or Focus in a sign, planet, or house.

name: Astrologically Linked Enchantment
description: Enchantment linked to a target by Nativity Horoscope or to a seasonal astrological cycle.

name: Astronomical Device
description: A laboratory Feature: a tool for measuring the heavens such as an astrolabe or armillary sphere, providing Intellego and Vim Specializations.

name: Asturia
description: Where the Dragon-Maiden lives in a cave.

name: Astuth
description: Verditius full member of Verdi, aged 93.

name: Athenaeus
description: Second-century author of Edicts of Augustus.

name: Atlantium
description: One of the six known lands of Arcadia: the land under the sea.

name: Atlax of Tytalus
description: Fudarus magus who read the Redcap Camille's messages.

name: Atoms
description: Four varieties of uncuttable building blocks of the universe (earth, water, air, fire), each with two qualities.

name: Atrox of Tytalus
description: Magus of House Tytalus who invented the Unsubtle Knife; his sigil makes messages and errors appear in blood.

name: Atsingani Tradition
description: A Byzantine tradition of wandering sorcerers, seers and healers who once served the Emperor Constantine IX.

name: Attica
description: Region ravens flew from, per Pliny.

name: Attract the Doomed Victim
description: Each uisge power (MuMe 30) lessening a victim's caution so they climb onto its back.

name: Atzilut
description: Highest of the Four Worlds (Emanation), the eternal Divine realm.

name: Aubert
description: Bishop of Avranches who built the chapel on Mont St. Michael; his relics include a skull holed by the archangel.

name: Aubeterre-sur-Dronne
description: Town with a monolithic church.

name: Auditor litterarum contradictarum
description: Papal official who receives appeals to petitions and arbitrates compromises.

name: Augustina filia Ragoneda
description: Maga listed in the index, filia of Ragoneda.

name: Augustinian Order
description: Religious order of which the legate James is a member.

name: Aura (Duration)
description: Faerie ritual Duration lasting while the target remains within a supernatural aura; equivalent to Year.

name: Aura Effect Table
description: Table giving Personality Trait adjustments of +1 to +3 by aura level for emotion-enhancing auras.

name: Aura Strengthening Table
description: Table rolled when the yearly aura modifier is +4 or more, with outcomes from new regio levels to permanent aura increase.

name: Aura Variation
description: Rules by which a Magic aura's current score deviates from its base score due to magical activity and impinging foreign auras.

name: Aura Weakening Table
description: Table rolled when the yearly aura modifier is -4 or less, with outcomes from vanished regio levels to permanent aura decrease.

name: Aura of Beguiling Appearance
description: A Muto Imaginem spell (MuIm 10) variant of Aura of Ennobled Presence that makes the target appear more friendly and credible, granting +3 to win trust and to Charm-based Defense Totals.

name: Aura of Enobled Presence
description: Effect wrongly believed bestowed permanently by the Holy Oil.

name: Aura of Inconsequence
description: ReMe 25 spell deflecting casual attention from the recipient, inspired by Veil All Eyes.

name: Aura of Reason
description: Aura growing from learning and rational thought in Florence, Bologna, Palermo and Literatus, a threat to magic.

name: Aura of Rightful Authority Pendant
description: A bejeweled golden pendant crafted by Stentorius and worn by his familiar Oswald, imbued with multiple uses of Aura of Rightful Authority and other effects.

name: Aura of the Ennobled Presence
description: Spell Alexander the Lame casts to retard aging.

name: Auram Resistance
description: Quality and Ability of storm giants.

name: Auram province
description: The Auram-aligned province of the Twilight Void: misty and electric, clouds and smoke shine white and can be walked upon.

name: Aurelia
description: Parens of Latrunculus.

name: Aurelian
description: Roman emperor from 270, son of a Sol priestess, who proclaimed Deus Sol Invictus the official deity and built a temple and college in Rome.

name: Aureliana
description: Founding maga of Atsingani from the Byzantine Atsingani tradition, who led her group west from the Theban Tribunal.

name: Aurelius Ambrosius
description: Brother of Uther Pendragon who defeated Vortigern and the Saxons and had Merlin bring the Giant's Dance to Britain; slain by treachery.

name: Aurochs
description: Large, powerful wild cattle of Scandinavia, symbol of Uruz; can be summoned by rune spells.

name: Aurulentus
description: Magus of House Jerbiton, several of whose forefathers were Gifted.

name: Ausculator
description: A famous living representative of House Guernicus's earth-magic tradition, leader of the covenant of Hedyosmos in the Theban Tribunal.

name: Auspicious Shape
description: A Minor laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab is formed into a magically beneficial shape such as a hexagon or pentagram, granting +1 Aesthetics and +1 Vim.

name: Austringer
description: A specialist falconer who trains non-falcons such as hawks.

name: Autodictation
description: A Rego Terram 15 spell that lets a magus write by talking, inscribing a metal stylus across prepared wax boards as he speaks.

name: Autumn Tenens
description: Tenens Occultorum overseeing the Roman, Rhine and Greater Alps Tribunals.

name: Autumnus
description: A powerful Autumn covenant housed in a single enormous magically warmed building atop a mountain peak, ruled by a council of its four oldest magi and protecting a smaller covenant in another Tribunal.

name: Autun
description: Great Roman city in Burgundy with the Cathedral of St. Lazarus.

name: Auvekoejaks
description: Vicious tribe of northern merfolk, minions of Tursus, seal or walrus from the waist down, who never run out of javelins.

name: Auvergne Fire Elemental
description: Powerful fire elemental dwelling deep underground, source of hot springs.

name: Auxerre
description: Holy city with the Abbey of St. Germanus.

name: Avallon
description: Walled hilltop town with a relic of St. Lazarus.

name: Avarice
description: One of the capital vices, opposed by a holy temper.

name: Avebury
description: A village within the largest of many mysterious monuments, a stone circle about a thousand feet across with banks, ditches, inner circles and avenues said to lead somewhere not of this world on particular days.

name: Avenging Angels
description: Angels in Mathey.

name: Avenue
description: The process of spiritual awakening, purification, and testing by which a Criamon magus reaches a new station, requiring a Lore score, a trial or investiture, and insight from a story.

name: Averna of Tytalus
description: Corporeal necromancer who fought the Diedne at the Mendip site during the Schism War, leaving undead guardians.

name: Averroes
description: A twelfth-century Islamic scholar who refuted al-Ghazali's claims in his book The Incoherence of the Incoherence.

name: Avranches
description: Small county and diocesan town on Normandy's border with Brittany.

name: Awaken the Leafy Warders
description: InHe 35 spell of Whitburh's making plants notify the caster of specified events.

name: Awakened Items
description: Magical devices that become magic things through lab accidents or exposure to the Magic Realm.

name: Awkward Shape
description: A Minor laboratory Structure Flaw: the chamber is a difficult shape, long and thin or partitioned (-2 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Axe
description: Single weapon dealing slashing damage.

name: Axinomancy
description: Divinatory method using balancing a hatchet, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Axior
description: A martial magus of House Flambeau and founding member of Oculus Septentrionalis who disagreed over its site and founded Terschelling (later Waddenzee) instead; killed in a magical accident.

name: Ay
description: Ancient Gaulish vintners' town with a royal residence.

name: Aymeric of St. Maur
description: English Templar commander (1200-1220), envoy to King John; ordered construction of a massive mill in London.

name: Azay-le-Rideau
description: Village near cave settlements; a valley south of it has a level 4 Magic aura and Aquam vis.

name: Azenis of Tytalus
description: Author of The Dismal Itch.

name: Ba'al Shem (companion)
description: Companion template of an itinerant Ba'al Shem tinker working wonders around Bremen.

name: Baba Yaga
description: Figure whom a hero may be forbidden to speak to in a typical interdiction.

name: Babenbergs
description: Ruling family of Austria and Styria, descended from Marchio Liutpoldos.

name: Babhan Sith
description: An unseelie solitary fairy woman who lures men into a glamoured dance in a moorland shieling and drinks their blood.

name: Babylon the great is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils
description: Debauchery/Psychomachia 15 tarnishing an Infernal aura.

name: Bad Reputation
description: Flaw appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Badakhshan
description: Single source of lapis lazuli.

name: Baggage Train
description: The army's support of cooks, clerks, wives, priests, surgeons and armorers; one unit needed per ten units, and attacking it gives a bad Reputation.

name: Baha' al-Din ibn Shaddad
description: Friend and biographer of Saladin (d. 1234).

name: Bailli
description: Professional royal bureaucrats appointed by Philip II to administer bailliages in Normandy and Anjou.

name: Baillia
description: Revenue districts of English Templar holdings.

name: Baker
description: A covenfolk template for a returned faerie changeling who bakes faerie-style, with Free Expression and Lesser Purifying Touch.

name: Balaam
description: Figure to whom Michael appeared (Numbers 22).

name: Balaam's ass
description: Biblical animal cited as one God chose to imbue with a soul.

name: Balastor
description: A feral journeyman of House Criamon at Fengheld who seeks enlightenment by returning to a primal state; his Warped Magic gives him a savage cast, and his philosophy aligns with the Hawthorn Gild.

name: Balder
description: Son of Odin whose funeral can be witnessed in Elysium.

name: Baldwin I
description: The first Count of Flanders, exiled in 862 for marrying Judith, who fought the magical bear at the site of Brugge.

name: Baldwin II
description: Built a stone castle at Ghent.

name: Baldwin Ironarm
description: First Count of Flanders (866) who built Bruges's castle.

name: Baldwin V of Flanders
description: Co-regent for Philip I.

name: Balearic Islands
description: An independent taifa in 1220 with megalithic structures and a former temple to Mercury.

name: Balento
description: A ninth-century Verditius magus convinced he was a direct descendant of Vulcan, who focused on fire magic and founded the Confraternity of Balento.

name: Balkan Peninsula
description: Region whose people have traditions analogous to Sin-Eating.

name: Ball of Abysmal Music
description: A Muto Imaginem 20 spell, reputedly Pendule's favorite, that targets a formulaic Ignem spell mid-cast and turns its fire into a harmless burst of color and sound.

name: Ball of Abyssal Flame
description: Fire spell used by Gravis to slay Talus and to attack Dominicus.

name: Ball of Light Ignem Vis
description: Glowing ball of vis providing illumination.

name: Ballista
description: A large arbalest mounted on a frame, used as a sniper weapon and to launch ropes over walls.

name: Balls of Bladud
description: Local will-o-the-wisps.

name: Balmung
description: Siegfried's sword, with which Kriemhild decapitates Hagen in the Nibelungenlied.

name: Balneator
description: Merry Devil lord encouraging conspiracy and fornication in the baths; Infernal Might 25.

name: Balthasar
description: One of the Three Wise Men whose body lies in the Shrine of Kings at Cologne Cathedral.

name: Baltic Coast
description: Coast along which Pomerania's major settlements lie, distant from the Cursewood.

name: Balvina
description: Clare's niece who moved from Arezzo in 1214 to become abbess of Vallegloria, Spello.

name: Bamr
description: Hybrid, larger-than-human phantasticum form within which sleepwalkers are cloaked.

name: Banco
description: Dean of the Goldsmith's Guild of Rome and member of the Savelli family, a skilled maker of wondrous goods who secretly seeks to learn how to make genuine Hermetic magic items.

name: Bandinus of Siena
description: Papal corrector in 1220, a deacon.

name: Bane of the Elves
description: PeVi 15 spell known by Bartholomew.

name: Banish the Unwelcome Guest
description: Truffle Matron's power to expel anyone from the regio by command, if it penetrates.

name: Banishment from Tribunal
description: Punishment requiring a magus to leave a Tribunal's area and find another residential Tribunal.

name: Banner of Winter
description: Artifact the Dachstein giants desire, letting them travel in the summer lands for extended periods.

name: Banshee
description: Irish faerie and ghost of a woman who sings the death lament for her descendants and grants a wish to anyone claiming to be her foster child.

name: Baptismal font
description: Font in parish churches; baptism there grants a Faith Point.

name: Baptismal font of St. Brendan
description: Hibernian variant replacement for the xoanon, with the same powers; an ideal cathach.

name: Baptismal name
description: Name received at baptism that cannot be used as a Sympathetic Connection.

name: Bar Shasketh
description: Jewish degree of Hell, the Pit of Destruction.

name: Baraka
description: Blessing sought by Muslims at the tombs of holy forbears.

name: Baraqiel
description: An angel named in some lists of the archangels.

name: Barb
description: Horse from North Africa, Muslim Iberia or the Levant that makes a fine courser or destrier.

name: Barbarus
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Barberà
description: Castle donated to the Templars in Aragon.

name: Barbican
description: Works limiting access to the gatehouse, including walls, portcullises and murder holes.

name: Barcas
description: Example magical giant (Might 16 Terram), a boastful wrestler nearly invulnerable to metal except for a spot below his sternum; based on Ferragus.

name: Barcelona Street
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city.

name: Bard, the God of Snaefell
description: Icelandic legend figure.

name: Bardney Abbey
description: The abbey to which Saint Oswald's bones were transferred; a heavenly light over the cart at the gates showed the monks they should welcome the foreign king's relics.

name: Baresarks
description: Coenwulf's unarmored band of six men and one woman who pride themselves on ferocity.

name: Barfleur
description: Harbor town where William's invasion fleet was built, haunted by maritime ghosts including a spectral fleet.

name: Bargaining with Demons
description: The dangerous practice of trading with summoned demons for aid.

name: Bark of Doom
description: Power of the cu sith: if the dog barks three times at a person, death soon follows.

name: Barnabé
description: Arrogant grog cursor trained to run for seisin trials.

name: Barnenez tumulus
description: Tumulus with 11 chambers.

name: Baron of Montverte
description: Mundane lord of Montverte castle, unwittingly controlled by the covenant's magi.

name: Barontel
description: Ex Miscellanea member of Sansaron.

name: Bartholomew of House Merinita
description: Merinita magus of the Devil's Lane Covenant.

name: Bartholomew of Mercere
description: Redcap acquitted of stealing a staff from Errantus but fined for injuring him.

name: Bartholomew's Laboratory
description: A tiny faerie regio (Faerie aura 8) reached by a spiral stairway from Julia's laboratory, where the senile Bartholomew dozes by the fire.

name: Bascinet
description: Late medieval fitted helmet with visor.

name: Base Aura Score
description: The aura score generated by a site's tethers: the natural aura score plus the preternatural aura score.

name: Basilica (Temple of Mercury)
description: A three-storied domed building of offices that housed administrators for the Cult of Mercury and the legionary garrison, including the Salary, Library, Correspondence, Municipal and Scrying Offices.

name: Basilica of Saint John Lateran
description: Cathedral of Rome and papal seat holding the heads of Peter and Paul.

name: Basilica of St. Benedict
description: White-stone basilica at Fleury finished in 1218.

name: Basilica of St. Denis
description: Royal abbey church north of Paris, the first in the new French style, housing royal tombs and the Oriflamme.

name: Basilica of St. Martin
description: Pilgrimage basilica in Tours where St. Martin is interred.

name: Basilica of the Holy Blood
description: Bruges church housing a reliquary of the Blood of Christ.

name: Basilicus
description: A Primus of House Ex Miscellanea, a Hermetic Haruspex with prophetic abilities, who seized control before the Schism War and re-instituted the Council of Four.

name: Basingwerk Abbey
description: Abbey associated with Henricus and Abbot Gilbert, sources of the Tractatus.

name: Basque Country
description: Region in Iberia home of the Basajauns.

name: Bassianus
description: The rector of Montpellier striving to raise the reputation of its Faculty of Arts against the dominant Faculty of Medicine.

name: Bastard
description: Minor Social Status Flaw: an illegitimate child whose father does not recognize him.

name: Bastard Sword
description: Late-medieval sword usable one- or two-handed.

name: Bastard Sword Attack
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Bath Abbey
description: The Norman cathedral priory of Bath, still called Bath Abbey by locals, operated by around 40 monks and running the baths.

name: Baths (Temple of Mercury)
description: A ruined Roman bathing complex with pools of different temperatures, heated by furnace and underfloor venting and supplied by the aqueduct.

name: Baths of Alaron
description: One of Bath's three main baths, named for Bladud's consort or for Latin inscriptions; renamed the King's Bath in 1225.

name: Baths of Bladud
description: Possible fourth, hidden set of baths deep underground lit by Bladud's ceaseless fires, whose waters suppress the Gift's social effects.

name: Bathtub Cross
description: Bronze cross made from Christ's bathtub, which heals and brings rain.

name: Battering Ram
description: Siege weapon treated as a bludgeon; used against castle doors with a stress check.

name: Battle Abbey
description: A Benedictine abbey founded by William the Conqueror on the site of the Battle of Hastings, its high altar marking where Harold died.

name: Battle Axe Attack
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Battle Axe Parry
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Battle Ease Factor
description: Target for battlefield events: Engaged 9, Advantage or Setback 12, Imminent Victory or Defeat 15.

name: Battle of Alesia
description: Caesar's defeat of Vercingetorix.

name: Battle of Châlons
description: 451 battle in which Romans, Franks and Visigoths defeated the Huns.

name: Battle of Dyrrachium
description: Battle against the Byzantine Empire in which Sikelgaita rallied fleeing troops.

name: Battle of Grissors
description: Battle where English spears turned French cavalry.

name: Battle of Hastings
description: 1066 battle leading to the Norman conquest of England.

name: Battle of Hattin
description: Humiliating Christian defeat leading to the loss of Jerusalem.

name: Battle of Loch Oadh
description: Battle where Pralix's forces were separated during the war against Damhan-allaidh.

name: Battle of Poitiers
description: Charles Martel's victory in 732.

name: Battle of Tours
description: 732 victory by Charles Martel over an Islamic army.

name: Battle of the Bloody Glen
description: Battle of August 815 where Damhan-allaidh was wounded.

name: Battle of the Great Light
description: Final battle in 816 where a false sun lit the sky and Pralix defeated Damhan-allaidh.

name: Battle of the Standard
description: 1138 battle where Archbishop Thurstan defeated David.

name: Batz
description: Island.

name: Baumesel
description: A malicious wood-spirit used to frighten children, which attacks lone travelers in the woods.

name: Bautzen
description: The only place in Lusatia with real German influence, site of the 1018 Peace of Bautzen, where the Knights of the Sword maintain a fortification holding slaves before transport to Prague.

name: Bavacum
description: Roman ruins at a seven-road junction with Magic aura 3 and journey-shortening roads.

name: Bavarian Alps
description: Region where the Motherhouse and Sinews of Knowledge lie, and where five chapter houses were created after the fall of Highest Aspiration.

name: Bavarian Illuminati
description: Adam Weishaupt's later group, a connotation to avoid.

name: Bay of Naples
description: Bay on which Lake Avernus lies.

name: Bay of Troubled Souls
description: Bay of shipwrecks.

name: Bayeux Cathedral
description: Cathedral in Bayeux storing the tapestry.

name: Bean King
description: The king of revels chosen by finding a hidden bean or trinket in a treat; dark faeries may hunt wandering bean kings.

name: Bean Nighe
description: Washerwoman faerie of Scotland and Ireland seen washing the bloody clothes of one soon to die.

name: Bear Clan
description: A clan of Crintera composed of its largest and fiercest warriors, traditionally berserkers who fight with maces; their leader Dietrich can sense shape-changers.

name: Beast Master Tradition
description: A tradition within House Ex Miscellanea able to call and command animals; Luna initially trained in it.

name: Beast Qualities
description: Features of animals affecting capabilities, from Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults.

name: Beating the Boundaries
description: Procession in which a militia patrols its community and teaches new members the borders of its protectorate.

name: Beauseant
description: The sacred black and white Templar banner; while raised no Templar may retreat.

name: Beauvoir
description: Small chartered forest community in Normandy.

name: Beaver of Virtue
description: A gentle magical beaver whose testicles have medicinal properties and whose teeth can cut down trees.

name: Become a Being of Magic
description: MuCo(Vi) 50 Mystery Effect of the Great Elixir transforming the magus into a magical creature.

name: Bee King Virtue
description: A variety of Strong Faerie Blood granting agelessness until death at 100, command and understanding of bees, and immunity to insect stings.

name: Beech Amulet of Luck
description: Circular spider-web amulet woven from Enriched branches of a Beech Tree of Virtue; the wearer is treated as having the Luck Virtue.

name: Bees of Virtue
description: Magical bees spontaneously generated from rotting cattle carcasses, forming a model society ruled by a king.

name: Beghard
description: A man living chastely following the beguine lifestyle.

name: Beghards
description: Male equivalents of the Beguines.

name: Beguinage of Saint Elizabeth
description: Very substantial beguinage in Ghent enclosed by ditches and a wall.

name: Behemoth
description: Great beast whose carved shape gives +3 great size.

name: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep
description: Purity Transcendence effect (Level 50) letting the caster go a year without sleep.

name: Beit ha-midrash
description: School attached to a synagogue focused on Hebrew literacy.

name: Belaquin
description: Covenant in Provence whose grog sold Angela a club of faerie-forest wood.

name: Belas Knap
description: A long barrow with a stone-blocked doorway that is said to open on significant nights, allowing access to a faerie palace from which no one returns.

name: Belial
description: One of the Maskim, Commander of the Vessels of Iniquity and Prince of Darkness, spirit of hatred, deception and error; Hell's prelate, equated with the Antichrist.

name: Belinda
description: A Redcap who has traveled further east than any other and reported a vast magical city ruled by wise old magi at the fringes of the Order.

name: Belinus
description: A legendary king of Britain who, with his brother Brennius, sacked Rome and brought back a hoard of treasure possibly including magical texts.

name: Belisarius
description: General whose troops sacked Naples; Guorna claimed to raise the dead of that sack.

name: Bell Flower
description: Bell-shaped stone flower supporting Confluensis magi's residences.

name: Bell and Staff of St. Mungo
description: Relics carried north by a fleeing abbot rather than being handed to the bishop.

name: Bell and staff of the founding ab
description: Relics proving ownership of a Scottish monastery and focusing its Dominion aura.

name: Bellaquin
description: Provençal covenant that followed Literatus' example of joining mundane and magic.

name: Belle-ile
description: Largest Breton island.

name: Bellephon of Prague
description: Disciple of the Worm devoured by maggots in 1034 while the Quaesitors questioned him.

name: Bellow
description: Maze Beast power penalizing Quickness rolls of listeners.

name: Bells of Speyer
description: The bells of Speyer's cathedral that toll without mortal hand on the occasion of an imperial death; they refused to toll for the excommunicated Henry IV until his absolution.

name: Belomancy
description: Divinatory method using shooting arrows in the air, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Beltaine
description: Rituals that can hex practitioners of magic, including magi lax in renewing their Parma Magica outside their Aegis.

name: Beltane Fire Festivals
description: Irish fire festivals that dispel minor Hermetic enchantments and curse witches, forcing the Gifted behind the Aegis of the Hearth.

name: Belvilia
description: Place near Assisi where Elias Bonibarone was born.

name: Ben Nevis
description: Tallest mountain in Scotland.

name: Bene Elohim
description: Sons of God who gave rise to the Nephilim.

name: Benedictine Abbey of Hersfeld
description: Abbey near Hersfeld whose monks recorded the flying dog as a miracle.

name: Benedictine Monks
description: Monks following the Benedictine model whose wilderness monasteries created allodial Church land.

name: Benefactor
description: A sponsor who agrees to buy a single piece of artwork from an artist; gaining one grants 3 Artist Reputation experience points.

name: Benjamin of Tudela
description: 12th-century traveler from Navarre to Jerusalem who recorded Jewish communities and wrote the Sefer ha-Masa'ot.

name: Berechiah ben Natronai haNakdan
description: A Jewish scribe and author of Oxford (born 1162), secretly a highly skilled natural magician considering contact with the Order to defend the Jews.

name: Berenger
description: An example fellow alchemist, less skilled than Martin, who learns the cement formula from Martin's Laboratory Text and tractatus.

name: Berenguer of Tytalus
description: Magus acquitted of molesting the fay after rescuing his apprentice from faeries.

name: Bergen
description: Port from which Hadrianus sailed.

name: Bergenland
description: Region listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Beriyah
description: Second of the Four Worlds (Creation), associated by Hermetic magi with the Magic realm.

name: Bernard
description: Young novice in the aligned aura example, made more cowardly by a fear aura.

name: Bernard Vigilante de Vida
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Bernard of Quintavalle
description: Founder member of the Franciscans whom player characters may meet.

name: Bernard of Trémélay
description: Grand Master (1152-1153).

name: Bernard, Bishop of Puy
description: Uncle of Peter of Montaigu.

name: Bernice of Thessalonica
description: The maga who was Flavius of Jerbiton's teacher, collected him from the Alps, and negotiated with Trianoma to bring Eastern Empire magi into the Order; she died in 763 before the First Tribunal.

name: Bernicia
description: Saxon kingdom whose capital was Bamburgh.

name: Bernoni
description: Shadow Senator doubting the Senate's leadership.

name: Berthe
description: Abbess of Fontrevrault in 1220, in charge for two years.

name: Berthold IV
description: Zähringer who founded Fribourg in 1157.

name: Berthold V, Duke of Zähringen
description: Founder of Berne in 1191, who named it after a bear he killed.

name: Bertram de Gurdun
description: Crossbowman who shot Richard at Chalus.

name: Bertrand de Born
description: Troubadour with supernatural musical gift.

name: Bertrand of Blanquefort
description: Grand Master (1156-1169).

name: Berwick
description: Royal burgh and mint.

name: Bestiarius
description: School of Beasts used by Bjornaer, substituting Heartbeast for Finesse.

name: Bestiary
description: A medieval book about the characteristics and behavior of beasts, attributing remarkable powers to animals.

name: Besting the Challenge
description: Summa on Area Lore: Cursewood by Regulus, Level 3 Quality 9.

name: Beth Din
description: Rabbinic court hearing cases under halakhic law, led by the Rosh Beth Din.

name: Bethoc
description: Daughter and heir of Donald Ban torn apart by her own hunting dogs.

name: Betraying Whispers of the Jealous Mind
description: An InMe 30 spell that lets the caster hear, as muffled repeated whispers, the dominant emotions other people hold concerning him as they come within earshot.

name: Beuthen
description: A Polish town with a lead mine operated by the demon Szarlen in return for services under a demonic arrangement.

name: Bezalel
description: Craftsman who built the Ark, with profound understanding of creation through Hebrew letters.

name: Beziers
description: Site of a massacre in the Albigensian Crusade.

name: Bia
description: The Daimon of force, power, and compulsion, daughter of Styx and Pallas, who with her sister Peitho represents forceful inducement.

name: Biarg spirits
description: Healing/protective spirits to whom ond (Creo, Corpus or Vim vis) is offered; one sustains Asta's daughter.

name: Bibliotheca Historica
description: Work by Diodorus Siculus describing Egyptian shapechangers who carried books to Thebes.

name: Bielowezca Forest
description: A forest in Poland where Ulf's ancestor Lupercus haunts in the form of an immense wolf Great Beast.

name: Bielowiezca
description: A forest in whose region the example Bjornaer magus Ulf drives out a village of hunters and becomes leader of the largest wolf-packs as part of his Great Beast's trials.

name: Big Angus
description: A prize fighter whom no one has ever beaten in bare-knuckle fighting; in a story seed, grogs can win back lost money by defeating him.

name: Big and Little Harcar
description: Islands with Magic aura 2; Big Harcar is a level 4 vestige tethered to Leviathan and the site of many wrecks.

name: Big and Little Scarcar
description: Two rock pillars in the inner Farnes with a narrow gut where a small boat can be moored safely.

name: Binah
description: Sefirah meaning 'Insight', level 8 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 8.

name: Bind The Gift
description: A Rego Vim 30 enchanted effect in Philippus Niger's Wizard's Bridle that prevents the casting of any spells of level 25 or below as a constant effect.

name: Bind the Devil's Hands
description: PeVi Gen hindering Infernal Powers in a room.

name: Bind the Living Ghost
description: Cr(Pe/Re)Me(Co) Mystery Ritual defining a Living Ghost's Haunt, destroying the body and binding the spirit.

name: Bind the Mystical Structure
description: ReVi Mystery Ritual linking the component devices of a Hermetic Architecture enchantment into one working whole.

name: Bind the Wound
description: CrCo 10 spell known by Edwin.

name: Binding the Gift
description: A Minor House Mystery (Virtue) taught by Merinita that lets a magus share his Gift's social quality through the familiar cords, moderating the Gift's penalties via the Golden, Silver, Bronze Gifts and the three cords.

name: Binding the Immortal Memory
description: CrMe Mystery enchantment that binds studied experience into an immortal's talisman at level 10 x XP.

name: Binding the Magic Spirit
description: ReVi 51 effect in Regulus' Tablet binding a Magic being in a circle.

name: Biorn Egilsson
description: Old galdraman and leader of the galdramen hreppur, slain by Julius on the Night of Tears after requesting a dialog in Latin.

name: Birchwood wand
description: Wand serving as a young Tremere magus's sigil, used to ignite the funeral pyre.

name: Bird Dog
description: Dog trained for hawking; the best come from Iberia and are called espagnols or spaniels.

name: Bird Women
description: Faeries forced to be spouses when their feather cloaks are stolen.

name: Birkebeiners
description: Norwegian political group ('birchfeet') that supported the northern kings in forty years of civil war.

name: Birth Apparitions
description: Visions or supernatural beings that appear at the birth of important people with realm-linked Virtues or Flaws.

name: Birthing Faerie
description: Threshold faerie attracted by a pregnant mother.

name: Bishop Adam
description: Bishop of Caithness, possibly a faerie, found as a baby in a basket and killed over a butter tax.

name: Bishop Orris
description: Churchman from Antagonists representing the Church's strong distrust of magic and the Order.

name: Bishop Werner of Straussburg
description: Ancestor of the Hapsburgs who built the castle of Hapsburg in the 11th century.

name: Bishop of Bayeux
description: Bishop who wielded a mace at the Battle of Hastings.

name: Bishop of Mende
description: Bishop who is also Count of Gévaudan, holding the Majaridas for the French crown.

name: Bishop of Orléans
description: Feared not all Orléans heretics had been captured.

name: Bishop of Toul
description: Ordered all Waldensians chained and tried in 1192.

name: Bishop's Platter
description: A wondrous silver serving tray made by a silversmith that copies the spell Taste of the Spices and Herbs (Craft Level 13).

name: Bishop's Quarter
description: South-east corner of Bath containing the palace, priory and baths.

name: Bishop-baron
description: A bishop who is also a feudal lord, typically with about 50 vassal knights, entangled in feudal disputes and warfare against canon law.

name: Bitter Taste of Betrayal
description: InVi 15 spell giving a bitter taste when the caster's Parma is penetrated by new magic.

name: Bjorn Ironside
description: A deputy of Waddenzee who is the ship's master of the Nebelkönigin.

name: Bjornaer Septs
description: Divisions within House Bjornaer.

name: Black Boar Tusks
description: Enriched tusks of the Black Boar that grant Berserk to their bearer in battle.

name: Black Boar of the Bog
description: Beast of Virtue, a huge black boar with Magic Might 20 guarding a swampy wood; powers Protect the Herd and Terror of the Charging Boar.

name: Black Book
description: Sacred Yezidi text.

name: Black Cat Wards
description: Group of protective powers used by Black Cats to defend homes or settlements from minor faeries and demons.

name: Black Dog Hide Cowl
description: Cowl from a Black Dog's Enriched hide granting Puissant Stealth.

name: Black Dogs
description: Class of solitary black hounds known throughout northern Europe under many names, wrongly thought Infernal.

name: Black Forest Road
description: The only road across the Black Forest, built by the Roman 8th legion under Cornelius Clemens between Strassburg and Augsburg, with magical milestones warding away supernatural denizens.

name: Black Horseman
description: Demon of the third seal bearing balances.

name: Black Mark
description: Splinter Criamon society believing the Dominion will destroy all magic; possibly Infernally inspired. La murdered a priest under its precepts.

name: Black Serpent of the Barrow
description: A serpent dwelling in a barrow on the Mournful Mound that kills the sons of the King of Suffering daily and carries a wish-granting gold stone in its tail; slain by Peredur.

name: Black Truffle
description: Purplish-black truffle growing on oak and hazel roots in Normandy, Provence and Iberia, best in Périgord.

name: Blackberry Cat
description: Cat power, also called Feigned Innocence, making a group forget something the cat did.

name: Blackberry God
description: A powerful faerie harvest deity worshipped in the Worshipful covenant's regio; the magi side with him as a Faerie Landlord and provide him vast amounts of beer.

name: Blacklisting
description: Informal House Mercere sanction in which Redcaps refuse to recognize a covenant or magus, losing records and messages.

name: Blackrose
description: Covenant founded by Blackthorn in 1104 on the North York Moors near Voluntas; recalled in 1107 after persistent mundane troubles.

name: Blacksmith's Son
description: Sample seven-year-old grog, a bully with Magic Sensitivity and No Sense of Direction.

name: Blacksmithing
description: Ability listed in the text.

name: Blackthorn of Virtue
description: Tree whose 13 Enriched thorns grant a Magic-aligned Hex power usable once each; may instead be harvested for 2 pawns of Perdo vis.

name: Bladud's Library
