description: A secret cave library of magical lore gathered by Bladud, written in a lost language and invaluable to a covenant if found.

name: Bladud's enchanted wings
description: Wings that failed over the Temple of Apollo.

name: Blain
description: Place where two minor trade routes cross, with a small castle and busy market.

name: Blanca of Navarre
description: Mother and regent of Theobald IV, loyal to King Philip.

name: Blaringhem
description: Town in Flanders where Saint Ursmar's relics were humiliated in 1060.

name: Blatant Magic
description: Flaw gained through Extraction of the Soul.

name: Blautopf Pool
description: A deep-blue round pool at the southern edge of the Swabian Jura, source of the River Blau, with a Faerie aura and home to the water faerie Schöne Lau.

name: Bleeding Stone
description: Stone in a cavern below Lapis Crudus's council chamber, source of its name and of Corpus and Terram vis.

name: Blending with Substance
description: Enchantment letting a magus embed small items in his flesh for talisman attunement, at the cost of Warping.

name: Blessed Cyprian
description: Penitent magician who may perform a miracle to be recognized as a saint, long awaited by House Jerbiton.

name: Blessed Relief of the Benighted Reins
description: A Rego Corpus 25 spell that magically removes a kidney stone from a patient's body into the caster's hand, requiring an Intelligence + Finesse roll.

name: Blessing of Mercury
description: CrVi 30 ritual granting +3 to Casting and Laboratory totals for a Year.

name: Blessing of Urban Wisdom for the Rustic
description: GvBl 20 spell granting the target the Clear Thinker Virtue with a general Limit.

name: Blessing of the Swordsman's Expertise
description: GvBl 20 spell giving the target +2 to Single Weapon (or another Ability in variants) until a Limit is met.

name: Blight the Household
description: Fictiles Power spoiling food and blighting crops.

name: Blinding Reflection
description: Chalkydri power.

name: Blisters of Humility
description: Saint curse covering the target with boils for a week.

name: Blitild
description: Daughter of King Clothar claimed as ancestor by the Carolingians.

name: Block voting
description: Tremere practice of voting as a bloc at Tribunal via free proxies to the Tribune.

name: Blood Feud
description: Highland clan feud escalating from insults to full-scale raids.

name: Blood Haze
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw: the maga is crazed by bloodshed, penalizing Formulaic magic and Concentration in combat.

name: Blood Libel
description: Unfounded accusation that Jews practice human sacrifice.

name: Blood Oath of Becoming a Member of Ikhwan as-Safa'
description: Initiation Script granting Philosophical Refining and Weak Elementalist Resistance.

name: Blood of the Bee King
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue for children of Bee Kings: slower aging and the ability to give simple instructions to bees they touch.

name: Blood of the Sun
description: Listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Blood of the Telechines
description: Heritage granting +1 Dexterity and an extra Major Virtue (usually Ways of the Waters), with the Supernatural Nuisance Flaw.

name: Bloodcap Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety from bloodcaps granting a Strength bonus.

name: Bloodcap Faerie
description: Wicked, violent faeries of battlefields and ruined towers with long teeth and talons who dye their caps in their foes' blood.

name: Bloodline
description: Gruagach Target affecting a bloodline.

name: Bloodline Target
description: Hermetic target parameter usable by Merinita for inheritance spells.

name: Bloodstone of Virtue
description: Stone containing 1 pawn of Creo vis that, when Enriched, grants Rapid Convalescence while the bearer rests in bed.

name: Bloody Flux
description: A Serious Phlegmatic Disease (excess of phlegm) caused by cold, wet living conditions, common in towns and armies.

name: Bludgeon
description: Inexpensive crushing Brawl weapon.

name: Blue Springs of the Somme
description: Enchanted pools with Faerie auras up to 3 inhabited by mischievous water sprites.

name: Bluebeard
description: Faerie role of a handsome husband who turns hideous when his wife breaks a taboo and sees his victims' corpses.

name: Blunted Weapon
description: Slashing or piercing weapons blunted for tournaments, subtracting 3 from Damage.

name: Boar
description: Malicious, dangerous prey hunted from midsummer through autumn with a boar spear.

name: Boar Helm
description: Coenwulf's enchanted Saxon boar-crested helmet, his magical focus that changes with him.

name: Boar Tattoo
description: Example Give Blessing tattoo Dombnall creates for a Single Weapon bonus.

name: Boar of Virtue
description: Lesser Magic boars ridden by truffle drones and kept in the truffle fields, possessing The Unimpeded Traveler power.

name: Boaz
description: One of two great hollowed stone pillars ("great strength") of Solomon's temple legend that hold treasures of the ancient Hebrews.

name: Bocage
description: Norman practice of dividing fields with low stone walls into small allotments.

name: Bocan
description: A helpful type of Scottish faerie mentioned alongside brownies.

name: Body of Brass
description: Miser's Pot Power making it immune to fatigue and disease.

name: Body of Fire
description: Power of fire elementals.

name: Body of Stone
description: Stoneskinned power improving brawling statistics.

name: Body-of-water
description: Special Atlantean Target covering an entire lake, river or sea; equal to Structure.

name: Boggart
description: English trickster spirit causing havoc in the home; a brownie that has decided to be malicious.

name: Boglin
description: A foul, tentacled, primeval swamp spirit (Magic Might 25, Aquam) of northern Germany that lurks underwater, drags prey to its maw, and yields Animal and Perdo vis.

name: Bogomils
description: Dualist successors of the Manichees.

name: Bohemian Truffle
description: Above-ground truffle found in the Rhine, Greater Alps and Normandy Tribunals whose mature gel is a natural dye.

name: Bohemond, Count of Tripoli
description: Reclaimed Antioch in 1219; supported by the Templars.

name: Bohort
description: Informal, impromptu tournament with blunted or wooden weapons.

name: Boii Springs
description: Twelve hot mineral springs in western Bohemia near a Celtic settlement, including a 40-foot geyser; drinking the waters cures digestive disorders and the name derives from the Celtic Boii tribe.

name: Boiled Leather
description: Tough stiff armor material; cuir boulli is a variant.

name: Boiling River
description: River of sulfur and blood in Purgatory where traitors are thrown; it flows into the Mouth of Hell.

name: Boiteux
description: Mastiff son of Affreux and Anacrôn's Magical Animal Companion; pulls his trolley.

name: Bologna Way
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city.

name: Bolos of Mendes
description: Probable ultimate origin of Pseudo-Democritus' tradition, two centuries before Christ.

name: Boncompagno
description: The rector of Bologna's Faculty of Arts, a famous rhetorician proposing to erect a dedicated building to house the university's learning.

name: Bond
description: A Personality Trait expressing why and how strongly an agent is attached to a principal.

name: Bond Cords
description: The Bronze, Silver and Gold cords linking magus and familiar; Radislav also forged an Enigmatic cord.

name: Bondi
description: Icelandic free farmer.

name: Bone-Biting
description: Diedne-derived certamen technique of self-injury for strength.

name: Bones of St Martin
description: Healing relics at the Church of St Martin in Tours with Faith 4 and Divine Might 40.

name: Boni non valde
description: The not completely good, whose destination is the Earthly Paradise.

name: Boniface VIII
description: Vile diabolist Pope who duped Celestine V into resigning.

name: Bonisagus Quaesitor
description: Quaesitor attached to House Bonisagus who decides on banned research.

name: Bonisagus's Cave
description: Former shrine to Hermes in the Southern Alps where Bonisagus developed his theory and Parma Magica.

name: Bonosian heresy
description: Heresy teaching Mary had other children after Jesus, persisting into the eighth century.

name: Bonosus
description: Repudiated fifth-century bishop of Sardica who exiled himself to Veliki Brijun and initiated the Bonosian heresy.

name: Book Of Divine Works
description: Hildegard's summa on metaphysics and Theology.

name: Book of Enoch
description: Text quoted in this chapter.

name: Book of Instruction
description: A text written by Tytalus laying down arbitrary rules and seemingly random punishments for apprentices; the most hated object of a Tytalan apprentice, governing how to treat rather than train him.

name: Book of Jeremiah
description: Biblical book telling Jews to seek the well-being of where they live, justifying golem protectors.

name: Book of St. Peter
description: Book recording a person's thoughts and deeds for Judgment Day; analogy for tempora.

name: Book-Learner
description: Virtue appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Books of Visions
description: Elizabeth of Schönau's three volumes of visions, a Theology tractatus.

name: Books on the Miracles of St. Martin
description: Dominion Lore tractatus by Gregory of Tours.

name: Books that Scream in Pain
description: An Intellego Animal 25 spell with Herbam requisite that checks every book in a room for a physical or historical property; named for an early Durenmar librarian who made damaged books cry out.

name: Boon Works
description: Added days of labor theoretically performed out of love for the lord, who feeds laborers.

name: Boosted Casting
description: Mutantes mastery ability spending vis to increase spell parameters.

name: Boosting
description: Mutantum technique spending vis to increase a spell's Range, Duration, Target or size.

name: Borbygus of Verditius
description: A Verditius magus and Collegium member who secretly imprisons scholars to build a magical collection of 'realia' that serves as a living library on Intellego.

name: Bordeaux
description: A city in the Provençal Tribunal; Castra Solis is located several leagues south of it.

name: Bordeaux Street
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city.

name: Border lords
description: Lords between Scotland and England who will follow either king for a price.

name: Boreas
description: A ninth-century Flambeau magus, descended from Flambeau through Apromor's line, who created the cold-based School of Boreas to appeal to both major lineages of his House.

name: Born of Rock
description: Fimus's Power: a body of solid rock.

name: Bornholm
description: Baltic island contested by the King of Denmark and the Bishop of Lund.

name: Borrow the Eyes of Another
description: An Intellego Mentem spell letting the caster see through the eyes of a person to whom he has an Arcane Connection.

name: Borrow the Eyes of the Cat
description: GvSh 5 spell known by Conall, cast at Voice Range.

name: Borrow the Nose of the Hound
description: GvSh 3 spell turning the caster's nose into a hound's, granting +6 to smell-based Perception rolls.

name: Borrow the Wings of the Eagle
description: GvSh 10 spell turning the caster's arms into giant wings allowing flight as fast as a galloping horse.

name: Borrowers
description: Exotic traveling faerie wizards practicing the Ars Fabulosa who trade novel goods to faeries for blessings.

name: Bort-les-Orgues
description: Site of Rego and Imaginem vis.

name: Botanomancy
description: Divinatory method using burning sticks carved with questions, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Bougon Tumuli
description: Six hidden burial mounds forming an undiscovered pagan necropolis, likely haunted.

name: Boukoloi
description: First House Acclaim rank of magi Bonisagi ('cowherds').

name: Boulogne
description: Port and pilgrimage site where Claudius based his invasion of Britain.

name: Boulonnais Coast
description: Tame wilderness of interest to magi.

name: Bound Ghost
description: A Flaw that magically binds a ghost so it cannot leave the covenant, taken by the Ghostly Warden.

name: Bound to (Realm)
description: A Major Supernatural Flaw: the character cannot survive in the mundane world and must live in a supernatural aura of 5 or greater of a chosen realm to stay healthy.

name: Bound to (Role)
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw: the character is physically bonded to a device or place and suffers deprivation if separated from it; includes the effects of Unaging.

name: Boundary target
description: Spell target that can affect a well-defined parish or diocese.

name: Boundless
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab interior has unlimited space despite mundane outer limits, of non-Hermetic or faerie origin (+2 Warping).

name: Boundless Energy
description: Minor Child Virtue granting +3 to Fatigue rolls.

name: Boundless Wealth of the Oceans
description: CrAn 20 Ritual creating 3,000 pounds of identical pearls marked with the caster's sigil.

name: Bountiful Boundary's Splendid Aura
description: CrVi 99 Mystery enchantment increasing the Magical aura in a Boundary by +1 to a maximum of 6.

name: Bounty
description: Reward in vis offered by a senior Redcap for dealing with a threat to travel.

name: Bourges
description: Heavily fortified royal city south of the Loire and seat of an archbishopric.

name: Bovate
description: Land half the size of a virgate, used to supplement the income of families with other primary work.

name: Bovater
description: Peasant renting a bovate, often a miller, reeve, shepherd or manor servant.

name: Bow and Stable Hunting
description: Driven hunt in which mounted hunters flush game toward a line of archers.

name: Boðvar Bjarki
description: Norse folk hero whose hamr took the shape of a great white bear in battle.

name: Brabantine Mercenaries
description: Mercenaries employed in Richard Lionheart's paid army.

name: Brabançons
description: Disaffected mercenary brigands from Brabant, excommunicated by Alexander III, who form Atsingani's soldiery.

name: Brand
description: Village where a scholar killed a dragon.

name: Brandea
description: Containers and wrappings of original relics, themselves imbued with sanctity.

name: Brandenberg
description: Territory held by the descendants of margraves.

name: Brantôme
description: Abbey town with the Fountain of the Rock.

name: Branwen
description: A woman in her twenties at Cad Gadu, the only covenfolk member trying to reverse its decay by improving defenses and recruiting new magi.

name: Brass Head
description: Famous enchanted device built by Albertus Magnus and rumored smashed by Thomas Aquinas.

name: Break Time's Arrow
description: Pasiel's power moving a creature to a past state.

name: Break Wards
description: PeVi power of Gull's warhammer that dispels wards with successive strikes.

name: Break the body, bend the will / One can injure, one can kill
description: Incantation/Consumption 30 healing a target by wounding a victim.

name: Breaking the Captain's Baton
description: Spell (Magi of Hermes) turning trained soldiers into an untrained group.

name: Breaking the Shackles of Vulgar Perception
description: A spell of at least 5th magnitude invented by Primus Handri of Merinita that allows the target to perceive the world as the faeries do.

name: Breastplate of Manannan
description: Manannan's breastplate that no weapon can pierce, Protection +20, resizing to his forms.

name: Breath of Corruption
description: Revenant power exhaling disease.

name: Breath of the Angry Goddess
description: Dindyméné's power creating winds that trap ships at Bear Island.

name: Breath of the Bellows
description: Xaphan's Power making a metal item glow white-hot.

name: Breath of the Desert
description: Xaphan's Power blowing hot dry smoke that makes things tinder dry.

name: Breath of the Poisoned Land
description: Silver Lady power releasing arsenic breeze.

name: Brechin
description: Royal burgh and see.

name: Bregenz
description: Regional capital of Vorarlberg.

name: Breisgau
description: Zähringer center.

name: Brenner Pass
description: Most significant eastern pass.

name: Brest
description: Port.

name: Breton March
description: March in France that has since dissolved into smaller units.

name: Brew the Healing Tonic
description: A Rego Herbam 10 spell that combines raw ingredients into a restorative theriac giving +3 to Wound Recovery rolls, provided the caster has the formula.

name: Bricriu mac Carbada
description: An Irish poet/demigod claimed by some Ex Miscellanea as the progenitor of the Nemthengacha line of bitter-tongued sorcerers.

name: Bricriu's Glen
description: Irish glen containing the Cave of Cruachan.

name: Bricstan
description: A man of the Ely estate falsely accused of usury by Robert 'Malarteis', imprisoned in London, and miraculously freed by St. Benedict, St. Etheldreda, and St. Sexburga.

name: Bridge of Frost
description: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 30) that forms a thick layer of frost firm enough to walk on across the surface of a body of water.

name: Bridge of Secrets
description: Bridge near Beignon.

name: Bridge of St. Cloud
description: Old wooden bridge with a Magic aura of 2; any king who sets foot on it is said to die.

name: Bridge to Paradise
description: Knife-thin rock bridge over the Boiling River that is a regio boundary into the Earthly Paradise, widening for the repentant.

name: Bridle of the Talking Horse
description: A wondrous bridle made by a leather maker that allows a horse's rider to talk to his steed (Craft Level 17).

name: Brienz
description: Might 30 Aquam Daimon of Lake Brienz, reclusive and irritated by fish.

name: Brigandine
description: Late armor of small plates riveted to canvas or leather.

name: Brijuni Islands
description: Island group off Croatia in the northern Adriatic, an alternative Farne location.

name: Brilliance of the Eagle's Plumage
description: A CrIg 30 Spectacle-Target spell that blinds anyone looking directly at the caster with brilliant light.

name: Brimstone of Vim Vis
description: Brimstone vis that inflicts a Warping Point on contact.

name: Bring Down the Roof
description: Zwergenstimme power that collapses a cave roof, causing +20 damage and sealing the exit.

name: Bringing Ruin on One's Sodales
description: Hermetic crime charged against magi whose actions endanger the Order or other magi.

name: Bristol
description: A well-defended sea port surrounded by the rivers Frome and Avon and a royal castle, governed by a mayor and prospering chiefly on trade with Ireland.

name: Brit Milah
description: Jewish ritual circumcision and naming eight days after a boy's birth, with the same divine effect as baptism.

name: Brittle Bones
description: A Major Curse (Rego Corpus effect) making the victim's bones fragile, risking broken bones (treated as Heavy Wounds) during strenuous activity.

name: Broadsword Attack
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Brogo the Dwarf
description: A dwarf trouvère from Tournai with the Curse of Venus and Death Prophecy, a wandering composer presented as a starting companion-level character who has visited Hermetic covenants.

name: Broken Branches
description: A group of Redcaps united by love of nature, founded by a Loamwalker.

name: Broken Mirrors Vexillation
description: Vexillation founded by Albanus to investigate diabolism, treason or cowardice within House Tremere.

name: Broken Vessel
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw: the character's supernatural powers may be temporary, and rolling a zero on Stress Rolls for them costs experience points.

name: Brother Bonvicino
description: Papal chamberlain and Templar who will lead the flagellant movement.

name: Brother Haimard
description: Treasurer of the French Templars and the French Crown; plots to create wealth using Hermetic magic.

name: Brother Illuminato
description: Franciscan who accompanied Francis to meet the Sultan of Egypt.

name: Brother Paul of Bolzano
description: An Augustinian canon, once a petty thief, who died at the hands of diabolists; his severed head weeps tears containing Mentem vis on the anniversary of his conversion.

name: Brother-Knight (Templar)
description: Core Templar rank of noble birth wearing white mantles with red cross.

name: Brother-Priest (Templar)
description: Templar chaplain second in spiritual authority only to the pope.

name: Brother-Sergeant (Templar)
description: Subordinate Templar rank of common birth wearing black mantles.

name: Brother-Servants
description: Non-military brother-sergeants.

name: Brotherhood of Saint Lazarus
description: An order that, with House Jerbiton, maintains a leprosarium within an Immunity aura where covenfolk live long, healthy lives until they leave.

name: Brotherhood of the Black Mask
description: League of annoyed minor English nobles that robs and beats Italian priests given livings; a social movement without a leader.

name: Brown Wullie
description: Leader of six exiled rebel selkies on Brownsman Island who has stolen the selkie king's name.

name: Brownie Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety granting a bonus to Profession totals.

name: Brownsman Island
description: Outer island with Faerie aura 2 occupied by rebel selkies; joined to Staple Island at low water.

name: Brownsman's Gut
description: Channel separating Brownsman Island from Staple Island at high tide.

name: Broërec
description: Southern region.

name: Bruce
description: A hot-headed ruffian who attacks Paul first in a combat example.

name: Brude Mac Maelchon
description: Northern Pictish king baptized by St. Columba.

name: Brude son of Bile
description: Pictish king who consolidated North and South Picts 672-693.

name: Brude's Broch
description: Broch/tower in the far North on the northwest coast where Brude lives, near standing stones and a vis-rich island.

name: Brugge
description: A Flemish town and major power in the wool, weaving, and cloth industries, governed by elected officials and linked to the sea by the Zwin channel created by a sea dragon.

name: Brugge Bear
description: A ferocious bear that attacked Baldwin I at the site of Brugge, was magically transformed, joined his retinue, and became the first citizen of Brugge.

name: Bruise
description: Non-lethal damage causing Bruise Penalties, recovering faster than wounds.

name: Brunhilda
description: Henri de Tours' Swedish wife, a magical folk practitioner with the power of divination who can send her spirit in animal shape; not formally a member of the Order.

name: Brunswick
description: A Saxon city beautified by Henry the Lion, centered on a bronze lion statue (the Burglowe) and a fortress-shaped cathedral beside Burg Dankwarderode.

name: Bryn-Celli-Ddu
description: A mound on Anglesey with a chambered passage and a carved labyrinth warding stone; the place where Llewellyn, last primus of House Diedne, was last seen, and which Hermetic magi tend to avoid.

name: Bréhat Archipelago
description: Island group off Brittany's north coast, an alternative location for the Farne Islands.

name: Bréhat Isles
description: Isles with Magic aura 4.

name: Brünn
description: A castle and town at the confluence of the Svitava and Svratka rivers, seat of the Premyslid rulers in Moravia; once tormented by the Dragon of Brünn.

name: Bubastis
description: Ancient Egyptian city whose great queens were ancestors of the Black Lineage's founding cat.

name: Buchan
description: Northern Lowland region with many recumbent stone circles.

name: Buckler
description: Small shield of the high period.

name: Budapest
description: City near Lake Balaton.

name: Bufonite of Virtue
description: A Toad Stone containing 2 pawns of Intellego vis that, when Enriched, has a Lesser Power to detect poison by turning red.

name: Bugbear
description: Traditional bogeyman used to frighten children.

name: Builder's Helper
description: A wondrous miniature ladder that expands to 15 feet upon command and can be carried in a builder's pack (Craft Level 15).

name: Bukhara
description: Persian city near which Ibn Sina was born.

name: Bulcis
description: Master of both Buliste and Harpax.

name: Buliste of Tytalus
description: Magus who accused Camille of interfering with mundanes.

name: Bulla
description: Small gold charm inscribed with the master's name worn by apprentices; some are enchanted.

name: Bullatores
description: Chancery officials who hold the papal seal.

name: Bully
description: Minor Child Personality Flaw: compelled to pick on weaker others (Bully +3).

name: Burchwen
description: Saint Godric's sister, also a hermit, who according to Godric gave him his shortest hymn after she died.

name: Burg Trifels
description: An imperial fortress-palace atop the Sonnenberg at the edge of the Palatinate Forest, favored by Frederick Barbarossa, where Richard the Lionheart was imprisoned in 1193.

name: Burgenland
description: Land of castles on the tribunal border.

name: Burglar
description: A thematic covenfolk template thief with Great Dexterity x2 and high Legerdemain and Stealth, suited to covenants involved in Hermetic politics.

name: Burgrave
description: Keeper of a castle or fortified town, ranked as a viscount.

name: Burgundians
description: Tribe settled in what is now Savoy.

name: Burgundy Truffle
description: Dark brown truffle with hazelnut-like aroma found on oak and hazel roots across Mythic Europe.

name: Burkland, Count of Unspunnen
description: Count of Unspunnen and foe of the Zähringers who established annual games at Interlaken.

name: Burn
description: Obligatory Greater Power of fire elementals, damaging and igniting what touches them.

name: Burned and Buried Men
description: Persons saved from immolation or burial by magical creatures of Ignem or Terram, gaining Virtues like Drowned Men.

name: Burning Acorn Vexillation
description: Continuing Tremere vexillation of explorers seeking the leaders of House Diedne, governed by Umno.

name: Burning Acorns Vexillation
description: Tremere vexillation led by retired Primus Umno from 1218.

name: Burning Curse
description: Xaphan's Power granting a diabolist the ability to ignite a building.

name: Burning Flesh
description: A Major Curse (Rego Corpus effect) covering the victim in itching red splotches, requiring Stamina + Concentration rolls to do anything but scratch.

name: Burning Issue of the Day
description: A ReMe 30 spell that compels a target Group to repeat a piece of information (true or false) to everyone they meet for the spell's duration.

name: Bursar
description: Official combining cellarer and terrar in smaller houses, or keeping internal accounts in larger ones.

name: Burst of the Sweeping Flames
description: A Rego Ignem spell (Level 25) that causes a fire to explode outward along the ground as if blown, igniting anything in its path for +5 to +15 damage.

name: Burthred
description: Young man betrothed and married to Christina of Markyate, who refused him.

name: Burthulet
description: Frigid place.

name: Buss
description: A small, long, narrow seagoing ship descended from the Viking knarr, carrying around 20 tons and used for coastal trade and fishing.

name: Butatschah-iglis
description: A Swiss lake faerie pretending to be a demon: a vast amorphous sack covered in fire-beaming eyes that eats fish and fishermen, guarding a supposed gateway to Hell.

name: Butler
description: Nominally the king's wine steward, responsible for feeding the court.

name: Butterfly and Two-Pronged Fork
description: Ancestral Tremere symbols of Aita's priesthood and Pluto.

name: Buying a Chair
description: Alpine process by which a covenant pledges ten pawns of vis a year from a registered source to give a magus a vote at tribunal.

name: By His Works
description: CrMe 5 spell refreshing a memory in the caster, used to recall sigils perfectly.

name: By evening ash and morning dew I send your charms away from you
description: Incantation/Malediction 50 removing a Major Virtue.

name: Byzantine Priest
description: Companion template: a married Eastern priest born in Constantinople who fled its sack.

name: Béhuard Island
description: Loire island with an oratory over a sea-goddess shrine, where a Dominion aura swamps a level-2 Magic aura.

name: Cabal of the Golden Coin
description: Secret cabal, begun by Tytalus magi, that fixes the outcome of Hermetic Tourney contests to maximize prizes.

name: Caballer
description: Catalan vassal who rules a single castle.

name: Caballero
description: Iberian mounted warrior whose status depends on keeping his gear and serving in the field.

name: Caballero Villano
description: Caballero tied to a particular town who must live there and be ready to muster.

name: Caduceus
description: Symbol of Mercury/Hermes: a winged staff with entwined serpents.

name: Caelum
description: Faerie realm of air and stars, associated with stone alignments.

name: Caen
description: Town on the River Orne, William the Conqueror's effective capital, dominated by Caen Castle.

name: Caen Castle
description: Enormous fortress begun in 1060, recently extended by Philip II.

name: Caereidyn
description: Mynyddawg's seat, near Edinburgh.

name: Caerleon
description: Welsh site near which one faerie Camelot was found.

name: Caerwent
description: A place in Britain whose old lord imprisoned his young bride; the hawk-knight, father of Yonec, was killed there for love of the lady.

name: Caesar Tower
description: Square watchtower and prison in Provins.

name: Caesarea
description: Diocese in which Athlit is situated.

name: Caesarius of Arles
description: Author of the first regulations specifically for nuns in the early sixth century.

name: Cagair an t-Aile
description: Domnhull Beg's osprey familiar (Whisper of the Wind), who reads over his shoulder and loves courtly romances and Arthurian legend.

name: Cage of Change
description: An iron enchanted cage (CrVi 30) that gives a captive animal 5 Warping Points in hope it becomes monstrous and can be harvested for Muto vis.

name: Cagliari
description: Sardinian port near Verdi.

name: Cagoux
description: Master-thieves who enforce the King of the Beggars' edicts as his chief nobles.

name: Cailleach Bheur
description: The blue hag of Ireland and Scotland representing winter, guardian of streams and wells, who spreads her plaid over the land until summer.

name: Cairo
description: City where al-Husayn's head and al-Shafi'i are interred.

name: Cairo Way
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city.

name: Caithlinn
description: A maga of House Diedne of Oakdell covenant against whom Severus Maximus declared Wizard War in 1004 AD.

name: Caitlin Ex Miscellanea
description: Aindread's filia, a young polite maga who sometimes represents Burnham at tribunal and refuses all negotiations; has mismatched eyes.

name: Caitlin of Crun Clach
description: Major magus of the Loch Leglean Tribunal from the covenant of Crun Clach.

name: Calatrava
description: Fortress in Castile where the Order of Calatrava was founded.

name: Calc
description: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Chalk", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

name: Caledonian Forest
description: Primeval hardwood forest covering much of the Highlands.

name: Calgacus
description: Leader of the Caledonians killed at Mons Graupius in A.D. 84.

name: Caligula
description: Tiberius' heir who did not inherit the title Antistes Mercuria.

name: Caliph
description: Successor to the Prophet, religious and secular leader of the Muslim state; nominal head for Sunnis in Baghdad.

name: Call for Justice
description: Greater ReVi ritual calling on Nemesis to deliver justice; never attempted.

name: Call of Morpheus
description: Andru's group-target version of Call to Slumber.

name: Call of the Hunter
description: Boar King power to appear anywhere in his forest.

name: Call of the Rushing Waters
description: An Intellego Aquam spell (Level 15) that lets the caster locate any natural body of water to which they have an Arcane Connection by hearing it.

name: Call the Dream
description: A Rego Mentem spell letting the caster determine the theme of a sleeping person's dream by touch.

name: Call the Fallen Eagles from the Mist
description: Rego Mentem level 65 Ritual used on ancient battlefields to summon and control up to 10,000 pagan dead.

name: Callanish Stones
description: Great stone circle said to lead to Barathrum, Antrum and Tartarus; a gateway to Arcadia with aura 10.

name: Calliclean
description: One of the two ethical viewpoints of House Tytalus's Philosophy of Conflict, represented by clockwise spiral symbolism indicating growth and perception.

name: Calliclean Ethics
description: A branch of Tytalan philosophy named after the Sophist Callicles that champions physis over nomos, holding that the strong should throw off the restraints of custom; symbolized by a clockwise spiral.

name: Callicles
description: An ancient Greek Sophist quoted in the Analects of Tytalus who championed natural justice of the strong over the laws of weaklings; the Calliclean view is named after him.

name: Calling on God's Aid
description: Templar practice of calling God's aid before battle.

name: Calling the Council of Trees
description: A Hermetic ritual many magi believe to be of druidical origin, though House Merinita claims it for their Founder.

name: Calling the Khrafstar
description: Naonhaithya's Power releasing swarms of noxious creatures from his body.

name: Calling the Odious Drought
description: A Perdo Aquam Ritual spell (Level 50) with an Auram requisite that causes a drought over the surrounding area, drying streams and rivers.

name: Calm Temper
description: Temper of tolerance and peace, tied to Hope and opposing the sin of Wrath.

name: Calming Touch
description: A power of the angel Nasir (3 points, Animal/Mentem) that, by touching the target, calms their fears and reassures them in the face of dangerous terrain.

name: Calorific Stone
description: A Level 10 Alteration Reagent that, when dropped into water, makes the water boil within seconds; a single dose can affect a bathtub of water.

name: Calots
description: A court of Parisian argotiers who sit slack-jawed as apparent dotards.

name: Caltis of Tremere
description: A young Tremere magus among the members recruited to Nigrasaxa.

name: Calvinus of Jerbiton
description: A Florum magus with the Gentle Gift, posing as Piet's uncle, skilled in urban magic, illusions and spying; father of Petrus.

name: Camail
description: Mail hood covering head, forehead, lower face.

name: Caman
description: Walking stick and club used for shinty, like a golf club with a six-to-eight-inch head.

name: Camaret
description: Village.

name: Camargue Delta
description: The wild and inhospitable delta where the Rhone ends, home to a ghostly horse that keeps a larder of up to 100 wicked children.

name: Camelot
description: Legendary Arthurian site duplicated by faeries in several places, near Edinburgh, in Winchester and near Caerleon.

name: Camerlengo
description: Director of the papal camera (finances).

name: Camille of Mercere
description: Redcap whose messages were read; later fined for using a knight to harvest vis.

name: Canaan
description: Land promised to Abraham, which became Israel.

name: Canals that Accommodate Seagoing Vessels
description: CrTe 20 ritual creating a stone-lined canal wide and deep enough for seagoing ships, up to 909 paces long.

name: Cancer
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Candida Casa
description: St. Ninian's whitewashed church at Whithorn.

name: Candidus
description: A powerful chalk-white eyeless faerie of Fontainebleau who grants wishes through bargains and trapped Lapis Crudus.

name: Cannophori
description: Third rank of magi Bonisagi ('reed-bearers'), eligible for the Colentes Arcanorum.

name: Canon Episcopi
description: Church document declaring night rides illusions of faithless minds.

name: Canon court
description: Church courts held by archdeacons, bishops, and the curia, with no jury and no power to shed blood.

name: Canonesses
description: Female religious living under a rule as canons.

name: Canons
description: Cathedral administrative staff who elect a new bishop.

name: Cantled Saddle
description: Saddle used in tournaments or warfare giving +3 to resist being unhorsed by a charge.

name: Cape Pachynus
description: Site of the storm destroying a Roman fleet in 255 BC.

name: Cape Tainaron
description: Southernmost point of mainland Greece in Achaea; its church was a nekromanteion to Hades and a cave beneath leads to Purgatory or the pagan dead.

name: Capellani
description: The college of priests, deacons and sub-deacons serving in Rome; 70 in 1220.

name: Capital Messuage
description: The lord's enclosed piece of land around his house, containing his hall, outbuildings and curtilage.

name: Capitulation of Neuss
description: Agreement defining Papal lands.

name: Capnomancy
description: Divinatory method using fumes from burning poppies, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Capocci Family
description: One of Rome's great noble families.

name: Capons
description: A court of Parisian argotiers who cheat marks at cards.

name: Cappadocia
description: Home of wizards whose memoirs Bonisagus had.

name: Caprican of Merinita
description: Leader and champion of Oleron, with Strong Faun Blood, hostile to Tytalus.

name: Capricorn
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Captain of the Nightwalkers
description: Leader of a nightwalker host, chosen by its supernatural patron, often marked by a pennant on the battlefield.

name: Capuchonnes
description: A movement begun by Durand in the 1180s to eradicate brigands, which massacred 3000 in Auvergne then became brigands themselves.

name: Caput
description: The core lands at the center of a nobleman's affinity in England and France.

name: Carbuncle
description: A gem said by some bestiaries to lie on the asp's forehead.

name: Carcassonne
description: Siege site of the Albigensian Crusade.

name: Cardiff
description: The most important town in Wales, in a country with few towns and a largely barter-based economy.

name: Cardinal Robert Caurçon
description: The cardinal who discovered the heresy of David of Dinant in 1215 after reading his book Quaternuli.

name: Cardinal Ugolino
description: Cardinal appointed protector of Francis' followers who took control of the movement and tried to make the friars and Poor Sisters live more like Benedictines.

name: Cardinal-Bishop of Ostia
description: Chief clergyman of Ostia who views magi as a great threat.

name: Cardinal-bishop
description: Highest rank of cardinal: the bishops of seven small towns near Rome; the pope is ordained by a cardinal-bishop.

name: Cardinal-deacon
description: Rank of cardinal; there can be up to 18.

name: Cardinal-priest
description: Rank of cardinal; there can be up to 28.

name: Cardus
description: The east-west main street of the temple town bisecting the Decumanus.

name: Care of Souls
description: Priest's seasonal activity of preaching giving willing congregants +1 to activities matching the sermon theme.

name: Careless with (Ability)
description: A Minor General Flaw: the character is reckless with a particular Ability, treating any rolled zero as a botch when using it.

name: Carhaix-Plouguer
description: Settlement.

name: Carissimus
description: The captain of a mesnie, the lord's best friend or most skilled knight.

name: Carles
description: A stone circle of forty-two stones about thirty meters across, surrounded by a bank, containing three round barrows and a rectangle of stones called the Porter's Lodge said to become a guarded house on certain nights.

name: Carlos
description: Jerbiton magus of Literatus teaching at the University of Law.

name: Carmelite Nuns
description: Order of female religious discussed in the chapter on women.

name: Carmina Burana
description: Famous work produced by the Goliards.

name: Carna
description: Ancient Roman goddess who protected a princeling from vampires with hawthorn.

name: Carneades
description: Early critic of astrology and divination (219-126 BC).

name: Carnutes
description: Ancient Gaulish tribe giving Chartres its name, home near Orléans.

name: Carol
description: Circle dance.

name: Carolingian Empire
description: The Frankish empire whose institutions underlie the French and German noble systems.

name: Carpathian Mountains
description: Rumored site of the Blessed One's fortified covenant.

name: Cartagena
description: Diocese subject to Rome.

name: Cartouche Magic
description: Magic of ancient Egypt believed ancestral to learned magicians' magic.

name: Carve the Mystic Tower
description: Jacinta's Perdo spell that etches away surplus rock to leave a building.

name: Cas Corach
description: Faerie hero said to have killed the daughters of Airitech.

name: Cas-chrom
description: The Highland footplow, a long-handled tool with an iron head used to turn soil.

name: Case Rulings
description: Tribunal rulings arising from convictions or acquittals in criminal cases.

name: Casius
description: 10th-century magus who invented Bellum.

name: Caspar
description: One of the Three Wise Men whose body lies in the Shrine of Kings at Cologne Cathedral.

name: Cassiel
description: Ruler of Araboth.

name: Cast away your mortal soul / And keep it safe in mortal bowl
description: Incantation/Consumption 50 transferring the caster's soul into a vis-containing vessel.

name: Castel Sant'Angelo
description: Fortress used by the Papal court in need.

name: Castennac
description: Village.

name: Casting Item
description: Physical items in a Potent spell's design that the caster must touch to cast it.

name: Casting foci
description: Items used by Verditius-trained magi in casting.

name: Castle Defenses
description: Castle characteristic describing walls, earthworks and moats, graded Shoddy to Excellent, giving a Defense Bonus and determining wall damage levels.

name: Castle Garrison
description: Castle characteristic measured in combat groups of infantry, levies, knights, serjeants and archers; it sets a Weight of Numbers modifier and check interval.

name: Castle Kyburg
description: Home castle of the Kyburgers.

name: Castle Rock
description: The king of Scotland's seat in Edinburgh, where the Stone of Scone lies.

name: Castle Supplies
description: Castle characteristic representing stored food, water and materials and the ability to resupply; it grants a Siege Conditions Bonus to supplies rolls.

name: Castle of Hapsburg
description: Castle built by Bishop Werner of Straussburg.

name: Castle of the Grail
description: Knights of the Green Stone headquarters, probably in a Rhine forest and possibly a regio with moving entrances.

name: Castles in Lieu of Halls
description: On large estates a castle may replace the hall; castles are detailed in Covenants and summarized in Chapter Eight: Massed Combat.

name: Castratus
description: A Minor General Flaw: the character was castrated before puberty, suffering -3 social rolls in Latin culture; only available to characters born with testicles.

name: Castro Selvaggio
description: Covenant castle whose magi created siege spells when besieged by a Milanese force; it was eventually sacked.

name: Casual Augury (Numerology)
description: Numerological augury used with Numbering the Flock to interpret numbers.

name: Casual Divination
description: One-round divination observing signs in the immediate environment, rolled with Perception + Divination.

name: Casualty
description: A group member with a Medium Wound or worse, unconscious, or unable to fight due to magic; casualties raise the Ease Factor to rally.

name: Cat Like a Shadow
description: Personal cat power, a version of Veil of Invisibility.

name: Cat-Fish
description: A Warped cat, fore-part black cat and back-part silvery fish, living in a tributary of the Seine.

name: Catalaunian Fields
description: Site of the 451 battle against Attila, with a Malevolent Infernal aura 3 and an Infernal regio yielding Perdo and Corpus vis.

name: Cataphract ghost
description: Ghost of an Eastern Empire mounted warrior, Magic Might 15, recruited by House Tremere.

name: Cataplasm of Mandrake
description: A Theriac of Level 5, Potency Moderate, a secret of the School of Salerno using mandrake and hyoscyamus; it numbs a body part and reduces Wound and Disease Penalties by 3.

name: Catapult of the Mighty Winds
description: A Cr(Re)Au 30 spell that uses strong winds to hurl an object on an arched trajectory; once airborne the projectile's motion is natural and bypasses Magic Resistance, doing about +10 damage.

name: Cataracts
description: A Minor Curse (Perdo Corpus effect) clouding the victim's eyes white and penalizing vision-based rolls and reading advancement by -3.

name: Catching Up On Masses
description: Story seed where priests perform a marathon of backlogged masses, boosting the Dominion and disturbing faeries and demons.

name: Catechumen
description: Adults undergoing instruction in Christianity prior to baptism.

name: Caterans
description: Landless men adopted into a clan.

name: Cathach
description: A trophy item Hibernian covenants need.

name: Cathedral
description: The church of the bishop, usually the largest in the diocese's main town.

name: Cathedral Chapter
description: A legal corporation of the canons of a cathedral, very influential in diocesan governance and electing the bishop by secret ballot.

name: Cathedral magic schools
description: Icelandic clerical sorcery schools closed by investigation.

name: Cathedral of Bourges
description: Half-built French-style cathedral begun 1195.

name: Cathedral of Notre-Dame
description: Paris cathedral begun 1163.

name: Cathedral of Sainte Croix
description: Cathedral in Orléans whose priests were arrested.

name: Cathedral of St. Pierre in Beauvais
description: A new-style Gothic cathedral north of Paris standing over 150 feet tall, cited as an example of soaring cathedral architecture.

name: Cathedral of St. Tryphaena
description: Large ugly cathedral in Artakia holding St. Tryphaena's relics; Dominion aura 5.

name: Cathedral of St. Étienne
description: Second-earliest church in the new French style, in Sens.

name: Catinaccio
description: Laurens's home.

name: Cattle Raiding
description: Major part of Highland life in which clans lift each other's cattle, especially at summer's end.

name: Catulus
description: A Bjornaer apprentice ('cub'), the common property of the sept during the sleeping years of training.

name: Caucasus Mountains
description: Likely location of the Tree Guarded by Michael.

name: Caul
description: Hood of membrane with which most nightwalkers are born; kept by the nightwalker and in some traditions the source of his powers, granting caul-based Virtues.

name: Causabon
description: A magus of House Bonisagus whose journal records his sense of the forests' primal power and his hope that the three domus magnae might share their secrets.

name: Cause Poisoning
description: Silver Lady power coating objects in lead or arsenic.

name: Causes And Cures
description: Hildegard's summa on natural philosophy and Medicine.

name: Causimomancy
description: Divinatory method using behavior of objects placed in a fire, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Cautious with (Ability)
description: A Minor General Virtue letting a character roll two fewer botch dice for a specific Ability.

name: Cautious with Chirurgy
description: A Virtue commonly taken by empirici that reduces botch risk when using the Chirurgy Ability.

name: Cautious with Medicine
description: A Virtue that enhances medical skill, reducing the risk of botches when using the Medicine Ability.

name: Cave of Cruachan
description: Irish cave on Bricriu's Glen where the wolf-daughters of Airitech dwelt.

name: Cave of Polyphemus
description: Foul cave atop a cliff, closed by a huge door stone, home of Polyphemus.

name: Cave of Sabinus
description: Cave with a genius loci and Aquam vis, a luctatio.

name: Cave of Twisting Shadows Lore
description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

name: Cave of the Inscription
description: Cave under the Mendips with Magic aura 6 bearing the Inscription that binds Winter faeries; site of Averna's laboratory.

name: Cavillor
description: Young Transitionalist Guernicus from the Roman Tribunal who defends accused magi.

name: Ceann cath
description: The chief of a Highland clan.

name: Cehennem
description: Sinkhole ('hell') linked by tunnel to Cennet; said to be bottomless, once a prison of Typhon, leading to Purgatory.

name: Ceilidh
description: Gathering to tell stories and sing.

name: Celebratory Processions
description: Nightwalker feasts and processions where spirits of animals are eaten to regenerate Long Term Fatigue.

name: Celestial Demons
description: Demons who once inhabited Heaven and rejected it: angels who fell with Lucifer and the Watchers.

name: Celestine V
description: Saintly Pope overwhelmed by intrigue and duped into resigning.

name: Cement (Reagent)
description: A Level 5 alchemical Reagent, a dry powder that when sprinkled over loose earth or sand binds it as solid as granite, covering about three paces to six inches deep.

name: Cennet
description: Sinkhole ('heaven') in Asia Minor in the Tribunal of the Levant with a monastery at its bottom founded by Saint Paulus.

name: Cenobite
description: A magus living in an unrecognized covenant, as the Cherbourg magus is treated.

name: Censum
description: Annual fee excusing a peasant from week work for a year, sometimes used as a punishment.

name: Centiloquium
description: Aphorisms falsely ascribed to Ptolemy.

name: Central Massif
description: Volcanic highland in eastern Aquitaine.

name: Centrus
description: Target in the Line Range example who creeps round the wall to Lineus.

name: Centurions' Feast
description: Honos's power that feeds 100 and heals those with Dutybound.

name: Cephalomancy
description: Divinatory method using severing the head of a goat or donkey, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Cera
description: Castle above Tomar, main Portuguese Templar chapterhouse.

name: Cerberus
description: Guardian of the gate of Hades, whose statues guarded Roman cave taverns.

name: Ceremonial Augury Phenomena
description: Table of divinatory techniques (aeromancy through scrying) with bonuses for types of questions.

name: Ceremonial Divination
description: Divination taking 15 minutes per 5 Ease Factor, using sympathetic magic and devices, rolled with Intelligence + Divination.

name: Ceremonial Figures
description: Hermetic Geometry use of ceremonial casting with regular figures for +3 Casting Score.

name: Ceres
description: A goddess one of whose priestesses always serves as a hierophant of the Huntress in the Wood.

name: Ceridwen
description: The witch whose cauldron gives Gwion Bach magical powers; example of a donor.

name: Ceroscopy
description: Divinatory method using patterns of wax dripped in water, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Certamen Schools
description: Distinct styles of certamen practiced mainly by Tremere magi, each with its own Finesse-based tricks; Harenarii pioneer most new schools.

name: Cerularius Bonisagi
description: Tenth-century magus of Normandy who developed Lancea Magica.

name: Ceylan
description: Verditius magus, amicus of Nerius, who gave him his mantle.

name: Chaioth ha-Qadesh
description: The four Angels of Judgement in Jewish tradition.

name: Chalcedon
description: Council 451.

name: Chalkydri
description: Lion-bodied crocodile-headed sun creatures regulating heat.

name: Chalus
description: Castle near Limoges where Richard was fatally wounded.

name: Chamber of Summer Breezes
description: A Creo Auram 10 spell with Ignem requisite creating a continual breeze of fresh, dry, warm air to keep a room's humidity and temperature constant, often cast on armarii and book chests.

name: Chamberlain
description: Officer responsible for the king's chamber, retinue, and personal possessions.

name: Champ-Dolent
description: Menhir marking the Schism War's final battle.

name: Champagne Trade Fairs
description: Six main fairs at Provins, Troyes, Lagny and Bar-sur-Aube where Redcaps run temporary Mercer Houses.

name: Champions
description: Mercere magi who fight certamen on behalf of Redcaps.

name: Chamuel
description: An archangel listed by Dionysus the Areopagite among the archangels.

name: Change the Nature of Vis
description: MuVi 5 spell.

name: Channel Islands
description: Islands where a dialect close to Norman is spoken.

name: Chansons de geste
description: Great romances with arcane lore.

name: Chantecler
description: Cockerel caught by Reynard.

name: Chaotic
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab or its outfittings are in constant flux or motion (-2 Safety, +1 Warping, +2 Muto or Rego).

name: Chapter of Canons (Church Boon)
description: Minor Church Boon: the priests form a chapter holding benefices.

name: Chapter of Cherbourg
description: Chapter house of Fengheld near Cherbourg, occupied by a single magus considered a cenobite in Normandy.

name: Character guide
description: A summary of requirements for designing a magic character type, used instead of a full sheet.

name: CharacterType (Bjornaer Magus)
description: A magus of House Bjornaer who possesses a heartbeast and belongs to a clan and sept within the ancestor cult.

name: Characteristic
description: The eight inborn attributes (Intelligence, Perception, Strength, Stamina, Presence, Communication, Dexterity, Quickness) defining a character's potential.

name: Charge
description: Combining movement with exertion on attack; mounted charges tire the horse instead.

name: Chariot Mysteries
description: Ancient mystical practice inspired by Ezekiel's vision of the divine chariot, seeking communion with angels.

name: Charism
description: Gift given by God and stamped on the soul; Andru argues the Gift is one.

name: Charities
description: Lands given to the Church in exchange for services such as masses for the donor; increasingly offered to nunneries.

name: Charlemagne's Empire
description: The historical Frankish empire whose civilizing forces helped wipe out the Gothic witch-cult tradition.

name: Charlemagne's Loaf
description: A wondrous loaf of bread whose smallest nibble grants the eater incredible courage, giving a +3 on all Bravery rolls (Craft Level 17).

name: Charlemagne's Talisman
description: Coronation relic in Reims believed to contain a fragment of the True Cross.

name: Charles II the Bald
description: Successor of Louis defeated by Nominoé.

name: Charles III
description: French king who made an accord with Rollo in 911.

name: Charles IV
description: Holy Roman Emperor who wrote of a haunting at his castle in Prague.

name: Charles of Anjou
description: French count crowned King of Sicily in 1266, bringing Windgraven Magi into Italy.

name: Charles the Simple
description: King of the Franks from 898, driven out by Robert.

name: Charm Against Capriciousness
description: TuFa 20 charm treating stress rolls for Great Weapon as simple rolls.

name: Charm Against Magic
description: Rego Vim spell enchanted into amulets of Imanitosi and Steris.

name: Charm Against the Hex
description: TuMa 10 charm raising Hex Ease Factor by +9.

name: Charm Magician
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: the learned magician may not create amulets, only chartae.

name: Charm Offensive
description: Andru's campaign to have the Church declare Hermetic magic enchantment rather than sorcery.

name: Charm of Alacritous Fortune Against Earth
description: TuMa 10 charm adding +4 Defense vs magical earth attacks.

name: Charm of Protection Against Achilles' Bane
description: TuSa 5 charm adding +8 Soak vs non-magical arrows; versions for other weapons.

name: Charm of Protection Against the Attacks of Semita Errabunda
description: TuSa 15 charm giving +4 Defense vs nonmagical attacks by Semita Errabunda residents.

name: Charm of Protection Against the Faerie
aliases: Charm of Protection against the Infernal
description: VuMa general charm warding against Faerie creatures of lower Might; versions for other realms.

name: Charm of Quickness
description: SuFa 20 charm improving luck with Quickness; exists for each Characteristic.

name: Charm of Warding Against Unwanted Pests
description: TuSa 5 charm keeping pests away from the recipient.

name: Charon
description: Ferryman on the River Styx, after whom the Charon certamen trick is named.

name: Charon (certamen trick)
description: Trick allowing two spells on an opponent at certamen's end.

name: Charta for Healing a Broken Limb
description: SuSa 4 charta giving +6 to Recovery rolls for a broken limb.

name: Charter Demon
description: A typical demon with Infernal Might 15 (Mentem) that offers services such as disease relief or merchant bonuses to townsfolk in exchange for tithes or worship under a demonic charter.

name: Charter Strength
description: Optional rule scoring each side's legal position in a charter (Intelligence + Civil and Canon Law + stress die).

name: Chasidim
description: German Jewish mystics who developed a cultural and religious renaissance after the First Crusade, emphasizing asceticism, martyrdom, and lifelong penitence.

name: Chassenon
description: Roman city ruins with baths whose healing water has Creo vis.

name: Chaste
description: Personality Flaw suitable for characters affected by vows.

name: Chastise the Disobedient
description: Bordelon's Power making her switch strikes double Wound Penalties.

name: Chastise the Sinful
description: Kolazonta's plague power.

name: Chateau Galliard
description: Great Angevin castle fallen in 1204.

name: Chaudepysse
description: A Minor Choleric Disease contracted from unclean women, notoriously difficult to cure, causing painful urination.

name: Chausses
description: Mail leggings.

name: Chavin of Tytalus
description: A magus of House Tytalus whose spells all promote or advocate war or violence per his sigil; his version of Voice of the Lake makes the lake sound arrogant.

name: Chearlach
description: Gruagach used in the newid gornest example, taking bird form to escape Brude's lava.

name: Chearlach Mac Caolin
description: Young gruagach once of the covenant of Eilean Beg, abducted and trained by Brude Deathless, bound by a geas to train a student before his forty-ninth year.

name: Chef
description: Folk magician using Free Expression, Knack and Craft Lesser Charm to cook magical food.

name: Cheiron
description: A centaur who mentored Herakles and became the constellation Centaurus; a powerful astrological spirit aligned to Magic.

name: Chelm
description: Mythical city of fools of Jewish folklore.

name: Cherem
description: Civic ostracism excommunication under Halakha.

name: Cheshire
description: One of the two English palatinates, where the Earl of Chester holds all the authority of the king.

name: Chess System
description: Decimal vis currency (pawn, rook, queen) invented by the Tremere.

name: Chessed
description: Sefirah meaning 'Love', level 7 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 7.

name: Chevalier De Panne
description: Knight who fought Pan Caudarax and lived.

name: Chevauchee
description: Tactic of ravaging enemy territory; returning inhabitants suffer a –2 Living Conditions modifier and extreme cases may develop a Malevolent Infernal aura.

name: Chewstoke
description: Village west of Stanton Drew below Pagan's Hill.

name: Child Killers
description: Common faeries of folklore that kill children.

name: Child Stealers
description: Faeries that steal children.

name: Child Virtues and Flaws
description: New type of Virtue and Flaw reflecting childhood traits that must be exchanged by adulthood.

name: Childbed Fever
description: A Major Sanguine Disease afflicting women who have just given birth, caused by the childbed fever demon.

name: Childebert
description: Son of Clovis buried at St. Denis.

name: Childebert I
description: Son and successor of Clovis who died childless in 558.

name: Childeric III
description: Last Merovingian king, shorn and retired to a monastery.

name: Children of Danu
description: Celtic gods who drove the Fomoire beyond the Ninth Wave.

name: Children of Hermes Lore
description: Organization Lore taught to new Children of Hermes.

name: Children's Crusade
description: 1212 crusade started by a shepherd boy from Châteaudun.

name: Childwrite
description: Tax on unmarried pregnancy, often absorbed into leywrite.

name: Chill Touch
description: Water elemental power extracting heat for +10 damage.

name: Chilperic
description: Frankish king buried in Tournai.

name: Chilperic I
description: Son of Chlotar, king who died in 584.

name: Chinon
description: Town on the River Vienne with a great castle built by Henry II; given to Philip II by the Treaty of Chinon.

name: Chivalrous Combat
description: Example player-defined Pretense combining sword and lance use for a faerie knight.

name: Chloe filia Andru
description: Lartan Jerbiton maga at Valnastium.

name: Chlotar II
description: Chlotar 'the Grand', reunited the Frankish kingdom in 613.

name: Chochmah
description: Sefirah meaning 'Wisdom', level 9 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 9.

name: Chorazon
description: Ruined city in the Holy Land where the Antichrist is to be born.

name: Christopher of Romagna
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Chromatic Flames
description: A Level 4 alchemical Reagent that, when sprinkled over flames or mixed with fuel, causes them to burn a different hue chosen by the alchemist until extinguished.

name: Chrétien of Troyes
description: The most famous trouvère of northern France, whose Arthurian poems concentrate on Arthur and his peers.

name: Chrétien the Roamer
description: Much-traveled monk seeking to lose Difficult Underlings who fails his pilgrimage by yielding to temptation.

name: Chthonic Magus
description: A magus attuned to both Magical and Infernal auras through Chthonic Magic.

name: Chur
description: Rhaetian capital, a Roman colony with a bishop.

name: Church Auras
description: Divine auras radiating from a church altar as far as the bells can be heard, levels 1 to 5.

name: Church Courts
description: Courts dealing with priests and crimes against God or the Church.

name: Church Deacon
description: Grog template: a proud deacon who assists the parish priest and reads from the Bible.

name: Church School
description: Minor Church Boon: a school attached to the church.

name: Church Upbringing
description: A Minor Personality Flaw: the character was schooled and raised by the Church, leaving him less knowledgeable about society and requiring 25 experience points on Church-related Academic Abilities.

name: Church of Holy Wisdom
description: Largest church in Christendom in Constantinople, Dominion 5-10.

name: Church of Saints Peter and Paul
description: Church in Rome on the spot where Simon fell.

name: Church of San Damiano
description: Small semi-derelict church outside Assisi where Francis heard the crucifix speak; home of Clare's Poor Sisters.

name: Church of St Martin
description: Church at Tours housing the bones of St Martin, a pilgrimage site for healing.

name: Church of St. Cornelius
description: Church at Carnac.

name: Church of St. Donatius
description: Bruges's largest church.

name: Church of St. Nicholas
description: Half-complete church in Ghent.

name: Church of the Blessed Mary of Nazareth
description: Church whose pillars sanctify Templar woolen cords.

name: Church of the Holy Sepulchre
description: Church whose dome appears on the grand master's seal.

name: Church-scot
description: Small fee many free peasants owe the Church each November.

name: Churchwarden
description: Lay officers who oversee and help run church buildings, developing in England and elsewhere.

name: Churchyard
description: Hallowed place protected by the Divine where villagers gather, drink, dance and hold informal markets.

name: Châlons-en-Champagne
description: Ecclesiastical city on the Marne with Notre-Dame basilica and Notre-Dame-de-Vaux.

name: Ciaran
description: Feral boy adopted by the Aillwee Cave spirit, stealing on its behalf.

name: Cicero
description: Roman critic (106-43 BC) whose treatise On Divination ridiculed divine messages in dreams.

name: Cichol the Footless
description: One of the Fomoire.

name: Cindrallon
description: A Flambeau apprentice made a full maga after only seven years for single-handedly slaying a renounced magus in a Wizard's March using a spear.

name: Cinnamon
description: Pietro's leopard familiar, which ambushes birds from behind cloudbanks.

name: Circe's Cave
description: Example of a Muto-aligned aura.

name: Circle
description: Older Roman-based vis unit of four pawns, often infused in a ring or disc; used in Alpine contracts.

name: Circle of Clarity
description: PeVi spell dispelling active Vim effects within a circle.

name: Circle of Encompassing Flame
description: A Creo Ignem (CrIg 35) fire spell known by the Flambeau template magus.

name: Circle of Encompassing Flames
description: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 35) that creates a 6-foot-high circle of flames dealing +20 damage to anyone moving through; with a Rego requisite the circle can shrink or grow as the caster concentrates.

name: Circle of Lethargy
description: PeCo 30 Ring spell preventing targets inside from recovering Fatigue by resting.

name: Circle of Time
description: House Criamon's core belief that time runs forever in identical cycles, an unguarded prison from which they seek to escape with all humanity.

name: Circle of Warriors
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Circle of the Unique Cherub
description: Small invitation-only school of no more than a dozen Jewish mystics in Provence and the Rhine, using the Sefer Yetzirah; they have created three golems.

name: Circlet of the Primus
description: Enchanted circlet commanding Fudarus's servant spirits, worn by Buliste.

name: Circuit of Saint Patrick
description: Pilgrimage itinerary through sites of Saint Patrick's miracles ending at Lough Dearg.

name: Circular Ward Against Faeries
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Circular Ward Against the Faeries of the Wood
description: Hermetic spell targeting the material a faerie is made from, effective against faeries.

name: Circular Winds of Protection
description: A wind-based spell referenced as a strength level achievable by the Whistle Up the Wind Ability.

name: Circulation Total
description: Roll (reputation + summa level + die) to circulate a polemic to a Tribunal, House or the Order.

name: Cirein Croin
description: Ancestor of all stoorworms, so large it circled Britain; its teeth became the Northern Islands and its body Iceland.

name: Cirion
description: A magus of House Tremere who declared Wizard War against Pietro of House Diedne of Oakdell covenant in 1004 AD.

name: Cistercian
description: A monastic tradition that balances its monastic offices with physical or mental labor.

name: Citeaux
description: Founded in 1098, origin of the Cistercian Order.

name: City Harbor
description: Kyzikos' harbor, now unused, where the Altar of Apollo of Landings stands.

name: City of Christ
description: Heavenly city in the Fourth Heaven, also beyond Lake Acherusia.

name: City of Luz
description: Divine city of immortality reached via an almond tree in the Holy Land; level 3 and 7 regio.

name: City-Watch
description: Patrols in large towns that enforce curfew and interrupt crimes in progress, but with no formal investigative function to solve past crimes.

name: Civitas Orleans
description: Civil and Canon Law tractatus by Magistrate Bayne.

name: Clach Crubain of Virtue
description: Bent formed stone containing 1 pawn of Perdo vis that when Enriched with oil confers Lesser Immunity to arthritis.

name: Clach neart
description: Stone of strength used as a test of manhood.

name: Clam Shell of Virtue
description: Shell containing 1 pawn of Terram vis that, Enriched under a waterfall, confers the Tough Virtue.

name: Clan Mac Donald
description: Highland clan used as an example; its chief is called 'the Mac Donald'.

name: Clan Mysteries
description: Minor-Virtue Mysteries unique to each Bjornaer clan, Initiated by elder clan members to help fulfill duties to their ancestors.

name: Clan of Geirrod
description: Giant clan whose Jotunn tongue Gull speaks.

name: Clandestine Marriage
description: Marriage without priest or witnesses, common but recently outlawed by the Church.

name: Clarion Call of the War Horse
description: A MuMe 15 Sound-Target spell that heartens anyone hearing the caster's battle cry, granting a +3 bonus to their Brave Personality Trait.

name: Clash of Weapons
description: Optional rule checking for weapon breakage when Attack Total exactly equals Defense Total.

name: Claude of Orleans
description: Only Gifted member of the Orleans Witches, rumored to have killed two rivals with curses; lives in a shack north of Orleans.

name: Claude's Shack
description: Shack by a stream north of Orleans near a ruined Roman villa with a magic apple tree.

name: Claville
description: Chartered community in Normandy that is really a large manor.

name: Cleanse the Verminous Vis
description: ReVi 15 transferring Infernal vis, reducing but not removing its taint.

name: Clear Breath of the Consummate Liar
description: A Muto Vim (Mentem) 20 spell invented by Imanitos Mendax that lets him manipulate a Frosty Breath of the Spoken Lie cast on himself to appear truthful or lying as desired.

name: Clear Sight of the Naiad
description: An Intellego Aquam spell (Level 5) that lets the caster see as clearly through water as through air for a single moment.

name: Cleidomancy
description: Divinatory method using dangling a key from the Bible, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Clemens
description: The most senior master of Fengheld of House Tremere, filius of Stentorius, who runs Fengheld's biggest chapter house.

name: Clementine Recognitiones
description: Text quoting Simon Magus; with Pseudo-Clementines, refutes his beliefs.

name: Cleopatra
description: Consort of the Blessed One, said to have been the Egyptian queen in a past life.

name: Clergy
description: Virtue.

name: Clermont
description: City on a former druid wood with a regio of Terram vis, ruled by its Lord Bishop.

name: Cleromancy
description: Divinatory method using casting dice or lots, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Cliff Ogres
description: Large faeries haunting cliff-top roads who throw travelers onto rocks for their children to eat.

name: Cloak for the Thief in the Night
description: TaVs 25 spell making a cloaked target silent and imageless until the cloak is removed.

name: Cloak of Concealment
description: Caitlin's cloak (MuIm 25) making the wearer hard to pick out.

name: Cloak of Gilded Feathers
description: Spell (MuCo 35, golden eagle) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Cloak of Manannan
description: Manannan's cloak that can be any color, make him invisible, shelter a place in fog and prevent two people meeting again.

name: Clodoald
description: Grandson of Clovis who cut his hair, founded a monastery and gave St. Cloud its name.

name: Clodomir
description: Son of Clovis, father of Clodoald, and king of Burgundy at Orléans.

name: Closed Mouth of the Nightwalker
description: A PeMe 40 Spectacle-Target spell that makes anyone who sees the caster instantly forget having done so.

name: Closed Privacy of the Enchanted Regio
description: Mu(Pe)Vi(Te) 79 Mystery enchantment shrinking a regio's interface until it pinches off, closing the regio.

name: Closing the Earth's Gate
description: A Perdo Aquam spell (Level 25) that dries a single spring permanently so it never flows again.

name: Cloth Hall of Ypres
description: Central hall where cats are kept and later hurled.

name: Clotilde of Burgundy
description: Christian wife of Clovis whose prayers cured their son.

name: Cloud of Pepper
description: Gourmand's Power creating a choking cloud of pepper dust.

name: Clove Car
description: Low-lying hidden rock that shreds ship hulls near Big Harcar.

name: Clovis I
description: First Christian Merovingian king.

name: Club
description: Inexpensive crushing single weapon.

name: Clutch of Ebony Eggs
description: The Criamon clutch filled with the servants of the Path of Strife, the only clutch with no followers of other paths.

name: Co
description: Reference to Corpus in spell shorthand (ReCo 65) for the Summoning the Champions effect of the Horn of Champions.

name: Co-adjudicator
description: Priest appointed by the bishop to perform the duties of an ill, senile, or mad parish priest.

name: Coat of Plates
description: Lamellar cuirass worn over mail c.1250-1300.

name: Codex of lessons
description: Church Lore Tractatus received by lectors at ordination.

name: Coemption
description: Roman marriage form of mutual symbolic slavery, considered demeaning by magi.

name: Coenobium Rhodanien
description: A covenant in the Provençal Tribunal notorious for its involvement in Hermetic politics, preventing the foundation of any covenants it does not control over a large area of the tribunal.

name: Coerce the Spirit of Anger
description: A ReMe 20 spell that compels a spirit of anger to obey the caster through dramatic threats, with effectiveness determined by a Communication + Leadership roll.

name: Coerce the Spirit of Fire
description: ReIg 20 threatens fiery spirit.

name: Coeris Gambit
description: Chess move of Octavian.

name: Cog
description: The main clinker-built trade ship of the Atlantic, North Sea, and Baltic, usually carrying 20 tons but sometimes 100 to 140 tons.

name: Coif
description: Open-faced mail hood.

name: Coinchenn
description: Dog-headed Irish giantess who beheads her daughter's suitors.

name: Colchester
description: Castle with a keep 151 by 111 feet.

name: Colchis
description: Distant land on the Black Sea where the Golden Fleece waited.

name: Cold Iron Vexillation
description: Tremere vexillation of faerie-blooded soldier-diplomats settling faerie disputes, led by the Epicurean.

name: Coldingham
description: Double foundation burned down on account of the nuns' vanity.

name: Colentes Arcanorum
description: Inner Circle of five magi Bonisagi ('Collectors of Secret Lore') who disseminate House research via folios and can remove the Primus.

name: Coll
description: Example grog who gains faerie Virtues in Arcadia.

name: Collect the Potency of Blood
description: Robyn Redcap's power (MuCo 15) to dip his cap in a victim's blood for +3 Str and Sta per Size point.

name: Collector
description: Papal financial officials under the camerlengo.

name: College of 13
description: Electoral body of 13 that chooses a Templar grand master.

name: College of Cardinals
description: Body that elects the Pope, whose election practice House Jerbiton follows.

name: Collegial training
description: Uncertain new Hermetic technique of training many apprentices together.

name: Colloqui Cum
description: A magical power of the Virtuous Hound (Imaginem, 0 points) that lets it speak by creating sounds apparently from its mouth.

name: Colloquium Delectorum
description: Seven-yearly conference of the Colentes Arcanorum and Tenentes Occultorum held at a regular Tribunal.

name: Cologne Avenue
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city. It is currently bricked up due to civic reconstruction city-side.

name: Cologne Cathedral
description: Cathedral holding the relics of the Three Wise Men; every Magoi of the Star must make pilgrimage there for Christmas Day.

name: Colonna Family
description: One of Rome's great noble families.

name: Colosseum
description: Ancient ruin used by the Frangipane as a fortress.

name: Comarb
description: The religious leader of a Scottish monastery.

name: Combat Group
description: Standard military unit of five fully equipped men used to measure army size.

name: Combat Round
description: Six-second unit of combat time in which each character acts once in Initiative order.

name: Comfort the Righteous
description: Camuel's power alleviating doubt and fear.

name: Command the Flock
description: Power (ReAn 35) letting the bird trill commands to up to 100 birds for a duration of Sun.

name: Command the Four Hosts of Builders
description: Architectus's Power commanding swarms of tiny builder demons.

name: Command the Living Fire
description: Rego Ignem 20 spell to control a fire elemental of up to Size 0.

name: Command the Vile Spirit
description: ReVi 20 forcing a demon to obey.

name: Command the Waters
description: Men of the Lake ritual power turning water into a water elemental.

name: Commander
description: Major Social Status Virtue for a Templar commander, grants Temporal Influence.

name: Commander of the Knights
description: Commander over the brother-knights under the marshal.

name: Commander of the Land of Jerusalem
description: Templar treasurer responsible for the storehouse in Acre.

name: Commanding Spirits
description: Tractatus on Magic Lore by Pholus of Tytalus, Quality 9.

name: Commendation Ceremony
description: The ritual solemnizing the lord-vassal relationship, with oaths before mortal witnesses and God, typically including homage and an oath of fealty.

name: Commodus
description: Emperor whose murder in 192 AD led to civil war and the temple's decline.

name: Common Fear
description: -2 Mental Flaw laid by Brude's Curse on Duncan (fear of the moon).

name: Common Giant
description: An enormous ugly man-like magical creature (Magic Might 12, Corpus) about 20 feet tall, found throughout the British Isles; unlike many magical creatures, giants eat, drink, breathe, and age.

name: Common Magics
description: Mystery Virtues once secret but now well known throughout the Order, which any character may take at creation.

name: Common White Wolves
description: Magical wolves descended from Tremere's familiar, serving the House.

name: Commons
description: Village areas, typically pasture called the village green, set aside for villeins and regulated by the manor court.

name: Commune Lore
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Commune Mercenary
description: Magus vocation (Tytalus) who hires out to Italian communes, using subtle self-enhancing magic in battle.

name: Communication of the Heroes
description: CrMe 55 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

name: Communion (Range)
description: Holy magic Range affecting things over which the caster has holy authority or a ceremonial bond; equal to Arcane Connection.

name: Community Loyalty
description: Loyalty of peasants to a community magi create and govern (rather than to the magi themselves), gained by offering better terms than a town's royal charter.

name: Companion Animal
