description: A Minor Social Status Flaw (animals only): the character is the Animal Companion of another character and has little control over his own life.

name: Company
description: Group of knights riding under a single banner in tournaments, with its own Reputation.

name: Compiègne
description: Ancient city on the Oise around a royal abbey of St. Cornelius.

name: Complaint
description: Letter declaring and justifying Wizard's War, often containing a clause of redress.

name: Complex Armor Design
description: Optional rules to build armor from materials by body area and Load Factor, useful for faerie or historical armor.

name: Complexio
description: Elemental composition of an item.

name: Composite Bow
description: Bow used by Saracens, Moors and Asiatic nomads.

name: Compound device
description: Item with multiple components opened for enchantment, used for talismans and architectural structures.

name: Comprehending the Mystic Doorway
description: InHe 30 spell to see into the Twilight Void through a wooden structure's vestige, giving +9 to travel.

name: Compress of Mallow
description: A Theriac of Level 15, Potency Mild, a cool bandage of mallow and cucumber that soothes burns and heals any Light Wound caused by fire over a week.

name: Compulsion (Lies)
description: A Flaw compelling Imanitos Mendax to lie.

name: Compulsive
description: Flaw listed in this text.

name: Compulsive Lying
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw: the character finds it hard to tell the truth and embellishes or invents stories whenever he won't be immediately caught.

name: Compurgation
description: Canon court ritual in which about a dozen witnesses swear to the defendant's good character, acquitting him.

name: Compurgator
description: Oath-helper witness; a lord asks peasants to act as compurgators and lie about disputed land.

name: Comraich
description: The sanctuary lands of a Scottish Church monastery, protected by its Dominion.

name: Comyn family
description: Powerful Scottish family that squabbled with Alan Durward during Alexander III's minority.

name: Conaing
description: A Fomóir leader magically put to sleep by Lugh; the Hibernian replacement for Dindyméné.

name: Conall the Gruagach
description: UnGifted gruagach and hunter, blamed for every mishap, who shapeshifts into a bear and studies under Domhnall.

name: Concealment
description: Difficulty of seeing a character due to darkness, foliage or invisibility, granting Defense and Attack bonuses.

name: Conches
description: Chartered village outside an abbey in Normandy.

name: Concierges
description: Specialist porters of merchant houses who work both sides of the Gates, suffering heavy warping.

name: Conciliarius
description: Member of the Tremere Council holding his own sigil; councilor and counselor.

name: Concoction of Litharge and Henbane
description: A Theriac of Level 15, Potency Strong, a poison combining litharge, henbane, cinnabar and other ingredients that inflicts a Heavy Wound unless the imbiber succeeds at a Stamina roll.

name: Concordia
description: A short-lived covenant (821–823) in the Lake District that attempted to weld Ex Miscellanea traditions together but fell apart from internal tension.

name: Condensed Notation
description: Optional way of writing combat scores for weapon and shield combinations.

name: Confarreation
description: Marriage by contract signed before ten witnesses; binding under Hermetic law if a quaesitor witnesses (dotal contract).

name: Confound the Truth
description: BaalBaruth's power creating convincing false theological arguments.

name: Confraternity Member
description: A Minor Story Flaw marking membership in one of the smaller cults of magi in House Verditius, granting access to a confraternity's unique Inner Mystery.

name: Confraternity of Balento
description: A confraternity of House Verditius founded by Balento that produces wood-carved devices imbued with fire spells, with members claiming descent from Vulcan.

name: Confraternity of Himinis the Mad
description: A confraternity of House Verditius founded by Himinis the Mad that produces cursed items and trick devices using the Bind Curse Mystery.

name: Confraternity of Irene the Younger
description: A confraternity of House Verditius founded by the Byzantine princess Irene that creates magical paintings, statues, and mosaics affecting viewers and surroundings.

name: Confraternity of Roland
description: A confraternity of House Verditius founded by Roscius that crafts magical swords engraved with an 'R', studying the sword Durendal.

name: Confreres and Consoeurs
description: Associate members of the Templars.

name: Confuse
description: Hagbui power (ReMe 15) like Confusion of the Numbed Will.

name: Confuse Predator
description: White Stag power confusing enemies.

name: Conjunction of the Mystic Veils
description: Re(Mu)Vi 45 Mystery enchantment creating a password-opened gateway between two levels of a magical regio, typically as two pillars.

name: Conjuration of Bread
description: CrHe 35 ritual creating enough long-lived bread (ciabatta) to feed a moderate covenant for a season, giving +7 to a besieged castle's Supply rolls.

name: Conjuration of Wild Thyme
description: A Creo Herbam 20 Ritual spell that creates ten thousand doses of wild thyme, prepared and dried; a different spell is required for each herb.

name: Conjuration of the Tasty Tea
description: Creo Aquam 5 effect of the Potent Pot of Tasty Tea.

name: Conjure Spices
description: Gourmand's Power summoning spices, herbs and plant poisons.

name: Conjure the Sturdy Vine
description: A Creo Herbam spell (Level 5) that grows 10 paces of strong, pliable vine suitable for use as rope from wood or fertile soil.

name: Conjuring the House of God
description: A ritual Creo Terram spell (Level 45) that creates an unconsecrated church with vaulted ceilings, towers, and stained glass windows.

name: Conrad
description: Inquisitor described in the 1233 letter who suggested names of accused to victims.

name: Conrad II
description: German emperor who defeated Odo of Champagne at Bar.

name: Conrad of Urach
description: A cardinal legate present in Montpellier preparing to announce the pope's desired statutes that would make the Bishop of Maguelone the university's sole authority.

name: Conrad the Salian
description: Emperor whose empire absorbed the Kingdom of Burgundy in 1033.

name: Consecrated ground
description: Ground protected against Ihwaz corpse-animation and speaking with the dead.

name: Consecration
description: Blessing of a site or altar, often by interring relics beneath it, required before a Dominion can be created.

name: Consequences
description: Story component covering what results from the characters' actions, including political ramifications and rewards such as experience, Confidence Points, and changes in Personality Traits and Reputations.

name: Consolamentum
description: Cathar ritual laying on of hands substituted for sacraments.

name: Consolations of Philosophy
description: Boethius' tractatus on Philosophiae (Quality 9).

name: Consolidation of Scotland
description: Period 840-900 when Pictish culture disappeared and Diedne ascended over Ex Miscellanea.

name: Consortes
description: Trusted non-magi who handle a covenant's day-to-day affairs.

name: Conspiracy
description: Allying with mundanes in common cause, which the Code forbids. Aid given without the recipient's knowledge is not conspiracy.

name: Constable
description: Royal officer title; in France the Constable leads the army and may countermand the king in battle.

name: Constance filia Vortimer
description: Secundus of House Jerbiton, a core member of Valnastium.

name: Constance of Brittany
description: Widow of Geoffrey and mother of Arthur of Brittany.

name: Constant Damaging Effect
description: Orm Personal Faerie Power emitting noxious slime or toxic breath for +5 Damage.

name: Constant Powers
description: Greater, Lesser or Personal Powers made to trigger automatically at sunrise and sunset, costing Might each time.

name: Constanta the Tessellatrix
description: A student of the Jerbiton Primus Andru, extremely active in coordinating her fellow antigones.

name: Constantina filia Andru of Jerbiton
description: Young firebrand trained by the Primus, currently Mathieus's designated heir.

name: Constantine Alexander of Jerbiton
description: Author of the Terram summa A Material Inspired by the Divine.

name: Constantine IX
description: Emperor whom the Atsingani seers served in the mid-11th century.

name: Constantine V
description: Byzantine Emperor, son of Leo III, against whom the League of Iconophiles was still intriguing at the time of the First Tribunal as monasteries were sacked and icons burned.

name: Constantine of Mercere
description: Redcap who entered Dorisa's sanctum to collect a debt of twelve pawns; the charges were dismissed.

name: Constantinople Street
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city. It is currently bricked up due to civic reconstruction city-side.

name: Constitutions of Clarendon
description: Accepted by Thomas Becket at Templar persuasion.

name: Constrict
description: Orm natural power encoiling a victim, dealing automatic damage until broken free.

name: Constriction
description: Optional grapple-based attack by which dragons and worms suffocate victims.

name: Constriction Attack
description: Grapple-based attack by a larger creature that deprives its victim of air.

name: Constructing the Memory Palace
description: CrMe 20 Ritual permanent locus.

name: Contagion
description: A natural principle (pars pro toto) by which substances acquire second qualities through association or contact, underlying Arcane Connections.

name: Container for Ephemeral Vis
description: Enchanted seashell or crystal to capture and release insubstantial vis.

name: Contemplative Mysticism
description: Mystical path of imitating Christ via theosis; its Divine Ascent takes the form of Divine Form and it progresses by Spiritual Paths.

name: Contested Resource
description: Hook costing exclusive access to a luctatio.

name: Conti Family
description: One of Rome's great noble families.

name: Continent
description: Flaw whose restriction the owner of Enriched Fennel of Virtue must observe, or its power fades.

name: Continuous Research
description: Optional rule granting Lab Total bonuses for uninterrupted seasons on a single project.

name: Contortions
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Contra Haereticos
description: Divine Lore summa by Hugh of Amiens compiled with an Infernal Lore tractatus.

name: Control Environment of Fudarus
description: Six enchantments of the Rod of the Primus varying light, heat, portals, smells, noises and textures.

name: Control Spirit
description: Rego Vim 55 power of the Circlet of the Primus commanding spirits.

name: Control the Hungry Beast
description: Power of awakened truffles to mollify any beast so it no longer finds them interesting, threatening, or edible.

name: Control the Waters
description: Focus Power.

name: Conversation
description: Gruagach Range equivalent to Touch/Eye, requiring conversation within three paces.

name: Converse with Plants and Trees
description: Spell (InHe 25) known by Amberitus.

name: Copper Rooster
description: Mercere-owned inn in Basel used as a redcap message point.

name: Coquillards
description: A court of Parisian argotiers who carry forged pilgrim certificates.

name: Corazzo
description: Abbey in Calabria where Joachim took the Cistercian habit.

name: Corbie
description: Benedictine abbey founded by St. Bathilde, major theological center where Carolingian script developed.

name: Cordovan Cuirbolli
description: Level 5 Minor alchemical reagent turning hides into superior boiled leather, reducing Craft Ease Factors by 2.

name: Cords
description: Gold, Silver and Bronze cords measuring a familiar's bond.

name: Cornelius Clemens
description: The Roman commander of the 8th legion who built the Black Forest Road during the rule of Vespasian, aided by Mercurian priests.

name: Cornu Ammonis of Virtue
description: Horn of Ammon, a coiled stone with 2 pawns of Intellego vis that, Enriched, grants prophetic dream Visions to one sleeping on it.

name: Coronation
description: Elaborate ceremony, involving bishops, a great church and anointing, required to establish a new king.

name: Coronation and anointing
description: Rite granting kings Magic Resistance, Soak, and Commanding Aura.

name: Coroner
description: English office of four elected knights per shire who curb sheriffs, collect royal rights, and collect murdrum.

name: Corong Gorge
description: Gorge with genius loci.

name: Corpus province
description: The Corpus-aligned province of the Twilight Void: glowing human figures and remains, with health and age visible.

name: Corpuscles
description: Building blocks of matter with shape: cubes for earth, icosahedra for water, octahedra for air, tetrahedra for fire.

name: Corrector
description: Chancery official who approves drafted papal letters; usually two.

name: Correspondence
description: Letters between magi that grant experience and may serve as debate testimony.

name: Corrguineach
description: An Irish tradition of wizards controlling elemental spirits who were enemies of House Diedne and joined House Flambeau to exterminate them; a Hermetic Sahir variant.

name: Corrupt
description: Major Church Hook: corrupt priests give the church an Infernal aura.

name: Corrupt Traditions
description: Infernal traditions of knowingly evil people or placatory cults.

name: Corrupted (Ability)
description: Flaw granted by the Watchers' Corrupted Knowledge Power, rewarding selfish or sinful use of the Ability.

name: Corrupted Aura
description: A permanently tarnished Infernal aura of at least 3 with corrupting effects beyond its tarnish; divided into Debauched, Malevolent and Perfidious.

name: Corrupted Tree
description: Oaks, willows and pines of the Cursewood awakened and corrupted by the Infernal aura that ambush and devour victims; Infernal Might 10.

name: Corrupters
description: Demon role directly tempting mankind into sin.

name: Corruption Rite
description: Rites learned via Infernal Lore that formalize a mortal sin to allow a corruption roll, usually with candles, profane names, obscene acts and sacrifice.

name: Corruption Roll
description: Storyguide roll (stress die + temporary Infernal aura) made after a major sin to maintain or increase an Infernal aura.

name: Corruption of Tytalus
description: Historical episode during which a Tremere magus botched A Simple Method for Rapid Vallation.

name: Corseul
description: Site of a temple of Mars in a regio.

name: Coryza
description: A Minor Phlegmatic Disease caused by a cold, damp environment producing an excess of phlegm in the head.

name: Cosm
description: A world in the Magic Realm connected to a thing in the mundane world; may be a microcosm or macrocosm.

name: Cost of Breaking Convention
description: Optional guideline imposing a -1 social penalty on magi who dress above their station or flaunt familiars.

name: Cottar
description: Peasant with ten acres or less, living by hired labor or a trade, such as a blacksmith; half of manorial peasant families.

name: Council Mirror
description: Great mirror at the head of Montverte's council table in which Geirlaug appears.

name: Council chamber
description: Official meeting place of a covenant used to measure seisins and covenant spacing.

name: Council of Ancyra
description: Council of 314 A.D. to which the Canon Episcopi is allegedly attributed.

name: Council of Archmagi
description: Council that reputedly appoints the Antares and hires Sabastien.

name: Council of Clermont
description: 1095 council where Urban II called for the First Crusade.

name: Council of Four
description: The ruling council of House Ex Miscellanea representing different facets of the House's interests, instituted by Pralix and re-instated by later Primi.

name: Council of Lyons
description: Ecumenical councils held at Lyons in 1245 (deposing Frederick II) and 1274 (temporary reunion with the Greek Church).

name: Council of Members
description: The governing council of a covenant, comprising its probationary and full members, which holds covenant resources in common and decides matters by vote.

name: Council of Pavia
description: City council of Pavia on which Erimas of Luctatio sits.

name: Council of Regency
description: Council which runs England on behalf of Henry III, chaired by Pandulf.

name: Council of Tours
description: A Church council whose decree of 1163 forbade the participation of monks in commercial medical practice and non-monastic university education.

name: Counselor
description: A person who gives useful advice in the lord's select councils.

name: Count Palatine
description: A count with extra powers to deal with a difficult border, as in Durham and Chester.

name: Count Philip of Flanders
description: Noble whose wealth lured William Marshal to his side on the tournament circuit.

name: Count Thorstein
description: A flamboyant centaur merchant and guild councilor.

name: Count of Champagne
description: Example liege.

name: Count of Toulouse
description: Nobleman whose court supports Henri of Toulouse's petition to found a monastery.

name: Counter-mining
description: Defensive tunnelling by a castle garrison to collapse enemy mines before they reach the walls.

name: Countess Jeanne of Flanders
description: The current lord of Brugge, married to Fernando of Portugal and living in Lille, who is without an heir.

name: County of Bayeux
description: Forested county west of the Seine basin, with the towns of Caen and Bayeux and the ruined covenant Baiocassium.

name: County of Cornouaille
description: Peninsula county.

name: County of Gévaudan
description: County in the Auvergne long troubled by bold wolves.

name: County of Nantes
description: Breton county around Nantes with few Bretons and a Frankish population feeling affinity with Anjou and Poitou.

name: County of Périgord
description: Region of the Aquitaine producing the best black truffles; a suggested site for the truffle regio.

name: County of Rennes
description: Eastern Breton region.

name: Court Wizard
description: Magus bound as a vassal employee of a mundane lord, forbidden by the 865 Grand Tribunal ruling.

name: Court coram rege
description: The highest court of the land, where the king himself sits in judgment wherever he is; only the most important cases reach it and there is no further appeal.

name: Court of Piepowder
description: The court that upholds justice during a fair, named from the French for the dusty feet of itinerant tradesmen; it handles trade-related prosecutions under merchant law.

name: Court of the Alder Prince
description: A faerie court of the seasons, suggested to be sited in the Odenwald, paired with the Willow Maiden's court in the Swabian Forest.

name: Court of the Bees
description: A faerie court with which the young Spring in the Woods covenant has developed good relations.

name: Courtauds-de-boutanche
description: A court of Parisian argotiers who pretend to be out-of-work tradesmen.

name: Courts of Love
description: Formal courtly tradition to which Minnesang belonged.

name: Courts of Summer and Winter
description: Seasonal faerie courts that fight battles on the Equinoxes, summer and winter defeating one another in turn.

name: Coutances
description: Former Venelli capital, burned by Normans in 998.

name: Covenant Boon
description: Covenant benefit, e.g. Mathematicus Ally.

name: Covenant Boons and Hooks
description: Preexisting boons and hooks for a covenant at the Magic temenos.

name: Covenant Charter
description: The written constitution of a covenant defining membership, governance, resources, rights, responsibilities, and censure; a sample based on Arae Flaviae is provided.

name: Covenant Registration
description: Mercere tradition whereby covenants register their address with the House to be visited by Redcaps, agreeing to shelter any member of the Order for three days a year.

name: Covenant Season
description: Life stage of a covenant (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter).

name: Covenant Seasons
description: Life stages of covenants: Spring, Summer, Autumn.

name: Covenant Ship Captain
description: Companion vocation: captain of a covenant's ship who smuggles on the side.

name: Covenant Townhouses in Venice
description: Townhouses every Roman covenant maintains in Venice as centres of intrigue, information and learning.

name: Covenant of Crisp Winds
description: A constantly mobile covenant living on a flotilla of ships that follows a route around the Mediterranean collecting vis and trade goods.

name: Covenant of Lycaneon
description: Tremere covenant holding the House's amber deposits and lodging hired Verditius magi.

name: Covenant of the Castle of Fees
description: A covenant where, by Unnatural Law, glass is as durable and hard as iron and used as building material and armament.

name: Covenant of the Monkey's Reed
description: A covenant on a floating island whose aura, warping to a pattern, is slowly twisting its people and structures into an ancient Egyptian village.

name: Covenant of the Redbreasted Warriors
description: A fallen covenant whose aura a faerie king is said to hold captive in a wine bottle.

name: Covenant of the Solemn Scholars
description: A covenant where, by Unnatural Law, children are able to fly until they lose their virginity.

name: Covenant on the Isle of Arran
description: Covenant of Criamon magi studying regiones who can show the path to Manannan's realm.

name: Covenant trophy
description: Hibernian tradition that a covenant losing its trophy for a year and a day is no longer a covenant.

name: Covenants (supplement)
description: Supplement describing castles in detail.

name: Cover
description: Terrain protecting against attacks, giving +3 to +12 Defense.

name: Covet Device
description: A Personality Trait left in an attuned item that makes its owner crave the device, building up over seasons of ownership.

name: Cow and Calf
description: Agreement protecting copies of books.

name: Craford's Gut
description: The only safe water between Longstone End and Little Harcar.

name: Craft (Leather)
description: Craft Ability whose Ease Factor Cordovan Cuirbolli reduces.

name: Craft Automata
description: A Major Hermetic Virtue and Ability (initial score 1) granted by the Automata Mystery, allowing a character to construct mechanical men and beasts.

name: Craft Greater Charm
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Craft Guild Training
description: A Minor General Virtue granting 50 experience points in Craft, Profession, Bargain, or Guild Organization Lore from above-average apprenticeship.

name: Craft Hex Toys
description: Releganta's craft of making cursing wax figurines.

name: Craft Illuminations
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Craft Lesser Charm
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Craft Magical Trinket
description: Faerie power creating a glamour object letting its holder use a particular Virtue once.

name: Craft School
description: Hermetic movement prizing beautiful and functional objects, whose members (Crafters) are mostly mage-smiths.

name: Craft: Bookbinding
description: Ability listed in the text (e.g. in character statistics or rolls).

name: Craft: Charm
description: Ability cunning-folk substitute for Artes Liberales in Lab Totals.

name: Craft: Mason
description: A Craft Ability for masonry; Villard de Honnecourt's sketchbook tractatus can be studied as a quality-7 source for it.

name: Craft: Percamenarius
description: The craft of making parchment; a Perception + Finesse roll substitutes for it to determine the quality of vellum produced by the spell Hide to Parchment.

name: Craft: Poetry
description: A Craft Ability for writing poems, increased by studying other poets' literature and used to determine a poem's Aesthetic Quality.

name: Craft: Potter
description: A Craft Ability governing pottery, used by Maker of Textured Vessels and Maker of Water Vessels to determine vessel shapes and bonuses.

name: Craft: Sculptor
description: Craft Ability rolled with Dexterity to carve figurines for Figurine Magic.

name: Crafter of Herbam
description: Common non-Hermetic power of nature spirits that can animate trees.

name: Craftswoman
description: Virtue listed in this text.

name: Cramped
description: A Minor laboratory Structure Flaw: equipment is packed too close together, hampering all but one specialized activity (-1 General Quality, -1 Upkeep, -2 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Crane
description: Large bird hunted by paired hawks.

name: Crane Skin Bag
description: Manannan's bag of crane skin containing the External Vis Sources of dozens of dead Irish gods.

name: Cranequin
description: Mechanical device for spanning a heavy arbalest.

name: Crantel
description: Criamon who proposed the Graveyard of the Arch-Magi at their first meeting.

name: Crateuas
description: The greatest herbalist of antiquity, author of the first pharmacopoeia and herbal, the original Root-Cutter, and ancestor of the Pharmacopoeians.

name: Craving for Travel
description: A Minor General Flaw: the character suffers loneliness and boredom penalties if he does not expose himself to new experiences, getting worse the longer he stays in one place.

name: Create the Hunter's Blind
description: GvVs 10 spell covering a small group with an illusion of boulders or bushes affecting sight only.

name: Creating an Empty Book From a Filled One
description: A Perdo Animal 3 spell that creates a palimpsest from an existing book by flaking away a thin layer from each page.

name: Creation of a Legion of Appointed Cottages
description: CrTe 30 ritual creating identical stone houses with roofs, floors, doors, shutters and plumbing, nine per casting.

name: Creation of a Well-Appointed Town
description: CrTe 30 ritual creating well-appointed cottages, the road between them and the water and sewage pipes within the road.

name: Creation of an Undeserved Reputation
description: A CrMe 20 spell that creates a false memory of a person confessing to an enjoyable evening of intercourse with another, damaging reputation.

name: Creation of the Simile
description: A CrMe 20 spell that creates a new category of thing in the viewer's mind, granting unconscious familiarity with a broad range of its instances.

name: Creation of the Walls of Simple Cottages
description: CrTe 20 ritual creating a series of identical stone cottage enclosures linked by thin stone so they count as an Individual target.

name: Creativity
description: Human creative collaboration required for a faerie to change its glamour and advance.

name: Creativity in the Faerie Realm
description: Mechanism by which a character with unspent fable points makes a creative offer to alter Faerie's environment, symbolism, or a faerie's attitude.

name: Creature of Virtue
description: Magic animals such as Ravens, Stags, Hares and Mice of Virtue that inhabit the truffle regio.

name: Credenza di San Ambrogio
description: The popolo of Milan in 1202, which chose its own council.

name: Credo au Ribaut
description: Goliard poem quoted as the Goliard Credo.

name: Creep
description: Great leather glove worn by a hawker.

name: Cremona
description: One of the famed southern schools of medicine with access to the corpus of Arabic medical texts, where many Greek and Roman texts were translated from Arabic.

name: Crest of the Earth's Wave
description: ReTe 20 spell known by Iasper.

name: Criamon Primi
description: The ghosts of the Primi of House Criamon, ritually bound as genii loci to the Axis Magica, who habitually predict the doom and rebirth of the Order.

name: Criminal Brand
description: Flaw listed in character statistics in this text.

name: Crisis of Faith
description: The loss of True Faith, when God turns His gaze away and the character must remain steadfast to regain it.

name: Cristiana
description: Companion of Clare who co-founded the Foligno community in 1217.

name: Critias
description: A Sophist and leading member of the Thirty Tyrants of Athens, quoted in the Analects of Tytalus; he held that virtue could be imposed by force and religion was a human invention to control the masses.

name: Crodh
description: Highland cattle, smaller and more intelligent than lowland cattle, which scatter when startled.

name: Croesus
description: Namesake of The Wealth of Croesus spell.

name: Cronos
description: Fabled opponent of Zeus with faerie versions in the Faerie Realm.

name: Cronus
description: Titan whose sickle was created by the telechines.

name: Cross Baths
description: Baths of Bath used by lepers.

name: Cross of Saint Oswald
description: The wooden cross Saint Oswald raised before battle; its splinters and the moss growing on it have healing powers, as in the cure of the monk Bothelm.

name: Crossbows
description: Weapon Ability used for crossbows and arbalests; untrained use does not add the usual extra botch dice.

name: Crossroads
description: Places of faerie power where two borders cross.

name: Crossroads Faerie
description: Faerie governing the transition between life and death that afflicts Iasper.

name: Croton
description: Where Pythagoras founded the Society.

name: Crow of Virtue
description: A magical crow said to know the paths of treachery and predict the future.

name: Crow's Voice
description: A Minor Curse (Muto Corpus Animal effect) causing the victim to caw throughout speech, penalizing communication rolls and spell casting by -3.

name: Crown of Poplar Leaves
description: Enriched crown of Poplar Tree of Virtue leaves granting the Long-Winded Virtue to one wearer for about two weeks.

name: Crozon
description: Peninsula.

name: Crucifix
description: Adds +1 to exorcism.

name: Cruel
description: A Minor Flaw making a character cruel, taken by the Familiar Cat as a species Flaw.

name: Cruithne
description: Ancestor of the Cruithni.

name: Crumbling
description: Church Hook for a church that is very old and in a bad state of repair.

name: Crushing Doubt
description: Demon of Futility power preventing victims from spending Confidence.

name: Crushing the Will
description: Bordelon's Power sapping a target's will and vitality.

name: Crystal Castle
description: Castle of faerie knights at Lake Comper.

name: Crystal Custodian
description: An invested magical item invented by Gudrun Tigurina of Verditius at Durenmar.

name: Crystal of Imaginem Vis
description: Rock crystal vis granting invisibility as Veil of Invisibility.

name: Crystalomancy
description: Divinatory method using crystal-gazing, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Cserwenitsa
description: Hungarian site of Europe's only significant opal deposits, secured by a Tremere covenant.

name: Ctesiphon
description: Persian capital in Iraq.

name: Cu Chulainn
description: Irish legendary hero.

name: Cu Sith
description: Green faerie dogs whose bark presages death if heard three times; wild in the Highlands and kept by the good folk in the South.

name: CuChulainn
description: Gaelic hero of Highland stories.

name: Cubic Fluorite
description: Cubic Fluorite listed in the Tribunal index among minerals and substances.

name: Cucurbit
description: Flask with a still head attached.

name: Cudgel
description: Inexpensive two-handed crushing weapon.

name: Cuelebre
description: A sort of dragon.

name: Cuenca
description: An Iberian town whose fuero of one thousand clauses, granted by Alfonso VIII of Castile in 1190, regulates inheritance, criminal law, and Christian-Jewish relations.

name: Cuir Boulli
description: Boiled leather made by boiling in oil.

name: Cuirass
description: Breastplate and backplate.

name: Culmerland
description: Territory given to the Teutons by Frederick II.

name: Cult of Ancestors
description: House Bjornaer's tradition of revering ancestral spirits and Great Beasts, taught through House Bjornaer Lore alongside the House's Exoteric Mystery.

name: Cult of Dionysus
description: Lost Roman-era cult sought by Bonisagus and Iozheza.

name: Cult of Dyssynergy
description: House Criamon's bugbear, believed to oppose humanity's acceleration into Twilight; may not exist.

name: Cult of Hephaestus
description: An ancient Greek Mystery Cult of smiths and artificers founded by the god Hephaestus, ancestral to House Verditius.

name: Cult of Hermes
description: Greek magical cult from which the Cult of Mercury drew its ideals; its artifacts later reached Italy.

name: Cult of Isis
description: A Roman cult once centered on early Florence, with relics found in the Roman Temple of Isis in a magical regio in the city, occupied by a High Priestess and followers.

name: Cult of Jupiter
description: Roman cult whose high priest was the Pontifex Maximus.

name: Cult of Mithra
description: Roman army cult with temples along the walls lacking magical power.

name: Cult of Osiris
description: Egyptian wizards whose incubation rite made Iozheza disappear.

name: Cult of Thoth
description: Ancient Egyptian cult Fenicil identified as a forerunner of the Order.

name: Cult of Twilight
description: Mystery cult; if used, the Cave of Twisting Shadows is one of its centers.

name: Cult of Vulcan
description: The Roman successor of the Cult of Hephaestus, renamed under the empire, which emphasized destructive fire magic and supplied enchanted items to Caesars and the Cult of Mercury.

name: Cult of Wyzwanie
description: A Mystery Cult Regulus was building around communing with Wyzwanie using Walking the Path.

name: Cult of the Boar King
description: A newly revived pagan cult attempting to re-consecrate a temple to the Boar King.

name: Cult of the Dead
description: An alleged cult blamed by medieval writers for the rise of the restless dead; its existence, identity, and responsibility are left to the storyguide.

name: Cumae
description: Abandoned Greek colony where the Cumaean sibyl Carmentis guards a gate into Purgatory.

name: Cunning
description: The animal equivalent of Intelligence; Animal spells may affect beasts with Cunning analogous to Mentem affecting human minds.

name: Cup of Truth
description: Manannan's cup which breaks if a lie is told by one who drinks from it.

name: Curazzo
description: Monastery Joachim was made abbot of.

name: Curse Fetish Weaving
description: Weaving a curse fabric on a loom over a season with an Arcane Connection.

name: Curse for the Spied Spy
description: GvCu 35 curse at Voice range that blinds the target until the condition is fulfilled or the wound heals.

name: Curse for the Unjust Justice
description: GvCu 25 curse with Blood target that afflicts a whole bloodline with the Flaw Judged Unfairly.

name: Curse of Aging
description: Folk witch curse (EF 12) causing an immediate Aging Crisis.

name: Curse of Coughing Fits
description: VuSa 10 curse causing uncontrollable coughing.

name: Curse of Disease
description: Folk witch curse (EF 9) inflicting fevered disease and a Medium Wound.

name: Curse of Emotion
description: Folk witch curse (EF 12) making the target feel strong emotion toward someone.

name: Curse of Fortuna
description: VuFa 20 curse adding a botch die and minor misfortunes.

name: Curse of Mars
description: Greater ReMe ritual cursing a nation to internal strife.

name: Curse of Miscarriage
description: Folk witch curse (EF 9) that may make a pregnant woman miscarry.

name: Curse of Paralysis
description: Folk witch curse (EF 15) preventing movement of limbs.

name: Curse of Quotidian Fever
description: VuSa 25 curse inflicting quotidian fever.

name: Curse of Reduction
description: Folk witch curse (EF 18) reducing target Size monthly.

name: Curse of Rheumatism
description: Cat power giving rheumatism in the limb of anyone who touches (kicks) the cat.

name: Curse of Rotting Wood
description: PeHe 5 spell known by Edwin.

name: Curse of Slander
description: A Minor General or Supernatural Flaw: unpleasant rumors about the character spread wherever he stays, building a bad Reputation centered on a section of mundane society.

name: Curse of Weakness
description: VuFa 25 curse giving -1 to Strength rolls.

name: Curse of the Aged Swordsman
description: VuSa 15 curse causing hand cramping, -2 to affected activities.

name: Curse of the Beast
description: Folk witch curse (EF 18) turning the target into a small animal.

name: Curse of the Evil Humors
description: A MuAu 25 spell that converts clean air into a noxious cloud of foul humors that can cause malaria (a Medium Wound) on a failed Stamina roll.

name: Curse of the Faerie Forest
description: Enchantment/Conjure (Dream) 45 ritual changing a group into animals suited to their surface thoughts until they make amends.

name: Curse of the Festering Bruise
description: Evocation/Woe 20 rite cast on a weapon so the struck target's wound heals as Incapacitating.

name: Curse of the Haunted Forest
description: A Muto Herbam ritual (Level 60) with a Perdo requisite that turns a normal small forest into a haunted, conscious, and cruel dangerous place.

name: Curse of the Ravenous Swarm
description: A Creo Animal Ritual spell (Level 50) with a Rego requisite that calls a swarm of locusts or destructive insects to devastate an area's plant life and fields.

name: Curse of the Rotted Wood
description: A Perdo Herbam spell (Level 5) that causes a non-living wooden object up to the size of a door to rot and fall apart into dust.

name: Curse of the Tongue
description: Folk witch curse (EF 15) making the target forget all languages.

name: Curse of the Unruly Tongue
description: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 5) that causes the target to stutter and slur words, penalizing communication and spoken spellcasting.

name: Curse the Sinful Foe
description: Abbas' power, as Spasms of the Uncontrolled Hand.

name: Cursed
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab suffers a supernatural curse with appropriate Characteristic penalties.

name: Cursed (Duration)
description: Infernal conditional Duration that triggers an effect under a stated uncommon circumstance; equal to Duration Sun.

name: Cursed Guile
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw, the boy-who-cried-wolf curse likely from Infernal influence: three extra botch dice with Guile and rarely being believed even when honest.

name: Curses and Corruption
description: Mara's Tractatus on Area Lore: Cursewood, Quality 8.

name: Cursor
description: Athletic grog who proves in a trial run that a vis source is a seisin.

name: Curtain Wall
description: Crenelated wall around a bailey about thirty feet high, protected by mural towers.

name: Curtilage
description: Unroofed land enclosed within the messuage's wall, used for orchards or holding court.

name: Custodian
description: Custodial Redcap who escorts others through danger, guards Portals, collects fines and debts, and hunts bounties.

name: Customary Marriage
description: Simplest marriage form, most practiced by covenfolk: a year of cohabitation.

name: Customized Covenant Creation
description: Build Point rules for designing covenants, used to design covens.

name: Cutting the Cords
description: PeVi ritual used as a Tribunal punishment to permanently sever a magus's bond with his familiar.

name: Cweorth
description: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Fire twirl", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

name: Cybelle
description: A goddess of the wilderness honored in a True Merinitae Initiation festival held from the 15th to 27th of March, with rites including ritual castration beneath a sacred pine.

name: Cyclic Magic (Astrological)
description: Astrological variant of Cyclic Magic listed among the Curious Common Magics.

name: Cynewulf Gryreleoth
description: Horsingas magus who completed Jehan's training.

name: Cyrian
description: Blessed figure whose fingerbone relic Andru carries.

name: Cyrus the Great
description: Persian king who returned the Jews to Israel in 539 BC.

name: Czech
description: One of the three legendary founding brothers of the Slavic peoples; ancestor who led his tribe, the Czechs, to settle in Bohemia, and from whom the Premyslid dynasty descends.

name: Cú Chulainn
description: Legendary hero cited for dangerous childhood stories.

name: Dabbler
description: Type of magus Bonisagi playing with Range, Duration and Target; a Magic Theory specialization.

name: Dacia
description: Origin of another necromantic remnant group allied to Tremere.

name: Dacians
description: People who ruled Transylvania before the Romans, fighting under wolf-headed dragon banners.

name: Daduchos
description: Second rank of magi Bonisagi ('torch-bearers'), expected to attend the Grand Tribunal.

name: Daevas
description: Seven Zoroastrian evil spirits opposing the seven spentas; Naonhaithya is one.

name: Dafydd
description: Faerie prince who carried Isabelle through the air.

name: Dagger
description: Piercing/slashing Brawl weapon.

name: Dagger Attack
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Dagger of Ice
description: A Cr(Re)Aq 10 spell that creates and hurls a foot-long icicle inflicting +5 damage if it penetrates Magic Resistance, then shatters.

name: Dagverdara
description: Vindolanda's farmstead.

name: Dahut
description: Gradlon's daughter, seduced by the Devil, who became the siren Marie-Morgane.

name: Daimon (Virtue)
description: Free Social Status Virtue of all Daimons.

name: Daimon Points
description: Spiritual strength gained by a Daimon from Invoke Pact spells, spent to fix study, increase Might or Characteristics, or learn from other spirits.

name: Daimon Summoning Points
description: Points accumulated by Invoke Pact castings toward summoning a Daimon's Aspect.

name: Daimon of Revenge
description: The Daimon behind the She-Wolf and the Luperci cult; the She-Wolf is one of its Aspects, and it sends creatures of judgment to watch over new magistri.

name: Daimon of Vengeance
description: Daimon residing in the Magic Realm embodying revenge, of which the She-Wolf is an Aspect.

name: Daimonic Adjuration of Pukis
description: Andrilikes's Hermetic ritual that summons Pukis to a sanctum.

name: Dairmuid of Ex Miscellanea
description: Author of the Vim tractatus Unravel That Which is Cast.

name: Dajjal
description: The Antichrist in Islamic belief, to be slain by Jesus.

name: Dalmatia
description: Coast whose islands' vis rights are claimed by House Mercere.

name: Dalmatian Coast
description: Coast where Francis' ship to the Holy Land was wrecked in 1212.

name: Dalquiel
description: Ruler of Shehaqin.

name: Dama
description: The Praeco of the Provençal Tribunal, a House Merinita maga born in 993 who fell into Twilight and emerged, and is rumored to lead a Mystery Cult not part of House Merinita.

name: Damage Levels
description: How many damage levels a weapon or shield sustains before breaking; most have two, spears and lances one.

name: Damages
description: Hermetic penalty paid directly to the victim, including costs; in a March the victim gets a quarter of the outcast's estate.

name: Damhan-Alladh
description: Figure whose war centuries ago eliminated the vitkir from the British Isles.

name: Damme
description: Harbor for Bruges.

name: Damp
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is waterlogged or moist, spoiling parchment and ingredients (+1 Upkeep, -1 Health, -1 Aesthetics, +1 Aquam).

name: Damsel's Tresses
description: Rare golden spice growing on an ancient oak.

name: Dan O'Thunder
description: Flambeau magus who co-wrote a letter complaining about Horsingas.

name: Dance That Heals
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue from some Sufi traditions granting the ability to dance objects to wholeness, like Path of Walking Backward magi.

name: Dance of the Staves
description: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 5) that causes a long thin non-living wooden object to lash about wildly and strike its holder for +4 damage.

name: Daniel Tonatris
description: Author of Unveiling the Tempest.

name: Danket
description: Gravis's faerie caricature, a grumpy, stick-thin dwarf with a perpetual scowl contrasting Gravis's sunny disposition.

name: Danse Macabre
description: Dread Host practice of possessed troupes dancing to death.

name: Dante
description: Author of the Divine Comedy, to be written later in the thirteenth century.

name: Daoulas
description: Abbey.

name: Dareth of Tytalus
description: 63-year-old Rellantali magus jealous of Evoco, considering plotting with Verdi.

name: Dark Jerbiton
description: A group associated with the covenant of Oculus Septentrionalis that may be dovetailed with the demonic schemes of Radegast and Gymir.

name: Dark Mother
description: A chthonic spirit of the deep forest and fertile earth who resents the Church; Lise is her only priestess.

name: Dark Secret (Diedne Magic)
description: Flaw not appropriate for Tremere characters, since the House would react violently to a druidical lineage.

name: Darkness has power over all things general / Weather and wind and all courses variable
description: Debauchery/Effusion 20 flying winds.

name: Dart
description: Light javelin about three feet long used by Highlanders.

name: Das Goldene Kalb
description: Upmarket tavern and brothel in Lübeck owned by a Jerbiton magus, with an Infernal aura 3 tarnished with Lust.

name: Das Heldenbuch
description: Collection of German romances containing the legend of Dietrich.

name: Dasim
description: Son of Iblis with dominion over discord.

name: Data communis
description: Public reading of petitions performed by the vice-chancellor and notaries.

name: Daughter of Branded Criminal
description: Social Status Flaw of the Urchin.

name: Dauphiné
description: The domain of Lord Guigues, who commissioned a mechanized magpie automaton.

name: Davan
description: Tremere member of Postestas.

name: Dave
description: Example player with faerie knight.

name: David de Soulis
description: Hereditary seneschal of Scotland rumored to ride with demon dogs seeking souls for his demonic master.

name: Dazzling Appearance
description: Scitalis power (ReMe) stupefying all who look at it.

name: De Aluminibus et Salibus
description: Alchemical work attributed to Rhases.

name: De Amore
description: Book by Andreas Capellanus (1174) setting the rules of fin' amors; full title Incipit liber amoris et curtesie.

name: De Anima in Arte Alchimiae
description: Work attributed to Avicenna supporting transmutation.

name: De Congelatione
description: Avicenna's work denying real transmutation.

name: De Initio Creaturae
description: 11th-century treatise by Aelfric on Lucifer's rebellion and the gap it left among the angelic choirs.

name: De Laude Sanctorum
description: Theology summa (Quality 11, Level 5) by St. Victricius kept at Rouen Cathedral.

name: De Magia Sympathetica
description: A Tractatus on Magic Theory (Quality 11) by Elaine covering Arcane Connections and sympathetic connections.

name: De Operationes Daemonum Dialogos
description: Book by Michael Psellos; a Latin copy is a Summa on Infernal Lore Level 5 Quality 10.

name: De Operationes Daemonum Dialogus
description: Summa on Infernal Lore (Level 5, Quality 12) by Michael Psellos on the nature of demons.

name: De Ordinis Hermetici
description: An encyclopedia by Quaertus of Bonisagus comprising five Quality 9 tractatus on the Code of Hermes and Order of Hermes Lore (history and geography).

name: De Potestate et Obligatione
description: A Tractatus on Philosophiae (Quality 11) by Elaine discoursing on the responsible and ethical practice of magic, influenced by Saint Augustine's City of God.

name: De'dee
description: One of the Three Sisters.

name: Dead Language: Gothic
description: An Academic dead-language Ability used in all the rituals of House Bjornaer and essential to members of Clan Ilfetu, with little use outside ritual contexts.

name: Dead god
description: Eight-foot magical skeleton shackled beneath Sinews of Knowledge whose regrowing flesh slows aging.

name: Deadly Dance
description: Nain power compelling victims to dance until sunrise.

name: Deadly Gaze
description: Gorgon power transforming into stone any person or animal making eye contact.

name: Deadly Scream
description: Greater Power of the mandrake root, deadly to all who hear it when pulled from the soil.

name: Deals with the Devil
description: Pacts with demons sealed by oath or contract, often with curses to deter repentance; demons often cheat the supplicant.

name: Dean of Order
description: Monk, one per ten, responsible for keeping good order among his brethren.

name: Deanery
description: Group of up to two dozen rural parishes under a rural dean.

name: Death Shark
description: Psychopompic faerie shark, white with red eyes, that waits in the shallows until a sea-connected person dies.

name: Death of A Thousand Nightmares
description: Penalty for intruders into the Vermilion Temple: nightly death by one's personal nightmare for a thousand nights.

name: Death of Familiar
description: The most severe punishment short of a March, in which the convicted magus's familiar is killed.

name: Death's Vengeance
description: Fimus's Power exploding his body upon death.

name: Death's head moth
description: Moth believed to be a form of the moro.

name: Debatable Land
description: Borderland between England and Scotland where Patrick of Dunbar acts as judge.

name: Debilitation
description: Condition inflicted on those killed in a night battle.

name: Decadence
description: Fat golden demon with heavy chains and a giant mouth, dressed as a monk.

name: Decans
description: Three sub-periods into which each sign of the Zodiac is divided, revealing different aspects of the sign's influence.

name: Decay
description: Special gruagach ability of Damhan-allaidh. Like Perdo Animal and Corporem; characteristic Stamina.

name: Decay Fur and Hide
description: A Perdo Animal spell (Level 10) that destroys an object made of animal fur or hide, including wool and leather.

name: Decay of Eleven Score Years
description: Pasiel's power aging non-living objects to dust.

name: Decaying
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab's equipment, furnishings, and materials are neglected or gone bad (-1 General Quality, -1 Upkeep, -1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Deceiver's Boost
description: Enervator Power boosting a mortal's spell Casting Total while letting the demon manipulate it.

name: Decennial
description: Ten-yearly meeting of the Tremere Council at Coeris.

name: Decennials
description: Every second Quinquennial, open to turbs from surrounding tribunals.

name: Decree of the Atlantean
description: Atlantean power summoning a water creature within the same water-way.

name: Decretum
description: Gratian's compendium of papal decrees; Civil and Canon Law Summa Level 5 Quality 11.

name: Decumanus
description: The 500-pace north-south main street of the temple town.

name: Dedicated Building
description: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab is in its own building shared with no one else, reducing distractions (+1 Upkeep, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Rego).

name: Dedication
description: Legal recognition of a covenant as a place given a particular task, drawing specialists from across the Order.

name: Deed of London
description: Title deed for London, kept in a regio guarded by demons or faeries.

name: Deep Cover Disguise
description: Tytalus practice of assumed identities.

name: Defective Heating
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab has inadequate or missing heating and is too cold in winter (-1 General Quality, -1 Upkeep, -1 Health, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Defective Lighting
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is poorly lit, dingy and gloomy (-1 General Quality, -1 Upkeep, -1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Defenders as Interceptors
description: Optional defender rule requiring the defender to win action priority to intercept attackers.

name: Defense Bonus
description: Castle rating derived from Defense Quality that, multiplied by a size modifier, gives each wall's damage levels.

name: Defense of Sodales
description: The right of magi to act in a fellow magus's defense, for example by rescuing prisoners or avenging Redcaps.

name: Defense of the Art
description: The right to treat as an enemy anyone who publicly vows to purge wizards.

name: Defense of the Herd
description: White Stag power giving deer +2 defense as a trained group.

name: Defenses
description: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab has a sturdy defense such as a portcullis or battlements (+1 Aesthetics).

name: Defixio Magic
description: Magic practiced by Roman chthonic cults, descended from cartouche magic.

name: Defixione
description: Lead curse-tablet necromancy practiced by descendants of Guorna the Fetid.

name: Deformed
description: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: part of the structure has subsided or warped, e.g. a partially collapsed wall (-1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Deft Art
description: A Virtue, here Deft Art (Herbam), possessed by Ioannes Acer.

name: Deft Characteristic
description: Minor Child Virtue halving the age Characteristic Modifier for one Characteristic.

name: Deft Rune
description: Minor Virtue: no penalty when omitting name.

name: Degenerative
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the equipment and ingredients decay unnaturally quickly (+2 Upkeep, -1 Safety, +1 Warping, -2 Health, -1 Aesthetics, +2 Perdo).

name: Degree
description: A rank of status or Initiation within a Mystery Cult; each degree typically teaches a distinct Mystery Virtue.

name: Degree of Jupiter
description: Second degree of the Magoi of the Star, granting Potent Magic in the Initiate's birth house; robes deep blue.

name: Degree of Mars
description: Third degree of the Magoi of the Star, in red robes, opposing infernalists and initiating Periapts.

name: Degree of Mercury
description: Degree of the Magoi of the Star requiring teaching and travel, granting a Major Magical Focus relating to the Potent house.

name: Degree of Saturn
description: First degree of the Magoi of the Star, requiring Artes Liberales 4+ and initiating Planetary Magic; members wear black gowns.

name: Degree of Venus
description: Fourth degree of the Magoi of the Star, in emerald robe, teaching the Major Virtue Celestial Magic.

name: Deheubarth
description: An ancient Welsh principality in the south, centered on the fort of Dinefwr; once nearly unified under Lord Rhys.

name: Delay the Serpent's Venom
description: Stag of Virtue power delaying poison until sunrise or sunset.

name: Delayed Action
description: Choosing to act later in the round in response to events.

name: Delayed Sustenance of Fire
description: Delayed ReVi(Ig) container ritual.

name: Deliverance of the Righteous
description: Thrones power instantly transporting endangered worshippers to safety.

name: Della Scala
description: Family ruling Verona.

name: Delos
description: Aegean island once floating, tethered by Zeus; meeting place of the Theban Tribunal.

name: Deluge of Rushing and Dashing
description: A Creo Aquam spell that causes a stream to flood into a raging torrent, sweeping along and damaging anyone caught nearby.

name: Demesne
description: Land reserved for the lord's own use, farmed on his behalf by villeins as part of their rent; usually the most fertile land of the manor.

name: Demetrios of Athens
description: Mairi Sean's pater, a master of spirits in Greece, who sent Diana nam Grechanach to Mairi when his familiar died.

name: Demiurge
description: God's intermediary per theurgists, seen variously as good or as an evil spirit creating Divine and Infernal auras.

name: Demon Blood
description: Major Supernatural Virtue.

name: Demon Horse of Lord Goulis
description: Demon bound in horse form with fiery breath.

name: Demon Weakness
description: Each demon's vulnerability, knowable with Infernal Lore, which forces flight or prevents harm to a protected group.

name: Demon families
description: Groups of demons within an order sharing traits, including a common weakness.

name: Demon of Avarice
description: Demon that aids magi hoping to create a merchant class whose souls he can claim.

name: Demon of Greed
description: A local demon, disguised through an agent as a taverner, who wants the characters to ease a baron's overworked peasants so they can freely sin again.

name: Demon of Scrofula
description: A demon with Infernal Might that uses the Diseased Possession power to inflict the disease scrofula on a possessed victim.

name: Demon of Vendée
description: Demon trapped by a Magical ward in a sea cave at Vendée.

name: Demon's Visage
description: A Major Curse (Muto Corpus Animal effect) transforming the victim's head into a demon-like beast shape, penalizing communication, social rolls, and spell casting by -6.

name: Demon-Hunter
description: Magi who push the Code to seek out and destroy demons.

name: Demonic Orders
description: The nine orders of demons mirroring the nine angelic choirs, grouping demons by function and Might.

name: Demons of the Air
description: Class of demons warded off by an Enriched Thunderbolt of Virtue.

name: Demonstrating Harm
description: The part of a plea in which harm to a magus's interests must be shown.

name: Dendrophori
description: Fourth rank of magi Bonisagi ('tree-bearers'), from which Primi are chosen.

name: Denique of Quaesitor
description: Full member of Magvillus and Transitionalist.

name: Dent Coccinus
description: Giuseppe Del Mato's mastiff familiar, armored on raids.

name: Deny Them the Bridge
description: ReTe 30 spell that lifts a stone bridge with its foundations clear of the river and sets it elsewhere.

name: Dependence
description: Minor Child Personality Flaw: uncomfortable without a trusted mentor, -3 when alone.

name: Deployment Total
description: Intelligence + Area Lore + stress die, generated by commanders to determine Territorial Advantage.

name: Deriten
description: Demon who made a pact with Frederick Barbarossa and sought to claim Peris' lands.

name: Desert Truffle
description: Above-ground truffle of arid Mediterranean lands, believed to be created where lightning strikes the sand.

name: Desert of al-Meraya
description: Desert north of al-Meraya in southeast Iberia, inhabited by a thirsty spirit.

name: Desiderius of Verditius
description: An old Verditius magus of Voluntas who is a necromancer, smelling of rotting flesh, lately becoming sociable despite poor social skills.

name: Desires Rest
description: Ghost trait measuring how driven it is to conclude its earthly business.

name: Desperata
description: Example alchemist maga who achieves the Great Elixir aged 161.

name: Despot
description: Leader of a Byzantine successor state who grants pronia.

name: Destroy Fur and Hide
description: PeAn 5 spell known by Edwin.

name: Destroyers
description: Demon role winning souls through torment, death and disaster.

name: Determinata
description: Example maga seeking her missing shield grog via sympathetic divination.

name: Determine the Location of the Absent Volume
description: An Intellego Animal 25 spell (based on The Inexorable Search) that locates a missing book by showing the magus's sigil on a map, with an optional Creo requisite to project the location on a mirror.

name: Deus Sol Invictus
description: The 'unconquered sun', the name of the one God worshipped by the Sol Invictus cult, proclaimed official deity of Rome under Elagabalus and Aurelian.

name: Dev
description: Armenian giants with up to seven one-eyed heads; some can change into dragons or other monsters.

name: Deventer
description: A modest-sized city and early missionary-bishopric on the right bank of the Rhine, surrounded by marshland, with a church named after St. Lebuinus and at the center of a struggle against pirates.

name: Devil's Bridge
description: Bridge in Saint Gotthard's Pass, said to be built by the Devil.

name: Devil's Chamber
description: Cave.

name: Devil's Lane Workshops
description: A labyrinth of candle-lit basements beneath Devil's Lane where worker elves create the magic toys.

name: Devil's Mind
description: Mengalaz's power making him aware of everything in Devil's Lane.

name: Devoted Parent/Child
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is extremely attached to a parent or child, suffering anxiety and penalties when separated.

name: Devotion (Duration)
description: Holy magic Duration lasting as long as a religious observance continues; equal to Sun.

name: Devotion Point
description: Point of devotion to a saint listeners may gain from preaching.

name: Devotion Points
description: Dedicated experience points used only to raise Devotions, gained through pilgrimage, endowments, guilds, miracles, etc.

name: Devouring Regio
description: Rumored roaming Infernal regiones attracted to evil souls that swallow people and may deliver them to Hell.

name: Devouring the Heat of the Fire
description: Salamander power extinguishing any fire it touches.

name: Dexter
description: Follower of Bonisagus who co-trained Regina.

name: Dhampir
description: Major Supernatural Virtue: a half-vampire child with slowed aging, Second Sight and darkvision; Tremere recruit dhampirs as guards but forbid training them as Hermetic magi.

name: Dhikr
description: Sufi group meditation in which the names of God are intoned with bodily movement until closeness with Him is achieved.

name: Dhu'l-Fiqar
description: Two-pointed sword of the Prophet given to 'Ali; relic with Divine Might 70 that puts out enemies' eyes.

name: Diabetes
description: A Minor Sanguine, Lifelong Disease from rich food and gluttony, named by Aretaeus after the Greek word for a siphon.

name: Diabolic pact
description: Pact with the devil granting Virtues, signed by corrupt Vallumbrosans.

name: Diabolist (Virtue)
description: Free Special Virtue required of diabolists.

name: Diamond Mines of Solomon
description: A legendary treasure-site the Expedition covenant was founded to discover, following a map used by two prior expeditions that never returned.

name: Diana nam Grechanach
description: Young Greek girl from the Isle of Boetia training under Mairi Sean, sent by Demetrios of Athens; skilled in medicine.

name: Diana of Ex Miscellanea
description: A Mystagogue of the Disciples of the Worm.

name: Diana of Tremere
description: A Tremere maga of Blackthorn who declared a Wizards' War in 873 against William of Jerbiton of Rosalba.

name: Diaspora
description: The dispersal of the Jews after the fall of the Second Temple.

name: Diceless Defense
description: Option replacing the Defense stress die with a constant 6.

name: Dick Whittington's Cat
description: Helper cat who makes his master undeservedly rich.

name: Dictionarius
description: A famous 13th-century craft manual by John de Garlande about various trades that adds +4 to a craftsman's Workshop Total.

name: Didyma
description: A covenant in the Theban Tribunal linked to the city of Miletos by the Sacred Way, a mundane road that is also a major route from the faerie realm to the mundane world.

name: Diet of Roncaglia
description: Assembly defining Imperial rights, prompting a Tribunal decree against Literatus interfering.

name: Dietrich III
description: The duke of Upper Lorraine who dies in 1220 and is succeeded by Matthew II.

name: Dietrich von Bern
description: Daimon of the German hero-king of Bern who guards his dragon-blooded tomb in the Lessini Mountains.

name: Difficult Arts
description: Hedge Arts that advance as Abilities, preventing easy high Penetration.

name: Difficult Terrain
description: Terrain halving movement and adding a botch die.

name: Diminutive
description: A Minor laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab is configured for an especially small magus, causing difficulty for normal-sized users.

name: Dinan
description: Port with the Basilica of St. Savior.

name: Diocese of Bayeux
description: One of the oldest dioceses in Mythic Europe, founded by St. Exuperius.

name: Diodorus Siculus
description: Ancient author of the Bibliotheca Historica describing Egyptian shapechanger priests.

name: Dione of Quaesitor
description: Full member of Magvillus and Traditionalist.

name: Dionysios
description: God whose vineyards exist only in stories about him in the Faerie Realm.

name: Dionysius the Areopagite
description: Greek convert of St Paul believed to have written The Celestial Hierarchy.

name: Dionysus Exiguus
description: Collector of Church canons banning names of non-scriptural angels.

name: Direach
description: A gigantic version of the Fachan found in the Scottish Highlands.

name: Dirk
description: Main Highland weapon, a large knife sixteen to twenty inches long, sometimes used with the targe.

name: Dirne-Weibl
description: A wood-wife who dresses in a red frock and carries a basket of apples that turn to gold if she is treated courteously; her apples are Creo vis sought by magi.

name: Dirty
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is not kept to basic cleanliness, leaving the owner smelly (-1 Health, -2 Aesthetics, +1 Perdo).

name: Discipline Roll
description: A reaction roll (leader's Presence + Leadership + stress die) required when a group is tempted to break formation; failure makes the group disordered.

name: Discovery
description: Extraordinary Results Chart result required for original research, which must then be stabilized.

name: Discredited Lineage
description: Negative quality for Alpine recruitment.

name: Disease Recovery
description: Hermetic or setting concept referenced in the description of the Mythic Locations sites.

name: Diseased Possession
description: An infernal power, a variety of Possession, by which a demon enters a victim and spends Might to inflict a disease's contagion.

name: Disengagement
description: Reaction contest of Defense against opponents' Attack totals to move away while engaged.

name: Disguise of the Transformed Wizard
description: A Muto Imaginem 15 spell known by Imanitos Mendax.

name: Disguised
description: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab or its entrance is concealed mundanely, such as by a hidden door (-1 Aesthetics).

name: Disibodenberg
description: Benedictine abbey in the Rhineland where Hildegard and Jutta joined the nuns.

name: Disjointed Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw preventing the magus from using prior knowledge of similar spells or enchantment bonuses to aid his magic.

name: Disorder
description: Alpine term for intercovenant warfare, technically legal but seen as deeply immoral.

name: Disordered Group
description: A group that failed a Discipline or Morale check; trained groups function as untrained, and untrained disordered groups hit only half as often.

name: Disorganized
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is organized haphazardly, though some magi prefer it (-1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics, +1 Muto or Experimentation).

name: Disorienting Magic
description: Supernatural Flaw available to vitkir.

name: Disparagement
description: Illegal selling of a ward's marriage or marriage to unsuitable persons.

name: Dispassionate
description: A new Minor Personality Flaw making one unable to express strong emotions; the first Sacrifice on the Arcadian Path.

name: Dispel Fortuna Belli
description: VuFa 5 curse forcing re-rolls of positive Attack Advantage.

name: Dispel the Phantom Image
description: A Perdo Imaginem (General) spell that destroys the image from any one Creo Imaginem spell whose level the caster matches or exceeds on a stress die plus spell level.

name: Dispensation
description: Exception granted by bishop or pope, e.g. for priests not meeting ordination criteria.

name: Disputants
description: Tremere certamen specialists.

name: Dissolution
description: Air elemental power making matter lose cohesion and melt.

name: Distance Level
description: Measure of line length used as Ease Factor for Line Range calculations.

name: Distant Eidolon
description: Manannan's power to create an illusory form to converse and deliver messages, giving him Arcane Connections.

name: Distillation of the Purest Stream
description: A Rego Vim 15 spell (R: Touch, D: Mom, T: Ind) that concentrates the essence of exceptionally pure stream water into a pawn of Aquam vis.

name: Distorted Ghosts
description: Ghosts of miners bound and warped by Averna (Magic Might 6 Mentem).

name: Distraction of the Magpie
description: A Muto Mentem spell that alters the target's estimation so shiny objects become highly desirable and distracting.

name: Divide the Gathered Essence
description: ReVi 25 spell transferring raw vis from an item into one or more containers.

name: Dividing the Enemy
description: Alpine policy of rewarding one party for betraying its allies in a coalition against the Alps.

name: Divination (Numerology)
description: Numerological divination for which Hermetic Numerology is prerequisite; the Numerologist's Book adds to it as ceremonial bonus.

name: Divine Aid Bonus
description: Bonus of up to +3 to rolls furthering an objective, gained by invoking God's aid.

name: Divine Authority
description: Authority power giving absolute knowledge and command over one aspect of creation.

name: Divine Balance
description: Potentate power creating a virtuous thought to oppose a devil's sinful suggestion.

name: Divine Being
description: Any creature with Divine Might.

name: Divine Comedy
description: Dante's great medieval work, not yet written in 1220.

name: Divine Direction
description: Domination power to command beings of equal or lesser Divine Might or those aligned to the Divine.

name: Divine Elections
description: Procedure for electing a grand master.

name: Divine Guidance
description: Angel power modifying Personality Trait rolls toward virtue.

name: Divine Insight
description: Cherubim power granting Clear Thinker, Free Expression or Inspirational until the target sins.

name: Divine Justice
description: Thrones power to learn the truth and most just judgment of a case.

name: Divine Office
description: The daily prayers recited at the canonical hours, also called the Opus Dei or Liturgy of the Hours.

name: Divine magic
description: Holy magic taught to guardians of Purgatory.

name: Divining the True Heir
description: InCo 20 spell revealing the relationships of a group of claimants to a target bloodline.

name: Djinni of Aladdin
description: The djinni from Aladdin and the Wonderful Lamp who grants wishes and lets Aladdin fly.

name: Doctor
description: The title held only by graduates of a university faculty of medicine (or those with Clerk and Medicine 3+), the only physicians with formal claim to it.

name: Doctrine of Foreshadowing
description: Doctrine justifying pagan mysteries as presaging Christianity.

name: Doctrine of Origen
description: Origen's heretical teachings including the Perfectibility of Man and that stars are living beings and signs rather than causes.

name: Dog that Flew
description: A Warped hunting dog with grey feathered wings, able to glide, hiding near Hersfeld.

name: Dogger Bank
description: Shallowest part of the North Sea and a rich fishing ground whose destruction would cause famine and war.

name: Dol
description: Town with a cathedral to St. Samson.

name: Doliónes
description: Original Greek inhabitants of Bear Island, ruled by King Kyzikos.

name: Dolmen of Bagneux
description: Largest dolmen in the Samur region with a low Magic aura.

name: Dolmen of Kerguntuil
description: Petrified giant dolmen.

name: Dolorosa
description: Example maga who makes a staff talisman with multiple components.

name: Dolphin of Virtue
description: The fastest fish in the ocean, friendly to man, fond of music, and a harbinger of storms.

name: Dombnall
description: Example gruagach with an External Soul who creates a Boar Tattoo.

name: Domesday Book
description: Record that lists English manors, including one manor that had no inhabitants.

name: Domestic Animal
description: A Free Social Status Virtue (animals only) for an animal that is the property of a covenant or character.

name: Domestic Work
description: Focus power performing household tasks from a distance, including kindling fires and hurling objects.

name: Domhnall the Gruagach
description: A gruagach character.

name: Domhnall the Gruagach Master
description: Gifted gruagach master from a Scottish highland village, a large cudgel-wielding man who fought the English and seeks to rebuild a collective.

name: Dominate Canine
description: Black Dog power making canines obey its voice.

name: Domination
description: Arkliss' gaze power to bend a person to one command.

name: Dominations
description: Choir governing the Divine realm and ordering lesser angels.

name: Dominia the Ascetic
description: Example character with True Faith 1 who experiences Divine Ascent and Divine Gloom.

name: Dominican
description: One of the two major new mendicant friar orders of the early thirteenth century, growing rapidly in popularity.

name: Dominicus
description: A magus of House Jerbiton exonerated by the Normandy Tribunal of 898 for using Wizard's War to avenge a slain amicus, establishing legal precedent for avenger pledges.

name: Dominicus of House Jerbiton
description: Magus who slew Gravis in 891 AD and was acquitted of seeking retribution by Wizard War in 898 AD.

name: Dominion (Target)
description: Holy magic Target affecting everything within a divine aura whose source is in range; equal to Boundary.

name: Dominion Rite
description: Ritual by a celebrant with an appropriate Social Virtue before a congregation of ten, used to consecrate an area and allow the Dominion to enter it.

name: Dominus
description: Term meaning master or lord used by an apprentice for his master; domina for a maga.

name: Domleschg druids
description: Community of 15 druids at Domleschg who resisted Díedne.

name: Domnhull Beg
description: Magus of House Bonisagus, son of the clan chief, trained at Durenmar to integrate gruagach magic with Hermetic magic; holds the covenant's Hermetic title and dreams of founding a new House for the gruagach.

name: Domnhull's Oak Staff Talisman
description: Domnhull Beg's talisman with bonuses to destroy, control, project bolt, repel and protection from storms.

name: Domnu
description: Chthonic titan of darkness and fertility, mother of the Fomoire.

name: Domovoi
description: Slavic brownie living beneath the threshold or stove, a hairy little man with tail and horns who predicts the future.

name: Domus Magna of House Tytalus
description: Tytalus headquarters that floats smugly off the coast of Normandy and causes strife in neighboring Tribunals.

name: Donald Ban
description: Malcolm Canmore's brother who resisted English influence and was twice king before being blinded by Edgar.

name: Donald Dubh
description: Young gruagach used as an example of learning new Exceptional Talents such as Magic Sensitivity and Transform.

name: Donation of Constantine
description: Document recording Constantine's gift of the Western Empire to the Papacy; those who saw it died within a year.

name: Donatism
description: Ancient heresy that sacraments are invalid when performed by unworthy priests.

name: Donatus
description: Author of Ars Grammatica.

name: Donegal
description: Region of Ireland where Saint Patrick preached his ministry.

name: Donestre
description: Lion-headed human faerie using Faerie Speech to lure travelers off roads to be eaten, then weeping beside their heads.

name: Donncadh Mac Calum
description: Chief of Clan Mac Gruagach, a former hell-raiser now worn down by old wounds, who dreads passing the clan to his son Raibert and struggles to check his brother Lachlan.

name: Doolin
description: A guild master clothier living in Paris, a man of inexhaustible energy who makes excellent quality clothing and dreams of monopolizing the formal attire of wizards.

name: Dordogne River
description: River in Périgord.

name: Dorisa
description: Maga of Ex Miscellanea who charged Redcap Constantine with taking twelve pawns of vis from her sanctum.

name: Douai
description: City with a great keep of the Counts of Flanders.

name: Doubt
description: A Major Curse (Rego Mentem effect) filling the victim with doubt, requiring Intelligence rolls before undertaking any activity.

name: Douglas
description: One of the three towns on the Isle of Man.

name: Doué-la-Fontaine
description: Site of rock containing Creo vis with power to preserve flesh.

name: Dovecote
description: Small building housing several hundred doves or pigeons that tenants may not harm; attracts familiars and magical animals.

name: Dover Castle
description: Castle whose octagonal three-story archery Bell Tower (built 1189) exemplifies the archery-tower extreme of mural-tower design.

name: Dover Strait
description: Strait averaging 33 paces deep.

name: Dower
description: Payment by a husband's family to an heiress's father or guardian.

name: Down Tor
description: A group of stones on Dartmoor with a circle around a barrow and a long line of stones said to bind and channel a powerful ghost that can be summoned along the line by those who know the rituals.

name: Downpatrick
description: Site on the Circuit of Saint Patrick.

name: Downside
description: The other end of Devil's Lane; on Walpurgis Night an entrance to Hell briefly appears there.

name: Dowry
description: Money or goods paid by the bride's family to the bride upon marriage.

name: Dowsing Rod
description: Fetish for Dowsing; enchanted with 1 pawn of Intellego vis.

name: Dozens of Eyes
description: Gorgon power of omnidirectional eyes granting extraordinary Perception.

name: Dragon Hill
description: A small hill near the White Horse of Uffington with a flat top on which nothing will grow.

name: Dragon banner
description: Enchanted wolfish dragonhead battle banner carried for each exarch.

name: Dragon of Assisi
description: Dragon seen prowling Assisi's walls in Sylvester's dream, put to flight by a cross from Francis' mouth.

name: Dragon of Brand
description: Dragon listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Dragon of the Pyrenees
description: Powerful creature used as a scale comparison with magical Highland giants.

name: Dragon of the Sauerland
description: A dragon that must be conquered and its heart eaten as the second Quest of the Path of Energy.

name: Dragon's licking stone
description: Rock in a dragon cave that ends hunger when licked; House Mercere would pay handsomely for it.

name: Dragonet
description: Small, quick fire-breathing dragon with corrosive blood.

name: Dragons and Dragonets
description: Creatures listed in the Tribunal index; Vorarlberg dragon myths are cited as a source.

name: Drain Energy
description: Cat power similar to Invocation of Weariness at Touch or Eye range.

name: Drake images
description: Lesser dragon images Pan Caudarax sends to assess the strength of the armada.

name: Dram of the Lion
description: MuCo(An) 35 ritual charged potion turning the drinker into a lion for a year.

name: Dramatic Elements
description: The breakdown of a story's structure into dramatis personae (roles) and acts, following the structure common to folktales.

name: Draper
description: Great official responsible for clothing.

name: Drawing Down the Moon
description: Thessalian sexual sorcery now summoning Selene.
