name: Drawing Up the Siege Ladder
description: A Rego Herbam 15 spell originally for hauling siege ladders over castle walls, used by librarians to rearrange wooden furniture and move groups of wooden objects.

name: Dreadful Bane of the Fae
description: A general Perdo Vim spell invented by Philippus Niger, like Demon's Eternal Oblivion but working on creatures with Faerie Might.

name: Dreadful Howl
description: Black Dog power like Weight of a Thousand Hells.

name: Dream Calling
description: Dream interpreter ability to make a touched sleeper dream about a chosen subject (Ease Factor 6).

name: Dream Duration
description: New Duration lasting for an actual dream, equivalent to Concentration.

name: Dream Portal
description: Portal within dreams, created by physical travelers or occurring naturally, leading to memory, imagination, the dreamscape, or back to the real world.

name: Dream Rituals
description: Ritual magic in dreams cast spontaneously via Ceremonial Magic rules, requiring dream vis.

name: Dream Target
description: New Mentem Target allowing travel into one sleeper's dream, equivalent to Individual.

name: Dream of the Artifice
description: InTe 50 spell like Dream of the Mind that Sits for artificial stone.

name: Dream of the Forged
description: InTe 55 ritual like Dream of the Mind that Sits for metal objects.

name: Dreamer's Eternal Oblivion
description: Level 10 dream variant of Demon's Eternal Oblivion used by a diabolist dream traveler against Morphea.

name: Drekavac
description: Serbian faerie drawn to Christmas celebrations.

name: Drinking
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Drogo Invigilor
description: A Tremere magus of Fengheld closely associated with the Welfs, investigated by House Guernicus over suspicions he arranged accidents for the emperor's heirs.

name: Drop of Spring Water of Aquam Vis
description: Drop of vis creating a spring on bare earth.

name: Drowned Man
description: A person who died at sea and was returned to life by a mysterious sea power, like Osgood.

name: Druid Lore
description: Lore in which the White Ladies are steeped.

name: Druidism
description: Tradition from which Hermetic magic arose; anti-Druidical prejudice persists.

name: Druids' Circle
description: A stone circle on a moor overlooking the Irish Sea whose entrance stones are sensitive to oaths and move nearer to swearers; dark tales say druids practiced human sacrifice there.

name: Druids' Dale
description: Diedne covenant sponsored by the Well of the Head in 956; destroyed in the Schism War.

name: Druon Antigon
description: A giant who plagued the Scheldt estuary cutting off hands; slain by Silvius Brabo.

name: Drusela of Blackthorn
description: Maga who trained and then cast out Jehan.

name: Drusus
description: Roman who conquered Bavaria in 15 BC.

name: Dry Rot of a Hundred Years
description: PeHe 15 spell of Whitburh's destroying ten paces of wooden structure.

name: Dryad
description: Beings tending trees in a primeval forest tether.

name: Dryades
description: Greek genii loci of forests.

name: Dublin
description: City seized by Godred Crovan along with the Sudreys.

name: Duck
description: Large bird brought down by paired hawks.

name: Dudo of St Quentin
description: Historian (960-1025), author of History of the Normans.

name: Duel for love
description: Certamen fought without a political issue, without vis.

name: Duguth
description: Old Saxon term Horsingas uses for its band of weardmenn instead of turb.

name: Duke Francio
description: Legendary ancestor of the Frankish kings who fought alongside Priam at Troy.

name: Duke Leopold of Austria
description: Duke insulted by Richard on crusade who imprisoned him.

name: Duke Mark
description: Ruler who refused St. Paul a bell.

name: Duke Simon
description: Example noble with many vassals.

name: Duke William of Aquitaine
description: Father of Eleanor who died on pilgrimage in 1137.

name: Duke of Aquitaine
description: Founder of Cluny who made the monastery free from secular authority and subject only to the pope.

name: Duke of Purgatory (power)
description: Pasiel's constant power boosting Might against control within Purgatory.

name: Dull Weapon
description: Hagbui power (PeTe 5) reducing a weapon's damage bonus to zero.

name: Dumah
description: One of the Maskim, Chief of the Avengers of Evil, the Angel of the Silence of Death, a thousand-eyed angel armed with a fiery rod.

name: Dumping Ground
description: Covenant Hook: covenant cares for old and infirm nobles, risking interference charges if magic restores them.

name: Dunadd
description: Former capital of the Scottish kingdom.

name: Duncan Bad Blooded
description: MacBeth's predecessor, claimed ancestor of the Earls of Dunbar.

name: Duncan I
description: Grandson of Malcolm II who became King of Scots in 1034; killed by MacBeth.

name: Duncan II
description: Malcolm's son raised in the Norman court, made king by William Rufus, then murdered.

name: Duncan the Bold
description: Example clan warrior who suffers a Geas and Curse from Brude Deathless, is Gifted by the Old Woman of the Heather, and has his Geas lifted by Domnhull Beg.

name: Dunoding
description: A region of Wales near an island where the swynwyr established Pralix's military headquarters, later renamed Cad Gadu.

name: Duplicate the Magi's Control
description: Jaevert's power duplicating Rego spells.

name: Duplicate the Magi's Creation / Perception / Transmutation / Destruction / Control
description: Deluders Powers duplicating Hermetic spells of one Technique.

name: Duplicate the Magi's Transmutation
description: Jaevert's power duplicating Muto spells.

name: Duplicate the Mechanism
description: Cr(In)Te 35 Ritual creating an exact duplicate of an existing mechanism.

name: Duplicate the Noble Mechanism
description: Level 45 ritual variant creating a precious-metal mechanism.

name: Durable External Soul
description: Major Virtue kolduni must purchase so their External Soul can only be destroyed in a very specific manner.

name: Durand
description: A freeman who founded the Capuchonnes in the 1180s.

name: Duro
description: Youngest magus of Literatus, wishing to pursue the Dark Arts in seclusion.

name: Dust Devil
description: A Minor Supernatural Skinchanger variant letting a character become a Size +1 dust devil whirlwind, focused through a glass amulet of Magic-aura sand.

name: Dust Devil of Auram Vis
description: Small whirlwind of vis keeping air breathable.

name: Dutiful Movement
description: A common automaton power (base effect 20) letting the automaton walk and follow its creator around.

name: Dvergar
description: Norse dwarves originally maggots in the corpse of Ymir, given intelligence by the gods; they flee sunlight and crafted the treasures of the gods.

name: Dwarf (Faerie)
description: Faerie with typical Might 5 that may seek to become a dwarf king.

name: Dwarf (Flaw)
description: Flaw suggested for dwarf-blooded characters.

name: Dwarf-forged warhammer
description: Gull's magical battle hammer, head over 1000 lbs, with the Break Wards power able to shatter the Aegis of the Hearth.

name: Dybbukim
description: Spirits cut off from heaven that possess the living.

name: Dyer's Guild
description: Small Parisian guild infiltrated by Fudarus, producing magically enhanced dyes.

name: Dying Giant
description: A giant pinned to the earth by rocks near Anne's manor, whose blood yields Corpus vis.

name: Dying Master
description: Mengalaz.

name: Dyscrasia
description: The imbalanced state of humors producing a patient's symptoms, which a physician must understand to bring the humors back into balance.

name: Dysenteric Infliction
description: Saint curse destroying the target with fatal dysentery.

name: Eagle Clan
description: A Crintera clan of the nimblest, keen-eyed grogs who are expert archers, acting as spies, hunters, and an informant network across Europe.

name: Eagle of Virtue
description: A magical eagle with wondrous eyesight that rejuvenates itself by flying to the sun and diving into a fountain.

name: Ear
description: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Grave", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

name: Ear of Truth
description: InMe 30 spell letting the caster tell whether he hears the truth; used to endorse testimony.

name: Earl Harald
description: Earl of Orkney (Harald Maddaderson) who invaded Moray and Ross from 1197; his family was cursed to be bellicose.

name: Earl of Norfolk
description: Powerful English noble facing the North Sea, husband of William Longespee's mother.

name: Early Punishment for the Sinful Witch
description: MuVi(Ig) Gen destroying an Infernal effect on an infernalist in white flame.

name: Ease Factor
description: Target number for casting Geasa, Gifts and Curses.

name: Easing the Strain of Childbirth
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: East Anglia
description: Region where peasants maintain dykes and lords of marshy manors run large sheep flocks.

name: East Prussia
description: Region whose forests hide the regio castle where a maiden told Gunnar of the Green Stone.

name: Eastern Christendom
description: A cultural society of Mythic Europe centered on the Byzantine empire and Constantinople, defining its own Social Statuses.

name: Eastern Patriarch
description: Head of the Eastern Church.

name: Eastern Tribunal
description: One of the Tribunals named in 865.

name: Eastern magic
description: Arab and Persian magical technology channeled through spirits and sometimes powered by demons.

name: Eavesdrop with the Eyes
description: TaVs 10 spell letting the gruagach's fetch relay conversations of anyone within the caster's field of vision.

name: Eberhardini
description: A clan of vagantes from northern Italy forming one chapter of the Ordo Vagorum.

name: Echeneis, the Remora
description: Fish of the Farne Islands.

name: Ecumenical Council
description: Special synod called and presided over by the pope; twelve have been held.

name: Edessa
description: Crusader city whose fall in 1144 triggered the Second Crusade.

name: Edicts of Augustus
description: Athenaeus' second-century tractatus on Civil and Canon Law recording Augustus' investiture.

name: Edifice
description: Church Boon representing a notable building feature, such as a church tower.

name: Edifice Boon
description: A covenant Boon that troupes may select instead of paying Build Points for a Great Work.

name: Eduardus
description: Tytalus magus apprenticed in Jerbiton, steward of Montverte under the persona Edward; a member of the purple Fideli.

name: Educated (Bardic)
description: A Minor General Virtue for attending a Hibernian bardic school, granting 50 experience points in storytelling and lore Abilities.

name: Educated (Vernacular)
description: A Minor, General Virtue representing secular instruction given by tutors to scions of merchant houses, granting Academic Abilities and 50 extra experience points for practical business skills.

name: Edward I of England
description: English king who arbitrates the Scottish succession and conquers Scotland.

name: Edward the Confessor
description: English king at whose court Malcolm Canmore grew up.

name: Effica
description: Example maga with Mutable Puissant Terram.

name: Efficient & Permanent Wall of Protecting Stone
description: CrTe 20 ritual creating a permanent stone wall of 10,000 cubic paces, the maximum at no extra cost for a fourth-magnitude ritual.

name: Efnisien
description: A Welsh hero claimed by some as the first of the Nemthengacha, the bitter-tongued Ex Miscellanea tradition.

name: Egbert
description: Brother of Elizabeth of Schönau who helped with and influenced the reports of her visions.

name: Egg of Animal Vis
description: Snake egg of vis that releases poisonous snakes when warmed.

name: Eginolf
description: A magus of House Flambeau of Rudiaria covenant against whom charges of diabolism were brought (unproven) in 962 AD.

name: Egyházasfalu
description: Future Templar site in Hungary.

name: Egyptian days
description: Inauspicious days whose observation was a forbidden practice for inquisitors.

name: Eibingen
description: Place across the Rhine where Hildegard founded a nunnery in 1165.

name: Eidolons
description: Airy Spirits of emotions created by humans near strong magic.

name: Eildon Hills
description: Hollow hills near Melrose containing a faerie community led by the Queen of Elfland, with regio leading to Arcadia; split into three by Michael Scot's demon.

name: Eilean Beg
description: Covenant where Uierna met the young gruagach Chearlach Mac Caolin.

name: Ein Sof
description: The infinite and unknowable counterpart to the Sefirot; hubristic kabbalists who strive for it risk temptation.

name: Einhard
description: Historical author of The Life of Charlemagne, listed among the period works in the bibliography.

name: Eirik
description: Example vitki.

name: Eisheth Zenunim
description: One of the four demon wives of Iblis, a demon of prostitution.

name: Eithne
description: Prophetic member of the Fomoire.

name: El Cid
description: Iberian hero whose tales Flambeau magi love.

name: Elagabalus
description: Roman emperor who declared Sol Invictus the State religion in the early third century and was removed four years later.

name: Elbe
description: A river haunted by a Wild Hunt led by Frau Wode and by shadowy boatmen carrying invisible passengers.

name: Elbruz Mountains
description: The mountains where Baghl the earth jinni haunts a dark cave formerly used as a quarry.

name: Eleanor Sworder
description: The woman who has led Nigrasaxa's turb for five years and aspires to be a knight; bears an ugly scar on her left cheek.

name: Eleanor of England
description: Daughter of Henry II and Eleanor of Aquitaine who married Alfonso VIII and co-founded Las Huelgas in 1187.

name: Electus
description: Third degree of the Fraternity of Samos, which teaches the esoteric principles of astrology and grants Planetary Magic.

name: Elegans
description: Magus of Mercere at Harco who makes longevity potions and magic items.

name: Elemental Affinity
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue giving Elementalist Form xp when studying a chosen Ability.

name: Elemental Spirit of the Waves
description: Potent water elemental possibly penned inside the island's wall, dying and furious; Magic Might 35.

name: Elemental Warping
description: Elementalist warping as elemental Personality Traits that add to Soak and can cause madness.

name: Elemental kings
description: Powerful spirits of the Magic realm whose favor Archmage Vinaria of Merinita must win for her archmage challenge.

name: Elemental spirits
description: Primordial spirits of fire and water that retreated underground, revealed in hot and cold springs.

name: Elementalist Air (Virtue)
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Elementalist Air 0 and a Sanguine trait.

name: Elementalist Earth (Virtue)
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Elementalist Earth 0 and a Melancholic trait.

name: Elementalist Fire (Virtue)
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Elementalist Fire 0 and a Choleric trait.

name: Elementalist Societies
description: Groups of likeminded elementalists sharing particular Techniques and Forms; initiating members via Mystery Cult rules.

name: Elementalist Water (Virtue)
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Elementalist Water 0 and a Phlegmatic trait.

name: Elementary
description: A Major laboratory Outfittings Flaw: a cut-down lab with extremely limited equipment allowing only one category of lab activity, cheap to maintain (-2 General Quality, -3 Upkeep).

name: Elephant of Virtue
description: A wise magical elephant that lives three hundred years and never forgets; it must eat mandrake root to mate.

name: Eleutherius
description: Assistant of St. Denis, martyred with him.

name: Elevated
description: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab is at least four floors up or atop a tower, commanding a view (+1 Aesthetics, +1 Auram).

name: Elisha
description: Old Testament prophet whose 'Death in the Pot' story is thought to involve desert truffles.

name: Elixir Points
description: Points from extra ingredients determining Elixir Level for the Lesser Elixir.

name: Ellyon
description: Welsh brownie-like faeries that vanish forever if they learn they are being spied upon.

name: Elohim
description: Angelic messengers.

name: Eloi of Jerbiton
description: Founder and prior of Cunfin, a pious Gentle Gifted magus bridging Order and Church.

name: Elpis
description: Hope, the only being remaining in Pandora's jar.

name: Elsa
description: The young widowed duchess of Brabant rescued by the Knight of the Swan Lohengrin, whom she wedded and lost when she broke her vow not to ask his name.

name: Elspeth
description: Example tainted midwife dedicated to a demon at birth, devoting newborns to her demon.

name: Elysian Guardian
description: Guardian of the Path of Destiny, usually of the kerberos type, conferring a hero symbol with a boon and prohibition.

name: Elysian Quest
description: Reenacting a legend on the Path of Destiny to gain insight or a boon of faerie nature.

name: Ember Days
description: Four seasonal fasts of the western Church whose Thursdays are when the benandanti fight; kresniks also battle then.

name: Embodying the Light
description: Cumulative powers of divine light gained at True Faith Scores 2, 3 and 5, based on the theological virtues Devotion, Hope and Charity.

name: Emerald Coast
description: Northern coast near Mont St. Michel.

name: Emerald of Charlemagne
description: A 28-pound 'emerald' of glass at Reichenau, among many spurious relics.

name: Emerald of Virtue
description: Gem containing 2 pawns of Animal vis that, Enriched in a snake's nest, grants Animal Ken restricted to serpents.

name: Emeralds
description: Emeralds listed in the Tribunal index among minerals and substances.

name: Emesa
description: Syrian city where the Sol cultists kept a hidden temple with relics from Elagabalus' reign; liberated by Crusaders in 1110.

name: Emet
description: Word meaning 'truth' written on a golem's forehead; erasing the aleph makes it 'met' (death) and returns the golem to clay.

name: Emotion Theft
description: A Supernatural Ability granted by the Thief of Emotions Virtue, allowing one to steal an emotion from a person and transfer it to another by touch.

name: Emotion-Enhancing Aura
description: A Magic aura that grants or modifies Personality Traits of those without Magic-derived supernatural abilities, e.g. Aggressive, Carefree, Communicative, Respectful.

name: Emperor Aurelian
description: 3rd-century emperor who built Rome's walls.

name: Empire of Nicea
description: Possible location for the Cursewood in the Theban Tribunal variant.

name: Empowering Prison of the Declining Spirit
description: Re(Mu)Vi(Forms) general Mystery enchantment that traps a spirit in a device and drains its Might to power Ritual effects.

name: Empress Helena
description: Empress who originally discovered the bodies of the Three Wise Men on her pilgrimage to the Holy Land.

name: Empyreal realm
description: Realm to which Nerius could travel through his greater regio spell.

name: Emrys
description: A Welsh seer who made a pact with faeries to trade his life for his son Ambrosius's, serving as magical advisor to a faerie court; his spirit could be seen watching over the boy.

name: Enais
description: The Peacock Angel revered by the Mulhidun, who extinguished Hell's fires and released its demons.

name: Enbarr
description: Manannan's horse, Splendid Mane, which runs faster than the wind and trots across water.

name: Enchanted Anchor of Verdi
description: Iron anchor keeping Verdi's lake clean and fresh.

name: Enchanted Baron's Chair
description: Centuries-old high chair enchanted with a Mentem effect to ensure the baron's compliance; slightly Warps its occupants.

name: Enchanted Brooch
description: Hermetic enchanted item lost by a Redcap that makes travel easier, found by a Franciscan friar.

name: Enchanted Caman of Count Gwyridden
description: Gwyridden's enchanted shinty stick.

name: Enchanted Devices
description: Hermetic enchantments forming the basis of magical technology.

name: Enchanted Item
description: Magic device that can be triggered as a combat action.

name: Enchanted Items
description: Magic items churches may possess, costing 1 Build Point per level.

name: Enchanted Priest
description: Story element: local priest held by a disgruntled faerie.

name: Enchanted birthing chair
description: An enchanted chair at Voluntas's village that ensures almost all mothers and children survive childbirth, giving Wilton unusually high life expectancy.

name: Enchantment of the Magnified Regio
description: MuVi(Te) 39 Mystery enchantment doubling the size of a Magical regio up to 200 paces across.

name: Enchantment of the Pedestrian Pigeon
description: A MuMe 15 spell that occludes a person's memory of told information until a key phrase unlocks it, used for secure transfer of information between conspirators.

name: Enchantment to Block the Assault of Iron
description: Rego Terram 20 spell by Domnhull Beg, focused on an iron ring, enchanting an item that blocks attacks with substantial metal components.

name: Enchantment to Block the Assault of Wood
description: Rego Herbam 20 spell by Domnhull Beg, focused on a wooden ring, blocking attacks with substantial wooden components.

name: Enclosure Movement
description: Post-game-period English movement that popularized the tragedy-of-the-commons idea and gave greens to landed gentry.

name: Encroaching Dominion
description: Scenario presented in Tales of Power, apt for approaching the Apple Gild.

name: Endless Wine
description: Faun power filling vessels with wine.

name: Endor
description: Home of the woman with a familiar spirit.

name: Endorsing Testimony
description: Process by which a Quaesitor magically verifies a witness's testimony after the witness lowers Parma.

name: Endow the Servant of Retribution
description: She-Wolf ritual power imposing the Spiritual Pact Virtue on a target.

name: Endurance of the Flame Dancer
description: Flame Dancer power to feel unwounded and unfatigued until sunrise or sunset.

name: Endurance of the Gluttonous
description: Mahonin's Power making the possessed oblivious to pain while eating.

name: Energy Sense
description: InCo(Me) 20 spell sensing a target's Fatigue status.

name: Enfolding
description: Angelic power (Vim) rendering the soul, or at greater cost the body, of the pious wholly protected for a brief moment.

name: Engadine valley
description: Valley from which Josephine hails.

name: Engagement
description: State of being within reach or line of fire of an enemy; engaged characters must disengage to move.

name: Engelbert I
description: The current archbishop of Cologne, a tall, fair, and just man holding the status of Archchancellor of Italy, martyred in 1225 if the saga follows real history.

name: Enhance the Memory Palace
description: CrMe 20 locus spell.

name: Enigmatic Cord
description: Special familiar cord forged by Radislav with Volya granting the Visions talent.

name: Enigmatic Magic
description: Criamon magic Auctus sought to integrate.

name: Enlighten
description: Gabriel's power to implant Knowledge.

name: Enliven the Gross (Elemental Form)
description: Ritual Power creating and controlling an elemental from raw elemental matter.

name: Enliven the Gross Fire
description: Ritual power letting a fire elemental spawn more fire elementals.

name: Enliven the Gross Water
description: Phorcys' ritual power to create and control a water elemental of Might up to 39.

name: Enliven the Gross Waters
description: Anne's Ritual Power creating water elementals.

name: Ennoble the Base
description: Berith's Power making a target see something as more noble than it is.

name: Enriched Objects of Virtue
description: Objects enriched using Magic Lore that could spread in Mythic Europe.

name: Enter the Faerie Forest
description: Gegenes power to pass between the faerie forest regio and mundane forest on Bear Island.

name: Enter the Sylvan Glen
description: Daktyl power to enter any Faerie regio.

name: Entreat the Divine Powers
description: Minor Virtue gained via Initiation, invoking Divine powers.

name: Entreat the Faerie Powers
description: Required Virtue for cunning-folk.

name: Enumerus
description: A renowned Jerbiton magus who wrote a treatise on covenant economics held in the Great Library of Durenmar; he gave his name to the Pound of Enumerus, the unaccountable yearly petty expenditure.

name: Envy
description: One of the capital vices, opposed by a holy temper.

name: Eosophoros
description: Planetary spirit of Venus, ruling romance, poets and jewels.

name: Eostre
description: Sabbat held at the Spring Equinox.

name: Epic of Charlemagne
description: Collection of chivalric tales about Charlemagne and his paladins.

name: Epimetheus
description: Hariste's devoted pupil who contracted leprosy while consoling her after Tytalus's disappearance, thereby founding the leper magi lineage.

name: Epistles of the Brethren of Purity and Loyal Friends
aliases: Rasa'il Ikhwan as-Safa' wa Khillan al-Wafa
description: 52 letters in four books serving as tractatus and, with the Comprehensive Epistle, summae on Elementalist Arts.

name: Equine Charisma
description: Kelpie power making itself alluring to victims.

name: Equine Metamorphosis
description: Kelpie power transforming it into a black stallion.

name: Equine Shape
description: Personal Power letting the character transform into a horse until sunrise or sunset.

name: Equipment Availability
description: Classification of weapons and armor by historical period (ancient, early, high, late medieval) or region.

name: Equipment Without Encumbrance
description: Faeries suffer no Encumbrance for traditional props, which are made of glamour and can be reconstituted.

name: Er Lanic
description: Isle with stones.

name: Eratosthenes
description: Devised the armillary sphere in antiquity.

name: Erfurt
description: The oldest and largest settlement in Thuringia, an episcopal city under the archbishopric of Mainz, deriving wealth from the export of woad.

name: Erictho
description: Legendary Thessalian witch described in Lucan's Pharsalia, namesake of the Daughters of Erictho.

name: Erik von Ribe
description: A magus of House Tytalus, filius of Tasgillia, quoted remarking that a magus lacking a disgraced ancestor shows a distinct lack of enterprise.

name: Erimas of Tytalus
description: Luctatio magus on the Council of Pavia.

name: Erin
description: Former young Quaesitor who joined the Blessed One and serves in the Inner Circle.

name: Erinnyes
description: Chthonic Leti who avenge crimes against the natural and moral order.

name: Erispoë
description: Nominoé's son, who took the title King of Brittany.

name: Eristic Moot
description: A public dispute between competing speakers used by House Tytalus to settle differences, announced by Redcap; includes special forms such as the Apprentice's Gauntlet and the contest for Primus.

name: Ermenrik
description: Dietrich's uncle, German ruler of Rome, who conquered Bern.

name: Errant Knight
description: Knight who makes his living from the tournament circuit rather than a fief.

name: Errantus
description: Criamon magus who kept a staff stolen from Justina and was injured by Bartholomew.

name: Erratus
description: Example magus who miscalculates an Astrological Duration.

name: Errina
description: Ancient Greek writer who described the tortoise game.

name: Ertholmene Archipelago
description: Uninhabited Baltic archipelago lacking sea room.

name: Eruv
description: Boundary temporarily set up to define the community a golem protects.

name: Erysipelas
description: A Minor Choleric Disease of morbid choler from excessive heat and dryness, causing a maddening rash on the extremities.

name: Erythravis
description: An Archmage of House Guernicus who executed Tasgillia for diabolism in 961 AD.

name: Escalade
description: Direct assault in which attackers scale castle walls with towers, ladders and ropes, resolved with battlefield event rules.

name: Eschenfrau
description: A very evil wood-spirit who must be appeased with a sacrifice on Ash Wednesday by those unfortunate enough to live near one.

name: Esoteric Magic
description: Secret variations on standard Hermetic magic practiced by those who belong to Mystery Cults.

name: Espera of Merinita
description: A Merinita maga of Ungulus who offended a faerie lord and devotes herself to survival, never leaving the Aegis and wearing enchanted iron items against faeries.

name: Esperance
description: Follower of Verditius whose diary describes the history of Whitlams.

name: Espurgatoire seint Patritz
description: A widely circulated tract describing a knight's vision of the torments of Hell.

name: Essedarius
description: Charioteer certamen techniques that intimidate foes.

name: Establishment
description: Kennels, stables or mews with a quality, capacity, maintenance and Living Conditions modifier.

name: Estampie
description: Stamping dance.

name: Estor
description: Signal to charge in the tournament melee.

name: Estrid Danesson
description: A magus Ex Miscellanea (age 36) of Oculus Septentrionalis, a Danish former hedge wizard specializing in sailing and weather magics who gathers vis around the Baltic; cousin and enemy of Eric Ribecus.

name: Eternal Repetition in a Bottomless Pool
description: A Creo Imaginem 35 spell that uses enchanted mirrors to display the text of a book the magus has an arcane connection to, navigable by vocal command.

name: Eternal Sleeper
description: Mysterious being in whose mind the Vermilion Temple is said to be a dream; rumored to be an old one, the sleeping king, or Tytalus.

name: Ethelwald
description: The seneschal and autocrat of Voluntas who plays lord of the manor to the outside world and avoids becoming a knight to escape military service.

name: Ethereal Fisherman Spiders
description: Social spiders that trap and breed in ghosts; farmed for silk.

name: Etin Bride
description: A female Jotun who has taken a human husband and teaches Trollskap to her descendants.

name: Etruscans
description: Ancient people whose burial shafts Vespillo explored and whom Lasa Vegoia taught theurgy and divination.

name: Ettin
description: Brutish Germanic giants (also called ogres or trolls) of Size +3 to +5, harmed by sunlight; their females are troll-wives.

name: Ettin Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety granting Stamina, with sunlight vulnerability.

name: Ettrick Forest
description: Lowland forest whose inhabitants use bows.

name: Eucrasia
description: The state of perfect balance of the humors that prolongs life and negates bodily suffering, the goal of a medical regimen, represented as a Living Conditions Modifier.

name: Eule's Wisdom Item
description: A low-level but very high-Penetration Perdo Mentem magic item hidden in the floor of Eule's receiving room that calms minds and removes emotion, used by Gunther to fake her wisdom.

name: Eulogius of House Ex Miscellanea
description: Decrepit founder of the Donatores who runs Requies Aeterna; a master of Perdo, Corpus and Mentem.

name: Euric
description: Visigoth king campaigning across Western Europe 470-485.

name: Europa
description: Phoenician princess carried off by Zeus.

name: European Wildcat
description: Wild cat with thicker shaggy coat and bushy tail.

name: Eurybia
description: Titaness, mistress of the weather.

name: Eurynome
description: A sea nymph who, with Thetis, rescued and raised Hephaestus after Zeus cast him into the sea.

name: Eustace de Faukenberg
description: The treasurer of England, who heads the Exchequer.

name: Eustace the Monk
description: The leader of the French reinforcement fleet of eighty ships; defeated by Hubert de Burgh's fleet and beheaded against the rail of his own ship.

name: Eustace, Abbot of Flay
description: An abbot sent by the Pope in 1200 to lead a mission against Sunday trading in England, whose preaching and miracles caused many Sunday markets to close or move.

name: Eustorage
description: Uncle of Peter of Montaigu, Archbishop of Nicosia.

name: Evaluate Luxury Goods
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Evaluate Vis
description: Ability possessed by Domnhull Beg.

name: Evander
description: Son of Mercury and Carmentis who founded Pallantium and brought the wolf-cult from Arcadia.

name: Evangelium
description: Normandy Tribunal officer, always a Redcap, reporting Tourney results.

name: Evasion
description: Optional combat score for dodging, based on Quickness, Brawl or Ride, Size and Encumbrance.

name: Evasion Total
description: Prey's Dexterity + Athletics + Terrain Bonus + stress die minus fatigue.

name: Event Total
description: Stamina + Leadership + Territorial Advantage + Weight of Numbers Bonus + Event Bonus (Maneuver + Enemy + Size).

name: Everard of Barres
description: Grand Master (1149-1152), retired.

name: Everlasting Boots
description: Boots gifted to Charlemagne by Yan den Houtkapper.

name: Everstorf Forest
description: A forest north of Schwerin in which the Giant's Grave lies.

name: Evisceration of Ten Thousand Knives
description: A Perdo Corpus 35 enchanted-item effect in Philippus Niger's talisman, a Group-targeted version of his Evisceration of a Thousand Knives.

name: Evisceration of a Thousand Knives
description: A Perdo Corpus 30 spell invented by Philippus Niger that inflicts an Incapacitating wound on one target.

name: Evoco of Tremere
description: Mercatora's second-in-command and lover at Rellantali.

name: Evreux
description: County granted to Rollo.

name: Ex Miscellanea Shapeshifter
description: Magus template: a feral magus who takes the forms of wolf, goat, hare, raven and golden eagle.

name: Ex Miscellanea Storm Witch
description: Magus template: a Highland weather witch who calls or dispels storms by whistling, disdained by other Hermetic magi.

name: Exactly to Scale
description: Rego Aquam level 10 spell (Mentem requisite) designed by a Tremere Artificer to draw precise pictures of a magus's ideas in ink, used for diagrams and mapmaking.

name: Example Childhoods
description: Ability packages (Athletic, Border, Covenant Bred, Exploring, Feral, Fighting, Mischievous, Shy, Social, Traveling, Wilderness) for spending 45 experience points by age 5.

name: Exarch
description: Senior Tremere magus commanding House operations in one or more Tribunals; six exist.

name: Excalibur
description: Arthur's sword, guarded by a Lady of the Lake.

name: Exceptional Communication
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Exceptional Servant
description: A type of faerie related to the mentor that takes an adolescent on an adventure, leaving them with excellent prospects, then feeds on the vitality of the family.

name: Exceptional Strength
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Exceptional Talent (Virtue)
description: Virtue granting an Exceptional Talent.

name: Excessive Heating
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is kept far warmer than necessary with extensive facilities (+2 Upkeep, -1 Safety, +2 Ignem).

name: Excessive Lighting
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is lit far more than necessary with hundreds of candles or lamps (+2 Upkeep, +2 Imaginem).

name: Exchange of the Two Minds
description: A ritual spell that switches the minds (but not the souls) of two creatures.

name: Exchequer
description: A branch of the royal court headed by the treasurer Eustace de Faukenberg, responsible for checking and receipting all moneys owed to the crown; staffed by Barons of the Exchequer.

name: Exciting Experimentation
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw causing the character's experiments to have dramatic flair, rolling two dice on experimentation tables with the storyguide choosing the more amusing result.

name: Exertion
description: Spending effort (Fatigue) to boost Attack or Defense.

name: Exeter
description: The seat of a bishop and the most important town of southwest England, a sea-port on the river Exe with a Norman cathedral dedicated to St. Peter and a wine trade with Gascony.

name: Exilarch
description: Notional head of all diaspora Jews, based in Baghdad, able to extend Holy Influence.

name: Exileratus
description: Jerbiton magus of Literatus teaching at the University of Law.

name: Exorcise the Filthy Spirit
description: PeVi Gen reducing a possessing demon's Possession Might Pool.

name: Exorcist
description: Minor order whose members receive a scroll of exorcism rites and gain +1 to exorcisms.

name: Expanded Armor Rules
description: Rules expanding ArM5 armor with more materials and a component system of body armor, surcoat/greaves and helmet.

name: Experience Points
description: Game reward characters may gain from completing a story.

name: Experimental Scripts
description: Process by which a Mystagogue devises a new Initiation Script through risky experimentation using the Extraordinary Results chart and a validity roll.

name: Experimentation Table
description: Table rolled on when using hazardously copied Laboratory Texts.

name: Exposed
description: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the building is partially exposed to the elements, e.g. unroofed or wind-cracked (-1 Safety, +1 Upkeep, -2 Health, -1 Aesthetics, +1 Auram).

name: Expositio Sybillae et Merlini
description: Tino's corrupt Church Lore summa claiming to discuss prophecies of the sibyls and Merlin.

name: Exposure
description: Experience gained by an apprentice assisting the parens when not being taught.

name: Exposure Experience
description: Experience points gained from casual attendance at preaching, even in unknown Abilities.

name: Exquiro of Quaesitor
description: Full member of Magvillus and Traditionalist.

name: Extended Action
description: Action taking a full round or longer, which cannot be delayed and requires Concentration if distracted.

name: Extended Material and Size Table
description: Table extending enchantment sizes to rooms, structures and boundaries for Hermetic Architecture.

name: Extensive Stores
description: A Minor laboratory Structure Virtue: large stores let the lab withstand shortages and store vis and dangerous materials more safely (+2 Safety).

name: External Defenses
description: Optional rule for outlying fortifications that must be taken before the main castle can be assaulted, using their own Defense Bonus.

name: Extractions of the Soul from its Husk
description: Gifted gruagach initiation placing the soul in a stone; grants External Soul and Blatant Magic.

name: Extraordinary Results Chart
description: Experimentation chart on which a Discovery must be rolled.

name: Eye of Hell
description: Infernal location in the island chapter.

name: Eye of the Eons
description: An Intellego Terram spell (InTe 5) known by Tabanus.

name: Eyes for the Prince
description: InVi 15 spell detecting Faerie creatures of Might 40+ despite disguise or invisibility.

name: Eyes of Stone Demons
description: Architectus's Power using gargoyle-like demons as spies.

name: Eyes of the Eons
description: An Intellego Terram spell that determines the age of any nonliving target to within 10% of its actual age.

name: Eyes of the Flame
description: An Intellego Ignem spell (Level 35) that lets the caster see a fire to which they have an Arcane Connection, plus all things the fire illuminates.

name: Eyes of the Owl
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Ezekiel
description: Prophet whose vision of the divine chariot inspired Merkavah.

name: Fabia
description: An ancient Roman family (genus) that ran the Luperci and gave its name to the Fabiani college.

name: Fabiani
description: One of the two colleges of the Luperci, named after the ancient Roman Fabia family; it is led by its own magister luperci.

name: Fabric Ripper
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue granting the power to tear any manufactured object made from plant or animal fibers, as a PeAn(He) 25 effect.

name: Fabricor of Verditius
description: A young Verditius magus, one of the newly arrived members of Libellus.

name: Fabulae
description: Hyginus' work summarizing the Golden Fleece legend.

name: Face of the Count
description: Berith's Power transforming a volunteer into a facsimile of a nobleman; dispelled by sacraments.

name: Facilitate the Stifled (Form) Spell
description: A Muto Vim general spell cast alongside a formulaic spell to remove the casting penalty from reduced or absent gestures and voice; has ten versions, one per Hermetic Form.

name: Faerie (Duration)
description: Faerie ritual Duration lasting while target or caster has Faerie Might and is in Mythic Europe.

name: Faerie Advancement Through Change
description: Rules for faeries altering their roles to gain powers via cognizance, vitality and a creative human.

name: Faerie Ally
description: Virtue appearing in faerie statistics in this text (Faerie Ally).

name: Faerie Ancestor Spirit
description: Powerful faerie that kidnaps a child to pose as a false heir.

name: Faerie Animal
description: Mengalaz.

name: Faerie Animal Companions
description: Animal-shaped faeries who take children on adventures.

name: Faerie Background
description: Free Supernatural Virtue granting a positive and negative Sympathy Trait from an unusual birth or childhood.

name: Faerie Bargaining
description: Branch of faerie hedge wizardry concerned with bargains between mortals and fay, using Summoning, Bonding, Captivating, and Dismissing.

name: Faerie Blood (Spinnen)
description: New Minor Virtue letting a character convert their body weight of fiber into cloth per day by touch, or unweave cloth.

name: Faerie Blooded
description: Virtue referenced in this text.

name: Faerie Boons
description: Blessings or maledictions gained from Eudokian journeys: Virtues balanced by Charm Flaws, or fading Flaws.

name: Faerie Chains of the Familiar Slave
description: A CrVi ritual spell (R: Touch, D: Until) that binds a supernatural creature as a temporary familiar to the caster until an incorporated condition comes to pass.

name: Faerie Champion
description: Faerie with typical Might 25.

name: Faerie Court of Faeries' Rock
description: Faerie court that assembles at Faeries' Rock before the winter solstice to try transgressors.

name: Faerie Doctor Special Virtue
description: Special Virtue that makes a character a Mythic Companion faerie doctor, granting free Dowsing and 2 Virtue points per Flaw point, with compulsory Virtues and Flaws.

name: Faerie Dog
description: Faerie with typical Might 5.

name: Faerie Drake
description: Potent faerie drake that slumbered in the forest and attacked Raisa's covenant; defeatable only by tears of a rhinoceros.

name: Faerie Familiar
description: A faerie bound as a magus's familiar; at Irencillia magi such as Glesig make their caricatures (e.g., the troll Humnel) into faerie familiars.

name: Faerie Flight
description: Faerie power letting Count Gwyridden fly for 3 miles.

name: Faerie God Blood
description: Faerie Blood from old gods, granting points in Sympathy Traits.

name: Faerie Godmothers
description: Protector faeries who guard and gift godchildren.

name: Faerie Gruagachan
description: Knee-high long-haired faeries in gentleman's clothes to whom Scottish farmers pour milk; they curdle milk or dry cows if disrespected.

name: Faerie Hedge Wizardry
description: Traditions of faerie magic enabled by sympathy; each tradition has four Favored Abilities.

name: Faerie Homunculus
description: A faerie homunculus whose bond grants a Homunculus Wizard a Faerie version of The Gift.

name: Faerie Ingredients
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: some lab stores are supplied by faeries with beneficial if unpredictable properties, e.g. faerie silver.

name: Faerie Instructor
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a faerie store human Abilities taken in bargains and give them to favored humans.

name: Faerie Kidnapper
description: A faerie satyromaniac who, disguised as the girls' beau, kidnapped three village girls at Hocktide and fathered their children.

name: Faerie King
description: Faerie rulers able to enter treaties in accordance with their roles.

name: Faerie Lands
description: Lands where giants and titans are imprisoned; described as a ring between Dominion and wilderness.

name: Faerie Legacy
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue enhancing the benefit of Faerie Blood.

name: Faerie Lord of the Shrine
description: Faerie lord to whom a shire's site was sacred before Christianity; guards the border between profane and sacred and whose followers poison pilgrims.

name: Faerie Monarch
description: Ruler of a faerie court; the most powerful have Faerie Might around 60 and Penetration to challenge senior magi.

name: Faerie Patron
description: Source of bequeathed Might that grants a bonus to offers under Art & Academe rules.

name: Faerie Queen of Avalon
description: Faerie who permanently woke Oberon.

name: Faerie Queen of Irencillia
description: A faerie queen used as an example target in the Symbolic Magic ritual, affected at Symbol Range via 'queen,' 'winter,' and 'faerie' charms.

name: Faerie Queen of Oleron
description: Faerie queen embodying the Apple Mile, succeeded by her daughter at each challenge.

name: Faerie Rites
description: Spontaneous faerie spells requiring a Faerie Method, Faerie Power, and applicable Sympathy Trait; effects are never permanent.

name: Faerie Rival
description: A faerie given form by a character's emotionally charged injury, which must be overcome for the character to claim his birthright or adult role.

name: Faerie Road
description: Paths used by faeries with 'right of way', commonly corpse roads to churches; the most common type of trod.

name: Faerie Role
description: The story role a faerie fulfils and cannot easily change.

name: Faerie Sensitivity
description: Ability of magical giants.

name: Faerie Speech (Ability)
description: Ability or Pretense used in faerie statistics (Faerie Speech (Ability)).

name: Faerie Spider
description: A poisonous faerie spider befriended by Lutisse that protects her treehouse lab, though its cobwebs infest the dwelling.

name: Faerie Spouse
aliases: Faerie Spouses Trapped by a Trinket
description: Faerie role of selkie women trapped by a trinket (their seal skin).

name: Faerie Tarantula
description: A faerie creature whose bite afflicts victims with tarantism, an excess of yellow bile causing an irresistible urge to dance.

name: Faerie Time Dilation
description: Time passes faster in the mortal world relative to Faerie, based on the final fable score.

name: Faerie Toy Market on Devil's Lane
description: Faerie regio with entrances in many cities selling magical toys made by hidden elves, containing a Merinita covenant.

name: Faerie Trainer
description: Free Supernatural Virtue: the faerie has real human Abilities and can train humans conventionally.

name: Faeries' Cave
description: Dolmen northwest of Tours with a Faerie aura of 3 rising to 5 when fae feast there.

name: Faeries' Rock
description: Megalithic chamber where a faerie court meets.

name: Fair Haven
description: Artakia's harbor, the island's sole commercial port, site of Jason's shrine to Athena.

name: Fairy Loaves of Virtue
description: Flat bun-shaped formed stones containing 1 pawn of Muto vis each; Enriched, they keep milk fresh as a Lesser Power.

name: Fairy Ring
description: Ring of the faeries, the subject of an anonymous verse warning against disturbing it.

name: Faith (Target)
description: Holy magic Target affecting only those who worship God, or only those who do not; equal to Group.

name: Faith (Virtue)
description: Theological virtue of firm assurance and conviction in things unseen; the acceptance of God.

name: Faith, Love and Truth
description: Three swords by Ubertino of Verditius, each designed to inspire an emotion.

name: Falchion
description: Heavy one-handed machete-like weapon used by common soldiers; late medieval.

name: Falcon of Virtue
description: Rare falcon with burning feathers sought as a tournament prize in a story seed.

name: Falconer (Virtue)
description: Minor Social Status Virtue for a character training hawks and falcons for a noble patron; grants 50 extra experience points.

name: Falkirk
description: Where Wallace was defeated in 1298.

name: Fall of Darkness
description: Hagbui power (PeIg 25) creating a circle of darkness.

name: Fallen Temple
description: Church Hook for a church or chapel built on the site of a former pagan temple.

name: Falling from Horseback
description: Rule for damage taken when a rider falls or is unseated.

name: Fallow Deer
description: Rare deer.

name: Falls Like a Cat
description: A Minor, General Virtue protecting a character from injury when falling up to three (or six) times his height.

name: False Faerie Blood
description: Faerie-affiliated false version of Faerie Blood.

name: False Lover's Rock
description: Where Guyomart was trapped.

name: False Prophecy
description: Muto Mentem level 30 spell that alters a victim's memories of dreams into a persistent crafted nightmare meant to influence decisions.

name: False Window
description: A CrIm 5 miniature spell that traces a door or window frame to create an illusion of something beyond it, requiring a Perception + Finesse roll.

name: Famhair Laidir
description: Non-magical Highland giant up to 60 feet tall, dim-witted; many aided Damhan-allaidh.

name: Famhair a'falach
description: Magical Highland giant up to forty feet tall with hidden heart (External Soul), originators of gruagach magic.

name: Family Law
description: Area of law listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Famine Demons
description: Demons that attack a covenant that creates bountiful crops.

name: Famuli Matters
description: Story seeds giving a below-stairs view of servants, such as cleaning up after crises.

name: Fanning the Infernal Flames
description: CrVi Gen restoring a demon's Might Pool; known among infernalist magi.

name: Farm Implement
description: Improvised two-handed weapon.

name: Farmhouse (Kilkenny)
description: Farm in a Faerie-aura dell where Janine and Anne were taught; home of Agnes.

name: Farming (Renting)
description: Period English term for renting out land or manors, convenient for the Order of Hermes since paying for land use is not against the Code; falling from favor in 1220.

name: Farne Meditations
description: Book by the hermit Bartholomew; a Summa on Divine Lore, Level 3, Quality 6, recording his spiritual insights.

name: Farrier
description: Maker of horseshoes, overseen by a marshal.

name: Fast (Duration)
description: Holy magic Duration lasting as long as the caster fasts; equal to Moon.

name: Fast Learner
description: Virtue appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Fast Might Recovery
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a faerie restore its entire Might Pool in six hours.

name: Fast Runner
description: A heartbeast Quality example that, applied via Theriomorphy, gives the magus the legs of his heartbeast.

name: Fast-Cast Defense
description: Rapid defensive spell used in dimicatio.

name: Fasti
description: Ovid's poem on festivals, a summa on Organization Lore: Roman Empire (Level 3, Quality 8).

name: Fata
description: Faeries who inconspicuously join weaving and gossip sessions among elderly village women, using Pretenses to weave.

name: Fatal Menses
description: Lamashtu's constant poison power that poisons wells, kills crops and fetuses as she flies.

name: Fatal Register
description: A Muto Animal 20 spell that changes a book's bookmark ribbon into a venomous serpent (traditionally a cobra), typically vested in a single-use charged object activated when a book is stolen.

name: Fatalism
description: Belief that destiny is written in the stars; fashionable in the Roman Empire.

name: Fathach
description: An ugly saw-toothed two-armed giant replacing the Gegenes in the Hibernian variant.

name: Father Theophagus
description: Priest of St Helix who decorates the church with bones and secretly summons demons in his crypt.

name: Father of Serpents
description: Focus power duplicating non-Ritual Creo, Intellego, Muto or Rego spells pertaining to snakes.

name: Father of the Legion
description: Highest rank of the Legion of Mithras, clad in black; whispered to be a Living Ghost.

name: Fatigue Mastery
description: Major Quality letting a character spend Fatigue levels as Might Points.

name: Fatima
description: Daughter of the Prophet, entombed at the Mosque of the Prophet.

name: Fatimids
description: Isma'ili dynasty ruling North Africa and Egypt from the 10th century until 1171, claiming to be imams and rightful caliphs.

name: Fauho
description: The filius of Midusulf and second primus of House Bjornaer, with a fox heartbeast; the Seat of the Fox is named after him.

name: Fauld
description: Lamellar hip protection.

name: Fauni
description: Airy Spirits attending creatures, appearing as male animals or hybrids; sometimes called satyroi.

name: Faustrecht
description: 'Club law' in Rhaetia where rights go to the strongest.

name: Faux Feudalism
description: A Free covenant governance choice modeling hierarchical, feudal-style rule over residents.

name: Faux de Verzy
description: Sinister grove of twisted beeches with a Faerie aura of 4, where dark dwarf-like folk take villagers captive.

name: Favarone di Offreduccio
description: Noble father of Clare of Assisi.

name: Favila
description: Jerbiton magus of Literatus teaching at the school of Medicine.

name: Favorable Aura
description: Minor Site Boon: a covenant aura aligned to favor one activity.

name: Favorable Hour
description: Hour identified via horoscope granting a casting bonus.

name: Favors Owed
description: Covenant Boon for lieges.

name: Fear (Flaw)
description: Flaw; Abbas the Hunted has a fear of fire after being burned by a hell-hound.

name: Fear of the Mouse
description: Cat power similar to Panic of the Trembling Heart, making people afraid of the cat.

name: Fear of the Wilderness
description: Mazzikim Power inflicting overwhelming dread.

name: Fearful Aura
description: Hagbui power (ReMe 20) panicking one opponent a round.

name: Fearghus Mac Mungan
description: Magus Ex Miscellanea, cousin of Mungan Mor and apprentice of Mairi Sean, who studies the sluagh; lost a foot to a brollachan and has a secret drinking problem.

name: Fearsome Bark
description: Black Dog power like Panic of the Trembling Heart.

name: Feast of Fools
description: Celebration on January 1 reversing traditional roles such as bishop and jester.

name: Feast of St. John
description: Holiday of a feast story.

name: Feather Messenger
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue for a bird-shifter who can separate a feather and telepathically control it as a self-inking quill, associated with the Daughters of Four Fathers.

name: Febris Semitertiana
description: A Major Choleric Disease (Severity 18) from water corrupted by Saturn and Mars, capable of killing thousands in summer.

name: Fedoso
description: The protagonist of Verderis's epic poem The Travels of Fedoso, a young man who travels a strange landscape facing mystical obstacles, believed by some Criamon to be a map of the House's future.

name: Feeding the Font of the Covenant
description: CrVi Ritual causing an immediate Aura Strengthening roll.

name: Feldberg
description: The highest peak of the Black Forest, the bare-topped seat of the King of the Black Mountain, reached only via the haunted Höllental, with a multi-level regio of Faerie aura 3 to 8.

name: Felianthrope
description: Personal cat power to take human shape, a version of The Beast Remade.

name: Feline Lullaby
aliases: Keeping the Humans Safely Tucked Away
description: Cat power, also Keeping the Humans Safely Tucked Away, a version of The Call to Slumber.

name: Felix the Wolf
description: A black wolf guild member who enforces the guild rules.

name: Fen Ague
description: Disease contracted in the Cotentin swamps causing a Heavy Wound, chills and fever.

name: Fenicil's Library
description: Library within Magvillus holding books on the Abilities of Fenicil's rituals.

name: Fennel
description: Potently magical herb that repels disease demons and witches; the weapon of the benandanti.

name: Fenris wolf
description: Wolf to which Tyr sacrificed his hand so it could be bound.

name: Feoderee
description: The most physically imposing brownie, of the Isle of Man; a courtly faerie cursed to become a giant hairy monster.

name: Fer Caille
description: An Irish fachan-like creature that acts as a faerie herdsman and is accompanied by a hag.

name: Ferdinand II of Leon
description: Founded the Order of Santiago in 1170.

name: Ferdinand of Flanders
description: Count of Flanders captured at Bouvines, held for ransom in Paris; husband of Joan.

name: Ferilan
description: Transitionalist leader at Magvillus and one of the foremost Transitionalists in the Order; former master of Adria.

name: Fermentation Cycle
description: Competition at the Green Cockerel Great Convocation for the best breakthrough.

name: Ferragus
description: A giant who fought Roland in the pseudo-Turpin romance; the basis for Barcas.

name: Ferrara
description: Diocese subject to Rome.

name: Ferrymen
description: Travelers who navigate the waters between insulae; theorists of the Magic Archipelago.

name: Fertility Magic
description: Magic linked to Carnac and St. Cado's pillar.

name: Fertility Runes
description: Vitkar magic focus carved on coins.

name: Festival of All Souls
description: Feast on November 2nd created by Odilo; on it the Dominion weakens and Infernal auras increase.

name: Fetish
description: Item a folk witch must hold to use an Ability, prepared in a season of lab work.

name: Feudal System
description: Vassal-liege relationships of mutual obligation running through society.

name: Fi'noa
description: One of the Three Sisters.

name: Fiacail Geur
description: Aonghus Lamh Iarran's deerhound familiar (Sharp Tooth), feuding with Mungan's familiar.

name: Fiance
description: Submission of a defeated knight, securing a ransom.

name: Fidchell
description: Celtic protect-the-king board game.

name: Fief
description: Land or another valuable right loaned by a lord to a vassal in exchange for military support, counsel and other benefits.

name: Field of Chains
description: First field of Purgatory where the slothful lie chained face down while Iurgatores walk on them.

name: Field of Hooks
description: Field of Purgatory where perpetrators of fraud hang from hooks over flames.

name: Field of Nails
description: Field of Purgatory where sinners of self-indulgence are pinned with red hot nails and bitten by adders.

name: Fields of Asphodel
description: Where the Greeks thought most spirits in Hades dwelled.

name: Fiery Breath
description: Polymathes' power belching fire 50 paces long.

name: Fifth Ring of Solomon
description: Allows sensing the realm affiliation of beings; recited in Summer.

name: Fifth Trump
description: Trumpet sounded at the End of Days releasing the Demons of the Fifth Trump.

name: Figures Through Fire and Fumes
aliases: Enchantment of the Figures Through Fire and Fumes
description: InIg 15 spell of Whitburh's invention.

name: Fila specialis
description: Dioceses directly subject to Rome rather than to a province.

name: Filioque
description: 'And the Son' added by the West to the Nicene Creed, a cause of schism.

name: Fin' Amors
description: Courtly love: elaborate rules of romance between noble suitors and married ladies, condemned by the Church.

name: Findabair Ex Miscellanea
description: A young, stunningly beautiful maga at Cad Gadu who uses magic to preserve her looks and dresses to seduce, while whining about the covenant's decay.

name: Finding Hidden Loot
description: A Minor, General Virtue granting +9 to Awareness rolls when searching a confined space for hidden items.

name: Fine Aura
description: Major Site Boon: a covenant aura with an alignment benefiting most within it.

name: Fines
description: Hermetic penalty compensating the Tribunal and prosecution, split one third to the prosecutor and two-thirds to Tribunal coffers.

name: Fines for Being Fined
description: Rule that a peasant fined outside the manor court owes his lord equivalent compensation since the money was the lord's.

name: Fines for the King
description: Story seed where the king of England claims reparation when magi in England are fined by Tribunals.

name: Finesse roll
description: A roll using the Finesse Ability that controls the quality of craft magic and substitutes for mundane Craft rolls when using craft spells or devices.

name: Finger Bone of Saint Odilo
description: Relic acquired by Marco the Student.

name: Finland
description: Land containing Akkala, a place name borrowed for the spirit Akkala.

name: Finn Mac Coul
description: Gaelic hero of Highland stories.

name: Finz-Weibl
description: A wood-wife who wears a wide-brimmed hat and is very hairy.

name: Fionn
description: Pictish god, protector of man and destroyer of giants and monsters.

name: Fire Damp
description: A Level 10 Alteration Reagent kept in a stoppered flask that releases a heavy gas which dampens the intensity of flames, removing 10 points of fire damage.

name: Fire Hawk
description: Small magical raptor that ignites objects.

name: Fire Step
description: Hermetic fortification: raised step behind a solid wall letting defenders cast then take cover.

name: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word
description: Invocation Wonders effect (Level 35) summoning and controlling a powerful force of nature.

name: Fireheart
aliases: The Lost Talisman of the Founder
description: Flambeau's lost talisman, an oval-cut flawless fire opal the size of a walnut into which he invested several fire and mind effects; serves as an Arcane Connection to its creator.

name: Firmicus Maternus
description: Writer on astrology whose works are used extensively.

name: First Flautist
description: A leadership title of the Seirenes won at a grand competition every 12 years, treated equally to the other Firsts.

name: First Footing
description: Tradition that the first person to cross a house's threshold at New Year brings luck.

name: First Inscription
description: Inscription providing guaranteed Insight for Original Research.

name: First Lyrist
description: A leadership title of the Seirenes won at a grand competition every 12 years, treated equally to the other Firsts.

name: First Ring of Solomon
description: Grants 100 experience points in Philosophiae and +3 Communication; recited in Spring or Autumn.

name: First Singer
description: A leadership title of the Seirenes won at a grand competition every 12 years, hosting the next competition at her covenant.

name: Fish
description: Generic template for fish of the Farnes, with variants crab, dogfish, dolphin, eel, grey mullet, mackerel, octopus, salmon, sole.

name: Fish Out of Water (Terrain)
description: A Minor General Flaw giving the character an affinity for one terrain type and penalties when away from it.

name: Fisher King
description: Perceval's wounded host who guards the Grail.

name: Fitz-Hubert Family
description: Norman family hostile to the magi of Horsingas.

name: Five Angels of Punishment
description: Five angels of punishment Moses encountered in the Second Heaven per the Midrash Tehillin: Af, Hemah, Meshabber, Hesmed and Mashith.

name: Five Fairs of Flanders
description: A fair cycle of Lille, Mesen, Ypres, Torout, and Bruges held between February and November, built on the fine woolen and linen cloth trade.

name: Five Great Lieges
description: The five major liege covenants of the Normandy Tribunal, of which Montverte is one.

name: Five Great Lines
description: The five liege-vassal lines of Fudarus, Confluensis, Florum, Oleron and Montverte dominating Normandy politics.

name: Flagellant movement
description: Movement of pious Christians who publicly flagellated themselves expecting the Last Judgement, in which Templars later become prominent.

name: Flail
description: Two-handed crushing weapon.

name: Flame Dancers
description: Magic kin possessed by the power of fire who love fires and flesh and dance tirelessly around bonfires.

name: Flame Shape
description: Taltós phantastic form as a ball or wheel of flame, physically like an elemental of Might 10.

name: Flamen
description: The title ('priest') for a Mercurian magus, who performs ceremonial duties such as leading ritual magic, reading omens, and officiating Hermetic events.

name: Flames of Sculpted Ice
description: A Muto Ignem spell (Level 35) with an Aquam requisite that turns a fire up to the size of a small house into ice sculptures of leaping flame; the flames return as the ice melts.

name: Flaren of Flambeau
description: Luctatio magus aiding Erimas in Pavia.

name: Flashbacks
description: A Minor General Flaw in which combat or tense situations may trigger hallucinatory flashbacks to past battles, causing panic.

name: Flauberto the Difficult
description: Parens of Hagen.

name: Flavia of Jerbiton
description: A Jerbiton maga trained by Jerbiton himself who founded Rosalba in 820 and wrote philosophical tractatus before her mysterious Final Twilight in 890.

name: Flavius Ex Miscellanea
description: A frustrated old magus of Ungulus, trained there in its glory days, who clings to the failing covenant and hopes to rebuild it with young magi after the others pass.

name: Flavius Philostratus
description: Third-century biographer of Apollonius of Tyana.

name: Flawed Opening of The Gift
description: If the master lacks a score of 2 in each tradition power, the apprentice gains Flaws such as Deficient Art.

name: Flawed Parma
description: Flaw.

name: Flawless Equipment
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab's outfittings are flawless, perhaps too perfect for mortal hands (+2 General Quality, +2 Vis Extraction).

name: Flawless Tools
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab's tools are legendarily perfect (+2 Items).

name: Flaws of the Weaponsmith
description: A Perdo Terram 25 spell invented by Philippus Niger that rusts away up to 100 metal objects, such as the arms and armor of 30 men.

name: Flee to Safe Refuge
description: ReCo 44 effect transporting the wearer to the place designated by the Arcane Connection in the Phylactery; linked-triggered with Acquire the Connection.

name: Fleet of Foot
description: Kelpie power letting it travel three times a normal horse's speed in stallion form.

name: Fleet of Woodchips or Rushes
description: Manannan's power creating an illusory fleet of a hundred crewed vessels to scare away invaders.

name: Fleets of Venice
description: Heavily oversubscribed Venetian trading-fleet investments assumed unable to fail, whose occasional loss of ships to weather or piracy can cascade into an unraveling city economy.

name: Flemish Cloth Fairs
description: Cycle of cloth-trade fairs in Lille, Mesen, Ypres, Torhout and Bruges.

name: Flemish Pikemen
description: Specialist mercenary troops.

name: Flexible Casting
description: Gruagach Mastery Ability increasing spell variation per 5 Mastery points.

name: Flexible Gruagach Magic
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a gruagach vary formulaic spells by 3 magnitudes.

name: Flickering Aura
description: Church Hook under which the church's Divine aura drops (e.g. to 3 for a year) unless certain rites, such as carrying relics on the perambulation, are observed.

name: Flight (Benediction)
description: Example Greater Benediction allowing wingless flight with a prop.

name: Flight (Faerie Power)
description: Personal Faerie Power of gwibers and flying orms.

name: Flight Broom
description: Flying aid fetish (broom, bucket, etc.) enchanted with 1 pawn of Auram vis.

name: Flight of the Hummingbird
description: Constant Personal Power letting the character fly by concentrating.

name: Florence Avenue
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city. The Devil's Lane covenant stands opposite it.

name: Florilegium
description: A category of compiled Hermetic book noted by dedicated students of a subject, rarer than the Roots and Branches and found in libraries specializing in its theme.

name: Fluid Vis
description: The magical energy leaking from the Magic Realm that pools in magical areas to form auras; also called radiant vis or tellurian vis.

name: Flumen of Tremere
description: A Tremere magus, parens of Goliard and former leader of Blackthorn, who captured the Wild Hunt in 1154 and passed into Final Twilight in 1187.

name: Flying Ships
description: Ships held aloft by magic used for transporting passengers and cargo in a transformed Mythic Europe.

name: Focus (Certamen)
description: House Tremere's House Virtue, expressing Insight into nightwalking.

name: Focus (Domestic Work)
description: Brownie focus power creating domestic effects up to level 15.

name: Focus (Duration)
description: Faerie Duration lasting until the caster performs another supernatural effect; equivalent to Concentration.

name: Focus Faerie Powers
description: Virtue granting a Focus Power of 25 spell levels.

name: Focus Powers
description: Broad faerie powers costing Might equal to the effect's magnitude, with Initiative of Quickness minus maximum magnitude; cannot be reduced by intricacy points.

name: Focus of Flambeau
description: A Flambeau magus at Burnham, Scintilla's filius, about whom little else is known.

name: Fog of Confusion
description: A Muto Auram ritual (Level 45) that turns a bank of fog into a silvery mist too thick to see through, harassing and confusing those within it.

name: Foldcourse
description: A piece of land over which the right to graze sheep has been granted.

name: Foligno
description: Town where Marsebilia and Cristiana founded a Poor Sisters group in 1217.

name: Folio
description: Compilation of Lab Texts and tractatus assembled by the Colentes Arcanorum after each Colloquium and copied at Durenmar.

name: Folk Charm
description: A crafted charm made by a character with Faerie Lore and a Sympathy Trait that can end a faerie effect.

name: Folk Charms
description: Trinkets and signs made to repel faeries, such as the Italian finger sign or Greek painted eyes; a class of faerie taboo.

name: Folk Dancer
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue: members of a troupe of a dozen or more who perform pagan dances creating minor magical effects such as a harvest blessing reducing storms.

name: Folk Witch Apprenticeship
description: Ten-year training by a coven granting 200 experience points.

name: Folk Witch Casting Methods
description: Potion, Incantation, and Fetish methods folk witches use for Supernatural Abilities.

name: Folk Witch Gift Opening
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw: a Gifted folk witch's Opening failed to favor one of the seven folk witch Supernatural Abilities.

name: Folk Witch Magic
description: The supernatural magic of folk witches, including potion brewing in the kitchen, familiars, Openings and initiations.

name: Followers of Belin
description: Societas Merceris of Belin's descendants and adoptees who serve as elite, humble messengers.

name: Folly Spirit
description: Alpine spirits inhabiting buildings that drive castle-building to lay eggs, perhaps eating ghosts.

name: Fomoreach
description: Seafaring people of Irish legend from the North and East, possibly the Broch-builders.

name: Fomorii
description: Mythic opponents of the Tuatha De Danann.

name: Fontevraud
description: Fashionable convent where Eleanor resided.

name: Fool's Cap Bell
description: Proctor's talisman, a brass bell enchanted against Infernal influence.

name: Fool's Fire
description: Tiny flickering faerie lights, also called will o' the wisps, that guide lost travelers into dangerous marsh terrain.

name: Fool's Light
description: Ignis fatuus, a mysterious light on the Northern Hares that causes wrecks.

name: Fooling the Eye
description: A CrIm 10 miniature spell creating species of a swift bright object that makes the target's eyes track toward the magus, enabling Eye Range spellcasting.

name: Footwashing Bowl Cross
description: Cross made from the bronze bowl Christ used to wash the apostles' feet.

name: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills
description: Invocation Wonders effect (Level 40) creating an obedient mammal.

name: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles
description: Incantation/Phantasm 10 seeing through Infernal deception.

name: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform
description: Meditation Transcendence effect making the caster untargetable by weaker supernatural effects.

name: For thou hast power of life and death
description: Purity/Intervention miraculous effect (Level 40) opening a doorway into Purgatory.

name: Forest Cave
description: Mistress Greta's remote cave with Magic aura 6, lying inside a regio.

name: Forest Law
description: A separate legal system applying in royal forests, prohibiting hunting, wood-cutting, and fires, enforced by foresters and forest eyres.

name: Forest of Bart
description: Forest in Anjou where Fontrevrault was founded.

name: Forest of Brix
description: Forest south of Cherbourg haunted by packs of faerie wolves.

name: Forest of Broceliande
description: Haunted forest in Brittany where numerous covenants have been founded but none survived.

name: Forest of Luchon
description: Forest at the foot of the Pyrenees in France where gem-faced serpents, children of a vouivre, are found.

name: Forest of Lyons
description: Remnant forest favored for hunting by Norman nobles; a castle at its heart eliminated its forest spirit.

name: Forest of Shining Stone
description: A Great Work at Durenmar where Bonisagus's epitome The Art of Magic has been etched into 36 clear crystals each six feet high.

name: Forest of Yvelines
description: Forest south of Paris.

name: Forester
description: Lesser office caring for the lord's hunting wood.

name: Forfar
description: Where the last Mac William was killed.

name: Forge of Hephaestus
description: Sacred forges built by Hephaestus, the three Hermetic ones located at Verdi (Sardinia), Lemnos, and Mount Olympus, serving as Verditius Initiation chambers.

name: Forgettable Face
description: A Minor, General Virtue making a character hard to notice or describe, imposing -3 on rolls to identify him but incompatible with great beauty or charisma.

name: Forgotten God
description: Hermetic or setting concept referenced in the description of the Mythic Locations sites.

name: Forgotten Gods
description: Beasts and spirits once worshiped as gods who retreated into the Magic Realm or took living forms to survive the Dominion.

name: Form
description: The ten Hermetic Arts of subject; Bonisagus advised masters to favor the Forms first for the student's protection.

name: Form and Effect Bonuses
description: Enchantment bonuses from materials, e.g. Sardinian woods studied by Verdi.

name: Form of Woman
description: Baal-Peor's Power to take a beautiful woman's form.

name: Form of the (Temperament) Heartbeast
description: A Muto Animal 20 spell with four temperament versions (sanguine, choleric, melancholic, phlegmatic) that enhances an animal form's humoral correspondences; modeled from Birna's innate abilities.

name: Form of the Serpent
description: Aethnici Power to become a snake, lizard or salamander.

name: Formed Stones
description: Shaped stones, called lusus naturae, said to be formed by vis plastica, astral conjunctions or other causes; many are Objects of Virtue.

name: Formula
description: A researched recipe of experimental philosophy, like a Laboratory Text, describing how to make astrological inceptions, alchemical reagents, or pharmaceutical theriacs.

name: Formulary
description: Large, poorly organized collection of hundreds or thousands of charms from which learned magicians may cast directly.

name: Fornax of Tremere
description: Goliard's filia at Blackthorn, an ugly and rude mature maga rumored to specialize in Rego and Mentem to make people entertain her.

name: Fortification of the Memory Palace
description: ReMe General protects the memory palace.

name: Fortitude
description: Moral (Cardinal) virtue of willingness to take risks against insurmountable danger, helping resist fear.

name: Fortuna
description: Goddess of luck invoked in Gift charms and the Curse of Fortuna.

name: Fortunata of Jerbiton
description: A powerful eleventh-century spirit master of House Jerbiton who defeated many non-Hermetic enemies but was forced into exile and disappeared into Final Twilight after 1120.

name: Fortunatas of Jerbiton
description: One of the two heads of Vardian's Tomb.

name: Fortune Favors the Bold
description: SuFa 5 charm giving +2 to luck-based rolls.

name: Forum (Temple of Mercury)
description: A large open-roofed marble-flagged meeting area and market place in the temple town, with a raised pulpit at its northern end.

name: Forum Boarium
description: Place in Rome near Portunes's temple.

name: Fostered Apprentice
description: Minor Story Flaw: the character was fostered and owes favors to the fostering magus and a fellow apprentice.

name: Fougères
description: Frontier castle town.

name: Foul Weather made Fair
description: Dindyméné's power cancelling Breath of the Angry Goddess or stopping storms.

name: Foundation Charm
description: Charm placed in a hall's walls or foundations to protect the building, set by a hedge witch or via traditional sacrifice; may anchor a faerie guardian spirit.

name: Founding of the Order
description: The historical establishment of the Order of Hermes, predating which some traditions held antipathies against House Diedne.

name: Foundling Child
description: Sample seven-year-old Gifted orphan apprentice with a knack for books and an inherited Flexible Formulaic Magic.

name: Fountain of Barenton
description: Fountain that yields Vim vis.

name: Fountain of Fair Waters
description: Spring at the center of a Faerie regio (aura 6) in Fontainebleau, home of a nymph and white stag.

name: Fountain of St. Reina
description: Divine-aura curative fountain at Mont Auxois.

name: Four Estates
description: Division of Mythic Europe into those who pray, rule and toil (Church, nobility, peasants/townsfolk), to which the Order would add a fourth.

name: Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse
description: Biblical figures that may roam Mythic Europe in an apocalyptic saga.

name: Four Worlds
description: Kabbalistic scheme of four stages of emanation from the Divine: Atzilut, Beriyah, Yetzirah, Asiyah.

name: Foutins
description: Large clan of local roustabouts, Iasper's mundane family.

name: Fox
description: Cunning prey that gives good sport but little prestige.

name: Fox of Virtue
description: A trickster fox that feigns death to lure carrion birds.

name: Fragments of the True Cross
description: Common relics with 1 Faith Point and Divine Might 10.

name: Framlingham
description: Castle with 13 mural towers.

name: Francis' Cave
