description: Cave high in a valley near Assisi where Francis meditated; site of Meditation and Purity Initiations.

name: Franciscan
description: One of the two major new mendicant friar orders of the early thirteenth century, whose members take vows of poverty, chastity, and obedience and travel preaching.

name: Franciscan Friar
description: Grog template for a young mendicant friar.

name: Franciscan Nun
description: Grog template for a Poor Sister with Lesser Purifying Touch.

name: Franciscan Teacher
description: Companion template: an indebted university master who became a Franciscan and seeks to convert pagans and the Order of Hermes.

name: Francisco
description: Cowardly Shadow Senator.

name: Francois filius Alban
description: Lartan Jerbiton magus at Valnastium.

name: Franconia
description: A large and important region of the Rhine Tribunal containing some of the greatest German cities, with no single ruler; land shared between emperor and church.

name: Francs-mitoux
description: A court of Parisian argotiers who feign fainting fits in public.

name: Frangarach
description: Manannan's sword, the Answerer, which always kills his opponent.

name: Frangipane Family
description: Roman family using the Colosseum as a fortress.

name: Frankfurt
description: A trading city founded by Charlemagne at the 'Ford of the Franks' on the River Main, home to about 10,000 citizens and host of imperial elections.

name: Franz
description: A monk who investigated the Cursewood, was scared off, and hid a copy of De Operationes Daemonum Dialogos.

name: Frater
description: Term meaning brother, used for a fellow male taught Hermetic magic by the apprentice's master; soror for a female.

name: Fraternity of Samos Lore
description: Organization Lore of the Fraternity.

name: Frau Wacholder
description: A wood-wife who is the genius of the juniper tree, invoked to make thieves give up their booty.

name: Frau Wode
description: The female leader of a Wild Hunt that haunts the Elbe river, accompanied by shadowy boatmen carrying invisible passengers.

name: Fredegisa the Quaesitor
description: A reforming idealist quaesitor at Schola Pythagoranis, a brilliant young student of all laws who devises new structures of Hermetic law.

name: Fredegund
description: Wife of Chilperic I and regent for Chlotar II.

name: Frederick of Harco
description: One of Harco's three young Redcaps.

name: Frederico
description: Parens of Gunther of the Cave.

name: Free Choice
description: Flaw a bacheler knight may take instead of Oath of Fealty.

name: Free House Virtue
description: House Virtue that an apprentice studying long enough with his parens may acquire.

name: Free the Devil's Servant
description: Malachi's Power that frees a trapped demon after sunset until dawn.

name: Freedom of Movement
description: A common automaton power (base effect 25, Mentem requisite) letting the automaton walk toward areas pointed out to it.

name: Freiberg
description: The biggest of the mining towns in the Ore Mountains, founded in 1186 after silver and tin were discovered.

name: Freiherr
description: German noble with an allodial holding, sometimes translated as baron.

name: French Lore
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Freshly Sprung
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw subtracting 50 experience points from Pretense pool.

name: Freya
description: Norse goddess of love, marriage and fertility, for whom the first aett is named.

name: Freya's Aett
description: The first aett of the Elder Futhark, named after the goddess Freya, containing Fehu through Wunjo.

name: Fria
description: The goddess worshiped by the old Germanic tribes alongside Woden, Thunor, and Tius.

name: Friderich Invigilor
description: The filius of Drogo Invigilor, similarly investigated by House Guernicus for his association with the Salian dynasty.

name: Friendly Gruagach Collective
description: Major Covenant Boon in which the covenant controls a nearby gruagach collective that trades vis and gives aid.

name: Friesland
description: A broad, flat, swampy territory bordering the North Sea, sparsely populated and home to the independent Friesian people and the Friesian Islands.

name: Frighten
description: Sluagh power (PeMe 30) that drives a target insane with terror.

name: Frisia
description: Saxon-descended land where Sin-Eating is common.

name: Friuli of Quaesitor
description: Full member of Magvillus and Transitionalist.

name: From Hill to Hollow
description: Loamwalker power to move instantly between trees within sight.

name: From Nag to Charger
description: Aeolus's power (MuAn 15) to change himself into any kind of horse.

name: From This Line Descended
description: InCo 30 spell revealing whether the target of an Arcane Connection descends from a given bloodline and how strong that blood is.

name: Frost Giant
description: Giants dwelling on an icy peak that forms a tether.

name: Frost Giants
description: Norse giants associated with Aquam that have Greater Immunity to cold.

name: Fuero
description: Iberian town charter that sets out militia obligations, exemptions and the equipment required of caballeros.

name: Fugitive Stone
description: Roaming mooring stone, Magic Might 10, chained in Artakia, longing for Jason.

name: Fulda
description: An important pilgrimage site and home to a wealthy monastery, burial place of the martyred English monk St. Boniface.

name: Fulk Nerra
description: Count of Anjou 987-1040, founder of Ronceray abbey.

name: Fulmen of Guernicus
description: Quaesitor who disseminated a convict's mystery secrets, lost his familiar as punishment, and joined House Jerbiton as an advocate.

name: Fulmonious
description: A magus of House Tytalus who, with Schwall of Bjornaer, founded the covenant of Rheinstein in the Rhine Gorge in 1123 AD.

name: Fumigant of Minor Demons
description: PeVi General Boundary ritual, a variant of Demon's Eternal Oblivion, destroying minor infernal spirits on the island.

name: Furious Attacks
description: Attacks usable against multiple opponents in a round without penalty.

name: Furled Pad
description: Unfurled pad used as mooring point.

name: Furlong
description: Long rectangular section of a field whose crop is chosen by the manor court.

name: Fury of the Charging Bull
description: A ReAn 20 spell that enrages a target animal (up to Size +3), sometimes used by School of Vilano followers to make animals attack enemies, though unpredictably.

name: Fürst
description: German title meaning prince, in the sense of the first member of a family.

name: Gabricon
description: Maker of Gabricon's Doormat of Welcoming.

name: Gabricon's Doormat of Welcoming
description: Enchanted doormat that senses and announces a visitor's name, and would reveal a demon's True Name.

name: Gadiel
description: Seraph whose name wards devils.

name: Gaia
description: Primordial earth goddess, mother of Dindyméné.

name: Galatea
description: Maga of House Guernicus from Antagonists who may watch the covenant for crimes.

name: Galconer
description: Faerie whose statistics are used for the human form of seducing kelpies.

name: Galdor magic
description: Icelandic spirit-invoking magic of the galdramen, possibly integrated into Hermetic Theory.

name: Galdrakona
description: Female galdor practitioner.

name: Galdraman
description: Icelandic magician who works galdor magic by bargaining with and summoning spirits.

name: Galdramen hreppur
description: Association of Icelandic galdramen led by Biorn Egilsson, targeted by the crusade and possibly integrated into the Order.

name: Galgilliel
description: Authority overseeing the sun, Divine Might 70.

name: Galizur
description: Ruler of Raqia.

name: Gallery
description: A Minor laboratory Structure Virtue: an interior gallery or platform lets someone view the whole lab without disturbing it (+1 Safety, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Teaching).

name: Galley
description: An oar-propelled single-masted vessel popular with Italian maritime powers and Byzantine states, designed to ram enemies and discourage piracy.

name: Galli
description: A sect of nature worshippers once associated with the wild lands beyond the Roman Empire, later integrated into the Cult of Diana, said to be the origin of a True Merinitae Initiation Script.

name: Gallo-Roman Tower of Tours
description: Windowless Roman brick tower west of Tours with Magic aura 1 at base and 5 at top.

name: Galloglaich
description: Heavy infantry of the Danish islanders who wear cotte or chain hauberk and carry two-handed axes; a character template.

name: Galloglaichs
description: Orcadian mercenaries fighting in chain mail with two-handed axes.

name: Galloway
description: Region where the monk wandered before finding the covenant.

name: Gallowglaigh
description: Grog template: a Hebridean mercenary trained to attack at a run in heavy chain armor, veteran of Irish wars.

name: Gallows Wood
description: Wood where Svetlana harvested vis.

name: Gambeson
description: Garment of padded material worn over, under or instead of armor; also aketon or arming jacket.

name: Ganelon
description: A leading magus of the Ash Gild who declared Wizard War on Aschlaranda and Schadrit and pursued them into the Black Forest, never to be heard from again.

name: Gang Leader
description: Virtue for leading a group, e.g. mortal shinty players.

name: Gang Member
description: Grog vocation: a northern Italian city gang youth now serving magi as a warrior.

name: Gang Member (Virtue)
description: Virtue appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Gangrene
description: A Minor Sanguine Disease in which evil spirits in an improperly cleaned wound putrefy the blood; common after a botched Wound Recovery roll.

name: Gar
description: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Spear", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

name: Garden of Gethsemane
description: Where Camuel and Gabriel visited Jesus.

name: Gargantua
description: Giant credited with throwing the Pierres de Niton and digging Lac Léman.

name: Garotillo
description: A Serious Choleric Disease from excessive exercise inflaming the choler; its second stage spreads to the windpipe causing suffocation.

name: Garrinchus
description: A newly apprenticed magus of House Ex Miscellanea at Fengheld's Rheingasse chapter, companion of Wilhelm Weiss and a member of the Apple Gild; his master was an expert in physick.

name: Garron
description: The small, surefooted Highland pony used to haul loads rather than for riding or war.

name: Gate of Eurydice
description: Abyss beneath Coeris through which Orpheus entered the underworld; focus of Tremere funeral practice, possibly a regio.

name: Gate of Paradise
description: Golden jeweled gate at the end of the Bridge to Paradise where angels heal and clothe visitors.

name: Gate spirit
description: Spirit of Vindolanda's gateway that can swallow the gatestone to seal off Scartaris.

name: Gatehouse Keep
description: Large building serving as gatehouse and keep.

name: Gatestone
description: Stone of Vindolanda's gateway that the gate spirit can swallow to seal the passage.

name: Gateway
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab sits at a supernatural gateway such as a regio entrance, faerie realm, or Mercere Portal.

name: Gathas
description: Divine hymns of Zoroaster revealing Ahura Mazda.

name: Gaudy
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab's decoration is tasteless and excessive (+1 Upkeep, -1 Aesthetics, +1 Imaginem).

name: Gauls
description: Ancient inhabitants of the region who revered the boar and sacrificed to spirits and faeries.

name: Gautier d'Arras
description: Famous 12th-century trouvère of Arras, author of Eracle.

name: Gavrinis
description: Tumulus gateway to Faerie.

name: Gawain
description: Arthurian knight who beheads the Green Knight.

name: Gaze of Death
description: A Corpus power of the basilisk Sordus (8 points) that inflicts an incapacitating wound on anyone his gaze rests upon.

name: Gaze of Gray Years
description: Enchantment/Woe 30 rite forcing an Aging roll with a +15 penalty on a target met eye to eye.

name: Ge
description: Protogonos of Greek myth, mother of the Titans with Ouranos.

name: Geamair
description: Mairi Sean's owl familiar (Gamekeeper), able to see spirits.

name: Geas for the Narcissistic Maiden
description: GvCu 15 geas inflicting the Minor Flaw Disfigured on a victim who acts without humility, until she acts with humility.

name: Geas of Retribution for the Unthinking Slap
description: GvCu 25 geas that cripples one arm of the target if he breaks the geas.

name: Gehin
description: Islamic degree of Hell for idolaters and pagans.

name: Geita
description: Island at the head of the Vilnes Fjord with a lighthouse kept by Thorstar.

name: Gello
description: An Italian ogress whose breasts drain the blood of children; Vulnerable to the Divine since three missionaries forced her to return a child's blood.

name: Gelon
description: Verditius's first apprentice and the first Primus of House Verditius; he attended the original Grand Tribunal, won the first Contest, and perpetuated the Corsican blood feud.

name: Gemini
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: General Chapter
description: Secret decision-making meetings of the Templars held in Acre.

name: General Prohibition
description: A prohibition roughly comparable to the Restriction Flaw, adding +2 magnitudes like Sun Duration.

name: Genies
description: Spirits of Arabic wizards that carry them in flight.

name: Genitor
description: The fourth astrological house.

name: Genius
description: Spirits created as such (never material), including Daimons and Airy Spirits.

name: Gennes
description: Place with a Roman amphitheatre beside a Magic regio of nymphs.

name: Genoese Crossbowmen
description: Specialist mercenary troops.

name: Genoese Lore
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Genomi
description: Earth elementals known to the Order as genomi, rarefied from unworked earth, rock, or metal; long-lived, patient predators that crave the moisture of living beings and make excellent guards.

name: Gentle Air
description: Major Quality removing social penalties of Gifted or Magical Air.

name: Gentle Caress of Aesclepius
description: A CrCo 30 Ritual spell that improves all of the target's wounds by one level of severity and instantly heals Light Wounds.

name: Geoffrey Fitz Stephen
description: English Templar commander (1180-1185).

name: Geoffrey V of Anjou
description: Married Matilda, conquered Normandy in 1144.

name: Geoffrey de Mandeville
description: A treacherous noble who, charged with treason in 1143, ravaged the East Anglian fens and destroyed the covenant of Natura Antiqua before being killed in 1144.

name: Geoffrey de Marsh
description: The justiciar of Ireland refusing to come to England to account for his office's revenues, possibly seeking to form a palatinate with vice-regal authority.

name: Geoffrey de Nevile
description: The seneschal of Poitou who returned to England to resign his office, claiming he lacked the resources to carry out his role.

name: Geoffrey of Brittany
description: Son of Henry II, died 1186, father of Arthur of Brittany.

name: Geoffroi D'Arques
description: A baron from Antagonists representing the nobility's rising interest in the supernatural.

name: Geoffroy Martel
description: Count of Anjou who founded the Abbey of the Trinity in 1032.

name: Geoffroy of Corseul
description: Man who extended St. Magloire in the new style.

name: Geoffroy of Rudel
description: Troubadour devoted to Countess Hodierna of Tripoli.

name: Geography
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Geomancy
description: Divinatory method using patterns in earth, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Geomantia
description: Divinatory ability possessed by many Terrae-Magi cultists.

name: Georgia
description: Eastern Christian state.

name: Gerald of Wales
description: A churchman who campaigned much of his life to make St. Davids an archbishopric over the Welsh sees, author of The Journey Through Wales.

name: Geran
description: Verdi magus who made Geran's Iron Pick for the covenant's mine.

name: Geran's Iron Pick
description: Lesser enchanted mining pick that destroys plain stone.

name: Gerard
description: A grog used in the complex combat example, with combat statistics and skills Single Weapon 6 and Leadership 2, who fights his faerie duplicate.

name: Gerard de Roussillon
description: Founder of Vézelay and bringer of St. Lazarus' relics to Autun.

name: Gerard of Cremona
description: Translated De Aluminibus et Salibus.

name: Gerbert of Aurilliac
description: Scholar with reputed minor magical talent who aided Hugh Capet; archbishop of Reims.

name: Gerfallon of Criamon
description: The tattooed, shape-shifting Criamon leader of Semitae since 1151 who maps the covenant's wanderings and pursues the Enigma; shows no signs of aging.

name: Gerfallon of Semitae
description: A magus of the tribunal whom some magi believe carved the strange cup-and-ring markings at Roughting Linn, though he will not confirm it.

name: German System
description: System of titles in the Holy Roman Empire, marked by the prefixes reichs- (imperial) and frei- (allodial).

name: Gerontocracy
description: A Free covenant governance choice in which the oldest members rule.

name: Gervase of Chichester
description: Foreign candidate favored by the papacy, elected to Sées after Sylvester.

name: Gervase of Tilbury
description: Defended lapidaries against skeptics.

name: Gevurah
description: Sefirah meaning 'Power', level 6 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 6.

name: Geza
description: Newly Christian King of the Magyars who made peace with Otto in 973.

name: Ghaddar
description: Ghula form who entices and paralyzes men.

name: Gharad Ex Miscellanea
description: The second oldest maga at Cad Gadu, nearly blind and beset by Twilight delusions; rarely leaves her sanctum.

name: Ghayba
description: Occultation of the twelfth imam.

name: Ghillie
description: Grog template: a sixteen-year-old young man of a clan eager to prove himself on raids.

name: Ghost Ship
description: A spectral ship projected by the psyche of a ghost, like its clothes or weapons, which can be made solid with Mentem magic.

name: Ghost of Hadrianus
description: Spirit of the drowned archmagus haunting a Scottish island, who blames the Order of Odin before resting.

name: Ghostly Body
description: Living Ghost power letting it turn invisible, pass walls and ignore physical attacks.

name: Ghostly Form/Physical Form
description: Orphan Born power to interact with ghostly or corporeal beings.

name: Ghostly Magic
description: Living Ghost power spending Might to make spells affect the physical world.

name: Ghostly Vis
description: Living Ghost power expending Might Score as raw vis.

name: Ghostly maiden
description: Ghost whose lament is Mentem vis.

name: Ghosts of Botzberg
description: Spirits of the AD 69 battle that recreate the fight with Hermetic magi.

name: Ghul Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety granting retractable claws.

name: Giacomo
description: Accomplished Bologna scholar who joined the First Crusade in 1096, found Greek formularies and founded the Mathematici; also used in rules examples.

name: Giant Blooded
description: A Virtue making a character larger than a normal human, so that a wound that would be Medium for a normal human is only Light for them.

name: Giant-Blooded
description: Virtue increasing Size, making a one-year-old Size -1.

name: Gift (Exceptional Talent)
description: Exceptional Talent (+4, +2 for gruagachan) granting Virtues or abilities or removing Flaws, tied to a prohibition.

name: Gift of Bear's Fortitude
description: Spell used in the Ash Branch of Muto Vis effect.

name: Gift of Prometheus
description: Gift of [God] charm granting Good Teacher; Stefano casts it before lectures.

name: Gift of Self Assurance
description: Power of the Spirit of Self-Importance that donates a Confidence point to an action that makes its target seem more competent.

name: Gift of Silver Fur and Red Teeth
description: She-Wolf ritual power imposing the Skinchanger Virtue, with wolf fur growing inward.

name: Gift of Venus
description: SuFa 25 charm granting Venus' Blessing; others in the Gift of [God] series exist.

name: Gift of the Gab
description: Example Lesser Benediction making the speaker convincing.

name: Gift of the Oneiropomp
description: Re(Mu)Te(Me) 15 Mystery spell sending a non-magical stone or metal object through a portal into a dream.

name: Gift of the Tortured Bowels
description: A Rego Corpus 10 spell that inflicts a sudden intestinal cramp and bout of diarrhea, used therapeutically by medically inclined magi to purge putrefied humors.

name: Gifted Gruagach Initiations
description: Scripts available only to Gifted gruagachan for Fetch and External Soul.

name: Gifted Lab Assistant
description: A Gifted child kept as a lab helper without having her Arts Opened; most Tribunals declare this practice a low crime.

name: Gigantic Sovereigns
description: The increasingly large rulers of the merfolk.

name: Gigantomachy
description: Ancient war after which Giants were imprisoned in the Faerie Lands.

name: Gilbert Erail
description: Grand Master (1194-1200).

name: Gilbert of Basingwerk
description: Abbot of Basingwerk to whom Owain told his vision.

name: Gilds of the Rhine
description: Political groupings characteristic of the Rhine Tribunal.

name: Giles of Assisi
description: Early follower of Francis, a farmer's son noted for fervent prayer and mysticism.

name: Gillomaur
description: The king of Ireland who swore the Britons would take no stone from his kingdom; his naked army was defeated and he was slain in a wood while fleeing.

name: Gilpatrick
description: An Irish-born baccalaureate student at the University of Paris and companion-level character with the Entrancement Ability and Latent Magic Ability, indebted to the bishop of Dublin.

name: Giovanni Parenti
description: Provincial of Spain who historically succeeds Elias at the head of the Franciscans.

name: Giovanni of Matha
description: Urban hermit living in the Acqua Claudia ruins who founds the Trinitarians and is canonized.

name: Giraud Le Cornu
description: A baron from Antagonists representing the Order drawing closer to the mundane and nobles' interest in the supernatural.

name: Girdle of the Virgin
description: Relic at Le Puy-Notre-Dame aiding childbirth, Faith score 1.

name: Gisela
description: Daughter of Henry of Bavaria who married Stephen of Hungary.

name: Giselbertine
description: Parens of Prima La.

name: Gite
description: French tax consisting of a feast for the lord and retinue on his tour of inspection; sometimes sold to others.

name: Giuseppe
description: Bored Shadow Senator who may cause havoc in Rome.

name: Giuseppe Del Mato
description: Italian Flambeau magus of Horsingas who hates Normans, attended by mastiff familiar Dent Coccinus.

name: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts
description: Invocation Adjuration effect (Level 50) summoning a supernatural being via a holy connection.

name: Gladiatrix
description: School of the Swordswoman using a phantasmal chessboard.

name: Glamorous Flesh
description: Flaw appearing in faerie statistics in this text (Glamorous Flesh).

name: Glamour Exercise Slates
description: Glamour completed exercise slates sold by Walter.

name: Glasgow
description: Cathedral city where St. Mungo built a church.

name: Glass-blower
description: A covenfolk template for a dwarf-blooded glassblower craftsman with Faerie Blood and Great Dexterity, able to make clear glass.

name: Glastig
description: Scottish faerie, the Green Maiden, an attractive blonde woman hiding goat limbs under a green dress.

name: Glaucon Trianomae
description: Magus Trianomae and Seeker who searches mountains for Mercurian temples.

name: Glaucon the Seeker
description: Example magus who invents a faerie realm-aligned version of Sight of the Transparent Motive.

name: Gleam of the Freshly-Polished Glass
description: A Perdo Terram 25 spell that keeps a lab's equipment immaculately clean, granting the Spotless Virtue while cast monthly but raising Warping by one.

name: Gleemen
description: A group of jugglers warned of by northern clerics as tainted by the infernal, accused of diabolical powers, robbery, and sacrificing stolen children to a demon patron.

name: Glen Glas
description: Valley where the buildings of the covenant of Mac Gruagach are spread, with a Magic aura of 0 to 5.

name: Glesig
description: A master maga of House Merinita at Irencillia, most versed in the subterranean fae and specializing in Terram magics; her copper hair is a Twilight effect and her familiar is the troll caricature Humnel.

name: Glide
description: Sir Excelsis's renamed Flight power allowing movement through water.

name: Gliocas
description: Caitlin's cu sith faerie dog companion of two hundred years.

name: Glittering Treasure
description: Nain power creating vanishing silver coins.

name: Gloria
description: Example maga selected by her cult to ascend to the Hall of Heroes via Ascendant Form and Transformation rituals.

name: Glossopetrae of Virtue
description: Stone Adder's Tongue containing 1 pawn of Aquam vis, Enriched to be an antidote to liquid poisons.

name: Glowing Footprints of the Thief
description: A MuIm 20 synaesthetic spell that makes a person's sweat traces visible by transforming olfactory species into iconic species.

name: Gluttony
description: One of the capital vices, opposed by a holy temper.

name: Gmünd
description: A town in the Stauferland founded by Conrad III in the 12th century, named after the Hohenstaufen dynasty; it lies on the ancient Roman limes and specializes in luxuries.

name: Gniezno
description: Polish archdiocese.

name: Gnostic Philosophers of Rome
description: Group favoring Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes as a path to immortality.

name: Goat Hill
description: Hill with a Faerie Aura 5 used in a Threshold example with Branoic.

name: Goat of Virtue
description: The best climber among beasts, with eyesight keen enough to tell hunters from travelers at a distance.

name: Goat's Foot
description: Late-medieval lever for spanning a crossbow.

name: Gobert of Eze
description: Cluniac monk driven mad in purgatory who learned necromancy and began the corruption of Cluny through necromantic rites.

name: Goblin Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety granting a bonus to stealth totals.

name: Goblin Duke of Normandy
description: Mysterious figure universally dreaded by lutin, unknown to the Order.

name: Goblin Rats
description: Rats of Devil's Lane.

name: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever
description: Purity Cursing effect (Level 40) striking the target instantly dead.

name: Godar
description: Icelandic chieftains involved in peace negotiations.

name: Godfrey of St-Omer
description: One of the nine founding knights of the Templars with Hugh of Payns.

name: Godfroi
description: An example agent of Carolus, a merchant who handles stolen goods and is influential in local government and the Merchant Guild; held by Fear of Carolus.

name: Godred of Man
description: King of Man defeated by Somerled in 1156.

name: Gods of Tartessos
description: Old faerie gods of Tartessos who stir when player characters create a rich port at the edge of the world.

name: Godsibs
description: The three baptismal sponsors (godfathers and godmothers) required by the Church for each child.

name: Goetic Mastery
description: Spell mastery ability adding a Goetic Art to casting totals for spells targeting spirits.

name: Gold Cord
description: Familiar bond cord.

name: Gold-Making of Cleopatra
description: Gnostic alchemical text.

name: Golden Book
description: Venetian register of the city's founding families.

name: Golden Cider
description: The power gained at the Avenue of Death on the Path of Strife, which makes mystical things mundane; many followers use it upon themselves near death to relinquish The Gift.

name: Golden Eagle Messenger
description: Speaking golden eagle serving the Queen of the Island of Little Cattle.

name: Golden Head of Gerbert
description: A legendary golden head crafted by Gerbert of Aurillac said to answer yes or no to any question; rumored to be used in Verditius Mystery Cult initiations.

name: Golden Maiden of Hephaestus
description: An ancient automaton created by Hephaestus and left in his forge; Verditius alone could understand it and made it function for seven days.

name: Golden Map
description: A solid-gold, gemstone-marked copy of an ancient Roman map given to Augustus Caesar; coveted as an enchantment shape and possible Arcane Connection, and rumored by some pagans to sustain the Dominion.

name: Golden dove of Constantine
description: Golden dove bearing the Holy Word that helped Constantine root out Infernal corruption; since lost.

name: Goliardic tradition
description: A tradition of wandering, irreverent student-poets famously led by the Archpoet, spreading debauchery and satire across Germany and Italy.

name: Goliath of Gath
description: The most famous giant in Mythic Europe, from the Bible, nine and a half feet tall (Size +2).

name: Gonfanier
description: Banner-bearer of the Templars.

name: Good Arms
description: Virtue possessed by Donncadh Mac Calum.

name: Good Characteristics
description: Virtue for points spent on Characteristics.

name: Good Works
description: Seasonal activity of worthy deeds, Source Quality 2 and 1 Faith Point.

name: Goodwin
description: Author of Reading the Perturbations of Place.

name: Goose
description: Prey animal; the largest prey a wild gyrfalcon can kill.

name: Goose maiden
description: Faerie shapeshifter; Charlotte's mother was one.

name: Goose of Virtue
description: A good watchman that can smell humans better than any other animal.

name: Gorget
description: Stiff collar protecting throat and neck.

name: Gorgias
description: A Sophist and pupil of Empedocles quoted in the Analects of Tytalus who taught the arts of persuasion and deceit, illustrating the corrupting power of words.

name: Gorgoneion
description: The head of the gorgon used as a traditional symbol warding off evil.

name: Goshawk
description: Hawk flown from the fist, aggressive toward small prey.

name: Goslar
description: A Free Imperial City on the northern edge of the Harz Mountains, famed for the silver mines of the Rammelsberg, which are flooding due to spiteful gnomes.

name: Gossip of the Marketplace
description: A Creo(Rego) Mentem 20 spell invented by Imanitos Mendax that implants information in a target who is then compelled to pass it on to friends.

name: Gothic cathedrals
description: Great cathedrals created by architects with non-magical tools, masterpieces of the Dominion.

name: Gotland
description: Baltic island that cannot be purchased from its ruler.

name: Goulis family
description: Hereditary seneschals of Scotland who hold Monksend castle and are rumored to worship the Devil.

name: Gown of Enfolding Colors
description: Evocation/Beguile 15 rite making everyone in a room perceive the caster or another as especially beautiful.

name: Goëmagot
description: A monstrous giant twelve cubits tall from Geoffrey of Monmouth's history, who slaughtered Britons with twenty companions.

name: Grace (Duration)
description: Holy magic Duration lasting while the caster remains without mortal sin; equal to Year.

name: Graculus
description: Example magus who becomes a Living Ghost with a 1,000-pace Haunt and Might 50; later Graculus Defunctus.

name: Grades of the Brethren
description: Four grades of the Brethren of Purity requiring increasing Ability scores.

name: Graf
description: German title equivalent to count, with variants such as burgrave and landgraf.

name: Grail Library
description: Celeres' collection of texts on Arthur and the Grail at Cunfin.

name: Grail Quest
description: Arthurian legend not yet fully realized in 1220.

name: Grail Templars
description: Wolfram's Grail guardians, distinct from the Knights Templar.

name: Granary
description: Building storing threshed grain and flour; a prime raider target.

name: Grand Charge
description: The main melee charge, adjudicated by random encounters or mass combat.

name: Grand Commander
description: Great official second only to the grand master, carrying the beauseant.

name: Grand Council of Venice
description: Council of 480 true rulers of Venice, perpetuating Infernal activity.

name: Grand Entrance
description: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: an elaborate entranceway leads to the lab, impressing observers (+2 Aesthetics).

name: Grand Master
description: Supreme leader of the Templars, elected for life, with Holy Influence.

name: Grand Master's Seal
description: Double-sided seal and Divine relic with Faith Score 1 granting Divine Might 10 and protection against gluttony.

name: Grand Sabbat
description: A gathering of many folk witch covens; one is held each All Hallow's Eve in Stonehenge and another on Walpurgis' Night at Brocken Mountain.

name: Grand Tour
description: Jerbiton pre-Gauntlet visit to a large city to view artifacts.

name: Grande Brière
description: Immense peat marsh between the Loire and Vilaine estuaries, rich in fish, eels and wildfowl but scarcely inhabited.

name: Grant Deficiency
description: Wyzwanie's power halving a target's Ability or Form until sunrise or sunset.

name: Grant Fortuna Belli
description: TuFa 15 charm making combatants re-roll non-positive Attack Advantage for a Martial Ability.

name: Grant Longevity
description: Eiael's power to remove Aging Points.

name: Grant Lost Love Flaw
description: Manannan's ritual power: shaking his cloak between two people ensures they never meet again.

name: Grant Magical Power
description: Godhead power granting Puissant Art, tainted with the infernal.

name: Grant Puissance in Combat
description: Faun music power granting +3 on Weapon Skills.

name: Grant Victory
description: Morrighu's Power granting +3 to Attack and Damage for a battle.

name: Grant a Glimpse of the Future
description: GvVs 30 spell granting the recipient hints and visions about a specific topic for a Moon.

name: Granyena
description: Castle given to the Templars by Ramon Berengeur II.

name: Grapple
description: Maneuver holding a defender, imposing -6 and preventing spell gestures.

name: Graslei
description: Ghent's main docks.

name: Grateful Lions
description: Actor: two playful, speaking lions who offer friendship for aid.

name: Grave of the Dragon
description: Rubble at Brand.

name: Grave-Faerie
description: Threshold faerie met by an old man.

name: Graveyard of the Arch-Magi
description: Hidden tomb in the Apennines, Magic Aura six, where Arch-Magi are interred, protected by Magvillus.

name: Gravis
description: A journeyman magus of House Bonisagus at Irencillia pursuing a fascination with the fae; despite great Faerie Lore he cannot grasp Faerie Magic, and his caricature is the grumpy dwarf Danket.

name: Gravis of House Flambeau
description: Magus who slew the prankster Talus with a Ball of Abyssal Flame and was later slain by Dominicus.

name: Gray Leather Jerkin of the Prince
description: The Prince of the Grey Jerkin's enchanted jerkin (protection 15) that repels wooden objects and can turn the wearer to mist.

name: Great Bearer
description: Minor Heroic Virtue letting one carry twice as much and travel twice as far.

name: Great Characteristics
description: A Virtue boosting a character's physical or mental Characteristics; held by the Blacksmith template.

name: Great Convocation
description: Gathering of Green Cockerel Initiates held every seven years in Alexandria.

name: Great Fermenter of the Seven Salts
description: Bladud's alchemical engine of four barrels.

name: Great Hall (Confluensis)
description: Largest pad of the Sundew at Confluensis, with dining, training and storage.

name: Great Immunity
description: Virtue such as Great Immunity: Drowning, suggested for water-aura inhabitants.

name: Great Iron Tree
description: Legendary tree enchanted by one hundred Mercurians for a mysterious task.

name: Great Leap
description: Power to leap 30 paces up or 50 across, possessed by the Great Stallion and White Stag.

name: Great Library at Alexandria
description: Library supposedly maintained by the Mutantes' ancestors before its destruction by Caesar.

name: Great Ones
description: Ancient beings Latrunculus believes are buried at major intersections of the Roman road network.

name: Great Perception
description: Characteristic Virtue.

name: Great Saint Bernard Pass
description: Important pass with a hospice monastery.

name: Great Schism
description: The schism between Latin and Greek Churches, complete by about 1054.

name: Great Stone of Bladud
description: Stone enchanted to be perpetually hot.

name: Great Sword
description: Late medieval two-handed sword.

name: Great Temple
description: Secret temple of the Legion of Mithras, legendarily in a cavern in the Greater Alps, holding its Initiatory manual.

name: Great Tower of Bourges
description: Keep in Bourges's southern wall, prototype of the Louvre.

name: Great Tree
description: The tree that holds the world together, climbed by taltós in vision quests to reach other worlds.

name: Great William
description: A Redcap with giants' blood standing just under eight feet tall; interested in magical theory, with boots of swiftness and an enchanted accurate axe.

name: Greater Collection
description: The sum of all Hermetic libraries, which great libraries coordinate to build by specializing in areas of weakness; Durenmar aids its construction as a spare copy of its own collection.

name: Greater Dream Magic
description: Virtue replacing Fourth Edition Oneiromancy along with Dream Magic.

name: Greater Expansion
description: A Major laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is greatly enlarged with at least double the usual equipment for specialized tasks.

name: Greater Faerie Power
description: Faerie Virtue granting a greater power.

name: Greater Feature
description: A Major laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab prominently features a unique extensive structure aiding certain lab work, granting +2 Aesthetics and 3 Specialization points.

name: Greater Focus
description: A Major laboratory Structure Flaw: an existing Greater Feature is the overwhelming focus of the lab, enhancing it but hindering unrelated activities (-2 General Quality).

name: Greater Guardian
description: A Major laboratory Supernatural Virtue: a powerful supernatural creature (Might 20+) that is not the owner's familiar resides in and protects the lab.

name: Greater Horde
description: A Major laboratory Supernatural Virtue: a large community of minor supernatural creatures serves and protects the lab and assists with simple tasks.

name: Greater Illusion
description: A Major laboratory Supernatural Flaw: a major aspect of the lab is merely an illusion; a balancing Major Virtue is taken but its effects are negated.

name: Greater Immunity (Deprivation)
description: Major Supernatural Virtue making a character immune to deprivation like magic beings.

name: Greater Immunity to Flame and Heat
description: Virtue of Adramelech.

name: Greater Introduction to Astrology
description: Abu Ma'shar's work, translated in 1133.

name: Greater Magical Defenses
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue doubling Magical Defense Bonuses.

name: Greater Magical Power
description: A Virtue or Magic Quality named among the traits of magical animals or dragons in this text.

name: Greater Secundus
description: Second-ranking officer of House Jerbiton, who does not live in the Valley.

name: Greaves
description: Armor for the lower legs.

name: Greed Passion
description: Virtue appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Greek Cult of Hermes
description: Cult that came to Italy c. 700 B.C.

name: Greek Islands
description: Possible location of Bonisagus's lost books.

name: Greek Orthodox Church
description: Eastern church whose patriarchs have Magic Resistance 20.

name: Green Dragon of Labin
description: A dragon famously slain by the Flambeau magus Vilano, who crushed it with two falling trees using only indirect spells.

name: Green Fingers
description: Example Lesser Benediction making plants prosper.

name: Green Kings
description: Third degree: separation, Mars, green, iron; Initiated into Unaging before exile.

name: Green Knight
description: Knight beheaded by Gawain; also an actor story element idea.

name: Green Stone
description: A stone said to have fallen from Heaven, perhaps from Lucifer's brow or carved into the Holy Grail; the Knights of the Green Stone seek it.

name: Green Stone Lore
description: The cult Lore of the Knights of the Green Stone.

name: Greeting the Maker
description: Spell (InTe 30) known by Amberitus.

name: Gregorius of Bonisagus
description: A young Bonisagus magus, one of the newly arrived members of Libellus.

name: Greta's Coven
description: A folk witch coven, mostly living city-side in Bologna and Florence.

name: Grettir the Strong
description: Saga hero whose saga tells of the revenant Glam.

name: Grey Lady of the River
description: Example supernatural entity offering service in return for dominion over auras.

name: Grey Wolf
description: Helper in the tale of Prince Ivan; example of the helper role.

name: Griffin vulture
description: Large raptor of the Adriatic coast, popular as intelligence gatherer.

name: Grifo
description: An example famous maestro affiliated with the Divine realm, commissioned to paint a wall mural for the bishop of Milan.

name: Grim
description: An example grog used to illustrate disease and demonic possession rules, who is assailed by a Demon of Scrofula.

name: Grime's Graves
description: About a dozen large pits with tunnels in a Norfolk chalk hill, believed to be inhabited by faerie folk; those who wander too close at night tend to vanish, and strange lights are seen.

name: Grindylow
description: Yorkshire variant of Jenny Greenteeth inhabiting pools and marshes.

name: Grochan
description: Minor faeries who, along with brownies, perform household chores at Crun Clach.

name: Grog Captain
description: Leader of grogs.

name: Group Combat
description: ArM5 rules letting characters fight as a group with a leader and vanguard, sharing a combat bonus and inflicting Damage per member.

name: Group Leader
description: The character commanding a group in combat; issuing orders is usually a fast action and the leader's Presence + Leadership governs Discipline, Morale and rallying.

name: Group Modifier
description: Leaderless ceremony bonus equal to total Ceremony scores minus 13.

name: Grove of St. Lie
description: Oak grove on a Gaulish burial mound with a chapel to St. Lie, whose flowers yield Creo vis as a tropaeum.

name: Grows Quickly
description: Minor Child Virtue treating the character as one age category higher for Size.

name: Growth and Shrinking
description: Manannan's paired Focus Powers letting him alter his size with spells up to level 25.

name: Growth of Creeping Things
description: Spell mentioned as an alternative way to generate bees, one of the insects created when destroying beef.

name: Gruagach (deity)
description: Pictish god of the sun, plants and animals, patron of the gruagachan who grants external souls and other favors.

name: Gruagach Ally
description: Minor Covenant Boon: a single gruagach living near the covenant who assists the magi.

name: Gruagach Collective
description: The typical gruagach organization of one to three Gifted gruagachan with unGifted students, which competes with others for vis and apprentices.

name: Gruagach Initiations
description: Initiation Scripts through which unGifted gruagachan gain their Arts, such as the Curse Initiation fulfilled by punishing a wrongdoer or the Shape Initiation tied to shapechangers.

name: Gruagach Knowledge
description: Basic gruagach ability granted at character creation.

name: Gruagach Resident
description: Minor Covenant Hook: one or more gruagachan live in the covenant, likely drawing a Quaesitor's visit.

name: Gruagach Tattoo
description: Enchanted tattoos, usually animal-shaped like Pictish carvings, imparting magical effects on their bearer.

name: Gruffyd ap Llewelyn
description: A Welsh king who attacked England, besieged Blackthorn and sacked Cad Gadu; magi suspected him of being a returned Díedne magus due to his name.

name: Gruoch
description: Queen buried at Relig Oran with MacBeth.

name: Gryphon
description: Creature whose eye might restore Polyphemus' sight.

name: Guard
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: a shield grog stands permanent duty at the lab's entrance to dissuade intruders (+1 Aesthetics).

name: Guardian dog of Pagan's Hill
description: Spirit in the form of a huge dog guarding the Mercurian temple.

name: Guardian of the Faith
description: Local role of Children of Hermes member collecting vis dues.

name: Guardian of the Fishes
description: A huge, human-shaped scaled faerie of the Baltic Sea with fish fins, gills and eyes, which rarely leaves the water.

name: Guardian of the Forest
description: A self-declared role, usually taken by a Bjornaer magus, claiming a forest or wilderness as personal Hermetic territory; treated as the Oath of Fealty Sacrifice rather than a Quest.

name: Guardians of Iceland
description: Ancient bound protectors of Iceland against hostile magic: Pan Caudarax, Vindsvall and the Gray Bull.

name: Guardians of Purgatory
description: Small Holy Tradition favoring Meditation, Purity, Understanding, and Intervention that guards the gate to Purgatory.

name: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal
description: Supplement with more information on Falke.

name: Guardinia of Merinita
description: Maga who accused Berenguer of Tytalus of molesting the fay.

name: Gubbio
description: City in Umbria terrorized by a man-eating wolf.

name: Gudruty-kom the Giant
description: A giant Daimon (Magic Might 40, Auram), master of hail who can stretch his mouth from the ground to the clouds and swallow storms and spells; once revered in the lands of the Albanians.

name: Guerin of Montaigu
description: Brother of Peter of Montaigu and Grand Master of the Hospitallers.

name: Guernicus Advocate
description: A Guernicus magus who defends absent defendants or clients with strong cases.

name: Guest of the House
description: A Minor General Virtue making a magus politically a member of House Criamon while built using another House's rules.

name: Guglielmo de Pusterla
description: The podesta of Bologna who forbade the Oath of Matriculation, demanding masters swear loyalty to the city rather than to non-city organizations.

name: Guides to Adventure
description: Child-stealing faeries who take children on dangerous stories.

name: Guild
description: Associations of craftsmen offered as a model for explaining covenants to society.

name: Guild Lore
description: An Organization Lore Ability covering the rules and bylaws of a guild, required at increasing scores for journeymen, masters, senior masters, and deans.

name: Guild of Masters
description: Non-democratic masters' guild of the University of Bologna that decides who teaches.

name: Guild of Saint Bartholomew
description: A guild dedicated to Saint Bartholomew, used as an example of guild processions earning Devotion.

name: Guild of Saint Peter
description: A guild dedicated to Saint Peter competing in the Easter Day procession.

name: Guild of Watermen
description: A particularly powerful guild in large cities lacking sufficient bridges, such as Paris and Venice; watermen ship goods and passengers along rivers, coasts, and fords.

name: Guild-Master Wendell
description: The pedantic self-appointed leader of the merchant guild, selling wands.

name: Guild-Mistress Greta
description: A faerie-blooded folk witch councilor selling potions.

name: Guillot
description: Baudouin's brother, whose naked corpse lay where the slain wolf had been; he was his brother's rival for Odette.

name: Guiseppe
description: Visiting merchant at Harco who told Tamgor the covenant was honest in its trade.

name: Gulf of Morbihan
description: Gulf.

name: Gulf of Taranto
description: Gulf dividing southern Italy.

name: Gull Hellirsson
description: Leader of the fire giants, a Jotunn of the Clan of Geirrod who wields a dwarf-forged warhammer able to break wards and seeks vengeance on Julius's forces.

name: Gulo Midusulfis
description: Bjornaer co-founder of Atramentum Renatus.

name: Gunhilda
description: A member of the covenfolk of Oculus Septentrionalis whose elder sister Matilda serves as autocrat and Henri's housekeeper.

name: Gunhilda Henrasdottir
description: A Follower of Jerbiton (age 31), daughter and filia of Henri de Tours, a young maga specializing in housecraft who is married to Estrid.

name: Gunnar Loftursson
description: Neighboring bondi and church warden who seeks ond from Vindolanda's magi to save his gravely ill daughter.

name: Gunnar of Ex Miscellanea
description: Example theurgist magus who invokes the spirits Akkala and Nissila to cast Pilum of Fire.

name: Gunter
description: Klaus's apprentice in the worked example, a storyguide character with Strength +1 and Swordsmith 3 who is trained over the course of the example.

name: Gunthelm
description: Subject of a medieval otherworld vision.

name: Gunther (redcap)
description: Newly Gauntleted redcap briefed by Mary on his warming pin and survival in the Alps.

name: Gutenberg Printing Press
description: Historical press from 1455 used as a model for the impact of mass book production.

name: Guthred
description: Great-grandson of Duncan invited by the Mac Williams in 1211; captured and beheaded.

name: Guy (son of Perceval)
description: The ten-year-old eldest child of the Redcap Perceval and Lucy.

name: Guy of Lusignan
description: Erstwhile King of Jerusalem who bought Cyprus from the Templars.

name: Guy, Baron Naworth
description: Uncle of Henry Fitz-Hubert who has borne many Horsingas raids.

name: Guyomart
description: Unfaithful lover of Morgan Le Fay trapped at False Lover's Rock.

name: Guérande
description: Settlement overlooking the Brière marsh with the church of St. Aubin, built on a baptistery site; salt is extracted nearby.

name: Gwawrieir
description: The eldest swynwraig and effective leader of the Columbae who opposed joining Pralix; found strangled within her own protective circle while wearing the enchanted robes that became the Robes of Dusty Dawn.

name: Gwenn (the white mantle)
description: King Arthur's white mantle in the Dream of Rhonabwy; anyone wrapped in it can see everyone while remaining invisible.

name: Gwenolod
description: A kingdom destroyed by drowning by the Red Knight of Ys.

name: Gwenwynwyn
description: A persistent Welsh foe of Llywelyn, lord of Powys who repeatedly switched allegiance between Llywelyn and King John.

name: Gwiber
description: A Welsh dragon that begins as an orm and grows leathery wings after tasting human breast milk; may form a milk-brother bond with a human infant.

name: Gwion Bach
description: Hero who gains magical powers from Ceridwen's cauldron.

name: Gwydyon
description: The librarian and autocrat of Cad Gadu, a large, resigned man in his fifties who keeps the neglected library from outright ruin.

name: Gwynasere
description: Venerable recipient of a Flambeau letter complaining about Horsingas.

name: Gwyndolen
description: The wife of Colomen who, with him, adapted the Columbae's ward-powers to Hermetic magic and spread their ward-spells through the Order.

name: Gwynedd
description: An ancient Welsh principality in the north, centered on the fort of Aberffro; ruled by Llywelyn the Great.

name: Gwynn ab Nudd
description: The king of the faeries and of Annwfn, who dwells in a faerie castle on Glastonbury Tor; St. Collen banished him and his castle with holy water.

name: Gyöngy
description: A sorceress who never joined the Order but whose magpie-heartbeast descendants founded the Sept of Gyöngy during the Schism War.

name: Gâvre Forest
description: Forest near Blain in which a leper hospital is hidden.

name: Gérard of Ridefort
description: Grand Master (1185-1189).

name: H. of Sawtrey
description: Anonymous monk who wrote the Tractatus de Purgatorio Sancti Patricii around 1160, perhaps Henricus of Basingwerk.

name: Habach Valley
description: Lost emerald mine.

name: Hachim al'Khalejj
description: A quiet Muslim magus of House Criamon at Waddenzee (age 36), filius of Hassan of Fengheld, whose knowledge of astrology aids the pirates' raids.

name: Hackney
description: Draught horse used for farm work and pulling carts.

name: Hadewijch of Antwerp
description: Child in 1220 overcome by intense love of God, a future mystic.

name: Hadith
description: Individual narrative reports of the Prophet; also the collective literature.

name: Hadrian I
description: Pope (772-795) who revised Dionysus Exiguus' canons.

name: Hadrianus
description: Archmagus of House Flambeau who sailed for Iceland in 1214 hunting the Order of Odin, was attacked by Pan Caudarax, fell into Twilight and drowned; his ghost later haunted a Scottish island.

name: Hag Ride
description: Sexual demon Power to 'ride' a paralyzed victim for an evening, costing Fatigue.

name: Hagbui
description: An undead Viking barrow-dweller that guards buried treasure, with powers such as Rock Swimming, Reanimation and Immunity to Edged Weapons; Magic Might 10.

name: Hague-Dicke
description: Ninth-century Norse earthwork cutting off the northwest Cotentin, now ruined and rumored to hide buried loot.

name: Haifa
description: Coastal town near Athlit.

name: Hakennman
description: Merman with the body and tail of a fish and a human torso rising from the front.

name: Haland
description: Ungifted Viking warrior, elder brother of Harivald, ancestor of the lords of Montverte.

name: Halberd
description: Late-medieval pole axe with a spike and hook for dragging riders from horses.

name: Haleyon's Idyllic Day
description: Halcyon power calming storms over water.

name: Half-free Peasant
description: Free person who rents villein land and so owes villein service.

name: Halfgrim
description: An example grog who suffers Light and Medium wounds in combat and is treated with First Aid and Palliative Care at a covenant.

name: Halfling
description: Person with one faerie and one mortal parent, common among Journeys End Merinita.

name: Halitgar
description: Author of the Roman Penitential.

name: Hall
description: The chief building of a manor and residence of the lord or his bailiff, typically a timber long house 60-75 feet long.

name: Hall Keep
description: Long, low stone keep evolved from the manorial hall; the most spacious keep.

name: Hallowe'en
description: All Saints' Eve ending October, when the dead are thought to walk.

name: Hallstadt
description: Salt mines in the Greater Alps Tribunal haunted by faeries.

name: Hallstadt faeries
description: Salt-mine faeries demanding salt hearts.

name: Hallucinations
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is afflicted by vivid hallucinations that seem like true visions but are figments of imagination.

name: Halo
description: Abbas' power, as Lamp Without Flame.

name: Hamadan
description: Persian city with the tomb of Ibn Sina.

name: Hamburg
description: A Free Imperial City and trading port on the River Elbe with a violent history of Viking and Wendish raids, occupied by Valdemar II in 1216; once home to St. Ansgar before the see moved to Bremen.

name: Hanafis
description: Madhhab (school of Islamic law) founded by Abu Hanifa.

name: Hanbalis
description: Madhhab founded by Ahmad ibn Hanbal.

name: Hand of Glory
description: Infernal item made from a hanged murderer's hand dipped in wax, with five finger-candle charges that render sleepers unconscious; Valefar teaches its making.

name: Handfast
description: Highland trial marriage.

name: Hands of Life
description: Spring folk witch initiation script granting the Major Virtue Healing and the Flaw Enfeebled.

name: Hands of the Magical Animal
description: Personal Power letting an animal carry and manipulate items as with human hands.

name: Hans
description: Klaus's journeyman employee in the worked example, a storyguide character with Strength +2 and Swordsmith 5.

name: Hanukkah
description: Eight-day festival commemorating the miracle of oil.

name: Haoviath
description: Seventh and deepest Islamic degree of Hell, for hypocrites.

name: Hapsburg Family
description: Noble family, rival of the Zähringers, which followed a policy of founding new towns.

name: Hapsburgs
description: Noble family named after the castle of Hapsburg in Vindonossa.

name: Harald Fairhair
description: Norwegian king who created the earldom of the Orkneys.

name: Harald Hardrada
description: King of Norway killed at Stamford Bridge in 1066.

name: Haram
description: Sanctuary area around the Ka'ba at Mecca, direction of prayer.

name: Harco Village
description: Village below Harco populated by covenfolk relatives.

name: Harco's Magical Ships
description: Four enchanted ships of Harco that never lack wind, cannot sink and always find home port.

name: Hard Tartan
description: Water-shedding woolen cloth made from oily Highland wool.

name: Harder Man
description: Possessed monk turned to stone as a face on Mount Harder, looking over the Oberland.

name: Hardness of Adamantine
description: A MuTe 25 spell that instills a metal object with supernatural hardness, making it nearly unbreakable and boosting armor Protection by +2 or weapon damage by +1.

name: Hardy Convalescence
description: Virtue listed in character statistics in this text.

name: Hare of Virtue
description: A swift, timid hare that can change sex; Alpine hares turn white by eating snow.

name: Harenarius
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue, a 'Person of the Sand' able to master two Certamen Schools, starting with Reputation 2 as a master duelist among Tremere.

name: Harivald
description: Viking sorcerer, founder of Montverte and of a Flambeau lineage.

name: Harmonizer
description: Type of magus Bonisagi integrating other magic into Hermetic theory; a Magic Theory specialization.

name: Harmony
description: In Criamon cosmology, the force that attracts and promotes cohesion; one of the two great forces of the universe, reflected by the Art of Creo.

name: Harness the Wind
description: Incubus/succubus Power allowing swift flight from one place to another.

name: Harnessed Casting
description: Mutantes mastery ability to end a spell at will.

name: Harnessing
description: Mutantum technique letting the caster end a spell early by concentrating.

name: Harold's Vengeance
description: A covenant founded in 1066 in the East Anglian fens by Saxon magi seeking to drive William the Conqueror from England; Marched and destroyed by 1068 for repeated Code violations.

name: Harpin of Mountain
description: Giant from the romances, probably Size +3 or less.

name: Harran
description: City in Syria home of the Sabeans.

name: Harrier
description: Small dog used to chase hares in bow and stable hunting.

name: Harrowing of Hell
description: The common belief that Jesus descended into Hell before his resurrection and liberated the limbo of the Fathers.

name: Harsh Moon
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the folk witch suffers a Heavy Wound during each Witch's Moon.

name: Harstein
description: Elder member of Harco overseeing daily operations.

name: Haruspicy
description: Divinatory method using entrails of sacrificed animals, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Hasan of Basra
description: Mystic who prayed on water in a story with Rabi'a.

name: Hasan-i Sabbah
description: Persian Fatimid propagandist who seized Alamut in 1090 and founded the Assassins.

name: Hasophis
description: Legendary founder of the Cult of Mercury, said to be buried in the southern Alps.

name: Hassan El-Megrayhi
description: A master of Fengheld of House Criamon who maintains a lone tower (Turris Acontiarum) in the Kyffhauser Mountains studying the stars with a single mute companion.

name: Hassan of Fengheld
description: A magus of Fengheld who is the Hermetic parens of Hachim al'Khalejj of Waddenzee.

name: Hatchet
description: Inexpensive slashing single weapon.

name: Hatred Passion
description: Virtue of Damhan-allaidh (Order of Hermes).

name: Hatred for Seekers
description: A Minor Ordeal Flaw from the Bind Curse Initiation, a burning loathing for other magi not of the House who seek Hephaestus-made items.

name: Haubergeon
description: Short-sleeved armored tunic.

name: Hauberk
description: Knee-length long-sleeved coat of flexible armor.

name: Hauberk of Sublime Lightness
description: A PeTe 30 spell that renders a suit of metal armor nearly weightless, reducing its Load while leaving its bulk unchanged.

name: Haunt
description: The area to which a Living Ghost's spirit is bound; if destroyed, the ghost is unbound.

name: Haurvatat
description: One of the Zoroastrian Immortals (Amesha Spentas): 'Health', associated with Strong and Aquam/Auram in the Blessing ritual.

name: Hautefort
description: Castle of the de Born family.

name: Hautvillers Abbey
description: Abbey founded in 660 by St. Nivard, famed for decorated manuscripts.

name: Havamal
description: Norse poem quoted.

name: Have mercy upon me, O LORD for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed
description: Purity Intervention miracle (Level 50) instantly healing a Heavy Wound.

name: Havfrue
description: Mermaid whose sighting warns of storms; herds white cattle on terrestrial grass during fogs.

name: Hawk Hood
description: Embroidered or bejeweled hood keeping a hawk calm, a fashion from the court of Sicily.

name: Hawk of Virtue
description: A finely trained Hawk of Virtue is a gift worthy of one's liege.

name: Hawking
description: Falconry, a prestigious noble pursuit of hunting with trained birds of prey.

name: Hayward
description: Villein officer overseeing harvest laborers, guarding the crop and the pasture.

name: Head of John the Baptist
description: Relic claimed by churches in Amiens, Constantinople and Damascus; Faith 5, Divine Might 50.

name: Head of the Novitiate
description: Official responsible for those preparing to take religious vows.

name: Head of the statue of Minerva
description: Buried head holding 7 pawns of Aquam vis.

name: Heal
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Heal Guardian
description: Host power healing the guardian one Health level per 10 Might.

name: Heal a Medium Wound
description: CrCo 25 healing Ritual invested in Medica's Staff of Healing.

name: Heal an Incapacitating Wound
description: CrCo 35 healing Ritual invested in Medica's Staff of Healing.

name: Healer
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Healers
description: Mercere magi who craft healing items and spells.

name: Healing (spirit power)
description: Ritual spirit power of healing possessed by al-Meraya and Aillwee.

name: Healing Gaze
description: Caladrius Ritual Power drawing non-fatal disease from a patient into itself.

name: Healing Runes
description: Vitkar magic focus on bone.

name: Heard Healu
description: Sir Edwin's enchanted, combat-trained magical horse companion under a permanent Steed of Vengeance.

name: Hearing the Silent Chorus
description: An Intellego Imaginem 15 spell invented by academic magi that lets the recipient barely hear the unheard sounds of planetary orbits (musica mundana), granting a bonus to astrology or song composition.

name: Heart of the Lion
description: A CrMe 15 spell that instills indomitable courage, raising the target's Brave Personality Trait by +3, sometimes leading to recklessness.

name: Heart's Delight
description: Covenant of the Praeses Septentrionalis destroyed in one night by Damhan-allaidh in the late 880s.

name: Heart's Ease of Virtue
description: Herb granting Lesser Purifying Touch: Childbirth Fever.

name: Hearth Mate
description: A curate's domestic woman-of-all-work, effectively often a wife.

name: Hearth Prison
description: Enchantment/Portage 40 ritual preventing everyone in a room from leaving for the duration.

name: Heavenly Fire
description: Seraphim power, as Pilum of Fire but doing +30 damage.

name: Heavenly Host
description: The angels of Heaven, locked in conflict with Hell.

name: Heavenly Jerusalem
description: Heavenly city in the Fourth Heaven ruled by Michael.

name: Heavenly Servant
description: Angel power doubling traits against Infernal beings.

name: Heavy Arbalest
description: Late-medieval steel-bowed arbalest spanned by a cranequin.

name: Heavy Cavalry
description: Covenant Boon: the covenant maintains a mounted military force requiring good relations with neighbors.

name: Hebdomadarius
description: The canon whose weekly turn it is to lead the liturgy.

name: Hebrew Calendar
description: Lunar calendar with a 19-year cycle; Julian 1 April 1220 equals 26 Nisan 4980.

name: Hebrew Instruction
description: Library ability score for teaching Hebrew at Literatus.

name: Hebron
description: Site of the Cave of the Patriarchs, tomb of Abraham.

name: Hecate
description: A powerful faerie goddess who once saved Byzantium from Phillip of Macedon and lives in a regio coincident with Constantinople, entered only via a ritual path lit by a crescent moon.

name: Hechalot Texts
description: Scrolls on Ma'aseh Merkavah; studying them alone grants 'Curious about the Infernal'.

name: Hedge Wizard (Social Status)
description: Free Social Status for tradition members, granting access to tradition powers.

name: Hedvig of the Rhine
description: Legendary maga devoured by werewolves while awaiting induction into a Mystery Cult.

name: Heed the Mistress' Command
description: Dindyméné's power forcing an animal to obey her for a day.

name: Heimdall
description: Norse god who guards the rainbow bridge to Asgard; the second aett is named for him.

name: Heimdall's Aett
description: The second aett of the Elder Futhark, named after Heimdall, containing Hagalaz through Sowilo.

name: Heinous Architecture
description: A Minor laboratory Structure Flaw: the chamber is deliberately inauspicious or perverse (-1 General Quality, -2 Safety, +1 Warping, -2 Aesthetics).

name: Heinzelmännchen
description: German brownie-like creatures resembling dwarfs; every house in Cologne once had one until a curious housewife broke their taboo.

name: Heirs to Merlin
description: A Hermetic lineage within House Merinita descended from Ambrosius, who practice Charm, Story, and Symbolic Magic and serve as advisors to faerie courts.

name: Hekate
description: A spirit named among the Daimons, the Witch; Tytalus claimed his black dog familiar was a son of Hekate and brother to Kerberos.

name: Hekate Cord
description: Spirit familiar cord corresponding to the bronze cord, adding to Stamina rolls when the familiar spends Might.

name: Held (Duration)
description: Faerie Duration delaying the effect while the caster concentrates; equivalent to Concentration.

name: Helevetii
description: Celtic tribe defeated by Caesar and resettled in the Alpine passes.

name: Heliodromus
description: Sixth rank of the Legion, seven members clad in golden robes.

name: Hell-hound
description: Infernal hound that burned Abbas.

name: Hellequin
description: A cursed spirit at the center of a mobile regio (Hellequin's Hunt, a host of the dead), tasked with guiding souls unable to reach Heaven onto their resting place.

name: Helluland
description: Destination of fleeing trollsynir and giants.

name: Helm
description: High-medieval headgear encasing head and neck.

name: Helmet of Invisibility
description: Helmet which, according to some, grants Manannan perfect invisibility (PeIm 40 effect).

name: Helper
description: Dramatic role of one always well-inclined toward the hero, providing timely aid in travel, rescue, or tasks.

name: Helvennia of Bonisagus
description: Maga who claimed eight apprentices, all of whom died; acquitted but slain after seven Wizard Wars were declared on her.

name: Hemah
description: Angel of punishment who revenges idolatry.

name: Hemicynes
description: Peaceful dog-headed people from the far north in western European folklore.

name: Hengest
description: Leader of the treacherous Saxons who murdered the flower of Britain as they ate, prompting King Aurelius to build a monument.

name: Henrician heresy
description: Heresy of Henry of Lausanne that spread among Cluniac houses.

name: Henry Dandolo
description: Doge of Venice who led the Fourth Crusade to Zara and Constantinople.

name: Henry Fitz-Hubert
description: Baron Egremont who tried to imprison Giuseppe Del Mato.

name: Henry I of Champagne
description: Count under whom Provins and Troyes flourished.

name: Henry I of France
description: King succeeding in 1031.

name: Henry IV
description: An emperor who died in Liege after excommunication and forced abdication; the bells of Speyer would not toll for him until his excommunication was posthumously revoked.

name: Henry Murdac
description: An abbot sent from France in 1144 to bring Fountains Abbey into line with Cistercian practice, later contentiously elected archbishop of York, after which a mob sacked and burned Fountains.

name: Henry VI
description: An emperor who imprisoned Richard the Lionheart at Burg Trifels in 1193.

name: Henry de Goulis
description: Seneschal appointed by King Alexander I, ancestor of Lord Goulis.

name: Henry de Sully
description: Archbishop who began Bourges cathedral.

name: Henry fitz Ailwyn
description: The first Lord Mayor of London, who served for 23 years from 1193 and oversaw the city's first modern charter in 1204.

name: Henry fitz Count
description: The son of the old earl of Cornwall and sheriff of that county, who withholds receipts from the treasury and usurps royal prerogative while trying to claim the earldom.

name: Henry of Essex
description: One of Henry II's constables who deprived St. Edmund of his rights; defeated in a 1163 trial by combat after seeing the vengeful vision of St. Edmund, he became a monk at Reading.

name: Henry of Lausanne
description: Cluniac monk expelled for teaching Petrobrusian views; his Henrician heresy spread among Cluniac houses.

name: Henry of Saltrey
description: Man who heard the knight Owein's tale and told it to Marie of France.

name: Henry the Fowler
description: Duke of the Saxons who received the German crown in 919 and defeated the Magyar hordes at Riade in 933.

name: Hera's Chatelaine
description: Galena key ring whose keys open every lock in the Cave.

name: Hera's Gloves
description: Pale gray leather magical gloves letting Hera handle material objects.

name: Heraclitus
description: Greek philosopher cited for conceptions of evil inherent in matter.

name: Herald
description: Tournament official who publicizes events, knows knights' devices, provides commentary and adjudicates.

name: Herbam province
description: The Herbam-aligned province of the Twilight Void: growing plants seen brightly with seasonal colors and lush aroma.

name: Hercinia
description: Creature suggested as an Ignem familiar.

name: Hercinia of Virtue
description: A bird of the forests of southern Germany whose glowing feathers light travelers' paths.

name: Hereditary priesthood of the dead god
description: Pre-Hermetic priests who guarded the 'dead god' skeleton at Sinews of Knowledge and were exterminated during the Sundering.

name: Heretics
description: Major Church Hook: priests with heretical beliefs.

name: Heriodas
description: Faerie leader of processions of the dead, collecting the dead and leading them to pagan underworlds.

name: Heriot
description: Death duty owed when a household head dies, often the peasant's best beast.

name: Herlichinus
description: Demon jester in fool's motley who leads the best-known Infernal procession of punished souls.

name: Hermann
description: The chief of the Cheruski, trained in Roman service, who rallied the German tribes and destroyed Varus's legions at the Battle of the Teutoburger Forest in 9 AD.

name: Hermas
description: Narrator of the Shepherd of Hermas who has a vision of the Church as an aged lady.

name: Hermes Cord
description: Spirit familiar cord corresponding to the golden cord, also adding to Enigmatic Wisdom rolls.

name: Hermes Mercatorius & Hermes Furis
description: Saga seed where the Order becomes the richest institution through banking by House Mercere.

name: Hermes Triceres
description: Mercere's second apprentice and son, nicknamed 'Mutant', who specialized in Muto Vim metamagic.

name: Hermes the Blessed One
description: Charismatic leader of the Children of Hermes claiming to be Hermes Trismegistus reborn.

name: Hermetic Arithmetic
description: Secrets of number magic in the Arithmetic Magic chapter.

name: Hermetic Charity
description: Tradition of Redcaps secretly leaving gifts of vis to deserving magi at the start of winter.

name: Hermetic Charm
description: Use of Sympathy Traits in Hermetic lab work and enchanted devices designed as charms that must be activated in secret.

name: Hermetic Crime
description: Offence under the Code.

name: Hermetic Elementalist
description: Possible Hermetic mystery cult for which Elemental Magic may be an Outer Mystery.

name: Hermetic Experience
description: A Minor, General Virtue for a character with experience among the magi of the Order of Hermes, granting 50 extra experience points for relevant Lore or Latin.

name: Hermetic Fair
description: A gathering of the Order held in a vast twelve-sided quartz-walled hall in the Alps, supported by impossible ivory trees.

name: Hermetic Flaw
description: Flaws tied to Hermetic magic; including one when teaching a Hermetic Virtue gives a bonus, and they are gained through learning Virtues or uncontrolled Twilight and are permanent.

name: Hermetic Generans
description: Lesser Enchantment (ReTe 15) of an iron disc producing rotary motion like one horsepower.

name: Hermetic Gruagachan
description: Gruagachan nominally members of the Order of Hermes, taking the Hedge Wizard Flaw and Arcane Lore Virtue.

name: Hermetic Inclination
description: A maestro Virtue allowing a score in a specific Hermetic Form, used to instill spell-like effects into artwork while creating it.

name: Hermetic Maga
description: Virtue listed in this text.

name: Hermetic Mercenaries
description: Magi hired by communes as guardsmen, thieves or assassins, working covertly.

name: Hermetic Mid-Summer Fair
description: A fair held by a covenant in the Tribunal of the Greater Alps each early June, lasting up to eight days, where magi trade vis, books, and enchanted devices; an auction is run by the Quaesitores on the fourth day.

name: Hermetic Prosecution
description: Legal pursuit of wizards under Hermetic law.

name: Hermetic Raiding
description: Tradition of covenants raiding each other, established largely by Montverte and upheld by Tribunal precedent.

name: Hermetic Rites
description: Rituals designed by a magus with a Faerie Method and Power using faerie rite guidelines, cast with vis like Hermetic rituals.

name: Hermetic Rune Magic
description: A potential Hermetic integration of vitkir magic as a Major Breakthrough, giving a Rune Duration and Inscription Target.

name: Hermetic Sahir
description: A tradition referenced as the model for relocating the Corrguineach; wizards who command spirits.

name: Hermetic Sigil
description: Magical signature of a magus, which can be shrouded.

name: Hermetic Sihr
description: Hermetic practitioner of Sihr who researches jinn.

name: Hermetic Sorcery
description: Major Hermetic Tainted Virtue: studying Goetic Arts also yields Rego experience, and studying supernatural Lores yields Vim experience.

name: Hermetic Traditions
description: Infernal societates within the Order of Hermes.

name: Hermetic True Names
description: Virtue taught to Knights of the Green Stone.

name: Hermetic longevity ritual
description: Ritual that expires when Pasiel inflicts an aging crisis.

name: Hermetic necromancy
description: Magic unable to question those given a Church burial.

name: Hermetic phonotactics
description: Study of the voice as a tool to cast magic, Bronwyn's field.

name: Hermetic theurgist
description: Magus practicing Hermetic Theurgy who could learn to summon landvaettir.

name: Hermitage
description: Lands around which Lord Goulis has area lore.

name: Hermitage Castle
description: Castle in Liddesdale built on monks' bones, home of Lord David de Soulis.

name: Hernis
description: Rhine magus convicted of endangering the Order through excessive Wizard War and hunted down.

name: Hero
description: Dramatic role of the one who sets off on adventure, either a seeker-hero or a victim-hero; in Faerie stories often taken collectively by the characters.

name: Herodias
description: Evil biblical woman; name given by the educated to the she-demon of the strigae.

name: Herodotus
description: Ancient historian who wrote about Aristeas.

name: Heroes' Birthright
description: Minor Heroic Virtue granting a special magical power of up to Level 15.

name: Heroic Gesture
description: Maneuver (+4) of foolhardy bravery; if the leading character dies the event is won.

name: Herr
description: German title (generosus) for any noble without a higher title, equivalent to lord.

name: Herrit of Tytalus
description: A young Tytalus magus among the members recruited to Nigrasaxa.

name: Herrod of Hohenbourg
description: The most famous woman painter of 1220, recently deceased, whose book Hortus deliciarum showcases her illuminations.

name: Hertha
description: A powerful faerie goddess who bathes in Hertha Lake each Walpurgis Night, drowning a chosen mortal in return for blessing local farmers with good harvests; served by the priestess Zora.

name: Hertha Lake
description: A mysterious dark lake in the Stubnitz Forest near Crintera where the goddess Hertha bathes every Walpurgis Night and then drowns a chosen mortal in exchange for good harvests.

name: Hervé filius Évrard
description: Redcap son of Évrard who runs the temporary Mercer House at the Champagne fairs.

name: Herzak of Verditius
description: Member of Feritel.

name: Herzog
description: German title equivalent to duke.

name: Herzog Ernst
description: German epic hero.

name: Hesmed
description: The angel of annihilation among the five angels of punishment.

name: Hespera
description: The namesake of the enchanted lab item The Bookstand of Hespera.

name: Heusaff family
description: Ancient Breton family owning the Isle of Ushant; Lord Heusaff is secretly a guise of the Primus.

name: Heuvelland
description: Flanders' uplands.

name: Hex Toys
description: Releganta's wax figurines crafted into Arcane Connections to punish people.

name: Hexentanzplatz
description: A rocky crag in the northeastern Harz with a Faerie aura of 2 where the witches of the Harz gather every April before proceeding to the Brocken.

name: Hexham Priory
description: Priory headed by Abbot Geoffrey, frequently raided by Horsingas for supplies.

name: Hibernation of the Slumbering Turb
