description: A ReMe 35 ritual Texture-Target spell, invented by Odorpes, that puts anyone touching the caster to sleep until the Spring Equinox.

name: Hicuccus of Criamon
description: Author of The Babble Within Thought.

name: Hidalgo
description: Ancestral caballero backed by his family in matters of honor, with the Knight Virtue.

name: Hidden (Duration)
description: Faerie ritual Duration lasting while the caster or target is hidden; ends if discovered.

name: Hidden Resources
description: Covenant Boon representing vassal tithes to liege.

name: Hidden Virtues
description: Fixed, occult qualities of objects granted by astral influences and ordained by God that cannot be explained by their substance.

name: Hide
description: Amount of land (120-144 acres) required to maintain a family of affluent free peasants, producing four pounds for a lord.

name: Hide Flavor
description: Gourmand's Power altering the flavor and texture of a substance.

name: Hide from Mortal Sight
description: Forcas's Power of true invisibility lasting until the next Sunday.

name: Hide to Parchment
description: A Rego Animal 10 spell that stretches, shaves, and dries animal hides into writing-ready vellum as if a percamenarius had worked them.

name: Hiding in the Crowd
description: A PeIm 10 transparency spell that makes the caster selectively invisible to a single person by destroying a thin cone of emitted species, useful in city crowds.

name: Hiding the Mystic Key
description: MuTe(He) 15 spell softening stone or wood to hide a small item such as a Key to the Mystic Veil.

name: Hiems
description: A Winter covenant of medium power, declined to six magi, occupying a largely uninhabited complex of caves, tunnels, and towers in a magical forest now haunted by a returned dragon.

name: Hierophants
description: The three mysterious leaders of the Magoi of the Star, greatest astrologers able to Initiate many astrological Virtues.

name: High Crime of depriving a magus of his magical power
description: Crime committed by harvesting another's legacy or damaging magical resources.

name: Higher Ground
description: Height advantage giving +1 to Attack and Defense.

name: Highland Chieftain
description: Companion template: chief of a sept responsible for forty families, embroiled in a blood feud.

name: Highland Giants
description: Nearly extinct race of giants in Sutherland and Strathnavar, in two kinds.

name: Highland Sailor
description: Grog template: a former galley crewman from the western coast now serving a covenant ashore.

name: Highland Weather Witch
description: Tradition of Highland witches able to call or dispel storms by whistling.

name: Highly Skilled
description: Virtue appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Hijra
description: Muhammad's emigration from Mecca to Medina in 622.

name: Hilda
description: An immense female covenant grog (custos) born and bred at Fengheld, a skilled mace-and-shield warrior with Great Strength and prime leadership material, given as a gift to young magi.

name: Hildebrand
description: Dietrich of Bern's man-at-arms who kills Kriemhild after discovering the bodies of Gunther and Hagen.

name: Hill of Martyrs
description: A hill in Paris to which Salvirius asks a magus to deliver a sealed message.

name: Hind
description: Semi-mythical source of diamonds and spices.

name: Hinder the Gift
description: A Perdo Vim 55 enchanted effect in the Wizard's Bridle that reduces the Casting Total of any spells by 25 points as a constant effect.

name: Hippian
description: One of the two ethical viewpoints of House Tytalus's Philosophy of Conflict, represented by anticlockwise spiral symbolism indicating introspection.

name: Hippian Ethics
description: A branch of Tytalan philosophy named after the Sophist Hippias that holds some unwritten divine laws are intrinsic to nature and necessary curbs on selfish physis; symbolized by an anticlockwise spiral.

name: Hippian school
description: School of thought within House Tytalus that Eduardus supports.

name: Hippias
description: A Sophist quoted in the Analects of Tytalus who believed in the fundamental unity of mankind through unwritten laws of divine provenance; the Hippian view is named after him.

name: Hippolytus of Rome
description: Church Father whose Philosophumena recounts Simon Magus' death.

name: Hippomancy
description: Divinatory method using behavior of horses, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Hired Sword
description: Flaw appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Hirsau
description: The most powerful Benedictine monastery in Germany, founded 1059 with the relics of St. Aurelius and modeled on Cluny; with a Divine aura of 5, it has been immune to the faerie attacks beset other Black Forest monasteries.

name: Historia Francorum
description: History of the Franks written by St. Gregory of Tours in 594.

name: Historia Normannorum
description: History by William of Jumieges with an Area Lore: Normandy summa.

name: Historia rerum Anglicarum
description: History by William of Newburgh with Area Lore: England summa and Area Lore: Normandy tractatus.

name: History of the Britons
description: Tractatus by Nennius, earliest account of Arthur.

name: History of the Franks (Aimon)
description: Tome by the monk Aimon, official chronicle of the Capetians; summae on French Royalty, Ile de France, and Divine Lore.

name: History of the Kings of Britain
description: Tractatus by Geoffrey of Monmouth including the Prophecies of Merlin.

name: History of the Normans
description: History by Dudo of St Quentin containing Area Lore: Normandy summa and tractatus.

name: Histria
description: Oppidum on the Istrian Peninsula in the Transylvanian Tribunal.

name: Hobble the Foul-Mouthed Wretch
description: PeCo 40 talisman enchantment laming the target for a Sun duration.

name: Hobgoblin
description: A creature often used as the form of the phantasmal being sent into a victim's mind by a Phantasm maleficium.

name: Hocktide
description: Monday and Tuesday after Easter week in parts of England, when women capture men for a ransom of a penny or kiss, and men return the favor.

name: Hod
description: Sefirah meaning 'Splendor', level 3 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 3.

name: Hohenstaufens
description: Dynasty that received most of the Swabian pretender's lands.

name: Holder of Benefices
description: Minor Covenant Boon: the covenant holds parish benefices.

name: Holdfast
description: Remora power duplicating any movement-inhibiting spell up to level 35.

name: Holly and Baby
description: Story seed in which a hedge witch uses holly on a nursery window at Candlemas to let dark faeries attack a noble lady's family.

name: Holstein
description: A territory between the North Sea and Baltic under the control of the Danish king Valdemar II, where new port towns are springing up.

name: Holy Blood of Heiligenblut
description: Vial of the blood of Jesus held in the church of Heiligenblut.

name: Holy Characters
description: Blessed people possessing powers and backgrounds aligned with the Divine realm.

name: Holy Forbears
description: Muslim revered figures at whose shrines baraka may be invoked, similar to saints.

name: Holy Innocents Day
description: December 28 feast when children are sometimes allowed to run the Church.

name: Holy Island
description: Island seven miles up the coast from the Farnes, home to Lindisfarne Priory.

name: Holy Land Lore
description: Lore Ability of the Knight Templar template.

name: Holy Maga
description: Sample Ex Miscellanea maga trained in Holy Magic by a holy hermit, dubious of Hermetic Arts, suited to aid a covenant with the Divine and Infernal.

name: Holy Magic Theory
description: Divine variant of Magic Theory taught by the book in the Uncovered Crypt story seed.

name: Holy Magic Theory summa
description: Untitled book found in a crypt beneath Mont St. Michael; its reader is visited by the archangel Michael.

name: Holy Method of Meditation
description: Holy Method with which the Holy Music Ability is associated.

name: Holy Music (Virtue)
description: Major Supernatural Method Virtue granting Holy Music 1.

name: Holy Oak
description: Diedne covenant founded in 817 and destroyed during the Schism War.

name: Holy Saturday
description: Day on which demons in Christian lands must abandon physical form until Easter.

name: Holy Sepulcher
description: The place where Christ was buried, an example of a site with a Divine aura of 10 arising where God directly intervened.

name: Holy Spirit
description: Third person of the Trinity received at Confirmation.

name: Holy Thorn
description: Thorn from Christ's crown at the Abbey of St. Peter at Solesmes, Faith score 2.

name: Holy Tradition: Franciscans
description: Treatment of the Franciscans as a Holy Tradition with favored Abilities Intervention, Meditation, Purity, and Understanding, open only to friars or Poor Sisters.

name: Holy Unicorn
description: Divine being.

name: Holy Vis
description: Vis extracted by holy magi in the Dominion, with unusual, miraculous side effects and doubled botch dice.

name: Holy water
description: Adds +1 to exorcism.

name: Holyrood
description: Abbey at the end of Edinburgh's Royal Mile.

name: Homage
description: Act in the commendation ceremony in which the kneeling vassal-to-be places his joined hands within the lord's hands and asks to become his vassal.

name: Home Village Lore
description: Ability used by nightwalker characters in this chapter.

name: Homer
description: Author of The Odyssey, quoted on the Cyclopes.

name: Homilia Leonis
description: Church Lore Tractatus Quality 8 by Pope Leo IV listing visitation articles.

name: Homobonus
description: A patron saint of merchants and of cloth and tailoring; a citizen of Cremona who died in 1197 and was canonized in 1199.

name: Homunculus Wizard Flaw
description: Flaw taken with The Gift to play a homunculus wizard; may be the inherent Flaw of an Ex Miscellanea magus.

name: Honor Among Thieves
description: Valefar's Power preventing a thief from revealing a secret.

name: Hoopoe
description: Bird suggested as a Vim familiar.

name: Hoopoe of Virtue
description: A foul bird nesting near cemeteries whose blood and heart are powerful ingredients in black magic.

name: Hoplite Quaesitor
description: Guernicus magi able at both investigation and combat, often sent to lawless Tribunals.

name: Hoplomachus
description: A defensive certamen style named for warriors armored like Greek hoplites; it trades attack and initiative for greatly increased Defense.

name: Hopolites
description: A group of warrior magi, many of them Flambeau Arch-Magi, who enforce the rulings of the Quaesitores.

name: Horizon
description: Example new spell Range invented by Tillitus as a Minor Breakthrough.

name: Horkos
description: Oath, a child of Eris most damaging to men who swear falsely.

name: Horn of the Champions
description: An invested magical horn kept at Castra Solis that can alert and instantly summon senior Flambeau magi from anywhere in Mythic Europe via Arcane Connections.

name: Horobael
description: Authority guarding a grove.

name: Horrid Wilting
description: A Herbam power of the basilisk Sordus that kills every living plant within 5 paces and rots vegetable matter; he cannot control it.

name: Horrifying Appearance – Snake Legs
description: A Major Supernatural Flaw in which the character has snake-like tails instead of legs, a deformity that can be hidden under clothing but not while moving.

name: Horse Bow
description: Compact composite bow suited to horseback.

name: Horse Collar
description: New device allowing a horse to outperform an ox in draught work.

name: Horse Courser
description: English term for a horse dealer, a profession with a bad reputation.

name: Horse Gaits
description: Walk/amble, trot, canter and gallop, each with a movement rate and combat effects.

name: Horse of Virtue
description: Exceptional horse; many destriers are Horses of Virtue.

name: Horse-Headed Serpents
description: Great water serpents with the heads or forequarters of horses, red or yellow eyes and fangs.

name: Horses of Virtue
description: Herd of magical horses (Might 10) of the Camargue led by the Great Stallion.

name: Hospice of Saint Bernard
description: Benedictine hospice saving lost travelers, with Hermetic ties.

name: Hospital of Saint John the Baptist
description: Hospital inside Bath for the infirm poor, whose inmates in blue robes are called the Blue Alms.

name: Hospitaller Knights of St. John
description: A military order present in Acre that controls its own section of the city.

name: Hostile Gruagach Collective
description: Major Covenant Hook in which a nearby gruagach collective spreads rumors and harvests the covenant's vis.

name: Hostillar
description: Monk in charge of the guest house, not bound by silence; most often dealt with by visitors.

name: Hosting Covenant's Choice
description: Tourney event chosen by the hosting covenant.

name: Hot Baths
description: One of the three main public baths of Bath.

name: Hot-trod
description: Right to pursue a cattle thief across the border.

name: Hothama
description: Islamic degree of Hell for Jews.

name: Hounds of Anwyn
description: Faerie hounds said to leave the faerie court to chase the dead across Wales by night.

name: Hour + 1 (Duration)
description: Faerie Duration lasting an hour and a day; equivalent to Sun.

name: House Council
description: Council of Tremere magi holding their own sigils, meeting every ten years at Coeris; lacking formal powers since the Schism.

name: House Jerbiton Lore
description: Ability appearing in character statistics in this text.

name: House Merinita Lore
description: The Ability Merinitae use to Initiate their House Mysteries, representing knowledge of all the House's secret rites, mysteries, and legends; common to all members.

name: House Tytalus Lore
description: A Hermetic lore Ability concerning the history and customs of House Tytalus, exemplified by the Analects of Tytalus summa.

name: House Virtue
description: The free Minor Hermetic Virtue each magus receives from his House, gained through 10 seasons of one-on-one interaction or Outer Mystery initiation.

name: House of Flambeau
description: (Not present)

name: House of Flames and Smoke
description: Stone hall in Purgatory with pits of molten metal punishing perverse appetites and violence against God.

name: House of Wisdom
description: The most famous madrasah, in Baghdad, a center for translating Syriac, Persian, and Greek texts into Arabic; historically destroyed by Mongols in 1258.

name: House of Zähringen
description: Now-extinct noble family, founders of Berne and Fribourg, who tried to unite the Alps.

name: Houses of Hermes
description: The twelve Houses that organize the Order of Hermes, now split into three groups of four: Mystery Cults, True Lineages, and Societates. They remain the same Houses as in earlier editions.

name: Hovel
description: A Major laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is cramped, neglected, and filthy, little more than a stinking dump (-1 General Quality, -2 Upkeep, -2 Safety, -3 Health, -4 Aesthetics).

name: Howls of Confusion
description: Power (PeMe 15) of Lord Goulis's demon dogs that confuses victims, resisted by Int roll of 9+.

name: Hrools
description: Intelligent ferret-like creatures dwelling in warrens near the ruined Calebais laboratory of Ierimyra, who still protect the lab.

name: Hrothgar
description: Former king of the Danes whose hall site is now occupied by the covenant Heorot; he was terrorized by the troll Grendel until the hero Beowulf slew it.

name: Huarwar
description: A Welsh faerie who helped complete Offa's Dyke in 787 in exchange for cattle; now eats parts of the dyke and villages when not paid.

name: Hudud
description: Canonical penalties for five major crimes.

name: Huelgoat
description: Boulder site.

name: Hugh
description: Local lord at Blaringhem moved by Saint Ursmar's relics to pardon a murderer.

name: Hugh Foliot
description: The archdeacon of Shropshire who became bishop of Hereford in 1219 and was an employer of Robert Grosseteste.

name: Hugh IV of Burgundy
description: Eight-year-old Duke of Burgundy.

name: Hugh Neret
description: Canonist bishop of Coutances, elected 1208.

name: Hugh X of Lusignan
description: Count of La Marche, betrothed to Isabella.

name: Hugh de Cressingham
description: Hated Treasurer of Scotland flayed after Stirling Bridge.

name: Hugh of Amiens
description: Theological writer (1130-74), author of Contra Haereticos.

name: Hugh of Forcalquier
description: Hospitaller commander in Aragon, close to King James.

name: Hugh of Lincoln
description: A former bishop of Lincoln who began the rebuilding of the minster in 1192 and is being considered for canonization; associated with the miracle of St. Hugh's Swan at Stow.

name: Hugh of Payns
description: Founder and first Grand Master of the Templars (1119-1136); visited London in 1128.

name: Hugh of Saint Victor
description: Author of a list of seven mechanical arts.

name: Hugh the Great
description: Effective ruler of France under weak Carolingian kings.

name: Huldra
description: A Scandinavian nymph, beautiful in front but hollow-backed with a cow's tail, able to vanish when unobserved; male form is huldu or huldrekall.

name: Huldra Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety allowing invisibility when still.

name: Human Ally
description: Flaw of Aillwee.

name: Human Figment of the Waking Mind
description: A Creo Mentem spell that places a hallucinatory person, seen and heard only by the target, into the target's common sense.

name: Human Shape
description: Personal Power transforming a creature into a normal human shape.

name: Humans are Easily Misplaced
description: Cat power, a version of Inexorable Search using scent-marked Arcane Connections.

name: Humiliation of Relics
description: Practice of physically humbling relics to prompt a saint's action or persuade the laity to piety.

name: Humnel
description: Glesig's faerie caricature, which has taken the seeming of an immense troll and become her faerie familiar, very protective of his mistress.

name: Humors
description: The four bodily humors (blood, black bile, yellow bile, phlegm) manipulated by elemental physicians.

name: Hunted by Wolves
description: This chapter's rules for wolf hunts in five phases: stalk, encounter, rush, chase and kill.

name: Hunter's Lethal Arrow
description: PeAn40 Tethered spell giving an animal a fatal wound, often tethered to an arrow.

name: Hunter's Sense
description: An Intellego Animal spell (Level 30) letting the caster sense the shapes and primary motivations of all animals above a chosen size that can be heard.

name: Hunter's Tracks of the Faerie Glow
description: Performance Duration variant of Tracks of the Faerie Glow, lasting while the caster hunts.

name: Hunting with Hounds
description: The most prestigious form of hunting: quest, assembly, relay, finding, chase, kill, and unmaking.

name: Huntingdon
description: English town where Christina of Markyate was born.

name: Huntress in the Wood Lore
description: The Ability required to Initiate the grades of the Huntress in the Wood cult, with set thresholds for advancing from kerykes to eumolpids.

name: Huntsman
description: Dog handler who seeks out prey with lymers during the quest and positions hounds in the relay; grogs perform the role well.

name: Hutins
description: A court of Parisian argotiers who pretend to be bitten by mad dogs.

name: Hydra
description: A many-headed monster whose teeth provide Shape and Material bonuses of +6 Creo and +8 regeneration.

name: Hydromancy
description: Divinatory method using observing water, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Hyginus
description: Author of the Fabulae, which summarizes the Golden Fleece legend.

name: Hyperboreans
description: Ancient people who founded the Temple of Apollo in London.

name: Hypereia
description: An island of the Thebes Tribunal inhabited by cyclopes.

name: Hyperion
description: Titan who establishes day and night.

name: Hypernestoria
description: Mysterious lands reached via the regio where the Axis Magica emerges from the other side of the Earth's sphere, few of whose contents are known to Criamon magi.

name: Hywel Dda
description: The legendary lawgiver who created the laws of Wales many centuries ago, laws still known by wise men across Wales.

name: Höllental
description: A tortuous and haunted valley winding up from the center of the Black Forest, the only route to the Feldberg and the King of the Black Mountain.

name: I conjure this, by foul decree / In its same likeness unto me
description: Incantation/Effusion 25 summoning an object to the hand.

name: I delight to do thy will, O my God; yea, thy law is within my heart
description: Meditation Understanding effect (Level 35) revealing whether an action is God's will and preventing botches while pursuing it.

name: I saw three unclean spirits, like frogs, out of the mouth of the dragon
description: Incantation/Phantasm 20 ominous vision.

name: I will make them of the synagogue of Satan; I will make them worship before thy feet
description: Incantation/Psychomachia 50 group command.

name: I, Eirik Svennson, Bound This Wound
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Eirik Svennson's Berkanan 15, Method I script: +9 to recovery rolls from combat injuries.

name: I, Eirik Svennson, Call My Helmet Alu
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Eirik Svennson's Algiz 25, Method I script: +5 to Soak via his helmet.

name: I, Eirik Svennson, Invoke Tyr's Cunning
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Eirik Svennson's Tiwaz 25, Method I script: +5 to Defense rolls.

name: I, Eirik Svennson, Invoke Tyr's Power
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Eirik Svennson's Tiwaz 25, Method I script: +5 to Attack rolls.

name: I, Eirik Svennson, Strengthen the Sword of My Ancestors
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Eirik Svennson's Othila 25, Method I script: +5 Initiative, Attack and Defense with his inherited sword.

name: I, Eirik Svennson, Will Work Well This Day
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Eirik Svennson's Dagaz 15, Method I script: +3 to all-day activities.

name: I, the Runemaster, Am Thrice Blessed
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Gebo 15, Method I: +3 to meeting and influencing others, offsetting The Gift.

name: I, the Runemaster, Ask for Freya's Blessing
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Fehu General, Method I: bonus to rolls in the pursuit of wealth.

name: I, the Runemaster, Bless the Fields
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Jera 5, Method I: buried runed stone ensures a healthy, disease-resistant harvest.

name: I, the Runemaster, Bless the Work
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Jera General, Method I: bonus to year-long activities such as study or harvest.

name: I, the Runemaster, Call the Serpent from the Brambles
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Thurisaz 30, Method I: turns a twisted branch into a venomous snake.

name: I, the Runemaster, Can Sense the Liar's Craft
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Tiwaz 30, Method I: sense whether people believe they tell the truth.

name: I, the Runemaster, Carve Runes to Close the Flesh
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Berkanan 20, Method I: heals a Light Wound, permanent if the amulet lasts a week.

name: I, the Runemaster, Carve the Runes of Giants
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Dagaz 20, Method I: the vitki grows with the sun, up to Size +2 at noon.

name: I, the Runemaster, Dedicate Helmet-Destroying Hail
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Hagalaz General, Method I: weapon Damage bonus equal to magnitude.

name: I, the Runemaster, Feel My Hearth and Home
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ingwaz 20, Method I: sense the direction, distance and mood of family.

name: I, the Runemaster, Fight for My Companions
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Tiwaz General, Method I: bonus to Attack rolls in battle.

name: I, the Runemaster, Give Eight Legs to My Horse
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Raido 30, Method I: the horse covers ten paces per step.

name: I, the Runemaster, Give Understanding of the Hollow Voices
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ansuz General, Method I: target hears spirits and distinguishes illusory noises as if with Second Sight.

name: I, the Runemaster, Hear the Thunder of the North
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Raido 20, Method I: sense which way is north.

name: I, the Runemaster, Kiss the Treacherous Deep
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Laguz 20, Method I: the vitki breathes in water.

name: I, the Runemaster, Make Men Sure and Steady
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Mannaz 30, Method I: increases Dexterity by 1, to no higher than 0.

name: I, the Runemaster, May Speak with the Shades of the Past
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ihwaz 35, Method I: communicate with the spirits of a grave.

name: I, the Runemaster, Need Strength for My Trials
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Uruz General, Method I: bonus to Strength-based rolls.

name: I, the Runemaster, Paint the Runes of Frenzy
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Wunjo 30, Method I: a warrior ignores Fatigue and Wound Penalties.

name: I, the Runemaster, Protect Against Beings of Fire and Pain
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Algiz (Kauno) General, Method II: wards fire creatures and disease spirits.

name: I, the Runemaster, See Through the Darkness
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Kauno General, Method I: bonus to eyesight rolls, improving night vision.

name: I, the Runemaster, Sense the Sleeping Alfar
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Perth 20, Method I: sense and identify vis within ten paces.

name: I, the Runemaster, Sharpen My Axe
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Othila General, Method I: bonus to Initiative, Attack and Damage with a particular weapon.

name: I, the Runemaster, Speak with Odin's Voice
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ansuz General, Method I: bonus to communication Ability rolls equal to magnitude.

name: I, the Runemaster, Step Most Surely in Sunlight
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Sowilo General, Method I: bonus to Perception-based rolls.

name: I, the Runemaster, Store Power for My Time of Need
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Naudiz General, Method I: binds another rune spell to trigger under set conditions.

name: I, the Runemaster, Summon Summer's Brightness
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Sowilo 25, Method I: bright sunlight shines from the target, driving off creatures of the night.

name: I, the Runemaster, Summon the Aurochs
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Uruz 45, Method II: summons an uncontrolled aurochs.

name: I, the Runemaster, Tame the Wild Waves
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Laguz 25, Method I: a ship travels at double speed.

name: I, the Runemaster, Walk Swiftly Through the Murky Wood
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ihwaz 15, Method I: intuitive sense of trees for forest travel.

name: Iacula
description: Bonisagus maga researching projectile motion.

name: Iain's Curse
description: Unseelie curse causing Iain Mac Gabhan to partially turn into a pig when casting faerie spells.

name: Iamblichus
description: Greek philosopher whose teachings the Brethren of Purity combined in their encyclopedia.

name: Iapetos
description: The Titan of mortality.

name: Iasper
description: Young Tytalus magus of Exspectatio, filius of Adanos, with an affinity for turmoil.

name: Ibbur
description: Spirit that co-inhabits a body to express its wisdom.

name: Ibn 'Arabi
description: Mystical poet of Damascus, currently the most active Sufi thinker.

name: Ibn Ishaq
description: Author of al-Sira al-Nabawiyya, a biography of the Prophet.

name: Ibn Tumart
description: Founder of the Almohads who proclaimed himself the mahdi c. 1121.

name: Ibn Wahshiya
description: Author of The Book of Poisons, quoted for a recipe combining mouse, hellebore and other ingredients to make a fatal poison.

name: Icarus
description: Greek figure of the Flight of Icarus.

name: Ice Cavern
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab is built of never-melting ice in the far north or atop a mountain (+1 Upkeep, +1 Warping, +2 Aesthetics, +2 Rego or Terram).

name: Ice Maiden
description: Local faerie of the Queen of Winter's woods who can thaw the earth.

name: Ice wyrm
description: Monster that hibernates between feeds, another suspect for Werfen.

name: Icelandic Rune Poem
description: Rune poem.

name: Icelandic highlands
description: Where the Gray Bull wanders; southeastern highlands host the Hermes Portal.

name: Icicle of Perdo Vis
description: Never-melting icicle of vis that drains Fatigue.

name: Iconium
description: City visited by the apostles in Acts 14.

name: Iconoclastic Controversy
description: Quarrel from the 700s in Byzantium over veneration of icons.

name: Icthyocentaur
description: Creature with human torso and head, fish or dolphin tail, and horse front legs.

name: Icthyocentaurs
description: Faerie tribe of amphibious, armored centaurs mimicking chivalric knights; can serve as companions.

name: Ida of Unspunnen
description: Last heir of the Unspunnens, stolen away by Rudolph of Wadenschwyl, sparking war with the Zähringers.

name: Iddawg son of Mynyo
description: A horseman who captured Rhonabwy and led him across the sea to King Arthur's court in the dream.

name: Idea
description: Miser's Pot Power silently suggesting it as a place to store valuables.

name: Identification as the Hero
description: Declaring oneself the legendary hero after the Guardian, costing a Confidence point and granting a fable point.

name: Idun
description: Norse goddess abducted from Asgard in legend.

name: Idus of Flambeau
description: Rellantali magus who stays at the Asinaran fortress, used for quick violent action.

name: Idyllic Surroundings
description: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab sits in a charming peaceful location such as a vale or garden (+2 Health, +1 Aesthetics).

name: Ierbii
description: Name the Rhaetian-speaking covenfolk of Valnastium call themselves.

name: Ierimyra
description: A maga of the former covenant of Calebais whose ruined laboratory remains haunted by her ghost.

name: If (Condition) (Duration)
description: Faerie ritual Duration triggering when the target fulfills a condition, adding four magnitudes.

name: Ifranj
description: Muslim name for Europeans (Franks).

name: Ignatius Loyola
description: Future systematic mystic whose works are not yet written in 1220.

name: Ignavus
description: Example magus who plans a wand with a Disenchant Ritual to destroy a rival cult's shield.

name: Ignem Anima
description: Faerie created from a botched Ignem spell in the Faerie Realm.

name: Ignem Domini
description: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

name: Ignem Monstrosity
description: Flaw referenced in this text.

name: Ignem province
description: The Ignem-aligned province of the Twilight Void: a monochromatic place of light, shadow, heat and cold.

name: Ignes Festi
description: Flambeau magus who survived Loch Oadh with Pralix, quarreled with Brude Deathless, and died fighting Damhan-allaidh alone.

name: Ignis Domini
description: 'The Fire of God', a saint curse bringing a pillar of fire from heaven (+30 damage).

name: Igraine
description: King Arthur's mother, deceived by Merlin's glamour.

name: Ihya' 'Ulum al-Din
description: Summa by al-Ghazali uniting mainstream doctrine with Sufi inspiration.

name: Ijma'
description: Consensus of the community, in practice legal scholars.

name: Ilchester
description: County town under strong Dominion where the boy Roger Bacon lives.

name: Ilchester Priory
description: Priory from which the property of Roger Bacon's family is held.

name: Ile de France Lore
description: Area lore of the Ile de France.

name: Ilfetu
description: One of Birna's six apprentices, told to 'Teach,' a swan from ancient Frisia, the only one to learn the Ritual of Twelve Years from Birna; founder of Clan Ilfetu.

name: Ilham
description: Divine inspiration of the imams.

name: Ilium
description: A port town on the Aegean coast south of Constantinople, located in a faerie regio enterable only by ships with faerie pilots, ruled by the faerie lord Priam who claims descent from Zeus; possibly the legendary Troy or a faerie imitation.

name: Image Phantom (spell)
description: Imaginem spell on which the Image Phantom power is based.

name: Imaginary Friends
description: Toy-like faerie friends of children.

name: Imagined Folk Tradition Vulnerability
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character sincerely believes he is vulnerable to traditional wards and folk magic like the fey, and sabotages such wards.

name: Imaginem province
description: The Imaginem-aligned province of the Twilight Void: images, colors, sounds and smells bombard the senses and species travel far.

name: Imagines
description: Spirits of sensation embodying sensory species (singular imago).

name: Imam
description: Prayer leader; for Shi'is also a divinely designated spiritual leader from the line of Muhammad.

name: Immateriality
description: Personal power making a faerie immaterial until sunrise or nightfall.

name: Immobilize Prey
description: Wise Owl power paralyzing any creature meeting its eyes.

name: Immortality
description: Goal reached by apotheosis; ascended magi become unchanging immortals.

name: Immortality of the Forest
description: A new Major General Virtue linking one's life force to a forest, so that while remaining within its supernatural aura one makes no Aging roll but gains a Warping Point each year.

name: Immune to (Source of Damage)
description: Minor or Major Supernatural Virtue making a faerie take no damage from a nominated force such as cold, fire or iron.

name: Immune to Bashing Weapons
description: Power of the scarecrow-bodied Man in Black making him undamaged by crushing weapons.

name: Immunity
description: A Virtue rendering people and objects within a covenant's aura immune to a specified form of damage, influence, or Flaw.

name: Immunity from Terram
description: Virtue appearing in faerie statistics in this text (Immunity from Terram).

name: Immunity to Cold
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue making normal cold harmless to the character, though extreme magical cold still affects him.

name: Immunity to Drowning
description: Major Virtue granted by a caul; the character floats unconscious to shore rather than drowning.

name: Immunity to Edged Weapons
description: Permanent hagbui power (MuCo 35).

name: Immunity to Fire
description: Gull's immunity to heat and flame from his Jotunn Affinity.

name: Impair the Hound's Nose
description: PeAn 20 spell known by Whitburh that destroys an animal's sense of smell.

name: Impaled by the Thorn
description: Boar King power: a hurled boar spear that paralyzes and suspends aging of its target.

name: Impart Wisdom
description: Eiael's power to teach Ars Notoria at Source Quality 13.

name: Imposter
description: Companion template of a young noble man who, with a demon friend's help and Gender Shift, poses as a novice in a nunnery to spread corruption.

name: Imposture
description: Act in which a false hero claims credit for the hero's deeds before being exposed by an identifying token.

name: Impregnable
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab is completely inaccessible except through powerful magic, e.g. requiring a Muto Terram spell (-2 Aesthetics).

name: Impression of the Faded Sigil
description: InVi 30 spell identifying Technique, Form, details and sigil of an effect on a touched object.

name: Improved Attack
description: Minor Quality increasing a natural weapon's Attack by 2.

name: Improved Confidence
description: Minor Quality increasing Confidence Score by one.

name: Improved Defense
description: Minor Quality increasing a natural weapon's Defense by 2.

name: Improved Fatigue
description: Minor Quality adding a Fatigue level.

name: Improved Recovery
description: Minor Quality halving Might recovery time.

name: In Christ's Footsteps
description: A Rego Corpus spell (ReCo 5) created by Falke that allows the caster to walk on water.

name: In partibus infidelium
description: Status of a diocese overrun by infidels or lost to catastrophe, whose bishop lives outside it.

name: Incalculable Strength of Heaven
description: Principality power banishing non-Divine creatures from its domain for a day.

name: Incantamen
description: Latin word Hermetic magi use for spells, meaning both formulaic and spontaneous.

name: Incantation of Putrid Wine
description: A Muto Aquam spell (Level 15) that makes all liquids within a target room vile and malodorous for weeks or months.

name: Incendiaries
description: Boiling water, oil and hot sand poured by defenders on escalading troops; damage uses the heat and corrosion table.

name: Incendior Homines
description: A Creo Ignem 30 enchanted weapon (wand, ring, or brooch) providing heavy firepower that envelops a target in flame for +15 damage with +8 Penetration, usable by unskilled grogs.

name: Incidental Matter
description: Dust, water and other matter a faerie draws around its spiritual anchor to form its body.

name: Incinerate
description: Special gruagach ability of Damhan-allaidh. Like Creo and Rego Ignem, only for true fire; characteristic Presence.

name: Incompetent Curate
description: Minor church Hook: the church's curate is incompetent and, if discovered, may be removed, bringing many visitations; not available to a major church.

name: Inconspicuous
description: Minor Child Virtue giving +3 to hide and avoid attention.

name: Incorporeal
description: Power making the Ushant spirits invisible and intangible.

name: Incorporeal Form
description: Orphan Born power to become incorporeal like a ghost.

name: Increase of the Room's Modest Aura
description: CrVi 84 Mystery enchantment increasing a room's Magical aura by +1 to a maximum of 5.

name: Increased Hubris
description: A Minor Ordeal Flaw making a Verditius magus more proud and self-centered, granting experience to increase his Hubris score by one level.

name: Incredible Intelligence
description: Virtue appearing in character statistics or rules in this text.

name: Incredibly Cute
description: Cat power similar to Trust of Childlike Faith that impairs others' rationality.

name: Incubi & Succubae
description: Family of Tempters (Might 5), seducing Corrupters.

name: Indebted
description: Covenant Hook for vassals.

name: Indech
description: Fomoire king.

name: Indenture (Virtue)
description: Free redcap virtue: lifetime service in exchange for necessities, longevity potion at 35.

name: Indentured Servant
description: Flaw listed for the Prince (squire).

name: Independent Covenants
description: Covenants in the Roman Tribunal not officially recognized by the Tribunal.

name: Independent Craftsman
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character works poorly with others, treating his Leadership and Craft or Profession Abilities as three levels lower when collaborating.

name: Independent Magic
description: Virtue.

name: Independent Rebel
description: Magus vocation (Tremere) seeking vengeance on the Roman Tribunal for his master.

name: Indescribable Face
description: A Minor, General Virtue making a character hard to describe and separate from others, either by being unremarkable or by a distracting striking feature.

name: Indiscreet
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character is unable to keep a secret, compelled to tell all unless he succeeds on an Intelligence-based stress roll.

name: Indulgence
description: A certificate purchased with repentance and good works that mitigates the length of a decreed penance.

name: Inescapable
description: Demons of the Fifth Trump Power to unfailingly track prey.

name: Inescapable Sense of the Quarry
description: She-Wolf power sensing the direction and distance of a target to which she has an Arcane Connection.

name: Ineslemen
description: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for a member of one of the religious tribes of the Tuareg, with authority over disputes and immunity from feudal demands; exists only in North Africa.

name: Inexhaustible Supplies
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab is blessed with magically replenishing ingredients that never run out (-3 Upkeep, +1 Warping).

name: Infallible Guide
description: Samuil's power to traverse any regio.

name: Infamitus
description: Arch-Mage quoted on the Old Ones, author of The True Origins of the Magical Traditions.

name: Infantry Shield
description: Large shield usable only on foot, such as the Roman scutum.

name: Infanzone
description: The lowest rank of Iberian gentry.

name: Inferior Equipment
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is outfitted with shoddy wares (-1 General Quality, -1 Upkeep).

name: Inferior Tools
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab's tools are crudely crafted and prone to breakage (-1 Upkeep, -1 Safety).

name: Infernal Ability
description: Common Infernal Blessing giving an unnatural bodily ability such as wings or fangs.

name: Infernal Angels
description: Beings claiming to be angels working in Hell at God's command, such as the Avengers of Evil and Accusers.

name: Infernal Artifact of the Cursewood
description: An Infernal artifact that can reform or move to another form if destroyed; it can only be permanently destroyed in a place of Dominion aura 5+ by an ordained clergyman with True Faith spending a Faith Point.

name: Infernal Bridges
description: Listed in the index; bridges of infernal origin.

name: Infernal Bull
description: Infernal animal terrorizing local cows in a story idea.

name: Infernal Confidence
description: Common Infernal Blessing granting an additional Confidence Point.

name: Infernal Curse
description: Maledictions, usually of Forsaken Duration, that remain until dispelled.

name: Infernal Device
description: Common Infernal Blessing providing a device with an unholy effect up to level 15.

name: Infernal Greatness
description: Common Infernal Blessing granting effects of a Major Virtue.

name: Infernal Hawk
description: Infernal bird in a story seed that follows grogs hoping to snatch a Gifted baby.

name: Infernal Health
description: Common Infernal Blessing giving +3 Aging rolls at the expense of a victim.

name: Infernal Hierarchy
description: Ordering of fallen angels into nine orders mirroring angelic choirs.

name: Infernal Powers (blessing)
description: Common Infernal Blessing granting effects of an appropriate Minor Virtue.

name: Infernal Prowess
description: Common Infernal Blessing enhancing Soak, Damage, Initiative, Attack or Defense.

name: Infernal Relics
description: Objects binding the dead, sold by the Dread Host as false relics.

name: Infernal Sentries
description: Guardians of Hell who fight the Hounds of God with iron batons.

name: Infernal Sleep of the Damned
description: Re(In)Me 25 effect of a hand of glory, rendering people in a building unconscious until sunrise.

name: Infernal Smoke of Death
description: A Muto Auram spell (Level 40) that turns fire smoke into a thick corrosive cloud inflicting +25 corrosion damage to anyone immersed in it.

name: Infernal Supernatural Abilities
description: Also Supernatural Virtues takable at creation or initiated via corrupt Mystery Cults.

name: Infernal Talisman
description: Talisman at Verdi destroyed by Nerius.

name: Infernal Witches
description: Servants of the Infernal who curse villages and battle nightwalkers in the night battles, often as the malandanti.

name: Infernal artifact of Terentia
description: A demonic artifact of Terentia used against Regulus and now enclosed in Wyzwanie's boulder aspect.

name: Infernal pact
description: Bargain with a demon.

name: Infested
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab has an animal or plant infestation, e.g. mice, a vine, or fungi (-1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics, +1 Animal or Herbam).

name: Infinite Divisibility
description: Archangel power to split into many self-aware copies to attend to all duties at once.

name: Infirmarer
description: Chief surgeon of the Templars.

name: Infirmarian
description: Religious who cares for the sick and elderly and the health of the community.

name: Infirmary
description: Room or detached building of a monastery where sick, elderly and indigent people are cared for by the monks.

name: Inflexible Magic
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw limiting spell variation to 1 magnitude.

name: Inhabitants
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab is shared with other creatures who consider it their home (-1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Inherent vis
description: The vis contained in a magic character's body, typically Might Score / 5 pawns.

name: Initiate
description: A member of a Mystery Cult, or one undergoing the rite to become such.

name: Initiation into the Blessing Form
description: UnGifted gruagach script requiring permanent aid to a hopeless person; grants Blessing and Weird Magic.

name: Initiation into the Curse Form
description: UnGifted gruagach script requiring poetic punishment of a wicked person; grants Curse and Vow.

name: Initiation into the Give Technique
description: UnGifted gruagach script requiring a quest for justice; grants Give and Restriction.

name: Initiation into the Shape Form
description: UnGifted gruagach script requiring defeat of a shapechanger; grants Shape and Weak Tattoo Magic.

name: Initiation into the Take Technique
description: UnGifted gruagach script requiring oblations to Gruagach; grants Take and Dark Secret.

name: Initiation into the Vision Form
description: UnGifted gruagach script requiring fasting at a Pictish site; grants Vision and Transformation Prone.

name: Initiative
description: Roll determining order of action in combat rounds; spellcasting has weapon initiative modifier 0.

name: Ink of Noblest Metals
description: A Muto Terram 20 spell with Aquam requisite that transforms gold into a liquid applied as ink, reverting to solid metal when it expires.

name: Inmost Companion
description: A Muto Mentem spell (Level 40) with an Animal requisite that makes the target's mind physical as a bird; if the bird is killed the target dies, as their mind has been killed.

name: Inner Circle
description: The Blessed One, Cleopatra, Erin and four other magi leading the Children of Hermes.

name: Inner Council of Montverte
description: Secretive council of five elder magi ruling Montverte, led by Geirlaug.

name: Inner Hebrides
description: Island group close to the Scottish mainland with deeply cut sealochs and slightly better weather.

name: Innocentia
description: Daughter of Saint Severus of Ravenna and Vincentia.

name: Innocu
description: Parens of Phalene.

name: Inscribed Memories
description: Memories that power one's Arts and non-physical Abilities, which magic cannot transfer or create.

name: Inscription Target
description: A new Hermetic Target from integrating rune magic, working like Circle but not requiring penetration.

name: Insights from Twilight
description: Summa on Magic Theory by Perpauca Bonisagi.

name: Insignificance
description: Bomburkhan's Power preventing any power forcing him to use his Powers.

name: Instant Loyalty of the Rebellious Turb
description: A CrMe 50 ritual cast at a midwinter gathering that grants up to 100 people a 'Loyal to Covenant' score of +4 while inflicting Warping Points each year.

name: Instant Transportation
description: Magical transport rules with new guidelines by magnitude of distance.

name: Institutiones Capituli Generalis
description: 1203 statutes of the Cistercian general chapter, a kind of Peripheral Code.

name: Insubstantial Vis
description: Vis in forms like breezes, sound, or light requiring special containers.

name: Insula
description: In the Magic Archipelago theory, an island-like location of the Magic Realm, resembling a high-level Magic regio.

name: Integration Breakthrough
description: Research to incorporate non-Hermetic magic into Hermetic theory.

name: Intelligence
description: Characteristic used in ordination and argument rolls.

name: Intelligence of the Heroes
description: CrMe 55 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

name: Interference in the mundane
description: Hermetic crime a magus may be prosecuted for.

name: Interference with the Church
description: Hermetic crime; certain church sites in the Alpine Peripheral Code treat even minor violence as interference.

name: Interfering with the mundanes
description: Hermetic crime the crusaders commit by killing mundanes.

name: Interim lease
description: Provisional lease on a newly found vis source granted by a Quaesitor.

name: Interloping Wolves
description: Pack of Magic wolves (Might 13) that followed roe deer into the truffle regio intending to gorge on its magical creatures.

name: Interplanetary Magic
description: Theurgic magic of celestial spirits from Realms of Power: Magic.

name: Interrupting Actions
description: Optional rule letting a delayed character resolve his action before the triggering action via Action Priority.

name: Inundation
description: The Red Knight's power to generate Creo, Muto or Rego-like Aquam or Terram effects that break sea defenses or raise waves.

name: Inverness
description: Area with standing stone circles.

name: Inverse Auction
description: Auction at the Midsummer Fair where bids start high and descend; bids taken in Vim vis.

name: Investigation Immunity
description: Limited immunity from scrying charges granted to Quaesitors and their agents while pursuing justified investigations.

name: Investiture Controversy
description: Conflict between pope and emperor in which Matilda of Tuscany was the pope's main supporter.

name: Invisibility (Sir Giles)
description: Sir Giles' power to make himself and his horse invisible except to Second Sight.

name: Invisible
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab interior and outfittings are invisible, requiring magical means to see them (+1 Warping, halve Aesthetics, +2 Imaginem).

name: Invisible World
description: The world of spirits, known to magi and wizards.

name: Invisible to Magic
description: Major Heroic Virtue to become temporarily invisible to magic by concentrating.

name: Invitation Token
description: Token letting a magical being or apprentice work magic within the Aegis of the Hearth; may be given to apprentices.

name: Invoke
description: Hermetic theurgy spell type summoning a spirit, which can incorporate Names of Power.

name: Invoke the Pact of Zelos
description: A ReVi general-level Ritual spell that forms a pact with the Daimon Zelos by targeting one of his Aspects to perform a specific service.

name: Invoke the Spirit Akkala for a Day
description: Gunnar's CrIg 30 Invoke spell summoning the spirit Akkala until sunset to cast Pilum of Fire.

name: Invoke the Spirit Nissila
description: Gunnar's Invoke spell with 15 added levels for a +30 Penetration bonus, summoning Nissila to cast Pilum of Fire.

name: Invoke the Spirit of (Form)
description: Generic Mystery spell forming a pact with a named spirit that performs effects as if casting Spontaneous Magic in a given Art combination.

name: Invoke the Spirit of (spell)
description: Generic Mystery spell forming a pact with a named spirit that casts a single Formulaic spell as a power on the magus's behalf.

name: Invoking God's Aid
description: Uttering a prayer and spending a Confidence or Faith point to gain a Divine Aid bonus (stress die + Communication + Dominion Lore).

name: Involvement
description: Contact with mundanes that does not breach the Code, such as proportionate self-defense.

name: Invulnerability to Metal
description: Barcas's power making him immune to metal weapons except one vulnerable spot.

name: Ioannes Acer
description: A young journeyman follower of Merinita at Irencillia, a knight with the Gift and Flawless Magic who specializes in Herbam and rides his stag caricature Kervus; youngest apprentice of Archmage Vinaria.

name: Iola of Guernicus
description: Magus who in 1047 distinguished court wizards as vassals rather than economic dependents.

name: Ionic Sea
description: Pirated southern sea.

name: Iopontes
description: Faun-like creatures with the lower parts of horses.

name: Ior
description: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Water monster", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

name: Iozheza
description: Conjurer who trained Bonisagus and vanished during an Osiris rite.

name: Iqta'
description: Muslim land grant similar to a feudal fief entrusted to a muqta'.

name: Irene the Younger
description: A Byzantine princess who became a Verditius maga and famous inventor of magical paintings and figurines, founding her confraternity.

name: Iris
description: One of Harco's three young Redcaps.

name: Irish Sea
description: Sea around which faeries claiming Manannan's role are found.

name: Irnerius
description: A charismatic jurist at Bologna, the first to teach the Corpus Iuris Civilis, who put the university on the map through the study of Roman law.

name: Iron
description: A supremely magical metal woven into many faerie stories as a ward, though miners, crafters and urban faeries often tolerate it.

name: Iron Cap
description: Helmet protecting the crown of the head.

name: Irregularity
description: Divine punishment of clergy who commit grossly immoral crimes, preventing use of Faith Points until confession.

name: Irresistible Light
description: Archangel power radiating Divine Light doing +40 damage to non-Divine beings and stripping Might.

name: Is
description: Drowned city.

name: Isaac (golem)
description: Golem created by Moshe ben Isaac with Divine Might 23, empowered to instill Divine anxiety in a greedy tax collector.

name: Isaac Angelus
description: Byzantine Emperor forced to send forces north against the Bulgarian rebellion.

name: Isaac Ben Solomon Israeli
description: Tunisian physician (850-932), monist and accomplished kabbalist.

name: Isabella of Angouleme
description: Wife of King John, suspected of bewitching him.

name: Isabella of Hainault
description: First wife of Philip Augustus and mother of Louis.

name: Isabelle of Angoulême
description: Countess of Angoulême, widow of King John, betrothed to Hugh X of Lusignan.

name: Isaiah
description: Prophet whose enthronement visions inspired Merkavah.

name: Iseult
description: Lover in the romance of Tristan and Iseult.

name: Ishim
description: Choir of white fire in the Fifth Heaven.

name: Ishtar
description: Babylonian goddess of love and war who transformed unfaithful lovers into wolves.

name: Isis
description: Pagan goddess in whom True Faith is not possible.

name: Isis Cord
description: Spirit familiar cord corresponding to the silver cord, adding to Lab Totals and Casting Scores involving spirits.

name: Islamic Caliphates
description: Earthly Islamic institutions of the faithful.

name: Islamic Lore
description: Lore Ability possessed by Golab.

name: Islamic Virtues
description: Virtues inspired by the Qur'an such as Righteousness, Generosity, Gratitude, Humility, Mercy and Patience.

name: Islamic wizards
description: Mystical groups beyond the Order, especially of the Levant, whom House Tremere studies and Poena seeks to counter.

name: Island of Man
description: Vis-rich island visited by many covenants including Crun Clach.

name: Island of the Sleeping Fomóir
description: Variant renaming of Bear Island when moved to the Hibernia Tribunal.

name: Islay
description: Southern island group granted to Somerled in 1156.

name: Isle of Boetia
description: Greek home of Diana nam Grechanach.

name: Isle of the Blessed
description: Fabled isle west of Ireland sought by Brendan the Navigator.

name: Isle of the Sleeping Fomóir
description: Alternative version of Bear Island relocated west of Ireland in the Hibernian Tribunal and tied to St. Brendan's voyage.

name: Islestone Shad
description: Islet entrance (with Glororum Shad) to a regio with a Magic aura of 3 containing a half-living tree.

name: Isma'ili
description: Sect of Shi'i Islam to which the founders of the Brethren of Purity belonged; oppressed in many areas.

name: Isra' and Mi'raj
description: Muhammad's night journey to Jerusalem and ascent to heaven.

name: Israel Lore
description: Area lore of Israel.

name: Israfil
description: Angel who will blow the trumpet twice on the Day of Judgment.

name: Istrian Peninsula
description: Peninsula near the Brijuni Islands, home to the oppidum of Histria.

name: Istvan Padas
description: A master of House Bjornaer holding the Seat of the Horse at Crintera, with a stallion heartbeast; the youngest and most willful Elder, a Wilderist descended from Magyars and lover of Zora.

name: Italian Sailor
description: Grog vocation: a fisherman's son who sailed Venetian merchant ships and now serves on a magi-owned ship.

name: Itching Thumbs
description: Valefar's Power granting a thief +3 on a single stealing roll.

name: Items of Quality
description: A Minor House Inner Mystery of Verditius for creating non-enchanted items whose latent magical bonus is drawn to the surface via runes, not resisted by Magic Resistance.

name: Iudicium of Guernicus
description: The ancient senior quaesitor of the tribunal who presides at meetings from Blackthorn; bears a tattoo of a scarlet serpent and favors Intellego and Mentem magic.

name: Ivan Asen II
description: Current Tsar of Bulgaria, claiming the title Emperor of the Bulgars and Greeks, enemy of the Latins in Constantinople.

name: Ivory Ball
description: Ball given by the White Fox that rolls toward a hermit.

name: Ja'far al-Sadiq
description: Sixth Shi'i imam (d. 765).

name: Jabir Ibn Hayyan
description: Arabic alchemist who stressed mercury and the four qualities.

name: Jabniel
description: Ruler of Shehaqin.

name: Jacinda of Flambeau
description: Author of Subtle Knives.

name: Jacinta filia Romana
description: Archmaga of the Tower of Ashes who writes to her apprentice Ash about the economics of Alpine peace.

name: Jacinth of Oleron
description: Magus convicted of damaging Infelicitas; later accused Lothaire of partisanship.

name: Jack
description: Brigandine jerkin, late medieval.

name: Jack's Beanstalk Giant
description: A hammy giant who knowingly lets a boy become famous by killing him, assisted by a wife who gives magic beans; the most anachronistic faerie in the book.

name: Jack-of-All-Trades
description: A Minor, General Virtue letting a character attempt Ability rolls without a score and without extra botch dice.

name: Jacques Vert
description: Merinita magus who speculated the Nains were dreams of dead Diedne and vanished at Carnac.

name: Jacques of House Flambeau
description: Former Brabançon warrior turned Flambeau magus who leads Atsingani's mercenaries and seeks revenge on the Capuchonnes.

name: Jael
description: Biblical heroine of Jael and Sisera.

name: Jahm of Alexandria
description: Ex Miscellanea magus who rediscovered Hermetic Alchemy in the tenth century (956 AD), origin of the Green Cockerel.

name: Jakin
description: One of two great hollowed stone pillars ("he establishes") of Solomon's temple legend that hold treasures of the ancient Hebrews.

name: Jambes
description: Plate armor covering the legs.

name: James of Vitry
description: Bishop of Acre (1216-1228), close Templar ally.

name: James the Legate
description: Papal chaplain linked to Saint Victor in Paris, appointed legate to Scotland and the Isles in 1220; an Augustinian.

name: Jami' al-Bayan 'an Ta'wil al-Qur'an
description: Massive commentary on the Qur'an by al-Tabari; Summa on Theology: Islam and Islamic Law.

name: Jami'at al-Qarawiyyin
description: A madrasah in Morocco described as the oldest madrasah in existence.

name: Janine's House
description: Kilkenny townhouse with a secret basement kitchen with Magic aura 4 and a vis spring.

name: Janis
description: Leader of Crintera's Swan Clan and volkv (priest) of the Forest Brothers, the covenant's contact among the pagan people of Rügen, often consulted by the magi on island matters.

name: Janna
description: Paradise, the blissful gardens.

name: Jar of Pandora
description: Jar that imprisoned the lugra; sought to bind them.

name: Javelin
description: Thrown piercing weapon.

name: Jean and Jeanne
description: Petrified betrothed couple, two menhirs on Belle-ile, who could be freed by ritual.

name: Jean de Brienne
description: Emperor of Constantinople who, after dreams of friars, gave up his throne to live as a friar until his death.

name: Jean de la Porte
description: Bailli of Rouen, appointed 1219.

name: Jehovah
description: Name used by pagan polytheists for the god they consider merely the most powerful deity.

name: Jennet
description: A palfrey ridden by a lady, always a mare.

name: Jennis
description: Richenda Spinosa's faerie caricature, a male version of the Polish maga who is helping her come to terms with her fae side.

name: Jenny Greenteeth
description: Nursery terror who drags children into wells.

name: Jerbiton Gauntlet
description: Gauntlet of House Jerbiton, which Carmine has passed.

name: Jerkin
description: Short sleeveless jacket.

name: Jerome of Jerbiton
description: Parens of Eloi at Confluensis who supported Cunfin's founding.

name: Jerome the Scribe
description: A scribe for whom Victor of Mercere is tasked with purchasing particular pigments in town.

name: Jerusalem Hospital
description: The most famous hospital instituted for those injured on Crusade, built by the Order of St. John.

name: Jesses
description: Leather or silk cords securing a hawk to its perch.

name: Jet of Virtue
description: Jet containing 1 pawn of Perdo vis that when Enriched grants Puissant Stealth, lost if anyone but the owner sees it.

name: Jewish Instruction
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Jewish Lore
description: Lore Ability possessed by Golab.

name: Jewish Mysticism
description: Jewish occult tradition encompassing Gematria, Kabbalah, golems and Merkavah.

name: Jewish Temple in Jerusalem
aliases: the last remnants of the Jewish temple in Jerusalem
description: The remnants of the Jewish temple in Jerusalem, cited as an example of a place with a Divine aura of 10.

name: Jezinkas
description: Bohemian faeries who steal eyes after lulling men to sleep.

name: Jihad
description: Struggle, greater (inner) and lesser (against evil, warfare).

name: Jinnistan
description: Subterranean homeland of the jinn conquered by Iblis.

name: Jinxed
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is a magnet for bad luck, being biased to be the one affected whenever chance determines misfortune.

name: Jiphella
description: An immense Ex Miscellanea maga of Dankmar (age 73), biological daughter of Schadrit and master of Mentem magics who keeps the covenfolk under her spell.

name: Joachim of Jerbiton
description: Early Legion theorist who formulated the doctrine of foreshadowing and found an Initiatory manual of Christianized Mithras rites.

name: Joan
description: Daughter of King John of England, betrothed to Alexander II.

name: Joan of Flanders
description: Commissioned Perceval continuations.

name: Joan of Hainault
description: Ruler of Flanders since 1205, niece of Philip II.

name: Joan the Wad
description: Will-o-the-wisp Queen of the Pisgies in Devon and Cornwall.

name: Job
description: Biblical figure of the Testing of Job.

name: Jocelin
description: A Redcap in his late twenties with brown hair and green eyes; favors new covenants and carries a ring of magic resistance and an enchanted shield.

name: Jochim
description: Example tainted noble's son conceived by incubus for a pointless war before the Mongol invasion.

name: John Cassian
description: Early writer whose works inspired the first rules for nuns.

name: John Comyn
description: Leader who rivals Robert the Bruce and attacks him in Selkirk forest in 1299.

name: John II
description: Married the daughter of Andrew II in 1218, partly due to Tremere influence.

name: John IV of Montoire
description: Count living in Vendôme castle who owns one of the spears.

name: John Marshal
description: William Marshal's father. He held a castle for Queen Matilda against King Stephen, broke a truce and offered his son as a hostage he would not ransom.

name: John Scottus
description: A scholar who in the ninth century corrected the error of two predeterminations, one good and one evil.

name: John Wascelin
description: Current constable of Bamburgh Castle with nominal suzerainty over the Farne Islands.

name: John de Garlande
description: Author of the famous 13th-century craft manual Dictionarius, covering moneychangers, clasp makers, cup makers, jewelers, and harness makers.

name: John de Warrenne
description: Earl of Surrey and Governor of Scotland who advances against Wallace.

name: John of Capella
description: Early follower of Francis who, while Francis was away, gathered lepers and began to develop a new religious order for them.

name: John of Frankfurt
description: Stated with Arnold of Villanova that spirits come voluntarily.

name: John of Mirfeld
description: English writer giving techniques for prognosis by magical means, including onomancy.

name: John of San Costanzo
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: John of Tours
description: Physician and Bishop of Somerset who moved his seat to Bath and built its priory.

name: John the Baptist
description: Precursor to Jesus (Yahya in Islam), beheaded by King Herod; several churches claim his head.

name: Joining the Navy
description: Story seed where a nobleman demands ship carriage from a port town near a covenant.

name: Jolarsveniar
description: Norwegian faeries drawn to Christmas celebrations.

name: Jon Arnsson
description: A 98-year-old master of House Bjornaer holding the Seat of the Stag (protector) at Crintera, with a lion heartbeast; a devout Christian Harmonist with divided loyalties.

name: Jon Baudin
description: Guildmaster of the Dyer's Guild and Fudarus spy who plays two Daniel impersonators against each other.

name: Jonaquil of Merinita
description: A young Merinita magus, one of the newly arrived members of Libellus.

name: Jonathan Carpenter
description: Example character who gains the Reputation Patron (Clergy) by building a nave for a parish church.

name: Jonathan Tweet
description: Ars Magica co-creator who wrote the game's preface; an in-world author note rather than a setting figure.

name: Jongleurs
description: Lower-born minstrels.

name: Jophiel
description: An archangel listed by Dionysus the Areopagite among the archangels.

name: Josce fil' Isaac of London
description: An important London usurer who currently holds the office of archpresbyter, the crown-appointed Jewish representative.

name: Josce of London
description: Presbyter Judaeorum of England in 1220.

name: Joscelin of Wells
description: Bishop of Bath since 1206 who wishes to move his seat to Wells and build a cathedral; a potential ally of magi.

name: Joseph d'Arimethie
description: Tractatus by Robert de Boron on the Holy Grail.

name: Josephine filia Theodore
description: Lartan Jerbiton maga at Valnastium.

name: Joshua
description: Conqueror of Canaan.

name: Josiah
description: Prophet who rendered the Vale of Hinnom ceremonially unclean, ending child sacrifice there.

name: Josselin
description: Castle town.

name: Jotun Language
description: The ancient language of the giants, magical language of the trollsynir, replacing Pictish.

name: Jotun Lore
description: Lore universally taught to trollsynir.

name: Jotunheim
description: The land of the Norse giants, perhaps within the Magic Realm.

name: Jotunn Affinity
description: Giant magical ability to work with Jotunn spirits; Gull's is with Fire.

name: Jotunn Spells
description: Gull's power to invoke fire magics directly using Stamina.

name: Jotunn spirits
description: Spirits called upon by giants through Jotunn Affinity.

name: Jotunnar
description: The Norse giants spawned from Ymir, including frost, mountain, sea, storm and fire giants; affiliated with elemental Forms and all possessing magical powers.

name: Journal of Regulus
description: Tractatus on Area Lore: Cursewood, Quality 9, revealing Wyzwanie, the diabolists, vis sources and Significatos.

name: Joyous Garden
description: Garden Merlin conjured for Viviane.

name: Judah
description: Southern kingdom with Jerusalem as capital.

name: Judah Halevi
description: Toledo-born poet (1075-1140) who held Israel the only place for true prophecy; murdered outside Jerusalem.

name: Juden of Verditius
description: Magus of Verdi who murdered clergy on Sardinia to restore magic and was killed under a Wizard's March.

name: Judges of the Dead
description: Figures of the Underworld negotiated past in the Orpheus story.

name: Judgment of the Glowing Iron
description: Ordeal of carrying red-hot iron; innocent if wounds are uninfected after three days.

name: Judith
description: Biblical widow whose story Joachim used to calculate 1260.

name: Julia of Jerbiton
description: Example maga who enchants stone columns to increase her covenant's aura and close its regio.

name: Julia's Laboratory
description: The ground-floor sanctum of the Devil's Lane covenant, a spooky chamber filled with bleached bones and skulls.

name: Julian of Flambeau
description: A magus of House Flambeau whose version of The Beast Remade gives transformed beasts bright red hair in their new form.

name: Jumieges
description: Benedictine abbey on the Seine founded 634 by St. Philibert, a major center of scholarship with over 1,000 monks.

name: Jumieges Abbey
description: Normandy abbey which received lost Viking-era books.

name: Jungfrau
description: Region with St Beatus' caves.

name: Juniper
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Junius of Verditius
description: An old, powerful Verditius magus of Semitae who makes the covenant's enchanted wagons and works secretly on an unrevealed project.

name: Juno
description: Externalized conscience created from the spirit of a morally-conflicted being; Esther may be one.

name: Jupiter's Touch
description: Air elemental power causing lightning for +30 damage.

name: Jurade
description: Citizen assembly governing St-Èmilion.

name: Jurisdiction
description: Major Church Hook: the church has jurisdiction over many subordinate churches.

name: Jury of Inquisition
description: Group appointed by the court to investigate a matter and report at the next session.

name: Jus Primae Noctis
description: The legend of the lord's right to a bride's first night, noted as not medieval.

name: Just an Instant
description: A Minor, General Virtue letting a character who briefly looks about a room detect and remember anything of interest without Awareness checks.

name: Justice
description: Moral (Cardinal) virtue creating respect toward others, source of piety, gratitude and duty.

name: Justin of Tremere
description: A young Tremere magus, one of the newly arrived members of Libellus.

name: Justina of Criamon
description: Filia of Errantus whose staff he stole; awarded twelve pawns in damages.

name: Jutta
description: Anchoress who taught the young Hildegard reading and writing and was the only person she confided her visions to; died 1136.

name: Jörmungandr
description: The Midgard Serpent, with a Might of 75.

name: Ka'aba
description: A holy site in Mecca cited as an example of a place with a Divine aura of 10 where God intervened directly.

name: Ka'ba
description: Shrine of the Black Stone in Mecca built by Abraham and Isma'il; Dominion aura 10.

name: Kabbalah Shimmush
description: Practical kabbalah, the relatively new pragmatic, ritualistic application of the forces of creation.

name: Kabbalist (companion)
description: Mythic Companion template, a rabbi and kabbalist.

name: Kabouters
description: Dwarf-like faeries of the Low Countries who made bells for missionaries and sang the first carillon; Florum sits above their ancient workshop.

name: Kaerbadon
description: Capital of King Bladud, suggested as the site of the Battle of Mons Badonicus.

name: Kaeso
description: Founder of the Mithraic tradition within House Flambeau; a hedge wizard of the Cult of Mithras recruited by Apromor who founded the covenant of Castra Solis.

name: Kalazonta
description: The Chastiser, an example angel.

name: Kalevipoeg
description: Hero who sailed toward the Underworld and found an island of peaceful koerakoonlased.

name: Kalkriese
description: Site of the Varus disaster skirmish where Tremere necromancers routed Diedne magi with ghosts.

name: Kallikantzaroi
description: Small Greek faeries living under the Earth sawing at the World Tree, allowed on the surface from Christmas until Epiphany.

name: Kalodaemones
description: Ancient Greek sorcerers' name for the good spirits used in their magic, contrasted with kakodaemones.

name: Kalshedra
description: An Albanian fire-breathing dragon that can take hag shape, pollutes water, causes drought and feeds on human vitality.

name: Kapparah
description: Ritual of transferring sins to a chicken before Yom Kippur.

name: Kara
description: The kolduni term for a geas or curse.

name: Karantia
description: Tremere member of Postestas.

name: Karbala'
description: Site of al-Husayn's burial.

name: Karet
description: Serious excommunication; the dead under it become dybbukim.

name: Karreg an Tan
description: Fire Rock with Ignem vis.

name: Karzełek
description: Polish dwarfs with green grass for hair who ride diminutive horses over sleeping field hands; they aid diligent farmers but punish minor infractions violently.

name: Kashrut
description: Dietary requirements codified in the Torah; kosher food complies.

name: Kaspar
description: Mechthild's eldest son from a previous marriage, physically dominant but dimwitted, holding real power in the castle.

name: Kassala
description: A location in Alodia, the most remote of the three Nubian kingdoms on the southern reaches of the Nile, home to the Mortuary Society that practices Kassalan Exorcism.

name: Kassalan Dust
description: A dust of powdered gold, myrrh, and spices made by the Mortuary Society of Kassala, required for Kassalan Exorcism and granting a +3 Shape & Material bonus against the dead.

name: Kassalan Exorcism
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue allowing minor exorcism spells via the rites of the Mortuary Society of Kassala, aligned to the Magic Realm and using Kassalan Dust.

name: Katadesmos
description: A curse tablet, usually lead or a mirror's back, used to curse and control the individual named upon it; +2 penetration.

name: Kataphraktoi
description: Byzantine armored horse archers whose horses wore scale armor.

name: Kattenfeest
description: Ypres ritual of hurling cats from the Cloth Hall belfry.

name: Katzenveit
description: A Waldgeist (wood-spirit) who haunts the forests of the Fichtelgebirge (Spruce Mountains).

name: Keeper of the Path
description: The figure who tests aspirants at the Path of Strife's Initiation site, requiring them to negotiate the Labyrinth of Strife.

name: Keepers of a Thousand Tales
description: Group focused on Arabic stories, of which Caprican is a member.

name: Kelledei
description: The cele de ('servants of God'), communities of Scottish Church brothers who left monasteries ruled by greedy lay abbats; they have no formal rule.

name: Kelpies
description: Faerie horses that drown victims.

name: Kemuel
description: Archangel whose servants guard the Treasury of the Four Winds.

name: Kennels
description: Establishment for hounds whose size indicates noble prestige.

name: Kent
description: County palatine that resisted after the Conquest.

name: Ker
description: Leader of the Keres.

name: Kerbourg
description: Patch of firm ground in the Grande Brière with a covered alley of megaliths in a low Magic aura.

name: Kerotakis
description: Closed vessel exposing metal leaves to vapors; credited to Mary the Jewess.

name: Kerry Mountains Pool
description: A deep black pool in the Kerry Mountains of Hibernia where the ancient Irish cast votive offerings to their ancestors; a Bjornaer ancestor site.

name: Kerseenn
description: Great Spirit of Ushant of misdirection, constantly shifting shape.

name: Kervus
description: Ioannes Acer's faerie caricature, which has taken the form of a huge stag capable of bearing his weight, which he rides everywhere.

name: Keswick
description: Place-name origin of Ealwynn of Keswick.

name: Keter
description: Sefirah meaning 'Crown', level 10 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 10.

name: Kettle Hat
description: Bowl-shaped iron cap with wide brim.

name: Key of Solomon
description: The greatest grimoire, key grimoire of the middle ages, attributed to Solomon.

name: Key to the Mystic Veil
description: InVi 30 enchantment in a key embedded in a grove feature granting sight across a regio boundary to cultists.

name: Keynsham
description: Village northeast of Bath named for Saint Keyne.

name: Khadija
description: Wealthy widow who employed and married Muhammad; his first wife.

name: Khanqah
description: Sufi convent.

name: Khawass al-Qur'an
description: Special properties of the Qur'an, which may be invoked anywhere; Divine Might 100.

name: Kherion of Merinita
description: Magus who defeated Lanval in 1028.

name: Khidr
description: Immortal Muslim prophet, the Green One, who drank of the Water of Life and wanders giving advice.

name: Khrafstar
description: Persian name for the noxious biting creatures that burst from Naonhaithya's body cavity.

name: Khshathra Vairya
description: One of the Zoroastrian Immortals (Amesha Spentas): 'Desirable Dominion', associated with Just and Vim in the Blessing ritual.

name: Kiburg Family
description: Noble family of the Alps, rival of the Zähringers, which followed a similar policy of founding towns.

name: Kidron
description: River carrying Jerusalem's sewage from Hinnom.

name: Kikimora
description: Wife of the domovoi who helps with chickens and spinning; seeing her spin is a presentiment of death.

name: Kilkenny
description: Irish town home to the Kilkenny Coven.

name: Kilkenny Coven
description: A fractured folk witch coven in and near Kilkenny split between rival Gifted cousins Janine and Anne.

name: Kill the Living Air
description: Spell cast spontaneously with vis that badly drains Vindsvall's Might.

name: Kind Temper
description: Temper of love and mercy, tied to Charity and opposing Envy.

name: Kinderschrecker
description: German child-eating ogress ('child guzzler'), a version of the Gello without exsanguinating breasts.

name: King
description: A ruler (rex, roi) who owes allegiance to no living man except perhaps the pope or emperor. Anointed kings have minor supernatural powers and magic resistance.

name: King Albion
description: Lombard king under whom Pavia became capital.

name: King Alfonso I
description: Aragonese king whose death brought the Templars great lands.

name: King Aurelius
description: A king of Britain who sought to build a monument to his murdered people and was advised by Merlin to bring the Giant's Ring from Ireland.

name: King Baldwin I of Jerusalem
