description: King of Jerusalem; an encounter with him led the pirate-merchant Godric to repentance and pilgrimage.

name: King Clodio
description: King of the Franks whose wife bore Merovech.

name: King Dagobert
description: Seventh-century king who founded Saint Denis's Lendit Fair near Paris, once the most important fair in France.

name: King Edgar
description: King legendarily said to have rid England of wolves in the 950s.

name: King Edward of England
description: English king asked to adjudicate the Scottish succession after 1290.

name: King Gradlon
description: Sixth-century King of Cornouaille whose city Is drowned; founded Quimper.

name: King Haakon
description: Norwegian king whose invasion failed at Largs in 1263.

name: King Henry III
description: Young English king whose treasury the Templars maintain in 1220.

name: King Hezekiah
description: King who broke Nehushtan into pieces during his fight against paganism.

name: King Holly
description: The faerie ruler of the northern Holly Forest among the Courts of the Seasons, a tyrannical and cold-hearted Winter King who battles King Oak; possibly linked to the leader of the Wild Hunt.

name: King James I of Aragon
description: King of Aragon (1213-1276) who will campaign in the Balearics and Valencia.

name: King Jereboam
description: Biblical king in I Kings 13.

name: King Kyzikos
description: Ruler of Bear Island killed by Jason; buried in a tumulus on the Leimonian Plain.

name: King Lothair
description: King of Lotharingia whose kingdom split in 855.

name: King Louis of France
description: King who led the Second Crusade; Templars took over command by Antioch.

name: King Lycurgus of Sparta
description: Spartan king whose saying 'Obedience is of the highest benefit' is a Tremere moral touchstone.

name: King Mark of Cornwall
description: One of Arthur's under-kings who later held Tintagel as his seat.

name: King Melchior
description: One of the three Magi, possibly linked to Sal Almelke.

name: King Philip II
description: French king whose treasury is kept by the Paris Temple.

name: King Priam
description: King of Troy alongside whom Duke Francio fought.

name: King Richard of England
description: Crusader king who captured Cyprus and Acre and raised Robert of Sabloel to grand master.

name: King Richard's Ring
description: A wondrous gold ring that protects the wearer from fire (+5 Soak), named after Richard the Lionhearted and the legendary ring he wore on crusade (Craft Level 16).

name: King Sancho II
description: King of Portugal (1223-1245).

name: King Sel
description: A king said to be buried on horseback with his treasury within Silbury Hill near Avebury, his tomb protected by a curse that strikes dead would-be robbers.

name: King Sigebert
description: The king who founded the abbey at Bury St. Edmund's in 633.

name: King Stephen
description: King who besieged John Marshal. He threatened to catapult the hostage William but spared him instead, which changed his Reputation.

name: King Stone
description: A large stone standing apart from the Rollright Stones circle, the most magical of the lot, whose chips are supposed to ward against demons.

name: King Valdemar I of Denmark
description: Danish king who invaded the island of Rügen in 1168, threatening Crintera's pagan aura.

name: King of Aragon
description: Banished the Waldensians from his lands in 1194.

name: King of Atlantis
description: Pavania's father, ruler of sunken Atlantis.

name: King of England
description: England's monarch, who holds 15 to 20 percent of the kingdom's arable land and has 45 greater-baron vassals.

name: King of Fire (Power)
description: Adramelech's Power to create any Ignem effect cheaply.

name: King of the Beggars
description: Title of the ruler of the Parisian beggars and thieves, also the Grand Coësre; currently held by Anacrôn.

name: King of the wolves
description: Magical being whose blessing might grant a Skinchanger pelt.

name: King's Bench
description: One of the highest English courts of appeal, fixed at Westminster by Magna Carta, trying important civil and treason cases and issuing writs; its senior justice is Martin of Pattishall.

name: Kingdom of Asturias
description: A kingdom in northern Spain where Laberius served as court magician and fought the Moors during the early Reconquista.

name: Kingdom of Burgundy
description: Kingdom absorbed into the empire in 1033.

name: Kingdom of France Lore
description: Area lore of France.

name: Kingdom of Man and the Isles
description: Kingdom ruled by the Norse king of Man, to which Kintyre belongs.

name: Kingdom of Tír Chonaill
description: Irish kingdom in the northwest of Ireland containing Lough Dearg.

name: Kirburgers
description: Relatives-by-marriage who inherited the Zähringer lands, the most powerful indigenous nobles of the Western Alps.

name: Kirist of Flambeau
description: A young, fiery-tempered Flambeau magus of Voluntas specializing in Ignem who is committed to the greater good of the Order.

name: Kiss of Forgetfulness
description: Faerie power causing the person touched to forget his mortal life until he sees an object associated with his home.

name: Kitab al-Irshad
description: Biography of the twelve imams by al-Shaykh al-Mufid.

name: Kitab al-Luma'
description: Tractatus by al-Ash'ari defending mainstream theology against the Mu'tazilis.

name: Kitab ash-Shifa
description: Ibn Sina's Book of Healing; summa on Artes Liberales and the four Elementalist Forms.

name: Kite Shield Parry
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Klaus
description: A companion-level craftsman example character, master of the Swordsmiths' Guild, with the Virtue Touched by the Divine Realm, who makes greatswords and a wondrous flaming greatsword.

name: Kleité
description: King Kyzikos' wife who hanged herself on his tumulus.

name: Kleon of Criamon
description: A magus of House Criamon who spent years in the Thuringian Forest performing dangerous experiments with raw vis, became riddled with Warping, and likely perished in a Twilight episode.

name: Klymene
description: Titaness who is the underworld's cavern.

name: Knife
description: Brawl weapon that can also be thrown.

name: Knife of Human Bone
description: Philippus Niger's talisman, a wickedly curved dagger of human bone enchanted to stay razor-sharp, with attunements for Precise Destruction, Destroy Body, and Destroying Minds.

name: Knight (title)
description: A professional mounted warrior (miles, chevalier), who in some places must pay his overlord a fine for dubbing others.

name: Knight Shield Parry
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Knight Templar
description: Companion template: a scarred Templar returned from the Holy Land who loves fighting and fine living.

name: Knighthood
description: Ceremony creating a knight, often tied to vassalage since a knight usually joins the liege's household as a minor vassal.

name: Knightly Demands
description: Optional Major Story Flaw that replaces Oath of Fealty. The storyguide can use it to pull knights into ballad-style plots such as quests, feuds and rescues.

name: Knightly Duties
description: Flaw a caballero villano may take instead of Dependents.

name: Knights of Alcantara
description: Iberian military order based in Castile-Leon.

name: Knights of Blanik
description: The sleeping army of St. Wenceslaus, knights seated motionless in stone chairs in an underground hall within the Divine regio of Mount Blanik, awaiting their call to arise.

name: Knights of the Holy Stone
description: Cult whose members often choose heraldically charged shields as talismans.

name: Knights of the Round Table
description: Heroes of medieval romances who fight giants.

name: Knivestone
description: Three knife-like rocks among the outer Farnes.

name: Knockers
description: Cornish mine faeries said to warn miners of collapses by knocking, playing along with belief that they are souls of dead Jewish miners.

name: Know Then the Calloused Touch of Faerie Hands
description: Evocation/Grant 30 rite granting the target 5 Warping Points, a permanent effect.

name: Know-It-All
description: Major or Minor Child Personality Flaw: compelled to show off knowledge and superiority.

name: Known Hedge Wizard
description: Major Story Flaw: the character is known to and watched by the Order.

name: Knows People
description: A Minor, General Virtue letting a character act as a social middleman, requesting a 'bait' once per story to gain aid from a non-player character.

name: Knoxes Reef
description: Inner Farne feature that remains above water at high tide.

name: Kobolds
description: German mine faeries that lace mines with arsenical ore and cause minor trouble, though some are helpful.

name: Koerakoonlane
description: Dog-human hybrid faeries of the frozen north who raid settlements on dog sleds to take slaves.

name: Koios
description: Titan who rules the axis of the heavens.

name: Kolding
description: A small trading town at the head of Kolding Fjørd on the border between the Kingdom of Denmark and the Duchy of Schleswig, with about 200 inhabitants relying on fishing and a weekly farm market.

name: Koldovali
description: The kolduni's name for their oral magic, very similar to gruagach magic, in which water plays an important role.

name: Koldovali Theory
description: Ability that replaces Pictish Language in koldun spell formulae.

name: Koldun Lore
description: Lore studied by kolduni.

name: Korrigan
description: Breton faeries: hunchbacked manikins with cat's claws and goat's hooves who dance and may take the form of a beautiful woman; dangerous in Brocéliande.

name: Kostchei the Undying
description: Villain in Maria Morevna, cited as an example of the villain role.

name: Kraken
description: Sea monster form in which Pan Caudarax attacks the ships from below.

name: Kratos
description: The Daimon of might, bodily strength, and sovereign rule, son of Styx and Pallas, referenced in the Analects of Tytalus as a constant companion of the Founder.

name: Kraxios Lord of Wrath
description: A demon who could draw the remaining Infernal aura into a hidden regio and cause paranoid dreams among grogs.

name: Krems
description: City near Vienna with a Luciferan community.

name: Kresniki and Kudlaki
description: Local nightwalker traditions.

name: Kropel
description: A good-natured dwarflike creature of the Harz who travels abroad hidden by his hat of fog.

name: Kunal Trow
description: The 'king' trow, a more powerful trow that takes villages under its care in exchange for a bride or groom and may learn all gruagach powers.

name: Kupala
description: A faerie lord who guards the Fire Flower in Slavic lands and from whom Richenda Spinosa is descended, source of her secret faerie blood.

name: Kushiel
description: An Avenger of Evil whose angel-like name means Rigid One of God.

name: Kutna Mine
description: A fantastically rich silver mine opened by the Cistercian monks of Sedlec, where a monk named Anton found silver rods sprouting; site of a story seed about a magus secretly mining silver with magic.

name: Kyburgers
description: Noble family with a home castle near Winterthur and about 100 vassal castles.

name: Kyffhauser Mountains
description: A double line of hills on the Saxony-Thuringia border, legendary resting place of famous kings (notably Frederick Barbarossa) and site of Fengheld's Turris Acontiarum chapter.

name: Kyllénos
description: A female Idaian Daktyl who remains on Bear Island with Titias.

name: Kyzikos staters
description: Lost coins said to be buried in chests on Bear Island.

name: König
description: German title for king. Within the empire, kingdoms are usually held by the emperor.

name: L'espurgatoire Seint Patriz
description: Norman French tractatus by Marie of France on Area Lore: Purgatory, Quality 9.

name: La Chaise-Dieu
description: Monastery of St. Robert heading over 200 priories.

name: La Coloubre
description: Dragon near Lalinde slain by St. Front.

name: Lab Notes
description: Laboratory records; Verdi holds 400 years of them.

name: Laberius
description: A hermit-wizard of the ancient Roman cult of Mithras who healed and trained the young Flambeau, later killed by sahirs in Iberia.

name: Labor Points
description: Points describing business development, also applied to errant knights' tourney income.

name: Laboratory Horoscope
description: Horoscope cast for a season of lab work to gain an Astrological Modifier of +1 to +5 to the Lab Total.

name: Laboratory Turbulences
description: Turbulences occurring during laboratory work, covered in the Adolescentia chapter.

name: Labyrinth
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab's exterior is a maze or structural puzzle, favored by some Criamon magi (-1 Safety, -1 Health, -2 Aesthetics, +2 Mentem or Vim).

name: Labyrinth Meditation
description: A non-magical Criamon ritual of walking a maze while contemplating a problem to improve concentration, granting a bonus to a single subsequent roll.

name: Labyrinth of Strife
description: A tangled structure of tunnels at the Path of Strife's Initiation site that magi can only escape by performing feats violating Criamon tenets of apt action.

name: Lacerta
description: A Clan Arelie magus of an Iberian sept, parens of Natrix.

name: Lachlan Mac Calum
description: Younger brother of Donncadh and seanachaidh of Clan Mac Gruagach, a storyteller knowledgeable about Highland supernatural beings who expects to inherit the chieftainship.

name: Lack of Penetration
description: Flaw.

name: Lack of Potency
description: Flaw possessed by Calum Mac Lachlan.

name: Ladha
description: Islamic degree of Hell for Christians.

name: Ladislaus
description: A trusted companion of Roznov covenant who haunts the Prague slave market using his Magic Sensitivity to identify and filter out Gifted children among the slaves for delivery to Coeris.

name: Lady Godgifu
description: The legendary noblewoman of a story seed whose lord promised to reduce taxes if she rode naked through the marketplace.

name: Lady of Winter
description: Magic being held captive by the Lord of Summer, disrupting the seasons.

name: Lady of the Game
description: Anonymous powerful magical spirit in the form of a woman who leads nightwalker processions, appoints captains and resurrects eaten animals.

name: Laering
description: Vitki apprentice.

name: Lagny-sur-Marne
description: Site of the 1179 tourney to which Henry the Young King brought five hundred knights.

name: Laigle
description: Small chartered forest community in Normandy.

name: Lair
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: a creature hides or hibernates in the lab, known or unknown (-1 Safety, +1 Warping).

name: Laity Objects
description: Items given as gifts to the Church by dying people, such as the deathbed or best robe.

name: Lake Acherusia
description: Sample terrestrial regio from the Apocalypse of Paul near Tarsus, a multilevel regio leading to a city where Michael baptizes the repentant.

name: Lake Avernus
description: Circular sulfurous lake on the Bay of Naples in the Roman Tribunal, connected by tunnel to Cumae.

name: Lake Balaton
description: Lake near Budapest home to Men of the Lake, site of a failed Tremere assault.

name: Lake Comper
description: Viviane's home.

name: Lake District
description: The region where the covenant Ungulus sits in a carved tower on a ridge, and where Aquila rides the thermals in eagle form.

name: Lake Léman
description: Lake near Geneva dug by Gargantua.

name: Lake Nemi
description: A sacred lake in the Roman Tribunal in whose waters Huntress initiates may bathe on the Ides of August during the Eumolpid initiation.

name: Lake Pavin
description: Lake where a basalt stone summons a storm yielding Auram vis.

name: Lake Sonderdach
description: Lake with a dragon.

name: Lake Thun
description: Lake with the castles of Thun and Oberhofen.

name: Lamballe
description: Seat of the Baron of Penthièvre.

name: Lamed Vav Tzadikim Nistarim
description: The 36 hidden righteous souls in each generation who sustain the world.

name: Lamellar
description: Overlapping plates fastened to each other.

name: Lammergeir
description: Bearded vulture, the heartbeast of Eginhard and Kamilla.

name: Lammergeyer
description: The bearded vulture deemed by House Jerbiton the correct falconry raptor for magi; its bones make particularly good magical flutes and it has deep orange iron-rubbed plumage.

name: Lammikin
description: Ugly Scottish faerie who torments children and kills mothers.

name: Lampaul
description: Fishing community on Ushant.

name: Lampedusa
description: Island southwest of Sicily once a Roman fish-sauce manufactory, perhaps with a weak Magic aura.

name: Lampione
description: Island southwest of Sicily said to be a stone dropped by a cyclops; may have a Faerie aura.

name: Lancea Magica
description: Magical attack developed by Cerularius that pierces Parma Magica; banned by the Colentes.

name: Land of Nod
description: Place of Cain's banishment, equated by some with Arcadia.

name: Land of Spirits
description: Mystical realm explored by the magi of Tarragon Vale alongside Arcadia.

name: Landernaeu
description: Port.

name: Landfriedensbund
description: Temporary regional peace alliances encouraged by German nobles, designed to keep the peace by developing processes of law instead of military feuds; they pave the way for later eternal alliances.

name: Landgraf
description: A graf with a larger than usual area of administration, ranked slightly above a count.

name: Landvaettir attendant
description: Spirit given to each galdraman during the war, with Might equal to Song Talent x5, reducing casting time and accepting bargains for little vis.

name: Landvaettir bargains
description: Deals galdramen make with spirits that can give magic resistance.

name: Landvaettir lords
description: Powerful landvaettir who held the galdramen leader in esteem and give attendant spirits to all galdramen during the conflict.

name: Landévennec
description: Abbey.

name: Langon
description: Village with a chapel on a temple of Venus.

name: Langres
description: Walled hilltop town of the Lingones.

name: Langue d'oc
description: Southern language region of the Cathars, belonging to Provençal.

name: Languedoc Tribunal
description: Tribunal where Mathematikoi robes resemble Cathar perfecti.

name: Languidus
description: Somnifer's filius, representing Lapis Crudus at Tribunal without formal membership.

name: Lanleff
description: Round Templar chapel.

name: Lanner
description: North African falcon easy to train and taught to hunt in pairs.

name: Lannion
description: Town with Brélévenez Church.

name: Lanterns of the Dead
description: Cemetery towers with lanterns; an angel pulls down those over unworthy dead.

name: Lanval
description: Arthurian knight and champion of Oleron defeated by Kherion in 1028.

name: Lanvaux Moors
description: Moors.

name: Lapidary
description: An 11th-century text by Bishop Marbode of Rennes on the magical use of gems.

name: Lapis Minor
description: A Level 20 Alteration Reagent creating a reddish waxy stone whose touch purifies a precious metal from its alloy; called the Lesser Stone, distinct from the sought-after Greater Stone.

name: Lapiths
description: Ancient people of Thessaly who fought the original centaurs.

name: Laplander Nightwalkers
description: Nightwalker tradition whose members die if their insensate bodies are simply touched.

name: Laplander Shamans
description: Shamans who battle in phantastic form, suffering fatigue; the true origin of certamen.

name: Laquerius
description: The certamen School of the Noose, whose practitioners bind the opponent's ritual working and impose lasting Defense penalties.

name: Lares Lore
description: An Ability used by Vestals to interact with lares (household spirits, also called penates), domestic faeries of the home and community.

name: Large Wolf
description: A wolf up to twice normal weight, usually the leading male of a pack.

name: Large-field Farming
description: Farming system using about half of Mythic Europe's agricultural land, suited only to heavy soils, found in central England and near large French and German cities.

name: Largen of Quaesitor
description: Associate Quaesitor member of Magvillus who avoids its politics.

name: Largs
description: Site of the battle of 1263.

name: Larinda
description: A young Ex Miscellanea maga of Dankmar (age 20), daughter and filia of Jiphella, with a sunny disposition and affinities for Animal, Herbam, Aquam, and Auram.

name: Larus Egg-Thief
description: Clan Chief of Clan Maruhs, a wandering magus with a skua (seabird) heartbeast who haunts the coasts of western Europe.

name: Lasa Vegoia the Matron
description: Water nymph Daimon who taught the Etruscans theurgy and divination and can teach theurgy.

name: Lash of the Chastened Servant
description: PeVi 15 removing 5 Might from a demon; incurs suspicion of diabolism.

name: Last Flight of the Phoenix
description: A CrIg 50 spell in which the caster immolates himself in a white-hot blast doing +45 damage; an early version was found in Flambeau's own lab notes, used by magi with Greater Immunity to fire.

name: Last Italian Faerie Forest
description: The last great Faerie forest of the Roman Tribunal, mainly on Sicily, with shifting borders and many regiones.

name: Lasting Consequences of Serious Damage
description: Option where Incapacitating Wounds may leave a Minor Flaw.

name: Late Bloomer
description: Minor Child Flaw: treated as one age category lower on the Aging Chart.

name: Latent Mystical Ability
description: Virtue appearing in character statistics or rules in this text.

name: Lateran Palace
description: Usual residence of the Pope.

name: Latin Kingdom of Jerusalem
description: Crusader kingdom established on Christmas Day 1100.

name: Latin Quarter
description: The left-bank Paris district of jumbled houses where masters and students live, a lawless place of books, learning, drinking, and gambling.

name: Latin conquerors
description: Victors of the siege of Constantinople who weakly rule Bear Island.

name: Latins
description: Latin invaders occupying Constantinople and the Theban Tribunal.

name: Lauds
description: Canonical hour of the Divine Office: Service at 1 am (or dawn in summer) after which monks return to bed.

name: Laughter of Mentem Vis
description: Vis whose laughter fills listeners with joy.

name: Laurens
description: Dwarf king who rules the Rosegarten regio and cursed his roses to appear as stone.

name: Laval
description: Town whose mayor Pugnatis controlled.

name: Lavinia
description: Archmaga and Quaesitor of House Guernicus, an Intellego specialist skilled in wards and necromancy, who calls the War Tribunal at Durenmar and co-leads the crusade.

name: Law of Contagion
description: Magical principle transferring the Stag of Virtue's fever immunity to those who eat its flesh.

name: Law of Names
description: A magical principle by which knowing a ghost's full name allows it to be summoned, as used in the Incantation of Summoning the Dead.

name: Law of Sympathy
description: Magical principle by which the Cockerel of Virtue's cry terrifies spirits of darkness.

name: Lawidh
description: Cherub who tests the faithful.

name: Laws of Edward the Confessor
description: 12th-century English laws under which the King owns all Jews and their property, relevant to a Minority Boon covenant in England.

name: Laws of Hospitality
description: The Rhine Peripheral Code rules, derived from German guest-laws, governing the duties of guests and hosts and entitling a magus to request hospitality at any legal covenant for a vis fee.

name: Laylat al-Bara'a
description: Night when God approaches Earth to forgive sins.

name: Le Conquet
description: Town where Fudarus formed an artificer guild.

name: Le Havre
description: Port from which the Ship of the Dead departs.

name: Le Mans
description: Capital of Maine with the Cathedral of St. Julien and a pagan fertility menhir.

name: Le Mans Menhir
description: Pinkish menhir by Le Mans cathedral, former fertility cult center whose sacrificial blood yields Creo vis.

name: Le Puy
description: Town from which the Capuchonnes spread.

name: Le Puy-Notre-Dame
description: Pilgrim church housing the Girdle of the Virgin.

name: Le Puy-St-Front
description: Town rival to Le Cité.

name: Lead Mania
description: Silver Lady power similar to Blessing of Childlike Bliss.

name: Lead curse tablets
description: Tablets thrown into the waters.

name: Leader of the Pack
description: Black Dog power making canines fight as a trained group at +2.

name: Leap of the Shadows
description: Evocation/Portage 20 rite moving a seen target instantly into shadows.

name: Learn (Ability) From Mistakes
description: A Minor, General Virtue granting experience points in a chosen Ability the first time per session the character botches or narrowly fails a roll.

name: Learn Chirurgy from Mistakes
description: A Virtue commonly taken by empirici allowing them to learn the Chirurgy Ability from their failures.

name: Leather Ripper
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue granting the power to destroy a group of leather objects, as a PeAn(He) 30 effect.

name: Leaving the Crypt
description: Necropolis ghost power to physically affect the living for a Diameter.

name: Lecanomancy
description: Divinatory method using bowls of fluid, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Leccacorvo
description: The Genoese bank cited as a legendary money/banking income example.

name: Lech
description: One of the three legendary founding brothers of the Slavic peoples, who continued on to settle in Poland.

name: Lechfeld
description: Battle site in 955.

name: Lectio
description: Ability appearing in character statistics in this text.

name: Lector
description: Minor order whose members receive a codex of lessons and now have ceremonial duties.

name: Leczyca
description: A covenant established in Poland in 1052 by refugees from Grand Silesia to reinforce the New Slavonic Tribunal's authority over the Slavic lands.

name: Leda
description: Julia's twin sister, abducted by faeries at age five.

name: Ledea
description: Merinita maga who started a healing cult around an Airy Spirit's spring, hoping to convert it to Faerie.

name: Left Bank of Paris
description: The intellectual and scholarly district of Paris, center of Roman Lutetia.

name: Legates
description: Personal representatives of the pope sent throughout Europe.

name: Legati a latere
description: Highest grade of papal legate, usually cardinals, with the widest powers including decisions binding even the pope.

name: Legati nati
description: Historic title held by some archbishops (vicarii apostolici) that by 1220 carries no real power.

name: Legatus
description: Field leader of House Tremere in war and the Primus's heir.

name: Legends of Brittany
description: Summa on Faerie Lore by Celeres of Breton Arthurian tales.

name: Legio IX Hispana
description: Roman legion that marched north in 118 and vanished; ghost sightings are reported.

name: Legion Lore
description: Ability referenced as used or valued by Tremere magi or creatures.

name: Legionaries
description: Roman soldiers garrisoned at the temple town.

name: Legionary ghost
description: Ghost of a fallen Roman legionary, Magic Might 10 (Mentem).

name: Leiden papyri
description: Ancient papyri containing a list of 37 substances and plants with their mystical names.

name: Leinster
description: Irish region where the gallowglaigh fought.

name: Leir
description: Son of Bladud.

name: Lemnos
description: The island where Hephaestus settled and took twelve forge-companions; site of a Forge of Hephaestus, a Verditius covenant (Ingasia), and an all-Verditius community.

name: Lend Senses
description: Famulus Power lending its hearing or sight to one it touches; broken by displays of religious sentiment.

name: Lens of Glimpsing Spirits
description: InIm(Me) 34 constant-effect crystal lens in a brass ring that reveals invisible spirits.

name: Leo III
description: The Byzantine Emperor who in 729 ordered the destruction of images of Christ and the saints and forbade crosses in worship, prompting the formation of the League of Iconophiles.

name: Leodontina
description: Filia of Tremere who became unhinged before Tribunal and was ostracized; most of her filii were killed in the ensuing Hunt.

name: Leon of Armenia
description: Armenian ruler who declared war on the Templars in 1211.

name: Leonardo Fibonacci of Pisa
description: A reclusive Pisan mathematical genius (Int +4, Com +5) who discovered the golden section / Fibonacci sequence and wrote the tractatus Liber abbaci; his work can aid Aristotelian Magic Theory and Herbam research.

name: Leopold of Austria
description: Leader of the Fifth Crusade.

name: Leprosy (Flaw)
description: A Major Flaw gained by the victim of the leprosy disease, imposing a Living Condition penalty and reputation effects.

name: Les Halles
description: The great central market of Paris, covered by Philip II in 1183.

name: Les Trois Pignons
description: Barren sandstone massif in western Fontainebleau housing Lapis Crudus.

name: Lesser Enchantment Imaginem Vis
description: Truffle-shaped Imaginem vis whose shavings flavor food, giving a host +3 to influence guests.

name: Lesser Enchantment Rego Animal Vis
description: Truffle-shaped Rego vis whose scent compels wild boars and pigs to try to devour it, driving them berserk.

name: Lesser Enchantment Vis
description: Extraordinary vis emulating a lesser enchantment, usually level 30 or lower, not consumed by use.

name: Lesser Expansion
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is enlarged with some specialized equipment (+1 General Quality, +2 Upkeep, 1 Specialization point).

name: Lesser Feature
description: A Minor laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab features a unique structure aiding certain lab work, granting +1 Aesthetics and 1 Specialization point.

name: Lesser Focus
description: A Minor laboratory Structure Flaw: an existing Lesser Feature is the central focus of the lab, enhancing it but hindering unrelated activities.

name: Lesser Guardian
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Virtue: a supernatural creature (less than Might 20) not the owner's familiar resides in and protects the lab (+1 Safety).

name: Lesser Horde
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Virtue: a small group of semi-intelligent creatures helps in the lab (+1 General Quality, +1 Upkeep, +1 Safety, +1 Aesthetics).

name: Lesser Illusion
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: one apparent merit of the lab is merely an illusion; a balancing Minor Virtue is taken but its effects are negated.

name: Lesser Magic Power
description: Virtue granted by the Rowan of Virtue amulet, equivalent to a Rego Vim ward.

name: Lesser Magical Power
description: A Virtue or Magic Quality named among the traits of magical animals or dragons in this text.

name: Lesser Nymph
description: Weak dancing nymph with Might 10.

name: Lesser Secundus
description: House Jerbiton officer who must remain at Valnastium.

name: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell
description: Purity Cursing effect (Level 85) laying utter waste to everything within a boundary.

name: Let the Bonfire Burn
description: Flame Dancer power setting fire to a slightly inflammable target.

name: Letter of Authority
description: Document granted by a Quaesitor to non-Quaesitors giving them investigation immunity and the right to demand cooperation.

name: Letter of Credit
description: Templar banking instrument allowing pilgrims to deposit wealth and retrieve it elsewhere.

name: Leucrota
description: A mythical beast whose tongue provides a Shape and Material bonus of +6 to mimicking human voices.

name: Levant Lore
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Lewis
description: Hebridean island with large stone circles.

name: Leywrite
description: Theoretical adultery tax charged on a woman who made herself unmarriageable by losing her virginity.

name: Liban
description: Irish woman changed into a mermaid by Danu who lived 300 years, was baptised, and entered Heaven as a Holy Virgin.

name: Liber Regularum
description: Civil and Canon Law summa (Quality 10, Level 3) by St. Victricius.

name: Liber abbaci
description: Leonardo of Pisa's book (1202), a Quality 14 tractatus on Artes Liberales (arithmetic) covering interest, square roots, alloy percentages, and the golden section; reading it aids Herbam research and Aristotelian Magic Theory.

name: Liber de Lumine
description: A Tractatus on Ignem (Quality 11) by Elaine concentrating on light as an aspect of the Form of Ignem.

name: Liberate the Sinful
description: Domination power permanently removing a sinful Personality Trait.

name: Libra
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Library Tower
description: Oldest structure of Confluensis with council chamber, library and Mercere Portal.

name: Library of Alexandria
description: Destroyed by Caesar in parable.

name: Library of Apollodorus
description: A work summarizing the Golden Fleece legend.

name: Library of Durenmar
description: Enchanted to prevent Memory Palace of the Sage being performed within.

name: Libuse
description: The Gifted granddaughter of Czech who had a great vision at Vysehrad Rock foretelling her husband Premysl, founder of Bohemia's ruling dynasty.

name: Libya
description: Land whose queen became Lamia.

name: Liddesdale
description: Valley in the Scottish Borders with a Malevolent Infernal aura 3 tarnished with Fear.

name: Liddeswater
description: Small river running through Liddesdale.

name: Liege
description: A prince-bishopric and market city where the River Legia joins the Meuse, grown from the martyrdom site of St. Lambert; its most famous bishop was Notger.

name: Lien
description: Loan in which the lender receives the use of a borrower's vis source until repaid.

name: Life Linked Folk Witch Magic
description: Virtue possessed by Mistress Greta.

name: Life of Saint Guthlac
description: Text quoted about demons attacking Saint Guthlac.

name: Life-Boost
description: Virtue requiring expenditure of Fatigue; a Daimon expends Might instead.

name: Life-Linked Art
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue letting an artist wound himself while working to increase artwork's Aesthetic Quality, making the piece a permanent Arcane Connection.

name: Life-Linked Folk Witch Magic
description: Major Supernatural Virtue letting a folk witch spend Fatigue levels to boost her Casting Total by 5 each.

name: Lift the Unfair Curse
description: General-level TaCu spell that removes a curse if the total meets double the curse's level (or its level if the caster cast it).

name: Ligature
description: A small charm of parchment, stones, or herbs worn around the neck containing an Arcane or Sympathetic Connection, employing natural principles to grant a bonus to a single die roll.

name: Light Shaft of the Night
description: A Rego Ignem spell (Level 20) that collects moonbeams and starlight into a controllable vertical shaft of soft silvery light, castable only under the night sky.

name: Lightless
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab is totally dark and its contents cannot be seen, requiring other means of spatial perception (-1 Upkeep, +1 Warping).

name: Lila
description: Henri's only child, a daughter whose marriage to a manipulable husband is vital to Nidi's welfare.

name: Lilac Grove of Nidi
description: A possibly druidic oak grove in Henri's chase overgrown with perpetually flowering lilacs that yield Herbam vis; Nidi's key vis source.

name: Lille
description: Seat of the Counts of Flanders and a cloth fair town.

name: Limbo
description: Destination of unbaptized pagans.

name: Limbo of Infants
description: Part of Hell holding those who die in original sin alone, without personal mortal sin.

name: Limbo of the Fathers
description: Part of Hell where the souls of the just who died before Christ awaited Heaven; emptied by the Harrowing of Hell.

name: Limes
description: A line of defensive forts reinforced by magic built by the Roman legions under Mercurian guidance, delineating the empire's northern extent and first fracturing the Hercynian Forest.

name: Limit (Condition) Duration
description: A gruagach Duration required for all Blessing and Curse spells, lasting until a condition that lifts the spell is fulfilled; easier-to-lift limits are cheaper.

name: Limited Gestures
description: Minor Inferiority limiting manipulation to vague gestures.

name: Limited Movement
description: Minor Inferiority restricting travel to short distances.

name: Limited Speech
description: Minor Inferiority preventing intelligible speech.

name: Lindisfarne Priory
description: Priory on Holy Island famed for illuminated scriptures; its library holds the Vitae of Saint Cuthbert and Bede's works.

name: Lindworm
description: Dragon near Klagenfurt with a taste for virgins, slain by Herakles.

name: Line Range
description: New Hermetic Geometry Range equivalent to Sight not requiring the target be seen, needing a geometry calculation.

name: Line of Muj
description: A mythic lineage from the Balkans whose ancestor made a pact with a magical guardian spirit, blessing his descendants with great strength and power over storms; surviving members live in the Transylvanian Tribunal and belong to House Tremere.

name: Lineage of Abydaros
description: Mystery lineage to which Carmine belongs.

name: Lineage of Carolinus
description: Mystery lineage of which Vortimer is a senior member.

name: Lineage of Hercynius
description: A Bonisagus lineage descended from Hercynius, the penultimate apprentice of Bonisagus, which founded Waldherz to pursue primal forest magic and was largely destroyed in the Schism War.

name: Lineage of Irmele
description: A line of wandering, weather-working magi within House Bonisagus founded by Irmele filia Trianoma, prominent among the peregrinatores and the Linden Gild.

name: Lineus
description: Example magus who casts a Line Range spell at Centrus beyond a wall.

name: Lingering Injury
description: A Minor General Flaw in which an old injury won't heal, penalizing physical rolls and worsening with age.

name: Linosa
description: Small island southwest of Sicily.

name: Lion
description: Legendary fierce beast said by Pliny to have lived in Greece; will not attack a prostrate man.

name: Lion Mane Collar
description: Collar woven from a Lion of Virtue's mane that duplicates Mastering the Unruly Beast.

name: Lion of the North
description: An Ars Magica sourcebook describing Pralix's war against Dav'nalleous, referenced in-text.

name: Lise
description: A Spirit Votary and Warped priestess of the Dark Mother, aged 129, who seeks revenge against the Church after mistreatment by a priest.

name: Lisieux
description: County granted to Rollo.

name: Lismore
description: See created in 1190, and Isle of Lismore.

name: Lists
description: Hoardings marking starting points and site of jousting.

name: Literatus Manor House
description: New three-story manor southwest of Bologna housing Literatus since 1180.

name: Literatus Student
description: Magus vocation (Jerbiton) trained at Literatus and the University of Bologna.

name: Lithe
description: Virtue appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Lithuania
description: Baltic region where Nicolai grew up in a pagan village destroyed by Christian knights.

name: Little Saint Bernard Pass
description: Important pass with a second Saint Bernard house.

name: Little William
description: A Redcap over six feet tall and heavily built who obtained a longevity potion; the only Redcap to wear armor (enchanted lighter chainmail) and a skilled fighter.

name: Liturgical Hours
description: Daily offices observed by monks, hermits and some laity.

name: Liturgy
description: The church service in Latin, with the priest facing east before the altar.

name: Liver Sea
description: Sailors' name for coagulated waters in the Magic Realm that halt ships.

name: Lives of the Fathers
description: Church Lore tractatus by Gregory of Tours.

name: Living
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab's structure is alive, e.g. inside a faerie tree or the belly of a slumbering beast (-2 Safety, +2 Warping).

name: Living Ghosts
description: Wizards who bind their own spirit to a location, becoming ghost-like while retaining will and magic.

name: Living Quarters
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab contains furniture so the owner can live and sleep in it, a small benefit to lab work but bad for health.

name: Llanthony Priory
description: Welsh priory whose orchard extends over twelve acres.

name: Llewellyn
description: The last primus of House Diedne, last seen at Bryn-Celli-Ddu, whose parting words (Llewellyn's Curse) are carved into the passage wall there.

name: Llewellyn's Curse
description: The carved parting words of Llewellyn, last primus of House Diedne, vowing that the House will last and return to haunt its enemies as long as nature endures.

name: Llewelyn
description: The last primus of House Díedne, whose name fueled magi's belief that Gruffyd ap Llewelyn was a returned Díedne magus.

name: Llywelyn
description: The prince of Wales who nominally acknowledges Henry as lord but controls south Wales and wages low-level war on the Anglo-Norman Marcher barons.

name: Llywelyn ab Iorwerth
description: Prince of Gwynedd since 1194, a great warrior and politician who has come nearer than anyone since the Romans to unifying Wales.

name: Lo'relyn
description: One of the Three Sisters.

name: Loamwalkers
description: Tree-spirits born in or able to take human form who represent the interests of forests in the mundane world.

name: Local Saint
description: Saints of Divine Might 25 venerated by a town or two.

name: Location
description: Familiar power to know where the master is.

name: Loch Cuan
description: Huge sea loch in Ulster (Strangford Loch) with legendary 365 islands; an alternative Farne location.

name: Loch Dee
description: Lake in Scotland inhabited by Men of the Lake.

name: Loch Leglean (place)
description: Pralix's winter camp and hidden town where tribunal meetings occur every seven years.

name: Loch Ness
description: Loch whose vis is said to block scrying spells.

name: Loch Oadh
description: Loch where Damhan-allaidh ambushed Pralix in 814.

name: Loch Ochy
description: Site of Pralix's battle with Damhan-allaidh in 815.

name: Lochoch of Fox Lungs
description: A Theriac of Level 20, Potency Strong, a syrupy medicine made from boiled honey that cures phthisis, a Major phlegmatic disease, over a month.

name: Loci
description: Locations within a memory palace, five per room, each holding a complex piece of information.

name: Locksmiths' Guild
description: The guild of locksmiths, which historically did not develop until the late 14th and early 15th centuries; in the 13th century locks are made by specialist smiths.

name: Locmariaquer
description: Megaliths.

name: Locronan
description: Pilgrimage site.

name: Locus of the Literatus
description: CrIm 20 Ritual that draws the caster's location as a vestige in a book, producing a map for travel in the Magic Realm.

name: Lofanneth Wolf-Brother
description: Faerie captive of Arduinna and donor who knows where the Stone Drum is hidden.

name: Logi
description: Norse kosmokrator giant embodying devastating wild fire, of Ymir's first hostile brood.

name: Lohengrin
description: The golden-haired knight drawn by a swan who defeated Telramund and wedded Elsa on condition she never ask his name; he departed when she finally did. His legend forms part of Wolfram von Eschenbach's Parzival.

name: Loki
description: The multi-faceted and often malevolent Norse god from whom some Ex Miscellanea claim the Nemthengacha tradition descends.

name: Lombard Warrior
description: Grog vocation: a mercenary from Lombardy serving a covenant's magi.

name: Lombardy Lore
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: London Street
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city.

name: Long Ax
description: Light Highland ax with three-foot haft, often used as a walking stick.

name: Long Meg and Her Daughters
description: A roughly hundred-meter stone circle in the Lake District whose stones cannot be reliably counted and are thought to be the petrified bodies of a witch and her daughters; Long Meg is a sandstone pillar that bleeds if chipped.

name: Long Rock
description: Menhir.

name: Long Sword
description: Expensive single weapon with variations such as the spatha and Mongol saber.

name: Long Winded
description: A Virtue possessed by all Rottweiler grogs.

name: Longbow
description: Late bow historically confined to Wales, signature English weapon after 1283.

name: Longevity
description: Aging reduction via potions.

name: Longevity Project
description: Research project at Sinews of Knowledge founded by Sancia filia Sabrina to improve longevity potions, now led by Philomena.

name: Longevity Specialists
description: Group listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Longevity specialist
description: Magus who makes longevity potions for others.

name: Longinus
description: Roman soldier who pierced Christ's side with a spear.

name: Longstone
description: Outer island with Magic aura 3 favored by magical seabirds; has a fish-shaped rock that turns jumpers into fish; best site for a covenant.

name: Look at Me
description: A Creo Mentem spell that creates a thought in a target's imagination, causing him to look directly at the caster and make eye contact.

name: Looking Glass of Intellego Vis
description: Glass of vis letting one see through a wall into a room.

name: Loose Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw that halves the magus's Advancement Total whenever he tries to Master spells.

name: Lord Corvinius
description: Example lord.

name: Lord Cuthbert
description: Example noble feuding with a magus.

name: Lord Fitz-Hubert
description: Norman neighbor of Horsingas.

name: Lord Goulis's Armor
description: Enchanted armor gifted by his patron demon, giving Protection 16 and boosting his Strength, Dexterity and Quickness; vanishes if he dies.

name: Lord Goulis's Demon Dogs
description: Demonic hounds (Might 8) accompanying Lord Goulis, with Howls of Confusion.

name: Lord Guigues of Dauphiné
description: A noble who commissioned Hephaestion to build a mechanized tin magpie automaton for his bedchamber.

name: Lord Theobald
description: Example lord whose land ownership has a vestige in the Magic Realm.

name: Lord of Imaginem
description: Manannan's Focus Power allowing any non-ritual Imaginem effect of level 40 or below.

name: Lord of Summer
description: Magic being who holds the Lady of Winter captive in his forest cosm castle.

name: Lords of Montverte
description: Noble family descended from Haland, dominated by the magi of Montverte.

name: Lords of the Passions
aliases: Lords and Ladies of The Passions
description: First degree of the Volshebnii Mechtateli, those who know the Minor Virtue Dream Magic.

name: Lordship of Léon
description: Northwestern extremity.

name: Lordship of Penthièvre
description: Barony on the central north coast.

name: Lore-master
description: A covenfolk template scholar versed in many Lore Abilities including Arcane Lores such as Dominion, Faerie, Infernal, Magic, and Order of Hermes Lore.

name: Lorelei
description: A nymph that haunts the Rhine and sings men to their doom.

name: Lorica Hamata
description: Roman mail haubergeon.

name: Lorica Segmentata
description: Imperial Roman lamellar cuirass.

name: Lorris
description: A small town in France first granted customary rights by King Louis VI, later confirmed by Louis VII in 1155, whose generous customs included freeman status after a year and a day.

name: Loss of Familiar
description: Punishment in which the cords binding magus and familiar are cut, a painful and emotionally scarring experience.

name: Loss of an Apprentice
description: Punishment requiring the convicted magus to surrender his apprentice immediately to a new master.

name: Lost Children
description: Abandoned children left in Magic auras who become magical, unaging beings appearing aged five to 15.

name: Lost in the Memory
description: A Muto Mentem spell that fills the target's mind with memory, causing him to relive past scenes while neglecting all but basic urges.

name: Lothair
description: King inheriting his father's crown in 954.

name: Lothair II
description: King of Lotharingia who died without heir in 869.

name: Lotharingian Movement
description: Group of covenants seeking to secede from Normandy and the Rhine to reform the Lotharingian Tribunal.

name: Loudéac
description: Market town.

name: Lough Dearg
description: A red-tinged lake ('red lake') in northwest Ireland in Tír Chonaill with forty-six islands, site of the Purgatory of Saint Patrick.

name: Lough Neagh
description: Lake in Ulster used as a reference point for the Hibernian variant of the Cursewood.

name: Louis I the Pious
description: Frankish king, son of Charlemagne, who established Brittany as a duchy.

name: Louis III
description: King to whom Adela was accused of being court wizard.

name: Louis IV
description: King of the Franks from 936.

name: Louis V
description: 'The Indolent', king in 986.

name: Louis VIII
description: King of France from 1223.

name: Louis the German
description: King of East Francia who divided Lotharingia at Meersen.

name: Louis the Pious
description: Ninth-century ruler during whose reign high magic was in vogue.

name: Lousy Ingredients
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is supplied with dirty, impure, or poor-quality ingredients (-1 General Quality, -1 Upkeep).

name: Love of God
description: Personality Trait possessed at +5 by all angels.

name: Love's Unfaithful Witness
description: Intellego Terram level 35 spell to question jewelry about its wearer's activities, its personality shaped by its largest gemstone.

name: Low Ceiling
description: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the ceiling is below the requisite ten feet, hampering some magical activities (-1 General Quality, -1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Low Countries
description: Region producing good draught horses.

name: Low Crimes
description: All offenses other than high crimes, which cannot result in a Wizard's March.

name: Low German
description: Living Language with Frisian and Flemish dialects.

name: Lowland City Militiaman
description: Grog template: a woodworker from a Lowland city trained to wield the spear.

name: Lowland Merchant
description: Companion template: a calculating, obese Lowland merchant who secretly acts as a front for magi.

name: Loyalty
description: Virtue appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Loyalty (Covenants rules)
description: The loyalty mechanic from Covenants used to track household loyalty; suited to magi organizations but less so to lesser nobles and their peasants.

name: Lucan
description: Author of the Pharsalia describing Erictho.

name: Lucas
description: A magus of the Waddenzee covenant whom Imanitos got on well with during his stay there.

name: Lucas von Beck
description: An aggressive Follower of Flambeau at Waddenzee (age 45), son of a German altgraf and expert in Perdo magics who has begun studying necromancy using bodies from his pirate raids.

name: Lucent Faeries
description: Moon faeries of great interest to Alpine magi.

name: Lucidia of Flambeau
description: A young Flambeau maga, one of the newly arrived members of Libellus.

name: Lucius
description: A sodalis who vanished for three days last solstice, an example of suspicious behavior.

name: Lucius of Flambeau
description: Founder of the Seventh Wave cult who self-Initiates into Affinity with Art (Aquam).

name: Lucy
description: The wife of the Redcap Perceval, living at Mercer House with their children; she believes their daughter Maud has the Gift.

name: Luddites
description: Movement destroying textile factories; proto-Luddites might harass covenants.

name: Lugdunum
description: Roman capital, now Lyon in the Provençal Tribunal.

name: Lugra
description: Spirits of the hardships of life, released from Pandora's jar.

name: Luke of Evreux
description: Bishop of Evreux elected 1203, who historically dies in 1220.

name: Luke of Jerbiton
description: Member of Vardian's Tomb.

name: Lulach the Unready
description: Adopted son of MacBeth.

name: Lumen's ring
description: A ring possessed by Lumen of Jerbiton that makes her appear as a man, allowing her to travel to monasteries in disguise.

name: Luna of Bjornaer
description: Young Sicilian-born maga of Nidi with a rat heartbeast, originally trained in the Beast Master tradition of Ex Miscellanea; heir-designate of Micropedus.

name: Lunchtime in the Vis Stores
description: Story seed about a dormant earth elemental consuming a covenant's Terram vis.

name: Lund
description: Scandinavian archdiocese.

name: Luneburg
description: A wealthy city built on extensive salt mines, where subsidence causes houses to tilt over rickety streets.

name: Lungs of Water and Death
description: Spell cited as the design precedent for Rack of Thorns.

name: Lupellis
description: The most junior grade of the Luperci. It requires Organization Lore: Luperci 1, and Initiates gain the Skinchanger Virtue and the Dark Secret Flaw.

name: Lurching Heart
description: Fachan power causing hearts of viewers to flutter unless a Brave roll succeeds.

name: Lusignan family
description: Noble family ruling Cyprus and claiming the throne of Jerusalem, in conflict with the Templars.

name: Lust
description: One of the capital vices, opposed by a holy temper.

name: Lust for Life
description: A Major Curse (Creo Mentem effect) making the victim obsessed with sensual pleasure, requiring rolls to do anything besides follow compulsions.

name: Lutetia
description: Roman town that preceded Paris, centered on the left bank.

name: Lutin
description: Servile faerie goblins of Normandy (Faerie Might 5 Aquam) that clean households for offerings and dread a 'goblin duke of Normandy'.

name: Lux Draconis
description: An undistinguished covenant founded in 915 in the Pennines; barely clinging to survival, it died out by 1100 and Blackthorn claimed its property.

name: Luzabel
description: Author of The Piercing Tongue.

name: Lyb-craeft
description: Magical healing and surgery practised by lybmen (faerie doctors).

name: Lymer
description: Heavy-jowled scent hound related to the bloodhound, trained to track silently.

name: Lymphae
description: Water elementals (the 'pure waters') rarefied only from naturally occurring liquids; the best learners among elementals, they collect and mix substances and attack by pulling foes down to smother them.

name: Lyncuriam
description: A semi-precious flame-colored stone formed from the hardened urine of the Lynx of Virtue.

name: Lyndsay
description: Chief equerry of the Covenant Where Journeys End and Miklos's true love.

name: Lynx of Virtue
description: A keen-sighted lynx whose urine hardens into the flame-colored stone lyncuriam.

name: Lyon
description: City of Peter Waldo; St Guinefort is venerated in a diocese there.

name: Lyons
description: Site of councils 1245 and 1274.

name: Lyre
description: Chartered village outside an abbey in Normandy.

name: Lysette
description: Caprican's wife, the faerie queen.

name: Lystra
description: City visited by the apostles in Acts 14.

name: Ma'asei-Bereshit
description: School of philosophy seeking the foundations of creation, based on the Sefer Yetzirah.

name: Mabon
description: Sabbat held at the Autumn Equinox.

name: Mac Peadars
description: Clan in long, deadly feud with a chief's clan in a story idea.

name: Mac Williams
description: Rebellious descendants of King Duncan who repeatedly rose against the Canmore kings until crushed in 1230.

name: MacBeth the Good
description: Scottish king defeated by Malcolm Big-Head.

name: Mace
description: Crushing single weapon.

name: Mace Attack
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Mace and Chain
description: Early medieval crushing single weapon.

name: Macedonia
description: Region raided by Asen.

name: Machaoi Island
description: Island in Loch Cuan home to Saint Machaoi; its monastery was destroyed in a battle between Pralix and Diedne in 806.

name: Machonon
description: The Fourth Heaven, containing the City of Christ and heavenly Jerusalem, ruled by Michael.

name: Mackerel Sky
description: Cat power, a version of Sailor's Foretaste of the Morrow.

name: Macrocosm
description: A cosm embodying one aspect of a greater thing, a world greater than its parts.

name: Madhhab
description: School of Islamic law.

name: Madrasah
description: An Islamic higher-education school attached to a mosque and run by religious leaders, privately endowed and supported by student tuition.

name: Madrid
description: Harco has a Portal to a tower north of it.

name: Maenads
description: Women devoted to Dionysus who tore Orpheus limb from limb in a wild rampage.

name: Magestone
description: Portable tether rumored made by Verditius; Durenmar and a Rhine covenant hold some.

name: Maghera
description: Site on the Circuit of Saint Patrick.

name: Magi Bonisagi
description: The research branch of House Bonisagus, followers of Bonisagus.

name: Magians
description: The original priestly caste of Persia, of which the Median tribe of Magians were the true blood ancestors granting the Magian Lineage Virtue.

name: Magic Archipelago
description: Theory of the Magic Realm as a physical chain of islands (insulae) separated by the waters of the Twilight Void.

name: Magic Character Creation
description: Rules in Realms of Power: Magic for designing magic animals, humans, spirits and things.

name: Magic Hound
description: Sample magic animal character guide (Might 0-10 Animal) with the Inexorable Hunter power.

name: Magic Humans
description: Humans or human-form beings affected by the realm of Magic: giants, Spirit Votaries, Magic Kin, and the transformed.

name: Magic Inferiority
description: Detrimental trait of magic characters that grants extra Magic Qualities.

name: Magic Item (Virtue)
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: a magic item is installed in the lab, granting Virtues, Flaws, or Specialization changes; treated as Minor if very large.

name: Magic Item Merchant
description: Magus vocation (Verditius) from Verdi who sells magic items to nobles.

name: Magic Monster
description: Flaw referenced in this text.

name: Magic Quality
description: Beneficial trait of magic characters bought with Might; can be gained by Transformation.

name: Magic Realm Magic
description: Extensions to Hermetic magic enabling manipulation of vestiges, boundaries and travel in the Magic Realm, gained via a Minor Breakthrough.

name: Magic Susceptibility
description: Flaw possessed by Calum Mac Lachlan.

name: Magic Theory roll
description: Library trap mechanic: a magus following uncorrected deliberate-error lab notes who fails an Intelligence + Magic Theory roll against Ease Factor 12 rolls as if he botched an experiment.

name: Magic as Technology
description: Chapter Four proposal recasting magi as inventors and enchantments as technology.

name: Magic-Taming
description: Mutantes view of 'taming' wild magic, giving it direction and binding it to service.

name: Magical Animal Companions
description: Magical animals for which the pet statistics can serve as templates.

name: Magical Beast
description: A creature of magic with Magic Might that can be created at high levels of Creo Animal, requiring requisites for its powers and a Vim requisite for its magical nature.

name: Magical Disaster
description: An overwhelming eruption of Magic that can transport wielders, objects or whole regions into the Magic Realm.

name: Magical Fascination
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character is intensely interested in supernatural and magical phenomena to the exclusion of other motivations.

name: Magical Fish of St. Corentine
description: Regenerating fish with Divine Might 2 that fed St. Corentine.

name: Magical Fortitude Charm Against Lightning
description: TuMa 5 charm adding +8 Soak vs magical lightning.

name: Magical Gloves and Sword of Degare
description: Gloves and broken-pointed sword left by Degare's faerie father.

name: Magical Heating
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: heating is provided magically, functioning as Superior or Excessive Heating without space and Upkeep cost.

name: Magical Investigation Specialist
description: Guernicus magi called in to support investigations with specialist magic, often endorsing testimony.

name: Magical Lighting
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: lighting is provided magically, functioning as Superior or Excessive Lighting without space and Upkeep cost.

name: Magical Lineages of Cats
description: Three families of cats tracing descent to the familiars of the Founders or their earliest apprentices, each with its own oral history and culture.

name: Magical Meditation (Quality)
description: Major Quality giving the Supernatural Ability Magical Meditation at 1.

name: Magical Oven
description: A Creo Ignem 20 enchanted device shaped as an iron box encased in fire-brick whose interior becomes red-hot on command to cook food.

name: Magical Resistance
description: Virtue unavailable to gruagachan.

name: Magical Seabirds
description: Magic Animal birds arriving at the Farnes from March, whose overwintering location is unknown.

name: Magical Sensitivity
description: Ability appearing in character or creature statistics in this text.

name: Magical Shepherd's Pipes
description: Pipes played by the tityroi.

name: Magical Silver
description: Magically created silver, which Redcaps refuse and which the Stonehenge Tribunal limited after it caused inflation.

name: Magical Teasel
description: Pixie-grown teasel giving +2 to thread-crafting and containing Herbam vis.

name: Magical Technology
description: The use of Hermetic enchantments as technology to transform Mythic Europe.

name: Magical Tether
description: Mystical link that anchors an aura; created by rituals of level 45+, age of structures, or natural beauty.

name: Magical Wolf
description: A magical creature (Magic Might 20, Animal) resembling a slightly large gray wolf that watches over all wolves in its range, can split into a pack of duplicates, and instantly slay any wolf it strikes.

name: Magical constructs
description: Non-human servants at Ungulus, including human-form constructs, self-working animated brooms, knives and pans, warning bells, and invisible bound spirits serving as guards and messengers.

name: Magical theurgy
description: Secret lore by which each manifestation of a spirit is called an Aspect.

name: Magician's Boost
description: SuMa general charm increasing a just-cast charm by 5 levels.

name: Magician's Desire Denied
description: Nain power making objects appear as vis.

name: Magician's Second Wind
description: SuMa general charm increasing a charm's Duration (or Range/Target) by one.

name: Magister et Artibus
description: A Major Social Virtue (university master of arts) listed as a high-Resistance social status on the Resistance of Agents Table.

name: Magistrate Bayne
description: Author of Civitas Orleans.

name: Magistrate's Court
description: Orleans court where Jean the Wise uses Dowsing to find stolen property.

name: Magitech
description: Anachronistic modern-style technology realized through magic.

name: Magnantrum
description: Covenant founded around 1111 in a cave under Salisbury Plain; disintegrated in 1187 due to internal disputes.

name: Magnate
description: Great noble with a sphere of influence, retinue, tenants, and affinity.

name: Magnitude
description: One-fifth of a magical effect's level, the Hermetic in-character measure of power.

name: Magnus Gizurarson
description: Bishop of Skalholt whose son is slain in the killings; he leads a delegation to Rome petitioning the Pope against the Order of Hermes and chairs the settlement.

name: Magnus the Quaesitor
description: A Quaesitor investigating a Hermetic maga suspected of diabolism who asks veteran magi to help pursue the criminals into the Cursewood.

name: Magpie
description: Talking pet bird with game statistics.

name: Magus Orbus
description: A magus whose House of origin is unknown or lost.

name: Magus errant
description: Tradition of young magi adventuring abroad for vis and renown.

name: Magvillius
description: Place Promethea went to await the end of the struggle.

name: Magvillus Warehouse
description: Large Venetian warehouse owned by Magvillus where Tribunal meetings are held, rumoured haunted.

name: Magyar Shamans
description: Pagan Hungarian shamans with the full taltós powers, including immortality until their Mystery passes on.

name: Mahdi
description: Messiah who will appear at the end of time.

name: Maiden (foreman elf)
description: A beautiful golden-haired foreman elf.

name: Maiden Castle
description: A large set of hilltop earthworks south of Dorchester in Dorset, seemingly deserted but said in local tales to be a faerie stronghold where the fay may be met on the correct night.

name: Mail
description: Chain mail; mail shirts ancient, full mail early medieval.

name: Maine
description: County/duchy forming part of Anjou; capital Le Mans.

name: Mainland
description: Name of the largest island in both Orkney and Shetland.

name: Mainland (Orkney)
description: Principal island of the Orkneys, site of the Stennes stones.

name: Mairi Falt Ban
description: Wife of Donncadh Mac Calum and unofficial leader of the women of Clan Mac Gruagach, a calming influence with considerable say in clan matters.

name: Mairi Sean
description: Maga Ex Miscellanea of Mac Gruagach, a spirit mistress trained in Greece (Thebes tribunal) who summons ghosts of the Picts and is fixated on the Broch-builders.

name: Major Flaw (Inferiority)
description: Major Inferiority granting a Major General or Supernatural (Magic) Flaw.

name: Major Hermetic Virtue
description: Category of Virtue, e.g. Diedne Magic and Life-Linked Spontaneous Magic.

name: Major Magical Deficiency
description: Major Flaw with an aett.

name: Major Magical Focus in Spirits
description: A Major Magical Focus developed by Titanoi magi during apprenticeship, applying to all supernatural entities with a naturally insubstantial form including ghosts.

name: Major Orders
description: Clerical grades of sub-deacon, deacon, priest and bishop, who are celibate.

name: Makatiel
description: An Avenger of Evil whose angel-like name means Plague of God.

name: Make a Liar of the Boastful
description: Bomburkhan's Power granting someone a talent contradicting a boast.

name: Make the Miser Generous
description: TaBl 30 spell eliminating a Major negotiation-related Virtue (or equivalent) from the victim until he behaves honestly.

name: Maker of Textured Vessels
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue allowing a character to craft vessels with impressed mystical patterns that grant a +3 bonus in a single Ability to their owner.

name: Maker of Water Vessels
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue allowing a character to make magical water vessels whose drinker may swap an Ability score for the crafter's Craft: Potter score.

name: Malak Ta'us
description: The Peacock Angel of the real Yezidi religion.

name: Malandanti
description: The 'bad walkers', evil nightwalkers (usually Infernal witches, sometimes unruly ghosts) who oppose the benandanti, fighting with sorghum.

name: Malchut
description: Sefirah meaning 'Kingdom', level 1 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 1.

name: Malcolm Big-Head
description: Ancestor of the current Scottish royal line, who defeated MacBeth.

name: Malcolm II
description: Scottish king who defeated the Angles at Carham in 1018.

name: Malcolm IV
description: King called 'the Maiden' for his vow of celibacy; traded David's southern gains for Huntington.

name: Malcom Ceann Dubh
description: Son of the chief and tanist of a clan, leader of a cattle drive to Aberdeen.

name: Malfalla of Portugal
description: Future mystic who is an infant in 1220.

name: Mali non valde
description: The not completely evil, whose destination is Purgatory.

name: Malignant Magus
description: A Minor Story Supernatural Flaw where a Twilight-loosed piece of the magus's psyche manifests as an adulteration that attacks his enemies without his consent.

name: Malik ibn Anas
description: Founder of the Maliki school (d. 795).

name: Malikis
description: Madhhab founded by Malik ibn Anas, followed by most Sunni jurists under the Almohads.

name: Malingreux
description: A court of Parisian argotiers who fake a dreadful disease with fat and ashes.

name: Malleus Epistula
description: Chain letter from the 5th century instructing inquisitors to torture and burn witches; a summa (Quality 26) on the Witch-Hammer Favored Abilities.

name: Malta
description: Island ruled by a count owing fealty to the King of Sicily.

name: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away
description: Meditation Intervention effect (Level 20) creating the appearance of a human being.

name: Mandeans
description: Monotheists in Iran with a Dominion.

name: Maneuver
description: Battlefield event component: Defend, Attack, Run the Gauntlet, Take, or Heroic Gesture.

name: Manfred
description: Bastard son of Frederick II, possibly demon-spawned, who took Sicily's crown before being killed.

name: Mangonel
description: A tension-powered catapult throwing stones on a low trajectory, used to bombard walls and gates.

name: Manichaeism
description: Older dualist heresy resembling Catharism.

name: Manichees
description: Dualist sect, succeeded by the Bogomils and Cathars.

name: Manifest Sin
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which a past sin stains the character's spirit and is manifest to those who can perceive hidden things, penalizing social interactions.

name: Mannanan Mac Leir
description: Magician-king, arguably Bladud's grandson, fought by Saint Patrick on the Isle of Man.

name: Mannus
description: Son of the god Tuisto, from whom the word 'man' derives, who sired the fathers of the three German tribal groups.

name: Manor
description: The basic fief for game purposes: the land (around six hundred acres) traditionally required to maintain a knight, his family and household retainers, yielding about twenty pounds a year.

name: Manorial Roll
description: The parchment rolls recording manorial court decisions, onto which special decisions and retirement contracts are sewn.

name: Manorial Rolls
description: Long records of previous cases and debts kept by the court clerk.

name: Mansur
description: The Muslim emir of Semita Errabunda, used as an example of invoking God's aid in combat.

name: Mantle of Nerius
description: Mantle made by Verditius magus Ceylan for Nerius, letting the wearer survive without food; Faith 3, Divine Might 30; now lost.

name: Manumission
description: The freeing of serfs by lords, favored by Church teaching but rarely practiced by senior Churchmen; costs six to ten pounds for a player character.

name: Manzikert
description: Where the Turks routed the Byzantine army in 1071.

name: Mar
description: Northern Lowland region with many recumbent stone circles.

name: Mara ex Miscellanea
description: A young maga of Ex Miscellanea, Regulus' amica and proxy holder of his sigil, author of Curses and Corruption.

name: Marbaid of Flambeau
description: A magus of House Flambeau whose wizard's sigil is connected to an obsession with blood, turning his water spells into gushes of blood.

name: Marbhairn na Gearr-fhiadh
description: Mungan Mor's familiar (Hare Killer), an old grizzled deerhound with a long rivalry with Fiacail Geur.

name: Marbode of Rennes
description: Bishop who wrote the 11th-century Lapidary.

name: Marcandiers
description: A court of Parisian argotiers who pretend to be robbed merchants.

name: Marcher Lord
description: Lords placed between England and Wales after the Conquest, with near-royal rights to build castles, levy taxes and make war.

name: Marcher Lords
description: Anglo-Norman lords holding land in or along the borders of Wales, including the Marshals, de Braoses, Mortimers, and Bohuns, whose lordships function much like palatinates.

name: Marchio Liutpoldos
description: Nobleman made overlord of the East March in 976, progenitor of the Babenbergs.

name: Marcus Antonius
description: Former chief priest of the luperci.

name: Marcus of Paris
description: Redcap majordomo of Mathieus who sells intelligence about Paris and recruits servants for covenants.

name: Maren
description: Verditius who made great weapons for kings before the Treaty.

name: Margrave
description: A count with fuller legal powers over a difficult border (markgraf, marchio).

name: Marguerite of Flambeau
description: A beautiful but rude maga of House Flambeau, sole inhabitant of Fengheld's Fengheld House chapter in Cherbourg, who considers mundanes beneath her.

name: Maria of Constantinople
description: Mater of Mathieus.

name: Marie-Morgane
description: Evil siren, formerly Dahut, who drowns sailors to people sunken Is.

name: Mario (Shadow Senator)
description: Slow-witted Shadow Senator.

name: Mario of Tytalus
description: Luctatio magus on the Council of Milan.

name: Marius
description: Legendary British king, son of Arvirarous, who killed Sodric and gave the Picts Caithness.

name: Mark Anthony
description: Octavian's rival in the civil war during which Julius' temple was destroyed.

name: Market Fair
description: Fair held on the lord's demesne where surplus is exchanged for manufactured goods, typically twice a year.

name: Marking the Territory
description: A ReCo 15 Scent-Target spell that bars Corpus-associated intruders from a warded area marked by the caster's scent.

name: Marla
description: A grog patrolling a covenant hallway who interrupts a fleeing intruder in an example.

name: Marmoutier
description: Monastery by Tours' gate where St. Martin lived.

name: Marne
description: River near Reims on whose banks lies Matilda's vineyard.

name: Mars incised with a square
description: House Tremere's symbol; the square represents a Roman road flagstone.

name: Marsebilia
description: Companion of Clare who started a new Poor Sisters group in Foligno in 1217 as its abbess.

name: Marseilles
description: Port to which Mathieus sailed after Constantinople fell.

name: Marshal (Virtue)
description: Minor Social Status Virtue for the specialist in charge of a noble's stables; grants 50 extra experience points.

name: Martial Abilities
description: Category of Abilities that masters of kennels and marshals may take freely.

name: Martial of Tytalus
description: A magus of House Tytalus who collects turtle shells inscribed with bellicose Latin quotations.

name: Martim Martins
description: Templar commander of Portugal, childhood friend of Sancho II.

name: Martin (abbot of Cunfin)
description: Middle-aged abbot of Cunfin who supports the magi.

name: Martin of Pattishall
description: The senior professional justice at the court of the King's Bench.

name: Martin the Alchemist
description: An example philosopher and alchemist with Philosophiae 5 who learns and concocts the Cement reagent and writes Laboratory Texts for fellow alchemists.

name: Martinmas
description: The Feast of the Plowman, celebrated with a feast on 11 November.

name: Maruhs
description: One of Birna's six apprentices, told to 'Strive,' from her own tribe, whose name means 'stallion' in Old Gothic; founder of Clan Maruhs.

name: Marut
description: One of two fallen angels who, per the Qur'an, taught sihr (magic) to mankind to tempt them from Islam.

name: Mary the Jewess
description: Early alchemist credited with inventing an efficient still, the water bath and the kerotakis.

name: Mashith
description: Angel of punishment who punishes the wicked through the death of their children.

name: Mask the Odor of Magic
description: A spell used in conjunction with a magically maintained persona enchantment to hide magical traces.

name: Maskim
description: The nine archdemons heading the nine orders of demons, the ruling council that advises the Devil; each has Infernal Might 75.

name: Maslin
description: Bread mixture of the lowest class of the manor's main grain with a cheaper foodstuff such as rye, barley or beans.

name: Masons' Guild
description: The only craft guild that operates internationally, whose members travel across Mythic Europe in army-like groups to build cathedrals, churches, and castles.

name: Mass Hallucination
description: Lilin Power making multiple sleepers share a dream.

name: Masseo
description: Early follower of Francis known for his eloquence and courtesy.

name: Massif Central
description: Southeastern border area of uncertainty.

name: Massylian Priestess
description: Guardian of the temple of the Hesperides.

name: Master (Virtue)
description: A free Social Status Virtue specific to the Rhine, granting the rank of magister, the right to train apprentices, and the use of a retired magus's voting sigil.

name: Master Conall the Gruagach
description: A gruagach master character.

name: Master Fortis
description: One of the papal notaries in 1220, a sub-deacon.

name: Master Guido
description: Papal notary and sub-deacon who becomes vice-chancellor in 1222.

name: Master Maximus
description: One of the papal notaries in 1220, a sub-deacon.

name: Master Obizo
description: One of the papal notaries in 1220, a sub-deacon.

name: Master Willelmus
description: Papal vice-chancellor in 1220, a subdeacon, succeeded in 1222 by Master Guido.

name: Master of Auxiliaries
description: Tremere magi who lead mundane soldiers with multicast spells.

name: Master of Challenges
description: Creature tormenting magi deep in Arcadia that sometimes claims to be Tytalus, jailer of imprisoned Giants and Titans.

name: Master of Fierce Winds
description: Rok's Focus Power to spontaneously conjure Creo Auram winds or hail.

name: Master of Illusion
description: Polymathes' Focus Power to alter appearances as Muto Imaginem.

name: Master of Kennels (Virtue)
description: Minor Social Status Virtue for a character managing a noble's kennels; grants 50 extra experience points in related Abilities.

name: Master of None
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character cannot stick at a task for longer than a season, preventing reapplication of experience points to the same Ability or Art in a year.

name: Master of Sound
description: Power of the Zwergenstimme imago duplicating any non-Ritual sound spell up to level 15.

name: Master of Storm and Sea
description: Rumael's power to create Creo, Muto or Rego effects affecting storms and water.

name: Master of the Magic Spirit
description: ReVi 41 effect in Regulus' Tablet forcing an Airy Spirit to obey.

name: Master of the Pack
description: Human who leads a pack of dogs as a trained group using Animal Handling.

name: Master of the Undergrowth
