description: Cat power, a version of Intuition of the Forest.

name: Master on This Side of the Sea
description: Officer sometimes appointed to oversee Western provinces.

name: Mastered Rune
description: Minor Virtue reducing botch dice.

name: Mastered Talent
description: Virtue possessed by Calum (Shapeshifter).

name: Mastery Faerie
description: A classification of faerie applied to the dragon Vishap.

name: Mastery of Misdirection
description: Kerseenn's power over misdirection.

name: Mastery of Mist
description: Mogidell's power over mist and fog.

name: Mastery of Storms
description: Arnev's power over bad weather.

name: Mastery of the Oceans
description: Rahab's Power to create any Aquam effect.

name: Mastiff
description: Shaggy, vicious guard and hunting dog used against boar or bear.

name: Masyaf
description: Most important Syrian fortress of the Assassins, besieged by Saladin in 1176.

name: Material Bonuses
description: Magical properties of materials used in enchanting items.

name: Mathematical Sciences
description: Book One of the Epistles; Artes Liberales tractatus and Elementalist Air summa.

name: Mathematicus Ally
description: Minor Covenant Boon: a single mathematicus living near the covenant aids the magi.

name: Mathematicus Resident
description: Minor Covenant Hook: one or more mathematici live in the covenant.

name: Mathey
description: The Fifth Heaven, true Empyrean and home of the Avenging Angels, dwelling of Metatron ruled by Shatqiel.

name: Matilda of Tuscany
description: Noblewoman trained in war who championed the pope in the Investiture Controversy and nearly destroyed Imperial authority in Northern Italy.

name: Matres
description: Gallic mother goddess with a temple at Alesia.

name: Matter of Britain
description: Cycle of Arthurian tales.

name: Matter of France
description: Cycle of Charlemagne and paladins.

name: Matthew
description: Young landed knight, Simon's vassal.

name: Matthew II
description: The duke who succeeds Dietrich III as duke of Upper Lorraine in 1220.

name: Maud (daughter of Perceval)
description: The two-year-old daughter of the Redcap Perceval and Lucy, suspected of having the Gift.

name: Maugis d'Aigremont
description: Chanson de geste hero.

name: Maurillac
description: Where seven Waldensians were executed in 1214.

name: Mausoleum of Herlicarnasus
description: An epic site chosen as the headquarters of the example league The Singers in Hollow Rooms.

name: Mavens of Etiquette in the Court of the Purple Bower
description: Chaste sexual demons (Tempters, Infernal Might 5) serving Neqael, who teach courtiers a distorted moral code and seduction techniques.

name: Mawlid al-Nabi
description: Birthday of the Prophet holiday.

name: Measure of Success
description: Fable points earned in an Elysian quest determine Failure, Mediocre, Accomplished, or Unmitigated Success.

name: Mechanica of Heron
description: The lost teachings of Heron of Alexandria whose rediscovery would allow building semi-magical devices without vis; source of Mutable Devices.

name: Mechanical Animals of Verdi
description: Enchanted mechanical animals in Verdi's woods that warn grogs of intruders.

name: Mechanicians
description: A now-extinct magical tradition of mechanic-magicians who studied under Heron of Alexandria and infused mechanical devices with wondrous abilities; they died out in the fifth century.

name: Mechthild
description: Countess of Mecklenburg and most powerful member of the family, skilled at Summoning and Binding with Hierarchy Score 7.

name: Mechthild of Magdeburg
description: Mystic born 1210 who begins having visions of the Holy Spirit in 1222.

name: Medea
description: Legendary sorceress of Trianoma's maternal bloodline.

name: Media
description: Land whose mercenary soldiers were massacred, per Pliny.

name: Medica
description: Example maga with a Staff of Healing powered by a bound spirit.

name: Medicinal Divining
description: Virtue for sensing imbalanced humors and diagnosing illness; taught by Tulab Ibn Sina.

name: Medicinal Summoning
description: Virtue for altering bodily humors to cure or cause disease; taught by Tulab Ibn Sina.

name: Medieval Universities
description: Autonomous corporations of masters and scholars seeking independence from ecclesiastical and secular authority; in 1220 there are nine, organized into faculties, nations, and hospices.

name: Medina
description: Oasis formerly Yathrib that welcomed Muhammad; site of the Mosque of the Prophet.

name: Mediterranean Sea
description: Sea where 10 percent of ships are lost.

name: Mediterranean Sea Lore
description: Area Lore Ability possessed by Elisavet.

name: Medium (Target)
description: Faerie Target where a medium holds the effect and passes it to a target that comes within range; same level as Part.

name: Medusa
description: Gorgon whose name means protector.

name: Megaliths and Megalithic Tombs
description: Prehistoric stone monuments and dolmens of Germany and the Netherlands cited as reference material for specific sites.

name: Meiringen
description: Village near the Aare Gorge.

name: Meistersingers
description: New German minstrel tradition spreading joy via cynical parodies of nobility and Church.

name: Melchior
description: One of the Three Wise Men whose body lies in the Shrine of Kings at Cologne Cathedral.

name: Melee Events Table
description: Table of targets encountered in the melee, modified by Prudhomme Reputation.

name: Meles of Bjornaer
description: A young Bjornaer magus, one of the newly arrived members of Libellus.

name: Meles of Criamon
description: Member of Vardian's Tomb.

name: Melrose Abbey
description: Cistercian abbey founded in 1136, plundered by Horsingas.

name: Mementos
description: Ghost power (ReTe(He) 10) to handle objects emotionally connected to it in life.

name: Memory Palace of the Sage
description: CrMe 25 Ritual memorizing a whole text.

name: Memory of Water
description: Men of the Lake power to see the past of a volume of water.

name: Memory of the Waters
description: Anne's power.

name: Men of the Lake
description: Sentient water-elemental-like beings from magical lake regiones, organized by season and linked by a lake network.

name: Men's Abbey
description: Fortified abbey in Caen built by William the Conqueror, site of his botched funeral.

name: Men-Marz
description: Menhir.

name: Men-an-Tol
description: A holed round stone with two pillars in a Cornish field, said to have healing powers (crawling through the hole) and divinatory powers (placing a gift and asking a question).

name: Menagerie
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab contains a collection of live animals (+1 Upkeep, -1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics, +2 Animal).

name: Mendicants
description: Religious who own no possessions personally or as a group, may beg, and answer to their own leaders and the pope rather than the local bishop.

name: Menorah
description: Six- or eight-branched candelabrum; the eight-branched chanukkiyah is used at Hanukkah.

name: Mental Construct
description: A Major laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab exists entirely in the magus's mind via a powerful Creo Mentem ritual, limited by his Intelligence and unable to support familiar-bonding, item enchantment, or teaching.

name: Mentem Monstrosity
description: Warping Flaw of the Puffin Joker.

name: Mentem province
description: The Mentem-aligned province of the Twilight Void: emotions, thoughts and minds are perceptible and intelligent beings appear as ghostly outlines.

name: Mercadier
description: Mercenary knight who botched Richard's wound and flayed Bertram.

name: Mercantile Instruction
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Mercatora
description: Tytalus leader of Rellantali, aged 71, greedy, ruthless and prone to fury.

name: Mercere Magi
description: The Gifted members of House Mercere, about twelve in number, who support Redcaps through invested devices and healing.

name: Mercere Portals
description: Magical transport portals.

name: Mercere Primus
description: Head of House Mercere, who issues warnings to Redcaps flouting their duties.

name: Mercere Triangle
description: Copper triangle badge presented as sigil to each Mercere at gauntlet.

name: Merchant Guild
description: A guild of merchants granted by charter, holding monopolies (such as Ipswich's monopoly on milling) and operating a court for resolving disputes in towns like Freiburg.

name: Merchant Venturer
description: A Social Status Virtue used to purchase the Typical merchant income band.

name: Merchant's Associate
description: Rellantali's Master Thief.

name: Merchant's Son
description: Sample thirteen-year-old companion obsessed with saints' lives, hoping to gain True Faith and become a preaching friar.

name: Merchants' Table
description: Carved stones.

name: Merchet
description: Fine paid to a lord for permission for serfs to marry, widely loathed by peasants.

name: Mercurial priesthood
description: Ancient priesthood of Mercurian magic whose artifacts Sabastien is rumored to own.

name: Mercurian Magi
description: Mercere magi of Priamitus's lineage who practice Mercurian magic and spell mastery abilities.

name: Mercurian Magicians
description: Roman magicians of Mercury, for whom a tower near Tours was built.

name: Mercurian cults
description: Cults among the Hermetic magi whose members often succumb to the Vulnerable Casting Flaw.

name: Mercurian lineage
description: A Hermetic magical lineage descended from the Roman priests of Mercury, granting Mercurian Magic and predating the Order of Hermes.

name: Mercurian portal
description: Ancient functioning portal of the Cult of Mercury linking to the temple ruins.

name: Mercurian priesthood
description: Ancient priesthood whose tombs Vespillo sought beneath Rome.

name: Mercury's Blessing
description: CrVi25 Mercurian Ritual giving a Might-like aura that improves chances children will have the Gift or heroic qualities.

name: Merfolk of Ys
description: Tribes of merfolk (merrow) around the coasts of France who claim descent from the people of Ys and hate the Red Knight.

name: Merk
description: Scottish unit of value equal to 2/3 of a pound, with no coin.

name: Merlin's Step
description: Stone at Barenton summoning storms.

name: Merlin's Well
description: A spring on the escarpment of Alderley Edge in Cheshire, marked by an inscription and a carved face said to represent Merlin, where Arthur and his knights are said to sleep beneath the Edge.

name: Mermaid
description: A water-inhabiting faerie for which Undine Blood can substitute.

name: Merovingian Kings
description: Early Frankish kings who donated lands to the Church and whose locks granted mystical powers.

name: Merry Maidens
description: A stone circle of nineteen granite boulders at Land's End, said to be girls turned to stone for dancing on Sunday to the music of the Pipers, who were demons.

name: Mesen
description: Flemish cloth fair town.

name: Meshabber
description: Angel of punishment who punishes incest.

name: Mesnie privée
description: A select group of friends of a powerful lord within his mesnie who strongly reflect his tastes.

name: Messenger
description: Grog vocation: carries messages between a covenant and its interests across Italy.

name: Messenger's Memory
description: Minor Heroic Virtue to recall any short message word for word.

name: Messengers of Mercury
description: UnGifted servants of the Neo-Mercurians who run messages and help restore lost temples.

name: Mestus
description: River in Greece bounding the lion's European range per Pliny.

name: Metal Scale
description: Metal lamellar armor, including brigandine.

name: Metallic arsenic
description: Brittle metal smelted from arsenic salts with Material Bonuses for killing magic, preservation of the dead, and stimulating the ill.

name: Metamagic
description: Muto Vim magic that alters other magic, developed by Triceres.

name: Metaphysical Evil
description: Limitations or privations imposed by one's own nature; magic seeks to overcome it, which may explain the Church's wariness of magic.

name: Metered spell
description: Spell whose verbal component is poetry, easier to learn and cast.

name: Method I
description: Rune spell method in which the runemaster names himself as the subject, typically affecting the vitki or an object tied to him.

name: Method II
description: Rune spell method in which the runemaster is named in the third person, typically affecting others or an area around the runes.

name: Methods
description: Supernatural Abilities describing what a holy character must do to activate a miraculous effect; combined with a Power to produce it.

name: Metz
description: The largest and most important city of Upper Lorraine, originally Roman Divodurum, a wealthy Free Imperial City since 1143 and former capital of Austrasia and Lotharingia.

name: Mews
description: House for falcons and hawks.

name: Mezuzot
description: Phylactery cases bound to door posts.

name: Mice That Burned the Barn
description: A family of mice Warped by Flambeau Ignem magic that belch sparks and set barns alight.

name: Michael (demon)
description: Demon from the ArM5 bestiary, reassigned as a Tempter with the Obsession Sensitive to Mockery.

name: Microcosm
description: A cosm bigger than the thing it is connected to, such as a country inside a pebble.

name: Microcosmic Station
description: An advanced Station on the Criamon Path of the Body; Primi who achieve it are active administrators coordinating the House's ventures.

name: Micropedus of Bjornaer
description: Elderly Bjornaer magus of Nidi with a starling heartbeast and Twilight-shrunken feet, originator of the philosophy of covenants exploiting urban niches; an Auram weather magus.

name: Midday/Midnight (Duration)
description: Faerie Duration equivalent to Sun that manifests at dawn, noon, dusk, or midnight.

name: Midgard
description: The world, formed from Ymir; one of his eyebrows formed all of it.

name: Midrash Tehillin
description: Jewish mystical text telling of the five angels of punishment in the Second Heaven.

name: Midusulf
description: One of Birna's six apprentices, told to 'Lead,' founder of Clan Midusulf, whose name means 'mead-wolf' (bear) in Old Gothic.

name: Midwife
description: An almost exclusively female practitioner whose Chirurgy skills are employed throughout pregnancy and childbirth, sometimes having her thumbs surgically removed to assist births.

name: Might Recovery Requires Vitality
description: Major Supernatural Flaw requiring rest and a meal in a human community to regain Might.

name: Mihalpi
description: Primus of House Mercere, addressee of Thomas Verus's letter.

name: Mihalyi
description: Insatella's father, the last Primus of Mercere, who replaced Aldico after the Schism War.

name: Miklos's mandolin
description: Magical mandolin won in Arcadia that commands living things through song lyrics.

name: Milanese
description: Milanese force and rivals that besieged Castro Selvaggio and were suspected in its fall.

name: Mild Aging
description: A Minor General Virtue granting a +1 bonus to the Living Conditions Modifier on aging rolls and a +3 bonus to survive an aging crisis.

name: Miles de Levis
description: Bailli of Cotentin, appointed 1215.

name: Militant Orders
description: Orders of warrior monks established to aid the crusades; four major ones in 1220.

name: Military Order (Church Boon)
description: Major Church Boon: the church is an outpost of a military order.

name: Military Orders
description: Orders of knights whose heads attended Lateran IV; a church may be an outpost of one.

name: Milites Dei
description: Bull of Eugenius III in 1145 clarifying Templar clergy rights.

name: Milites Templi
description: Bull proclaimed by Celestine II in 1144 describing Templars as defenders of pilgrims.

name: Milk Brother
description: A human who shared milk with a gwiber, gaining Animal Ken and a Faerie Friend bond with it.

name: Millards
description: A court of Parisian argotiers who racketeer among peasants in the countryside.

name: Milo of Bonisagus
description: An Archmage of House Bonisagus who prepared for his archmage contest while a member of Schola Pythagoranis, then joined Durenmar.

name: Milvi Antiquiti
description: 'Kites of old', a Societas Merceris of Mutantes and companions who copy and lend ancient books, flying in hawk form.

name: Mimer the Old
description: A minor deity in the Scandinavian pantheon from whom Wayland learned smith-craft techniques.

name: Mimic Dogs
description: Creatures described by Roman writers that could be taught to repeat human actions; probably servant faeries destroyed by the Dominion.

name: Mimir
description: Wise counselor of the gods, of Ymir's second, friendlier brood.

name: Mimizan
description: A covenant in the Provençal Tribunal with only two members, one of whom is the Praeco Dama.

name: Mina
description: Site of the hajj where pilgrims stone a column representing Satan.

name: Mind Suggestion
description: Sluagh power (ReMe 30) implanting suggestions to kill or destroy what the target holds dear.

name: Mineral Rights
description: Rights to resources beneath the ground, held by the lord or king.

name: Minerva Sulis
description: Sleeping Romano-Celtic goddess of Bath; Faerie Might 25; grants requested vengeance via curse tablets.

name: Minister General
description: Title of the leader of the Franciscans after Francis.

name: Minor Allergy
description: Cat power, a Sight-range version of Touch of the Goose Feather.

name: Minor Deficiency
description: Flaw listed in character statistics in this text.

name: Minor Demon of Pride
description: Demon attracted to a boy manipulated by a faerie queen in a story seed.

name: Minor Discomfort from Iron
description: Flaw listed in character statistics in this text.

name: Minor Enchantments
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue giving the character items with magical powers designed as Hermetic enchantments totaling 25 levels or less.

name: Minor Flaw (Inferiority)
description: Minor Inferiority granting a Minor General or Supernatural (Magic) Flaw.

name: Minor Knight
description: Faerie with typical Might 10.

name: Minor Magic Deficiency
description: Flaw appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Minor Magical Focus in Certamen
description: All Tremere magi have a Minor Magical Focus in Certamen, making them excellent duelists but limiting their power.

name: Minor Potency
description: A Virtue granted at the first Station of the Criamon Path of the Body, conferring potency in an aspect of the Art of Corpus.

name: Minor Rune Focus
description: Minor Virtue: single-rune focus.

name: Minor Supernatural Ability
description: A Virtue granting a minor supernatural power, gained by long-lived Durenmar covenfolk in their seventh decade.

name: Minority (Church Boon)
description: Church Boon representing a minority community, such as Jews, attached to the parish.

name: Minster
description: Older superior church with aristocratic patronage ruling subordinate churches; some persist in 1220.

name: Minstrel
description: Musician using almost-magical music to affect emotions.

name: Miqveh
description: Communal ritual bathhouse maintaining halakhic purity.

name: Mirabilia
description: Monastic books recording faeries and magical or unusual natural phenomena, signs and wonders; a research resource for magi.

name: Miracle Need
description: Modifier to a miracle's level based on how desperate or deserving the supplicant is, from Calamitous (-15) to Impious (+20).

name: Miracle Timeliness
description: Modifier to a miracle's level based on how quickly it manifests, from Immediate (+10) to Generation (-20).

name: Miracle of Our Lady of Boulogne
description: Apparition of the Virgin in 636 leading to a crewless boat bearing her statue, now a pilgrim relic.

name: Miracula
description: Monastic chronicles containing ghost stories of souls returned from purgatory and miracles of saints, read to foster Devotion and useful for research.

name: Miramolin
description: King of Morocco who imprisoned and later killed Franciscan friars, whose remains the flames would not touch.

name: Miravet
description: Significant Western Templar commandery in Aragon.

name: Mirebeau
description: Castle where Eleanor was besieged.

name: Mirror of Lapis Crudus
description: A magical mirror in a hut straddling the regio boundary, created by Mnemon; now the gate through which persons of like status swap places.

name: Mirrors of the Soul
description: Summa on Imaginem by Perpauca Bonisagi.

name: Mischievous Childhood
description: A childhood template used as the starting point for the sample Verditius apprentice.

name: Miser's Midas
description: Focus power turning any living thing the character touches, except himself, to stone.

name: Misguided Faeries
description: Faeries representing fear of decrepitude and powerlessness who are attracted to people working in old age, including magi, but attack them ineffectively.

name: Misguided Traditions
description: Infernal traditions deluded into believing they do good.

name: Mishneh Torah
description: Maimonides' Summa on Rabbinic Law, the foremost authority.

name: Missing Equipment
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Flaw: a lack of equipment makes one or two activity types totally impossible (-1 Upkeep).

name: Missing Ingredients
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: a lack of certain ingredients severely hampers one Technique or two Forms, halving relevant Lab Totals (-1 Upkeep).

name: Missing Sanctum Marker
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the sanctum marker is not prominently displayed or is missing, inviting Hermetic intrusion (-1 Aesthetics).

name: Mist Raising
description: Hagbui power (CrAu 10) raising a corpse-smelling mist.

name: Mistletoe Sprig of Herbam Vis
description: Mistletoe vis granting understanding of its forest.

name: Mistletoe of Virtue
description: Parasitic herb of virtue that, when Enriched by taking root in the wearer's flesh, grants the Supernatural Ability Divination & Augury but also Fragile Constitution; unenriched worth 2 pawns of Intellego vis.

name: Mists of Change
description: A Muto Corpus ritual (Level 60) with an Animal requisite in which patches of mist transform anyone remaining in the target area into a random creature for a Year.

name: Mithridates VI
description: King of Pontus and enemy of Rome who employed Crateuas as court physician; his potions let him survive poison and torture.

name: Mitigation of Realm Interaction Effects
description: Learned-magician rules for reducing penalties from Divine or Infernal auras via Entreat the Powers.

name: Mnemon of Tytalus
description: Rego master of Lapis Crudus who created the mirror gate and renegotiated with Candidus.

name: Moat Monster
description: A creature serving as a Local Ally for the Military Camp covenant situation, also referenced as a covenant Boon.

name: Mob Football
description: Peasant football played on festive days with unlimited players and few rules, winners getting the ball to a designated spot.

name: Mobile
description: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: the entire lab can be readily moved, e.g. on a ship or cart, usually taken with the Unstable Flaw (+1 Experimentation).

name: Mogidell
description: Great Spirit of Ushant of mists and sea-fog, appearing as a huge gray bird.

name: Mohammad
description: Prophet to whom the Qur'an was communicated, commemorated on the Night of Destiny.

name: Molosser
description: Large Roman dogs forming the basis of the St. Bernard breed.

name: Moly
description: Magical plant shown to Odysseus by Hermes.

name: Monarchs of the Veiled Court
description: Second degree of the Volshebnii Mechtateli who maintain the dream of the Vermilion Temple and may enter its innermost chambers.

name: Monasteries
description: Self-sufficient religious houses governed by a Rule, dominated by an abbey church.

name: Monastery
description: Religious house; the Inheritance seed's monastery has Divine aura 4.

name: Monastery of St. John of the Vines
description: Rich abbey in Soissons founded in the 11th century under royal patronage.

name: Monastery of St. Remigius
description: Eighth-century monastery and basilica over the grave of St. Remigius in Reims.

name: Monastic Enclosure
description: Rule of enclosure and stability of abode that Francis' preachers ignore.

name: Monastic Gardens
description: Monastic horticulture including cloister garth, orchards, physic garden, infirmary garden and herbers.

name: Monastic Vows (Flaw)
description: Story Flaw for religious characters living outside their community where keeping vows is a struggle.

name: Moncontour
description: Market town.

name: Monferrato of Quaesitor
description: Associate Quaesitor member of Magvillus who avoids its politics.

name: Mongol Horde
description: Force gathering far to the East that will bear down upon Mythic Europe.

name: Mongol Saber
description: Mongol variation on the long sword.

name: Monica Ierne
description: The second-in-command of House Tremere, an Archmaga and master of combat magic originally from the Stonehenge Tribunal who serves as an excellent field commander.

name: Monistic Mysticism
description: Mystical path of losing the self in the oneness of God, requiring Visions or True Faith; its Divine Ascent takes the form of Divine Gloom.

name: Monition
description: Official warning, usually for first-time offenders.

name: Monk of the Scottish Church
description: Companion template: a monk of the Scottish Church who left his monastery after it was annexed to the Cistercians.

name: Monkey
description: Pet with game statistics.

name: Mons Graupius
description: Battle of A.D. 84 where Romans defeated the Caledonians.

name: Monster's Hole
description: Dragon pit.

name: Monstrosity
description: (Form) Monstrosity Flaw developed by warped spice trees.

name: Monstrous Form
description: Death shark flaw.

name: Mont Auxois
description: Site of Alesia with a Magic aura and haunted temple to Matres.

name: Mont Maudit
description: The 'Accursed Mountain', second-highest peak of the Mont Joux ridge, where Bernard of Menthon chained or destroyed the demon worshipped as Jupiter.

name: Mont Saint Michel
description: Abbey whose quarry stone resembles Confluensis' buildings.

name: Mont St. Michel
description: Isle at the Normandy border.

name: Monte Cassino
description: Italian monastery from which St. Benedict's remains were moved.

name: Montferrand
description: Town around the Count of Auvergne's castle, rival of Clermont.

name: Montferrat
description: City refusing to join the Lombard League.

name: Monticelli
description: Community near Florence founded by Agnes in 1219 and addressed by Ugolino's rule.

name: Montjoy
description: Templar castle in Aragon.

name: Montserrat
description: Mountain above Barcelona, possible Grail resting place.

name: Monzón
description: Templar castle in Aragon.

name: Moorish magicians
description: Shadowy tradition of North African magicians with tentative links to Jerbiton magi of Iberia.

name: Moral Evil
description: An act of free will against the moral order prescribed by God; the only kind of evil that constitutes sin.

name: Moral Virtues
description: Also Capital or Cardinal virtues (Justice, Fortitude, Temperance, Wisdom) that moderate fleshly desire.

name: Morale
description: Roll from Chapter Nine: Optional Combat Rules made by a losing commander; failure may leave groups Disordered or Routed.

name: Morale Roll
description: A reaction roll (leader's Presence + Leadership + stress die) made when bad things happen on the battlefield; failure disorders or routs the group.

name: Morale and Discipline
description: Optional rules that weaken groups while making the leader more important, requiring Discipline and Morale rolls in battle.

name: Moray
description: Northern region ruled by MacBeth and Lulach's descendants.

name: Morgan
description: Welsh freshwater merman nursery terror.

name: Morgan Le Fay
description: Half-sister of King Arthur who imprisoned Guyomart in the Valley of No Return.

name: Morgana
description: The faerie who kept Ogier as a lover in Avalon, rejuvenated him with a ring, and later recaptured him.

name: Morgana Le Fay
description: Enchantress said to be Oberon's mother and Ogier's captor.

name: Morgat
description: Caves.

name: Moricus the Short
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Morlen of Merinita
description: A young Merinita magus among the members recruited to Nigrasaxa.

name: Mormaer
description: Great steward; the seven mormaers became earls.

name: Morning Star
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Morning Star Attack
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Morningstar of the Virulent Flame
description: CrIg 30 spell known by Verox.

name: Moro
description: Vampires created from exposed children, shape of death's head moth.

name: Morocco
description: Destination of early Franciscan missions where friars were martyred in 1220.

name: Moros
description: Leader of the Moroi.

name: Morphea
description: A dream maga used in examples who explores dreams, fights a demon and a diabolist dream traveler, and physically enters a dream.

name: Morrigan
description: Old goddess, a powerful faerie whose descendants may bear Faerie God Blood.

name: Mortuary Mass
description: Funeral Mass for the living believed to kill them; an Infernal rite.

name: Mortuary Society of Kassala
description: A society in Kassala, Alodia that makes Kassalan Dust and practices Kassalan Exorcism rites against ghosts and the physical dead.

name: Morum of Tytalus
description: Arabic Tytalus serving Magvillus as an enforcing associate member; bitter enemy of Verox.

name: Morwena of Ex Miscellanea
description: Magus who in 1030 A.A. charged Darius of Guernicus with a thirty-year vendetta against her.

name: Moshe ben Isaac
description: Example kabbalist who creates the golem Isaac to protect his community from a corrupt tax collector.

name: Mosque
description: Muslim building for communal prayer with a Dominion aura of 4 or 5.

name: Mosque of the Prophet
description: First mosque, in Medina, housing the tombs of Muhammad, Fatima, Abu Bakr and 'Umar; Dominion aura 9.

name: Mosul
description: Persian city north of which the Mulhidun live.

name: Mother (foreman elf)
description: A protective foreman elf.

name: Mother of Winds
description: Bearded old woman with four giant sons she keeps in order with her sack.

name: Motovun Forest
description: Forest on Istria where white truffles grow.

name: Motte-and-Bailey
description: Castle of an artificial mound with a wooden tower overlooking a palisaded courtyard (bailey).

name: Mougau-Bihan
description: Giant's tomb.

name: Mount Ararat
description: Mountain on whose top the dragon Vishap resides.

name: Mount Beauvray
description: Mount.

name: Mount Blanik
description: A mountain covered by a Divine regio, with an underground cavern holding the sleeping army of St. Wenceslaus, the Knights of Blanik, awaiting Bohemia's direst need.

name: Mount Carmel
description: Mountain in the Holy Land where Carmelite hermits live in caves around Elijah's well.

name: Mount Dol
description: Granite outcrop sacred to druids, site of Branugurix.

name: Mount Harder
description: Mountain bearing the face of the Harder Man.

name: Mount Klapsi
description: Western mountain of Bear Island, wooded wilderness with boars, bears and lions.

name: Mount Lycaeon
description: Associated with a ritual rumored to turn men into wolves for nine years.

name: Mount Lykaion
description: Mountain in Arcadia where the lykaia rite took place.

name: Mount Mercury
description: Highest point in the Vendée with a church on a Mercury shrine, a Redcap pilgrimage site.

name: Mount Purgatory
description: A mountain commonly believed to sit at the center of the antipodal region directly opposite Jerusalem, atop Hell, a place of contrition and repentance.

name: Mount Saint Michael
description: Place where Saint Keyne's brother lived and she left a magical chair.

name: Mount Saint Odile
description: A mountain in the northern Vosges housing the convent of St. Odile and a holy spring with a Divine aura of 4, a place of pilgrimage especially for those with eye diseases.

name: Mount Tabor
description: Site of the transfiguration where Joachim meditated for forty days.

name: Mount Triglav
description: Mountain in Slovenia home of the Zlatorog.

name: Mount of Olives
description: Site outside Jerusalem where Rabi'a is buried.

name: Mountain Giants
description: Norse giants associated with Terram who have Terram Resistance.

name: Mountain of Blood
description: Field of Purgatory where the violent are blasted by icy wind and hurled into a river of filth.

name: Mountains of Qaf
description: Homeland of the jinn thought to surround the world, likely within Arcadia.

name: Mountaintop
description: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab sits at a mountain peak, a dramatic remote setting prone to winds and snows (-1 Safety, +1 Upkeep, +2 Aesthetics, +2 Auram).

name: Mounted Archery
description: Rules for shooting from horseback, relevant to the horse bow.

name: Mounted Combat
description: Rules giving riders bonuses to Attack and Defense and a separate action for the steed.

name: Mournful Mound
description: A hill containing the barrow of the Black Serpent, reached beyond the court of the sons of the King of Suffering, where Peredur slew the serpent.

name: Mouse of Virtue
description: A mouse born spontaneously from the soil, able to gnaw iron.

name: Mouth of Hell
description: Entrance to Hell in Purgatory, a mountain-sized beast's mouth guarded by two seraphim.

name: Moving Objects with the Mind
description: Cat power, a Sight-range version of Unseen Arm.

name: Mu'tazilis
description: Muslim theological school stressing free will and a created Qur'an; briefly favored then banned in 1017 and 1041.

name: Muhammad al-Basri
description: Shaykh who miraculously found a woman's dowry certificate.

name: Muhammad al-Mahdi
description: Twelfth imam of the Twelvers, in occultation until he returns as the mahdi.

name: Muhammad ibn Idris al-Shafi'i
description: Founder of the Shafi'i school of law (d. 820), buried in Cairo; holy forbear with Divine Might 25.

name: Muhammad ibn Jarir al-Tabari
description: Author of Jami' al-Bayan (d. 923).

name: Muilearteach
description: A sea giantess who comes ashore in storms as a begging hag and devours those who shelter her; she has a pot of healing ointment.

name: Muireartach
description: The Pictish goddess of sea storms.

name: Mull
description: Southern island group granted to Somerled in 1156.

name: Mulsum
description: Honeyed wine served with the first remove.

name: Multiheaded Giants
description: Giants found across Mythic Europe whose heads each have their own personality, making them either easily confused or incredibly cunning.

name: Multure
description: Fee of a proportion of the grain milled, paid by millers renting mills.

name: Mummel Lake
description: An enchanted isolated lake near Seebach in the Black Forest, home to a Nixe (water-nymph) whose jealous elemental spirits may slay the mortals she bewitches.

name: Mummers
description: Masked bands who parade, beg or perform traditional plays during Christmas; faeries use the role to enter human lands.

name: Mundane Beasts
description: Beasts of Mythic Europe with no Might and no vis, using Cunning instead of Intelligence.

name: Mundane Politics
description: Covenant Hook: the covenant is deeply embroiled in mundane politics.

name: Mundane raiding
description: Normandy tradition that raiding mundane resources is not a Hermetic crime.

name: Mungan Mor
description: Magus Ex Miscellanea of Mac Gruagach trained as an animal mage, master of the clan's herds who drives them to the Lowlands each autumn.

name: Munkar
description: One of the two Questioners, Throne angels who examine the Muslim dead in their graves about Muhammad and punish unbelievers.

name: Munkar and Nakir
description: The Questioners, example angels.

name: Munsalvaesche
description: Castle where Parsifal places the Grail, guarded by templeisen.

name: Muqta' of Baghdad
description: Powerful patron protecting the Radhanite merchant.

name: Murderous Woodland
description: ReHe 55 Boundary ritual that wakens every tree on the island to walk and fight on command.

name: Murdrum
description: A fine on a community where a secretly killed person cannot be proven English rather than Norman.

name: Murmur of the Deep
description: Atlantean power to hear from any point in the same water-way.

name: Muslim Calendar
description: Lunar calendar dating from the hijra of 622.

name: Muslim ibn al-Hajjaj
description: Compiler of Sahih Muslim (d. 875).

name: Muspelheim
description: The fiery prison where the fire giants dwell.

name: Mutable Devices
description: A discovery from Heron of Alexandria's Mechanica allowing characters to scavenge spun vis and use its capacity in new enchantments.

name: Mutable Virtue
description: Astrological variant of a Virtue or Flaw applying only in the mutable signs; Major becomes Minor, Minor effects doubled.

name: Mutable Virtue or Flaw
description: Rule option listed among the Curious Common Magics.

name: Mutantes
description: Mercere lineage descended from Mutantus practicing Mutantum Magic ('magic-taming').

name: Mutantus
description: Great-grandson of Triceres who studied transformation magic and trained the first Mutantes.

name: Muzdalifa
description: Stopping place between 'Arafat and Mina during the hajj.

name: My New Best Friend
description: A Creo Mentem 25 spell of Henri de Tours that makes a target believe the caster is an old friend by substituting the caster for one of the target's real friends.

name: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips
description: Invocation Adjuration effect (Level 20) binding both parties to the terms of a bargain with a supernatural being.

name: My heart is inditing a good matter
description: Invocation Blessing effect (Level 20) granting the Free Expression Virtue for a day.

name: Mynyddawg Mwynfawr
description: Lord of Caereidyn whose 300-strong war band Aneirin praised.

name: Myomancy
description: Divinatory method using behavior of mice and rats, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Myrina
description: Current Evangelium, living at Dragon's Rest.

name: Myrmecoleon
description: A mythical creature whose exoskeleton provides a Shape and Material bonus of +6 to deprivation and starvation effects.

name: Mysterious Path
description: Potentate power creating an instantly traversable path between two locations.

name: Mystery Effect
description: Enchantment outside Hermetic theory usable only as part of a Mystery ritual.

name: Mystery Virtues
description: Virtues gained through Initiation into Mysteries; they can be taught to non-Initiates only under special circumstances such as a Minor Breakthrough.

name: Mystery of Becoming
description: Mystery preferred by faerie magi to becoming minor faeries in Stone Couches.

name: Mystery of Divination
description: A Major Virtue acquired through Clan Ilfetu's Trial and Oath of the Prophet, alongside the Visions Flaw.

name: Mystery of Divination and Augury
aliases: Esoteric Mystery of Divination and Augury
description: An Esoteric Mystery into which Clan Ilfetu members may be Initiated, teaching the haemagmomancy divination method.

name: Mystery of Hermetic Synthemata
description: The Mystery into which a new hierophant of the Huntress is Initiated, vital to controlling the pagan messiah they hope to create.

name: Mystery of the Anima
description: A Major House Mystery of House Bjornaer that transforms the heartbeast into a spiritual or elemental form composed of an element such as earth, fire, air, water, smoke, or shadow.

name: Mystery of the Epitome
description: A Major House Mystery of House Bjornaer that perfects the heartbeast into a Beast of Virtue, granting Characteristic bonuses, Mythic Feats, and immunity to physical Flaws in inner form.

name: Mystic Nun
description: Companion template of a noble-born nun whose mystical visions inspire verses studied by theologians.

name: Mystic Tower
description: Crusader base conjured in Iceland's southeastern highlands and protected by the Aegis of the Hearth, later assaulted by the giants.

name: Mythic (Characteristic)
description: Minor Heroic Virtue granting a specialty for a positive Characteristic.

name: Mythic Blood (Zmey)
description: Major Hermetic Virtue from descent from a zmey, granting a Minor Magical Focus with Storms and an innate power of invisibility, flight, or shapechange.

name: Mythic Cathay
description: Distant land to which emissaries went.

name: Mythic Companion Virtue
description: Free Virtue specifying a Mythic Companion's status; incompatible with The Gift.

name: Mythic Europe Lore
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Mythic Feat
description: An automatically successful incredible action a Beast of Virtue may perform at the cost of a confidence Point, covering feats of Perception, Presence, Strength, and other Characteristics.

name: Mythic Mimicry
description: Major Heroic Virtue to memorize accounts of any length and mimic voices or handwriting.

name: Mythic Pennies
description: Currency hoarded by Nicholas.

name: Mythic Places
description: Rare remaining magical and mysterious sites in Italy.

name: Mythic Presence
description: Virtue often held by those of Carolingian blood.

name: Ménez-Hom
description: Summit.

name: Naameh
description: One of the four demon wives of Iblis, a demon of prostitution.

name: Nails of the Cuckold's Vengeance
description: Andrew's Power causing stabbing nail-like pains.

name: Nain
description: Infernal imp-like guardians of the Carnac stones, once korrigan, who lure victims with false treasure and deadly dances.

name: Nakir
description: One of the two Questioners, Throne angels who examine the Muslim dead in their graves about Muhammad and punish unbelievers.

name: Name hiding
description: Means by which powerful beings hide their synthemata, reducing research points; typically Might/2.

name: Nameless Covenant
description: A Díedne covenant established on an ancient druidic shrine on Anglesey in 817, destroyed in 1011 and stricken from the records by the quaesitores after the Schism War.

name: Nameless Rock
description: Magic Thing island east of South Wamses, conspiring to join with it.

name: Nameless Runes
description: Minor Virtue: cast without name.

name: Nantes
description: City on the River Loire, political and ecclesiastical center and capital of the duchy of Brittany; its cathedral is a site of martyrdom from 843.

name: Nanteuil
description: Knights Templar priory in the Montagne de Reims, possibly a Divine regio.

name: Naples Covenant
description: Covenant founded in Naples by apprentices of Literatus that continues Literatus' work after its disbanding.

name: Narquois
description: A court of Parisian argotiers who are pensioned soldiers extorting with threats.

name: Natalis Invicti
description: Day honoring the sun god's birth (December 25), adopted for the celebration of Christ's birth.

name: Nathanael
description: Archangel whose servants guard the Treasury of the Four Winds.

name: Natrix
description: The filius of Lacerta in a Clan Arelie sept in Iberia.

name: Natt
description: Daughter of Mimir and Urd, the all-enshrouding night.

name: Natt-thel Prone
description: Flaw of Eirik Svennson, a vitkir susceptibility.

name: Natura Antiqua Cult Lore
description: Example new Mystery Cult Lore.

name: Natural Appearance
description: Major Quality letting a magic character look like a normal human or living creature.

name: Natural Environment
description: A Major laboratory Structure Virtue: natural scenery such as forest, desert, or river is in or around the lab, granting Aesthetics and terrain-appropriate Specializations.

name: Natural Measures
description: Measures based on the body or nature, such as salmon 'as thick as a man's wrist', which generally favor the lord.

name: Natural Philosophy
description: Arts open to Jewish scholars distrustful of magic.

name: Natural Sciences
description: Book Two of the Epistles; Philosophiae tractatus and Elementalist Water summa.

name: Natural Tether
description: A tether consisting of perfect natural features or astrological alignments, scoring 1 or 2, such as caves, forests, ice, volcanoes, water or wind.

name: Nature Wizard
description: A variant of Elemental Magic affecting Herbam rather than Ignem.

name: Nauarchos
description: Tremere naval officers of the House fleet.

name: Naumburg
description: A well-fortified town high above the River Saale with its own bishop, beginning construction of a cathedral dedicated to St. Peter and St. Paul.

name: Naval Koerakoonlased
description: Peaceful farming koerakoonlased on an island found by Kalevipoeg, who became fishers.

name: Nazareth
description: Mary's hometown.

name: Nebelkönigin
description: A magically enhanced ship, pride of Waddenzee's pirate fleet, stolen from Oculus Septentrionalis (built by the Verditius shipwright Marcus) while it carried vis and magical books.

name: Nebuchadnezzar
description: Conqueror of Jerusalem in 587 BC who destroyed the First Temple.

name: Necessary (Realm) Aura for (Ability)
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw giving a -3 penalty to a particular Ability when the character is not in the appropriate supernatural aura.

name: Necessity
description: The underlying laws of the universe in Criamon cosmology that forced the immortals into the cycle of time for three eternities.

name: Nechtan
description: King of the Picts who accepted the Roman Church in 710.

name: Nechtan Dubh
description: Gruagach of Mac Gruagach trained by Brude Deathless, a descendant and favorite student of Brude, free with his Curses and Gifts.

name: Nechtan Mac Brude
description: Pictish gruagach, son of Brude Deathless, who led Clan Mac Gruagach in 814 and kept it neutral; died in 987.

name: Necromancers of Vardian's Tomb
description: Ex Miscellanea magi invited into Vardian's Tomb who proved to be necromancers, in conflict with the Jerbiton founders.

name: Necromantic cult
description: Tremere's ancestral necromantic tradition, which made lairs under cities like Naples.

name: Necropolis Regio
description: A possible second regio (Magic aura 7) mirroring the temple town, always night, where those who die in the temple regio reappear as ghosts.

name: Ned Ludd
description: Name attached to Luddite manifestos.

name: Need Not Sleep
description: Virtue.

name: Nef
description: The main carvel-built trade ship of the Mediterranean, following a Roman design with lateen rigging borrowed from the Arabs and up to three masts.

name: Nehardea
description: Babylonian yeshivah city.

name: Nehushtan
description: The brazen serpent of Moses that healed all who looked upon it, broken by Hezekiah; if reassembled it would have Mass Healing.

name: Neil
description: Example player who designs a doppelganger faerie.

name: Nellie Long Arms
description: Variant of Jenny Greenteeth with long arms.

name: Nennius
description: Eighth-century British monk author of History of the Britons.

name: Neo-Mercurian Magic
description: Organization Lore ability of the Neo-Mercurians used with Performance Magic.

name: Neptune
description: Sea god whom Rumael falsely claims to be.

name: Neptune's Brooch
description: A wondrous carved precious stone made by a jeweler that prevents the wearer from drowning by letting him float on water (Craft Level 14).

name: Neptune's Imprisoning Arms
description: A Muto Aquam spell (MuAq 25) created by Falke that forms semi-solid 'vines' of water that can hold a small boat or up to six people, operating like Trap of the Entwining Vines.

name: Nesle
description: Picard town ruined in the Donatores' battle against undead; site of Requies Aeterna.

name: Nestor
description: Iacob's faerie caricature, a white (albino) crow that accompanies him on his travels and identifies him as the Prophet of the God of Truth.

name: Nestor of Tremere
description: The current curator (head) of the oppidum of Tablinum, who holds a collection of Arcane Connections used to enter its regiones.

name: Net
description: Weapon usable to trip, grapple, disarm or unseat a rider; otherwise ineffective.

name: Netiriun
description: Young Magus of Rellantali who refused Tamgor entry, suspecting him of spying for Magvillus.

name: Netzach
description: Sefirah meaning 'Endurance', level 4 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 4.

name: New Aristotle
description: The body of newly translated works of Aristotle dubbed by scholastic leaders, central to the twelfth-century recovery of philosophical knowledge.

name: New Forest
description: A royal forest in England cited as a legendary forestry income example.

name: New Temple
description: Templar chapterhouse in London on the Thames, seat of the English Master.

name: Newcastle
description: Seat of the king's sheriff who administers Northumberland; an English port.

name: Newid Gornest
description: Gruagach shapeshifting duel used to settle arguments, as certamen serves the Order; the winner may cast a Geas or Curse on the loser.

name: Niall
description: The example player who creates the magus Darius of Flambeau throughout the Detailed Character Creation worked example.

name: Nibelungs
description: A legendary race of men from the Lower Rhine who collaborated with dwarves and giants to conquer the wild river; their lost treasure is the Rhinegold.

name: Nicaea Empire
description: Byzantine successor state pushing north, expected to reclaim Bear Island.

name: Nicaise
description: First bishop of Rouen, martyred in the mid-third century.

name: Nicene Creed
description: Early Christian creed (325 A.D.); the Latin addition of 'filioque' was a point of East-West dispute.

name: Nicholas of Myra
description: Saint to whom Magvillus's chapel is dedicated, whose altar holds a shard of the brine barrel from his miracle.

name: Nicolai
description: A Lithuanian pagan summoner and merchant with the Summoning Art, who summons and bargains with spirits for a price.

name: Night Battle Taboo
description: Taboo forbidding nightwalkers and Infernal witches from speaking of their night battles, on pain of dream beatings.

name: Night Terrors
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is plagued by horrible nightmares, requiring a Stress Roll against Ease Factor 9 to avoid terrors and Long Term Fatigue loss.

name: Night of Tears
description: Night when crusaders slay the inhabitants of twelve farmsteads harboring magicians.

name: Night of the Sluagh
description: Attack of the sluagh on Loch Leglean in December 815.

name: Nightwalking
description: Supernatural Ability suggested as an alternative folk witch power.

name: Nile
description: River Chnoubis claims as his home.

name: Nimiane
description: Young damsel to whom Merlin taught all his secrets in eight days, recorded in a secret journal.

name: Nimrod
description: Builder of the Tower of Babel.

name: Niobe
description: A Criamon maga who longed to be Prima but was never selected; her perfect transmission created a study pond as she faded into Twilight.

name: Niort
description: Town.

name: Nishapur
description: Persian city sourcing turquoise and malachite.

name: Nissila
description: Second Pilum of Fire spirit invoked by Gunnar with high Penetration.

name: Nivelles
description: Town in Brabant where Marie of Oignes was born.

name: Nixe
description: A water-nymph faerie dwelling in the enchanted Mummel Lake who bewitches young men with her beauty, drawing the jealousy of the lake's elemental spirits.

name: Nixons
description: Border family surrounding Horsingas who take tribute from raids and protect the covenant.

name: Nizar
description: Eldest son of al-Mustansir, ousted and murdered; the Assassins sided with him.

name: No Chartae Making
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the character cannot create chartae.

name: No Familiar
description: Flaw listed in character statistics in this text.

name: No Magic Defenses
description: Minor Flaw from the Salutem Initiation.

name: No Natural Resistance
description: Flaw possessed by Domnhull; unavailable to gruagachan.

name: No Stores
description: A Minor laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab has nowhere to store supplies and cannot withstand shortages (-2 Safety).

name: No Tradition
description: Minor General Flaw for an infernalist who belongs to no Infernal tradition and so has no favored Abilities.

name: No-Name Street
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city. It is bricked up and nobody knows where it led.

name: Noah's Ark
description: Holy site whose resting place hosts terrestrial regiones; two Nephilim hid on it.

name: Noble Child
description: Sample six-year-old companion, a reckless noble's son prophesied to die by fire, with inherited Skinchanger and Great Dexterity.

name: Noheir
description: German dead who are ghosts of people born with cauls, with higher Might and greater persistence and destructiveness.

name: Noialle
description: Town massacred and plundered by Brabançons on the way to Limoges.

name: Noire
description: Maga, formerly Ash, apprentice of Jacinta filia Romana.

name: Noirmoutier
description: Island with a level 3 Magic aura and a druidess beach at level 5.

name: Nominoé
description: Ninth-century duke and king of Brittany who won independence and founded St. Magloire.

name: Nomos
description: In Tytalan philosophy, the abstract force of law, convention, or custom—a human invention that glues society together but is changeable and thus open to challenge.

name: Non-traditional
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: belonging to no holy tradition, with no favored Abilities; requires True Faith.

name: Nones
description: Canonical hour of the Divine Office: Afternoon service at 3 pm.

name: Nordic Triumph
description: MuMe(He)(Te) 65 ritual turning a ship into a dragon-prowed longship and its crew into Viking warriors.

name: Nordreys
description: The Northern Islands, Orkney and Shetland collectively.

name: Noricum
description: Celtic capital.

name: Norlanus of Jerbiton
description: Elderly eremite Jerbiton magus at Laon's cathedral school holding a Terram vis legacy; wrote of Nanteuil as a regio.

name: Norman Conquest of England
description: Conquest driving Saxon nobles and magi north into Scotland.

name: Normandy Lore
description: Ability appearing in character or creature statistics in this text.

name: North Pole
description: Target of a proposed Hermes Portal.

name: North Wamses
description: Magical island being competing in size with South Wamses; wide but squat.

name: Northern Crusade
description: Crusade against the Estonians, ending 1228.

name: Northern Tytali
description: Tytalus faction in the post-Schism Normandy Tribunal opposed to the Southern Flambeau.

name: Northumberland
description: The northernmost county of England, troubled by Scottish invasions, administered by the king's sheriff at Newcastle; contains the Farne Islands.

name: Nortorf
description: A small town in Holstein at the meeting of roads to Schleswig, Lübeck, and Hamburg, site of the prophesied infernal ash seedling cut down each New Year's Night by a white horseman.

name: Norwegian Rune Poem
description: Rune poem.

name: Norwich
description: English city whose Jews were massacred in 1190 and site of the first blood libel.

name: Nose of the Bloodhound
description: Black Dog power to track a scented quarry anywhere.

name: Not (Condition) (Duration)
description: Faerie Duration lasting while the target does not fulfill a common condition, up to a month.

name: Notae
description: Individual Ars Notoria formulas.

name: Notara
description: Example maga making astrologically linked enchantments, including a Pilum of Fire wand.

name: Notarius
description: Example magus who enchants an astrolabe for Ceremonial Astrology.

name: Notatio of Tytalus
description: Luctatio magus aiding Erimas in Pavia.

name: Notes of Delightful Sound
description: Hermetic spell (MuIm 10) in a Roman Tribunal magus vocation template.

name: Notger
description: Liege's most famous bishop, granted the diocese as a fiefdom by Otto II, responsible for many of Liege's grandest buildings, after whom it became a prince-bishopric.

name: Nothing Grows for the Wicked
description: Optional folkloric peasant-loyalty system in which God raises peasants' living standard around virtuous, successful characters, generating community loyalty.

name: Notre-Dame de Paris
description: Giant cathedral in the new French style on the Île de la Cité, begun 1163.

name: Notre-Dame de Reims
description: Vast cathedral in Reims begun in 1210 in the new French style.

name: Nottingwood
description: A town in a story seed that entered a charter agreement with a faerie king, electing a council of seven aldermen and hosting faerie merchants and knights.

name: Nova stella
description: New star in the heavens by which an ascended spirit announces its presence.

name: Novice
description: A junior member of a monastery or nunnery serving a probationary year before taking vows.

name: Novices
description: Children admitted to the Templars.

name: Noxious Vomit
description: Baal-Peor's Power spraying corrosive vomit.

name: Nuckalevee
description: Irish faerie like a flayed centaur that lairs in the sea and forages for human victims ashore; its breath causes plague and it fears fresh water.

name: Numbering the Flock
description: InAn 20 spell letting the Numerologist instantly know the number and kinds of animals she can see.

name: Numbering the Host
description: InCo 15 spell revealing the number of people the caster can see, distinguished by appearance.

name: Nuns
description: Women who are wards of the bishop and brides of Christ. They cannot usually be forced to marry and hold much land.

name: Nuraghi
description: Ancient conical dry-stone structures of Sardinia that yield raw vis to Verdi.

name: Nuremberg
description: An important Franconian trading city at a crossroads of trade routes, home to the Kaiserburg imperial castle and an unofficial capital of the empire.

name: Nursery Terrors
description: Faeries that terrify children.

name: Nyktophylax
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue: 'night guards' whose Sun-duration magic fails at noon and midnight, named from sentry duty in the Schism War.

name: Nymph Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety granting a Communication bonus.

name: Nymph of Fontaine-Belle-Eau
description: A beautiful nymph, believed an embodiment of Diana, who curses persistent hunters.

name: Nympholept
description: Young men taken by nymphs for years who gain Faerie Blood and often prophetic powers.

name: Nátt-thel Prone
description: Major Flaw: Nátt-thel on single botch.

name: Oak Tree of Virtue
description: Tree of Virtue containing Auram vis.

name: Oak Wand Talisman
description: Caitlin's talisman granting protection from storms and control at a distance.

name: Oak of Virtue
description: Oak whose heartwood, containing 2 pawns of Auram vis, can be Enriched to grant Lesser Immunity to lightning.

name: Obano
description: A 25-year-old journeyman swordsmith originally from Aragon, strong and scarred, who holds evidence of his former master's illegal dealings.

name: Oberhofen
description: Hapsburg vassal castle on Lake Thun.

name: Oberland
description: Hilly plateau, breadbasket of the western Alps.

name: Oberon
description: Dwarf-king Sleeper awakened at Oleron, with a magic horn.

name: Oberon's Horn
description: Horn banishing hunger, curing sickness and summoning people.

name: Object of Virtue
description: Item made by a hedge magician from the vis-bearing body part of a Beast of Virtue.

name: Oblate
description: A child given to a monastery to be raised and educated; the practice was outlawed by the Fourth Lateran Council in 1215.

name: Obliterate the Stone Walls
description: Perdo Terram 15 effect of Geran's Iron Pick.

name: Obrad
description: Exiled Serbian župan version of Osgood in the Brijuni variant.

name: Obstacle
description: Terrain requiring a special action to cross, such as a door or fence.

name: Occitan
description: Living Language (Langues d'Oc) with dialects Gascon, Limousin, Auvergnat, Provencal, Catalan.

name: Occult property
description: A hidden property of material not explained by its complexio, underlying attunement bonuses.

name: Occulta
description: A covenant founded in the East Anglian fens in 893 by newly gauntleted magi; it failed to establish resources and collapsed in 897.

name: Octagonal Fluorite
description: Octagonal Fluorite listed in the Tribunal index among minerals and substances.

name: Octavian of Tremere
description: Tremere magus who plays chess with a great noble and may be breaking the Code.

name: Odal law
description: Norwegian law granting a dead earl's lands to surviving sons.

name: Odette
description: A local maiden who witnessed the attack and supports Baudouin's story.

name: Odo of Champagne
description: Defeated by Conrad II in 1037.

name: Odo of Cheriton
description: Clerk wandering Mythic Europe collecting animal stories for sermons, who may visit a covenant to interview a child.

name: Odo of Conteville
description: Bishop of Bayeux and brother of William the Conqueror who commissioned the Bayeux tapestry.

name: Odo of Saint-Amand
description: Grand Master (1171-1179).

name: Odofredus
description: A great debater at Bologna and frontrunner for rector of the Faculty of Law, rival of Accursius in completing a legal digest.

name: Odovacar
description: Gothic king who conquered Italy in 476.

name: Oedipus
description: Hero who faced the Sphinx.

name: Ofaniel
description: Ruler of the Ofanim.

name: Offa's Dyke
description: A great earthwork of more than seventy miles marking the England-Wales boundary, completed in 787 with the faerie Huarwar's aid.

name: Offer Total
description: Roll of Communication + Charm, Profession or Craft plus modifiers, used to make creative offers to change a Faerie story.

name: Office (Duration)
description: Holy magic Duration lasting until the next formal prayer hour; equal to Diameter.

name: Office Holder
description: Minor Social Status Virtue for holding a Templar office.

name: Office for the Dead
description: Mass performed as a rite of imitation of death before entering Purgatory.

name: Ogier's Ring
description: Magic rejuvenating ring given to Ogier by Morgana.

name: Ogmios
description: A Gaulish god of strength, eloquence, and poetry worshiped at the western Vosges springs, identified by the Romans as Hercules.

name: Ogres
description: Creatures found in the Faerie forest's dark places.

name: Oidhche Challuin
description: New Year's Eve in the Highland calendar, with the tradition of first footing.

name: Oigh
description: The 'maiden', the first harvest sheaf cut by a chosen girl.

name: Oignes
description: Site of an Augustinian priory where Marie of Oignes lived and a community of lay women grew.

name: Oil of Prometheus
description: CrIg 60 ritual charged oil that sets a Boundary aflame up to 60 miles in diameter.

name: Ointment for Congealing Blood
description: A Theriac of Level 20, Potency Moderate, a compress of tormentil and comfrey that stays bleeding and cures a Medium Wound from a slashing weapon over a month.

name: Oisin
description: Irish hero of Oisin and Niamh.

name: Okeanides
description: Greek genii loci of the seas.

name: Okeanos
description: Titan who regulates the motion of the tides.

name: Ol-spirit
description: Part of a galdraman's soul, torn by Julius's spell.

name: Old
description: Flaw unavailable to gruagachan with External Soul.

name: Old Saxon
description: Dying language used as the covenant language of Horsingas.

name: Old Woman of the Heather
description: Local witch known to grant Gifts, who gifts Duncan the Bold with Withstand Magic.

name: Oleron Island
description: Small island in the Bay of Biscay containing the Apple Mile.

name: Oliver of Paderborn
description: Templar commander of the delegation seeking magical aid for the Fifth Crusade.

name: Ollamh
description: Trained storyteller of chiefs and lairds.

name: Ollamhain
description: Irish poets and performers with faerie kinship who favor Enchantment, Beguile, Dream, and Portage.

name: Olwen
description: Welsh heroine whose father is cursed to die when she weds.

name: Olympos
description: Legendary land existing in Faerie only within stories.

name: Ominous Levitation of the Weighty Stone
description: A ReTe 15 spell that moves a stone through the air; when released it falls naturally and bypasses Magic Resistance, dealing damage based on the stone's size with a successful aiming roll.

name: Omne datum optimum
description: Papal bull of 1139 by Innocent II exempting the Templars from all but papal authority and granting them their own priests.

name: On Airy Spirits of Significant Places
description: Summa on Magic Lore by Alexandros of Bonisagus, Quality 12 Level 3.

name: On Alliance with the Offspring
description: Polemic summa on Order of Hermes Lore by Hariste of House Tytalus arguing for admitting the Order Miscellanea.

name: On Divers Arts
description: A famous craft manual by the monk Theophilus about painters, glass makers, and metalworkers that adds +4 to a craftsman's Workshop Total.

name: On Divination
description: Cicero's treatise ridiculing the notion that the gods communicate through dreams.

name: On the Courses of the Stars
description: Tractatus by Gregory of Tours on Astronomy and Church Lore.

name: One-handed
description: Flaw represented by Calum's withered claw.

name: Onomancy
description: Divinatory method using comparing names, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Ooscopy
description: Divinatory method using burning or cooking eggs, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Opal
description: Precious stone for eye magic, from Cserwenitsa.

name: Opal of Virtue
description: Gem containing 2 pawns of Terram vis that when Enriched provides the Sure Traveler Virtue along with a minor Personality Flaw.

name: Open Helmet
description: Helmet leaving the face half exposed.

name: Opening Total
description: Total (Intelligence + highest Technique + lowest Form + aura) used to open society Arts.

name: Opening of the Arts
description: The Hermetic equivalent of Opening The Gift; harder if the apprentice's Gift was already Opened by a hedge tradition.

name: Opening the Runes
description: Opening an apprentice's runes.

name: Ophia Sirnaus Isle-Warden
description: Clan Chief of Clan Sirnas, a serpent-heartbeast maga who lives on an uninhabited Aegean island with a shrine to Artemis.

name: Ophites
description: Gnostic sect that worships the serpent of paradise as the symbol of God and revels in original sin.

name: Opulent
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is comfortable and well furnished (+1 Upkeep, +1 Health, +2 Aesthetics, +1 Teaching).

name: Or San Michele
description: Florentine church where Bonisagus's uncle served.

name: Oral Torah
description: Major source of Rabbinical Law.

name: Orations
description: Ars Notoria prayers recited in original languages at specific times.

name: Ordeal Flaws
description: Flaws inflicted by Initiation Ordeals; they cannot be lost in play or overcome by Hermetic magic.

name: Ordeal of Deleterious Circumstance
description: Ordeal required for Consummate Talisman.

name: Ordeal of the Bier
description: Ordeal in murder cases where the victim bleeds if the guilty touches the body.

name: Ordeal of the Cross
description: Ordeal where both parties hold arms outstretched before the cross; first to drop loses.

name: Order Miscellanea
description: Group of traditions led by Pralix that was eventually admitted to the Order of Hermes as House Ex Miscellanea.

name: Order of Avis
description: Smaller Iberian (Portuguese) military order supported by the Calatravans.

name: Order of Dobrin
description: German crusading order being absorbed by the Teutonic Knights.

name: Order of Montjoie
description: The oldest of three monastic orders dedicated to ransoming slaves, now failing and negotiating to be absorbed by another order.

name: Order of Saint Julian del Pereiro
description: Smaller Iberian military order whose formation was supported by the Calatravans.

name: Order of St. John
description: A religious order that built the Jerusalem Hospital for those injured on Crusade.

name: Order of Tempters
description: Weakest order of demons, to which children of female demons and human males always belong.

name: Order of Trinitarians
description: Religious order founded by Giovanni of Matha.

name: Order of the Lady of Mercy
description: An order of monks founded in 1218 dedicated to ransoming slaves.

name: Orderic Vitalis
description: Historian (1075-1141), author of The Ecclesiastical History.

name: Ordination Examination Total
description: Intelligence + Church Lore or Civil and Canon Law + stress die compared to an Ease Factor per rank.

name: Ordo Miscellany
description: Pralix's alliance of hedge wizards that fought Damhan-Allaidh and became House Ex Miscellanea.

name: Oreades
description: Greek genii loci of hills and mountains.

name: Organization Lore: Brethren of Purity
description: Organization Lore Ability known by all Brethren of Purity.

name: Organization Lore: Church
description: Ability referenced in this text.

name: Organization Lore: Cult of Mercury
description: Ability referenced in this text.

name: Organization Lore: Folk Witch
description: Ability used to recognize a folk witch's mark.

name: Organization Lore: Folk Witches
description: Lore Ability covering folk witch effects, where covens meet and the reputations of folk witches; its specialty must be a home coven.

name: Organization Lore: Franciscans
description: Knowledge of the Franciscan organization; required with Presence for Franciscan Initiation Scripts.

name: Organization Lore: Luperci
description: An Ability that sets eligibility for each Luperci grade and replaces Magic Lore when the magister invokes the She-Wolf; it is also used to dispel curses at Lupercalia.

name: Organization Lore: Students of Avicenna
description: Organization Lore Ability focused on by Tulab Ibn Sina.

name: Oriflamme
description: The flame-colored royal standard of France kept at St. Denis, which bolsters the king's troops and overrides other supernatural effects.

name: Original Sin
description: Sinfulness inherited from the Fall of Adam and Eve, cleansed by baptism.

name: Orleans
description: French city around which the Orleans Witches operate.

name: Orleans Witches
description: A mostly male folk witch coven around Orleans practicing a variant tradition with Premonitions instead of Shapeshifter.

name: Orlog spirits
description: Prophetic landvaettir (Norns) whose foresight coordinates the Icelandic assault and can help set ambushes.

name: Orléans Heretics
description: Heretical priests uncovered in Orléans in 1022, accused by Aréfast of orgies and demon summoning; some escaped.

name: Orn
description: The ancestor after whom the Clan Wilkis Sept of Orn is named.

name: Orogenesis
description: Power of the Wamses (CrTe 20) adding rock to the island at the cost of permanent Might.

name: Orphan Born
description: Humans engendered by dead parents and born beyond the veil, able to see spirits and become incorporeal.

name: Orphedra
description: A cruel Follower of Merinita at Dankmar (age 139), the covenant's link to the dark fae who specializes in illusions, cold, darkness, and fear; she taught Schadrit Faerie Magic.

name: Orphelines
description: A court of Parisian argotiers who slit the purses of the rich.

name: Orsini Family
description: One of the great noble families holding real power in Rome.

name: Orthodox Church Lore
description: Lore Ability of the Byzantine Priest.

name: Orthon
description: Breton noble version of Osgood in the Bréhat variant.

name: Ortolana
description: Mother of Clare of Assisi.

name: Orvieto
description: City visited by the Pope.

name: Osgood
description: Hermit abjurer living on Crumstone who is a Drowned Man serving Leviathan by luring ships onto Big Harcar, while also rescuing mariners.

name: Ossian
description: Gaelic hero of Highland stories.

name: Ossium of Bjornaer
description: A magus of House Bjornaer whose version of Talons of the Winds produces an eerie keening sound; his wizard's sigil makes many of his spells eerie or frightening.

name: Ossuary of St Helix
description: Crypt corrupted into a Perfidious Infernal aura 4 tarnished with hypocrisy, used by Father Theophagus to summon demons.

name: Otter
description: Riverine predator hunted with disdain in summer or autumn.

name: Otto da Tonengo
description: Master Otto, subdeacon and auditor litterarum contradictarum in 1220, succeeded in 1225 by Sinibaldus Fieschi.

name: Otto von Wittlesbach
description: Count Palatine granted Bavaria in 1180.

name: Our Lady of Haut
description: Healing chapel with Dominion aura 5.

name: Ouranos
description: Protogonos of Greek myth, father of the Titans with Ge.

name: Ouroboros
description: Gnostic concept amalgamated into alchemical tradition.

name: Outdoors
description: A Major laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab is not housed in a building and is fully exposed to the elements, taken with the Natural Environment Virtue.

name: Outer Farnes
description: The outer group of Farne islands, haunted by demons in local belief and home to faeries and magical creatures.

name: Outer Mysteries
description: The most basic Mysteries known to all Initiates of a Mystery Cult, often prerequisites for more advanced Mysteries.

name: Outer Mystery of House Verditius
description: The Verditius Mystery betrayed to the Order by an anonymous writer, leading to widespread Verditius Magic.

name: Outlawry
description: Icelandic legal penalty for raids and killings.

name: Overseer
description: Manages Literatus' fief.

name: Ovum Anguinum of Virtue
description: Serpent's Egg formed stone containing 2 pawns of Creo vis that confers Improved Characteristics (Stamina), Improved Communication, or Tough depending on Enrichment.

name: Pack Lore
description: Ability used by nightwalker characters in this chapter.

name: Pad of Crafters
description: Confluensis pad home to tradesmen, ceramicists and paper makers.

name: Pad of Gatherers
description: Confluensis pad housing food producers.

name: Pad of Parades
description: Open pad used for events, Aegis rituals and Tribunal meetings.

name: Padded Armor
description: Inexpensive armor of quilted fabric, felt, or stuffed leather.

name: Paderborn
description: A town at the source of the River Pader, famous as the site of the 799 meeting of Charlemagne and Pope Leo III that agreed the establishment of the Holy Roman Empire.

name: Padfoot
description: A faerie in the form of an immense black dog with glowing green eyes that protects travelers despite its fearsome reputation.

name: Padfoot Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety granting a Perception bonus.

name: Padua
description: City where Eccelino built eight prisons.

name: Padus
description: Venetian city whose refugees founded Venice.

name: Pagan Theology
description: An Ability covering non-Christian religious doctrine; the second book of Aristotle's Metaphysics is a tractatus on it.

name: Pagan Traditions
description: Groups of pagans following a tradition of faerie wizardry with Favored Abilities.

name: Pagan's Hill
description: Hill above Chewstoke, site of an Imperial Mercurian temple with a Magic aura of 2.

name: Page (Green Stone)
description: First degree of the Knights of the Green Stone, which teaches Free Expression, Performance Magic: Music and Art of Memory.

name: Pages of History
description: Theory of the Magic Realm as a record of past events, composed of tempora.

name: Paimpont
description: Monastery in Brocéliande.

name: Painful Magic Restriction
description: Supernatural Flaw available to vitkir.

name: Painless Moon
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue: the folk witch suffers no Medium Wound during her Witch's Moon.

name: Painless Witch Moon
description: Minor Virtue gained by Eliza from the Witch Moon.

name: Painting
description: A Craft/Profession Ability representing skill at painting, used in the example maestro Grifo's Aesthetic Quality calculations.

name: Palace of Woven Grass
description: Example story element: prison of the child stolen by the Rye-King.

name: Palace of the Selkie King
description: Undersea palace of the selkie king, possibly thatched with brides' hair.

name: Paladins
description: Charlemagne's twelve companions.

name: Palatial
description: A Major laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is lavishly outfitted with the best comforts and decoration (+1 General Quality, +3 Upkeep, +2 Health, +4 Aesthetics).

name: Pale Horseman
description: Demon of the fourth seal named Death, followed by Hell.

name: Palestine
description: Site of border skirmishes.

name: Palestrina
description: Cardinal-bishop town.

name: Pallantium
description: City founded by Evander on the site of Rome before Rome was built.

name: Pallium
description: Archbishop's symbol of office, received from the pope or a papal legate.

name: Palm Sunday
description: The Sunday before Easter, recognizing Jesus' arrival in Jerusalem.

name: Pan Lykaios
description: Deity to whom the lykaia ritual meal on Mount Lykaion was sacred.

name: Pancrestis
aliases: Pancrestis filius Occultes, Follower of Bonisagus
description: A young journeyman of House Bonisagus at Heorot, filius of Occultes and mentored by Philippus Niger, keen to learn Norse magic but deeply fearful of the wilderness.

name: Pandion of Flambeau
description: Magus convicted of stealing a magical horse from a Redcap.

name: Pandulf Marca
description: Italian-born bishop of Norwich, papal legate and chairman of England's Council of Regency, known for nepotism.

name: Panes
description: Satyrs with goat legs and tails.

name: Panicked Horse
description: A frightened or wounded horse that the rider must control with Presence + Ride.

name: Pannage
description: Right, paid for by villeins, to turn pigs loose in the woods.

name: Papal Bull
description: Unilateral charter issued by the Pope on any matter requiring decree.

name: Papal Camera
description: Office of the curia controlling papal finances, directed by the camerlengo.

name: Papal Inquisition
description: Emerging threat to the Order of Hermes.

name: Papal Letter of Inquisition
description: Extremely rare document granting its bearer extraordinary power backed by the papacy; only one Dominican holds one.

name: Papal seal
description: Held by the bullatores.

name: Paralyze a Man at R: Eye
description: The magical feat granted to magi of the Wolf of Virtue Mythic Blood lineage.

name: Pardons
description: Breton religious processions with feasting.

name: Parella
description: Example maga using Major Philosophic Alchemy.

name: Paris (son of Priam)
description: Son of the faerie lord Priam of Ilium, who holds a beauty contest during Ilium's mid-summer fair.

name: Paris Lore
description: Area lore of Paris.

name: Paris Temple
