description: Templar house in Paris serving as the French royal treasury, holding Saint Ursula's skull.

name: Paris Way
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city.

name: Parish church
description: Church at the center of parish life, consecrated by the bishop with relics under its altar; base Divine aura 4.

name: Parish clerk
description: Assistant to the parish priest (often an acolyte) who helps with the liturgy and rings bells, paid a yearly wage by parishioners.

name: Parisii
description: A fishing tribe who first settled the island in the Seine, giving Paris its name.

name: Parks and Lodges
description: Portions of wasteland reserved by lords for pleasure and as game reserves.

name: Parma Ablativa
description: The 'ablative shield' Parma fold that doubles Parma Magica for resistance but loses resistance equal to the Penetration of each resisted spell; takes ten minutes to perform.

name: Parma Absorbea
description: The 'swallowing shield' Parma fold that traps resisted spells for a round so their Penetration can empower the magus's next spell; halves Parma Magica.

name: Parma Condensa
description: The 'thick shield' Parma fold that doubles Parma Magica against one chosen Form but halves it against all others.

name: Parma Custodia
description: The 'guarding shield' Parma fold that protects against physical attacks, adding twice Parma Magica to Defense but giving no magic protection.

name: Parma Repercussa
description: The 'reflecting shield' Parma fold that bounces stopped spells back at a target the magus can see; halves Parma Magica.

name: Parma Restricta
description: The 'holding shield' Parma fold that encloses a touched target in a magical cage its spells must penetrate; often used to suppress a creature's magic.

name: Parsirus
description: A Verditius magus of Ungulus, beloved of Sinead, who was killed by the dragon.

name: Parthenay
description: Castle conjured by Mélusine for her second son.

name: Partially-fae horse
description: Horse breed of the Burning Acorn Vexillation, tolerating Gifted riders.

name: Partitio Monaviae
description: 1145 document by a special tribunal declaring Man neutral until a covenant is founded there.

name: Partridge
description: Game bird hunted by falcons.

name: Passau
description: Town near the Bohemian Forest.

name: Passes for Human
description: Free Social Interaction choice: the faerie suffers no social consequences as it can seem human, living at society's margins.

name: Passes of Saint Bernard
description: Monasteries vital to redcaps.

name: Passions
description: Strong character emotions treated like Personality Traits for the aura effects of the Resting Place of Mars.

name: Pastille
description: Small ignited lump of alchemical paste whose smoke carries magic to a Group target.

name: Pasture
description: Grazing land, primarily for sheep, often marginal land at the edge of the waste.

name: Paten
description: Plate for bread given to sub-deacons with a chalice.

name: Pater Noster
description: The 'Our Father', later called the Lord's Prayer, recited by Cathars.

name: Path
description: A House Criamon tradition combining a field of study, set of values, and lifestyle, each granting different Mystery Virtues; clutches originally followed a single path.

name: Path of Energy
description: A forest path discovered by Terious of Flambeau to replenish spent spellcasting energy from the forest, yielding the Life Boost and Mythic Blood Virtues.

name: Path of Warping
description: A forest path walked by Kleon of Criamon to influence the effect of Wizard's Twilight on his Gift, yielding the Puissant Enigmatic Wisdom and Twilight Mastery Virtues.

name: Path of the Founder
description: Sympathy bonus for Initiation Scripts that imitate the life of Francis.

name: Paths through the Forest
description: A tradition of nature magic inherited from Merinita, walked by many exsules, which may let them overcome one or more of the Lesser Limits of Hermetic magic.

name: Patriarch
description: Rank between archbishop and pope; the Latin Church has patriarchs at Jerusalem, Antioch, and Constantinople.

name: Patriarch of Jerusalem
description: Prelate before whom the first Templars took vows; authenticated relics.

name: Patrician monks
description: Monks who dwelt on Inisphadraig before the Augustinian chapter and taught Divine magic to the guardians.

name: Patrizio
description: Patrician of a northern Italian town's ruling elite, ranked above squire and below knight.

name: Patron Angel
description: Major General Virtue granted by the Fourth Ring of Solomon; a personal angel acting as guide and teacher.

name: Patron spirit
description: A spirit each Theban covenant must bind.

name: Patronage
description: Distribution of land, money, favors and titles, affecting Reputation and Gratitude.

name: Paul of Jerbiton
description: Luctatio magus on the Council of Milan.

name: Pavania
description: A self-proclaimed princess of Atlantis caught by fishermen who demands magi remove 'the taint of the surface world.'

name: Pavise
description: A large free-standing shield behind which crossbowmen span their weapons.

name: Pawning (Magic Items)
description: Redcap practice of lending about half an item's value in vis against a magic device that can be bought back within a set time.

name: Paxon of Verditius
description: Verditius magus who currently holds the right to harvest vis from Staubbach Fall.

name: Pazin
description: Place on the Istria Peninsula in the Kingdom of Croatia.

name: Pazuzu
description: Babylonian disease spirit whose image Lamashtu fears.

name: Peace of God
description: Church proclamation protecting the poor, Churchmen and merchants from violence.

name: Peacocks
description: Fourth degree: conjunction, Venus, copper; learns Hermetic Alchemy.

name: Peanhafel
description: Pictish covenant destroyed by Druids of House Diedne in a year-long siege in 849.

name: Peel
description: One of the three towns on the Isle of Man.

name: Peering into the Beastly Mind
description: Spell (InAn 30) known by Amberitus.

name: Peist
description: Immense serpent-like monster of Lough Dearg banished by Saint Patrick; its blood tinges the lake red.

name: Peitho
description: The Daimon of persuasion and charming speech, daughter of Styx and Pallas, who with her sister Bia represents forceful inducement.

name: Pelagius of Jerbiton
description: Jerbiton magus who drew Florum's folk magicians into the House.

name: Pelican (alchemical still)
description: Two-necked still returning distillate for re-distillation.

name: Pelicans
description: Sixth degree: distillation, Moon, silver, red; Mystagogues who learn Philosophic Alchemy.

name: Pellinore (cabal member)
description: Cabal member claiming descent from the real Arthur who manipulates churchmen against tournaments.

name: Pellus
description: The Latin cap of liberty worn as House Mercere's red cap of office.

name: Pelos
description: Old god whose descendants may bear Faerie God Blood.

name: Pembroke
description: Castle whose round keep is 80 feet high with walls 16 feet thick.

name: Pembrokeshire
description: Earldom held by William Marshal.

name: Penalty for Fighting Without a Helmet
description: Optional rule adding an extra botch die to melee Defense and Evasion rolls for characters without head protection.

name: Penetrate the Regio
description: Hermetic version of a Mercurian ritual.

name: Penetrate the Regio Skin
description: Cr(Re)Vi 25 ritual creating a new entrance through a Magic regio boundary.

name: Penetration Ability
description: An Ability that provides a Penetration bonus; creatures and characters without it have a Penetration bonus of zero.

name: Penitent
description: Woman living a permanent religious life of penitential practices in small groups, known as bizzoca, pinzocheri or continentes.

name: Penitent Ghosts
description: Disfigured ghosts of Bath bath thieves.

name: Penitentials
description: Reference books for confessors listing appropriate penances for sinful acts.

name: Penitentiaria
description: Papal judicial office handling lesser petitions, penances and dispensations.

name: Penitentiarius
description: Cardinal who deals with appeals to penances, grants dispensations and is confessor to the cardinals, with up to 12 sub-penitentiarii.

name: Pennius
description: Character listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Pennyroyal of Virtue
description: Creeping mint-like herb containing 1 pawn of Corpus vis, known as Heal-All; when Enriched it confers a Greater Purifying Touch against an ailment determined by the ruling star.

name: Penteli
description: The marble quarries near Athens, cited as a legendary mining income example.

name: Peon
description: Iberian townsman who fights on foot.

name: People of the Clouds
description: Magical sailors of a sky-sea regio who fly ships with power over winds and have insatiable wanderlust.

name: Pepin II
description: Pepin 'the Large', Dux et Princeps Francorum.

name: Pepin III
description: Pepin 'the Short', first Carolingian king, crowned 751.

name: Pepino
description: Hoplite and Legion of Mithras member who introduced and taught Darius.

name: Perambulation
description: Procession on Rogation Day in which priest and parishioners walk the parish boundary.

name: Perceive Motives
description: An Intellego Mentem effect (InMe 10) enchanted into Falke's talisman, like Sight of the Transparent Motive but with zero Penetration to avoid affecting Hermetic magi.

name: Perceive the Afflictions of Mortal Flesh
description: Caladrius power identifying diseases by sight.

name: Perceive the Distant Truths
description: Warders of Mystery power to perceive a place via Arcane Connection.

name: Perceive the Eyes of Knives
description: A new Intellego Mentem spell (InMe 20) invented for Tabanus that indicates whether anyone in the target room has hostile thoughts toward the caster.

name: Perceive the Firewalker
description: InIg 30 spell revealing creatures with Ignem-aligned Might.

name: Perception
description: Characteristic combined with Carouse.

name: Perception of Conflicting Motives
description: An Intellego Mentem 15 spell known by Imanitos Mendax.

name: Perchte
description: Faerie leader of processions of the dead, collecting the dead and leading them to pagan underworlds.

name: Perdo Ignem
description: Technique/Form combination that might extinguish the Ships of Flame's fire.

name: Perdo Mentem ritual (Sundering)
description: Likely ritual used inside Coeris to break Tremere's lieutenants' minds.

name: Peredur
description: A knight-hero of a Mabinogion tale who slew the Black Oppressor and the Black Serpent of the Barrow with the aid of a magic stone given by a mysterious lady.

name: Peredur's concealment stone
description: A magic stone given to Peredur by a mysterious lady that hid him from the seeing stone pillar guarding the Black Serpent's cave, letting him slay the serpent unseen.

name: Peregrine Falcon
description: Smaller ambush-predator falcon that attacks with a swooping dive.

name: Perfectibility of Man
description: Origen's heretical doctrine that there is no damnation and all things will eventually be saved.

name: Perfection of the Well-Designed Chamber
description: Re(Cr)Te(He) 20 spell reshaping one room of a building to be perfectly regular for Hermetic Geometry ceremonial bonuses.

name: Perfidious Aura
description: A corrupted aura embodying sins that betray trust, such as treachery and hypocrisy, typically found within the Dominion.

name: Performance Artist
description: An artist who performs art using a Profession Ability, such as jugglers, musicians, and minstrels, taking the Social Status Virtue Wanderer.

name: Performance Duration
description: New spell Duration lasting as long as the caster performs the Performance Ability; equivalent to Concentration.

name: Perfume-sorcerers of Soqotra
description: Sorcerers sent by spirits guarding incense trees.

name: Peril of Excellence
description: Listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Permanent Death
description: Faeries are permanently killed only by forces outside their story, such as destruction of Might, miracles, Infernal agents, or use of anchor vis.

name: Permanent Wall of Protecting Stone
description: CrTe 20 ritual creating a permanent 100 cubic pace wall of single unmortared stone.

name: Person
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: another person, such as a family member or maid, frequents the lab (-1 Safety, +1 Corpus or Mentem).

name: Personal Hatred
description: Flaw listed in character statistics in this text.

name: Personal Magic
description: Flaw.

name: Personal Powers
description: Faerie powers affecting only the faerie itself, often tailored using intricacy points.

name: Personal corrupters
description: Tempters personifying a person's evil inclination, opposing his guardian angel.

name: Personality Flaws
description: Faeries may have up to three Minor and one Major Personality Flaw, often tied to their form or role.

name: Pertinax of Tytalus
description: Necromancer and the only known member of the Worm cult; he acts as its contact with other cults.

name: Pesach
description: Passover commemorating the escape from Egypt.

name: Pessimistic
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character always expects the worst.

name: Pestilential Breath
description: Arkliss' power exhaling a disease-causing mist.

name: Peter Catanio
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Peter I of Dreux
description: Current regent of the duchy of Brittany through marriage to Alice.

name: Peter Igneus
description: Vallumbrosan monk who led the anti-simony party in Florence and passed unscathed through a bonfire in trial by ordeal.

name: Peter Lombard
description: A scholar who taught at pre-university Bologna and Paris and wrote the Sentences and biblical glosses, compared in a story seed to the works of a Hermetic writer.

name: Peter Mezzobarbo
description: Bishop in Florence accused of simony who confessed after Peter Igneus survived trial by ordeal.

name: Peter Waldo
description: Wealthy Lyon merchant who gave away his wealth in the late 1100s and founded the Waldensians.

name: Peter de Collemdio
description: A papal auditor in 1220.

name: Peter de Roches
description: Churchman who has care of the young king and all but rules England; hates William Longespee.

name: Peter of Bruyes
description: Defrocked twelfth-century priest who preached the Petrobrusian heresy, burning crosses and denying the value of the Sacraments.

name: Peter of Roches
description: Bishop of Winchester who will reform the Order of Saint Thomas in 1228.

name: Peter of Uist
description: Author of The Primal Power.

name: Peter the Venerable
description: Great reforming Cluniac abbot who led the counter-offensive against the Petrobrusian and Henrician heresies.

name: Peter von Wurzburg
description: A master of House Verditius at Fengheld, a famed grower of grapes and maker of wine who cultivates special varieties into wine as Charged Items.

name: Petit Pont
description: Short stone bridge of 1186 connecting the Île de la Cité to the left bank.

name: Petition Total
description: Com (written) or Pre (audience) + Church Lore + modifiers, with no die roll.

name: Petitioning
description: Clerical activity; Templar clergy petition commanders, grand master or pope.

name: Petrobrusian heresy
description: Heresy of Peter of Bruyes denying Sacraments and burning crosses.

name: Petrus Musandinus
description: A great Salernitan master under whom Gilles de Corbeil trained in medicine.

name: Petrus Virilis
description: Bonisagus magus at Durenmar, all of whose offspring have been Gifted.

name: Phaethon
description: Planetary spirit of Jupiter, ruling clergy, law and science.

name: Phaeton
description: A young sun god of folklore who, in river myth, drowned in the Po after falling from the solar chariot, his body never recovered.

name: Phainon
description: Planetary spirit of Saturn, ruling death, secrecy and sorrow.

name: Phantasm of the Skilled Musician
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Phantasmal Fire
description: A Creo Imaginem spell with an Ignem requisite that makes an image of a fire that dances, illuminates, crackles, and apparently warms but does not actually burn; popular at gatherings of House Flambeau.

name: Phantasmal Images
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Phantom Magic
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Pharmaceutical Theriac
description: An experimental-philosophy product forming part of the corpus of Medicine; a medicinal cure-all preparation, often a restorative, that some empirici sell genuinely and others fake.

name: Pharmacopeians
description: Tradition of which taltós are suggested as a regional variant.

name: Pharmocopoeians
description: A tradition referenced as the model for the Taltos, focused on herbcraft and pharmacology.

name: Pharsalia
description: Lucan's work of 65 A.D. describing Erictho.

name: Pheasant
description: Typical hawking prey animal.

name: Phessallia of Merinita
description: An old, cold Merinita maga of Voluntas connected with the faeries of winter, skilled in Perdo, who possesses faerie items obtainable only as gifts.

name: Phial of Christ's Blood
description: Crystal phial containing Christ's blood, authenticated by the Patriarch of Jerusalem.

name: Philip Hurepel
description: Nineteen-year-old landless son of Philip Augustus who might be appointed ruler.

name: Philip IV
description: 'The Fair', king from 1285.

name: Philip of Alsace
description: Count who rebuilt Ghent castle in 1180.

name: Philip of Ex Miscellanea
description: Donatores magus formerly of Requies Aeterna.

name: Philip of Nablus
description: Grand Master (1169-1171), retired.

name: Philip of Oldcoates
description: The sheriff of Northumbria who holds Mitford castle and refuses to surrender it to Roger Bertram despite royal summons.

name: Philip of Plessiez
description: Grand Master (1201-1209).

name: Philip the Tall
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Phillip Augustus
description: The current king of France, the first of his dynasty not to have his heir acclaimed while he lives.

name: Phillipus de Grevia
description: The chancellor of Notre Dame at Paris, who holds power to confer degrees and excommunicate university members and uses these rights to dominate the masters.

name: Philosopher's Egg
description: Special retort into which substances are distilled; the Philosopher's Stone hatches from it.

name: Philosopher's Stone
description: Ultimate alchemical product, hatched from the Philosopher's Egg.

name: Philosophers of Rome Lore
description: Organization Lore of the Philosophers of Rome.

name: Philosophical Refining
description: Major Virtue letting an elemental philosopher extract and move vis; gained via the Blood Oath of Ikhwan as-Safa'.

name: Philosophical Summoning
description: Virtue for conjuring natural phenomena, matter, or animals of an element; taught by Ikhwan as-Safa'.

name: Philosophumena
description: Book by Hippolytus telling of Simon Magus' burial.

name: Philostratus
description: Recorded Apollonios's conflict with a ghula.

name: Phimosis
description: A Minor Choleric Disease afflicting promiscuous men, caused by excess lust, usually clearing on its own.

name: Phlegethi
description: Fire elementals ('burners') that rarefy only from naturally occurring flame; short-lived, fast-moving creatures driven to burn and consume cold, that can beguile those who stare into their flames.

name: Phoibe
description: Titaness who is the prophetic earth.

name: Pholus of Tytalus
description: Author of the Magic Lore tractatus Commanding Spirits.

name: Phouka
description: Faerie that may become Infernal by delighting in tempting mortals to sin.

name: Phrygia
description: Region where Dindyméné is called Kybélé.

name: Phylactery
description: Shape/material bonus +5 protecting the wearer.

name: Phylai
description: Political groupings characteristic of the Theban Tribunal.

name: Phyllia
description: A master maga of House Bjornaer, the Eagle Elder at Crintera with a polecat heartbeast; a widely-traveled Harmonist and notorious gossip.

name: Phyllorhodomancy
description: Divinatory method using rose bush leaves, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Physica
description: Hildegard's tractatus on natural philosophy and Medicine.

name: Physical Evil
description: Evil that deprives a subject of some natural good, such as sickness, death, poverty, and oppression; attributed to demons by Divine religions.

name: Physical Traveler
description: A traveler who bodily enters a dream as if crossing into a regio, subject to real Fatigue, wounds and time, and able to retrieve hidden objects.

name: Physicianing
description: Female Daktyl power duplicating CrCo/MuCo/ReCo spells.

name: Physicians
description: Tremere healers and corporeal necromancers.

name: Physicus
description: A term applied to anyone with advanced education in both medicine and natural philosophy, distinguishing educated medics from educated chirurgeons.

name: Physika kai Mystika
description: Earliest Greek alchemical text, by Pseudo-Democritus.

name: Physiologus
description: An anonymous first-century Greek manuscript on which most medieval bestiaries are based.

name: Physis
description: In Tytalan philosophy, the abstract force of nature or self encompassing instincts, ambition, and competition, derived from a higher divine authority and thus permanent and unquestionable.

name: Picatrix
description: Best known work of astral magic, translated under Alfonso the Wise.

name: Pick Locks
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Pictish History
description: Mundane library subject at Mac Gruagach.

name: Piercing Eye
description: Sabaoth's Power to see through stone, wood and metal.

name: Piercing Lance of Bone
description: CrAn 20 spell creating a sharpened lance of hardened bone in the caster's hand.

name: Pierre de Castillon
description: Crusader who brought relics to Aubeterre.

name: Pierre du Thillai
description: Bailli of Caen, appointed 1205.

name: Piest
description: Irish serpent-whale that is Cara's heartbeast.

name: Piet de Spinnen
description: The false leader of the de Spinnen family, actually Petrus, mundane son of Calvinus of Jerbiton and former mercenary, who serves as Florum's willing spokesman.

name: Pietro Bernadone
description: Prosperous cloth-merchant father of Francis who paid his ransom after the war with Perugia.

name: Pilate
description: Roman governor petitioned to break the legs of the crucified.

name: Pillars of Islam
description: Five basic duties of Muslim life.

name: Pills of the Doctor
description: Prop from the mummer's play that now cures all wounds instantly and contains Corpus vis.

name: Pin
description: Maneuver holding a target helpless to the ground or a wall.

name: Pinfold
description: Pen within a messuage for impounded stray animals, which become the lord's property.

name: Pious Magus
description: A magus of true faith, as Nerius is rumored.

name: Pious Warrior
description: Grog template: a mace-wielding covenant warrior protected by a saintly relic necklace.

name: Piper Gut
description: Wide channel separating Big Harcar from North Wamses.

name: Pipio
description: Scribe of Harco.

name: Pirates of Rhodes
description: Pirates against whom Tremere's new naval doctrine is to be tested.

name: Pisces
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Pisuhänd
description: A small dragon of the Baltic coast that acts like a brownie.

name: Pixie
description: Fey beings of Buckland Saint Mary who annihilated the faeries and know traditional wards.

name: Piètres
description: A court of Parisian argotiers who feign lameness on crutches.

name: Plague of Frogs
description: A Rego Animal spell that spontaneously generates a swarm of up to thousands of frogs in a touched pool of water.

name: Plagued by Demon
description: A Flaw involving demonic persecution that cannot be taken if the saga excludes demons.

name: Plagued by Olympian Faeries
description: Dexithea's flaw reflecting enmity of Olympian faeries.

name: Plagued by Supernatural Being
description: Flaw possessed by Elisavet.

name: Plagued by Supernatural Entities
description: Flaw for nightwalkers or intervening magi harassed by demons seeking revenge or the dead seeking rest.

name: Plagued by an Angel
description: Story Flaw Devil Children often gain when targeted by Heaven's forces.

name: Plain of Wolves
description: A battlefield of the Schism War where the Tytali fought alongside Houses Tremere and Flambeau, referenced by the Tremere Primus Cercistum.

name: Planet
description: Astrological planets (Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, Mercury, Moon, Sun) governing effects and Green Cockerel degrees.

name: Plant's Withering Bane
description: A Perdo Herbam spell (Level 20) that withers and destroys one living plant up to the size of a small tree.

name: Plantagenet
description: Royal family of England, not known for patience.

name: Plate Armor
description: Armor of solid metal pieces; full Gothic plate is late medieval.

name: Plate and Mail
description: Mail strengthened with metal plates.

name: Plato's Comma
description: A fundamental flaw in the seven notes corresponding to the seven planets; research into it drives Hagen's lineage mad.

name: Play of the Virtues
description: Hildegard's morality play with music.

name: Player-Defined Pretenses
description: Pretenses corresponding to a faerie's story role rather than human abilities, negotiated with the troupe.

name: Player-Driven Stories
description: Stories where players decide scenery and characters met while the storyguide controls the plot.

name: Player-Influenced Stories
description: Stories where players alter events affecting their own character using plot devices.

name: Plea
description: The means by which noblemen raise legal issues with the Order, administered by redcaps, Guernicus or Jerbiton.

name: Pleasing Breath
description: Panther of Virtue power whose fragrant breath entrances humans and beasts.

name: Plestin-les Grèves
description: Bathhouse ruin entrance to the Yaudet regio.

name: Plot Device
description: A secret proverb given to a player to influence the plot once in a Faerie Realm adventure.

name: Plougerneau
description: Village.

name: Ploëmel
description: Town.

name: Plucking the Hair from the Billy Goat's Chin
description: CrVi 20 creating a temporary Arcane Connection to a demon.

name: Plundering
description: Low Crime of harvesting an undeclared vis source without an interim lease.

name: Pluralism
description: Practice of a single priest holding several benefices, technically outlawed.

name: Plutarch
description: Ancient writer who told of a seer proclaiming that 'Great Pan is dead'.

name: Pluto
description: God of the Underworld and hidden wealth whom Tremere's ancestors served, symbolized by the two-pronged pitchfork.

name: Pléchâtel
description: Village with caves and a vis oak.

name: Pneumonia
description: A Serious Phlegmatic Disease, an inflammation of the lungs caused by polluted air, prone to a Crisis on the seventh day.

name: Po
description: A river in which the young sun god Phaeton is said to have drowned after falling from the solar chariot.

name: Poacher
description: Illegal hunter on reserved land, sometimes of noble or clerical rank, fiercely punished.

name: Poine
description: The titan of vengeance and retribution and mother of the Erinyes; Tytalus's Prosopopoeia names the She-Wolf as her Aspect.

name: Poison the Air
description: Infernal dragon Power: exhaling poisonous smoke.

name: Poisoned Weapons
description: Fachan power smearing its weapons with deadly poison.

name: Poisoning the Fruit of the Vine
description: Salamander power making plants poisonous.

name: Poisoning the Well
description: Salamander power poisoning water by touch.

name: Poisoning the Will
description: A ritual spell that curses a place such as a valley, town, city, or covenant, gradually sapping the will and vitality from the people there.

name: Poisonous Blood
description: Polymathes' deadly blood that stays potent for nine days.

name: Poisonous Breath
description: Lindwurm power exhaling a cloud of poisonous black smoke.

name: Poisonous Skin
description: Salamander's constant contact poison.

name: Poisonous elemental
description: Elemental liberated by disturbing the poisoned battlefield that raids the mundane world.

name: Poitevins
description: Faction who came to England with King John's wife and are currently ascendant.

name: Poitiers
description: Ecclesiastic city with the Baptistery of St. John and Church of St. Hilary.

name: Poitou
description: County captured by Philip in 1205.

name: Pole Arm
description: Two-handed weapon usable to unseat a rider.

name: Pole Axe
description: Two-handed slashing weapon.

name: Poleyns
description: Knee protectors.

name: Policraticus
description: Work by John of Salisbury complaining about diviners common at court.

name: Polissons
description: A court of Parisian argotiers who go naked begging for clothes.

name: Political Agent
description: A thematic covenfolk template skilled in Intrigue, Guile, and Order of Hermes Lore, employed by covenants involved in Hermetic politics.

name: Pollute Water
description: An Aquam power of the basilisk Sordus that turns all standing water within 5 paces stagnant and putrefies other liquids; he cannot control it.

name: Polus
description: Ninth-century magus Trianomae whose diaries are at Durenmar.

name: Polyaigos
description: Island covenant in the Theban Tribunal running a school for Gifted children.

name: Polybius
description: Greek historian (202-122 BC) whose analysis of mixed Roman government inspired Guernicus's three arms of the Order.

name: Polymathes
description: An ancient, magically potent dragon who hoards rare books and scrolls in a tunnel lair of illusions.

name: Polyphemus
description: Last Cyclops of Sicily, nearly 50 feet tall and blinded by Ulysses, now lonely; Magic Might 40.

name: Pombal
description: Site of a major Templar fortress in Portugal.

name: Pomeranian Forest
description: One of Germany's most oppressive forests, dominated by pine, fir, holly, and evergreen oak; reputedly a stronghold of witches and werewolves and home to the sacred grove of Romowe.

name: Pomeranian tradition
description: A surviving pre-Hermetic magical tradition with which some of Bjornaer's descendants seek détente, fearing their Founder left it before learning all its rites.

name: Pomponius Mela
description: Roman historian who claimed nine virgin witches lived on Sein Island.

name: Pontarf
description: Irish giant fish nursery terror.

name: Pontida
description: Monastery where the Lombard League formed.

name: Pontifex Maximus
description: Title of the high priest of the Cult of Jupiter taken by Augustus.

name: Pontine Islands
description: Island group in the Tyrrhenian Sea in the Roman Tribunal, legendarily occupied by sirens.

name: Poor Combatant
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: loses 2 Attack and Defense with one combat Pretense.

name: Poor Disputer
description: A Minor General Flaw causing a character to suffer a -3 penalty on disputatio die rolls.

name: Poor Equipment
description: Flaw appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Poor Formulaic Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw subtracting 5 from every roll to cast Formulaic spells, though not Ritual spells.

name: Poor Intelligence
description: Flaw suggested for giants.

name: Poor Living Conditions
description: A Minor General Flaw giving an additional -1 Living Conditions Modifier, cumulative with the base modifier.

name: Poorly Insulated
description: A Minor laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab is poorly shielded from the outside, easily overheard and a nuisance to neighbors (-1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Poorly Trained Folk Witch
description: Minor General Flaw: 50 fewer apprenticeship experience points.

name: Poorly Trained Gruagach
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw reducing experience in gruagach Arts and spells.

name: Poorly Trained Magician
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw reducing experience points for Arts and charms by 50.

name: Pope Benedict
description: Pope whose ghost, saved from purgatory by Cluny, appeared to bless the Festival of All Souls.

name: Pope Calistus II
description: Pope who decreed clerical marriages invalid at the First Lateran Council in 1123.

name: Pope Calixtus II
description: Pope who signed the Concordat of Worms with Emperor Henry V in 1122.

name: Pope Celestine II
description: Pope who proclaimed Milites Templi in 1144.

name: Pope Clement III
description: Pope with good relations to Joachim of Flora.

name: Pope Clement IV
description: Guido Le Gros from Saint-Gilles.

name: Pope Gelasius I
description: Pope who abolished the Lupercalia in the fifth century.

name: Pope Gregory II
description: Pope of legend who may have passed Vatican texts to Bonisagus.

name: Pope Gregory the Great
description: A pope, later a saint, at whose earnest request God allowed the Roman Emperor Trajan to be saved after death, with a warning not to ask such things again.

name: Pope Innocent IV
description: Pope to whom Clare's completed written rule is presented in 1253.

name: Pope Leo
description: Pope to whom some copies of the malleus epistula are attributed.

name: Pope Leo I
description: Pope who declared the Church independent and turned Attila from Rome, reputedly with demons at his command.

name: Pope Leo IV
description: Pope (847-855) who authored the Homilia Leonis, a popular enumeration of visitation articles.

name: Pope Leo IX
description: Pope who in 1050 controlled no benefices outside the province of Rome.

name: Pope Martin IV
description: Simon de Brie.

name: Pope Nicholas II
description: Pope who excommunicated William and Matilda for being cousins.

name: Pope Urban II
description: Pope who preached the First Crusade at the Council of Clermont in 1095.

name: Pope Urban III
description: Pope with good relations to Joachim of Flora.

name: Pope Urban IV
description: Jacques Pantaléon from Troyes.

name: Pope Zacharias
description: Eighth-century pope who allied with Pepin the Short.

name: Pope Zachary
description: Pope who removed Uriel from the list of angels recognized by the Western Church in 745.

name: Popolo
description: Political societies of wealthy tradesmen opposing the magnates in the communes.

name: Porphyry
description: Greek philosopher whose teachings the Brethren of Purity combined in their encyclopedia.

name: Porta Salaria
description: Gate on the eastern side of Rome near the Church of Saint Aquila.

name: Porte de Mars
description: Roman triumphal gate at the north of Reims.

name: Portiuncula
description: Site at Assisi of the Franciscans' first general chapter meeting.

name: Porto
description: Cardinal-bishop town.

name: Portunalia
description: Portunes's feast on August 17th.

name: Possess the Deceased Host
description: Similar spell letting a ghostly magus possess and animate a corpse.

name: Possess the Living Host
description: ReCo 30 spell letting a ghost enter and control a living body.

name: Pot Plants
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab contains dozens of potted plants (+1 Upkeep, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Herbam).

name: Potamoi
description: Greek genii loci of the rivers.

name: Potenza
description: Town about nine miles south of Magvillus.

name: Potion Brewing
description: Folk witch laboratory activity of brewing doses of potions in the kitchen, costing vis per dose and effect; potions grant temporary Supernatural Abilities or effects.

name: Pottage
description: The peasants' second staple, a soup or stew of boiled oats, grains, legumes, vegetables and scraps, exempt from milling and baking charges.

name: Poulains
description: Syrian-born Westerners among the brother-knights.

name: Pound of Enumerus
description: A Hermetic accounting concept named after the magus Enumerus: at least one pound of covenant spending each year that can never be fully accounted for.

name: Poverty
description: Hook resulting from repeated raids.

name: Powder
description: Alchemical creation using charta mechanics without astrology.

name: Powers of Transformation
description: Guidance on designing faerie transformation abilities as Greater Powers or Focus Powers.

name: Powys
description: An ancient Welsh principality in the central regions, centered on the fort of Mathrafal; home of Gwenwynwyn and the abbey of Strata Florida.

name: Praecepsus of Flambeau
description: Magus accused of using a Perdo-enchanted sword in 1111.

name: Praeda
description: Covenant running an auction of vis smuggled from southern Tribunals, contrary to the Perthean Compact.

name: Praefactus of Bonisagus
description: A magus of House Bonisagus whose wizard's sigil makes him appear as dignified as possible; his version of Seven-league Stride always lets him arrive in a safe place.

name: Prague Street
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city.

name: Pralix Incident
description: Event leading to the Order of Miscellany.

name: Precarious
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab sits in a supernaturally dangerous place such as inside a volcano (-1 Safety).

name: Precentor
description: Monk responsible for music and chants.

name: Precious Ingredients
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is supplied with more expensive ingredients than typical (+1 General Quality, +2 Upkeep, +1 Longevity Rituals).

name: Precocious Girls
description: Gifted girls accidentally initiated as if unGifted by a coven.

name: Predecessor
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab retains foibles of its notable previous owner (-1 Safety, +1 Warping, +1 Experimentation).

name: Predictive Stigmata
description: A Minor Story Supernatural Flaw whose stigmata predict future challenges symbolically and may flee the body to become adulterations if ignored.

name: Prelum of Tremere
description: Goliard's filia at Blackthorn, a polite young maga with a remarkable talent for Vim, contrasting with her sister Fornax.

name: Premysl
description: A farmer found plowing with two oxen who became Libuse's husband and the founder of Bohemia's ruling Premyslid dynasty.

name: Presbyter Judaeorum
description: Chief rabbi of all English Jews, held in 1220 by Josce of London.

name: Preserved
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab or its contents are immune to natural decay (-1 Upkeep, +1 Warping, +2 Health, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Creo).

name: Prestigious Family
description: Virtue possessed by Domnhull Beg.

name: Preternatural Tether
description: A tether of non-natural origin caused by mortals, magic beings, or vis, scoring 1 to 5: magic monuments, magic residues, magic beings or vis sources.

name: Prevailing Discipline
description: An optional measure, tracked like Prevailing Loyalty, of how disciplined a covenant's covenfolk are, modifying rolls related to their duties.

name: Priam
description: The elderly faerie lord of Ilium who claims descent from Zeus and granted the town its charter; his son Paris hosts a beauty contest at the mid-summer fair.

name: Priceless Ingredients
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is supplied with copious gold and gems (+2 General Quality, +4 Upkeep, +2 Longevity Rituals).

name: Pricking Thumbs
description: Example Lesser Benediction sensing ill will.

name: Priest (Virtue)
description: Minor Social Status Virtue for an ordained priest who can conduct Mass and is subject to canon law.

name: Priest's Wife
description: Grog template of a practical housewife married to a parish priest, a confidante of local women.

name: Priesthood of Gruagach
description: Pictish priests of the god Gruagach who ensured crops and herds prospered and served as judges; ancestors of the gruagachan.

name: Priests of Mercury
description: Neo-Mercurian rank; one Priest cares for each temple and organizes the Mercuralia rites.

name: Prima of House Ex Miscellanea
description: Head of House Ex Miscellanea who refuses all outside contact while preparing for an apocalypse she has predicted for decades.

name: Primal Spirit
description: Spirit governing the whole earth, possibly identified with Mother Earth by some.

name: Primate
description: Rank sought by ambitious archbishops; several archdioceses are raised to primacies in the 13th century, but the effort to create a superior Western rank fails.

name: Prime
description: Canonical hour of the Divine Office: Service at 7 am when monks are roused from bed.

name: Prime Qualities
description: Properties of a thing derived from its matter and essential form, including the elemental mixture of hot, cold, moisture and dryness, readily discerned with the senses.

name: Primeval Giants
description: Immense giants of many mythologies, children of the Protogonoi and ancestors of Gods and Daimons, ranked by theurgists as kosmokrators; comparable in power to Archangels.

name: Primi of Criamon
description: The ghosts of past Criamon primi who remain at the Cave, teach rarely and influence history through the living Primus.

name: Primitive Equipment
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character can use only the simplest tools and equipment, suffering penalties when forced to use anything beyond Inexpensive weapons and armor.

name: Primitive Tradition
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: the folk witch cannot brew potions.

name: Primogeniture
description: Inheritance by the eldest son, now accepted for the thrones of England and France.

name: Primus of House Guernicus
description: Head of House Guernicus, one of two who know the Legion's affiliation with the Quaesitores.

name: Prince Camaralzaman
description: Prince of a Thousand and One Nights tale with Princess Badoura.

name: Prince Ivan
description: Hero example used for identification in Elysium.

name: Prince Louis
description: Heir of Philip Augustus, born 1187, not yet anointed; invaded England in 1216.

name: Prince Louis of France
description: French prince offered the English crown by the barons and defeated by William Marshal.

name: Prince of Gwynedd
description: A Welsh noble who has expressed interest in examining the seemingly immortal Gwrhyr; a court date has been set in the Fate of Cad Gadu story.

name: Prince's Magical Caman
description: Magical caman of the Prince that drives a ball twice as far and makes it turn twice in flight (ReTe(An) 15).

name: Princes of Evil
description: Rulers of the sitra achra, the Infernal realm, in Kabbalist writings.

name: Princes of Mecklenburg
description: Declining Sorbian noble family in northern Germany who worship the demon Radegast and are members of the Dread Host.

name: Princess
description: Dramatic role of the object of the hero's quest or a prize acquired along the way; can be any person or object.

name: Princess of the Shining Star
description: Young lady confined in a glass tower in a Magic regio (story seed).

name: Principal
description: A character (often a magus) who controls an agency of agents.

name: Principal Mistress
description: Woman selected annually to lead a large beguinage.

name: Principality of Achaea
description: Greek principality containing Cape Tainaron.

name: Principia Magica
description: The authoritative summa on Magic Theory written by Bonisagus; the Great Library holds three copies.

name: Prinz
description: German title for the child of a king.

name: Prior of Thetford
description: Corrupt Cluniac prior in England experimenting with binding spirits into murals.

name: Priory of Saint Nerius
description: Secret holy societas of Hermetic magi following a modified Benedictine Rule, seeking Nerius's canonization; its central house lies in the mountains of northern Italy.

name: Priory of St Gervais
description: Priory in Rouen where William the Conqueror died.

name: Priory of St. Nerius
description: Group seeking recognition of St. Nerius, with whom Eloi has contact.

name: Pripet Major
description: A covenant in the Novgorod Tribunal near the terminus of the one-way faerie trod from the Ziegensteine on Rugen.

name: Pripet Marshes
description: A wilderness ancestor site in the Novgorod Tribunal, the supposed origin of all the Slavic people, protected by the covenant Pripet Maior.

name: Prison for Mice and Birds
description: Cat power, a version of Circle of Beast Warding.

name: Private chapel
description: Chapel of nobles, castles, or guilds licensed for private use.

name: Privilege of Poverty
description: 1228 privilege from Pope Gregory IX confirming the Poor Sisters' right to refuse endowments.

name: Privileges of Criamon
description: A Grand Tribunal ruling that allows for House Criamon customs such as the ceremonial slaying of a willing Primus.

name: Prize Pawns
description: Gold tokens exchanged for Tourney prizes.

name: Pro-Lotharingian Faction
description: Magi retaining Cavillor as legal advisor.

name: Pro-Lotharingian Tribunal Faction
description: Faction seeking to create a new Lotharingian Tribunal from parts of the Normandy and Rhine Tribunals ahead of the Grand Tribunal of 1228.

name: Probationer
description: One who seeks entry to a Mystery Cult but has not yet been Initiated.

name: Probe Nature's Hidden Lore
description: An Intellego Herbam spell (Level 4) that tells you what kind of plant you are touching and gives an image of it in its natural habitat.

name: Probe for Pure Gold
description: InTe 4 spell, a variant of Probe for Pure Silver, known by the sample Verditius apprentice.

name: Procella of Quaesitor
description: Full member of Magvillus and Traditionalist.

name: Processions of the Dead
description: Nightwalker processions along the Ways of the Dead with the recently departed, keeping the ways clear and regulating the unquiet dead.

name: Production Artist
description: An artist who produces tangible artwork using a Craft Ability, akin to a craftsman, taking the Social Status Virtue Craftsman.

name: Profession (Soldier)
description: Ability referenced as used or valued by Tremere magi or creatures.

name: Profession Miner
description: Ability allowing mining operations in place of Profession Sapper with three botch dice.

name: Profession Sapper
description: Ability governing planning and execution of tunnelling to undermine walls, and counter-mining; cannot be used untrained.

name: Profession Siege Engineer
description: Academic Ability to design and construct siege engines and understand defensive engineering.

name: Profession: Accountant
description: Ability usurer characters should start with.

name: Profession: Carpenter
description: Carpentry profession ability.

name: Profession: Cellaress
description: Profession of the nunnery official responsible for food and drink.

name: Profession: Chamberlain
description: A Profession Ability used (with Presence) to compute the loyalty bonus contributed by a Chamberlain specialist.

name: Profession: Drover
description: Ability for damage rolls of the wagon.

name: Profession: Falconer
description: Ability governing care, breeding and acquisition of hawks and falcons.

name: Profession: Gardener
description: Ability referenced in this text.

name: Profession: Herald
description: Ability to recognize knights by device, recall their deeds, adjudicate tournament law and locate tournaments.

name: Profession: Laborer
description: Ability used by nightwalker characters in this chapter.

name: Profession: Mason
description: Profession held by a master stonemason in a parish's specialists.

name: Profession: Minnesinger
description: A Profession Ability for the German minstrel art; Wolfram von Eschenbach uses it to determine his songs' Aesthetic Quality.

name: Profession: Mount
description: Ability of Aeolus.

name: Profession: Preacher
description: Ability describing a preacher's development; can always be learned by listening to a preacher.

name: Profession: Reeve
description: Profession relevant to managing monastic estates.

name: Profession: Sailor
description: Ability used to pilot and navigate boats.

name: Profession: Shadchan
description: Profession ability of the Jewish marriage broker.

name: Profession: Terrar
description: Profession of a monastery's land agent.

name: Profession: Torturer
description: Ability referenced in this text.

name: Profession: Trouvère
description: A Profession Ability for the northern French minstrel art; Brogo uses it to compose and perform songs with a high Aesthetic Quality.

name: Prognosis Total
description: A medical total (Intelligence + Medicine + modifiers) compared against a disease's severity to determine whether a physician is skilled enough to plan therapy.

name: Progressives
description: Highly skilled Bonisagus magi who view the Founder as fallible and do not see themselves as inferior to his generation.

name: Prolific Artist
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue that reduces the time to create a piece of artwork by one quarter, but prevents the use of assistants.

name: Promethea
description: First Traitor, filia of Kalliste, who waited out the struggle against Tasgillia and became a Quaesitor.

name: Promise of Service
description: A promised action accompanying an offer that symbolically transfers vitality to Faerie and negates the story's threat.

name: Promised Favors
description: Minor covenant Boon for lieges.

name: Promoscundus
description: Title of the chef chosen as master of all chefs catering for the Grand Tribunal.

name: Prone to Chance
description: A Minor Ordeal Flaw making a Verditius magus keen on risk-taking, forcing experimentation on every applicable laboratory activity; incompatible with Averse to Risk.

name: Pronia
description: Byzantine grants of land revenues in exchange for military support.

name: Prop (Range)
description: Faerie Range where the caster touches the target with something he is also touching; equivalent to Touch.

name: Proposal Rulings
description: Tribunal rulings proposed for debate, which must be published two years in advance.

name: Prosopopoeia
description: Tytalus's summa on Magic Lore (Level 4, Quality 9); it names the She-Wolf as an Aspect of Poine.

name: Protagoras
description: A Sophist quoted in the Analects of Tytalus who taught that humans are the yardstick for deciding what is real, and that there is no independent truth.

name: Protantus of Quaesitor
description: Listed full member of Magvillus.

name: Protected Guest
description: A covenant membership status extended to visitors by a single full member, affording basic rights but no vote or council obligation.

name: Protection from Diseases
description: Major Child Supernatural Virtue granting immunity to all diseases from a supernatural agent.

name: Protection of the Close Friend
description: Shedim Power preventing the victim from acting directly against the demon.

name: Protinus Velox
description: Magus of House Verditius, supporter of change.

name: Protinus Velox of Verditius
description: Somewhat selfless Verditius magus, scribe and bookbinder, who secretly sells enchanted books to mundanes and supports loosening restrictions on interaction with society; his blood was turned to ink by Twilight.

name: Protinus's Enchanted Tome
description: Great enchanted tome carrying most of Protinus' spell effects; he also sells enchanted 'spell books' to mundanes.

name: Province
description: An archbishop's jurisdiction over neighboring dioceses.

name: Province (Twilight Void)
description: One of at least ten versions of the Twilight Void, each associated with a Form tied to Magic Might; travelers perceive only things of their province.

name: Provins
description: Champagne fair city with the Caesar Tower and court of Theobald IV.

name: Provocator
description: The certamen School of Challengers, which sacrifices Initiative for a higher Resistance Total; its members are social, organized and flippant in duels.

name: Provost
description: Historic head of a chapter of canons, assisted by the camerarius and cellerarius; largely disappeared by 1220.

name: Proxy Voting
description: Giving one's sigil to another magus to vote on one's behalf, as a directed or free proxy.

name: Prunellie of Merinita
description: An elderly Merinita maga studying the urban faeries of the Low Countries, allied with kabouters; she chose Florum's site.

name: Prémontré
description: Abbey in the Cuise Forest founded by St. Norbert, mother house of the Premonstratensians.

name: Psalter
description: Book of psalms that most monks know by heart and that is read during meals.

name: Pseudo-Democritus
description: Author of the earliest known Greek alchemical text, Physika kai Mystika.

name: Pseudopods
description: Brollachan power to extend fleshy tentacles to strike, grapple and smother foes.

name: Psychological and Rational Sciences
description: Book Three of the Epistles; summa for Elementalist Fire.

name: Psychopomp
description: A faerie that leads the spirits of the dead to an afterlife, a role of Hermes in classical times, now rare because of the Dominion.

name: Psychopompic tradition
description: Belief that the soul must pass spiritual guardians after death by knowing secret passwords.

name: Public penance
description: Canon punishment such as clergy chanting the psalter at each other or providing rushes for the church floor.

name: Puff of Flame
description: Varkos' power to spit a ball of flame.

name: Puffed Up and Hissing
description: Personal cat power granting extra mass, a version of Beast of Outlandish Size.

name: Pugnatis
description: Maga convicted of controlling the mayor of Laval and expelled in 1207.

name: Puissant (Rune)
description: Supernatural Virtue available to vitkir.

name: Puissant Artes Liberales
description: A Virtue making a character particularly adept with all seven liberal arts; the Sons of the Peters receive an Infernally tainted version from demonic tempters.

name: Puissant Bows
description: Virtue boosting the Bows ability; held by Baudouin.

name: Puissant Carouse
description: Virtue or creature Quality listed for a being (Anne, Minerva Sulis, Balneator) or setting feature described here.

name: Puissant Charm
description: Virtue; bonus not cumulative with Free Expression for offers.

name: Puissant Church Lore
description: Virtue listed in this text.

name: Puissant Craft or Profession Ability
description: A Minor Virtue a maestro may select at no cost, granting a bonus to a Craft or Profession Ability such as Painting.

name: Puissant Enchanting Music
description: A Virtue adding a bonus to the Enchanting Music Ability; held by the Minstrel template.

name: Puissant Enigmatic Wisdom
description: A Hermetic Virtue gained as the first Fruit of the Path of Warping.

name: Puissant Faerie Lore
description: Virtue granted as a Charmed Virtue by the rite A Proper Blessing.

name: Puissant Heartbeast
description: A common Virtue for Bjornaer magi giving a bonus to the Heartbeast Ability.

name: Puissant Imaginem
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue boosting the Imaginem Art, available to Confraternity of Irene Initiates.

name: Puissant Intellego
description: A Hermetic Virtue granting a bonus to the Intellego Technique; possessed by Tabanus.

name: Puissant Kabbalah
description: Virtue granting a bonus to Kabbalah, taken by the kabbalist template.

name: Puissant Merchant
description: Virtue taken by the Radhanite merchant template.

name: Puissant Militant Pretense
description: Flaw appearing in faerie statistics in this text (Puissant Militant Pretense).

name: Puissant Othila
description: Puissant Art Virtue for the Othila rune, giving Eirik a +2 bonus.

name: Puissant Profession: Torturer
description: Virtue referenced in this text.

name: Puissant Ride
description: Virtue granted by tack made from the Enriched hooves of the Great Stallion of the Camargue.

name: Puissant Scribe
description: Virtue taken by the sofer template.

name: Puissant Smith
description: Dexithea's minor Virtue boosting Craft: Smith.

name: Puissant Swordsmith
description: A Virtue providing a bonus to the Swordsmith Craft Ability, held by the example craftsman Klaus.

name: Puissant Teaching
description: Virtue of the Franciscan Teacher template.

name: Pulch
description: A magus of House Merinita who haunts the Kammerforst posing as a Waldgeist, chastising those who steal wood, and skirts close to the edge of Hermetic Law.

name: Pulsed Saga
description: A saga style alternating detailed stories with passages of several years, ideal for sagas of transformation.

name: Pumbedita
description: Babylonian yeshivah city.

name: Pumilius
description: The certamen School of the (Amusing) Dwarfs, which projects humorous images into the shared illusion to make opponents lose an attack or defense; some Tremere find it offensive.

name: Pungent Potion of Ease
description: CrCo 20 charged potion restoring a Short-Term Fatigue level that becomes Long-Term on expiry.

name: Punic Wars
description: Wars destroying Carthage, possibly with Infernal aid.

name: Punishments
description: Purely retributive Hermetic penalties set in a hierarchy of severity, from seasons of service to death of a familiar.

name: Purification of the Festering Wound
description: A Creo Corpus spell that provides a bonus to a wound Recovery roll, adding to any bonus from medical attention.

name: Purim
description: Celebration with public reading of the Book of Esther.

name: Purple Fideli
description: Faction of House Tytalus backing Buliste as the true Prima.

name: Purple Islands
description: Almost-mythical Atlantic islands ruled by a caste of magicians, with Magic and Faerie auras and vis.

name: Pursuit
description: Act in which the hero is pursued on his journey home and rescued by magical agent, helper, or quest object.

name: Pursuit Total
description: Hound Perception + Hunt + stress die minus fatigue, opposed to the prey's Evasion Total.

name: Pusiel
description: An Avenger of Evil whose angel-like name means Fire of God.

name: Puss in Boots
description: Helper cat who makes his master undeservedly rich.

name: Puy de Dôme
description: Volcano with a shrine to Lug, Mercury and St. Barnabas, and a temple of Mercury regio.

name: Pwyll, Prince of Dyfed
description: Welsh legendary prince.

name: Pyramids
description: Monuments in Egypt near which magi established a covenant and a desert laboratory beside the great Sphinx.

name: Pyroeis
description: Planetary spirit of Mars, ruling war, fire and monsters.

name: Pyromancy
description: Divinatory method using observing flames, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Pythagorean (degree)
description: Final degree of the Fraternity of Samos, requiring a five-year vow of silence as a Major Ordeal.

name: Pythagorean Lore
description: Pythagorean teaching holding that three is the first real number and linking the elements to geometric solids.

name: Pytho
description: One of the Maskim, Prince of the Spirits of Deceit, who has lied to prophets and oracles and is believed to have been the serpent in Eden.

name: Pépin
description: Son of Charles Martel who seized the throne from the Merovingians in 754.

name: Qarmatians
description: Revolutionary Isma'ili group found in Iraq and Arabia.

name: Qiyas
description: Legal reasoning by analogy.

name: Quaertus of Bonisagus
description: A magus of House Bonisagus credited as author of the encyclopedia De Ordinis Hermetici, covering the Code of Hermes and Order of Hermes Lore.

name: Quaesitor Celestin
description: Quaesitor who ruled mundane resources do not contribute to magical power.

name: Quaesitor Fluvius
description: Quaesitor who wrote The Order and Towns and invented An Ear for Distant Bells.

name: Quaesitor Investigator
description: Magus template: a newly initiated Quaesitor seeking to cleanse the Loch Leglean Tribunal without real authority.

name: Quaesitor Lothaire
description: Chief Quaesitor of Normandy who permitted mundane raiding; later joined Magvillus.

name: Quaesitor Whent
description: Quaesitor who stripped Fudarus of a legacy lease in 1172.

name: Quaesitor in Good Standing
description: Status proven by a letter signed by the Guernicus Primus, less than seven years old, without which a Quaesitor has no authority.

name: Quality of Arms and Armor
description: Rules from City & Guild for shoddy, standard, superior and excellent items; superior/excellent items grant bonuses, shoddy ones break easily.

name: Quarterstaff
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Quarterstaff Attack
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Quarterstaff Parry
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Quaternuli
description: David of Dinant's confiscated book of 'little note-books'; a tractatus describing the Infernal Virtue Incantation with a Quality of 13.

name: Quedlinburg
description: A Saxon town that was briefly the German capital under Henry the Fowler, later ruled by abbesses of a collegiate foundation; the lair of the Boglin lies near it.

name: Queen Guinevere
description: Queen whose kiss with Lancelot occurred at the Bridge of Secrets.

name: Queen Ingebourg
description: French queen whose will Haimard will execute.

name: Queen Isabella
description: The king's mother and countess of Angoulême, wife of Hugh de Lusignan, threatening to withdraw her support unless she receives more aid.

name: Queen Margaret
description: English princess, wife of Malcolm Canmore, who brought the Roman Church to Scotland; canonized in 1230.

name: Queen of Elfland
description: Faerie ruler of the community in the Eildon Hills.

name: Queen of Snowflakes
description: A powerful faerie, former lover of the Blackberry God, who controls the land above the tree-line and obstructs the Worshipful covenant's vis collection.

name: Queen of the Herd
description: Champion cow of Martigny's festival, possibly once host of a protective faerie spirit.

name: Queen's Champion
description: Consort ruling the Apple Mile, won by challenge on Midsummer's Day.

name: Quell the Savage Waves
description: Eider Duck power (ReAq 35) dampening waves within ten paces.

name: Quellen Marsh
description: Marsh near the Léguer.

name: Quench the Raging Conflagration
description: A PeIg 20 spell that extinguishes any fire up to the size of a house fire, learned by many Flambeau magi to control accidental Creo Ignem fires.

name: Quern
description: Hand mill for grinding grain, illegal in some places because lords demand use of their mill.

name: Quest Components
description: Valued deeds (pilgrimage, preaching, alms, crusade) totaling a Path Total.

name: Question
description: Munkar and Nakir's power compelling truthful answers.

name: Question the Cursed
description: General-level TaCu spell revealing who cast a curse, its level, duration and Limit, or the terms of a geas.

name: Questor
description: Wandering preachers who sell indulgences.

name: Quiberon
description: Island.

name: Quiet the Cursing Tongue
description: A ReVi spell of the Lineage of Pralix that prevents a target from using lower-level curse magic.

name: Quimper
description: Main town of Cornouaille.

name: Quinctilia
description: An ancient Roman family (genus) that ran the Luperci and gave its name to the Quinctiliani college.

name: Quinctiliani
description: One of the two colleges of the Luperci, named after the ancient Roman Quinctilia family; it is led by its own magister luperci.

name: Quinsy
description: A Serious Phlegmatic Disease contracted from swallowing worms that live in and swell the tonsils.

name: Quintin
description: Market town.

name: Quintinus of Verditius
description: Verditius magus who constructs new Stone Couches.

name: Quintus
description: A magus used as an example for writing books, with Ignem 24, Communication -1, and Language 5, who writes an Ignem summa.

name: Quit-Claim of Canterbury
description: Document by which Richard I sold William the Lion back Scotland's independence.

name: Quotidian Fever
description: Serious disease inflicted by the Curse of Quotidian Fever.

name: Quraysh
description: Dominant tribe of Mecca, guardians of the Ka'ba sanctuary, to which Muhammad belonged.

name: Ra
description: Ancient Egyptian god Iozheza sought to meet.

name: Ra's al-Sana
description: Muslim New Year.

name: Rabacyl
description: Ruler of Shehaqin.

name: Rabbi Eleazor
description: Rabbi of Worms who insists the memunim are deputy angels and dispensers of dreams.

name: Rabies
description: A Serious Choleric Disease caused by the bite of a mad dog, inflaming the choler and reducing the sufferer's mind to that of a furious beast.

name: Radiant Invisibility
description: Chalkydri power.

name: Radiant Mirror
description: Thrones power reflecting Primal Divine Light to raise a Divine aura by two with a Just Temper.

name: Radislav am Polanach
description: Polish Criamon magus at Crun Clach studying the Enigma among the faeries.

name: Raedbora
description: Whitburh's raven familiar that loves shiny objects.

name: Raibert Mac Donncadh
description: Son of Donncadh and tanist of Clan Mac Gruagach, a reckless hell-raiser and warrior friendly with Aonghus Lamh Iarran.

name: Rain of Oil
description: A Muto Auram ritual (Level 50) that turns rain into droplets of flammable oil, drenching the landscape; can be ignited with Creo Ignem magic.

name: Rainbow Fluorite
description: Rainbow Fluorite listed in the Tribunal index among minerals and substances.

name: Raisa of Ex Miscellanea
description: Maga of the Novgorod Tribunal and dream theorist who founded the Volshebnii Mechtateli tradition after learning Baltic dream magic and pulling real items from dreams.

name: Raisa of Novgorod
description: Maga who in the early tenth century synthesized Baltic dream folk tradition into Hermetic Dream Magic.

name: Raise the Siege
description: ReMe 30 spell that, via arcane connection, gives a besieging commander a pessimistic view of the siege through the day.

name: Raise the Veronese Flag
description: CrIm 30 spell creating the illusion of ten Veronese men-at-arms manning castle walls.

name: Raised in the Gutter
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character was raised on the margins of society and suffers -3 when using social Abilities among her betters.

name: Rally the Defeated Troops
description: ReMe 20 spell of Edwin's that rallies troops, granting Brave and Obedient traits.

name: Rallying a Group
description: A leader's action (Presence + Leadership + stress die) that improves a routed group to disordered or restores a disordered group to normal.

name: Ralph de Cierrey
description: Local dean elected bishop of Evreux after Luke.

name: Ralph de Neville
description: The vice-chancellor of England, a bastard son of a baronial family and royal clerk who does almost all the chancellor's work in the absence of the Great Seal.

name: Ramius
description: A mid-rank House Tremere magus who defected to House Flambeau after the Sundering of Tremere in 848 AD; skilled in mundane arms, he created the School of Ramius and fought Moorish wizards in Iberia.

name: Ramon Berengeur II
description: Count of Barcelona and Marquis of Provence who became a Templar confrere and gave them Granyena.

name: Ramon Lull
description: Scholar discussing alchemy.

name: Ramsey
description: One of the three towns on the Isle of Man.

name: Rancrax
description: Tytalus magus who founded Infelicitas after losing a wager, slain in Wizard's War by a magus of Moles Magna.

name: Ranitel of Jerbiton
description: Member of Feritel.

name: Ranrouët
description: Fortress under construction guarding the north side of the Grande Brière marsh.

name: Ransom
description: Payment (usually horse, armor or weapons) extracted from a surrendering knight.

name: Ranulf de Blundeville
description: Earl of Chester since 1180, an elder statesman of England and head of the palatinate of Cheshire, on Crusade in the Holy Land in 1220.

name: Raoul II
description: Baron of Fougères who led Breton nobles against Henry II.

name: Rapid Ordination
description: Acceleration through several grades at once, granting only 1 Faith Point.

name: Raqia
description: The Second Heaven, imprisoning evil angels, ruled by Raphael, Galizur and Zachariel.

name: Rarefied Tradition
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: the folk witch can only use Supernatural Abilities via potions.

name: Rashi
description: Rabbi of Troyes famous for commentaries on the Tanakh and Talmud.

name: Rashi's Commentaries
description: Two great tractatus in Theology (Judaism), Quality 13.

name: Rashid al-Din Sinan
description: Greatest master of the Syrian Assassins (r. 1162-c.1193), said to be a magician; threatened Saladin.

name: Rasus of Flambeau
description: A magus of House Flambeau and secret infernalist who seduced Raquel and trained her as Releganta; he deals with ghosts and spirits.

name: Rat Up a Drainpipe
description: A Minor General Virtue letting a character run through urban areas unobstructed using acrobatics, climbing, and dodging, aiding opposed Athletics rolls when chased.

name: Raucus
description: Example magus with Mutable Blatant Gift.

name: Rav Hamnuna Sava
description: Talmudic sage turned faerie appearing as an ass-driver teaching secrets of the Oral Torah.

name: Ravagers
description: Faeries that hunt magi seeking their longevity formula.

name: Raymond
description: Adopted son of the Count of Poitiers who married Mélusine.

name: Raymond of Poitiers
description: Ruler of Antioch, Eleanor's uncle, rumored lover.

name: Raziel
description: Angel who revealed the Sefer ha-Razim to Noah and Sefer Raziel to Adam.

name: Reaction
description: Roll responding to external events, like Defense or Concentration, that is not an action.

name: Read Lips
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Read it
description: Walter's power to discuss any book his audience has read.

name: Reading the Perturbations of Place
description: Dowsing Summa by Goodwin in the Orleans library.

name: Realia
description: Collections of mundane or magical objects (preserved animals, minerals, gemstones, bones) that magi study as a tractatus and use as clues for Intellego magic.

name: Realm Affiliation
description: Association of supernatural Virtues, Flaws and Abilities with a realm for realm interaction purposes.

name: Realm Interaction Effects
description: Negative aura effects on magic from other realms, which Entreat the Powers can mitigate.

name: Realm of Polyphemus
description: Fog-shrouded devastated lands of eastern Sicily where Polyphemus lives.

name: Realms of Power: Faerie
description: An Ars Magica sourcebook whose character creation and advancement rules can handle faerie-realm legendary artists.

name: Realms of Power: The Infernal
description: An Ars Magica sourcebook cited for rules on Infernal Ceremonies and infernalist abilities relevant to the False Power Flaw.

name: Reanimation
description: Permanent hagbui power (CrCo 45) healing a body level per round.

name: Reason
description: Rising force of rational thought producing Auras of Reason that may discount magic.

name: Rebel Passion
description: Virtue appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Rebellious
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character reacts adversely to any attempt to impose authority and works against those in command.

name: Rebellious Son
description: Companion vocation: a northern noble family's son turned sellsword.

name: Recets
description: Safe havens in the melee field where no fighting is allowed.

name: Recitation (Duration)
description: Holy magic Duration lasting as long as the caster recites scripture or prayer; equal to Concentration.

name: Recitation Score
description: Intelligence + Ars Notoria + modifiers; plus a stress die gives the recitation total.

name: Reckless Disengagement
description: Option to move away from combat with no Defense roll, granting a free attack.

name: Reconciliation
description: Final act of the fairy tale, in which the hero acquires the object he sought, such as a wedding or return home.

name: Rector Maris
description: A covenant founded on the Isle of Man in 866 and destroyed within six months.

name: Rector Novus
description: A covenant founded on the Isle of Man in 938 and destroyed within a year.

name: Red Cap of the Merfolk
description: Magical red cap or hat that gives merfolk their fish tail; its theft allows capture, and humans finding it can become merfolk.

name: Red Devils
description: A sports team consisting entirely of demons, captained by Hulikang.

name: Red Ettin
description: A three-headed giant who imprisoned the princess of Scotland, can turn people to stone and smell humans; answering his riddles is his Sovereign Ward.

name: Red Horseman
description: Demon of the second seal who takes peace from the earth.

name: Red Riding Hood
description: Fairy tale girl whose varied versions are all good story material.

name: Red Sea
description: Sea parted by God after Rahab refused Moses.

name: Red Sky at Dawn, Blue Sky at Dusk
description: Empathy/Grant ritual tinting a Faerie aura with one of the caster's Sympathy Traits.

name: Redcap (faerie)
description: A solitary dark faerie living in cliffs and abandoned towers that drops stones on passersby and dips its hat in their blood.

name: Redcap Warming Pin
description: Enchanted hatpin containing survival magic, passed between redcaps to keep them warm.

name: Redcap network
description: House Mercere's Hermetic postal and trade network.

name: Redemption
description: A sinner may always escape Hell by truly repenting, via confession and penance or ritual fasts of atonement.

name: Redon
description: Highest port on the River Vilaine accessible to sea-going craft, site of the Abbey of St. Savior and a trade distribution point.

name: Reduced (Characteristic)
description: Major Inferiority reducing a Characteristic already -5 or less.

name: Reduced Attack
description: Minor Inferiority reducing a natural weapon's Attack by 2.

name: Reduced Damage
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw decreasing a natural weapon's Damage by 2.

name: Reduced Defense
description: Minor Inferiority reducing a natural weapon's Defense by 2.

name: Reduced Fatigue
description: Minor Inferiority removing a Fatigue level.

name: Reforging Items
description: A Minor House Inner Mystery of Verditius for re-forging or repairing items, part of the Confraternity of Roland's mystery path.

name: Regal Countenance
description: Adramelech's Power forcing obedience to terse orders.

name: Regarder
description: Knights appointed every third year to census threats to forest animals.

name: Regars
description: Review parade of both sides before the melee.

name: Regeneration
description: Faerie bodies regenerate as suits their story; if killed they rebuild a body over months based on Might and Aura.

name: Regimen
description: A tailor-made recipe of diet, exercise and bloodletting prescribed by a physician to control the non-naturals and ensure eucrasia, providing a Living Conditions bonus.

name: Reginald
description: A wandering minstrel who plays a rebec of exceptional quality inherited from his minstrel father; his playing causes Imaginem vis to accumulate in the instrument's bowstrings.

name: Reginald's Rebec
description: A three-stringed fiddle of exceptional quality played by the minstrel Reginald; it grants a +3 bonus to Music rolls and accumulates Imaginem vis in its horsehair bowstrings when played well.

name: Regio (spirit power)
description: Ritual spirit power, usable only by spirits with Presence, that forms a Magic regio layer in the spirit's landscape; Might spent is permanently lost.

name: Regio Sight Roll
description: Roll to see a regio boundary.

name: Rego Mentem
description: A Hermetic Technique-and-Form combination (Control Mind) used to make disloyal covenfolk loyal or to compel obedience regardless of emotion.

name: Rego Vim
description: A Hermetic combination governing control of magic; Rego Vim spells and wards can dampen a legendary artist's powers and bar him from areas.

name: Regula Bullata
description: Franciscan rule approved by Pope Honorius in 1223.

name: Regular Clergy
description: Clergy bound by a Rule and divided into orders, living removed from society.

name: Regulus' Encampment
description: Regulus' sanctum and camp at the center of the Cursewood, now pulled into a level 7 Magic regio with a cottage, lake and the Old Oak.

name: Regulus' Staff of Unraveling
description: An elm staff with basalt and a magnet that cancels Aquam, Auram, Herbam and Terram effects.

name: Regulus' Tablet of Power
description: Regulus' talisman, a cypress and cedar tablet set with a star ruby, holding Master of the Magic Spirit and Binding the Magic Spirit.

name: Rehoboam
description: Solomon's son under whom Israel split into Israel and Judah.

name: Reindeer
description: Fabled Scandinavian prey said to give good sport.

name: Reinforced Armor
description: Leather or padding strengthened with small plates or rings.

name: Reismann Ex Miscellanea
description: The probable founder of the Rusticani tradition, a hedge wizard who swore the Oath at the Rhine Tribunal of 963 and wrote a summa on Craft Masonry.

name: Release the Spellbound Servant
description: Empathy/Ware ritual freeing the target from a single supernatural effect for an hour and a day.

name: Releganta of Flambeau
description: A Spanish False Maga from Leon whose Gift is corrupted by the Infernal; lustful, practicing Chthonic Magic and Hex, and apprentice of the infernalist Rasus of Flambeau.

name: Relic (Virtue)
description: Virtue representing possession of a relic, lost if gained through discovered simony.

name: Relic of St. Matthew
description: Lost head of St. Matthew with the power to quell storms at sea.

name: Relic of the Holy Blood
description: Reliquary containing the Blood of Christ brought by Thierry of Alsace.

name: Relics of the Three Magi
aliases: relics of the three wise men
description: A fabulous golden casket in Cologne's cathedral containing the bones of the three wise men who visited the infant Jesus, taken from Milan by Frederick Barbarossa in 1164.

name: Relics of the gifts of the Magi
description: Relics once in Constantinople.

name: Relief
description: The largest vassal tax, levied on inherited land.

name: Relig Oran
description: Burial place of kings on Iona, where most Scottish kings and St. Oran lie.

name: Religious (Social Status)
description: Social Status Virtue for priors, nuns, beguines and penitents who have taken religious life.

name: Religious Limitations on Demons
description: Holy days and rites limiting demons: Holy Saturday, Yom Kippur to Sukkot atonement, and the hajj.

name: Religious Symbols
description: A class of faerie taboo; such faeries flee church bells, and many powerful faeries cannot enter the Dominion uninvited.

name: Reliquary of the Holy Thorn
description: Coronation relic kept in the archbishop's palace at Reims.

name: Relisius
description: A contemporary House Bonisagus magus well known for his Christian faith and advocacy of harmony between Magic and the Divine.
