name: Relocation
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab's physical-world location can be magically adjusted, e.g. via a powerful Rego Terram effect.

name: Remembered Messages
description: MuMe 20 Boundary ritual that replaces a prepared memory in everyone on the island with a single useful piece of information.

name: Remi of Museau
description: A friendly, effusive 48-year-old Master magus of House Jerbiton at Triamore, a veritable polymath accomplished in mundane tasks and magic alike.

name: Remiel
description: An angel named in some lists of the archangels.

name: Remora
description: Magic Animal fish (Magic Might 20 Aquam) able to hold ships motionless with its Holdfast power.

name: Remote Writing
description: Enchantment reproducing writing at a distant location, not construable as scrying.

name: Removal of the Conspicuous Sigil
description: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 20) that obscures grooves, runes, and writings so they are not visible while the overall shape of the medium remains, e.g. hiding runes on a sword blade.

name: Removes
description: Three-course formal dining pattern of Valnastium banquets.

name: Renaud Fouinon
description: Redcap foundling, foster brother of Hervé and member of the Goliards.

name: Renaud de Ville-Thierry
description: Bailli of Bayeux, appointed 1206.

name: Renita Bjornaer
description: Praeco and leader of Confluensis who died last winter, causing a succession crisis.

name: Rennes
description: Capital of the duchy.

name: Renser of Tremere
description: Rellantali Tremere who united the thieves of Venice under his authority.

name: Renunciation
description: Hermetic expulsion; crusaders or Vindolanda magi may be renounced.

name: Renunciation of House Diedne
description: Emergency Grand Tribunal's decision to Renounce House Diedne.

name: Reorder the Contents of the Armarius
description: A Rego Animal 10 spell with Intellego requisite that sorts books in a chest or closet into a chosen sequence; an optional Mentem requisite raises it to level 15 for emotional or read-status sorting.

name: Repair Cracks and Tears
description: A Creo Animal 20 ritual that heals cracks and tears in the parchment and leather of a book, used for historically significant works like Bonisagus's diaries.

name: Repel Animals
description: Faerie power working like Circle of Beast Warding.

name: Replenishing the Fount of the Magus
description: A CrCo 30 spell created by Terious of Flambeau allowing a magus on the Path of Energy to restore lost Fatigue levels from the forest; recorded in the Great Library but never successfully cast.

name: Repose of the Eternal Moment
description: PeCo 35 Ritual causing the target to vanish into the Twilight Void for its duration.

name: Requested Vengeance
description: Minerva Sulis's power.

name: Research Notes on Aegis of the Hearth
description: Tractatus with a lab text of Aegis of the Hearth.

name: Reserves of Presence
description: New Virtue allowing a character once per day to add +3 to Presence for a scene at the cost of two fatigue rolls.

name: Resistance to Claws
description: Personal cat power making its coat resistant, a version of Doublet of Impenetrable Silk.

name: Resolution
description: The most important part of a story's synthesis: how the situation could be brought to a conclusion, best described as several possible end-states.

name: Resting Place of Mars
description: A regio on the plains of Lombardy about 10 miles northwest of Milan, possibly the tomb of a sleeping war deity; its aura increases warlike and decreases peaceful Personality Traits.

name: Restore the Image Transferred
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Restore the Moved Image
description: A Rego Imaginem (General) spell that cancels a Rego Imaginem spell which moved an image, putting the image back where it belongs if the caster matches the spell's level.

name: Restormel
description: Castle in Cornwall, 40 yards across, ambiguous between shell keep and inner bailey.

name: Restricted Learning
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character can only apply experience points to five chosen Abilities and cannot learn new Abilities without Teaching or Training; required of all mundane animals.

name: Restriction (True Feeling)
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw of the Cult of Orpheus.

name: Retetarius Bjornaer
description: Deputy chief of Clan Wilkis appointed by the prima, with a salmon heartbeast, dwelling in the River Danube.

name: Retistius
description: Verdi magus who won the 1181 Verditius contest with a mechanical dog.

name: Retistius' Mechanical Dog
description: Mechanical dog that won the 1181 Verditius contest.

name: Retrieve From Purgatory
description: Option in the Purgatory chapter.

name: Retrieve That Which is Lost
description: Forcas's Power to locate and summon an object via an Arcane Connection.

name: Return of Mental Lucidity
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Return the Lycanthrope to his Native Form
description: General-level TaSh spell that ends a transformation and returns the target to his native form.

name: Returned Dead
description: Faeries that are, or pretend to be, humans who died and return, often believing they died at an unnatural time.

name: Reveal the Hidden Words
description: A MuAq 5 charged-item effect that makes any group of words written in the enchanted colorless liquid visible for a Diameter duration.

name: Reveal the Lingering Spirit
description: New Intellego Mentem spell letting the caster see invisible ghosts.

name: Reveal the Lurking Watchers
description: An InVi 30 spell that allows the caster to see creatures of the Magic realm within his field of view and identify them as possessing Magic Might.

name: Reveal the Magical Deception
description: A new Intellego Vim spell (InVi 25) invented for Tabanus, designed to overcome spells that hide traces of magic such as Masking the Odor of Magic.

name: Revealed Flaws of the Mortal Flesh
description: A spell that instantly diagnoses a disease's cause and effect and adds +3 to the Prognosis total if the character designs the follow-up treatment.

name: Revelations of the Sacred Company of Virgins at Cologne
aliases: Revelatio De Sacro Exercitu Virginum Coloniensium
description: Elizabeth's book on Saint Ursula's martyrs, a Dominion Lore tractatus.

name: Revenge of the Bitten Toad
description: A PeAn 20 Flavor-Target spell inflicting a Heavy Wound on any creature that bites or tastes the caster.

name: Revive the Fading Amulet
description: SuMa general charm adding one charge to one's own amulet.

name: Revoke Gifts
description: Eiael's power to revoke any Ring of Solomon.

name: Rewriting the Mind
description: A Muto Mentem Ritual that utterly changes the target's cognitive goals, hopes and desires to an agenda dictated by the magus.

name: Reynard the Fox
description: Fox protagonist of a Märchen story used in an Elysian quest.

name: Rhabdomancy
description: Divinatory method using divining rods, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Rhaetian
description: Listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Rhases
description: Physician who wrote on alchemical theory and the elixir.

name: Rhesus of Verditus
description: Leader of Florum's magi, a weaver interested in the magical uses of flax, who came from the Roman Tribunal and supports the Lotharingian ideal.

name: Rhetoric
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Rhine Gold
description: Treasure cursed by a dwarf, contributing to Ragnarok.

name: Rhine-Main-Danube Canal
description: A proposed canal connecting the Main (a Rhine tributary) and the Danube to create a trade corridor across the continent, around which a saga could be designed.

name: Rhodocrosite
description: Semiprecious stone for memory and medical enchantments, from Coeris caves.

name: Rhonabwy
description: A warrior of Powys who, sleeping on an ox-skin in a foul hall, dreamed of being taken by Iddawg to King Arthur's court where ravens battled Arthur's men.

name: Rhone
description: A river that ends at the wild, inhospitable Camargue Delta where a ghostly horse keeps a larder of wicked children.

name: Rhyme of the Beast
description: Folk witch initiation script requiring living as an animal for a season; grants Animal Ken and the Flaw Incomprehensible.

name: Rhône River
description: River whose delta forms the Camargue.

name: Ribat
description: Sufi hospice.

name: Ricella
description: Faerie leader of processions of the dead, collecting the dead and leading them to pagan underworlds.

name: Richard I
description: King of England interred at Fontrevrault.

name: Richard I of England
description: Negotiated a truce allowing pilgrims into Jerusalem.

name: Richard I, Duke of Normandy
description: Duke who sponsored colonization of Mont St. Michael by Benedictines in 966.

name: Richard Mallebeench
description: English Templar commander (1172-1180).

name: Richard Rufus the Deacon
description: A learned theologian scholar at Schola Pythagoranis who writes tracts justifying the use of magic for virtuous ends, risking trouble with church authorities.

name: Richard of Glastonbury
description: A diabolist monk raised by diabolist monks at Glastonbury Abbey, skilled in Incantation and Diablerie, who commits sins of blasphemy and idolatry while believing his Powers are not evil.

name: Richard of Hastings
description: English Templar commander (1160-1171).

name: Richard the Devil
description: Figure whose penance bell Proctor believes his talisman to be.

name: Richenda Spinosa
description: An atypical journeyman maga of House Flambeau at Irencillia of secret faerie heritage descended from Kupala; her scarred Gift left her unable to use fire magic, so she turned to Herbam thorn magic and seeks vengeance on her master Indulius.

name: Richildis
description: Nun who acted as secretary to Hildegard of Bingen in recording her visions.

name: Ricohombre
description: Iberian great men of the aristocratic upper class who hold honores from kings. They have the Great Noble Virtue.

name: Riddle of the Magus
description: Personal enigmatic puzzle given to Criamon apprentices marking them as magi.

name: Ride in Dreams
description: Sir Giles' power to enter the dreams of a named sleeper and torment him with nightmares.

name: Ride the Diseased Body
description: Decani Power that possesses a victim and riddles them with incurable disease.

name: Riding the Phantom Steed
description: Sir Giles' power to materialize his war horse when he takes physical form.

name: Right Bank of Paris
description: The largest, commercial district of Paris, also called Le Marais.

name: Right of Entry
description: Faerie right, described in Realms of Power: Faerie, that lessens the Dominion's impact; purchasing London would grant it.

name: Right of Warren
description: Lord's right to trap and raise small game, extending to pests and even magical monsters and vis sources.

name: Right of Way
description: The ancient right of faeries to travel through a locale without permission.

name: Rigid Scale
description: Non-metallic scale or lamellar armor.

name: Ring Armor
description: Early medieval leather armor with rings.

name: Ring and Circle Wards
description: Wards traced as a ring, difficult to cast around an island.

name: Ring of Brodgar
description: Stone circle on Mainland in Orkney that leads to the faerie realm of Barathrum.

name: Ring of Lead
description: Lead ring around the Graveyard's entrance invested with warding spells and The Ring of Terror.

name: Ring of Plant Mastery
description: Caitlin's wooden ring allowing spontaneous ReHe spells up to 20 without fatigue.

name: Ring of Saint Maurice
description: Powerful relic held by the archbishop of Salzburg, said to make one undefeatable in battle.

name: Ring of the Sea's Command
description: Caitlin's silver ring with aquamarine allowing spontaneous ReAq spells on salt water.

name: Ring of the Sleeper
description: A ring worn by the Ogier-like Sleeper; whoever puts it on dies instantly and is replaced by a faerie believing itself to be the wearer's spirit.

name: Ring to Ward the Fire's Wrath
description: Caitlin's copper and ruby ring granting +15 soak against fire.

name: Rings of Verditius
description: Five magic rings, one for each finger and thumb, that Verditius forged from all he had learned, perhaps the most powerful magic rings in Hermetic history.

name: Ringwork
description: Most primitive castle: ditch, packed rampart and thin stone wall.

name: Rio Tinto
description: Iberian lead source, alternative location.

name: Ripper
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue with two inflexible powers: destroying cloth or disemboweling an animal at Sight range without words or gestures.

name: Rise from the Grave
description: Revenant power opening the earth over its grave.

name: Rising Passion
description: A Creo Mentem 15 spell invented by Imanitos Mendax that raises uncontrollable carnal lust in a target.

name: Risk Modifier
description: Experimentation modifier used on the Extraordinary Results Chart, limited by Magic Theory.

name: Rite of Opening the Mind
description: Tulab Ibn Sina Script at Ibn Sina's tomb granting Premonitions and Visions.

name: Rite of Testing the Physician's Dedication
description: Tulab Ibn Sina Script granting Medicinal Divining and Restriction.

name: Rite of the Scapegoat
description: Jewish atonement rite, a Divine-aligned version of Curse-Throwing, in which a goat is loaded with a community's sins on Yom Kippur and driven into desolation.

name: Rithmomachia
description: The philosopher's game.

name: Ritter
description: General German term for a cavalry soldier, equivalent to knight.

name: Ritual Faerie Powers
description: Virtue granting ritual-level faerie powers.

name: Ritual of Calling the Fetch
description: Gifted gruagach initiation fasting on a mountaintop to find the fetch; grants Fetch and Restriction.

name: Ritual of Discovering the Physician's Humor
description: Tulab Ibn Sina Script granting an Elementalist Form and Vow.

name: Ritual of Improving the Physician's Character
aliases: Ritual of Refining the Physician's Character
description: Tulab Ibn Sina Script granting Elemental Medicine and Study Requirement.

name: Ritual of Making the Soul Actually Knowledgeable
description: Ikhwan as-Safa' Script granting Elemental Philosophiae and Study Requirement.

name: Ritual of Mount Lycaeon
description: Rumored ritual turning men into wolves for nine years.

name: Ritual of Uncovering the Elemental Nature of Man
description: Ikhwan as-Safa' Script granting an Elementalist Form tied to humor, and the Mentor Flaw.

name: Rival Magic
description: Supplement presenting the Augustan Brotherhood.

name: River Aare
description: River feeding Lake Brienz.

name: River Avon
description: River on which Bath lies.

name: River Belus
description: River in Acre where Templar and Hospitaller mills compete for water.

name: River Dordogne
description: Southern border of the Tribunal.

name: River Nile
description: River protected by St. Michael.

name: River Rance
description: River.

name: River Styx
description: Underworld river of Charon.

name: River Sâone
description: Eastern border of the Tribunal.

name: River Vilaine
description: Breton river whose highest sea-going port is Redon.

name: River Yonne
description: River.

name: Road
description: Covenant Hook: covenant lies on a major road, river or sea route guaranteeing mundane contact.

name: Road (Target)
description: Target covering a road up to 100 paces long; equivalent to Room.

name: Road Magic
description: Neo-Mercurian extension of Mercurian Magic adding Road and Road Network Ranges and Targets; learnable in a season or Initiated as a Minor Virtue.

name: Road Network (Range)
description: Range reaching anyone on connected roads; equivalent to Arcane Connection, requires ritual magic.

name: Road Network (Target)
description: Target covering a road network 10,000 paces long; equivalent to Boundary, requires ritual magic.

name: Roane
description: Smaller, less bloodthirsty Highland version of the selkie.

name: Robert Bruce
description: Claimant to the Scottish throne named successor by Alexander II.

name: Robert Guiscard
description: Norman mercenary who conquered southern Italy with magic items bought from Roman Magi.

name: Robert I
description: Brother of Odo, crowned king in 922, died in combat in 923.

name: Robert Poulain
description: Archbishop of Rouen, a theologian elected 1208, who believes the Order of Hermes heretical.

name: Robert Wood
description: An outlaw of Yorkshire in the late 1100s, presumed a rustic-magic hedge wizard and exceptional archer/bowyer/fletcher with magic in his craft, registered as a vis source by Voluntas covenant.

name: Robert de Boron
description: Author of Joseph d'Arimethie, first to call it the Holy Grail.

name: Robert de Charteris
description: Example magus who writes a polemic, sponsored by Protinus of Verditius, on the benefits of his Tribunal integrating with mundane society.

name: Robert des Ablèges
description: Theologian bishop of Bayeux, elected 1206.

name: Robert of Arbrissel
description: Charismatic hermit and preacher who founded the Abbey of Fontrevrault in 1100.

name: Robert of Craon
description: Grand Master of the Templars (1136-1149).

name: Robert of Sabloel
description: Grand Master (1191-1193), formerly King Richard's admiral.

name: Robert the Frisian
description: Made Bruges his capital in 1093.

name: Robert the Strong
description: Ninth-century ancestor of Hugh Capet.

name: Robes of Puissant Might
description: Caitlin's protection 15 robes with no encumbrance.

name: Robin Hood
description: Cited as a legendary example of crime income, operating with demonic assistance.

name: Rocamadour
description: Shrine of Our Lady.

name: Rock Swimming
description: Hagbui power (MuCo 40) to swim through stone or earth.

name: Rock of Eternal Life
description: Rock in Brude's tower said to make its owner live forever.

name: Roddam and Green
description: Two rocky pillars in Piper Gut; once per year Roddam gains a Magic aura and a present person can judge the Wamses' contest for Intellego vis.

name: Rodopi Mountains
description: Mountains marking the southern extent of the Transylvanian Tribunal in Bulgaria.

name: Roe Deer
description: Deer considered too small for serious attention.

name: Rogation Blood
description: Story seed in which blood of virgin boys on a stone feeds an almost-forgotten pagan god that stirs when Rogation grows lax.

name: Rogation Day
description: April 25th, the day of the perambulation.

name: Rogation Days
description: Days beginning forty days after Easter when villagers walk the boundaries and boys are abused to remember the landmarks.

name: Roger
description: Jerbiton magus of Literatus teaching the Humanities.

name: Roger de Jouy
description: Flemish knight who shared tournament ransom profits with William Marshal for a year.

name: Roger of Howden
description: Chronicler who reported Joachim's prophecy to Richard about Saladin.

name: Roger the Great
description: Robert Guiscard's nephew, named King of Sicily.

name: Rogitien
description: Mercere alchemist at the Rorschach Chapter who brews longevity potions for redcaps and hoplites; he has the Gentle Gift.

name: Rognvald Kolsson
description: Earl of Orkney who crusaded in 1152 and was canonized in 1192; a poet boasting of nine skills.

name: Rogues
description: Mercere magi who pose as Redcaps for their own purposes.

name: Rogziel
description: An Avenger of Evil whose angel-like name means Wrath of God.

name: Roh-en-Aod
description: Stone yielding Auram vis.

name: Rok
description: A storm giant (Might 28 Auram) about 15 feet tall who conjures winds and hail; allied with a ship captain to raise storms against rival merchants.

name: Role
description: The series of symbols and rules a faerie cannot change or break through which it interacts with humans.

name: Role Requires Suffering
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the faerie feels pain and suffers wound penalties like a human.

name: Roll, you clouds, and thunder cry / And strike with flames from empty sky
description: Debauchery/Effusion 25 thunderstorm.

name: Rolling Stone
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character has moved so often that she finds it hard to form community attachments, giving -1 to social rolls within a community.

name: Rollright Stones
description: A thirty-meter stone circle of twenty-five stones in Oxfordshire, said to be a petrified army and its king; includes the King Stone whose chips ward against demons, watched over by a witch in the form of an elder tree.

name: Roma Nova
description: A covenant of traditionalist Latin magi founded in Kent in 946, unpopular with Bjornaer, Díedne, and Ex Miscellanea; destroyed by the Díedne in 1008.

name: Roman Army Lore
description: Ability referenced as used or valued by Tremere magi or creatures.

name: Roman Astrological Correspondences of Mercury
description: Tractatus attributed to Mercere with a horoscope of Augustus' investiture.

name: Roman Emperor Trajan
description: A Roman emperor whom God allowed to be saved after death at the request of Pope Gregory the Great.

name: Roman Law
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Roman Lore
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Roman Penitential
description: Halitgar's penitential listing penances for magical and sacrilegious acts.

name: Roman Ritual
description: Instructions for performing exorcism.

name: Roman Scribe
description: Companion vocation: a scribe's second son from Rome copying magical documents for magi.

name: Roman Tribunal Lore
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Roman roads
description: Roads that seem to form a great magical network created with the Cult of Mercury.

name: Rome Lore
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Romer
description: A young giant of Romerstein castle who fell in love with and secretly married Ruma, daughter of the dwarf king.

name: Romowe Oak
description: A surviving magical forest spirit of Pomerania in the Eastern Marches; it is likely to possess seekers who attempt communion with it.

name: Ronan
description: Irish hermit who settled at St. Renan; St. Ronan's walk is retraced at Locronan.

name: Roncesvalles
description: Pass where Roland was slain.

name: Room of Stale Air
description: A Perdo Auram spell (Level 15) that makes the air in a room stuffy and uncomfortable, penalizing physical exertion of breathing creatures.

name: Rope of Bronze
description: A Muto Herbam spell (Level 15) with a Terram requisite that turns a piece of plant-fiber rope into superior bronze that does not break under normal circumstances.

name: Rosalba
description: Covenant founded by Flavia of Jerbiton in 820 in the Yorkshire Dales; destroyed in 899 when all its magi were killed in a Wizards' War with Blackthorn.

name: Roscius
description: Filius of Verditius who stole the sword Durendal and took it to Verdi; by studying it he and his filii became famous makers of magical swords, founding the Confraternity of Roland.

name: Rose Coast
description: Pink granite coast.

name: Rosemary Sprig of Rego Vis
description: Rosemary vis protecting a home from weak wood faeries.

name: Rosh ha-Shanah
description: Jewish new year on 1 Tishri when all are judged.

name: Rosmert
description: Handri's faerie caricature, the imperious-looking Queen of Irencillia's fae and monarch of the Faerie Court.

name: Ross
description: Remote region where isolated clans speak Gaelic with Pictish elements.

name: Rostrenen
description: Hawthorn source.

name: Rotgiers de Gerberoy
description: Senior Tremere magus of Montverte, knightly warrior and Tourney champion responsible for martial affairs and raiding.

name: Rotgiers' Talisman Mace
description: Ornate bejewelled mace enchanted as Rotgiers' talisman.

name: Rothelin
description: Legendary Tytalus magus who converted, contracted leprosy and joined the Order of Saint Lazarus.

name: Rottweil
description: A town of Roman origin (Arae Flaviae) on the eastern edge of the Black Forest, overlooking the upper River Neckar, where butchers trained Rottweilers to pull carts.

name: Rouen Cathedral
description: Seat of the archdiocese at Rouen, holding saints' writings and the tombs of Norman nobles including Rollo.

name: Roughting Linn
description: A rock face in Northumberland carved with over sixty cup-and-ring markings, thought to be maps or faerie memorials and possibly carved by Gerfallon of Semitae.

name: Rouncey
description: Utility horse with courser combat training, favored by squires.

name: Round Shield
description: Inexpensive shield.

name: Round Shield Parry
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Round Table
description: The Arthurian Round Table that rises from a bog each midsummer near Tintagel, which a king might seek to seize.

name: Routed Group
description: A group that has lost its will to fight and tries to disengage and flee; results from a disordered group failing a Morale check.

name: Rowan of Virtue
description: Tree from which an Enriched protective amulet grants a ward against creatures of one supernatural Realm for seven years.

name: Roxburgh
description: Site of a royal mint.

name: Royal Burghs
description: Towns granted special privileges by the crown, with tollbooth and market cross.

name: Royal Charter
description: Charter by which a town holds directly from the king, placing it beyond the agricultural aristocracy.

name: Royal Courts
description: Courts dealing with the king's rights and crimes punishable by death, such as murder and arson.

name: Royal Forest of Dartmoor
description: An English royal forest composed of moorland, showing that a 'forest' is a hunting reserve rather than woodland.

name: Royal Prise
description: A special low price that royalty expects when buying at fairs, effectively a tax on the seller; King Henry III's Westminster fair promised to drop these prises.

name: Royal Touch
description: Power of French kings to cure the King's Evil, possibly from the Holy Oil or Merovech.

name: Roznov Castle
description: The castle housing the Rhine covenant of Roznov on the side of Mount Radhost, with Igor Rastvan's great-hall laboratory at one end.

name: Rudolph of Bonisagus
description: A magus of House Bonisagus and the brainchild behind plans to establish a Fengheld chapter at Durenmar.

name: Rudolph of Wadenschwyl
description: Knight allied to the Zähringers who eloped with Ida of Unspunnen.

name: Rudolph, Duke of Burgundy
description: Took the Frankish throne in 923.

name: Rudolphus of House Bonisagus
description: One of the most infamous Venatores, Wizard's Marched in 1151 A.D. for persecuting demons so much that they turned their wrath on the Order.

name: Rudophus of Durenmar
description: Magus convicted of endangering the Order after a demon he pursued attacked the Rhine Redcaps.

name: Rue de la Tabletterie
description: Paris street where Mathieus's house, an ivory-carving business, stands.

name: Rufino
description: Early Franciscan follower, a priest and cousin of Clare.

name: Rule of Clare
description: Rule devised by Clare, the first written by a woman, based on Francis' ideas and not requiring total enclosure.

name: Rule of St. Benedict
description: Rule established by Benedict governing monastic life of opus Dei, lectio divina and opus manuum.

name: Ruler of (Form)
description: Spirit power duplicating spells pertaining to a specific substance, e.g. Ruler of Lava, Smoke, Sandstorms, or Fog.

name: Ruler of Nature
description: Wyzwanie's power duplicating natural weather, water, plant and earth spells.

name: Ruler of Plants
description: Herbam spirit power used by Lise.

name: Ruma
description: Daughter of the dwarf king and a mermaid, able to transform into a stream of water; she surfaced to create the Rumaquelle while searching for her husband Romer.

name: Rumplestiltzkin
description: Fairy-tale figure who provides service and the chance to marry a prince, but becomes a threat; an example of a faerie playing several roles.

name: Rune Casting Variations
description: Modifiers to rune casting such as hidden or no name, hidden or no description, extra effort, emphasis and vis (Makt).

name: Rune Duration
description: A new Hermetic Duration from integrating rune magic, working like Ring but not requiring penetration.

name: Rune Scripts
description: Vitkar formula like formulaic spells.

name: Runes
description: The 24 runes of the vitkir, Accelerated Abilities used to craft magical effects.

name: Runic magic
description: Magic of Gifted Viking shape-changers.

name: Runild
description: Youngest Tremere member of Montverte's inner council, overseeing its library, vis and junior labwork; her familiar is a black cat.

name: Running Dog
description: Pack hound that pursues prey in pairs by scent, resembling the foxhound.

name: Runnymede
description: Where Magna Carta was signed.

name: Rupertsberg
description: Abbey near Bingen where Hildegard was abbess from 1150.

name: Rus
description: One of the three legendary founding brothers of the Slavic peoples, who settled at the River Dnieper with his tribe, the Russians.

name: Rusalka
description: A type of water nymph, returned dead who come back so their tragedy can be replayed.

name: Rustem
description: Slayer of dragons and demons.

name: Rusticus
description: Assistant of St. Denis, martyred with him.

name: Rye-King
description: Example story element: a faerie king who has stolen a child.

name: Römischer Kaiser
description: Roman Emperor, a title granted in the West through election by the electors of the Holy Roman Empire and anointing by the pope.

name: Rübezahl
description: A Waldgeist who haunts the forests of the Riesengebirge (Giant Mountains).

name: Saadia Gaon
description: Gaon of Sura (882-942), opponent of the Karaites.

name: Sabaoc
description: Angel named in Aldebert's heretical prayer. Derived from Sabaoth.

name: Sabastien filius Luise
description: Tytalus 'professional intruder' who disarms wards in dead magi's sancta and has one of the highest Parma Magica scores in the Order.

name: Sabath
description: Ruler of Zebul.

name: Sabaton
description: Foot armor.

name: Sabbath (Duration)
description: Holy magic Duration lasting until dawn of the next day of rest; equal to Sun.

name: Sabbatinus
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Sabeans
description: Star-worshipping cult of Harran, Syria, once granted dhimmi status.

name: Sabinus
description: Lingones chieftain who hid in the cave for nine years.

name: Sabouleux
description: A court of Parisian argotiers who daub themselves with blood and froth with soap.

name: Sabrina filia Maura
description: Maga who first improved Bonisagus's longevity potions and became third Primus of House Bonisagus.

name: Sacar
description: Islamic degree of Hell for Zoroastrians.

name: Sachiko of Merinita
description: A probably-female Merinita magus of Burnham whose sigil appears at tribunals but who is otherwise unknown to the tribunal.

name: Sack of Constantinople
description: The 1204 sack of Constantinople.

name: Sacramentals
description: Minor folk rituals and prayers, versions of invoking a saint.

name: Sacred Precepts of Pythagoras
description: Precepts vowed in a Minor Ordeal Vow of the Fraternity.

name: Sacrifice of Power
description: Taking a Hermetic Flaw as an Ordeal, considered mythically very appropriate for Initiation.

name: Sacrifices
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: animal sacrifices are needed for the lab to function (+2 Upkeep, -1 Safety, +1 Warping, -1 Health, -3 Aesthetics).

name: Sacrist
description: Official responsible for vestments, candles, incense and upkeep of the church.

name: Sacristan
description: Monk who rouses the others with a bell for Matins.

name: Safeguard the Clandestine Conversation
description: Mu(Re)Im 10 spell muddling the images and sounds of those within a circle to outside observers and scriers.

name: Saga
description: The ongoing campaign that discoveries like the Resting Place of Mars can alter.

name: Saga Speed
description: Rules concept for the pace of a saga (slow, fast, pulsed) affecting how transformations manifest in play.

name: Saggitarius
description: The Technique of the Archer, a certamen style introduced by a Merinita magus to humiliate a Tremere rival; it adds heavily to Attack but can do only one Fatigue level of damage, and many Tremere dispute its legitimacy.

name: Sagitar of Tremere
description: A Tremere magus who falsely claimed the Criamon Primacy, discovering it was voluntary mystical slavery; his contrite ghost haunts the Cave of Twisting Shadows.

name: Sagittarius
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Sail the Wind
description: People of the Clouds power to fly on winds and lift ships.

name: Saint Alban
description: Martyr whose shrine inspired Christina of Markyate to vow virginity.

name: Saint Almeric
description: Canonized Cistercian saint.

name: Saint Alphege
description: Under whom Bath Abbey adopted the Benedictine Rule.

name: Saint Ambrose
description: Patron saint of Milan whose rite is used by its Church.

name: Saint Andrew
description: A saint whose relics were stolen from Constantinople by the bishop of Amalfi in 1210, prompting Andru's personal grudge.

name: Saint Andrew's
description: Scottish archdiocese raised to primacy.

name: Saint Anne
description: Mother of the mother of God, much revered in Brittany; Nolwenn took her name.

name: Saint Anthony's Fire
description: A Minor Sanguine Disease from possession by a minor demon in the intestines; cured by exorcism.

name: Saint Barbara
description: A patron saint of French masons, whose feast day is December 4.

name: Saint Basil the Great
description: Saint whose devotees are immune to Patarus' powers.

name: Saint Beatus
description: British saint who converted the Jungfrau region and evicted a dragon from his cave.

name: Saint Beatus' Cave
description: Cave listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Saint Bernard Pass
description: Alpine pass listed in the index.

name: Saint Brendan
description: Patron of Irish sailors and arguably intercessor for islands in the Ocean.

name: Saint Bruno
description: Author of the Statutes followed by the Carthusians.

name: Saint Christopher
description: Patron of travelers; those who see his likeness and call on him are believed not to die that day on the road.

name: Saint Crispin
description: One of the patron saints of shoemakers, a third-century Roman preacher who made shoes; feast day October 25.

name: Saint Crispinian
description: One of the patron saints of shoemakers, a third-century Roman preacher who made shoes; feast day October 25.

name: Saint Croix
description: Castle of a sympathetic noble in the Dordogne where the Illuminati inner circle meets.

name: Saint Cuthbert
description: Seventh-century hermit and later bishop who lived on Inner Farne, performed miracles there, and drove the demons out to Megstone; the most popular saint in Northern England.

name: Saint Cuthbert's Gut
description: Channel between West Wideopen and Inner Farne, dangerous in stormy weather.

name: Saint Cyprian
description: Pre-Hermetic magus saint to whom Valnastium's main church is dedicated, often confused with Saint Cyprian of Carthage.

name: Saint Cyprian of Antioch
description: Sorcerer and perhaps diabolist who tried to seduce a Christian virgin with magic, then forsook evil; patron of the church at Valnastium.

name: Saint Dunstan
description: The patron saint of blacksmiths, whose feast day is May 19.

name: Saint Edmund
description: King and martyr whose day is November 20th, with a power to Bestow Fertility invoked at Bury Saint Edmunds.

name: Saint Eligius
description: The patron saint of armorers, whose feast day is December 1.

name: Saint Elisabeth
description: Daughter of the king of Hungary and wife of the landgrave Louis IV of Thuringia, who devotes her life to the needy; subject of the miracle of roses and later canonized as patron of Marburg's poor.

name: Saint Elizabeth of Hungary
description: A saint to be adopted as patron of bakers, who will die in 1231 and be canonized four years later; feast day November 17.

name: Saint Eugenia
description: Early Roman martyr who, in legend, wore men's clothing and became an abbot; patron for women seeking religious life as men.

name: Saint Euphemia of Chalcedon
description: Martyr venerated by the Templars; her heart and body are kept at Castle Pilgrim.

name: Saint Francis of Assisi
description: Saint who recently tamed the Wolf of Gubbio.

name: Saint Gertrude of Nivelles
description: The patroness of the recently dead who appeared in visions to many (often unGifted) Donatores, with souls in her care for their first night after death.

name: Saint Gilbert
description: Founder of the Gilbertines, died 1190 and canonized 1202; feast on February 4th.

name: Saint Guthlac
description: Saint who saw his cell filled with black troops of unclean spirits, quoted from the Life of Saint Guthlac.

name: Saint Hildegarde
description: Abbess of Zurich who gave Saint Meinrad a figurine of the Virgin.

name: Saint Homobonus
description: The recently canonized patron saint of clothiers, a tailor from Cremona who gave free clothes to the poor; his feast day is November 13.

name: Saint Honoratus of Arles
description: The patron saint of bakers, whose feast day is January 16.

name: Saint James
description: Saint whose tomb and relics are at Santiago de Compostela.

name: Saint Joan
description: Legendary woman said to have held the papacy as Pope John VIII in the mid-ninth century; the story was initiated by a demon.

name: Saint John Gualbert
description: Founder of the Vallumbrosans who spared his relative's murderer and saw a crucifix bow its head.

name: Saint John of the Cross
description: Future systematic mystic whose works are not yet written in 1220.

name: Saint John the Evangelist
description: Saint with whom Marie of Oignes frequently conversed.

name: Saint Justina of Antioch
description: Christian virgin whom Cyprian tried to seduce; shares the feast of 26 September with him.

name: Saint Keyne
description: Pious virgin saint whose well and prayers produce miracles near Keynsham.

name: Saint Keyne's Well
description: Miraculous well; whichever spouse drinks first gains the upper hand in marriage.

name: Saint Keyne's chair
description: Magical chair on Mount Saint Michael.

name: Saint Luke
description: One of the patron saints of glassmakers, whose feast day is October 18.

name: Saint Marina the Monk
description: A medieval saint, used as a character-concept example, who lived disguised as a monk, accepted false blame for a pregnancy, and was revealed to be a woman only after death.

name: Saint Mark
description: One of the patron saints of glassmakers, whose feast day is April 25.

name: Saint Martin
description: Bishop of Tours and founder of the Abbey of Ligugé.

name: Saint Martin of Tours
description: Saint at whose tomb a miracle swayed Clovis.

name: Saint Mary of the Angels
description: Little chapel in Francis' valley near the original Franciscan settlement.

name: Saint Maudez
description: Sixth-century saint who cleared Maudez Island of vermin; can substitute for Saint Cuthbert.

name: Saint Meinrad
description: Hermit saint murdered at Einsiedeln in 861, whose tamed ravens followed his murderers.

name: Saint Nicholas of Myra
description: Saint to whom each house of Saint Bernard was originally dedicated.

name: Saint Norbert
description: Founder of the Premonstratensians with 12 disciples.

name: Saint Paul's Nunnery
description: Benedictine nunnery near Bastia, Umbria, where Clare first took refuge.

name: Saint Paulus
description: Founded the monastery at the bottom of Cennet.

name: Saint Polycarp
description: Saint whose relics sanctify Templar woolen cords.

name: Saint Riquier
description: Saint whose body Hugh Capet recovered.

name: Saint Robert
description: Named as founder of the Vallumbrosan order, who ordered Peter to face trial by ordeal.

name: Saint Rémi
description: Archbishop of Reims who baptized and anointed Clovis; possible source of the Royal Touch.

name: Saint Sabina
description: Titular church of Tommaso da Capua.

name: Saint Stephen
description: The first Christian martyr and patron saint of masons, whose feast day is December 26.

name: Saint Stephen of Hungary
description: Geza's son, who married Gisela of Bavaria in 996.

name: Saint Stephen the founder
description: Canonized Cistercian saint and founder.

name: Saint Sylvester
description: Saint said to have slain the Leviathan dragon on New Year's Day 1000, possibly Pope Sylvester II.

name: Saint Thaddeus
description: Patron of penitent thieves whose sacred places ward the Privy Counselor.

name: Saint Ursmar
description: Saint whose relics were placed on the church floor at Blaringhem in 1060 to plead for mercy.

name: Saint Ursula
description: Fourth-century English princess martyred with her companions at Cologne, whose bones were discovered in 1155.

name: Saint Ursula of Cologne
description: Saint whose silver-covered skull is kept at the Paris Temple.

name: Saint Valéry
description: Saint whose body Hugh Capet recovered.

name: Saint Victor
description: Church in Paris to which the legate James is linked.

name: Saint XII Apostoli
description: Titular church of Stefano di Cecanno.

name: Saint's Thigh Bone
description: A relic with Faith Score 3 and a Cure Blindness power, kept at the example Covenant Chapel.

name: Saint-Evroult
description: Chartered village outside an abbey in Normandy.

name: Sainte-Chemise
description: The tunic worn by the Virgin Mary at Christ's birth, relic of Chartres that miraculously survived the 1194 fire.

name: Saintes
description: Regional capital on the Charente with the Arch of Germanicus.

name: Saintly Reputation
description: Reputation gained by a saintly character for miracles witnessed; a character with a True Faith Score cannot gain a negative Reputation.

name: Saints' Miracles
description: Supernatural deeds performed by saints expressed as powers channelled from God.

name: Sal Albrod
description: One of the seven salts in Bladud's fermenter.

name: Sal Alkine
description: One of the seven salts in Bladud's fermenter.

name: Sal Almelke
description: One of the seven salts in Bladud's fermenter.

name: Sal Armonak
description: One of the seven salts in Bladud's fermenter.

name: Sal Conim
description: One of the seven salts in Bladud's fermenter.

name: Sal Gemmce
description: One of the seven salts in Bladud's fermenter.

name: Sal Petrce
description: One of the seven salts in Bladud's fermenter.

name: Salgfräulein
description: A wood-wife who dresses in white and sits under old larch trees, singing.

name: Salian Franks
description: Frankish people ruled by Merovech and Childeric.

name: Salii
description: Priests of Mars after whom Aedes Salii was named.

name: Salisbury Plain
description: Plain around Stonehenge.

name: Sallet
description: Late medieval rounded helmet with visor.

name: Sally
description: Counterattack in which a garrison sends troops out to destroy specific enemy units such as miners or siege artillery, at Battle Ease Factor 9.

name: Salmo
description: A descendent of Ilfetu who became primus after the Schism War and refocused House Bjornaer toward a more traditional Hermetic mould.

name: Salome
description: Herod's daughter at whose request John the Baptist was beheaded.

name: Salomon
description: King of Brittany who took the throne by assassination; martyred in the ninth century.

name: Salterello
description: Leaping dance from Naples.

name: Salvani
description: Tribe of gnomes who wove moonlight into the Dolomites, turning them white.

name: Sama'
description: Sufi group meditation of listening to music or poetry composed for God to reach an ecstatic state.

name: Samaria
description: Native land of Simon Magus.

name: Samein Guernicus
description: Zoroastrian holy magus of House Guernicus who destroyed an evil spirit at Tribunal.

name: Sammael
description: In Jewish demonology the personification of evil and true Devil, who sent the serpent to tempt Eve; husband of Lilith.

name: Samnium of Bjornaer
description: Member of Sansaron.

name: Samos
description: Ionian island, birthplace of Pythagoras and site of his Semicircle school.

name: Samovily
description: Bulgarian mystical maidens, mostly faeries (one infernal), including woodland archers who ride deer, water and air spirits, and breath-stealing ghosts of brides.

name: Samovily Blood
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Faerie Blood bonuses plus one bonus (archery, riding, music, Presence or underwater) from descent from samovily.

name: Samuel ben Judah ibn Tibbon
description: Translator of Maimonides living in Marseilles until 1230.

name: Samuel ibn Tibbon
description: The translator who rendered Maimonides' Guide for the Perplexed from Arabic into Hebrew.

name: Samuel, King of the Bulgars
description: Bulgarian king who died of shock on seeing his blinded army in 1014.

name: Samur
description: Town grown around a monastery for St. Florent's relics, hosting tournaments in July.

name: San Damiano Crucifix
description: Byzantine-style crucifix in San Damian from which a voice told Francis to repair God's house.

name: San Pietro
description: Cathedral in Bologna around which university instruction occurs; some clergy join the Mathematici.

name: San Silvi
description: Vallumbrosan monastery burned during the simony conflict.

name: Sancia filia Sabrina
description: Perdo Corpus archmage awarded the Sinews site at the Grand Tribunal of 865, who founded the Longevity Project.

name: Sanctuary of the Alps
description: One of the original Tribunals created at the Second Grand Tribunal in 865.

name: Sanctum Law
description: Grand Tribunal rulings protecting sanctums and texts marked with a sanctum mark or House symbol; reading such texts is a low crime.

name: Saoshyant
description: The Savior, Seed of Zoroaster, from whom the elixir of eternal life was handed down.

name: Saoshyant's Elixir
description: CrCo50 Zoroastrian ritual requiring ordeal by molten metal and sacrifice of a holy bull; the drinker need not make aging rolls and cannot die while following Zoroastrianism, gaining Warping instead.

name: Sap the Griffin's Strength
description: A general Perdo Vim spell invented by Philippus Niger, like Demon's Eternal Oblivion but working on creatures with Magic Might.

name: Saracen Sorcerers
description: Non-Hermetic Muslim magicians of Africa and the Saracen armies.

name: Sarah
description: A young Gifted girl with Entrancement and Magic Sensitivity in the example.

name: Sarcophagus of the Resting Place of Mars
description: A huge empty sarcophagus for a being 50 feet tall in the tomb's center; any damage to it repairs on the next new moon.

name: Sarmatian Sea Snail
description: Pony-sized magical snails of the North Sea that eat magical stone and fight in swarms; Magic Might 7 (Aquam).

name: Satanim
description: A group of angels ruled by Satan in Jewish belief, assisting him in opposing man.

name: Satqiel
description: An angel named in some lists of the archangels.

name: Saturn
description: Planet influencing age, time, wisdom and resisting distraction; governs Perception.

name: Satyr Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety granting Communication and Presence bonuses with sexually compatible characters.

name: Satyriskoi
description: Child-satyrs.

name: Satyrs of the Black Forest
description: Satyrs denied entry to Devil's Lane.

name: Saulpatrick
description: Site on the Circuit of Saint Patrick.

name: Savantism
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is simpleminded with halved experience but exceptionally gifted in one favored Ability with a +3 specialization bonus.

name: Savelli Family
description: Roman family controlling the ruined temple to Jupiter used as a fish market.

name: Sawm
description: Fasting during Ramadan.

name: Saxons
description: Historical Germanic people whose history, by Widukind of Corvey, is a cited period source.

name: Saïr
description: Islamic degree of Hell for Sabians.

name: Scale Armor
description: Small overlapping plates on backing.

name: Scales of Magical Weight
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Scapulomancy
description: Divinatory method using roasting shoulder blades, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Scarecrow
description: Straw manikin invented in a story seed after a plague; faeries are drawn to them and they can take on faerie roles, even forming armies.

name: Scarf of Healing
description: A wondrous scarf that copies the effects of the spell Bind Wound (Craft Level 14).

name: Scartaris
description: Vindolanda's Icelandic complex and sanctum beneath glacial ice, target of Julius's assault.

name: Scattering Like Light
description: A MuTe(Im) Level 30 spell that changes metal in an object into iconic species carried off by passing light, disintegrating objects; originally created for metal plating.

name: Scent of Water
description: Anonymous Dowsing Summa in the Reims coven library.

name: Scent of the Predator
description: A CrMe 20 Scent-Target spell that fills anyone smelling the caster with a sensation of menace, cowing or intimidating targets.

name: Schism War Lore
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Schleswig
description: A Holstein town by the fjord of the River Schlei, grown next to a Benedictine cloister of St. Johannis near the ruins of the old Viking city of Haithabu.

name: Scholasticus
description: Chapter office (or chancellor) responsible for the church school.

name: Scholastus
description: A magus of House Jerbiton, the sole surviving member of Treverorum, who announced his covenant's abolition in 1172 AD and departed for the Greater Alps, held liable for its unpaid fine.

name: School of Chartres
description: A medieval cathedral school whose writers (Thierry the Breton, William of Conches, Bernard Silvestris) produced foundational works on cosmology and natural philosophy still taught in Mythic Europe's universities.

name: School of Ebroin
description: A minor combat school within the Schools of Sebastian family, based on conjuring animals.

name: School of Marosa
description: A minor combat school within the Schools of Sebastian family, based on Herbam attacks.

name: School of St Geneviève
description: A cathedral school in Paris where the scholastic luminary Peter Abelard taught.

name: School of the Swordsman
description: Balanced certamen school of the Founder Tremere, reflected in the basic rules.

name: Schools of Magical Combat
description: Informal styles of fighting magic recognized within House Flambeau, each named after the pioneering magus who invented it, used to classify combative approaches.

name: Schwarzholz
description: A dark faerie prince who, in a variant, takes over the Cursewood and mimics the Infernal taint to torment Wyzwanie.

name: Schwytzers
description: People of Schwyz whose sudden appearance is linked to the Vanishing Away of Tarragon Vale.

name: Schönau
description: Site of the Benedictine nunnery of Elizabeth and a Cistercian monastery where Hildegund lived.

name: Schöne Lau
description: A beautiful reclusive water faerie of Blautopf Pool with webbed feet and powers of divination, banished there by her faerie-king husband because she could not laugh; she foretells visitors' futures.

name: Scintilla of Flambeau
description: A Flambeau maga who came to Burnham from eastern Europe, rumored to be a powerful fire maga but has done nothing noteworthy in Stonehenge.

name: Scissor
description: The certamen School of Carvers, which skips an attack to deliver a crippling deep attack in the following round.

name: Scivias
aliases: Know The Ways Of The Lord
description: Hildegard's tractatus on Theology recording her visions (Know The Ways Of The Lord).

name: Scone
description: Where Scottish kings are enthroned.

name: Scorpio
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Scorpion's Tail
description: Demons of the Fifth Trump venomous tail attack.

name: Scots Penny
description: Silver coin introduced by David I, equal to the English penny.

name: Scottish (language)
description: Southern language mixing Anglian, Norman French and Gaelic.

name: Scottish Isles
description: Where Hadrianus's body washed up and haunted.

name: Scottish Temper of the Dominion
description: Special aura quality in Scotland whose benefits gruagachan cannot gain.

name: Scottish Wildcat
description: An untameable, solitary Scottish cat said to foretell weather and call wind and rain; favored by shapeshifters.

name: Scourge the Spirits of the Night
description: Cockerel of Virtue's crow causing nocturnal spirits to flee.

name: Scourging of Snakes
description: Saint power expelling all snakes from an island up to the size of Ireland.

name: Scouring
description: Summoning a non-specific spirit from the surrounding area.

name: Scouts
description: Tremere explorers and information gatherers.

name: Scribe Arabic
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Scribe the Perfect Circle
description: Re(Cr)Te 4 spell that scribes a perfect circle for a magus to trace for circle spells.

name: Scriptorium
description: Monastic room where books are copied, overseen by the chancellor.

name: Scroll of exorcism rites
description: Received by exorcists at ordination.

name: Scrying Device of Magvillus
description: Rumored ancient device able to spy through the most powerful wards and Aegis spells.

name: Scrying Mirrors
description: Distant viewer devices used by rulers to address subjects and displayed publicly for art.

name: Scrying Office
description: A basilica office containing a damaged shallow pool connected to the aqueduct, a component of the Scrying Pool ritual.

name: Scrying Pond
description: InAq 35 spell known by Whitburh.

name: Sculpt the Living Water
description: A Muto Aquam spell (MuAq 20) created by Falke that allows the caster to mentally mold water as if it were clay for Sun duration.

name: Scutum
description: Convex rectangular shield of the Roman legionary.

name: Scythian torc
description: Torc of teeth of a Scythian chieftain and warriors, made by Kore, summoning thirty-four ghostly horsemen.

name: Sea Giants
description: Norse giants who can breathe underwater.

name: Sea Runes
description: Vitkar magic focus on ships.

name: Sea nymphs
description: Nymphs that sun themselves on island beaches in the Thebes Tribunal.

name: Seahouses
description: Fishing village on the Northumberland coast where a boat can be hired to the Farnes.

name: Seal
description: Mundane animal whose statistics serve as the alternate form of a selkie.

name: Seal Skin
description: Skin whose theft binds a selkie wife.

name: Seal of Quaesitorial Authority
description: Seal Whitburh gives investigators granting quaesitoris authority for the dream investigation.

name: Seal of Solomon
description: Solomon's seal which bound the Spirits of Solomon; a gemstone inscribed with it is abhorrent to them.

name: Seal of the Templar Master of England
description: Seal bearing the Agnus Dei.

name: Seal the Breach
description: CrTe 20 ritual conjuring a section of wall that knits with existing fortifications, restoring up to five damage levels.

name: Seal the Wounds of Impetuous Youth
description: Lost Child ritual power permanently healing a Light wound.

name: Sean Beg
description: Ringleader of the clansmen who raid another clan's herd during the drive to Aberdeen.

name: Search
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Searching the Haystack for a Needle
description: A Rego Mentem spell granting +3 to sight-based Perception rolls for a specific object or quality, often used to locate vis.

name: Season (Duration)
description: Faerie ritual Duration running from one equinox or solstice to the next; same level as Moon.

name: Season (magic character)
description: Statistic replacing age for magic characters: spring, summer, autumn or winter, determining starting experience.

name: Seasons of Service
description: Punishment in which a convicted magus serves Mercere or Guernicus magi, e.g. enacting longevity rituals, investing devices or copying records.

name: Sebastian
description: An eighth-century hedge wizard who joined the Order as a Flambeau magus despite Deficient Arts, developing a combat method based on his only strength, the Form of Aquam; namesake of the Schools of Sebastian.

name: Sebastian filius Luise
description: Magus listed in the index, filius of Luise.

name: Sebastiano
description: Lion of Mithras and Mystagogue at Darius's Initiations, with Presence +3 and Lore 7.

name: Seclusion
description: Church Boon for a church in a secluded location, such as a covenant chapel in a shaded glen.

name: Second Heaven
description: Location of the Jewish Hell where Moses met the five angels of punishment.

name: Second Life
description: Folk witch initiation script requiring a cloak from a Beast of Virtue's hide; grants Shapeshifter and Age Quickly.

name: Second Ring of Solomon
description: Grants 100 experience points in Theology and +3 Intelligence; recited in Winter.

name: Secret Master
description: Sole Green Cockerel Initiate to have completed the Great Work, never seen by members; gender disputed.

name: Secret Masters
description: Conspiracy that Children of Hermes claim controls the Order.

name: Secret Runes
description: Minor Virtue: hide runes.

name: Secular
description: Worldly as opposed to religious; Hermetic magic is secular because Bonisagus removed invocation of names and powers from the Techniques and Forms.

name: Secular Canons
description: More lax chapters of canons who may eat meat, wear linen and own property.

name: Secular Clergy
description: Clergy administering to human society from within it (bishops, priests, deacons).

name: Seculars
description: Games celebrated every tenth Decennial with extra pomp.

name: Secunda Provincia Lugdunensis
description: Roman province corresponding to Normandy, whose chief city was Rotomagus.

name: Secutor
description: Tremere conciliarius who wins the right to assess the Primus's competency and may challenge the Primus.

name: Seduce the Innocent Heart
description: Enchantment/Beguile 30 rite filling the target with curiosity and carnal desire until sunrise.

name: See the Paths through the Void
description: InAu 20 spell revealing Auram boundaries and vestiges and allowing passage into the Twilight Void.

name: Seed of Betrayal
description: A Muto Mentem 15 spell invented by Imanitos Mendax that turns a target's emotions toward his masters into contempt, making him readily betray them.

name: Seed of Creo Vis
description: Seed of vis that grows instantly into a fruit tree.

name: Seelie faeries
description: Bands of benign faeries of the Lowlands who appreciate talented musicians.

name: Seething Resentment
description: Bael's Power magnifying resentment into all-consuming hatred.

name: Sefer Raziel
description: Book of sorcery on astral forces; Summae on Gematria, Merkavah, Intervention and Transcendence.

name: Sefer ha-Bahir
description: Book of Illumination by Provencal kabbalists; Tractatus on Kabbalah and Ceremony.

name: Sefer ha-Chayyim
description: Book of Names in which those meriting another year are recorded.

name: Sefer ha-Masa'ot
description: The Book of Travels; Summa Mediterranean Lore.

name: Sefer ha-Razim
description: Book of Amulets revealed to Noah by Raziel; tractatus on Craft Amulets, Merkavah, Ceremony and Dominion Lore.

name: Seilenoi
description: Aged, highly cognizant satyrs from ancient times, treated as fathers by modern satyrs.

name: Sein Island
description: Druid burial island.

name: Seithkona
description: Icelandic seith witch, among those slain by crusaders.

name: Seithr
description: Viking women's witchcraft taught by Gullveig.

name: Seize the Miser's Hoard
description: Miser's Pot Power creating an unbreakable grip inside the cauldron.

name: Seizure
description: The automatic passing of a felon's goods to his lord.

name: Self Bow Attack
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Self-Confidence
description: Minor Virtue that may be granted by possessing a caul.

name: Self-Defense
description: The right of magi to defend themselves, broadly defined.

name: Seljuk Turks
description: Militant Turks who occupied Baghdad and seized Jerusalem.

name: Seljuks
description: Rulers of lands east of the Byzantine Empire where the Mulhidun live.

name: Selkie Seal Skin
description: The seal skin of a selkie; if stolen the selkie may be forced to become a spouse.

name: Selkirk
description: Site of an English victory over the Scots and Selkirk forest.

name: Semicircle
description: Pythagoras' school on Samos.

name: Semikhah
description: Rabbinic ordination granting authority over halakhic law and Dominion auras.

name: Semitae's horses
description: A breeding line of horses raised by Semitae that are not frightened of magi; traded to other covenants but no one else has managed to breed them true.

name: Semyaza
description: One of the Maskim, Chief of the Deluders and foremost of the Grigori, who taught mankind the secrets of Infernal powers and descended to earth with the Watchers.

name: Send Message
description: Faerie power to send short verbal messages to beings to which the faerie has Arcane Connections.

name: Seneca
description: A crazed Durenmar magus obsessed with building the tallest tower in the world; his magical botch sent him into Final Twilight and collapsed his half-built tower, now Seneca's Folly.

name: Seneca's Folly
description: A jumble of ancient overgrown timber beams at Durenmar, the ruins of a giant tower whose builder Seneca was sent into Final Twilight by a botch.

name: Senior Redcap
description: The Redcap who runs a Mercer House, keeps track of local Redcaps and represents the House at Tribunal.

name: Senlis
description: Town where Hugh Capet was elected king.

name: Senones
description: Gaulish tribe giving Sens its name.

name: Sens
description: City and archbishopric overseeing most bishoprics of the Ile de France.

name: Sense Holiness
description: Exceptional Talent (MR).

name: Sense Holiness & Unholiness
description: A Supernatural Power allowing perception of holy and unholy qualities, such as the Manifest Sin Flaw, through one or more senses.

name: Sense of Lingering Magic
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Sense of Place
description: Folk witch initiation script requiring travel along a single path for a season; grants Dowsing and Motion Sickness.

name: Sense of Self
description: Maze Beast power letting him find his way to any remembered place.

name: Sense of Time
description: Orleans witches' initiation script for Premonitions.

name: Sense of the Bright Flame
description: Salamander power locating fires as if by hearing.

name: Sense the Feet That Thread the Earth
description: An Intellego Terram spell that feels what is moving along the ground within a mile; derived from the Terram tradition from which Guernicus the Founder came.

name: Sense the Feet that Tread the Earth
description: Great Stallion power sensing movement on the ground within a mile.

name: Sense the Hour
description: InVi 10 spell measuring astrological time around the magus.

name: Sense the Lingering Magic
description: The Hermetic effect (Target: Smell) underlying Philippus Niger's Sniff Out the Witch power for detecting magical residue.

name: Sense the Mortal's Name
description: Intéllego Mentem 10 effect in Gabricon's doormat.

name: Sense the True Path
description: InTe15 boosted, tethered spell sensing direction to an arcane connection.

name: Sensitive Hearing
description: New Minor Flaw suited to inhabitants of wind auras.

name: Sensitive Sight
description: New Minor Flaw suited to inhabitants of cave or water auras.

name: Sensitive Smell
description: New Minor Flaw suited to inhabitants of wind auras.

name: Sensitive to Cold
description: New Minor Flaw suited to inhabitants of volcanic auras.

name: Sensitive to Heat
description: New Minor Flaw suited to inhabitants of ice auras.

name: Sensitive to Smoke
description: Flaw listed in character statistics in this text.

name: Sentient
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab has developed an independent mind, likely from long exposure to a high-level magic or faerie aura.

name: Sephardim
description: Jews of Muslim and Mediterranean lands who embrace secular learning and public life.

name: Sept
description: A local grouping within House Bjornaer to which a magus may belong; sept members typically Initiate a magus into cults and provide mentorship.

name: Septimius Severus
description: Emperor triumphant in the civil war after 192 AD.

name: Sericans
description: The people of Serica, whom no European merchant has ever met; some Hermetic scholars believe they are monsters who eat silver, given their insatiable demand for it.

name: Serjeant
description: Lighter cavalry, professional soldiers retained by a noble or wealthy master.

name: Serpent
description: The least of the dragons' kin, snake-like supernatural creatures often venomous and able to entrance.

name: Serpent of Eden
description: Serpent of paradise honored by the Ophites as God.

name: Serrifuloria of Merinita
description: A magus of House Merinita believed to have discovered a unique path within the Arcadian forest, stripping herself of emotions as magical jewels to partially overcome the Limit of True Feeling.

name: Servant
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: a full-time mundane lab servant from the covenfolk performs the most menial tasks (Safety bonus from servant's Intelligence, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Mentem).

name: Servant Spirits of Fudarus
description: Invisible spirits performing menial tasks at Fudarus, commanded by the Circlet of the Primus.

name: Servant of the Ocean
description: Major Story Flaw of Drowned Men.

name: Servitia communia
description: A third of yearly income paid to the papacy by a newly appointed bishop or abbot.

name: Servus
description: Gloria's most senior follower, who invents the Transformation ritual for her.

name: Servus Maris
description: An attempt to found a Manx covenant in 1160, destroyed by a dragon within six months; one magus was sent back with the message 'Don't come back.'

name: Setting
description: Story component describing the location in which most of the action takes place, usually determined by the hook.

name: Seumas Dubh
description: Cattle thief mentioned by the ghillie template.

name: Seumas an Cat
description: Ex Miscellanea magus of Crun Clach whose master was executed for diabolism.

name: Seven Capital Virtues
description: Four cardinal virtues (Wisdom, Temperance, Courage, Justice) and three theological virtues (Faith, Hope, Charity).

name: Seven Isles
description: Archipelago yielding Herbam and Animal vis.

name: Seven Leagues in One Night
description: Berith's Power to travel three times faster than a horse, even over water.

name: Seven Seals
description: Seals of the great book of the heavens that Luciferans break to loose demons of the Apocalypse.

name: Seven Virtues
description: Faith, hope, charity, prudence, justice, fortitude and temperance, which demons entirely lack.

name: Seventh Wave
description: New cult founded by Lucius of Flambeau to rediscover lost magics of a ruined Fens covenant.

name: Seventh Wave Lore
description: Mystery Cult Lore of the Seventh Wave.

name: Sever the Connection
description: PeVi 20 reducing an Arcane Connection's duration by three magnitudes.

name: Sever the Ties That Bind
description: A Major or Minor Ordeal Flaw causing a Verditius magus to lose emotional bonds with family and friends, appropriate for learning Bind Curse.

name: Sever the Unwanted Limb
description: A Rego Corpus 25 spell that cleanly and painlessly amputates one of the target's limbs without bleeding, leaving the Lame or Missing Hand Flaw.

name: Severicus
description: A master of House Tremere at Roznov Fort, a tall, bald, Terram-specialist magus who detests change; one of only two Tremere in the Rhine to hold his own sigil and controls about two-fifths of the Tremere sigils.

name: Severus Maximus
description: A magus of House Flambeau who declared Wizard War against Caithlinn of House Diedne of Oakdell covenant in 1004 AD.

name: Sext
description: Canonical hour of the Divine Office: Midday service.

name: Shaari Moth
description: Jewish degree of Hell, the Gates of Death.

name: Shackles of the Frozen Ice
description: A ReAq 10 spell that freezes a circular portion of water into ice, trapping anyone in it; the ice holds fast regardless of Magic Resistance but only inflicts cold damage if it penetrates.

name: Shades
description: Ghosts that are distorted reflections dominated by an emotional tie.

name: Shadow Form
description: Black Dog power to become shadow, +4 Stealth and immune to physical attacks.

name: Shadow Owl
description: Small magical raptor that blends and flies through solids.

name: Shadow Senate
description: Six Roman senators who pacted with Hell and returned in 476 as undead revenants, secretly trying to rule Rome from their tomb.

name: Shadow Tribunals
description: Magi's term for organized grand sabbats of folk witches.

name: Shadows of the Fires past
description: An Intellego Ignem spell (Level 15) that reveals where fires have been in the past lunar month as a light red flickering haze, with an intuitive sense of when.

name: Shafi'is
description: Madhhab founded by Muhammad al-Shafi'i.

name: Shahada
description: Testimony of faith; Infernal creatures hearing it suffer discomfort.

name: Shamayim
description: The First Heaven, abode of the stars, ruled by Gabriel.

name: Shamir
description: A magical stone said to be held within the pillars of Solomon's temple that could cut other stones.

name: Shamshiel
description: Archangel ruling the Earthly Paradise with Divine Might 75.

name: Shape Shifter
description: Extraordinary Talent that some hagbui use.

name: Shape of the Agile Climber
description: Spell (MuCo 25, goat) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Shape of the Ancient Kite
description: MuCo40 harnessed, tethered spell turning the target and carried books into a small raptor.

name: Shape of the Moorland Runner
description: Spell (MuCo 25, hare) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Shapechange to Man
description: Each uisge power (MuCo 45) to take the form of a handsome dark-haired man.

name: Shapechanging Powder
description: Powder in Brude's tower allowing the user to change shape without a spell.

name: Shared Fatigue
description: Familiar power sharing Might and Fatigue.

name: Shared Powers
description: Familiar power letting the master use familiar's powers.

name: Shari'a
description: Islamic law derived from the usul al-fiqh.

name: Sharp Awakening
description: The cult's name for the period of Marches in which all known dream magi of the Volshebnii Mechtateli were killed.

name: Sharp Shriek of Pain
description: PeCo 20 spell of Edwin's that stabs the ears and deafens.

name: Sharpened Rock
description: Very primitive thrown weapon sometimes used by faeries.

name: Shatqiel
description: Ruler of Mathey.

name: Shatter
description: Special gruagach ability of Damhan-allaidh. Like Perdo Herbam and Terram; characteristic Strength.

name: Shattered Leg
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Shattering the Malicious Rune
description: A general Perdo Vim spell invented by Philippus Niger, like Unraveling the Fabric of (Form) but targeted specifically at rune-magic.

name: Shavu'ot
description: Festival celebrating revelation at Sinai.

name: She-wolf of Rome
description: She-wolf that raised Romulus and Remus, perhaps a powerful faerie still living.

name: Shedding of Blood
description: Clerics are forbidden to shed blood or be involved in blood punishments, reiterated at Lateran IV.

name: Shehaqin
description: The Third Heaven, where the Garden of Eden and Tree of Life reside.

name: Sheikh Adii ibn Mustafa
description: Reformer of the Yezidi religion in 1162, considered a saint.

name: Shell Keep
description: Stone wall replacing the wooden palisade atop a motte.

name: Shell of False Determination
description: Vim spell effect caused by stored Vim vis.

name: Shell of False Determinations
description: A Creo Vim ritual that creates a shell of magic on an item, giving false information to magi who investigate its powers.

name: Shell of Opaque Mysteries
description: A Creo Vim ritual similar to Shell of False Determinations that causes all attempts to investigate a magic item to fail unless the magus's roll exceeds the ritual's level.

name: Shema
description: Statement of Jewish belief from Deuteronomy 6:4, used in tefillin and mezuzot.

name: Shemini Atzeret
description: Festival marking the end and beginning of the Torah reading cycle.

name: Shen
description: Trickster faerie leader of the Seelie Court in the Last Italian Faerie Forest.

name: Shepherd of Hermas
description: Early Christian text (c. 140 A.D.) quoted describing a vision of the Church as an aged lady.

name: Shepherd's Crusade
description: Historical popular movement cited as inspiration for the spread of an idea through society.

name: Sherd
description: Small slate on which Alpine magi write the name of the magus they most despise in ostracism.

name: Shi'is
description: Muslims supporting the claims of 'Ali's family, following a line of imams and giving greater role to reason.

name: Shield of Mystic Might
description: Rego Terram 35 spell (Herbam requisite) combining the two Enchantment to Block spells, blocking all metal or wooden attacks; focus an iron and wood ring.

name: Shieling
description: Temporary stone, turf or wood huts at summer pastures; babhan sith dwell in abandoned ones.

name: Shinnui Shem
description: Kabbalistic rite of changing one's True Name through Gematria, severing arcane connections and granting a bonus to Aging Rolls.

name: Ship of the Dead
description: Ship leaving Le Havre each All Hallows Night carrying drowned sailors' souls to Hell under a terrible Captain.

name: Ships of Flame
description: Three perpetually burning Viking longships in Magic regiones (aura 6) on the Seine; Skuld's laboratory is on one.

name: Shoes of the Zephyr
description: Wondrous horseshoes that allow a horse to fly, running across the sky as if it were land (Craft Level 19).

name: Shofar
description: Instrument made from a kosher animal's horn; a relic with one Faith Point when sounded on holy days or in exorcism.

name: Shofiel
description: An Avenger of Evil whose angel-like name means Judge of God.

name: Shoney
description: The Pictish god of fish.

name: Short Dueling Stick
description: Ancient single-weapon crushing stick.

name: Short Sword
description: One-handed piercing/slashing sword.

name: Short-Lived Runes
description: Flaw: runes' magic fades.

name: Shortsword Attack
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Shout
description: Hulikang's Power to make a sentence audible to a whole crowd.

name: Show of Flames and Light
description: Effect Xaphan prefers.

name: Show of the Flames and Smoke
description: A Muto Ignem spell (Level 10) that makes a fire produce colored smoke, streams of flame, and strange noises, entrancing or horrifying onlookers and potentially igniting nearby objects.

name: Shrine of Jasonian Athena
description: Stone shrine built by Jason at Fair Haven; Faerie aura 1.

name: Shrine of Kings
description: Shrine in Cologne Cathedral holding the bodies of the Three Wise Men, brought from Milan in 1164.

name: Shrine of St. Romanus
description: Relic shrine of St. Romanus with a Faith Point total of 5, carried by the archbishop in a story seed.

name: Shrinking
description: Focus power letting a faerie reconfigure its body into any smaller Size.

name: Shropshire
description: English county where Whitburh was left to starve as a child.

name: Shrouded
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab is hidden or protected by a supernatural effect such as The Shrouded Glen (+1 Warping, halve Aesthetics).

name: Shrouded Bay
description: Oppidum on the island of Cres in the Transylvanian Tribunal.

name: Sicilian Vespers
description: 1282 Palermo revolt against French rule aided by Mistridge Magi.

name: Siderius
description: Faithful shield grog who pilgrimages hoping to gain Guardian Angel; True Friend to Boniface.

name: Sidriel
description: An angel named in some lists of the archangels.

name: Siege
description: A military operation in which an attacking army invests a castle or city; represented in play through a series of decisive events at intervals set by the castle's lowest characteristic.

name: Siege Tower
description: Wheeled tower moved against castle walls to let troops gain a foothold under protection.

name: Siege Weapon
description: Martial Ability governing operation of siege weapons, individually or as crew leader.

name: Siege of Alms
description: 21st place, a consolation prize.

name: Siege of Normandy
description: First place in the Tourney.

name: Siege of Notatus
description: Seventh place in the Tourney, granted a greater prize.

name: Siege of Shame
description: Thirteenth place, which receives no prize.

name: Siege of Valor
description: Second place in the Tourney.

name: Sienna
description: City whose 1257 offices numbered 860.

name: Siffed of Criamon
description: A young Criamon magus among the members recruited to Nigrasaxa.

name: Sigebert
description: Frankish king who warred on Chilperic in 567.

name: Sight of Alatheia
description: Lesser InVi ritual granting Second Sight 5.

name: Sight of True Form
description: Spell considered a reasonable covenant defense against magical spying.

name: Sight of the Astrological Hour
description: InVi 20 spell measuring astrological time at a visible point.

name: Sight of the Lazy Parens
description: InVi 40 spell making Gifted individuals appear surrounded by a magenta aura to the caster.

name: Sight of the Molting Magus
description: InCo 25 spell revealing Corpus material within sight and how long ago it was shed.

name: Sight of the River
description: Water elemental power to view any location connected by water.

name: Sight of the Sigil
description: InVi 50 spell to spot active magic and traces and read their sigil.

name: Sight of the Warm Surface
description: A MuIm 20 synaesthetic spell that transforms the species of warm surfaces, normally sensed by touch, into species the eye can perceive.

name: Sight of the Wolf
description: InAn 33 enchanted effect that detects wolves within an enclosed paddock or sheepcote, triggering secondary effects.

name: Signalers
