description: Tremere communication and illusion specialists.

name: Signum Irruptus
description: A master of House Criamon and leader of the covenant Heorot, obsessed with the trolls (whom he believes descended from degenerate gods), having lost his left arm and 14 grogs to his studies.

name: Sigrdrífa
description: Valkyrie who teaches Sigurðr.

name: Sigrdrífumál
description: Medieval poem.

name: Sigrunar
description: Victory runes; Eirik Svennson's Major Rune Focus.

name: Sigurd the Stout
description: Earl of Orkney who died at Clontarf.

name: Sigurðr
description: Hero taught rune magic.

name: Siguson
description: Great dragon from whom Anguis reputedly learned magic.

name: Sijilmasa
description: Saharan caravan town with wonderful healing baths built by a mysterious benefactor.

name: Silbury Hill
description: An artificial mound 500 feet in diameter and 120 feet high south of Avebury, said to be the cursed burial place of King Sel, entombed on horseback with his treasury.

name: Silencing of the Oracles
description: A supernatural event that destroyed the capacity of faeries to predict the future, perhaps an act of God.

name: Silent Casting
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Sourdine.

name: Silent Magic
description: Virtue.

name: Silent Shout
description: A CrIm 10 miniature spell that creates a burst of species matching the caster's voice striking the target's head, used on battlefields or to instruct apprentices.

name: Silent Speech
description: A spirit's communication with physical beings.

name: Silent Tradition
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the folk witch cannot use the incantation casting method.

name: Silva Ambages
description: Independent Merinita magus, protector and healer of the Last Italian Faerie Forest.

name: Silva Candida
description: Cardinal-bishop town.

name: Silva of Merinita
description: A maga of House Merinita whose spell variants have whimsical qualities, such as comical coloration on created toads or a happy, playful wave.

name: Silver Coin of Terram Vis
description: Faerie's coin of vis turning a thief to stone.

name: Silver Crucifix
description: Folk-belief holds one buried under the doorsill protects against Lord Goulis.

name: Silver Fangs
description: A pack of seven werewolves led by Antonio who violently protect the Last Italian Faerie Forest.

name: Silver Lady's Mount
description: Lead-armored hog that is an extension of the Silver Lady's body.

name: Silver Sickle
description: Symbolic sickle carried by the Persian, enchanted as a replacement talisman.

name: Silvery Scales of the Knight
description: A CrTe(An) 30 spell that conjures a suit of full chain mail armor styled after the caster's Wizard's Sigil; being magical, the wearer cannot grapple a magic-resistant creature while wearing the gauntlets.

name: Silvius Brabo
description: Roman soldier who defeated Druon Antigon.

name: Simiel
description: Angel named in Aldebert's heretical prayer. Identified with Samael, Satan.

name: Similar Spells
description: Hermetic rule constraining how enervators may manipulate boosted spells.

name: Similarity
description: A natural principle stating an effect resembles its cause, imbuing objects with Shape and Material bonuses; apothecaries call it the doctrine of signatures.

name: Simile
description: The pattern underlying the natural range of variance in a class of objects, distinct from the Platonic form; familiarity with it adjusts Finesse rolls for crafting.

name: Simo
description: Ancient warhorse, familiar of Rotgiers de Gerberoy.

name: Simon of Assisi
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Simon of Montefort
description: Leader of the Albigensian Crusade.

name: Simprim of Quaesitor
description: Quaesitor who delivered a Transitionalist speech to the Seven of Magvillus.

name: Simulacra
description: A common automaton power (base effect 15, Creo Imaginem) making the automaton look, smell, and sound real rather than a facsimile.

name: Simulacrum Form
description: Men of the Lake power to take a watery form of anything touched.

name: Sin (Target)
description: Holy magic Target affecting an individual stained with mortal sin, demons or unholy objects; equal to Individual.

name: Sinead Ex Miscellanea
description: An ancient maga of Ungulus, focused on combat against magical beasts, who burns for revenge on the dragon that killed her beloved Parsirus but is magically pushed away from it.

name: Sinead's enchanted iron items
description: A number of iron items worn by Espera of Merinita, all enchanted to defend against faeries, against the faerie lord she offended.

name: Singing Stones
description: Rocks yielding Imaginem vis.

name: Single Cast Charged Items
description: Breakthrough (40 points) letting Hermetic magi quickly create single-use charged items from chartae techniques.

name: Single-Use Charged Items
description: A Breakthrough in Magic Theory that could ease the creation of enchantments.

name: Singlemindedness of the Concentrating Wizard
description: A Rego Mentem spell granting +3 to Concentration rolls while automatically failing non-Concentration Intelligence rolls.

name: Sins and Tempers
description: Classification of Personality Traits into sins (Proud, Wrathful...) and opposing tempers (Loyal, Calm...).

name: Sir Callum
description: A young faerie-blooded knight who gives a Rain Parasol as a gift at a baron's feast.

name: Sir Degare
description: Hero of a lai left gloves and a sword.

name: Sir Dorigen
description: Lord whose realm has a Dominion aura of 3.

name: Sir Dudley
description: Example enemy of Lord Cuthbert.

name: Sir Edwin of Hexham
description: Tytalus war leader of Horsingas, a knight driven from England who feuds with Guilleme de Fontnevoy.

name: Sir Excelsis
description: The most powerful faerie knight and champion of the White Lady's kingdom, clad in scaled armor of metal fern fronds with a burning fern motif.

name: Sir Gawain
description: Hero of Sir Gawain and the Green Knight.

name: Sir Guilleme de Fontnevoy
description: Harsh Norman Lord of Hexham who raised Edwin and now feuds with him.

name: Sir Jehan of Surrey
description: Jerbiton magus of Horsingas with scrambled memory who believes himself Sir Oswald's son and a knight.

name: Sir Oswald of Alfreton
description: Saxon rebel nobleman Jehan squired for and believes to be his father.

name: Sir Owain
description: Knight (originally an Irish monk Owain) whose journey through Purgatory to the Earthly Paradise is the basis of the legend.

name: Sir Owain (poem)
description: Middle English poem, basis of the Vision of Hell and Heaven, with the later Owayne Miles.

name: Sir Pellinore
description: Knight of the Barking Beast tale.

name: Sir Percival
description: Hero of Parzival who quests for the Holy Grail.

name: Sir Robert the Dragonslayer
description: An example character cited to illustrate how a high Reputation can make people doubt a character's identity.

name: Sir Yvain
description: Romance hero who struck the giant Harpin of Mountain in the face with his sword while mounted.

name: Siren
description: Sea spirit; one guards a natural bridge near St. Malo.

name: Siren Song
description: The Major Non-Hermetic Virtue of the Seirenes that empowers a character's music to command those who hear it.

name: Sirnas
description: One of Birna's six apprentices, told to 'Protect,' with a stag heartbeast, who originated among the Wends of the Baltic Coast and founded Clan Sirnas.

name: Sister Andrea
description: Example tainted rebel, niece of a sorcerer, who escaped her Manufactured Ignorance and lives in a nunnery.

name: Site of Legend
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: stories and legends are associated with the lab, granting appropriate Characteristic and Specialization adjustments.

name: Sithean
description: A faerie mound; Crun Clach lies inside one.

name: Sitra Achra
description: Kabbalist term for the other side of Creation, the Infernal realm, ruled by the Princes of Evil; demons are born of it when man sins.

name: Situational Modifier
description: Bonus or penalty (+1, +3, +6) for battlefield circumstances.

name: Siward of Northumbria
description: Duncan's brother-in-law who aided Malcolm Canmore.

name: Sixth Ring of Solomon
description: Grants holy divination of God's plan; recited in Spring.

name: Size Reduction
description: Personal power letting the character take a single smaller Size.

name: Skalholt
description: Cathedral seat where the Gray Bull was captured.

name: Skeletons and Zombies
description: Undead guardians raised in the Graveyard of the Arch-Magi from past violators.

name: Skeney Car
description: Southernmost tip of Staple Island; any mortal jumping into the sea there is brought to the selkie king's court.

name: Skilled Smuggler
description: A Minor General Virtue letting a character hide one dagger-sized item, imposing -9 on Awareness rolls to find it.

name: Skin Blessing of Mercury
description: Hermetic version of a Mercurian ritual.

name: Skin Knitting
description: Enchanting an animal skin fetish for Shapeshifting using Animal vis.

name: Skin of Stone
description: Stoneskinned power increasing Soak with age or Might.

name: Skin of the Doppleganger
description: TaSh 20 spell letting the caster assume the perfect physical form of the victim, though not voice or mannerisms.

name: Skinchanger (Dove)
description: A Major Supernatural variant of Skinchanger using prepared feathers or feather-engraved stones to become a dove, associated with the Daughters of Four Fathers tradition.

name: Skull of Guorna the Fetid
description: Relic sought by necromancers to learn Guorna's techniques.

name: Skull of the lindworm
description: Skull of the lindworm kept by the people of Klagenfurt.

name: Skye
description: Hebridean island where the king of Man's hold was weakened; site of the Callanish stones per the text.

name: Slake Elemental Thirst
description: Pseudoelemental power (PeAq 15) draining fluid.

name: Slake Thirst
description: Earth elemental power drawing water from targets.

name: Slander
description: A canon offense since 1215.

name: Slave
description: A new Major Status Flaw for a character of likely Slavic origin who has been sold into captivity and is wholly beholden to a master's will.

name: Slave-Owner
description: A new Minor General Virtue making a character the legal owner of one (largely unskilled) slave, lost if the slave is freed or killed.

name: Slavers' Guild
description: A small guild occupying a grey area between craft and service guilds, dealing in the sale of non-Christian slaves; its members are skilled in Sailing and Leadership.

name: Slaves
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: human slaves are employed in the lab as labor or experimental subjects (+1 Upkeep, -1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Slay the Innocent
description: A Perdo Corpus (Animal) spell (PeCo[An]30) that Mari Amwithig modified to include an 'enemy' charm in the Charm Magic example.

name: Sleep Disorder
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character cannot sleep soundly and risks nodding off during quiet periods, losing Long Term Fatigue; incompatible with Night Terrors.

name: Sleep with Eyes Open
description: Lion of Virtue power preventing surprise while sleeping.

name: Sleeping Beauty
description: Fairy tale princess cursed by an insulted faerie, whose community sleeps in a regio for a hundred years.

name: Sleepwalker
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue: magician cloaked within a bamr rather than straying.

name: Sling
description: Thrown missile weapon.

name: Sloth
description: One of the capital vices, opposed by a holy temper.

name: Slow Might Recovery
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: the faerie recovers only one Might Point per day.

name: Sluag
description: Pictish lord of the dead, holder of secret knowledge and creator of the written word.

name: Smith
description: Magical blacksmith imbued with properties of iron, a village hedge magician using Natural Magic.

name: Smiting of the Lord
description: Saint curse hurling a lightning bolt for +35 damage.

name: Smoke Oil
description: A Level 10 Alteration Reagent that evaporates into a thick gray fog filling about a hundred cubic paces when its sealed container is opened.

name: Snaefellsnes
description: Icelandic peninsula where Vindolanda lies.

name: Snake Island
description: The only geographically stable faerie island in the Black Sea.

name: Snake Soup
description: Prop: a cauldron whose white snake meat grants supernatural strength and resilience.

name: Sniff Out the Witch
description: A 0-point Vim power of Philippus Niger that lets him smell the residue of magic on those with magical powers, with a Penetration of 5.

name: Snorri Sturluson
description: Great compiler of Norse myths, alive in Iceland in 1220.

name: Snow Queen
description: Faerie who steals and imprisons Kay.

name: Snow and Wind
description: Spirits of winter that descend each year to frolic in mountain lakes and bring the change of seasons; water collected as their favored lake freezes is a source of Muto vis.

name: Snowball
description: Yorkshire tailor attacked by a shapechanging ghost.

name: Snowdonia
description: The mountainous region of North Wales where Cad Gadu's island lies and where Cad Gadu magi once encountered Gerfallon etching a map into a mountainside.

name: Soak
description: Score subtracted from damage before determining wounds.

name: Soap and Suds
description: Lutin Aquam power making the floor of a room soapy and slippery.

name: Social Interaction Virtue or Flaw
description: Required for faeries converted to player characters.

name: Social Interaction Virtues and Flaws
description: Faerie Virtues and Flaws governing interaction with humans that replace Social Status Virtues.

name: Socrates
description: Greek philosopher whose teachings the Brethren of Purity combined in their encyclopedia.

name: Sodomy
description: Wiry clawed demonic spirit, part human and part wolf, dressed as a monk.

name: Sodric
description: Legendary king of the Picts from Scythia killed by Marius, per Geoffrey of Monmouth.

name: Soft Hearted
description: Flaw appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Soissons
description: City in the Aisne valley, once capital of Syagrius' Roman kingdom and later Frankish capital.

name: Soldier of Mithras
description: Third rank, heroic champions who learn Reserves of Strength or Enduring Constitution.

name: Sologne
description: Marshy heathland forest south of Orléans.

name: Solomon's Temple
description: Temple whose holy of holies was guarded by cherubim.

name: Solomonic magic
description: Eastern magic of coercing spirits; breakthroughs allow spirits to serve a device's wielder.

name: Somerset Levels
description: Marshy Somerset coast where magical teasels grow.

name: Somerset Moors and Levels
description: Wild marshy areas west of Bath where Saint Keyne turned snakes and dragons to stone.

name: Somerset hedge magicians' cult
description: Defunct Mystery cult among Somerset hedge magicians descended from Bladud's university, which Anne could revive.

name: Somme
description: River valley of interest to magi.

name: Somniare
description: Part of Arcadia reached through the Eildon Hills.

name: Somnifer of Lapis Crudus
description: Candidate for Praeco.

name: Somnifer of Merinita
description: Dream-magic master of Lapis Crudus who scried the outside world through dreams and trained an apprentice through the mirror.

name: Somnius
description: A dreamer whose dream Metrodorus and Morphea enter in an example of physical and spiritual dream travel.

name: Son of Covenfolk
description: Free Social Status Virtue for children of covenant inhabitants.

name: Son of Craftsman
description: Social Status Virtue of the Blacksmith's Son.

name: Son of Knight
description: Minor Social Status Virtue of a young squire.

name: Son of Landed Noble
description: Social Status Virtue of the Noble Child sample character.

name: Son of Merchant
description: Social Status Virtue of the Merchant's Son.

name: Song Talent
description: Galdraman ability determining attendant spirit Might.

name: Sons of the Peters
description: A small, argumentative group of northern speculative grammarians basing their method on Peter Helias and Peter of Spain; secretly aided in their disputationes by demonic tempters granting an Infernally tainted Puissant Artes Liberales.

name: Soothe the Ferocious Bear
description: A Rego Animal spell (Level 10) that calms an animal until it is threatened or aroused again, requiring soothing speech.

name: Soothe the Ferocious Boar
description: A Rego Animal spell (ReAn 10) known by Ioannes Acer with Mastery in Fast Casting.

name: Soothe the Pains of the Beast
description: CrAn healing spell for animals known by Kentigern and cast by his familiar Tobias.

name: Sophia
description: Calvinus' charming, bookish apprentice, posing as his daughter in Ghent.

name: Sophists
description: An antagonistic group of ancient Greek scholars and teachers of rhetoric whose teachings on the rivalry between nature and custom heavily influenced Tytalus's philosophy.

name: Soporific Sponge
description: A Theriac of Level 15, Potency Mighty, a precious secret of the School of Salerno combining opium, mandrake, hemlock and hyoscyamus into a hypnotic aid that induces deep slumber.

name: Soqotra
description: Home of perfume-sorcerers.

name: Sorcerer
description: A practitioner of the Goetic Arts, strongly stigmatized in Mythic Europe.

name: Sorcerer's Flower
description: A pale violet anemone growing on the slopes of the Brocken, reputed to be a source of vis.

name: Sorcery
description: Minor sorcery occasionally tried in canon courts; serious cases by secular courts.

name: Sordello
description: A practicing Italian poet living in Florence who has begun to write poetry in the spreading troubadour style.

name: Sordus
description: A basilisk with Magic Might 30 that serves as Philippus Niger's familiar; a knee-height gray lizard with a Gaze of Death and powers that wither plants and pollute water.

name: Sorghum
description: Plant used as weapons by the malandanti.

name: Sorinbrus
description: One of the six known lands of Arcadia: the land of dreams.

name: Sortes Sanctorum
description: Divinatory oracles whose use the Roman Penitential punishes.

name: Sotcastlà
description: Catalan vassal holding a fief that supports one knight.

name: Soul
description: Human souls in Purgatory and Paradise have a Might Score, no Decrepitude or Warping, and Abilities capped at half Might.

name: Soure
description: Site of a major Templar fortress in Portugal.

name: South Wamses
description: Magical island being, tall but narrow, plotting with the Nameless Rock to outgrow North Wamses.

name: Southern Alps
description: Location of Bonisagus's cave shrine to Hermes.

name: Southern Flambeau
description: Flambeau faction that opposed the Tytali over Diedne spoils; three covenants defected to Provence.

name: Sovereign Silence of Opposition
description: Evocation/Ware rite warding the target from creatures of limited Might while he stays silent.

name: Spacious
description: A Minor laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab has spare room so outfittings can be spread out (+2 Safety, +1 Aesthetics).

name: Spanish March
description: March said to have been founded by Constantine the Great, from whose nobility Iberian nobles claim descent.

name: Spanning
description: Extended Action needed to load a crossbow, its length depending on the mechanism (belt hook, windlass, cranequin, goat's foot).

name: Sparrowhawk
description: Most common hawk in Mythic Europe, notoriously fragile.

name: Spatha
description: Late Roman variation on the long sword.

name: Speak French
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Speak Gaelic
description: Language of the Highlands.

name: Speak Giant
description: Language used by famhairan a'falach in place of Speak Pictish for gruagach magic.

name: Speak Iberian
description: Ability appearing in character statistics in this text.

name: Speak Irish
description: Ability appearing in character statistics in this text.

name: Speak Jotunn
description: Giant language skill.

name: Speak Langue d'Oc
description: Ability appearing in character statistics in this text.

name: Speak Norman French
description: Ability appearing in character statistics in this text.

name: Speak Own Language
description: Ability appearing in character statistics in this text.

name: Speak with Animals
description: Caitlin's faerie power to converse with all animals except reptiles and dark faerie creatures.

name: Speak with the Living Flame
description: A spell whose Bjornaer version is a Range Personal, Target Hearing effect with a free Mentem requisite that interprets the sound of fire into thoughts.

name: Spear
description: Piercing single weapon with one damage level.

name: Specialists
description: Characters serving the Church in limited ways, bought with Build Points.

name: Specific Prohibition
description: A narrow geas prohibition (+1 magnitude, like Diameter) or a hard-to-lift limit on blessings and curses (+4 magnitudes).

name: Specimens
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab has a large collection of related things stored in visible containers (+1 Upkeep, +1 Aesthetics, 1 Form Specialization point).

name: Spectral Quinreme
description: Muto Mentem level 50 spell (Herbam requisite) making a spectral ghost ship solid enough to sail upon and carry cargo.

name: Spectres
description: Ghosts doggedly continuing their roles in life, e.g. Tremere's ghostly soldiers.

name: Speculation
description: Mercer House funding of risky expeditions in search of vis sources in return for a share of profit.

name: Speech Runes
description: Vitkar magic focus on wood.

name: Speech of the Warding Ring
description: InTe 35 spell allowing characters to speak with far larger stones, such as the island's stone jacket.

name: Speech with the Silent
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue granting the ability to charm elemental objects into assisting, as Path of Strife magi do.

name: Speed Level
description: Rating determining the length of a journey through the Twilight Void, from permanent to momentary.

name: Spell Powers
description: Host power creating spell effects equal to permanent Might.

name: Spell Trace
description: Residual magic left after a spell expires, with a decaying magnitude, used to identify casters.

name: Spell song
description: Galdor chant sustaining a Biarg spirit.

name: Spell-like Creo Herbam Vis
description: Extraordinary vis in the form of a large truffle that, buried at a plant's roots, instantly heals it of injury, poison, or disease.

name: Spell-like Herbam Vis
description: Large truffle whose spores make plants in a six-mile area healthy and fruitful for a year and grow truffles on tree roots.

name: Spenta Armaiti
description: One of the Zoroastrian Immortals (Amesha Spentas): 'Holy Devotion', associated with Loyal and Terram in the Blessing ritual.

name: Spenta Mainyu
description: One of the Zoroastrian Immortals (Amesha Spentas): 'Holy Spirit', associated with Wise and Corpus/Mentem in the Blessing ritual.

name: Spentas
description: The seven Zoroastrian spirits of goodness opposed by the daevas.

name: Speyer
description: A Rhine city originating as a Roman military camp, favored seat of the Salian dynasty, with a great cathedral whose bells mysteriously toll on imperial deaths.

name: Sphere of Mentem
description: Part of the Magic Realm where visitors may leave behind eidolons.

name: Spica
description: Scribe of Harco.

name: Spies
description: Church Hook in which someone in the church, such as the parish clerk, secretly reports on the priest to the bishop.

name: Spietz
description: Castle said to be founded by Attila.

name: Spill Blood
description: Selkie power raising storms when their blood is spilled on the ocean.

name: Spin Head
description: The last and ugliest of the faerie princes, a spider who took human form, married the Spinnen ancestress and gave her the first flax plant as dowry.

name: Spinnen
description: A family descended from a maiden and the spider prince Spin Head, some of whom can weave cloth by touch; all are employed secretly by Florum.

name: Spirit Anchor
description: An object anchoring a faerie; the stalagmite ball of the Witch.

name: Spirit Binding
description: Binding of spirits into objects, used by corrupt Cluniacs.

name: Spirit Master
description: Character design template recommended for the Daughters of Erictho.

name: Spirit Travel
description: Near-instant travel by a nightwalker's phantasticum, requiring a Stamina + Athletics roll by familiarity with the destination.

name: Spirit Votary (Virtue)
description: The Free Mythic Companion Virtue defining a character as a spirit votary.

name: Spirit bottle
description: Device Albinus uses to capture Vindsvall.

name: Spirit of Blood
description: Magical spirit representing a bloodline, summonable through Corpus to identify the true heir.

name: Spirit of a Person's Anger
description: An incorporeal Mentem spirit of Might 20 with the Wrathful Flaw and a Fury power that drives targets into uncontrollable rage; appears to Second Sight as a furious red-faced man.

name: Spirit of the Wind
description: Example spirit that might foster its son, as a swift horse, to a prince for dominion over mountains.

name: Spirits
description: Beings of pure form with no matter, immortal and insensible to physical beings without powers; includes genii and animi.

name: Spiritual Authority
description: Being invested with responsibility for others' spiritual well being, required for holy influence.

name: Spiritual Dream Travel
description: Traveling into a dream as spirit, leaving body and possessions behind while it lies in trance.

name: Spiritual Form
description: Power letting guardians and Host become material or immaterial and travel at 100 times speed.

name: Spiritual Path
description: Series of Quest Components through which a contemplative mystic gains a Revelation.

name: Spiritual Traveler
description: A dream traveler whose spirit enters a dream while the body lies entranced; perceives everything in dream as Imaginem illusion.

name: Spit Fire
description: Two-Headed Hound's Power to spit a bolt of fire.

name: Spontaneous Casting
description: Magic skill attributed to House Diedne.

name: Spontaneous Regio
description: Temporary Divine regio created by a divine effect of tenth magnitude or greater.

name: Spring Tenens
description: Least experienced Tenens Occultorum, covering Britannia, Hibernia, Loch Leglean and Stonehenge.

name: Sprint of the Zephyr
description: Great Stallion power to gallop a league in one Diameter.

name: Sprouting Out of Season
description: A Creo Herbam 20 spell (R: Touch, D: Sun, T: Ind) that causes the seed of any plant to sprout in a single day or night.

name: Spying on your sodales using magic
description: High crime under Hermetic law technically committed by counting magi with Intellego.

name: Squirming Sack
description: Power of the Man in Black moving a child who made eye contact into his sack.

name: Squirrel
description: Pet with game statistics.

name: Sron Dubh
description: Seumas's wildcat familiar, the only Scottish wildcat ever domesticated.

name: St Andrew
description: Greater saint, patron of Scotland, fishermen, and sailors.

name: St Beatus' Cave
description: Caves in the Jungfrau region once a saint's retreat.

name: St David of Thessalonike
description: Local saint, patron of Thessalonike.

name: St Eulogius
description: Local saint, patron of Cordoba.

name: St Finnbarr
description: Local saint, patron of Cork.

name: St Front
description: Converter of Périgord who slew the dragon La Coloubre.

name: St Gilbert
description: Local saint, patron of Sempringham.

name: St Gotthard
description: Local saint, patron of Hildesheim.

name: St Irene
description: Local saint, patron of Thessalonica.

name: St Jude
description: Greater saint, patron of lost causes.

name: St Kevin
description: Local saint, patron of Dublin.

name: St Kilda Archipelago
description: Islands far west of Scotland with about a hundred Viking-stock inhabitants, the largest called Hirtir.

name: St Thomas a Becket
description: Area saint, patron of Canterbury.

name: St Wolfgang
description: Pilgrimage church in the Abersee valley.

name: St-Pol-de-Léon
description: Bishopric.

name: St-Èmilion
description: Wine town ruled by the Jurade with an underground church.

name: St. Adalard
description: Cousin of Charlemagne under whom Corbie rose.

name: St. Aidan
description: Saint of Northumbria and Holy Isle (580).

name: St. Amand
description: Apostle of Flanders who founded Ghent's monasteries and Christianized Antwerp.

name: St. Ansgar
description: Apostle of the North born in Corbie, later archbishop of Hamburg.

name: St. Anthony's Fire Demon
description: A minor disease demon with Might 10 (Corpus) that lodges in a victim's intestines causing escalating wounds, exorcisable by a ritual of the Order of the Hospitalers of St. Anthony.

name: St. Arthmael
description: Founder of Ploëmel who defeated a dragon.

name: St. Basil of Caesarea
description: Author of the single Rule governing Byzantine monasteries.

name: St. Bathilde
description: Wife of Clovis II and founder of Corbie.

name: St. Begga
description: 7th-century mother superior giving the Beguines their name.

name: St. Bernard dog
description: Dog breed in its infancy in 1220.

name: St. Briac
description: Saint petitioned at Bourbriac for those subject to fits.

name: St. Bride
description: Saint whose feast on February 1 falls on Imbolc.

name: St. Brieuc
description: Port with St. Broch's fountain.

name: St. Brieve
description: Town used as a reference point for placing the Cursewood in the Normandy Tribunal.

name: St. Broch
description: Welsh saint commemorated at St. Brieuc, with a fountain granting a Blessing.

name: St. Cado
description: Saint with a chapel curing the deaf and a fertility pillar.

name: St. Christopher's Rock
description: Cliff settlement in the Vézère valley.

name: St. Clotilde
description: Wife of Clovis I; patron of the lame, invoked against sudden death and iniquitous husbands.

name: St. Cloud
description: Town on the Seine named after Clodoald, now belonging to the bishops of Paris.

name: St. Collen
description: A hermit living on the side of Glastonbury Tor who confronted Gwynn ab Nudd, banishing the faerie king and his castle with holy water.

name: St. Corentine
description: First bishop of Quimper who lived off a regenerating magical fish.

name: St. Cornelius
description: Saint said to have turned pursuing faeries into the Carnac stones.

name: St. Crispianian
description: Patron saint of leatherworkers and cobblers (with St. Crispin); brother of St. Crispin who preached in Gaul.

name: St. Crispin
description: Patron saint of leatherworkers and cobblers (with St. Crispianian); one of two brothers of a noble Roman family who preached in Gaul in the third century.

name: St. Curig
description: A Welsh saint whose gold-and-silver-encased staff, kept in the church of St. Germanus, miraculously cures tumors in exchange for an offering.

name: St. David
description: A saint who came from Wales to Glastonbury to rededicate the old church but was told in a dream that God had already dedicated it; he was wounded then healed as a sign.

name: St. Davids
description: A Welsh cathedral and see; Gerald of Wales campaigned to make it an archbishopric over the Welsh sees, without success.

name: St. Denis (town)
description: Wealthy royal town north of Paris hosting the Lendit fair.

name: St. Edmund
description: A king of East Anglia martyred by the Danes and beheaded, his head guarded by a wolf; his shrine is at Bury St. Edmund's and he appeared in armor to condemn Henry of Essex.

name: St. Eligius
description: Goldsmith and adviser to Dagobert I who founded Solignac monastery.

name: St. Eloi
description: Patron saint of goldsmiths and jewelers; a preacher who became Bishop of Noyon in seventh-century France.

name: St. Erhard
description: The uncle of St. Odile who baptized her, upon which she miraculously recovered her sight.

name: St. Erkenwald
description: A seventh-century bishop of London and patron saint of the city; the blasphemer Eustace who mocked his shrine was struck down by divine judgment.

name: St. Etheldreda
description: A saint whose tomb at Ely is a major pilgrimage site; she appeared with St. Benedict and St. Sexburga to miraculously free the prisoner Bricstan.

name: St. Exuperius
description: Founder of the Diocese of Bayeux in the first century.

name: St. Georgen
description: A Benedictine monastery founded 1084 as a daughter house of Hirsau, finally destroyed in 1208 by strange dark vines that killed its monks; suspected to be the work of Dankmar or the forest itself.

name: St. Germanus
description: Fifth-century bishop of Auxerre.

name: St. Giles
description: Saint whose statue in Cotentin is used as a fertility charm and allegedly regrows shaved wood.

name: St. Giles' Fair, Winchester
description: The most important fair in England, the only one where Redcaps are always in attendance, sited around the church of St. Giles outside Winchester's walls; tin from Cornwall and gold from Wales are obtained there.

name: St. Gregory
description: Called the deadly sins the 'capital vices'.

name: St. Gregory of Tours
description: Bishop of Tours who wrote the Historia Francorum.

name: St. Guirec
description: Welsh saint commemorated at Perros Guirec.

name: St. Guénolé
description: Founder of the abbey at Landévennec.

name: St. Helena
description: Saint, mother of Emperor Constantine the Great.

name: St. Hilary
description: Bishop of Poitiers who trapped a flood demon under the sea.

name: St. Hubert Monastery
description: Swiss monastery whose abbot breeds the St. Hubert running hounds, famed for their noses.

name: St. James the Great
description: Apostle of Compostela; greater saint, patron of Spain, pilgrims, laborers.

name: St. John Chrysostom
description: Fourth-century saint who heeded divine dreams but denounced those working magic through dreams.

name: St. John of Damascus
description: Greatest Eastern theologian (670s-760s), outlined Orthodox Christianity.

name: St. Just
description: Village north of Redon near which groups of gray stones lie in a level 3 Magic aura.

name: St. Justin
description: Attested Simon Magus founded a cult worshiping him.

name: St. Lambert
description: A 7th-century bishop of Tongeren martyred at the site of Liege amid a Merovingian feud; his tomb drew pilgrims and the cathedral of St. Lambert was erected over it.

name: St. Lebuinus
description: A saint who was the first to erect a chapel on the site of Deventer in 768; the present church of Deventer is named after him.

name: St. Lie
description: Fifth-century hermit-saint.

name: St. Liudger
description: A saint who rebuilt the chapel at Deventer in 776 after it was destroyed by Saxon heathens.

name: St. Livier
description: A local lord and saint beheaded by Attila when the Huns sacked Metz, who afterward picked up his head and walked to his burial place on a nearby hilltop.

name: St. Lupus
description: Early bishop who spared Troyes from Attila by offering himself as hostage.

name: St. Léonard
description: Godson of Clovis, hermit at Noblat.

name: St. Maelrubha
description: Saint associated with Applecross (601).

name: St. Magloire
description: Benedictine monastery at Léhon founded by Nominoé.

name: St. Martial
description: Converter of the Limoges region, buried at the abbey bearing his name.

name: St. Mary's Abbey, York
description: A large Benedictine monastery in York founded in 1080 whose dissatisfied monks went on to found the Cistercian Fountains Abbey; led in 1220 by Abbot Robert of Longchamp.

name: St. Mary's Day
description: August 15 feast by which the harvest is normally over.

name: St. Matthew's Point
description: Abbey site.

name: St. Maurice
description: Patron saint of dyers and weavers; an Egyptian soldier and principal officer of the Theban legion in the third-century Roman army.

name: St. Mellon
description: Successor of Nicaise who established the diocese of Rouen.

name: St. Michael's Mount
description: The place where the flood drowning Lyonesse finally stopped and where the first Trevelyan landed on his white horse.

name: St. Molaug
description: Saint of the Isle of Lismore (562).

name: St. Ninian
description: Holy man trained by St. Martin of Tours who brought Christianity to the southern Picts and built Candida Casa in 397.

name: St. Nivard
description: Founder of Hautvillers in 660.

name: St. Norbert
description: Founder of the Premonstratensian order.

name: St. Odile
description: A 7th-century saint born blind to duke Adalric, who miraculously recovered her sight upon baptism, established a convent at the Hohenburg, and brought forth a curative spring.

name: St. Ouen
description: Canonized bishop of Rouen (641-684) who converted or exterminated many pagans.

name: St. Patern
description: Welsh saint commemorated at Vannes.

name: St. Perpetuus
description: Bishop of Tours after St. Martin in 397.

name: St. Peter's Basilica
description: Seat of Dominion power in Rome, aura 5-10.

name: St. Philibert
description: Founder of the abbey of Jumieges in 634.

name: St. Piat
description: Converted Tournai.

name: St. Remi
description: Bishop of Reims, Apostle of the Franks, who baptised Clovis I.

name: St. Remigius
description: Bishop of Reims who baptized Clovis; patron saint of Reims, born in Laon.

name: St. Renan
description: Town.

name: St. Riquier
description: Seventh-century pagan converted by Irish missionaries who became a bishop then hermit.

name: St. Romanus
description: Archbishop of Rouen who paralyzed the Gargouille; his shrine has a Faith Point total of 5.

name: St. Samson
description: Welsh saint commemorated at Dol, where a cathedral to him is built.

name: St. Swithin's Soupbowl
description: An ancient stone column topped by a stone bowl, set there by Viking raiders; water left in the bowl by sunrise on St. Swithin's Day becomes Aquam vis by sunset.

name: St. Swithun
description: A saint to whom the cathedral priory (Oldminster) of Winchester and a church over Kingsgate are dedicated.

name: St. Symeon
description: Saint whose site of martyrdom is a possible pilgrimage goal.

name: St. Thomas Aquinas
description: Theologian who will write the Summa Theologiae later in the thirteenth century.

name: St. Tryphaena
description: First-century martyr of Kyzikos, patron saint of Bear Island.

name: St. Tugdual
description: Welsh saint commemorated at Tréguier.

name: St. Ursula
description: A British princess who undertook a pilgrimage with 11,010 virginal handmaidens and was martyred with them at Cologne by the Huns; a church in Cologne marks their burial.

name: St. Valery
description: Sixth-century shepherd turned monk and hermit near Amiens.

name: St. Vedast
description: Bishop of Arras who prepared Clovis I for baptism; depicted with a wolf and goose.

name: St. Victricius
description: Bishop and theological writer at Rouen (380-409), author of De Laude Sanctorum and Liber Regularum.

name: St. Vigor
description: Bishop of Bayeux who destroyed a pagan temple in the sixth century, earning the enmity of the faeries.

name: St. Wandrille
description: Large Benedictine abbey downstream of Jumieges; its monks colonized Mont St. Michael in 966.

name: St. Werburg
description: A saint whose Benedictine abbey lies in Chester; in legend she resurrected an eaten goose and forbade geese from entering a particular field forever.

name: St. Wulfstan
description: A bishop of Worcester before and after the Norman Conquest, credited with miraculously saving Bristol merchants at sea and abolishing the Bristol slave trade.

name: Stables
description: Establishment for horses.

name: Stack the Decorated Page
description: ReHe(An) 20 effect of the Superb Scrinium moving the written sheet to the right-hand slab.

name: Stackyard
description: Robustly fenced area in the messuage where harvested grain is stacked before threshing.

name: Staff
description: Two-handed crushing weapon.

name: Staff of Healing
description: Medica's staff with healing Rituals powered by a bound Might 27 spirit.

name: Staff of St. Curig
description: A relic staff encased in gold and silver with a cross-shaped top, kept in the church of St. Germanus, that miraculously removes tumors when pressed against them with an offering of a penny.

name: Stag Antler Cup
description: Cup carved from a Stag of Virtue's right antler that neutralizes poison.

name: Stag Clan
description: A Crintera clan that oversees the covenant's defense; its members are the most skilled soldiers, fighting with swords, and its leader serves as turb captain.

name: Stamford
description: Town with odd traditions, site of Bladud's university and possibly a second fermenter.

name: Stamford Fermenter
description: Second fermenter at Stamford.

name: Stan
description: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Stone", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

name: Stance of the Firm-Buttocked Knight
description: ReCo 20 spell preventing the caster falling from a seat or saddle.

name: Standard Apprenticeship
description: Benchmark model of a 15-year apprenticeship yielding about 240 experience points and 120 spell levels.

name: Stanica
description: Filia of Mara ex Miscellanea who inherited Regulus' proxy vote.

name: Stanton Drew
description: Megalithic rings west of Bath formed from a wedding party turned to stone; their tears hold Terram vis.

name: Stanton Drew stone people
description: Dancers turned to stone who weep Terram vis.

name: Staple Island
description: Outer island with Faerie aura 2 (5 in undersea grottoes), seat of the selkie king's court.

name: Staple Sound
description: A mile-wide channel separating the inner and outer Farne Islands.

name: Staters of Kyzikos
description: Ancient gold coins found on Bear Island.

name: Station of Passing Through Seeming
description: Station of the Path of Seeming relevant to Breakthroughs into nightwalking.

name: Station of the Perfect Tool
aliases: The Avenue of Subduing the Meat
description: The first Station of the Criamon Path of the Body, reached via the Avenue of Subduing the Meat, where the magus realizes the body is the perfect tool for Hermetic magic.

name: Stationer
description: A covenant staff member employed in the book trade to coordinate production, purchase scribal supplies, and dispatch books, often dealing with Redcaps.

name: Statue of Mercury
description: Decapitated marble statue of Mercury in the cella.

name: Statue of Our Lady of Josselin
description: Wooden Virgin statue before which local women beg forgiveness to avert a curse.

name: Statue of St. Giles
description: Phallic statue in Cotentin from which healing wood shavings are taken and which reputedly regrows them.

name: Statue to Animal
description: Hermetic spell (MuTe 25) in a Roman Tribunal magus vocation template.

name: Statutes of Lübeck
description: Special privileges granted to Lübeck by Henry the Lion that let it govern itself independently under a merchant council led by the Älderman.

name: Statutes of Saint Bruno
description: The rule followed by the Carthusians instead of the Rule of Benedict.

name: Stay the Fickle Hand of Fate
description: TuFa 5 charm preventing random mishaps from selecting the target.

name: Steadying Hand
description: A power of the angel Nasir (5 points, Animal/Corpus) that, by touching a target, ensures their footing is firm so they will not slip or fall while contact is maintained.

name: Steal Blood
description: Lucifuge Power drawing blood through the skin.

name: Steal Eyes
description: Lamia's power to remove a victim's eyes and place them in her own head.

name: Steal Life
description: Lilin Power: a withering touch of the lips.

name: Steal Thoughts
description: Lucifuge Power taking a fact, memory or desire from a mind.

name: Stealing the Cowl
description: Varriar's power to take the appearance of those under his authority.

name: Steedles
description: Small pillars raising granaries or grain stacks to prevent rodent infestation.

name: Steenvoorde
description: Town parading a giant mannequin in armor.

name: Steering A Vast Stone Dish
description: ReTe 40 Ring/Circle spell to direct the voyage of a small floating island.

name: Stefano di Cecanno
description: Cardinal-priest of Saint XII Apostoli (1213), appointed papal camerlengo in 1219.

name: Stella
description: Example maga with astrological Cyclic Magic.

name: Stellapser
description: A ruin in the West Country near which the region is suitable for magical colonization.

name: Stellasper
description: Covenant founded by Criamon magi in 1025 in the Scilly Isles southwest of Cornwall; destroyed in a great storm in 1163.

name: Stellus
description: Example Initiate born under Capricorn.

name: Stennes Stones
description: Stone circle on Mainland in the Orkneys leading to Barathrum and Caelum; a gateway to Arcadia.

name: Stephan of Tusculum
description: Ruthless Templar brother-sergeant leading a tomb-raiding team hunting relics in Greece.

name: Stephen Eruditus
description: The Jerbiton magus who founded and leads Libellus; trained in the Rhine Tribunal, around seventy but looks mid-thirties, with a reputation for risk-taking.

name: Stephen Langton
description: The Archbishop of Canterbury (born 1165, archbishop since 1207), a noted Paris theologian who helped draft Magna Carta and seeks to establish the archbishop as the highest ecclesiastical authority in England.

name: Stephen of Belmonte
description: Templar commander in Aragon seeking Hermetic magi for magical weapons and ships.

name: Stettin
description: A small port city on the River Oder overlooked by an old Wendish fortress, the ancestral home of the Pomeranian rulers, with the church of St. Jakob completed in 1187.

name: Sticky Skin
description: Each uisge power (ReCo 25) making its skin adhere to anyone who touches it.

name: Stifle the Lengthy Sickness
description: VuMa general charm reducing the Duration of a disease-causing magical effect.

name: Stiftsbibliothek
description: Library of Saint Gallen.

name: Stilbon
description: Planetary spirit of Mercury, ruling knowledge, scribes and travelers.

name: Still Sack
description: Power of the Man in Black keeping children unconscious in his sack; a powerful version of Cause Drowsiness.

name: Still the Raging Waters
description: A Rego Aquam spell (ReAq 15) created by Falke that stills the waves on a small body of water to mirror-smoothness.

name: Stink
description: Hagbui power (CrAu 10) like Stench of the Twenty Corpses.

name: Stir the Body
description: Evocation/Weal 20 ritual allowing an immediate Recovery roll.

name: Stirling
description: Site of Wallace's victory at Stirling Bridge.

name: Stock
description: A crudely carved wooden image left in place of a stolen infant.

name: Stock Characters
description: The caricatured folk-tale personas faeries often adopt when pretending to be human.

name: Stockade
description: Siege tactic of surrounding at least three castle walls to starve the garrison; forces periodic supplies rolls until the castle surrenders.

name: Stocky
description: Virtue appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Stole
description: Symbol of deacon and priest office.

name: Stollenwurm
description: The tunnel worm, a far longer variant of the tatzelwurm that rears up and attacks with its foreclaws.

name: Stone Couches
description: Faerie tumuli that grow duplicates of folk heroes, called Sleepers.

name: Stone Drum
description: Random story element whose sound ceases all Arduinna's powers.

name: Stone Weapons
description: Primitive weapons that deal 2 less Damage than metal ones, minimum +1.

name: Stone of London
description: Ancient stone in London said to be linked to the city's prosperity, a powerful tether for sovereignty magic.

name: Stone of Merlin
description: Rock slabs where Merlin may sleep.

name: Stone of the Black Serpent
aliases: the stone in the serpent's tail
description: A wish-granting stone in the Black Serpent's tail that gives its holder as much gold as desired; Peredur took only this from his victory.

name: Stone snakes
description: Petrified snakes containing vis.

name: Stone to Falling Dust
description: A Perdo Terram spell that turns one solid non-living object of base Individual size or smaller into a pile of dust.

name: Stone-Cutting Knife
description: A Rego Terram 15 enchanted chisel that shapes and forms stone as a stonemason would, usable to carve blocks from a quarry; can boost quarry productivity.

name: Stones
description: A Serious Choleric or Phlegmatic Disease in which coagulated bile or phlegm forms hard stones in the gallbladder, kidney, or bladder.

name: Storgodi
description: Powerful Icelandic chieftain in legal terms.

name: Stories of Holy Men
description: Work by Farid al-Din 'Attar quoted about Rabi'a.

name: Storm (Duration)
description: Special Atlantean Duration lasting until the end of a storm; equal to Concentration.

name: Storm Birds
description: Cormorants, petrels and fulmars associated with stormy weather.

name: Storm Giants
description: Norse giants with Auram Resistance and Lesser Immunity to lightning; Rok is one.

name: Storm-Calling
description: Power of the storm spirit duplicating Creo or Rego Auram effects up to level 35.

name: Story Elements
description: Actors, props, and scenery linked together to build Faerie stories, one per story experience point.

name: Story Experience
description: Experience points awarded per story; guide the number of story elements.

name: Story Flow
description: Story-planning method dividing a story into thesis, antithesis, and synthesis, fleshed out as six components: hook, trigger, setting, twist, resolution, and consequences.

name: Stout Potion
description: CrCo 60 ritual charged potion increasing Stamina by 1.

name: Straits of Gibraltar
description: Area in Iberia where apes are found in Europe.

name: Straits of Messina
description: Straits where sirens sing.

name: Strange Tricks Using Canal Contents
description: MuAq 25 Boundary ritual transforming water in the island's canals into another natural liquid such as oil, wine or honey.

name: Strassburg
description: A Rhine trade city at the confluence of the Ill and the Rhine, originally the Roman Argentoratum, whose powerful boater's gild controls much of the Upper Rhine trade.

name: Strata Florida
description: A particularly important Cistercian monastery in Powys, Wales, serving as a repository of history and mausoleum of princely dynasties.

name: Strategos
description: Byzantine general who controls a theme.

name: Strathclyde
description: British kingdom inherited by Duncan.

name: Stratifying the Subtle Realities
description: CrVi Ritual variant making regio creation more likely.

name: Stregoni
description: Evil witches of northeast Italy who transform into owls to spread misfortune, each group ruled by a male witch (strego).

name: Stregos
description: Archmagus who led the consortium charging Fulmen of Guernicus.

name: Strength Runes
description: Vitkar magic focus on impossible things.

name: Strengthen the Shielding Sark
description: MuHe 20 effect enchanted on Whitburh's robes.

name: Stride of the Impatient Human
description: Loamwalker power for a tree to change into a human until sunset.

name: Strife
description: In Criamon cosmology, the force that divides and promotes separation; one of the two great forces of the universe, reflected by the Art of Perdo and the source of magic's power.

name: Strike the Proud Low
description: TaBl 25 spell reducing one martial Ability of the victim to 0 until a Limit is fulfilled.

name: Stripping the Superfluous Realities
description: PeVi 30 Ritual aiming to destroy a regio level via Aura Weakening roll.

name: Stroke of Death
description: The power making Manannan's sword lethally sharp, an immediately fatal effect.

name: Strong Faun Blood
description: Virtue possessed by Caprican.

name: Strong Temper
description: Temper of self-control, tied to Temperance and opposing Gluttony.

name: Strong Verbal Charms
description: Major Supernatural Virtue improving the level of verbal charms and charms cast from texts.

name: Strong Writer
description: Writes well.

name: Structure target
description: Target that can affect an entire church; nave and tower floors count as Rooms.

name: Struggle
description: Act of direct conflict between hero and villain over the object of the quest, usually ending in the hero's victory.

name: Stubnitz Forest
description: The largest forest on Rugen, on the Jasmund peninsula, deep within which the covenant Crintera lies; also containing the mysterious Hertha Lake.

name: Stuck in Your Ways
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character insists on doing things his old covenant's way, using the lower of an Ability and his current Covenant Lore for certain Stress Rolls.

name: Student of (Infernal)
description: Minor General Virtue option for diabolists and summoners.

name: Student of Brude
description: +1 Gruagach Virtue: trained by Brude Deathless, with prestige and access to External Soul, but a Geas to train a student by age forty-nine.

name: Student of Divine
description: Virtue granting a bonus to Dominion Lore, held by the Sufi Poetess.

name: Student of Dominion
description: Virtue granting a bonus to Dominion Lore, held by the Church Deacon.

name: Student of Magic
description: A Virtue suggested as appropriate for Mercurian characters.

name: Student of Magic Realm
description: A Mystery Virtue the Titanoi cult can Initiate.

name: Student of the Infernal
description: Explains an Infernal background for vagantes.

name: Studio
description: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: an ornate room outside the lab displays the owner's prized possessions to guests, commonly built by Verditius magi.

name: Stygian Waters
description: Telechine power mixing Stygian water (Perdo vis) with sulfur to create a poison fatal to all men, beasts and plants.

name: Substance Over Form
description: Cr(Mu)Te(Me) 20 Mystery Ritual cast by a physical traveler in a dream with real-world vis, making a dream object real so it can leave the dream.

name: Subterranean
description: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab is underground, lacking natural light and requiring more candles (+1 Upkeep, -1 Health, -1 Aesthetics, +1 Terram).

name: Subtle Knives
description: Summa on Penetration by Jacinda of Flambeau.

name: Subtle Taste of Poison and Purity
description: An Intellego Aquam spell (Level 5) that lets the caster taste all properties of any liquid or mixture of liquids tasted.

name: Suck the Breath
description: Cat power causing an asthma attack like Grip of the Choking Hand.

name: Suckle Cows Dry
description: Cat power making a cow lactate while cats suckle.

name: Suffocate
description: Obligatory Greater Power of air elementals, entering a victim's lungs.

name: Suffocate the Dead
description: Cat power similar to Lay to Rest the Haunting Spirit, used by sleeping on a ghost's grave.

name: Sula
description: The autocrat of Durenmar, a wrinkled and gentle woman over ninety who arranges accommodation for visitors with uncanny ease.

name: Suleiman's Wrath on the Oath-Forsaken Jinni
description: A PeVi spell that weakens and possibly destroys a creature with Magic Might, permanently destroying one reduced to zero Might.

name: Sulfur-Mercury Theory
description: Alchemical theory of metals present in early European alchemy.

name: Sulfurous Whispers
description: InVi 30 speaking with a demon via Arcane Connection.

name: Sulis
description: Local goddess of Bath's springs identified by Romans with Minerva.

name: Sultan
description: Governor of territories theoretically serving the caliph.

name: Sultan of Bukhara
description: Ruler cured by Ibn Sina who rewarded him with access to his library.

name: Sultan of Egypt
description: Muslim ruler who received Francis courteously in his encampment, offered gifts, and sent him back to the Christian camp.

name: Summa Theologiae
description: Theological work by Thomas Aquinas to be written later in the 13th century.

name: Summer (Story Element)
description: Scenery story element of bounty and vigor that lulls one to sloth.

name: Summer Court
description: Faerie court that makes war on the Winter Court at the Equinox.

name: Summer Covenant
description: Established covenant.

name: Summer Fae of Somerset
description: Summer faeries that the Second Working could trap.

name: Summer Faeries
description: Faeries of the Arcadian summer lands who harried the Dachstein giants.

name: Summer Kingdom
description: Example Faerie destination reached through story choices, not geography.

name: Summer Solstice
description: Sabbat date.

name: Summer Tenens
description: Tenens Occultorum responsible for the Iberian, Provencal and Normandy Tribunals.

name: Summerlands
description: Land of Summer where pies grow on trees and rivers run with mead and milk; where one is forever young.

name: Summon Mavens of the Purple Bower
description: Neqael's power to summon lesser demons, which she rules without mystical compulsion.

name: Summon shapes of lustful need / And swiftly form a ghostly steed
description: Debauchery/Phantasm 20 phantasmal horse.

name: Summon the Haunting Spirit
description: Hermetic spell (ReMe 25) in a Roman Tribunal magus vocation template.

name: Summon the Rider of the Waves
description: Manannan's power, similar to Push of the Gentle Wave, to upturn boats or force ships away from the island.

name: Summoner (Virtue)
description: Free Special Virtue required of Summoners.

name: Summoning the Ancestor Spirit
description: ReCo 45 ritual summoning a magical spirit of a bloodline into a warding circle to be questioned about the true heir.

name: Summoning the Creeping Death
description: A Cr(Re)An 25 spell that conjures an obedient asp with deadly venom but no Might; sometimes used by School of Sebastian followers but disdained by other Flambeau magi as ignoble.

name: Summoning the Image of the Distant
description: InIm 17 effect of the Hermetic Speculum to see and hear a connected individual.

name: Summoning the Spirit of Anger
description: A ReMe 40 spell that calls a spirit of wrath to the magus's location via an Arcane Connection or its full name, inflicting a Warping Point on the source of the anger.

name: Summoning the Spirit of Fire
description: ReIg 40 calls fiery spirit.

name: Sunlight Without Flame
description: Level 15 variant of Lamp Without Flame.

name: Sunna
description: Actions and sayings of the Prophet and companions as examples of good behavior.

name: Sunnis
description: Mainstream Muslims whose doctrines follow al-Ash'ari and al-Maturidi; they recognize the caliph in Baghdad.

name: Superior Construction
description: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab benefits from distinguished construction techniques or materials (+1 Safety, +1 Aesthetics).

name: Superior Decoration
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is luxuriantly decorated, e.g. with fine tapestries (+1 Upkeep, +2 Aesthetics, +1 Imaginem).

name: Superior Demonic Familiar
description: Virtue of Lord Goulis.

name: Superior Equipment
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab has higher-quality equipment such as Venetian glassware (+1 General Quality, +2 Upkeep, +1 Safety, +1 Vis Extraction).

name: Superior Heating
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab has superior heating facilities so the occupant is never chilly (+1 Upkeep, +1 Health, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Ignem).

name: Superior Lighting
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is very well lit so things are easy to find and books easy to read (+1 Upkeep, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Texts, +1 Imaginem).

name: Superior Tools
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab's tools were produced by master craftsmen (+1 Upkeep, +1 Safety, +1 Items).

name: Supernatural Horse
description: Horse of Mythic Europe that may have higher Intelligence than its rider and decides action order.

name: Supple Iron and Rigid Rope
description: A Muto Terram spell that makes a flexible object stiff or a stiff object flexible, with appropriate Form requisites.

name: Supplies Roll
description: Roll of Siege Conditions Bonus plus stress die against an Ease Factor based on garrison size and years under siege; failure reduces the castle's supply quality.

name: Sura
description: Babylonian yeshivah city where Saadia Gaon was Gaon.

name: Sure Strike of the Sword
description: ReCo 20 spell of Edwin's granting +2 weapon skill.

name: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew
description: Meditation Transcendence effect (Level 30) letting the caster pass through nonliving obstacles.

name: Surface Form
description: Inherited Atlantean Virtue, a version of Skinchanger.

name: Surrey
description: English region of Sir Jehan's claimed origin.

name: Suryal
description: One of the five archangels who refused the sinning Watchers readmission to Heaven.

name: Susanna
description: The liberal-minded mater of Petrus Virilis, who researched fertility and the Gift and has since entered Final Twilight.

name: Susannah
description: Carmine's Flambeau parens.

name: Susceptibility to Magic
description: A Minor Curse (Rego Vim effect) that strips a victim's natural resistance to magic, imposing a -3 to resist spells and supernatural effects.

name: Susceptibility to Sunlight
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which direct bright sunlight causes the character pain and exhaustion, giving -2 to sight rolls in bright environments and Fatigue loss outdoors.

name: Susceptibility to Warping
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character gains an additional Warping Point from each Realm whenever he gains one in a year, without contributing to Twilight.

name: Susceptible to Infernal Power
description: Flaw.

name: Suspirium
description: A ninth-century Bjornaer magus, the most recent common ancestor of Stellatus and Lacerta, after whom their sept was renamed.

name: Sustain a Spell of (Form)
description: ReVi General Ritual binding a spell to a container.

name: Sustain a Spell of Fire
description: Example ReVi(Ig) container ritual.

name: Sut
description: Son of Iblis with dominion over lies.

name: Svantovit
description: A four-faced Slavic sun- and war-god worshipped at Arkona, whose Faerie aura lingers despite the temple's destruction; opposed to the Queen of Winter, granting Falke's ritual a bonus.

name: Sven Svennson
description: Powerful Norwegian duke, uncle of Eirik Svennson, who placed soldiers and builders under his authority.

name: Svetlana
description: Maga making late-night journeys to Gallows Wood, supposedly harvesting vis.

name: Swallow Assault
description: Baal-Peor's Power to swallow mundane attacks harmlessly.

name: Swallowed Alive and Sent to Hell
description: Saint curse opening a chasm that drops the target into Hell.

name: Swan Clan
description: The smallest Crintera clan, comprising crafts-folk and companions with non-shapechanging magical powers; led by Janis, contact with the pagan Forest Brothers of Rügen.

name: Swan Maidens
description: Faerie beings featuring in stories of the Faerie Realm.

name: Swanmaiden
description: Close cousins of the selkies who can be trapped by mortal men as brides.

name: Sway the Hearts of Man
description: Principality power inculcating a temper in many minds under a Divine aura.

name: Sweated Shillings
description: The shifting gaggle of young magi living with Mathieus, named after clipped coins.

name: Sweeping Prohibition
description: The broadest geas prohibition (+4 magnitudes, like Year Duration) or the easiest-to-lift limit on a blessing or curse (+1 magnitude).

name: Swift Assarting
description: Story seed about brigands claiming to be former assarting workers of a covenant that actually assarted magically.

name: Swift Knives, Invisible
description: A Perdo Animal 40 spell with Rego requisite that reduces a dead animal to its components, such as wool, hide, meat, organs, and skeleton.

name: Swift Wings of Timeless Days
description: ReVi 20 spell reducing the caster's Twilight Void journey by three steps.

name: Swimming
description: Ability for swamp swimming.

name: Swiss Gateway Lake
description: A lake in Switzerland said to have a gateway to Hell, actually created by a magical battle after the fall of the Western Empire.

name: Sword from the Unseen Scabbard
description: A CrTe 15 spell that conjures a steel longsword lasting about two minutes; it must penetrate Magic Resistance to harm magic-resistant opponents.

name: Sword of Bruncvik
description: The legendary sword that St. Wenceslaus is foretold to take up when he rises from the dead to lead his army.

name: Sword of Moses
description: Theurgic book naming angels and demons; Summa Infernal Lore and insight into Canaanite Necromancy.

name: Sword of Tytalus
description: Legendary Hermetic heirloom said possessed by Rothelin.

name: Swordbrethren
description: German crusading order being absorbed by the Teutonic Knights.

name: Swords of Silver and Moonlight
description: Muto Mentem level 40 spell (Terram requisite) making a ghost's metal accouterments solid so it can use its entire kit.

name: Swordsmiths' Guild
description: The craftsmen's guild of swordsmiths; Klaus the example craftsman is a master of it.

name: Sylvan Sanctity
description: Boar King power revealing the location and number of human intruders in his forest.

name: Sylvester of Assisi
description: Founder member of the Franciscans, a priest and cousin of Clare, who dreamt of a cross from Francis' mouth putting a dragon to flight.

name: Sylvester of Sées
description: Bishop of Sées elected 1201, formerly archdeacon; historically dies in 1220.

name: Symbol (Faerie Parameter)
description: Faerie Range, Duration, and Target using a symbol of the target, each requiring 3 points of applicable Sympathy Traits.

name: Symbolic Interpretation
description: Non-magical interpretation of dreams' symbolic meaning rolled with Intelligence + Divination (Dream Interpretation).

name: Symphony Of The Harmony Of Celestial Revelations
description: Hildegard's collection of music, a tractatus on Artes Liberales.

name: Synagogue
description: Gathering place for Rabbinical Jews to hear Torah readings.

name: Synesius
description: Stated that Pseudo-Democritus' work was in four books.

name: Synod
description: Meeting of clergy convoked by deans, archdeacons, bishops or archbishops.

name: Synod of Ancyra
description: Church synod whose material fed a penitential punishing those who practice auguries and pagan divination.

name: Synod of Whitby
description: 664 council declaring only the Roman Church should hold sway in the British Isles.

name: Synthemata of (X)
description: MuVi Mystery spell unique to one named being, adding its level to the caster's Penetration for the next spell against that being.

name: Szarlen
description: A demon who operates a lead mine for the Polish town of Beuthen in return for services such as appropriating the Church's tithe or requiring worship.

name: Szekeley
description: Hungarian mounted archers.

name: Tablets of the Testimony
description: Tablets Moses carried down from Mount Sinai.

name: Tablinum
description: A storehouse of information and artefacts in the Transylvanian Tribunal under the control of House Tremere, existing across numerous regiones entered only via spells requiring Arcane Connections held by its curator.

name: Tabula Geographica Magica
description: The Gazetteer of Magic, a catalogue of magical sites and regiones kept at the Great Library of Durenmar in Trianoma's Cipher.

name: Tacitus
description: Roman author of the Germania, listed as a period source on the Germanic lands.

name: Tackle
description: Maneuver causing attacker and opponent to fall prone.

name: Tactical Movement
description: Rules for walk, hurry and run movement rates on the battlefield.

name: Tadhkirat al-Awliya'
description: Biographies of Muslim mystics by Farid al-Din 'Attar, with altered sources.

name: Tafl
description: Popular Norse board game of defending a king.

name: Taking the Cross
description: Committing to a crusade in exchange for a free indulgence and a temporary Faith Point.

name: Taking the Cure
description: Rules for spa treatment relieving minor physical afflictions for three years.

name: Taklamakan Desert
description: A desert where Infernal storm spirits such as the Buran of Yenghissar are likely to be found.

name: Tales of Power
description: Ars Magica supplement containing the Encroaching Dominion scenario.

name: Talion of Flambeau
description: An ancient Flambeau magus, second oldest in the tribunal, who became praeco after Immanola was disqualified; renowned for mastery of Perdo.

name: Talking bears of Berne
description: Bears of Berne folklore led by a talking bear who saved a prince.

name: Talon of Criamon
description: Member of Sansaron.

name: Talos
description: A bull-headed bronze statue (automaton) made by Hephaestus that guarded Crete.

name: Talus of House Merinita
description: Prankster magus slain by Gravis after changing his voice with a spell.

name: Tame Nobleman
description: Covenant Boon: a nobleman fronts for the covenant's rule over its lands.

name: Taming
description: Seasonal activity accumulating points against a creature's Might to tame it.

name: Taming Creatures
description: Seasonal activity accumulating Intelligence + Animal Handling points to tame an animal.

name: Tandaline
description: A Follower of Bonisagus of Trianoma's lineage, a master of Muto and Auram, closest confidante of Murion and a Tenens Occultorum who maintains the House's correspondence.

name: Tannhäuser
description: A young 13th-century knight and poet of legend who discovered Venus's subterranean home, the Venusberg, and later sought absolution from the Pope.

name: Tapestry of Mythic Europe
description: Huge tapestry in Verdi's tower that tracks a person via an Arcane Connection and Imágonem vis.

name: Tarantism
description: A condition that works wholly differently from a disease, stemming from a faerie curse.

name: Targe
description: Typical Highland shield of two layered planks covered in studded leather, often with a boss spike.

name: Target: Group
description: Hermetic target of a continuous group of up to ten individuals, raised to 100 with one magnitude to affect a separated unit.

name: Tarith
description: Ex Miscellanea member of Vardian's Tomb.

name: Tarnkappe
description: A magical cloak of darkness taken by Siegfried from the dwarf Alberich, used to render him invisible and substitute for Gunther in the contests with Brünhild.

name: Tarragona
description: Spanish archdiocese.

name: Tarsus
description: Home of Paul, near the Lake Acherusia regio.

name: Tarus of Bonisagus
description: Author of Politics of the Order, musing on the Arch-Magi.

name: Task-Setter
description: Dramatic role that poses challenges for the hero to pass to win the princess, distinct from donor and villain.

name: Taste of the Dulled Tongue
description: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 5) that hides the taste of any substance, liquid or solid.

name: Tattoo Magic
description: Gruagach tattoo-based magic not practiced by trollsynir or kolduni.

name: Tattoo Mastery
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue reducing vis cost of gruagach tattoos by Pictish score.

name: Tatzelwurm
description: An Alpine dragon two to six feet long with a catlike head, lizard body without hind legs, and toxic breath.

name: Tavant
description: Village with a painted church, the only remnant of the covenant of Sinapis.

name: Tavistock Abbey
description: Abbey in Devon that owns the Scilly Isles and founded a monastic community at Tresco.

name: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies
description: Meditation Understanding effect (Level 15) giving a Common Sense-like vision.

name: Tear of Christ
description: Relic with Faith score 3 donated to the Abbey of the Trinity.

name: Tears of Sandalphon
description: Two powerful divine relics, tears shed by Sandalphon at the death of Muhammad, sought by an angel and by a diabolical coven wishing to use them as arcane connections.

name: Tears of a Rhinoceros
description: Rare item that Raisa retrieved from dreams to defeat the faerie drake attacking her covenant.

name: Teasels of Somerset Levels
description: Vis of the Poisoned Battlefield.

name: Technique
description: The five Hermetic Arts of action; a newly Opened apprentice has 0 in each.

name: Tefillin
description: Leather boxes containing the Shema; those owned by a Tzadik Nistar act as a relic.

name: Teind
description: Tithe of one mortal soul every seven years a Spirit of Deceit convinced a faerie court it owes Hell.

name: Telechines
description: A small group of titans, wizards and smiths who fought for the Olympians, made Cronus' sickle and Poseidon's trident, then created a deadly poison.

name: Teletarch
description: Master of Perfection: powerful Daimon embodying a concept or phenomenon.

name: Tell of the Forged
description: InTe 45 spell like Stone Tell of the Mind that Sits but usable on metal objects.

name: Tello
description: The Bishop of Palencia who works with the king to stabilize the university, allowing the masters an advisory council under the chancellor.

name: Telramund
description: A rebellious vassal of the late duke of Brabant who sought the dukedom and Elsa's hand and was defeated by Lohengrin in single combat.

name: Tempelburg
description: Future Templar site in Prussia.

name: Temperament
description: Dominant temperament of animals and people (choleric, melancholic, phlegmatic, sanguine) linked to elements.

name: Temperance
description: Moral (Cardinal) virtue that moderates inappropriate desire; chosen by Arshaq ibn Kareem in the Divine Unity example.

name: Tempering an Aura
description: Divine rule similar to Care of Souls.

name: Tempest of Needles
description: Group version of Shower of Needles known by Ragoneda.

name: Templar Ciphers
description: Encryption ledgers protecting Templar communications, kept secretly in provincial commanderies.

name: Templar Confrere
description: New Templar Virtue for lay associates of the Templars.

name: Templar Office Holder
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character holding a position in the local hierarchy of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon, such as deputy commander or marshal.

name: Templar Prisons
description: Secret Templar prisons across Mythic Europe.

name: Templar Rule
description: The strict rule governing Templar organization, hierarchy, penances and tactics, in seven sections.

name: Templar Sign Language
description: Limited hand signal language of the Templars.

name: Templar Treasury
description: The fabulously wealthy Templar temple in Paris operating as an early bank.

name: Temple in Jerusalem
description: The Temple built by Solomon, destroyed in 587 BC, rebuilt as the Second Temple and destroyed by the Romans.

name: Temple of Apollo in London
description: Lost temple in New Troy (London), founded by the Hyperboreans, where Bladud fell to his death and is buried.

name: Temple of Isis
description: An abandoned but well-repaired Roman temple within a magical regio in Florence's Piazza San Firenze, a potential covenant site holding relics of the Cults of Isis and Mercury.

name: Temple of Jupiter Ammon
description: Lost temple in Cyrene in the Libyan desert, source of true Sal Ammoniac.

name: Temple of Nodens
description: Temple in the Stonehenge Tribunal near which Cara was born, bearing rough drawings of piests.

name: Temple of the Hesperides
description: Temple where the Dragon slept.

name: Templeštejn
description: Future Templar preceptory in Moravia.

name: Temporary Magical Might
description: Quality whereby wounds reduce the elemental's Might pool.

name: Tempter
description: A kind of demon busy in nunneries, using those without real vocation to spread sin.

name: Tempus
description: In the Pages of History theory, a location in the Magic Realm that is a specific moment in history.

name: Ten Commandments
description: Stone tablets received by Moses at Sinai.

name: Tenants-in-Chief
description: Powerful families holding land directly from the king of England in exchange for military service, forming England's upper nobility.

name: Tenentes Occultorum
description: Inner Circle of four magi Trianomae ('Tenders of Secret Lore'), named for the seasons, who keep Hermetic secrets from mundanes.

name: Tentare
description: Scribe of Harco.

name: Terafim
description: Small pottery figurines used in divination and witchcraft, giving +5 to Understanding or Cursing amulet effects.

name: Terce
description: Canonical hour of the Divine Office: Morning service at 9 am, followed by the chapter meeting.

name: Tereus
description: King of the birds of Nephelococcygia, an epops who nests atop a thousand-foot spire said to hold records of prayers.

name: Terious of Flambeau
description: A magus of House Flambeau who walked the Path of Energy, became a living embodiment of the genius locus, and contributed the spell Replenishing the Fount of the Magus to the Great Library.

name: Terith of Jerbiton
description: Jerbiton researcher who seeks evidence of a diabolic pact tainting Italy and theorizes the Mercurians turned to diabolism.

name: Terra Nullius
description: An area of another realm home to no conscious thing, which faeries sense and may enter freely.

name: Terrae Cult
description: Terram-focused cult tradition within House Guernicus, possibly colonizers of Confluensis.

name: Terrain Bonus
description: +6 bonus to a native prey's Evasion Total, reduced by the relay and hunters.

name: Terram Magic
description: Earth magic cast spontaneously by trow; disliked by Am Balla.

name: Terram province
description: The Terram-aligned province of the Twilight Void: precious gems and metals shine like the sun; buried treasure is easily spotted.

name: Terrar
description: A monastery's land agent responsible for estates, tithes and accounts.

name: Terrestrial Demons
description: Demons who never knew Heaven: infernal ghosts or progeny of demons, including the Nephilim.

name: Terret
description: Ring on a jess slipped over a perch or finger.

name: Terrifying Howl of the Wolf
description: Power of the interloping wolves whose howl overcomes hearers with fear.

name: Terrifying Roar
description: Lion of Virtue roar freezing hearers in terror.

name: Terschelling (island)
description: A Friesian island on a deserted coastline that is home to the Waddenzee covenant and thousands of seabirds.

name: Tertiaries
description: Laymen following the Franciscan lifestyle without clerical vows, living with their families, under a rule of 1221.

name: Tertius
description: Fourth degree of the Fraternity of Samos dealing with metempsychosis and geometric solids, initiating Hermetic Architecture.

name: Tertius Quid
description: A forest where the Old Ones are said to sleep.

name: Tertullian
description: Quoted authority on initiation rites.

name: Test of Faith
description: An ordeal that can raise a character's Faith Score, such as a year spent on the Bush.

name: Test of Fastness and Fading
