description: An Intellego Aquam 5 spell that confirms the quality of a container of ink, dye, or paint, verifying it will not fade, flake, or eat through parchment.

name: Test of the Boiling Water
description: Ordeal of removing a stone from a boiling cauldron.

name: Test of the Flames
description: A CrIg 15 spell filling a circle with waist-high flames doing +5 damage per round; of ancient Cult of Mithras origin, once used by Flambeau magi as an endurance test alternative to certamen.

name: Testament of Solomon
description: Text listing the names of the 36 decani and the angels designated to counter them.

name: Testimony of Testimony
description: Written testimony read out by a principle at Tribunal on behalf of an absent witness.

name: Tests of Faith
description: Trials or ordeals by which God assesses a follower's devotion, often suspending Faith Points or Holy Virtues until fulfilled.

name: Tether
description: An object or circumstance of magical significance that attracts fluid vis to pool around it, forming the basis and center of a Magic aura.

name: Tether Strength
description: Value tied to spirit Might used in the Formation of Magic Auras.

name: Tethered Casting
description: Mutantes mastery ability passing control of a spell to another person or object.

name: Tethering
description: Mutantum technique passing control of a spell to another or to an object.

name: Tethys
description: Titaness who is the power of the waters under the earth.

name: Tetrabiblos
description: Ptolemy's astrology text, translated 1138.

name: Teviot
description: River north of which Lord Goulis rarely hunts.

name: Thabit ibn Qurra
description: Arabic writer (836-901) of a formula to rid a place of scorpions.

name: Thales of Miletus
description: Greek sage whose ghost haunts Kyzikos.

name: Thamik of Verditius
description: A young Verditius magus among the members recruited to Nigrasaxa.

name: Thamus Collis
description: Bonisagus Primus during the Schism War who abdicated.

name: Thamyris
description: Blind bard after whom amber-eyed children in Transylvania are often named.

name: Thanatos
description: Leader of the Thanatoi.

name: Thann Chapel
description: A chapel west of Mulhouse in the southern Vosges, built over a miraculous holy staff containing the ring and thumb of Theobald of Gubbio; has a Divine aura of 3 and is a place of pilgrimage.

name: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption
description: Meditation Intervention effect (Level 25) letting the caster perceive the stain of sin on people.

name: The (Over) Familiar Cat
description: A magical familiar cat with Magic Might 10 (Imaginem) bonded to a magus, with powers of night-vision and invisible movement and shared-senses bond effects.

name: The Abandoned Corpse
description: Premnemosyne's Power to leave a fake corpse behind.

name: The Ague
description: A Major Phlegmatic Disease (Severity 14) caused by bad air around sewage and tanneries, marked by continuous fever with chills.

name: The Alder Prince
description: The compassionate, secretive faerie ruler of the western Alder Forest among the Courts of the Seasons, strongest in spring, who woos and is repeatedly entrapped by the Willow Maiden.

name: The Ambulatory Laboratory
description: A Rego Terram 30 spell that transports a chamber's movable contents to another room via Arcane Connection, used by magi to move their labs without mundane effort.

name: The Ancient Wall
description: Example Eudokian story element doubling as Guardian of the Threshold, which must be climbed properly.

name: The Animal Powers
description: Ancient mysterious entities that ruled the Stubnitz region before the Bjornaer; revered at Crintera as animal-shaped fetishes said to house primordial spirits of nature.

name: The Animal's Tongue
description: Dindyméné's ritual power granting the Animal Ken Virtue.

name: The Apple That Etches
description: A Creo Herbam 20 ritual that creates 100,000 oak galls used for ink, useful to covenants closed off from the mortal world with abundant Herbam vis.

name: The Apple of the Kyffhauser
description: A magic spirit (Magic Might 70) manifesting as a withered apple tree at the base of the Kyffhauser, guarded by men-at-arms, that grants victory and lordship to whoever hangs their shield on it.

name: The Application of Vim to the Supernatural Humors
description: Diatribe tractatus on Magic Theory by Conciatta of Bonisagus opposing research of new Arts for each supernatural realm.

name: The Aqueduct Spring
description: A distant mountain spring feeding the aqueduct; an Aquam vis source yielding vis in the first gallon at dawn of the Summer Solstice.

name: The Arcane Tool
description: Summa on Vim by Vries van Breinermoor of Tremere, Quality 9 Level 6.

name: The Archpoet
description: An anonymous bawdy twelfth-century Latin poet and famed leader of the Goliardic tradition, rumored to have been a magus, whose poems a Bonisagus magus claims encode Mentem lore.

name: The Art of Magic
description: Bonisagus's epitome concerning Magic Theory, etched by later magi into 36 six-foot clear crystals at the Forest of Shining Stone, Durenmar.

name: The Assembly
description: Hunt breakfast where huntsmen present droppings and the prey is chosen.

name: The Auberge
description: A long-forgotten Mercere way station on a river island, accessible only through a Roman ruin's doorway into a Magical regio; its three spirit guardians give departing magi food containing Vim vis.

name: The Avariciousness of the Ptolemies
description: A Rego Animal 4 ward that prevents those lacking Magic Resistance from removing a book across an inscribed circle or doorway.

name: The Babble Within Thought
description: Summa on Mentem by Hicuccus of Criamon owned by the Tribunal.

name: The Bears' Cave
description: A hidden primeval cave in the northern Harz (Magic aura 3) strewn with ancient bear bones that may be harvested for Animal vis; secret vis source of a Bjornaer bear lineage.

name: The Birds
description: Play by Aristophanes, a tractatus of Quality 5 in Magic Lore, describing Nephelococcygia as intercepting communications between earth and heaven.

name: The Bishop's Mistress
description: Folk story of a priest's hearth mate who shamed a bishop; in the story seed a bishop finds everyone believes he has a mistress and a nursery is filling his home.

name: The Black Fir
description: A sinister magical fir tree near Durenmar's Great Library, key to a faerie revenge plot; it slowly inches toward the Tower of Bonisagus as part of the King of the Black Mountain's scheme.

name: The Black Horse of Busha
description: A proud black stallion seen as a figure in black shale in the Howgill Fells, said to travel the mundane world under cover of storms with purposes that bode no good.

name: The Blacks
description: Radical Guelph faction of Florence that blackmails magi into service.

name: The Blinded Sentry
description: A Perdo Mentem 5 spell invented by Imanitos Mendax that renders a target insensate for a moment, registering only the initial touch.

name: The Book Of Life's Merits
description: Hildegard's tractatus on moral philosophy and Theology.

name: The Book of Four Masters
description: Chronicle recording a 160-foot mermaid corpse washed ashore in AD 887.

name: The Book of God's Way
description: Elizabeth's summa on Church Lore warning against sins.

name: The Book of Learning by Example
description: Work by Usama ibn Munqidh quoted in Understanding.

name: The Book of Mundane Beasts
description: A free Atlas Games supplement describing beasts of Mythic Europe, on which the Virtuous Hound, Familiar Cat, and skinchanger's raven form are based.

name: The Book of Nimiane
description: The legendary journal in which Nimiane recorded Merlin's secrets and three great names; sought in the Stonehenge and Normandy Tribunals.

name: The Book of One Thousand and One Nights
description: A collection of stories begun in the ninth century around which the Keepers of the Thousand Tales formed; they believe several of its characters are magi who have passed into Arcadia.

name: The Book of Poisons
description: A book by Ibn Wahshiya, quoted for a recipe to make a poison from a scorpion-stung mouse, hellebore, and other ingredients.

name: The Bookstand of Hespera
description: A wooden lectern enchanted (ReHe 15) to follow the magus around the lab, holding a Lab Text and adding two points to a Texts Specialization.

name: The Box of Unguarded Thoughts
description: A small silver coffer inlaid with mother-of-pearl that collects nearby stray thoughts and distills them into silver coins containing Mentem vis, potentially serving as Arcane Connections.

name: The Boy Made from Iron
description: Further idea for an actor story element.

name: The Bremen Town Musicians
description: Fairy-tale figures cited as examples of faeries who are the heroes of stories.

name: The Bridges
description: Inner Farne features (with Solan Rock and Knocklin Ends) forming a crescent island at low tide; Aquam vis spume collects here on Saint Cuthbert's feast day.

name: The Brushstrokes Revealed
description: An InIm 10 spell that makes species cast by an object within a circle more vivid, revealing tiny details otherwise invisible, used to investigate artworks and creation.

name: The Bush
description: Paired islets with Divine aura 1 where Saint Cuthbert meditated for a year underwater; a site for a Test of Faith.

name: The Buskam
description: The largest of Rugen's mysterious findlinge boulders, partially submerged off the Monchgut peninsula and a site of Slavic worship; said to be left by giants from an epic battle.

name: The Cabal of Erigone
description: A House Tytalus cabal, symbolized by a triangular clavicula, determined to prevent Caecilius of Durenmar from becoming praeco of the Rhine Tribunal.

name: The Cabal of the Broken Ocean
description: A House Tytalus cabal, symbolized by a clockwise turbo of four lines, that provides covert support to the pagans of Lithuania against the Teutonic Knights.

name: The Cabal of the Lance
description: A House Tytalus cabal, symbolized by a helix made from chain, covertly shielding a newly formed covenant from the intrigue of its Tribunal for an unclear purpose.

name: The Cabal of the Shining Eye
description: A House Tytalus cabal, symbolized by a concha with an eagle at the center, dedicated to maneuvering the Roman Tribunal into colonization of North Africa.

name: The Captive Princess
description: Actor: a maiden imprisoned by her parents, guarded by an ogre, dragon, or thorns.

name: The Carpenter's Keen Eye
description: An InHe 15 spell (Voice, Momentary, Group) by which a magus learns whether wood is suitable for carpentry and what treatment it needs.

name: The Cerne Giant
description: A blatantly phallic figure carved on a Dorset hillside, said to be the lingering presence of a giant who terrorized the area before being slain; barren women who sleep on the phallus may conceive.

name: The Chariot
description: Cherubim power used by four cherubim to bow the heavens and purify a target, removing Warping, Decrepitude and Aging Points.

name: The Church (supplement)
description: Ars Magica supplement supporting common ground between magi and the Church and originating the Proctor of Hermes seed.

name: The Clandestine Mask
description: A MuIm 4 spell that blurs the caster's face and distorts her voice so she cannot be recognized; the disguise's form is determined by the caster's sigil.

name: The Clean Slate
description: A Perdo Mentem spell that wipes the target's memory clean, removing identity, Academic/Arcane/Martial/Supernatural Abilities, and all Arts.

name: The Cloudless Sky Returned
description: A Perdo Auram spell (Level 45) that clears the sky within the caster's vision of clouds and meteorological activity short of a hurricane or tornado.

name: The Command of Every Beast
description: ReAn 20 Boundary ritual letting the magus give a one-sentence command to every beast on the island.

name: The Comprehensive Epistle
description: Al-Risala al-Jami'a, key to the Epistles; a Philosophiae summa and summa for Philosophical Refining.

name: The Congregation
description: Rank-and-file Neo-Mercurian Initiates who recover lost secrets of ancient temples and serve the Priests.

name: The Conquered Bastard
description: Infernal Lore tractatus (Quality 6) describing the demon in William's corpse.

name: The Constant Expression
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw: the maga perpetually casts non-fatiguing Spontaneous magic effects, losing a permanent long-term Fatigue level and making laboratory work risky.

name: The Copyist's Critical Eye
description: InIm 10 spell revealing where a second text differs from the first.

name: The Courts of the Seasons
description: Four intrinsically linked faerie woodland courts (Holly, Alder, Oak, Willow) tied to the passage of the seasons, formed when one forest spirit splintered into four and each allied with a faerie lord.

name: The Creation of Acorns Aplenty
description: CrHe 20 ritual that creates a vast pile of acorns totaling 1,000 cubic paces.

name: The Creation of Verdant Grassland
description: CrHe 10 ritual covering about 1.25 acres with thick grass a pace high.

name: The Creation of a Forest
description: CrHe 40 ritual that creates a thousand mature trees.

name: The Crintera Schism
description: A saga concept revolving around the troubles within Crintera: the shapeshifter feud, the Harmonist-Wilderist split, and the Rügen crisis, culminating in the covenant being sundered and warring domus magnae.

name: The Crone
description: An aged, respected village woman with the Unaging Virtue whose menstrual blood contains Creo vis; though not Gifted, she knows something of magic and serves as a vis source near a covenant.

name: The Crow's Song
description: Power (PeCo 40) that forces an Aging Roll with +5 on a target the next time he sleeps.

name: The Crown of Hermes
description: An elaborate jewel-encrusted golden crown (Cr(In,Mu,Re)Me 50) whose creator is lost to memory; it lets its wearer enter a trance to create and work in an imaginary laboratory, inflicting Warping points.

name: The Cruel Stepmother
description: Further idea for an actor story element.

name: The Cult of Mercury (book)
description: Fenicil's ninth-century tractatus on Organization Lore: Cult of Mercury, Quality 8.

name: The Cult of Vesta
description: A Merinita cult founded by magae of Brittany who venerate faeries as household gods (lares), adopt Vesta as patron, and take vows of chastity in exchange for faerie powers.

name: The Curse of Poseidon
description: Polyphemus' power (ReAq 50) making the ocean the victim's enemy until Polyphemus or Poseidon is appeased.

name: The Dancing Place
description: Grass circle with Faerie Aura four where faeries dance each spring equinox and may answer a question.

name: The Dark Places
description: Places of ancient evil within the Faerie forest, locked away by Shen.

name: The Daughters of Echo
description: A Jerbiton league interested in magical methods of recording and reproducing events, led by a Merinita maga near Burnfoot in Hibernia.

name: The Dead That Walk Again
description: Revener Power animating unburied corpses.

name: The Dead of Ascalon
description: The cursed corpses of a Muslim fleet defeated off Ascalon in 1123; their skulls, smuggled aboard rival ships by a merchant house, cause every cursed voyage to end tragically.

name: The Death of Vermin
description: A Rego Animal 20 enchanted box that fills specific vermin with a desire to enter it, gathering them to be destroyed.

name: The Demand of the Frustrated Scholar Soothed
description: A Rego Animal 40 spell that teleports a book within 500 paces to the caster's hand via an arcane connection; higher-level versions reach up to seven leagues.

name: The Devil's Eye
description: Folk witch initiation script requiring an Arcane Connection to an invisible creature; grants Second Sight and Missing Eye.

name: The Devil's Penance
description: Medieval German folk tale of a devil refusing humiliating penance.

name: The Discerning Eye
description: Enhanced InIm spell detecting created or altered images and areas of Magic Resistance.

name: The Dismal Itch
description: Summa on Corpus by Azenis of Tytalus.

name: The Dragon of Brünn
description: A dragon that lived in a cave by the River Svratka near Brünn and devoured townsfolk, until a travelling butcher killed it with a lime-stuffed ox pelt; its stuffed carcass hangs in Brünn's town hall.

name: The Dragon's Tongue
description: Prop: eating it grants powers like speaking with animals; proof of slaying the dragon.

name: The Dragon-Maiden
description: Asturian girl turned into a cuelebre by a nymph.

name: The Dream Landscape
description: Dream realm described in the Mysteries of Dreams chapter.

name: The Dreamscape
description: Rumored shared dreamland beyond and between dreams where spiritual travelers meet; no direct path back to the waking world.

name: The Dull Knife
description: Prop: a crude blade that may cut the uncuttable or rust when another is in peril.

name: The Dumb Waiter
description: A Rego Terram level 35 enchanted device that instantly transports food and dishes from the kitchen to specified places in the covenant within 50 paces.

name: The Dying Lady
description: Eudokian example ancient ash tree, source of the forest's antagonism.

name: The Ear for Distant Voice
description: InIm 20 spell.

name: The Ear for a Distant Voice
description: InIm 12 effect letting the user hear the voice of a person to whom she has an Arcane Connection.

name: The Ecclesiastical History
description: History by Orderic Vitalis including Area Lore summae and a Civil and Canon Law tractatus.

name: The Ecclesiastical History of the English People
description: Encyclopedia by Bede of four tractatus of Quality 9.

name: The Edges of the World
description: Four regiones corresponding to the four elements and humors to which a spirit-traveling Criamon magus is sequentially drawn, and from which he must escape back to his body.

name: The Elfin Brewer
description: Similar spell creating 12 dozen pints of ale.

name: The Empty Forest
description: Example Eudokian story element: a forest villain whose trees resent animals.

name: The Enchanted Chef
description: A Rego Herbam (Animal, Aquam, Ignem) 45 enchanted pot that processes and transforms food into a described dish as if cooked, substituting Communication + Finesse for Craft: Cook.

name: The Enchanted Porter
description: A Rego Terram 15 enchanted glove that lifts and pushes an inanimate object while the user holds and moves it; based on The Unseen Porter.

name: The End of Hatred
description: A PeCo 50 Orphic spell that instantly slays a target against whom the caster has the Enemies Flaw; used only once in the Cult's history.

name: The Endless Summer
description: Empathy/Weal ritual giving a bonus to Aging rolls (and penalty to Recovery) for a year and a day.

name: The Epicurean
description: Masked figure who always leads the Cold Iron Vexillation; in Arcadia a continuing entity.

name: The Eternal Parry
description: Enchantment/Ware 25 rite giving +3 Defense while the caster brandishes a blade after a dance.

name: The Ever-Watchful Turb
description: A Perdo Mentem spell that prevents a target group from falling asleep by quelling the inclination to rest.

name: The Evil Twin
description: Further idea for an actor story element.

name: The Externsteine
description: An array of thirteen tall sandstone rocks on the southeastern edge of the Teutoburger Forest, a former pagan site now bearing a consecrated chapel with a Divine aura of 4.

name: The Eye of the Sage
description: An Intellego Corpus spell (Level 30) with an Imaginem requisite that lets you see a specific person and what is within one pace of them, clearly enough to read.

name: The Eyes of Every Beast
description: InAn 40 Boundary ritual letting the magus sense what the island's animals are seeing.

name: The Eyes of the Sage
description: InCo(Im) 30 spell known by Bartholomew.

name: The Face in the Mirror
description: Rego Mentem level 40 spell forcing a ghost to possess a magus while the magus retains control, used by Tremere Assessors.

name: The Falcon's Hood
description: A Perdo Animal spell that destroys an animal's vision, with the blindness healing as a Medium Wound; also referenced earlier as PeAn 20.

name: The False Gift of Revenge
description: She-Wolf ritual power imposing the Delusion Flaw so the target believes he becomes a wolf.

name: The Far-Speaking Voice
description: A CrMe 20 spell that delivers two minutes of one-way conversation into the mind of a target to whom the caster holds an Arcane Connection.

name: The Farm
description: Florum's industrial complex south of Ghent.

name: The Fatae
description: Faeries who humble women who boast of their weaving.

name: The Feast of Worms
description: Saint curse infesting the target's body with maggots.

name: The Feengrotten
description: Hidden crystal caves (Magic aura 1) on the eastern edge of the Thuringian Forest whose shifting passages cover explorers in glittering dust that is Imaginem vis for those genuinely lost.

name: The Fens
description: Wetlands where Natura Antiqua and the Seventh Wave lie.

name: The Ferryman
description: Actor: a gray-cloaked ferryman, perhaps a disguised king, who must be persuaded to carry characters.

name: The Finch Flourish
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: The Flora of a Bulrush
description: Might 5 Herbam spirit appearing as a young girl paddling in a stream.

name: The Flying Castle of Thomae
description: A flying castle crafted by a follower of Tytalus decades ago that simply vanished from Hermetic knowledge, referenced as a treasure to hunt (via the supplement Legends of Hermes).

name: The Folio of 1123
description: Example of a folio title, folios being named by the year they were made.

name: The Forbidden Chamber
description: Scenery story element: a room in a castle everyone is forbidden to enter, testing curiosity against obedience.

name: The Forgotten Child
description: Story seed where a magus unwittingly rarefies an elemental.

name: The Genethlialogical Investigation
description: An Intellego Corpus 15 spell by which the caster learns a target's place and time of birth; casting it on a magus is tantamount to declaring Wizard's War.

name: The Gentle Herd
description: A ReAn 20 spell (Touch, Concentration, Group) that renders a group of animals calm and placid even while unusual events occur, ideal for soothing cattle being magically milked.

name: The Geographica
description: A lost work by Ptolemy giving exact longitude and latitude for hundreds of legendary sites, many containing vis; House Mercere offers great quantities of vis for a complete copy.

name: The Giant's Grave
description: A rectangular bed of large stones in the Everstorf Forest north of Schwerin, said to be the grave of a giant trapped and buried by villagers of Naschendorf.

name: The Giant's Ring
description: The ring of great healing stones standing on a hilltop in Ireland that Merlin transported by his art to become Stonehenge in England.

name: The Giants' Castle
description: The remains of a primeval Celtic fortress on the edge of the Bohemian Forest, with a Magic aura of 3, where large fractured rocks were originally gathered by giants who may still visit.

name: The Gift (child story seed)
description: Not an entity; placeholder removed.

name: The Gift of the Enigma
description: Spell of which Archmage Vincent uses a deadly high-level optimization.

name: The Gingerbread Man
description: Fairy-tale figure cited as an example of a faerie who is the hero of a story.

name: The Girdle of Chang
description: MuCo 14 girdle changing apparent sex.

name: The Girdle of Change
description: Magical toy sold at the faerie toy market.

name: The Glass Mountain
description: Scenery story element: a towering mountain of smooth green glass topped by a castle and guarded by giant birds.

name: The God of Law
description: In the new dualist faith near the Bohemian Forest, the stern god who created and rules the material world but cares not for its inhabitants, falsely worshipped (the faith claims) by the Church.

name: The God of Truth
description: The creator deity of a new dualist faith in the villages near the Bohemian Forest, said to be immaterial and found only in wild places, opposed to the God of Law; his angels are said to be faeries, and his prophet is Iacob.

name: The Goddess's Companion
description: Dindyméné's ritual power creating a mundane bear.

name: The Goddess's Protector
description: Dindyméné's ritual power creating a mundane lion.

name: The Godhead
description: A demon of the Order of False Gods, an invisible stone head replacing Mercury's statue head, who poses as Mercury to corrupt magi.

name: The Good Witness
description: CrMe 25 spell refreshing a subject's memory of one day.

name: The Gray Bull
description: Iceland's third guardian, a spirit bull tamed by the Dominion at Skalholt in 1105 and held as Bishop Magnus's stud; if freed it grows into a vast aurochs.

name: The Great Discord
description: CrVi 55 Ritual that taints a parish so everyone suffers The Gift's social penalties for a Moon.

name: The Great Play
description: A tournament hosted every few years by the Shadow-Masters in which a built labyrinth or setting filled with illusions challenges participants; succeeding wins the responsibility to host the next event.

name: The Half Shell
aliases: The Large Ship The Half Shell
description: A large ship serving as the mobile site (an Edifice Boon) of the Swashbuckling covenant.

name: The Half-Glade
description: Half circle of nine trees in the Faerie forest serving as a seasonal portal to far Faerie places.

name: The Hedge Lord's Synthemata of (X)
description: MuVi spell from Synthemata Magia adding (level-5) to Casting Score against the named being for two minutes.

name: The Herbal of Crateuas
description: Crateuas's catalog of herbs and their powers, written in ancient Greek; a summa for several Abilities and rumored source of Insight into the Root-Cutter Virtue.

name: The Horn that Furnishes Soldiers
description: Further idea for a prop story element.

name: The Horsemen
description: Ghostly faerie riders of the Wild Hunt (Faerie Might 20) embodying icy winter storms, who can spread fear, control winds, and inflict cold; they can produce spells like Broom of the Winds.

name: The Immortal's Grimoire
description: ReVi Mystery enchantment letting a talisman hold a spell so an immortal can cast it normally.

name: The Impassable River
description: ReCo 60 ritual turning a river into a magical boundary that no man, woman or child can cross, used to protect lands from invasion.

name: The Imperfect Defense
description: Secret that a Divine aura suppresses Magvillus's Aegis for two hours before sunrise on Good Friday.

name: The Impossible Retreat
description: Halcyon power to teleport to an Arcane Connection.

name: The Incoherence of the Incoherence
description: A book by Averroes refuting al-Ghazali's The Incoherence of the Philosophers.

name: The Incoherence of the Philosophers
description: A book by al-Ghazali rejecting the ideas of Aristotle, Plato, and Socrates as harmful to the faithful.

name: The Incubus's Trick
description: A spell that turns a male caster into a woman, the counterpart of The Succubus's Trick.

name: The Infernal Grave of William the Conqueror
description: Story of William's corpse, inhabited by a demon trapped by his botched funeral rite.

name: The Inn of Good Rest
description: Brothel run by followers of a faerie lord that poisons pilgrims visiting a local shrine just after they reach a state of grace.

name: The Inscription
description: Ancient story on a cave wall binding Winter from Somerset; Averna believed it a Titan weapon.

name: The Instant Breach
description: PeTe 15 Charged Item destroying a section of stone wall.

name: The Inverted
description: Merfolk-derived faeries placed on land who sail sky-boats and net birds as fishers do fish.

name: The Invisible Glass-worker
description: A ReTe 4 spell (Touch, Momentary, Individual) that transforms a piece of glass into a finished form as if shaped by a glassworker.

name: The Invisible Shield
description: Enchanted item owned by Victor the redcap that protects him from metal weapons.

name: The Irresistible Dance
description: Empathy/Beguile 25 rite compelling the target to dance with hedonistic abandon.

name: The Irresistible Pressgang
description: CrMe Ritual granting a group fanatical loyalty to the caster for a year and 5 Warping Points; Anacrôn uses it to make cagoux.

name: The Isthmus
description: Low swampy isthmus joining Bear Island to the mainland.

name: The Journey not yet Complete
description: Apologia tractatus by Trianoma favoring admitting the Order Miscellanea; the original is at Durenmar.

name: The Keepers of the Pearl of Great Price
description: A Jerbiton league whose members surreptitiously stave off poverty in large cities; leaderless since crusaders sacked their Constantinople headquarters.

name: The Keepers of the Thousand Tales
description: A group of Merinita magi and companions formed in the Holy Land to collect, catalog, and spread the greatest stories, believing faerie immortality is ensured through legend; they have covenants in the Levant and Iberian Tribunals.

name: The Kettle
description: Deep calm pool on the north side of Inner Farne, the island's only harbor, kept calm by Eider Ducks of Virtue.

name: The Key of Theodorus
description: A ReTe 5 Hermetic spell (R: Touch, D: Mom, T: Part) that magically opens any single lock regardless of complexity, named for Theodorus of Samos.

name: The Keys of Solomon
description: Book containing the Ars Notoria.

name: The King's Goblet
description: A wondrous gold cup that trembles in the holder's hand if a poisoned beverage is poured into it (Craft Level 13).

name: The King's Name
description: The selkie king's name, a form of audible vis (five pawns of Animal) trapped in a seashell; using it destroys the king.

name: The Kiss of Death
description: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 45) by which the person kissed dies suddenly, leaving only the black imprint of the caster's lips; requires no spoken words.

name: The Konigstuhl
description: A 380-foot chalk cliff on Rugen; legend says whoever climbs it from the sea becomes king of Rugen, as Valdemar I did, and cheaters fail.

name: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul
description: Invocation Blessing effect granting Divine Magic Resistance equal to the effect's level.

name: The Laboratory of Bonisagus
description: A Creo Terram 45 ritual that furnishes an empty chamber with a fully equipped standard Hermetic laboratory better than normal, granting Flawless Equipment, Flawless Tools, and Spotless.

name: The Lais of Marie de France
description: Tractatus, Charm, by Marie de France.

name: The Lancet of Good Health
description: CrCo 25 scalpel giving +6 to Disease Recovery rolls.

name: The Lasting Synthemata of (X)
description: Diameter-duration MuVi Mystery synthemata spell adding (level-5) to Penetration for all spells against the named being while it lasts.

name: The Leafy Counselor
description: Eudokian example tree acting as Donor, at odds with its fellows.

name: The Lens of Wisdom
description: A crystal lens bound in brass that, focusing the summer-solstice noon sun on a blank parchment, burns indecipherable glyphs into the page, each page containing Intellego vis.

name: The Lightning-Bringer
description: A highly magical device of copper spheres, gold rods, and enchanted glass vessels invented by a Tremere Archimagus; on each new moon it summons a thunderstorm and accumulates its lightning as Auram vis.

name: The Limit of Experience
description: A lesser limit of Hermetic magic: it cannot create or transfer skills, knowledge, or Abilities in a person.

name: The Limit of the Soul
description: A lesser limit of Hermetic magic: it cannot create an immortal soul, true human life, or restore the dead to life.

name: The Linden of Neustadt
description: A protective Forest spirit (Magic Might 30) manifesting as a great lime tree that has adopted the town of Neustadt as its realm and grants victory and virtues to the town's defenders.

name: The Line of Quendalon
description: The lineage of magi descended from Quendalon who Initiate the three Arcadian Mysteries; many are Seekers devoted to experimental research, sometimes called 'The Last Commission' for Bonisagus's reputed charge.

name: The Little Mermaid
description: Fairy-tale heroine who deliberately reverses traditional stories, losing her voice and then her life for love of a mortal.

name: The Llancarfan Saints' Lives
description: Tractatus, Dominion Lore, Quality 6, hagiographies referencing Arthur.

name: The Long Man of Wilmington
description: A figure about 240 feet tall picked out by trenches on a Sussex hillside, grasping two staves; said variously to represent St. Paul or the keeper of the gates of dawn who may open them for travelers.

name: The Longest Race
description: Power of the Wamses (ReTe 30) letting an island heave itself a few paces.

name: The Lord's Terrifying Herald
description: Abbas' power, as Jupiter's Resounding Blow.

name: The Lost City
description: PeIm 45 Boundary ritual with Rego requisite that makes the island wall and everything within it invisible to outsiders.

name: The Luneburg Heath
description: A wild heathland south of Luneburg where shepherds tend flocks of Heidschnucken, goat-sheep crossbreeds descended from Corsican mouflon.

name: The Magestones of Verditius
description: Onyx-pebble enchanted devices crafted by Verditius, each bearing a powerful Creo Vim effect that manifests a Magic aura of 3; three were secretly gifted to Oculus Septentrionalis, the rest guarded by Durenmar, and their technique was never replicated.

name: The Magic Fountain
description: A spring near the Brocken that grants visions to those who drink from it.

name: The Magic Ring
description: Further idea for a prop story element.

name: The Mamluk Emir
description: Companion template for a proud, reckless, land-holding Mamluk noble cursed by jinn.

name: The Mamluk Soldier
description: Grog template for a low-ranking Turkish Mamluk soldier.

name: The Man in Black with a Sack on His Back
description: Scarecrow-bodied faerie that steals naughty children in a sack.

name: The Mandrake's Scream
description: Story seed about a nobleman's son killed by a mandrake's scream at a hangman's tree.

name: The Many-hued Conflagration
description: A Muto Ignem spell (Level 5) that makes a fire burn brightly in shifting colors, potentially blinding onlookers for a round if they fail a Stamina roll.

name: The Margravate of Lusatia
description: A mainly forest-wilderness margravate east of the Elbe bordering Silesia, populated by Sorbs and ruled by the margraves of Meissen.

name: The Market at the Crossroads
description: Scenery story element: a faerie market of rough stalls where purchases are not always what they seem.

name: The Marvelous Hound
description: A Muto Animal (Corpus, Mentem) 34 enchanted collar that transforms a normal hound into an erect, handed servant with a grog's intellect while retaining hound loyalty.

name: The Master of Naumburg
description: A young, enigmatic architect and sculptor of German origin who travels Germany working on great churches; some claim his unmatched work is aided by sorcery.

name: The Master's Things
description: Lutin power granting awareness of every item in the room it occupies.

name: The Maze of Singing Mirrors
description: A repository where copies of all recordings made by the Daughters of Echo are kept and sold to Jerbiton magi unable to attend performances.

name: The Mind's Imagination
description: Land within the mind reachable from dream that persists into waking; possessing spirits may reside there.

name: The Mind's Memory
description: Region of a person's mind containing all memories, reachable by dream travelers, where memories can be moved or made solid.

name: The Miniature of Immortality
description: A ritual Creo Herbam spell (Level 20) that creates a painted miniature of a person or scene on a wooden panel within voice range.

name: The Mole's Work
description: Lab texts by Adanos Lutorum of Tytalus.

name: The Moon
description: Planet influencing emotions, tides, cyclic magic, fertility; governs Dexterity.

name: The Morphean Gate
description: Re(Mu)Co(Me) 40 Mystery spell transporting the caster bodily through a portal into a dream, creating a dream portal back to the real world.

name: The Motivated Plow
description: A Rego Terram 15 enchanted plow-shaped device that transforms hard-packed earth into well-plowed soil in a circle; based on The Forgiving Earth and doing the work of about three laborers.

name: The Mournful Maga
description: A faerie that apprentices face while growing up.

name: The Mouse-Groom
description: Actor: a talking mouse who courts a female character.

name: The Muslim Traveller
description: Companion template for a Muslim scholar wandering Europe, inspired by a guardian angel.

name: The Mysteries (Revised)
description: Forthcoming book said to cover initiation into Holy Magic.

name: The Mystical Carpenter
description: A ReHe 25 spell (Touch, Momentary, Group) that cuts, splits, carves, and joins a pile of wood into a desired form, substituting Perception + Finesse for Craft: Carpenter.

name: The Neriusian Portal
description: CrVi 65 holy ritual (R: Touch, D: Sun, T: Circle) creating a level 1 terrestrial regio around the caster; said to have been taught to Nerius by the angel Samuil.

name: The New Iconophiles
description: A Jerbiton league, led ideologically by the Primus, attempting to recover the artistic treasures of Constantinople; based in Valnastium.

name: The Night-Badgers' Burrow
description: ReAn(Te) 20 spell moving targets from the Animal province to the Terram province.

name: The Oath Swearing
description: Truffle Matron's power binding oath-takers so that breaking the oath inflicts a Minor Flaw.

name: The Oath of Truth
description: Lesser PeCo ritual binding a willing subject to tell the truth at trial, seen as infallible.

name: The Obedient Fire
description: A ReIg 20 spell that controls the rate and direction a fire spreads, able to make it move as fast as a man walks; the fire's heat is non-magical and bypasses Magic Resistance.

name: The Obedient Slave
description: Malachi's Power forcing any person to perform commanded tasks.

name: The Odenwald
description: A German forest that comes into bloom earliest and most spectacularly, an ideal site for the Court of the Alder Prince, with bandits lurking on its western edge.

name: The Old Guard
description: Evocation/Conjure 20 rite creating a glamour of ten grogs to protect the caster.

name: The Old Oak
description: An ancient twisted oak with blood-colored leaves and a pained face in its bark where Regulus was hanged; the source of the Cursewood's Infernal aura and of poisoned Perdo vis sordida.

name: The Oneiropomp's Treasure
description: CrIm 30 Mystery Ritual used by a spiritual traveler with real-world vis to give real substance to a small dream object, which appears by his body.

name: The Order and Towns
description: Code of Hermes summa by Quaesitor Fluvius (1208) on mundane interactions.

name: The Ore Mountains
description: A bleak, unsettled range covered with evergreen forest adjoining the Spruce Mountains in Franconia, where silver and tin have recently been discovered, giving rise to mining towns like Freiberg.

name: The Pale Man
description: Actor: an emaciated vampire in a shroud, or Death itself.

name: The Paraclete
description: Nunnery where Héloïse was abbess.

name: The Path To Lemnos
description: Mu(In)Me 30 Mystery spell: the magus touches a dreaming sleeper and his own spirit enters the target dream while his body lies in trance.

name: The Path of Beacons
description: A Criamon path lacking a clutch that teaches Mysteries allowing each magus to create a sanctuary from the strife of the world; its eldest magus lives in a regio on the Isle of Arran.

name: The Path of Orpheus
description: A rumored great ritual following Orpheus's trek into the Underworld to restore a beloved to the living world, requiring vast vis and Wizard's Communion.

name: The Path of Strife
description: The Criamon path of worldly magic that transgresses House morality; its servants kill, lie, and destroy demons to prolong the universe, and they cannot enter Final Twilight.

name: The Path of the Mirror
description: The Criamon path followed only by living Primi under instruction of their predecessors, a series of Initiations for those who choose to serve the worldly House.

name: The Pawnbrokers
description: Societas Merceris of Redcaps who harvest vis into custom shapes such as tokens, coins, jewelry or tattoos, named in memory of Venafro.

name: The Penitent's Confession
description: ReMe 30 spell compelling the target to relate his involvement truthfully; counts as scrying and causes warping.

name: The Perfected Structure
description: Re(Cr)Te(He) 20 spell reshaping an entire building to be geometrically perfect, stronger and more pleasing.

name: The Perfected Tower
description: Re(Cr)Te(He) 34 Hermetic Architecture enchantment using seven component devices to keep a stone tower perpetually perfected.

name: The Peril of Phoebos
description: Tractatus on Ignem by Perpauca Bonisagi.

name: The Perilous Forest
description: Scenery story element: a dark, foreboding wood hiding outlaws, hermits, magical trees, and beasts.

name: The Phantom Blacksmith
description: A ReTe 20 spell (Touch, Momentary, Group) that transforms ready iron into a crafted result as if worked by a blacksmith to the magus's instructions.

name: The Pied Stranger
description: Actor: a half-white, half-black musician who is a thief and entertainer.

name: The Piercing Tongue
description: Penetration Summa by Luzabel in the Reims coven library.

name: The Pipers
description: Two immense standing stones near the Merry Maidens, said to be demons sent to tempt the dancing girls who were unable to flee divine justice and turned to stone.

name: The Pirates' Graveyards
description: A haunted region in Drenthe near the River Ems where pirates of Friesia bury their dead under standing stones; Lucas von Beck harvests vis and bodies there for necromancy, though its power may not be magical.

name: The Places I've Been - You Wouldn't Believe Me
description: A book describing a Greek Isles covenant whose soldiers ride gigantic terrapins into naval battle.

name: The Plunder of Twenty Geese
description: A Muto Animal 15 spell that transforms up to 100 feathers into goose wing feathers preferred for pens; a Rego variant at level 20 strips and tempers the pens.

name: The Poet's Bust
description: A Rego Terram spell (Level 5) that changes a block of stone into a carved bust of a person the caster touches.

name: The Poisoned Apple
description: Prop: a fruit half poisoned, half sweet, typically shared.

name: The Ponderers of Weight and Distance
description: A Jerbiton league of merchant magi interested in gaining money through mundane trade and manipulating economies, seemingly based in the Rhineland.

name: The Potent Pot of Tasty Tea
description: Brass tea pot by Aratol that pours intoxicating seasoned tea.

name: The Preening Peacock
description: Power raising a touched target's Presence above that of his companions until he looks foolish.

name: The Primal Power
description: Summa on Aquam by Peter of Uist.

name: The Private Speech of Eros and Psyche
description: An In(Cr)Me 60 ritual Orphic spell allowing the magos and a target to speak mentally at will, regardless of distance, for one year.

name: The Privy Counselor
description: Faerie noble trickster and saboteur sent by an angered monarch against a covenant, posing as a young nobleman.

name: The Prodigious Plant Pot
description: A large clay pot enchanted (CrHe 30) that grows a seed into a mature plant in a day, adding to a lab's Experimentation and Herbam Specializations; made by Ricardus Caespuus.

name: The Queen of Otters
description: Further idea for an actor story element.

name: The Relay
description: Positioning of fresh hounds along the prey's predicted route; can reduce the Terrain Bonus.

name: The Remote Entrance Portal
description: A Rego Corpus 50 enchanted device acting as a magical transporter activated only from within a covenant, moving seen targets up to 500 paces inside without arcane connections.

name: The Resolute Mind of the Tireless Researcher
description: A Rego Mentem Level 20 spell devised by Andreas of House Bonisagus that fixes a magus's mind on lab work for a day; daily use warps the mind and requires the Addled lab routine.

name: The Rhine Corruption
description: Practice in the Rhine Tribunal of keeping the proxy votes of dead magi ('sigil ghosts') to accumulate votes.

name: The Riches That are Rightfully Mine(d)
description: A CrTe 35 ritual spell (Touch, Momentary, Individual) that fills a chest with up to ten cubic feet of silver pennies, worth about 2000 Mythic Pounds; a copy resides in the Great Library of Durenmar.

name: The Riesenstein
description: A great stone near Zuschen hurled by the Devil at the village of Neueburg; it bears three red stains that weep bloody tears worth Ignem vis every All Hallow's Eve.

name: The Ring of Terror
description: Muto Mentem 35 constant ward causing terror to magi entering the graveyard ring.

name: The River
description: Faerie river ruled by Danu.

name: The Road To Lemnos
description: Mu(In)Me 40 Mystery spell that brings the spirits of a touched group of travelers into a sleeper's dream, their bodies lying in trance.

name: The Rooster's Crow
description: A PeVi Sound-Target spell that strips Might from demons who hear the caster's shout if it penetrates their Magic Resistance.

name: The Rosstrappe
description: A rock across a ravine from the Hexentanzplatz bearing a giant horse's hoofprint, from the legendary leap of Princess Brunhilde fleeing the knight Bodo.

name: The Rottweiler
description: A characteristic black-and-tan dog breed of the Black Forest, bred from Roman dogs and wild dark faerie species; some have faerie blood granting longevity and Second Sight, and at least one Rhine magus uses them instead of grogs.

name: The Rumaquelle
description: A magical green-watered spring in the southern Harz, said to be where Ruma, daughter of the dwarf king, surfaced as a stream to reunite with the giant Romer.

name: The Runemaster Binds the Beasts in Place
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Isa (Fehu) 20, Method II: holds a herd of domesticated animals motionless.

name: The Runemaster Brings Hardship to the Enemy and His Family
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Naudiz (Ingwaz) 20, Method II: residents of a structure lose 1 Confidence.

name: The Runemaster Calls His Children to His Side
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ingwaz 35, Method II: transports a family member to the runes.

name: The Runemaster Carves the Ice of the North
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Isa 25, Method II: creates a slippery sheet of ice ten paces across.

name: The Runemaster Causes Fiery Fever to Burn Bright
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Kauno (Mannaz) 30, Method II: afflicts a serious illness that cannot recover.

name: The Runemaster Curses the Wound with Blood He Spilled
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Berkanan (Mannaz) General, Method II: penalty to recovery rolls of the person whose blood is on the spear.

name: The Runemaster Curses with Years the Defilers of the Grave
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Dagaz (Mannaz) 30, Method II: grave disturbers age five years.

name: The Runemaster Defies His Rival and Laughs at His Misfortune
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Perth (Mannaz) General, Method II: adds botch dice to a rival rune wizard.

name: The Runemaster Gives the Gift of Joy
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Wunjo (Gebo) 20, Method II: a gift is received with joy and gratitude.

name: The Runemaster Gives the Gift of Obligation
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Gebo 30, Method II: the wearer of runed jewelry defers to the vitki.

name: The Runemaster Has Need of an Arrow
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Othila (Hagalaz) 20, Method II: summons an arrow to which the vitki has an Arcane Connection.

name: The Runemaster Leads Men to Greatness
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Mannaz 20, Method II: fighters within ten paces function as a trained group.

name: The Runemaster Prepares the Ogre-Slaying Spear
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Thurisaz General, Method II: reduces Might of supernatural creatures near the spear's path.

name: The Runemaster Protects Against the Beasts of the Wild
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Algiz (Uruz) 10, Method II: wild animals cannot approach within ten paces.

name: The Runemaster Speaks of Friendship Among Men
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ehwaz (Ansuz) General, Method II: listeners feel trust and goodwill toward the target.

name: The Runemaster Summons Thor's Lightning and Thunder
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Hagalaz 15, Method II: raises a terrible thunderstorm around the runes.

name: The Runemaster Summons a Hearty Ox
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Fehu 35, Method II: summons (and if needed revives) a specific ox via Arcane Connection.

name: The Runemaster Tames the Wild Stallion
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ehwaz 20, Method II: a horse becomes well-disposed to the vitki.

name: The Saga of the Volsungs
description: Norse saga quoted describing a worm creeping to its watering place.

name: The Salernitarian Women
description: A famous group of women at Salerno studying medicine, renowned as obstetricians and surgeons, legendarily credited with curing the Duke of Normandy.

name: The Sanctuary of Hercules
description: A hidden cave of magical springs on the western Vosges, with a Magic aura of 3, where the Gauls worshiped Ogmios and the Romans Hercules, ringed with ancient altars.

name: The Sanctuary of Lost Dreams
description: The innermost chambers of the Vermilion Temple, entered by the Monarchs of the Veiled Court.

name: The Schwanenburg
description: An old castle on a hill overlooking Cleves by the Rhine, named after the Knight of the Swan, Lohengrin.

name: The Scribe's Touch
description: A Perdo Animal 3 spell that trims the magus's quill with the flick of a finger.

name: The Scrier Spied
description: InVi 29 effect of the Hermetic Speculum detecting scrying spells on its bearer.

name: The Second Remove of the Giant's Dance
description: ReTe 35 ritual that uproots a structure such as Stonehenge and floats it through the air.

name: The Seducer
description: Faerie that meets an apprentice before the Gauntlet, tempting him with a life of social acceptance and domesticity.

name: The Self-Filling Purse
description: Further idea for a prop story element.

name: The Seven of Magvillus
description: The seven full Quaesitor members of Magvillus, chief administrators of their House, sworn to secrecy about the private library.

name: The Shadow-Masters
description: A troupe of Merinita magi who, using Plato's cave allegory, fashion illusory figures and stories to reinforce belief in the imaginary; they host the Great Play and Initiate Glamour, Animae Magic, and Perpetuity.

name: The Shape of Vengeance
description: She-Wolf ritual power imposing the Lycanthropy Flaw, her usual means of granting revenge.

name: The Significance of the Group
description: InCo 10 spell that divines the number of people in a group, with any Group restriction.

name: The Singers in Hollow Rooms
description: An example Jerbiton league that calls up the ghosts of ancient artists; its homages involve constructing or searching for tombs.

name: The Single Ocean
description: A Jerbiton league exploring the cities of the Levant and North Africa, seeking peaceful relationships with Jewish and Muslim sorcerers, led by Edward the White.

name: The Sleep of the Hand of the Thief
description: Valefar's Power making sleepers in a building unwakable until dawn.

name: The Slumbering
description: The Outer Chambers of the Courtyard of the Vermilion Temple, into which Initiates may invite guests.

name: The Society
description: Pythagoras' cult at Croton dedicated to numerology, purification and secrecy.

name: The Son of the Coin
description: Eudokian example mercenary acting as the False Hero.

name: The Song of Roland
description: Epic featuring Archbishop Turpin.

name: The Sorcerer's Fork
description: A Muto Vim spell that splits another spell into two or more identical spells of reduced power against separate targets.

name: The Soul in the Egg
description: Further idea for a prop story element.

name: The Source of the Danube
description: An enchanted spring in the eastern Black Forest, source of the River Danube, with a Faerie aura and a regio whose top level holds a gateway into Arcadia and abundant Aquam vis; presided over by the faerie Danu.

name: The Spell of Wrought Iron
description: A ReTe 15 spell (Touch, Momentary, Group) that transforms raw pig-iron into plain bars of wrought iron, separating out the slag.

name: The Spider
description: A character from The Travels of Fedoso who may assist player characters in a faerie wood; possibly a spirit or faerie said to have predicted the depredations of an evil magus.

name: The Spirit of Self-Importance
description: Might 10 Mentem eidolon that looks like its owner's idealized self.

name: The Stone of Death
description: An ancient stone aligned to the winter-solstice sunset; during the third decan of Gemini, daily animal sacrifices made at the rising of Saturn cause Perdo vis to form from the blood.

name: The Stoneskinned
description: Magic kin bound to Terram who become living stone with age and are turned to stone by sunlight.

name: The Stultified Peasant
description: A Perdo Mentem spell that destroys a target's imagination, removing his ability to think and leaving him standing mouth open.

name: The Subtle Chain
description: Philippus Niger's enchanted silver chain that forms a 3-pace circle and creates a variety of once-per-day warding effects against demons, spirits, beasts, and faeries.

name: The Succubus's Trick
description: A MuCo 5 spell that causes a female caster to adopt male physical characteristics; named after gender-changing demons of lust.

name: The Sufi Poetess
description: Companion template for a blind Sufi poetess, a living saint able to heal with a touch.

name: The Sun
description: Planet influencing rulership, kings, health; governs Presence and Stamina.

name: The Sundew
description: Enormous stone sundew sculpture supporting most of Confluensis' buildings.

name: The Swabian Jura
description: A series of harsh limestone hills separating the Danube and Neckar valleys, dotted with stalactite grottos such as the Nebelhöhle and Wimsener Höhle.

name: The Swan Cloak
description: Prop: a cloak of white feathers that transforms the wearer into a swan.

name: The Task-Setting Ogre
description: Actor: a giant who forces captives to perform impossible tasks.

name: The Tempest's Fury
description: Naonhaithya's Power summoning a huge storm.

name: The Teufelskuche
description: A forgotten stone circle and altar in the Haldensleben Forest near Magdeburg where the pagan god Woden was worshipped; it is the origin of the Wild Hunt.

name: The Thief's Tomb
description: The secret underground chamber where Guernicus entombed his master's murderer with Mercurian grimoires, guarded by an angry ghost.

name: The Three Sisters
description: Faerie merchant sisters Lo'relyn, Fi'noa and De'dee sharing a council vote; sell Rain Parasols.

name: The Three Worlds
description: The three paradigms of the Faerie Realm, Arcadia, Elysium and Eudokia, corresponding to stories that entertain, record history, or teach.

name: The Thuringian Forest
description: One of Germany's largest forests, covering nearly a hundred miles of the Thuringia-Franconia border, the traditional boundary between northern and southern Germany.

name: The Tireless Flight
description: ReCo20 boosted, harnessed, tethered spell letting the target ignore fatigue and wound penalties.

name: The Tireless Servant
description: An animated skeleton automaton (ReCo 25/40) that fetches and holds objects on verbal command, adding to a lab's General Quality and Safety.

name: The Tortoise
description: Faerie that possesses mothers to kill their babies; Mormo's role mate.

name: The Traitor
description: Voluntary exile from House Tytalus obliged to restart the House's stalled conflicts; bears a magical key.

name: The Transformed Folio
description: MuAn35 Boosted, Harnessed Ritual changing a book's pages into those of another book.

name: The True Origins of the Magical Traditions
description: A text by Arch-Mage Infamitus discussing the sleeping Old Ones.

name: The Twice-Gifted Coin
description: A PeMe 15 spell (Touch, Momentary, Individual) that erases the target's memory of having paid a coin, so he pays again; sometimes enchanted into a toll-gate.

name: The Unbidden Task
description: A MuMe 25 spell that creates a recurring prospective memory in a target, prompting them to infer and act on a reason for it.

name: The Unerring Lance
description: ReTe 20 spell making a thrusting weapon move only directly forward, so it can only be dodged.

name: The Unerring Slingshot
description: PeAn 58 effect triggered by Sight of the Wolf that strikes dead all wolves within the enclosure.

name: The Unexpected Blossom
description: ReHe 40 spell that instantly brings a small orchard to blossom regardless of season; can Warp plants unless designed for specific orchards.

name: The Unfaithful Favor
description: Rego Animal level 45 spell commanding a silk handkerchief to strangle an enemy for whom the magus has an arcane connection.

name: The Unforgiving Sea
description: Story seed about a magus trapped by a water elemental grown too powerful.

name: The Unhearing Ear
description: PeCo 20 spell of Whitburh's filling the target's ears with wax to deafen.

name: The Unnamed Cabal
description: A House Tytalus cabal, symbolized by a counterclockwise swirl of five lines, whose goal is to keep the other cabals in conflict; supposedly composed of the most powerful Tytalus Archmagi.

name: The Urgent Messenger
description: Empathy/Portage 25 rite doubling the target's movement rate while traveling.

name: The Vacant Castle
description: Vacant castle on the Cotentin peninsula lair of a Grendel-kin monster and holding a strong Magic aura; proposed site for a new covenant.

name: The Venusberg
description: A splendid subterranean home of the goddess Venus beneath a mountain in an unknown spot in Germany, discovered by the knight Tannhäuser.

name: The Verminous Infestation
description: A Rego Animal spell (Req: Perdo, Corpus) that infests a target with fleshworms in his intestines, inflicting the Worms disease immediately.

name: The Veto
description: Power of the Presiding Quaesitor to annul a ruling that clearly conflicts with the Code or a higher Tribunal ruling, reviewed by the Magvillus Council.

name: The Virtuous Hound
description: A magical beast with Magic Might 10 (Animal), an intelligent bloodhound recruited as covenfolk who can flawlessly track prey and speak; based on the bloodhound from The Book of Mundane Beasts.

name: The Vitalizer of Provisions
description: A Creo Animal (Herbam) 19 enchanted chest that preserves food placed within it, preventing decay while the door remains closed.

name: The Viticulturalists
description: A Jerbiton league that believes peasant life has virtue and engages in magically assisted manorial agriculture, led by Sabina of the Seine.

name: The Voice of the Bjornaer Magus
description: A Muto Animal 15 spell allowing a Bjornaer caster in animal form to speak with a human voice, cast without words or gestures.

name: The Vosges Mountains
description: A mountain range bounding Upper Lorraine to the east, once dominated by a secretive fir spirit that was extinguished by the planting of the holy staff at Thann.

name: The Wamses
description: Two islands that are Magic Things (Magic Might 25 Terram) fighting for dominance by changing size, yielding Muto and Terram vis.

name: The Wandering Eidolon
description: Re(In)Im 40 effect of the Effigy projecting the user's image to a distant location.

name: The Wandering Poor
description: Story seed about strangers who may be saints, God, demons or faeries in disguise.

name: The Wartburg
description: A great unbreached castle near Eisenach, ancestral home of the landgraves of Thuringia and famed center of literature and music hosting the Sangerkrieg.

name: The Wash
description: Estuary where King John's baggage train was lost in a tidal surge.

name: The Wealth of Croesus
description: CrTe 30 Ritual creating 13,000 silver pennies bearing the magus's sigil.

name: The Weightless Transportation of Books
description: A Perdo Animal 25 spell that makes the books within a chest almost weightless, easing transport or reducing a library's load on covenant floors.

name: The Welcome Addition of False Sunlight
description: A Creo Ignem 15 spell creating a steady, cool, smokeless, non-flickering light; often enchanted into library devices that float, embed in ceilings, or overlook desks.

name: The Well of the Head
description: Diedne covenant founded in 834 that sponsored Druids' Dale; destroyed in the Schism War.

name: The Werewolves' Glen
description: Glen at the forest's center with a Faerie Aura of five and a great evergreen holding Herbam vis.

name: The White Horse of Uffington
description: A horse figure carved into a Berkshire hillside that can rise and move about the country or Arcadia as a white horse of surpassing beauty, uncontrollable by mortals.

name: The Whole from the Part
description: InCo 20 spell giving a mental image of a person's essential nature via an Arcane Connection.

name: The Wicked Boys of the Third Square
description: Race of tiny demons with horse heads serving Rumael, who wreck things and steal beer and hats.

name: The Wicked Jar
description: MuVi Gen binding a demon into a sealed jar.

name: The Wideopens
description: Twin islands (East and West Wideopen) with the deepest soil, used to bury shipwrecked sailors; a regio tunnel links East Wideopen to the mainland.

name: The Wild Huntsman
description: A grim Unseelie faerie lord (Faerie Might 50) on an immense black horse, focus of every Wild Hunt, perhaps once a fragment of Woden, who seeks to maintain winter's hold on the land.

name: The Will of Alatheia
description: Lesser PeCo ritual binding a willing subject never to perform a specific action; occasionally a Tribunal punishment.

name: The Winding Path
description: The 'path' of Criamon magi who do not consciously develop themselves spiritually; the widest path of directionlessness, first followed by Juliasta.

name: The Wizard's Bridle
description: Philippus Niger's feared magical item, a head frame and shackles that trap a victim's tongue and limbs to prevent casting, enchanted with Bind The Gift and Hinder the Gift; used once to restrain a Marched Tytalus magus.

name: The Wizard's Chevauchee
description: PeHe 50 spell laying waste to all living plants the caster can see for around sixty acres, with a cosmetic magical fire.

name: The Woman of the Wheat Fields
description: A nasty faerie of the Stonehenge Tribunal who abducts boys and removes their brains.

name: The Woolen Cloud
description: Amiculum's Lesser Power letting it float and carry up to two people.

name: The Word That Opens All Locks
description: Further idea for a prop story element.

name: The Worst You Can Be
description: Spirits of Solomon Power inflicting one of seven curses (Deception, Strife, Battle, Envy, Power, Error, Corruption).

name: The Wrath of the Earth Mother
description: Dindyméné's power causing a severe earthquake.

name: The Writing on the Wall
description: CrIm 22 effect of the Unsubtle Knife making a written message appear at a connected location, seemingly in blood.

name: The Ziegensteine
description: A megalithic barrow of stone slabs under a giant oak near Monchgut on Rugen, used as a cemetery by the volkhvy; secretly a faerie-trod gateway through Arcadia to the Novgorod covenant Pripet Major.

name: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them
description: Purity Adjuration effect (Level 25) making non-divine beings perceive the character surrounded by holiness; demons must flee.

name: The cage of every unclean and hateful bird
description: Incantation/Diablerie 50 enslaving a supernatural creature.

name: The image of the beast should speak
description: Debauchery/Diablerie 35 summoning a demon's image.

name: The nameless goblin
description: A goblin noble who rebelled against the goblin king and was stripped of his name and transformed into a stalactite; the stalagmite he grows beneath himself yields Terram vis when ground to powder.

name: The stone prepared, his gift to grant / With foulest craft he does enchant
description: Incantation/Effusion General preparing an object to hold maleficia.

name: The student must be forced to learn / and thus the worm begins to turn
description: Incantation/Malediction 20 bad-luck curse.

name: Theater of Marcellus
description: Ancient Roman ruin.

name: Theban Legion
description: A legion of early Christians, including St. Victor, said by legend to have died at the Roman colony that became Xanten.

name: Theban Redcaps
description: Redcaps of the Thebes Tribunal, the likeliest source of information on Bear Island.

name: Theban Tribunal magus Lucian
description: Duplicate placeholder removed.

name: Theban spirit master
description: Spirit-magic specialist of the Theban tradition, as Albinus is.

name: Theft of Fire
description: Prometheus's theft of fire, which some magi think changed the relationship between Magic and Faerie.

name: Theia
description: Titaness who is the brilliant sky.

name: Theitmar of Merseburg
description: Bishop quoted on the night being given to the dead.

name: Thelxiope
description: The founder of the Seirenes, a Greek woman saved by the sirens and taught their magic, who then traveled Europe rescuing and training Gifted girls.

name: Then a spirit passed before my face
description: Meditation/Intervention miraculous effect (Level 25) making spirits and souls visible.

name: Theocracy
description: A covenant governance form in which the magi rule as priests through lesser priests, as in the Worshipful covenant.

name: Theoderic III
description: Frankish king under whom the kingdom reunited in 679.

name: Theodore Lascaris
description: The Byzantine Emperor living in exile in Nicea, whose agent seeks the magi's help to contact the goddess Hecate and expel the Latin usurpers from Constantinople.

name: Theodoros of Tytalus
description: Rival of Valerius who intends to challenge him to certamen and then the Prima.

name: Theodorus of Samos
description: The sixth-century Greek inventor credited with creating the first locks in Mythic Europe; namesake of the spell The Key of Theodorus.

name: Theodulf
description: Goth poet-scholar, bishop of Orléans, who founded Fleury's monastic school.

name: Theological Sciences
description: Book Four of the Epistles; Theology (Islam) tractatus and Elementalist Earth summa.

name: Theological Virtues
description: Faith, Hope and Charity, which infuse celestial traits into the soul directly from the Divine Realm.

name: Theophilus
description: The monk credited as author of the craft manual On Divers Arts.

name: Theopholus of House Jerbiton
description: A magus of House Jerbiton with the Gentle Gift who covertly teaches Magic Theory to university students to find naturally inclined Gifted individuals and recruit covenant members.

name: Theoretical Interview
description: The day-long verbal gauntlet on Magic Theory and the Arts required of magi Bonisagi apprentices.

name: Theoreticus
description: Second degree of the Fraternity of Samos.

name: Theosis
description: Process by which emulation of Christ lets the mystic participate more in the Divine.

name: Thera
description: A volcanic island, site of Akrotiri, whose ancient people discovered many magical and technological secrets; now infested with vampires.

name: Therefore shall all her plagues come in one day
description: Debauchery/Malediction 30 Cursed death curse.

name: Theriac (cure-all)
description: A wonderful cure-all for any ailment sold by traveling empirici, often claimed to be from a secret family recipe; real theriacs exist but most sold are pondwater and grass.

name: Theriomorphy
description: A Minor House Mystery of Bjornaer allowing a magus to apply a Quality or Virtue of his Heartbeast to his human form via partial physical change.

name: Thesaurarius
description: Administrator of the papal treasure; also an assistant to a chapter's custos.

name: These shall give their power and strength unto the beast
description: Debauchery/Consumption 20 ritual transferring Strength.

name: Theseus
description: Greek hero of the labyrinth and the Underworld.

name: Thessalian Magic
description: Magic magi wrongly believe certamen descends from.

name: Thetford
description: English Cluniac priory whose prior binds spirits into murals.

name: Thetis
description: A sea nymph who, with Eurynome, rescued and raised the cast-out Hephaestus and built him an underwater forge.

name: Theurgical Controlling
description: Virtue letting an elemental theurgist command supernatural beings with Might of the appropriate element.

name: Theurgical Summoning
description: Virtue granting Summoning of elementals from pure base material.

name: They shall make the whore desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh
description: Debauchery/Psychomachia 45 group emotion.

name: Thibaud d'Amiens
description: Historical successor to the archbishop of Rouen in 1222.

name: Thief of Emotions
description: A new Major Supernatural Virtue granting the Emotion Theft Supernatural Ability to remove an emotion from one person and transfer it to another; the second Fruit of the Arcadian Path.

name: Thief's Slippers
description: Wondrous shoes that let the wearer move without making a sound (Craft Level 15).

name: Thierry of Alsace
description: Former Count of Flanders who brought the Holy Blood from the Holy Land.

name: Thierry of Chartres
description: A scholar who taught at the cathedral school of Chartres.

name: Third Ring of Solomon
description: Grants 100 experience points in Medicine and Greater Purifying Touch.

name: Thirteenth House
description: House destroyed for paganism or Satanism.

name: Thirty Six Dramatic Situations
description: Georges Polti's scheme of thirty-six primal emotions driving all dramatic plots, recommended as inspiration for faerie stories (e.g. Supplication, Daring Enterprise, Obtaining).

name: Thomas Beard
description: English Templar commander in 1200.

name: Thomas the Rhymer
description: Subject of a ballad about the road to fair Elfland.

name: Thomas the Shoemaker
description: Example devout character with Piety +2, devoted to the Blessed Virgin and Saint Bartholomew and owning a relic of Saint Edmund.

name: Thorfinn son of Harald
description: Son of Earl Harald blinded and castrated by William the Lion.

name: Thorfinn the Mighty
description: Earl of Orkney 1045-1065.

name: Thormod
description: Flambeau filius of Geirlaug, Montverte's cold Hermetic ambassador and secretly a member of the Children of Odin.

name: Thoroughfare
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: supernatural creatures such as gnomes pass through the lab and cause minor nuisance (-1 Safety).

name: Thorstar
description: A lighthouse keeper on Geita, son of a Viking chieftain, saved and bound to his task by a magic fish since 912.

name: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory
description: Meditation Understanding effect (Level 20) giving a cryptic holy vision of what to do.

name: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations
description: Meditation Blessing effect granting a bonus to aging rolls for a year.

name: Thoughts Distinctly Burned
description: A Rego Aquam 15 spell that controls ink so it forms patterns on pages corresponding to the magus's spoken words.

name: Thrace
description: Region raided by Asen.

name: Thracian Harbor
description: Bear Island harbor with a perpetual inward wind; Magic aura 2.

name: Threat Level
description: Classification of obstacles (Trivial to Overwhelming) setting the Ease Factor of creativity offers.

name: Threatening a Saint
description: 'Humiliation of a saint': Presence + Leadership roll forcing a miracle after a failed invocation, risking curses.

name: Three Ages of the World
description: Joachim's teaching of the ages of Father, Son and Spirit.

name: Three Cords
description: The golden, silver and bronze cords of a familiar bond, renamed Hermes, Isis and Hekate Cords for spirit familiars.

name: Three Great Spirits of Ushant
description: Three mighty spirits bound into Fudarus's walls as genii loci, protecting the covenant.

name: Three Spears
description: Legendary flaming spears of Vendôme, Arcane Connections to each other that drip Divine-tainted Ignem vis when reunited.

name: Three Wise Men
description: The biblical magi Caspar, Melchior and Balthasar, revered by the Magoi of the Star, whose relics lie in the Shrine of Kings at Cologne.

name: Three-Field Rotation
description: Agricultural system in which wheat or rye, a secondary spring crop, and fallow rotate through three fields; the two-field system alternates fallow and crops.

name: Threshold Guardian
description: Faerie role controlling access to Faerieland.

name: Thresholds
description: Borders of life, social class, time and space that faeries inhabit.

name: Throne of God
description: God's Throne in Araboth, which Hell seeks to overthrow.

name: Through the Aegis
description: An Ars Magica supplement containing five fully developed covenants, one for each season plus one that returned from Winter to Spring.

name: Throwing Axe
description: Thrown slashing weapon.

name: Thunderbolt of Virtue
description: Pointed stone that falls in thunderstorms, containing 1 pawn of Auram vis; Enriched it wards against Demons of the Air as a Greater Power.

name: Thunor
description: An old Germanic thunder god worshiped by the German tribes.

name: Thurgau
description: Kirburger territory.

name: Thuringia
description: A landlocked upland region of the Rhine Tribunal bounded by the Kyffhauser Mountains and the Thuringian Forest, quaint rather than bustling.

name: Thurkell
description: Subject of a medieval otherworld vision.

name: Thurydices
description: Example Redcap whose fate is the subject of a divination example.

name: Tiana
description: Tremere member of Postestas.

name: Tibalt
description: Cat Reynard races.

name: Ticino
description: Valley region.

name: Tie the Threads That Bind
description: A general-level Rego Vim ritual formulaic spell used uniquely to unite an automaton's magic into a cohesive unit, requiring a level equal to the construct's Magic Might + 15.

name: Tiercelin the Raven
description: Raven whose cheese Reynard seeks.

name: Tiferet
description: Sefirah meaning 'Beauty', level 5 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 5.

name: Tillitus Bonisagi
description: Magus Bonisagi of Semita Errabunda attempting to break the Limit of Vis.

name: Tillitus of House Bonisagus
description: A magus of House Bonisagus of the covenant Semita Errabunda who invents Rego Vim warding spells against magical creatures in a spell-invention example.

name: Time Unmans All Foes
description: Andru's variant of Rusted Decay of Ten Score Years with Group target.

name: Time Waits for No Man
description: Pasiel's power inflicting aging on living things.

name: Time of Power
description: Virtue appearing in faerie statistics in this text (Time of Power).

name: Time or Place of Power
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue making Might 10 higher at a time or place linked to the faerie's role.

name: Time's Former Glory
description: Pasiel's power reverting himself to restore Might or cure wounds.

name: Tincture of Parsley
description: A Theriac of Level 10, Potency Strong, a herbal infusion that acts as an antidote to any serpent bite when consumed immediately after the bite.

name: Tinderdry
description: A Level 5 alchemical Reagent, a wool-like substance that when rubbed over damp wood dries it enough to be lit with flint and steel.

name: Tines
description: Tremere term for a magus's preferred certamen arts.

name: Tinted Aura
description: A Faerie aura given Personality Traits by tinting, imposing temporary traits on all within it.

name: Tiny Eggs
description: Story seed in which a faerie makes every egg on a manor thimble-sized, disrupting dues and prompting witchcraft accusations.

name: Tir
description: Son of Iblis with dominion over fatal accidents.

name: Tiranova rebellion
description: Rebellion of 1185 that led to independence for the Bulgarians.

name: Tirnova
description: Place near which the Asen brothers were minor lords.

name: Tiro
description: Term meaning young soldier or beginner, used by apprentices for each other and derisively by older magi.

name: Tirocinia
description: Tournaments for younger, less-experienced knights.

name: Tisha B'Av
description: Fast commemorating destruction of both Temples.

name: Titahion
description: Jewish degree of Hell, the Filthy Mire.

name: Titan
description: Primordial beings such as Dindyméné, imprisoned by Zeus.

name: Titania
description: A faerie queen who gifted the King of England a hippogriff that fell ill from London's strong Divine aura.

name: Titanoi Cult Lore
description: A cult lore Ability taught to magi raised in the Titanoi Mystery Cult of House Tytalus.

name: Titanomachia
description: War of the Titans in which Faerie gods ousted the Magic spirits from the thrones of the world.

name: Tithe of Vis
description: Story seed in which a bishop's representative inspects a covenant to tithe its vis, books and magic items.

name: Titias
description: A male Idaian Daktyl who remains on Bear Island and seeks the magi's help.

name: Titus Herennius Vespillo
description: Tenth-century necromancer magus of Rome who pioneered Hermetic spirit magic and founded the Disciples of the Worm.

name: Tityroi
description: Satyrs that play magical shepherd's pipes.

name: Tius
description: The battle god of the Germans, worshiped by Hermann and the Cheruski, whose priests' magic aided the tribes at the Teutoburger Forest.

name: To Break a Kelpie
description: Story seed in which a Highland clan chief commissions a magical bridle to capture a kelpie, risking breach of the Peripheral Code.

name: To Mark with Umbrage
description: Creo Imaginem level 30 spell marking up to a thousand people with the caster's sigil so friend can be told from foe in battle; a level 25 Voice version affects about ten.

name: To See as Others See
description: Intellego Animal level 40 spell (Rego requisite) letting a magus read an animal's thoughts and direct it as a spy, perceiving through its mind.

name: To Sin in Dreams
