description: Patarus' power altering memories to suggest mortal sin.

name: To stir the spirit, heart and fear / A shadow phantom hunts in here
description: Level 40 maleficium sending a phantasmal creature into a victim's mind.

name: Toad of Virtue
description: Toad from whose living head the Bufonite of Virtue must be removed for Enrichment.

name: Toads
description: First Green Cockerel degree: calcination, Saturn, black, lead; learns Planetary Magic.

name: Toasting Ritual
description: Rite by which a Hound of God passes his power to one who toasts his health, blowing three times across the bottle.

name: Toframanna Saga
description: Saga setting from Land of Fire and Ice centered on Vindolanda.

name: Toframenn
description: Icelandic term for the magi of Vindolanda.

name: Token of the Star
description: An example item whose acquisition by the characters could act as a story's trigger.

name: Tokens of War
description: Tokens dispatched when declaring war, when some aggressive magi don the pulla.

name: Tolas
description: Tremere member of Postestas.

name: Tolente
description: Vanished town in a regio.

name: Tom the Cutpurse
description: An example agent of Carolus, a thief with a Bond of Gratitude who is asked to steal a mayor's signet ring using Dexterity plus Legerdemain.

name: Tomar
description: Portuguese town founded by the Templars, with their chapterhouse at castle Cera.

name: Tomb of Ibn Sina
description: Site in Hamadan where supplicants of the Rite of Opening the Mind fast.

name: Tomb of the Shadow Senate
description: Hidden tomb beneath Pietro's house with an Infernal Aura and an unholy shrine.

name: Tommaso da Capua
description: Cardinal-priest of Saint Sabina (1216), appointed penitentiarius in 1219.

name: Tomte
description: Powerful Scandinavian brownie believing itself the spirit of the person who cleared the land on which the farm stands; aids fertility and cares for horses.

name: Tongue of the Beasts
description: Spell (InAn 20) known by Amberitus.

name: Tongue of the Birds
description: Spell (InAn 20) known by Amberitus.

name: Tongue of the Folk
description: Spell (InMe 20) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

name: Tonic of Gold
description: A Theriac of Level 5, Potency Weak, made with minute quantities of gold, that restores a Winded character to a non-fatigued state.

name: Toranos
description: The Pictish thunder god.

name: Torch of the Realm-bound Reveler
description: MuIg 25 spell letting the target affect fiery objects with Magic Realm Magic as if it had Ignem Might.

name: Torhout
description: Flemish cloth fair town.

name: Tormenting Familiar
description: Bartholomew (Mengalaz).

name: Torrent of Flame
description: Varkos' power to belch a 30-pace torrent of flame.

name: Tortoise Game
description: A children's game described by Errina based on a faerie that possesses mothers to kill babies.

name: Tortoiseshell Lineage
description: Cat lineage associated with Celtic spellcasters, split after the Schism War with kings in Scotland and the Rhineland, known for predicting the future.

name: Torture Chair of Zeus
description: A mechanized chair Hephaestus made that Zeus used to torture Hera; rediscovered by Milo and prize of the first Verditius Contest, won by Gelon.

name: Touch of Death
description: Leti power acting as Clenching Grasp of the Crushed Heart at Touch range, costing 6 Might.

name: Touch of Faerie
description: Condition gained by children who survive being stolen or raised by faeries.

name: Touch of the Merciless Lover
description: Empathy/Woe 25 rite making the target waste away and die until the duration ends.

name: Touch of the Mermaid
description: White Lady power acting as Kiss of the Mermaid.

name: Touched by (Realm)
description: Major Supernatural Virtue letting crafters make wondrous items without vis.

name: Tough Hide
description: Animal Quality listed in the seal statistics (Tough Hide).

name: Toul
description: A venerable city forty miles up the Mosel from Metz, formerly Roman Tullum, surrounded by tall white stone walls and remaining loyal to its duke.

name: Toul Goulic Gorge
description: Gorge with genius loci.

name: Touraine
description: County forming part of Anjou.

name: Tournai
description: Seat of Flanders' bishopric.

name: Tournament Enchantments
description: Minor enchantments sold by Verditius agents, such as reins that cannot be cut and saddles that grasp their rider.

name: Tower Keep
description: Keep usually four stories high, mostly built in the 12th century.

name: Tower of Babel
description: Tower built by Nimrod with help of the Nephilim.

name: Tower of Skulls
description: The fate of solitary magi who slide into horrific Corpus craft, which Ragoneda fears.

name: Town
description: Settlement granted rights by an overlord in a charter, whose residents are free of villein service; an average town has perhaps three hundred people.

name: Town Charter
description: Grant allowing town burgesses to elect mayors and hold courts in return for collective tenure; many Norman towns have them.

name: Town Crier's Guild
description: Guild formed to announce news using civic Specula.

name: Town Foundation
description: The practice of counts declaring villages to be towns, granting privileges and tax exemptions to attract settlers; a craze in full swing in 1220.

name: Townhouse (Reims)
description: Haunted ramshackle townhouse in Reims' poor quarter where Eliza lives, haunted by the burned witches' ghosts.

name: Toxic Visage
description: Telechine power whereby those who see the creature's true face die.

name: Toy Soldier
description: Foot-tall wooden faerie soldier guarding a sleeping child.

name: Track the Heavens
description: ReTe 28 enchantment linked to Know the Heavens that keeps the armillary sphere adjusted to current local astrological time.

name: Track the Presence of Vis
description: TaVs 5 spell in which the gruagach's fetch locates nearby vis and vocalizes where it is.

name: Tractatus de Purgatorio Sancti Patricii
description: Latin account (c.1160) of Owain's Vision; tractatus on Area Lore: Purgatory Q7 and summa on Theology L3 Q8.

name: Trade Policies
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Tragedy of the Commons
description: Later idea popularized by the Enclosure Movement that commons are destroyed by overuse, which the book says does not apply because greens are regulated.

name: Tragic (Characteristic)
description: Minor Heroic Flaw imposing a specialty in a negative Characteristic that subtracts three and adds a botch die in that circumstance.

name: Trail of the Lost Ways
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Trained Group Combat
description: Rule letting Templars who train a season fight as a trained group.

name: Trained as a Gruagach
description: -4 Hermetic Flaw: mistakenly trained as a gruagach for a year, giving -1 to Parma Magica and Art scores.

name: Training with Primi
description: Listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Traitor's Key
description: Magical key borne by the Traitor since Tasgillia, rumored to weaken Fudarus' defenses.

name: Trajan Decius
description: Roman emperor under whose persecution (250 AD) Origen was imprisoned and tortured.

name: Trajan of Tytalus
description: Magus who constructs an arena making combatants fight in berserk rage.

name: Trajan's Arena
description: CrMe 25 Hermetic Architecture enchantment by Trajan of Tytalus using eight stone pillars to make combatants in an arena fight in berserk rage.

name: Transfix
description: A Wolf of Virtue's power that leaves prey unable to move or speak while the wolf keeps eye contact; it fails if the wolf is seen first. It is ReCo(An) 20.

name: Transform Victim into (Animal)
description: Faerie power turning a target who hears the faerie's voice into a land animal for Sun duration.

name: Transform Victim into (Bird or Fish)
description: Faerie power turning a target who hears the faerie's voice into a bird or fish.

name: Transform Victim into (Object or Plant)
description: Faerie power turning a target into a solid inanimate object or plant.

name: Transform into (Environmental Effect)
description: Personal power transforming the character into a wave, breeze, cloud, fire or similar nebulous thing.

name: Transform into (Solid Object)
description: Personal power transforming the character into a specified object capable of speech and limited movement.

name: Transform into Animal
description: Personal power transforming the character into a specified land animal; faeries retain speech.

name: Transform into Bird or Fish
description: Personal power transforming the character into a specified bird or fish.

name: Transform into Coin
description: Power the Privy Counselor uses to spy as a coin.

name: Transform into Impenetrable Fog
description: Manannan's power to become a great cloud hiding the island.

name: Transform into Thunderstorm
description: Manannan's power to become a vast bank of thunderclouds driving winds and hail at foes.

name: Transform into Tide
description: Manannan's power to become the upper layer of the sea, carrying boats as he wishes.

name: Transform into Wheel of Flame
description: Manannan's power to transform into a wheel of flame, his most dangerous physical combat form.

name: Transform into Whirlwind
description: Południca's power to become a dust devil.

name: Transformation Prone
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: roll for transformation on a single botch; gained via Vision initiation.

name: Transformation points
description: Points accumulated by successful Transformation rituals toward a hierarch's ascension.

name: Transformed Beast
description: Magical beast with powers beyond its species' perfection, often from failed Hermetic attempts to create Beasts of Virtue.

name: Transformed Humans
description: Humans transformed by magic into beings of the Magic Realm, losing their humanity.

name: Transformed Thing
description: Virtue (Realms of Power: Magic) granted to the wagon by a botched transportation spell, turning it into a Magic Thing.

name: Transitionalism
description: Tremere political priority for Code changes compelling magi to assist the Order.

name: Transitions of Maturation
description: Three liminal stages (ages 8, 15 and 21) during which a young character may exchange Virtues and Flaws of equal value.

name: Transmission
description: The process by which a Criamon magus passes learned wisdom on to other members of the House, sometimes encapsulating it perfectly into a place or object upon entering Twilight.

name: Transport the Devout
description: Samuil's power to carry a person anywhere, even beyond the Lunar Sphere.

name: Transubstantiation
description: Miraculous replacement of the substance of wafer and wine with that of Christ at the words of consecration.

name: Transvestite
description: Flaw held by a high number of faerie doctors, reflecting their oath to wear women's clothes.

name: Trap the Treacherous Tongue
description: ReCo 15 spell of Edwin's holding the target's mouth shut.

name: Trapped Vendée Demon
description: Demon trapped in a sea cave by St. Hilary, bellowing at high tide.

name: Travel Lore
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

name: Traveller's Respite
description: CrCo 30 ritual restoring one Long-Term Fatigue level to up to 10 individuals.

name: Traverse Mother Earth
description: Personal power of awakened truffles to burrow through the earth as fast as walking.

name: Treasure Trove
description: Valuable buried objects collected by the coroner.

name: Treasure of Chalus
description: Golden treasure found at Chalus that lured Richard to his death; possibly diabolical.

name: Treasure of King John
description: King John's baggage train lost in the Wash; a small gold crown fragment may serve as an Arcane Connection to the rest.

name: Treasure of the Nibelungs
description: The great treasure Siegfried won from the Nibelungs, later sunk in the Rhine by Hagen and lost forever after the tragedy of the Nibelungenlied.

name: Treasurer
description: Guardian of the lord's wealth and treasury.

name: Treasures of Britain
description: Legendary set including a magical chessboard sought by Jerome.

name: Treasures of Manannan
description: Manannan's four or five magic items, which he may lend and which return to him if lost.

name: Treasury of the Four Winds
description: Sample celestial regio (level 7) storing all winds, guarded by servants of Metatron, Kemuel, Nathanael and Gabriel.

name: Treaty of Chinon
description: 1214 treaty giving Chinon to Philip II.

name: Treaty of Meersen
description: 870 treaty dividing Lotharingia.

name: Treaty of Perth
description: 1266 treaty recognizing Man and the Western Isles as Scottish.

name: Trebuchet
description: Counterweight siege engine lobbing stones in a high arc from a sling.

name: Tree Falling in the Forest
description: A Pe(Re)He 35 spell that instantly cuts down a tree in a chosen direction; with an aiming roll it can fall on a creature for up to +18 damage and bypasses Magic Resistance.

name: Tree Guarded by Michael
description: Sample Empyreal aura: a sacred tree from Eden (Divine Might 50) on a mountain, likely in the Caucasus, radiating aura 5; its seedlings' fruit grants Joyful and slows aging.

name: Tree of Knowledge
description: Tree from which Adam ate, giving rise to the qlippot.

name: Tree of Silver
description: Story element from which an arrow to kill the Rye-King must be fashioned.

name: Trembling Rock
description: Rocking stone.

name: Tremere Architect
description: Tremere magi specializing in fortification magic, creators of A Window of Singular Direction.

name: Tremere Assessor
description: Tremere magi who use The Face in the Mirror briefly for urgent tasks in cities.

name: Tremere Decennial
description: Periodic Tremere gathering; the most recent was in 1218.

name: Tremere Doctrine
description: House Tremere's method of war and philosophy of living, emphasizing coordinated soldiers.

name: Tres Ex Miscellanea
description: A rustic magus tried at the Provencal Tribunal of 1214 for interfering with mundanes after declaring Wizard's War and destroying a rival covenant's tower with an army.

name: Tresco
description: Island in the Scillies with a small monastic community founded by Tavistock Abbey.

name: Trethevy Quoit
description: A group of standing stones supporting a capstone, believed to be the home of a powerful faerie who does not like to be disturbed.

name: Trevelyan
description: The first Trevelyan, the only man who escaped the drowning of Lyonesse by riding his white horse ahead of the flood to St. Michael's Mount.

name: Treviso
description: Venetian city whose refugees founded Venice.

name: Trial by Combat
description: Ordeal where accused and accuser fight; rare in 1220, seen only in lands of Saxon heritage.

name: Trial by Ordeal
description: Court procedure invoking God's intervention to prove innocence; churchmen barred from it in 1215.

name: Triamour
description: Faerie Queen of Oleron who won Lanval.

name: Trianoma's Cipher
description: Secret shorthand code of magi Trianomae derived from Trianoma's Lab Text abbreviations.

name: Trianoma's third filia
description: Reference duplicates Irmele.

name: Trianomans
description: Wandering magi who politically defend certain sites of mystical significance across Mythic Europe.

name: Triath nan Leathad
description: Iain Mac Gabhan's billy goat familiar.

name: Tribunal Coffers
description: Tribunal funds kept by the Praeco, receiving fines and paying Quaesitors' investigation costs.

name: Tribunal Field of Durenmar
description: The traditional grounds at Durenmar where the Rhine Tribunal gathers, containing the Forum and the ancient seat of Bjornaer; site of the Order's initiation ceremonies.

name: Tribunal Treasury
description: Tribunal funds controlled by a Mercer House, which reimburses Tribunal expenses and collects fines.

name: Tribunal of Novgorod
description: A Hermetic Tribunal whose covenants often take advantage of the great fair of Thessalonica (the Demetria).

name: Tribunal of Transylvania
description: A Hermetic Tribunal whose covenants frequent the great fair of Thessalonica for its eastern goods.

name: Tribune
description: Local Tremere advocate who speaks and votes for the House at Tribunal.

name: Trident
description: Ancient piercing weapon.

name: Trigger
description: The precipitating event of a story's plot, dependent on the characters' actions or external to them.

name: Triumphal Arch
description: Ruined Roman arch bearing carvings of Augustus and Mercury that must be rebuilt to enter the temple regio.

name: Trivia
description: Threefold goddess of the roads, whose marble statue stands in a redcap exchange regio near Eisenstadt.

name: Trivium
description: The first stage of medieval learning, taught to future lawyers and clerics.

name: Tro Briez
description: Pilgrimage visiting the eight Breton founder-saint cathedrals.

name: Troad
description: Area in which Bear Island sits.

name: Troche of Colocynth
description: A Theriac of Level 5, Potency Weak, a compressed pill that causes violent bowel evacuations and can purge retained humors from a patient with a melancholic disease.

name: Trochilus
description: The scatter-brained small brown wren who keeps the single gate of the city of Nephelococcygia.

name: Trojan War
description: Legend more popular than the Golden Fleece.

name: Troll-wife
description: Often beautiful female ettins who take heroic husbands and bear powerful magicians, or steal Gifted children.

name: Trollskap
description: The magic of the trollsynir, performed like gruagach magic but using the Jotnar language and no tattoo magic.

name: Trotula of Salerno
description: A famous recent example of a female physician (medica) practicing medicine in Mythic Europe.

name: Troublesome Aura
description: Minor Site Hook: a covenant aura whose alignment hinders activities.

name: Troupe
description: The group of players of a saga, who choose which optional rules to use.

name: Trouvere
description: Romantic troubadours of the Normandy Tribunal who sing tales of Charlemagne and Arthur.

name: Truce of God
description: Church proclamation restricting war on Fridays, Sundays, holy days and Lent.

name: True Faith Magic Resistance
description: Magic resistance derived from True Faith.

name: True Merinitae
description: A cult and House lineage following Mendalus's effort to reconstruct Merinita's nature Mysteries, who claim to learn Nature Lore directly from the Founder via Agnes.

name: True Naming
description: Virtue first taught to Philosophers of Rome Initiates.

name: True Sight
description: Example Greater Benediction seeing through glamour and shapechanges.

name: True Sight of the Air (cat power)
description: Personal cat power, a version of the spell True Sight of the Air.

name: True Thomas
description: Struck dumb by the faerie queen.

name: True Torah
description: Primordial Torah of black fire on white fire residing in heaven.

name: Truffle Council Chamber
description: Interior of the holt where roots form seats and a dais and the Truffle Matron hears the pleadings of her subjects.

name: Truffle Daughter
description: Awakened truffles of Magic Might 20 who present issues to the Truffle Matron and can create Earth Elementals.

name: Truffle Daughters
description: Offspring of the Truffle Matron.

name: Truffle Drone
description: Awakened truffle warriors and guards of Magic Might 15, usually mounted on Boars of Virtue; the lowest social stratum of the regio, who do not vote.

name: Truffle Drones
description: Inhabitants of the Truffle Regio.

name: Truffle Fields
description: Second level of the truffle regio (Magic aura 5), where awakened truffles tend their crops among rings of awakened trees.

name: Truffle Holt
description: Third level of the truffle regio (Magic aura 7): two concentric circles of awakened trees on a low hill where the Truffle Matron holds court.

name: Truffle Worker
description: The weakest and most abundant awakened truffles (Magic Might 10), who tend the fields and burrow away from danger.

name: Truffle Workers
description: Inhabitants of the Truffle Regio.

name: Truffle of Virtue
description: Unusually large vis-bearing truffle that can be Enriched by being eaten by a Magic creature; otherwise worth two pawns of Creo Herbam Dedicated vis.

name: Truffle's Healing Touch
description: Ritual power of awakened truffles that instantly heals a plant of any injury, poison, or disease.

name: Truffles
description: Rare vis-bearing fungus containing Herbam vis.

name: Trun
description: Small chartered forest community in Normandy.

name: Trust Me
description: ReMe 20 spell counterbalancing the effect of The Gift on a mundane's attitude, not counted as scrying.

name: Trust of the Childlike Faith
description: PeMe 10 effect in Hervé's enchanted devices.

name: Trutina the Quaesitor
description: A beautiful mature maga and quaesitor who joined Burnham in 1195, says little, and instructs an unGifted Redcap to vote with Iudicium; wears the badge of House Guernicus.

name: Try Using the Other End
description: Optional rule giving a -1 Attack penalty when a weapon deals its secondary damage type.

name: Tréguier
description: Town with the Church of St. Tugdual.

name: Trôo
description: Village with cave homes in the Loir valley.

name: Tuareg
description: A North African people with designated religious tribes; the Ineslemen Social Status belongs to one of these tribes.

name: Tuatha De Danann
description: Irish mythic beings who fought the Fomorii.

name: Tubuas
description: Angel named in Aldebert's heretical prayer.

name: Tubuel
description: Angel named in Aldebert's heretical prayer.

name: Tuisto
description: The earth-born god of Germanic legend whose son Mannus sired the three ancestral fathers of the German tribes.

name: Tulgank
description: An ugly mountain-spirit faerie melded forever into his cavern floor by the Seelie he loved; his petrified hand still nurtures a rose whose petals yield Herbam vis.

name: Tumiac Tumulus
description: Tumulus.

name: Tundal
description: Subject of a medieval otherworld vision.

name: Turati of Tytalus
description: Luctatio magus who sets the rules of the covenant's game between Milan and Pavia.

name: Turb Trained
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character raised at a covenant and trained to fight in the turb, allowed to learn Martial Abilities at character creation.

name: Turba Philosophorum
description: Translation of an Arabic alchemical work using the marriage simile.

name: Turbary
description: The right to cut peat.

name: Turbulence Prone
description: Major Child Flaw for Gifted characters: must check for turbulence on every potential magical botch.

name: Turcopoles
description: Levantine mounted archers.

name: Turcopolier
description: Official responsible for mercenary cavalry and brother-sergeants.

name: Turks
description: Asiatic nomads who use the composite bow.

name: Turn the Man into his Appropriate Form
description: TaSh 20 spell turning a human into a land animal mirroring his Personality Traits, e.g. a liar into a snake.

name: Turnis
description: The second Primus of House Verditius who developed the ritual allowing other Hermetic magi to join the House and set the rules of the Contest.

name: Tursus
description: Almost a faerie god of northern merfolk, lord of seal beaches, likely to accompany invading Norse; Faerie Might 40.

name: Tursus Auvekoejaks
description: Supernatural being listed among island inserts.

name: Tuscany
description: Region where magi reputedly serve on councils.

name: Tusculum
description: Cardinal-bishop town.

name: Twelve Apostles
description: The apostles who spread the story of Jesus Christ after Pentecost.

name: Twelve Laws of Love
description: Rules of love listed by Andreas Capellanus.

name: Twelver Shi'is
description: Most numerous Shi'i division, recognizing twelve imams, the last in occultation until he returns as mahdi.

name: Twilight Avoidance
description: Roll to avoid Twilight, also used to avoid magical disasters.

name: Twilight Comprehension
description: Roll (Intelligence + Enigmatic Wisdom + stress die) used to navigate and comprehend experiences in the Twilight Void.

name: Twilight Mastery
description: A new Major Hermetic Virtue letting a magus choose the effects of Wizard's Twilight and induce Warping in others; the second Fruit of the Path of Warping.

name: Twinning the Quill
description: ReAn 19 effect in the Quills of Arcane Correspondence that mirrors the movements of one quill in the other.

name: Twinning the Tome
description: CrAn50 Boosted Ritual creating a near-perfect copy of a book.

name: Twist
description: Story component, especially important in intrigue stories, in which things are not what they first seemed.

name: Twist the Living Tree
description: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 25) that bends a living tree into unusual positions to form a cage, shelter, or wall while the caster maintains concentration.

name: Two Borders
description: Faeries that exist simultaneously on physical and developmental borders.

name: Two-Handed Mace
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Tyne River
description: River along which Horsingas lies.

name: Typhon
description: Mythic being temporarily imprisoned in Cehennem before Mount Etna.

name: Typical Source of Income
description: Income level granted by some Boons.

name: Tyr
description: Norse god of justice, truth and battle who sacrificed his hand to bind the Fenris wolf; Tiwaz is his rune.

name: Tyr's Aett
description: The third aett of the Elder Futhark, named after Tyr, containing Tiwaz through Othila.

name: Tytalan Ink
description: A charged item in the form of colorless ink that becomes visible (turns black or another color) upon a command word, used by Tytalan magi for secret writing.

name: Tzelmoth
description: Jewish degree of Hell, the Shadow of Death.

name: Uamh na Croig
description: Covenant destroyed by giants in 977 after its magi hunted the giants for sport.

name: Ubertino of Verditius
description: Verditius who made the three swords Faith, Love and Truth.

name: Uierna of House Bonisagus
description: Bonisagus magus whose quoted account describes the gruagachan and their magic in Scotland.

name: Ulaid
description: Irish region covered in The Contested Isle; Brother Bressal's Gaelic specialty.

name: Ulm
description: A city on the northern bank of the upper Danube first settled by Jews in the 9th century, declared a Free Imperial City by Frederick Barbarossa in 1164 and known for linen weaving.

name: Ulster
description: Region in the Hibernian variant, between Lough Neagh and the northern coast, where the Cursewood could be set.

name: Ultor
description: A Summa on Penetration (Level 5, Quality 11) by Elaine, emphasizing penetrating the Parma Magica.

name: Ulysses
description: Greek hero who blinded Polyphemus on Sicily's east coast returning from Troy.

name: Umayyads
description: Caliphal dynasty (r. 660-750); the Umayyad caliph's forces killed al-Husayn.

name: Umbria
description: Region of the Roman Tribunal containing Gubbio.

name: Unbaptised
description: Major Story Flaw among the new Christian Flaws.

name: Unbound by Land
description: Folk witch initiation script requiring a season above ground; grants Flight and Arthritis.

name: Unbridled Emotion of the Masses
description: Malachi's Power seizing up to a hundred targets with his current emotion.

name: Uncertain Faith
description: A Minor General Flaw in which doubt stands between the character and the Divine, giving -3 to holy influence rolls and a +1 Personality Trait that demons exploit.

name: Uncle (foreman elf)
description: A portly, hedonistic foreman elf.

name: Uncontrollable Strength
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character doesn't know his own strength, requiring a stress roll against Ease Factor 6 to avoid overdoing delicate tasks.

name: Undecorated
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab has spartan or absent decoration, making it uninspiring (-1 Upkeep, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Under-Marshal
description: Brother-sergeant supporting the marshal.

name: Undermining
description: Siege attack in which miners dig a supported tunnel under a wall and burn the supports to collapse it; resolved with Profession Sapper.

name: Understanding (Virtue)
description: Major Virtue and Supernatural Power of Understanding associated with True Faith mystics.

name: Underwater
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab is filled with water instead of air, causing breathing and movement difficulties (+2 Safety, +1 Warping, -2 Aesthetics, +4 Aquam).

name: Undine
description: Courtly faeries inhabiting rivers, especially boundary rivers, progenitors of mortal lineages like the rulers of Lusignan.

name: Undoing the Stonemason's Handiwork
description: A PeTe 15 spell that smashes masonry or pavement into component stones; used by School of Vilano followers to produce loose stones for ammunition or to collapse structures.

name: Unease of the Still Forest
description: A Mentem power of the bockman faeries that radiates an aura of unease up to 100 paces, silencing birds and instilling growing dread and paranoia in those within.

name: Uneven Floor
description: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab has a wonky or dangerous floor, e.g. a cave or sand-covered floor (-1 Safety, -1 Health, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Unicorns
description: Fifth degree: fermentation, Mercury, white; ambassadors who learn the Lesser Elixir.

name: Uninspirational
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is bland and boring; Presence and Communication may not exceed 0, and social Abilities used to impress suffer -3.

name: Unique Quest
description: A very specific Quest that no similar Quester could repeat, such as bringing the head of the Minotaur; grants +6 instead of +3.

name: Universally Liked
description: Example Greater Benediction giving social bonuses.

name: Universities
description: Studia generalia of masters and students organized like guilds with four faculties.

name: University Lore
description: Lore Ability of the Franciscan Teacher template.

name: University at Stamford
description: University of necromancers founded by Bladud at Stamford and later suppressed by the Church for heresy.

name: University of Reggio
description: A small student-run Italian university northwest of Bologna teaching law exclusively, founded by departing Bolognese scholars.

name: Unknown Letters and Unknown Language
description: Hildegard's writings in her own devised script, Dominion Lore tractatus, possibly Enigmatic Wisdom.

name: Unlucky
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is exceptionally unlucky, getting -1 to -3 on rolls in luck-based situations.

name: Unmaking
description: Butchering of the slain prey, followed by the curee, the rewarding of the dogs.

name: Unmarked Passage
description: Cat power, a version of Trackless Step.

name: Unquiet Spirit
description: Ghost power (ReTe 25) for telekinetic flinging of objects.

name: Unravel That Which is Cast
description: Tractatus on Vim by Dairmuid of Ex Miscellanea, Quality 10.

name: Unraveling
description: A new Mastery special ability applicable to Perdo Vim spells, adding three times the Mastery score to the spell's effective level for destroying magic.

name: Unraveling the Fabric of (Form)
description: A Perdo Vim 20 spell enchanted into Philippus Niger's talisman with ten related effects, one for each Hermetic Form; basis for Shattering the Malicious Rune.

name: Unraveling the Fabric of Imaginem
description: A Perdo Vim (PeVi 20) spell that dispels Imaginem (image) magic.

name: Unravelling
description: A Mastered Spell special ability for Perdo Vim spells, adding three times Mastery score to the effective level when destroying a targeted magical effect.

name: Unravelling the Fabric of (Form)
description: A Perdo Vim spell that cancels the effects of one spell of a specified Form; ten Form variants exist plus rarer non-Hermetic variants.

name: Unravelling the Fabric of Aquam
description: PeVi 40 effect in Regulus' Staff cancelling Aquam effects; similar effects exist for Auram, Herbam and Terram.

name: Unrelenting Struggle
description: Camuel's power to fight all night without Fatigue.

name: Unseat
description: Non-lethal special effect dragging a rider from the saddle; possible with halberds, pole arms, nets and whips.

name: Unseat Rider
description: Maneuver to pull a rider from his horse.

name: Unseelie Court
description: The dark faeries, mostly solitary in Scotland, who lurk in streams, pools and ruins and often kill mortals.

name: Unspecialized
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character does not have any specialties for any of her Abilities.

name: Unspunnen
description: Castle overlooking Interlaken.

name: Unspunnens
description: Noble family that ruled much of the Oberland, ending with the heiress Ida.

name: Unstable
description: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab is prone to movement, e.g. on a ship or earthquake-prone, causing occasional accidents (+1 Upkeep, -1 Safety).

name: Unterwalden
description: Region where Tarragon Vale is perched on a misty hilltop.

name: Until (Duration)
description: A Duration lasting until a certain thing occurs; treated as equivalent to Year but not requiring a Ritual.

name: Unusually Fecund
description: Example Lesser Benediction ensuring conception.

name: Unveiling the Tempest
description: Summa on Auram by Daniel Tonatris.

name: Unyielding Earth
description: A Rego Terram spell that compacts the ground surface in a 15-by-15-pace area, making it more solid.

name: Upside
description: One end of Devil's Lane; those who know how can walk to its end to enter the Faerie Realm.

name: Uranus
description: Primordial sky god, father of Dindyméné.

name: Urban Parish
description: Example church in one of the larger towns of a diocese, with canons, a guild altar, a Jewish minority, and a Divine aura of 5.

name: Urchin
description: Sample eleven-year-old grog, daughter of a branded outlaw living on city streets who aims to lead a gang of child thieves.

name: Urd
description: The Weaver, representing time and fate, of Ymir's second brood.

name: Urgen of Crintera
description: Leader of the Weissdorngilde (Hawthorn Gild), a follower of House Bjornaer from the covenant of Crintera.

name: Ursula Densacer
description: Clan Chief of Clan Arelie, a wolf-heartbeast maga acclaimed for erudition and poetry, and a friend of Prima Falke.

name: Usul al-fiqh
description: The principles of jurisprudence: Qur'an, Sunna, ijma' and qiyas.

name: Uswaurpa
description: A byname ('reject') for a Bjornaer magus known to have shapeshifted before Initiation, who acquires the scorn of his peers.

name: Vagi Scholares
description: 'Wandering scholars', a lesser chapter of the Ordo Vagorum centered in Austria and the eastern Alps.

name: Val Gardena
description: Valley in the Dolomites where the Rosegarten can be seen at dusk.

name: Valdemar I
description: The Danish king whose invasion of Rügen in 1168 surprised the Bjornaer covenant of Crintera and triggered its crisis.

name: Valdus
description: A magus of House Tytalus charged in 1109 AD by Treverorum for theft of vis from a site outside Trier; fined one pawn of vis and ordered to seek permission before harvesting again.

name: Vale Galina
description: Vale with a dragon hoard.

name: Vale of Angels
description: Site on the Circuit of Saint Patrick.

name: Vale of Hinnom
description: Valley by Jerusalem once used for child sacrifice to Molech; a powerful Tartaran regio with temples to the Devil.

name: Valerian
description: Chief hoplite of Normandy, Terram master reputed to be in the Terrae cult, with an invisible spirit familiar.

name: Valerius
description: Archmagus and current Secutor of House Tremere whose mind was damaged in a faerie forest.

name: Valerius Flaccus
description: Plagiarist author of a dull but accurate Latin Argonautika.

name: Valetudo
description: The sixth astrological house.

name: Valhalla
description: Norse hall where Valkyries act as serving maids.

name: Vallegloria
description: Monastery at Spello in Umbria where Balvina became abbess.

name: Valley of No Return
description: Valley holding the unfaithful.

name: Vallombrosa
description: Motherhouse of the Vallumbrosans in the mountains near Florence.

name: Valor Passion
description: Passion usable in place of Brave against The Ring of Terror.

name: Valvasore
description: Catalan noble with a retinue of five knights, similar to a banneret.

name: Vambraces
description: Arm armor.

name: Vampirism
description: Babhan sith power to suck the blood of her dancing partners, draining body levels.

name: Vanaheim
description: Legendary land existing in Faerie only within stories.

name: Vanasalus of Criamon
description: A young, friendly Criamon maga of Semitae who believes magic reflects one's personality and follows Gerfallon to understand the Enigma.

name: Vandals
description: Germanic invaders who sacked Rome and conquered Sicily and Sardinia.

name: Vanguard
description: The member of a group whose statistics drive its attacks; a group with no vanguard can't attack and the leader may designate a new one as a fast action.

name: Vanir
description: Norse gods allied with the Æsir against the Jotnar.

name: Varator
description: Demon of vengeance tied to the hedge wizard refugees plotting against the Order.

name: Vardian's Skull
description: Ancient artifact of three hedge wizards destroyed by Flambeau; its power created the Magical Aura of Vardian's Tomb.

name: Variola
description: A Serious Choleric Disease from putrid choler accumulating in the skin; highly contagious and disfiguring.

name: Varkos
description: A misshapen fire drake living in a mountain cave who desperately wants to be seen as a fearsome dragon.

name: Varstus
description: An Italian Alps wizard skilled in sympathetic magic whom Flambeau confronted with the words 'Join us or die!' in 771 and slew when he fled.

name: Varus Disaster
description: Roman defeat killing 60,000 legionaries whose ghosts routed Diedne magi.

name: Vast Sanctuary
description: Minor church Hook: by custom anyone may seek sanctuary within a wide area around the church, often putting the priest in conflict with the sheriff.

name: Vedast
description: Bishop of Arras who restored a blind man's sight.

name: Veil All Eyes
description: Lesser non-Hermetic ReMe ritual letting participants pass unnoticed.

name: Velitus
description: The certamen Style of the Spear, which wears down an opponent's magical resistance, potentially making their Resistance Total negative.

name: Velox
description: Magus of Mercere at Harco maintaining defenses and making items.

name: Venafro
description: Italian Redcap who harvested vis in lands left by the Diedne into chess-pawn tokens, giving rise to the 'pawn' unit.

name: Venatus
description: An eighty-year-post-Gauntlet Collegium-turned-Lyceum magus of Trianoma's lineage who discovered the New Aristotle at Bologna, split from the Collegium to found the Lyceum, and still teaches at a university.

name: Vendôme
description: Town on the River Loir with the Abbey of the Trinity.

name: Venedigers
description: 'Men from Venice', a type of faerie in Vorarlberg.

name: Venelli
description: Celtic tribe whose remnants are Confluensis' covenfolk, with an ancient pact with swamp powers.

name: Venerable Bede
description: Local saint who wrote two Vitae of Saint Cuthbert and the Ecclesiastical History of the English People.

name: Venetia
description: Northern Italian region.

name: Venetian Arsenal
description: The most heavily capitalized manufactory in Europe, located in Venice, capable of outfitting three war galleys per day to assemble a fleet for the Fourth Crusade.

name: Venetian Geography
description: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Venetian Spy
description: Companion vocation: a Venetian spy selling secrets to the highest bidder.

name: Venetian Thief
description: Grog vocation: a Venice street thief fleeing after a killing.

name: Vengeance Passion
description: Virtue appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Veniti
description: Strongest tribe of Gauls, defeated by Julius Caesar at sea off Morbihan.

name: Venom
description: Infernal dragon Power: rotting spittle.

name: Venomous Darts
description: Winter folk witch initiation script granting the Major Virtue Cursing and the Flaw Magical Air.

name: Venomous Velites
description: Creo Animal level 45 spell (Rego requisite) creating a swarm of a hundred poisonous scorpions the caster can command against specific targets.

name: Venus of Castennac
description: Pagan female statue used in rituals that always reappears when thrown in the river.

name: Verbal Charms
description: Quick, short-lived, least powerful learned-magician magic, which can violate the Arcane Connection limit.

name: Verdan of Ex Miscellanea
description: A magus of House Ex Miscellanea whose sigil makes all his spells involve the color green, such as turning poisonous liquids faint green.

name: Verderer
description: Unpaid landowners appointed to track fines taken by forest wardens.

name: Verderis
description: The third Primus of House Criamon, author of the epic poem The Travels of Fedoso; his ghost is absent from the Cave of Twisting Shadows and he had the Premonitions Virtue.

name: Verdi Light
description: Everburning torch in Verdi's main hall, said to result from Nerius' blessing.

name: Verdi's Tower
description: Tower raised by Conjuring the Mystic Tower where Verditius' hut stood; dwelling of the Primus, full of enchantments.

name: Verditius Contest
description: Great contest where Verditius magi compare creations at Verdi; held 1181, 1199, 1217.

name: Verditius Magic (Ability)
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Verditius Mystery
description: Mystery of House Verditius whose special abilities do not apply to Inscription on the Soul.

name: Verditius' Forge
description: The laboratory built by the Founder Verditius near the Tower of Bonisagus at Durenmar, traditionally housing the covenant's Artificer.

name: Verdun
description: A border city on the River Meuse famous for the Treaty of 843, where spies and assassins can be recruited and Redcaps meet while traveling between the Rhine and Normandy Tribunals.

name: Vermilion Temple of Wistful Sighs
description: Sacred dream place of the Volshebnii Mechtateli, made of emeralds floating above lemon clouds over an azure sea; said to be the dream of an Eternal Sleeper.

name: Vernacular Education
description: A minor general Virtue of secular tutoring for merchant-house scions, allowing purchase of Academic Abilities and granting extra experience points for trade-relevant Abilities.

name: Verox of Flambeau
description: Iberian Flambeau associate member of Magvillus who hunts hedge wizards and magical creatures; reputed an executioner.

name: Vervain of Virtue
description: Herb granting Enduring Constitution.

name: Very Knowledgeable
description: Virtue appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Very Tough
description: Faerie power granting +7 to Soak.

name: Vespasian the Avaricious
description: Parens of Siobhan.

name: Vesta
description: A Roman goddess of hearth and home whose rites were integrated into the cult of Diana and adopted as patron by the Cult of Vesta; treated as a faerie/pagan deity in Mythic Europe.

name: Vestige Travel
description: Travel through a vestige into the Twilight Void.

name: Vexillation pennant
description: Pennant enchanted with useful communication and travel effects given to vexillation leaders.

name: Vexillations
description: House Tremere military units.

name: Via Carolingia
description: Pilgrimage route from Aachen through Strasbourg, Basle, Como, Mantua, Ravenna and Assisi to Rome.

name: Via Francigena
description: Pilgrimage route from Canterbury through France, across the Alps near Aosta, via Parma and Tuscany to Rome.

name: Via Sacra
description: Road outside the Forum where Simon Magus fell.

name: Viator of Mercere
description: The only Gifted Redcap in the tribunal, retired to Ungulus to develop a magical means of communication between covenants without compromising their defenses.

name: Vicar
description: Priest appointed by a monastery to administer a parish it holds, paid a wage while the monastery takes the tithe.

name: Vicar-general
description: New diocesan office in a story seed, created by a bishop to hold a canon court visiting rural parishes in place of the archdeacon.

name: Vice-Chancellor
description: Head of the papal chancery since the office of chancellor was suppressed in 1216.

name: Victor's magical amulet
description: Amulet woven into Aeolus's mane that lets the horse ride across water, mud or any surface once per day on a command word.

name: Victory Runes
description: Vitkar magic focus carved into weapons.

name: Vieste
description: Italian port city.

name: Vigdis
description: Norn lady, an Orlog landvaettir lady, who warns the magi of Julius's planned attack on Scartaris and can grant landvaettir attendants.

name: Vigil
description: Night of prayer before an important event, costing a Fatigue level and granting a Confidence Point.

name: Viking Magic
description: Magic practiced by the Children of Odin, learned by Thormod.

name: Vilano
description: A ninth-century Flambeau magus from Istria in the Transylvanian Tribunal who suffered the Flaw Weak Magic but pioneered combat with only indirect spells, famously slaying the Green Dragon of Labin with falling trees.

name: Vile Surroundings
description: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab sits in an undesirable place such as a swamp or by a filthy hovel (-2 Health, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Vile Water of Sterility
description: A Muto Aquam Ritual spell that ruins a body of water up to a small lake, making it dark, noxious, and unfit for habitation or consumption.

name: Village
description: Settlement where villeins live, averaging around sixty families; becomes a town only through a charter granting legal rights.

name: Village Lore
description: Area lore possessed by Domhnall and Conall.

name: Village Parish
description: Example crumbling old church serving three villages beside a forest haunted by a faerie court, with a Divine aura of 4.

name: Village of the Vale
description: Village at Valnastium where François's smithy is.

name: Villain
description: Dramatic role of the one who opposes the hero repeatedly, culminating in a fight, struggle, or pursuit.

name: Villard de Honnecourt
description: The most famous master mason of 1220, who worked on cathedrals at Laon, Chartres, Reims, and Meux and produced tractatus sketchbooks usable to study Craft: Mason.

name: Vilnes Fjord
description: Fjord at whose head lies the island of Geita.

name: Vim province
description: The Vim-aligned province of the Twilight Void: combines properties of the other spheres; magic things grow brighter with magnitude.

name: Vincent of Beauvais
description: 13th-century encyclopedist discussing alchemy.

name: Vincentia
description: Wife of Saint Severus of Ravenna.

name: Vindolanda
description: Secret covenant located in Iceland, believed destroyed three centuries ago, with a mainland site and gateway; home of the Toframanna Saga player magi.

name: Vindsvall
description: Iceland's second guardian, an immense storm-colored eagle spirit as old as the land, bound by the ancients to protect the island, with Weather Mastery and Spiritual Form.

name: Vineyard (Reims)
description: Vineyard near Reims on the Marne, owned by a small monastery, where Matilda lives.

name: Viper of Virtue
description: Example Beast of Virtue that might have Deception as Essential Virtue.

name: Viper's Gaze (cat power)
description: Cat power, a variant of Viper's Gaze used to immobilize prey.

name: Virgate
description: Land a two-ox team could plow in a day, a quarter or sixth of a hide (24-32 acres), sufficient to support an unfree peasant family.

name: Virgater
description: Peasant who rents a virgate of land; worth about a pound a year to a lord.

name: Virgil
description: Figure followed by the Augustan Brotherhood.

name: Virgil's magic
description: Ancient tradition used in a variant to animate tomb effigies.

name: Virgilian Magic
description: A recently discovered magical tradition with a strong element of invention through Animo, the creation of objects with awakened spirits.

name: Virgo
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Virtues and Flaws
description: Special character features: Virtues grant benefits while Flaws impose disadvantages or story hooks, including supernatural abilities, aptitudes, and personality traits.

name: Virus Lunae
description: She-Wolf ritual power imposing Greater Malediction so the target spreads lycanthropy by scratches.

name: Virus Lunare
description: 'Moon-juice' left by Selene, acting as an Arcane Connection to the seduced man.

name: Vis Consumption
description: Chart rolled when a magic character avoids Acclimation by consuming vis, with botch, side effect, story event or transformation results.

name: Vis Exchange
description: Redcap practice of trading vis like moneychangers, usually two units for one.

name: Vis Forma
description: Vis associated with a Form ('formed vis').

name: Vis Formativa
description: Force from astral conjunctions said to fertilize soil and rocks to produce formed stones.

name: Vis Grant
description: A covenant Boon representing the annual division of surplus vis among the members.

name: Vis Lease
description: Minor Resources Hook for a legacy or tropaeum vis source.

name: Vis Obligation
description: Flaw appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: Vis Plastica
description: Creative force said by some to form shaped stones in the soil.

name: Vis Salary
description: A covenant Hook in which members must work to earn a share of vis, appropriate when individuals must petition the council for vis.

name: Vis Source Registration
description: Practice of recording a vis source's location and yield with the Redcaps so they can swear to prior ownership at Tribunal.

name: Vis Storage
description: Optional rule: large vis stocks of one Art cause spontaneous Art-appropriate spells nearby.

name: Vis Tenta
description: Vis associated with a Technique ('persistent vis'), valued at twice vis forma.

name: Vis-Monkeys
description: Disparaging term for magi who devote themselves solely to lab tinkering.

name: Vis-less Enchantments
description: A Breakthrough in Magic Theory allowing enchantments without vis.

name: Visconti Family
description: Ghibelline Milanese family that defeats the Della Torre in 1277.

name: Viscount
description: Originally a count's deputy. In France a lesser count, and in England the Latin form names sheriffs.

name: Vishap
description: A Mastery Faerie dragon atop Mount Ararat whose blood is so poisonous that weapons that injured it slay with a scratch.

name: Visigoth monster
description: Huge four-armed obsidian-furred monster that led the Visigoths into Rome, banished by a young priest.

name: Visigothic kings
description: Ancient kings from whom ricohombres claim descent.

name: Visigoths
description: Germanic invaders who sacked Rome, reputedly led by a demonic monster.

name: Vision of Heaven
description: Reward of glimpsing the Earthly Paradise after Purgatory.

name: Vision of Hell
description: Guided journey through Purgatory's fields of torment.

name: Vision of Infernal Terrors
description: Spell on which Visions Beatific is modeled.

name: Vision of the Marauding Beast
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Vision of the Oracles
description: Empathy/Dream 30 ritual using a coin on the target's forehead to give a faerie vision about the next year.

name: Vision of the Scrying Pool
description: A Hermetic spell adapted from one of the lost golden-tablet rituals of the Cult of Mercury.

name: Visions of Olympus
description: MuMe 35 spell making beings in the Mentem province perceptible outside the Twilight Void.

name: Visions of Zosimos
description: Late third-century alchemical text.

name: Visions of the Infernal Terrors
description: A spell that causes everything the target sees and hears to appear terrifying, potentially scaring them to death.

name: Visions of the Wandering Eye
description: InIm 45 spell.

name: Visitatio ad Limina
description: Canon law requirement that bishops report in person to the pope every four years.

name: Visual Eidetic Memory
description: Virtue appearing in character statistics or rules in this text.

name: Visurgis of Tytalus
description: Magus who accused Pernix of interfering with mundanes.

name: Viterbo
description: City visited by the Pope.

name: Vitkar Lab Total
description: Rune+Int+Rune Magic+Aura.

name: Vitkar Magic Foci
description: Vitkar magic focus tied to a purpose and material.

name: Vitki (Virtue)
description: The Virtue granting a character the vitkir rune magic tradition.

name: Vitriol
description: A Level 15 Alteration Reagent that creates strong acid able to dissolve stone, base metal, and wood, inflicting +10 damage if poured on a person; only glass is proof against it.

name: Vivian (cabal member)
description: Faerie-hating cabal member who targets troubadours.

name: Viviana of House Ex Miscellanea
description: Filia of Aureliana, spiritual leader of Atsingani, soothsayer and healer who owns a grand faerie wagon.

name: Viviana's Faerie Wagon
description: A grand wagon of faerie origin, larger inside, housing a laboratory and bedchamber and supplying endless clothing and linens with an unnaturally smooth ride.

name: Vocation
description: Character templates representing peoples and professions; here specific to the Roman Tribunal.

name: Vohu Manah
description: One of the Zoroastrian Immortals (Amesha Spentas): 'Good Purpose', associated with Kind and Animal in the Blessing ritual.

name: Voice Like a Bard
description: A common automaton power (base effect 10, Creo Imaginem) letting the automaton masterfully sing a small repertoire of ballads.

name: Voice Like a Nightingale
description: A common automaton power (base effect 5, Creo Imaginem) letting the automaton sing bird songs through its mouth.

name: Voice of the (Ocean)
description: Inherited Atlantean Virtue.

name: Voice of the Wolf
description: She-Wolf power producing an audible illusion of her voice within 15 paces.

name: Voice of the Woods
description: Boar King power letting him converse with and command woodland creatures and plants.

name: Voices from Hollow Spaces
description: Rego Mentem level 25 spell binding ghosts to objects or places such as mirrors, skulls and graves.

name: Volga
description: Region where Vörys-mort assists hunters.

name: Volmar
description: Monk who tutored Hildegard and helped her record her visions.

name: Voluntas vincit omnia
description: House Tremere motto, 'The Will conquers all', rarely used.

name: Volya
description: Radislav's prankster ferret familiar, friend of Am Balla.

name: Voralberg
description: Region listed in the Tribunal index.

name: Vorarlberg
description: Region with high faerie auras and dragons.

name: Vortimer
description: Constance's adoptive parens, a senior member of the lineage of Carolinus.

name: Voting Rights
description: Hermetic voting rights listed in the index.

name: Voting Sigil
description: Tribunal voting token; Rotgiers holds most Tremere sigils and Runild lacks her own.

name: Vouivre
description: A creature with a green two-legged dragon's hindparts and a woman's foreparts, with a single gemstone eye; it guards a treasure hoard and bathes once a year.

name: Vouivre's Eye
description: The vouivre's single gemstone eye, believed able to turn iron into gold.

name: Vow of Service
description: A Flaw binding a character to a vow of service, taken by the Ghostly Warden.

name: Voyages of John de Mandeville
description: Medieval fable cited as a tonal model for a high-fantasy island saga.

name: Vries van Breinermoor of Tremere
description: Author of the Vim summa The Arcane Tool.

name: Vukodlac
description: Variety of vampire from which half-wolf, half-man werewolf legends stem.

name: Vulnerability to Iron
description: Faerie weakness whereby blows of cold iron cause extra damage to the babhan sith.

name: Vulnerable
description: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab lacks even basic defenses and is easily entered (-1 Aesthetics).

name: Vulnerable to (Substance)
description: Minor or Major Supernatural Flaw giving Soak 0 against a particular substance.

name: Vulnerable to Bells
description: Faerie weakness Flaw; faeries must flee bells.

name: Vulnerable to Gold
description: Creature/character Virtue or Flaw listed in statistics.

name: Vulnerable to Iron
description: Faerie weakness Flaw.

name: Vulnerable to Rowan
description: Faerie weakness Flaw; rowan does double damage to many faeries.

name: Vulnerable to the Divine
description: Faerie weakness of Gello.

name: Vultchi Praznitsi
description: Seven days in November in Bulgaria when sinners fear wolves; the last day, Koutzoulan, is the worst.

name: Vysehrad Rock
description: A hilltop south of Prague where the Gifted Princess Libuse had her vision foretelling her husband Premysl, founder of Bohemia's ruling dynasty; now site of Prague's second castle.

name: Vésone
description: Sacred spring source of Aquam vis.

name: Vézelay
description: Benedictine monastery with relics of Mary Magdalene.

name: Vézère
description: River valley with Magic aura and painted caves leading to a regio.

name: Vörys-mort
description: An enormous, extremely swift giant who can look over the forest and sometimes drives animals toward hunters' traps on the Volga.

name: Wagoneering
description: Ability appearing in character statistics in this text.

name: Wahhab
description: An example jinni with Magic Might 15 (Ignem), a fire spirit inhabiting ancient ruins of a fane to a forgotten god in Iberia, with fire and shapeshifting powers.

name: Waif Rock
description: A faerie site near a village where a mother abandoned the bastard son of a noble.

name: Wailing Wall
description: Pilgrimage site in Jerusalem.

name: Waiting Spells
description: Spells embodying Imágonem rituals on the graveyard path.

name: Wake Day
description: Special wake celebrated the evening before the feast of the manor church's patron saint; Jerbiton-influenced covenants celebrate it on 26 September.

name: Wake the Dead
description: Cat power animating corpses by leaping over them, like Awaken the Slumbering Corpse.

name: Waldgeister
description: German wood-faeries dwelling in huge numbers in forests, some benevolent and some malicious, including Katzenveit, Gübich, and Rübezahl.

name: Walk Among the Ancients
description: Loamwalker power to see into the Herbam province of the Twilight Void.

name: Walking the Path
description: Mechanic of Sacrifice, Quest and Fruit used for communing with Wyzwanie.

name: Wall of Living Wood
description: A Creo Herbam spell (Level 25) that creates a straight wall of living oak 20 paces long, growing quickly from nearby trees or fertile earth.

name: Walpurgisnacht
description: April 30th in German lands, when witches gather to worship their master; an unholy night strengthening Infernal auras.

name: Walsingham
description: A shrine of Our Lady in Norfolk and a pilgrimage site of growing importance; the Virgin of Walsingham is claimed to be especially powerful.

name: Walter Van den Zande
description: Noted Franciscan scholar who asks magi to accompany him on a voyage to the Magic realm using notes found in Paris.

name: Walter de Grey
description: The Archbishop of York (elected 1215), a royal servant and former chancellor who quarrels with Stephen Langton over the right to bear his cross in the southern province.

name: Walther von der Vogelweide
description: The most brilliant minnesanger, who bested rivals at the 1204 Wartburg Sangerkrieg and composed poems for rival claimants to the imperial throne.

name: Walther von der Vogelwiede
description: One of the most famous German minnesingers, living in Vienna at the court of Leopold VI.

name: Wamses Gut
description: Channel forming between North and South Wamses at high tide.

name: Wandering Redcap
description: Redcaps who serve reluctantly and travel widely, discovering vis sources and trading news.

name: War Against Damhan-allaidh
description: War 810-816 of Pralix's forces and native magicians against Damhan-allaidh.

name: War Maul Attack
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: War Maul Parry
description: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

name: War Tribunal
description: Special Tribunal called by Lavinia at Durenmar in 1230 to organize the Hermetic Crusade, declaring all Icelandic magicians enemies of the Order.

name: War for the Woods
description: Story seed in which a covenant overharvests vis from a magical forest and awakened trees and forest spirits retaliate.

name: War in Heaven
description: The rebellion in Heaven during which the Grigori remained neutral.

name: War of the Faeries and the Pixies
description: Faerie representation of the Schism War in which pixies annihilated faeries at Buckland Saint Mary.

name: Ward Against Animal Demons
description: Rego Animal ward against animal demons.

name: Ward Against Faerie Ghosts
description: ReMe 10 spell known by Julia.

name: Ward Against Faeries of the Mountains
description: Rego Terram 40 ward.

name: Ward Against Flame
description: A Rego Ignem 15 spell creating a circle that mundane fires cannot cross, used around heat sources, grain stores, and sometimes whole laboratories.

name: Ward Against Infernal Ghosts
description: ReMe 10 spell known by Julia.

name: Ward Against Magic Ghosts
description: ReMe 10 spell known by Julia.

name: Ward Against Monsters Which Walk As Man
description: A Rego Corpus 25 warding effect enchanted into Philippus Niger's Subtle Chain, protecting against Might-bearing creatures affected by Corpus.

name: Ward Against Mundane Intrusions
description: A Rego Ignem 35 spell with Corpus, Animal, Aquam, and Herbam requisites that conglomerates other wards to hold off flame, light, thieves, pests, moisture, and mildew.

name: Ward Against Water Demons
description: Rego Aquam ward against water demons.

name: Ward Against the Curious Scullion
description: A Rego Corpus 10 spell creating a circle that humans lacking Magic Resistance cannot cross, used to bar entry to Hermetic sancta.

name: Ward Against the Faeries of the Wood
description: Herbam ward simulated by Black Cat Wards.

name: Ward against Wood
description: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 25) that protects the caster from nonenchanted wood so that none of it can contact his body.

name: Ward the Cruel Touch of Pestilence
description: A CrCo 20 spell that grants the target a +9 bonus to Stamina rolls to avoid contracting diseases.

name: Warden of Paris
description: Mathieus's role, recognized by House Jerbiton, as dedicated preserver of Paris.

name: Warder's Walk
description: Vim power used by Black Lineage cats to combine powers, a variant of Wizard's Communion.

name: Warding Circle
description: Circle into which a summoned spirit is called.

name: Warding Sword
description: Powerful enchanted sword held by the head of Verdi's turb.

name: Wardship
description: A liege's right over the lands and marriage of heirs and widows of his vassals.

name: Warhammer
description: Two-handed crushing weapon.

name: Warped Consors
description: Story seed about highly Warped covenfolk from a fallen Autumn covenant causing strife with nobility and church.

name: Warped by Magic
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw representing exposure to powerful magical forces, granting Warping Points, a Warping Score of 1, and a related Minor Flaw.

name: Wartburgskrieg
description: Early 13th-century minnesinger contest at a German court where the Knights of the Green Stone were founded.

name: Waste
description: Unplanted land, including woods and marshes; the domain of the faeries.

name: Watchtower
description: A fortified stone building atop the cliffs overlooking Durenmar's valley, occupied by the Protector Philippus Niger and surrounded by blasted ground.

name: Watchtowers of the World
description: Places where St. Michael watches for attacks on the City of God.

name: Water Siren
description: Magic Realm creature that charms sailors with song and summons storms.

name: Water of Life
description: Water which made Khidr immortal.

name: Wateringues
description: Societies of landowners reclaiming Flemish marshland.

name: Waters of Forgetfulness
description: Waters in the funeral cavern of Coeris, harvested for vis, whose residue dyes Tremere robes and heals psychological injuries.

name: Wattle and Daub
description: Peasant wall-building technique of woven twigs plastered with mud or mud and straw, fragile enough that housebreakers smash through it.

name: Wave Sweeper
description: Manannan's ship, which travels as swiftly as he wishes regardless of the wind.

name: Waxing Size of the Swelling Ocean
description: Rahab's Power to swell his Size while immersed.

name: Way of St. James
description: Pilgrim route to Santiago de Compostela through Anjou and Aquitaine.

name: Way of the Poisoned Land
description: Virtue granting bonuses in poisoned places.

name: Wayland's Smithy
description: A barrow near the White Horse that is the home of the invisible smith Wayland, who shoes horses left with a penny and is said to be able to shoe the White Horse itself.

name: Ways of the Dead
description: Routes traveled by the spirits of the recently departed, kept clear by nightwalker processions.

name: Ways of the Deep Earth
description: Minor Virtue of Dexithea.

name: Ways of the Island
description: Virtue listed in this text (e.g. for Iasper or the Black Dog).

name: Ways of the Mountains
description: A Virtue possessed by Adranus, the spirit of Mount Etna, attuning a being to its mountain environment.

name: Ways of the Ocean
description: Virtue possessed by Rahab.

name: Ways of the Swamp
description: A Virtue granting bonuses in swamp terrain; possessed by the Boglin, who gains combat bonuses from it.

name: Ways of the Waters
description: Virtue granting bonuses in water, usual extra Major Virtue for telechine blood.

name: Weak Amulets
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw subtracting five from Lab Totals for amulets.

name: Weak Chartae
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw subtracting five from Lab Totals for chartae.

name: Weak Elemental Resistance
description: Major Flaw: elemental traits don't add to Soak; Hermetic version weakens Magic Resistance vs elements.

name: Weak Elementalist Resistance
description: Major Flaw gained through the Blood Oath of Becoming a Member of Ikhwan as-Safa'.

name: Weak Enchanter
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the magus's Gift is ill attuned to creating enchanted devices, halving Lab Total for creating or investigating enchanted items.

name: Weak Parma
description: Flaw appearing in character statistics or rules in this text.

name: Weak Personality
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character lacks strong feelings, restricting Personality Traits to between +1 and -1.

name: Weak Sense of Smell
description: Minor Flaw suited to inhabitants of volcanic auras.

name: Weak Sense of Taste
description: Minor Flaw suited to inhabitants of volcanic auras.

name: Weak Sight
description: New Minor Flaw suited to inhabitants of ice auras.

name: Weak Verbal Charms
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: casting total plus die for charms is always divided by five.

name: Weakness for Women
description: Flaw exchanged for Disfigured in the Coll example.

name: Weapon Breakage
description: Stress die + Weapon Ability vs. Ease Factor 9 (15 for improvised weapons); failure loses a damage level.

name: Weapon Damage Types
description: Weapons are categorized as crushing, piercing or slashing by the injuries they cause, relevant to magical effects.

name: Weapons of the Resting Place of Mars
description: Magnificent weapons lining the tomb walls; each gives +3 damage and +2 First Strike and Attack, shifts Personality Traits toward war, and brings a ghostly swordsman upon the taker.

name: Weardmenn
description: Saxon term for the grogs of Horsingas, about fifty warriors.

name: Weasel of Virtue
description: An unclean animal with an understanding of medicine; the only animal able to kill a basilisk.

name: Weather Affinity
description: Ability of the storm witch.

name: Weather Made Good
description: MuAq 40 Boundary ritual preventing rain from falling on the island for a month.

name: Weather Mastery
description: Vindsvall's power to generate any weather effect up to 12th magnitude.

name: Weavers' Guild of Ghent
description: The Ghent guild to which many Spinnen belong, hiding them in plain sight.

name: Weaving
description: The commonest Craft Ability for factors, reflecting skill in producing their main product.

name: Wecelo
description: Expert fisherman of Lake Brienz saved from drowning by the lake spirit.

name: Week Works
description: Serf labor obligation expressed as days per week, each measured from sunrise to noon.

name: Weight in Gold
description: Story seed where an abbot promised a mercenary captain his weight in gold and seeks magi to feed him magically created food.

name: Well Insulated
description: A Minor laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab is especially shielded from the outside world, suitable for sensitive locations (+1 Safety, +1 Aesthetics).

name: Well Traveled
description: A Virtue incompatible with the No Sense of Direction Flaw.

name: Well worms
description: Serpents of northern England and southern Scotland related to the stoorworm.

name: Well-Trained Folk Witch
description: Minor General Virtue granting 50 extra experience points during folk witch apprenticeship.

name: Well-Trained Gruagach
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting extra experience in gruagach Arts and spells.

name: Well-travelled
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Wells
description: City of Joscelin's birth, seat of the Bishop of Somerset, where he plans to build a great cathedral.

name: Welsh Longbowmen
description: Specialist mercenary troops highly sought after.

name: Welsh druids
description: Indigenous Welsh magical tradition with which House Díedne had close links, though they did not join the Order; associated with stone circles.

name: Wends
description: People converted by the Premonstratensians.

name: West Country
description: The covenant-free region of Devon and Cornwall, suitable for magical colonization, near the ruins of Sursum and Stellapser and sites associated with Arthur.

name: West Franks Tribunal
description: Tribunal named in 865, predecessor of the Normandy Tribunal.

name: Western Alps
description: Region of the Tribunal with its own map in the index.

name: Western Christendom
description: A cultural society of Mythic Europe centered on western Europe and including the Crusader States, defining a set of Social Status Virtues and Flaws.

name: Western Empire
description: Empire after whose fall the Swiss lake was created by a magical battle.

name: Western quarter
description: Region of Iceland where crusaders hunt witches.

name: Westminster
description: The seat of the court of the King's Bench and site of the king's Maundy Thursday ceremony in Westminster Abbey.

name: Weyland the Smith
description: Magician-king who made magic items and flew.

name: Whale of Virtue
description: A giant whale whose back becomes covered with sand and plants, so sailors mistake it for an island.

name: Wheel of Fire
description: Field of Purgatory where the covetous are burned on an immense turning wheel.

name: When Fortuna Blinks
description: PeCo 10 spell making the magus vanish from the Magic Realm momentarily to avoid a deadly threat.

name: While (Condition) (Duration)
description: Faerie Duration lasting while the target performs an activity or holds a temporary condition.

name: Whip
description: Poor weapon usable to trip, grapple, disarm or unseat.

name: White Fox
description: Magic creature that gives an ivory ball leading to a hermit.

name: White Horseman
description: Demon released by breaking the first seal, a conqueror with a bow.

name: White Lineage
description: Friendly cat lineage descended from Founder Mercere's familiar, found in his House's covenants, protectors of people.

name: White Stag of Fontainebleau
description: A placid white stag accompanying the nymph.

name: White Swans
description: Second degree: dissolution, Jupiter, grayish-white, tin; learns Vulgar Alchemy.

name: White Truffle
description: Off-white truffle, best from Piedmont around Alba, growing throughout the Roman Tribunal and in Istria.

name: White Wolves of House Tremere
description: Wolves associated with House Tremere, similar to Wolves of Virtue but with Intelligence rather than Cunning.

name: Whiten the Wear of Travel
description: Amiculum's Lesser Power that removes dirt and mends small tears in the cloak.

name: Wido of Cornelly
description: Burgundian leper knight around whom the Order of Saint Lazarus formed.

name: Widukind of Corvey
description: Historical chronicler whose History of the Saxons is listed as a period source.

name: Wiederich
description: The sole survivor of the Magyar attack on Sirmium in 930, a Flambeau magus who joined the German armies to avenge himself on the Magyars; his vengeful descendants persist.

name: Wieliczka
description: A location in Poland named for its salt mines, cited as a Greater mining income example.

name: Wilding
description: A Major Nature Mystery letting a maga extract temporary vis from completely natural objects according to her Nature Lore.

name: Wilkis
description: Most eloquent of Birna's six apprentices, told to 'Nourish,' a wolf from a Prussian tribe, appointed first primus of the House; founder of Clan Wilkis.

name: Will over Form (Virtue)
description: Virtue allowing shapechange.

name: Willambrouk
description: Place in Brabant with a leper hospital where Marie and her husband worked.

name: William Brewer
description: Lord of the Exchequer and multi-county sheriff, loathed but influential; seeks his secret enemies.

name: William Marshal the Younger
description: The earl of Pembroke who holds Fotheringhay castle against royal orders and is suing Falkes de Bréauté over four disputed manors.

name: William Tyrell
description: Man who accidentally shot King William Rufus in 1100.

name: William White Hands
description: Archbishop of Reims who granted the city a charter.

name: William d'Ostilly
description: Bishop of Avranches, a local dean elected 1212.

name: William de Braose
description: Jailer of Arthur of Brittany.

name: William de Donjon
description: Archbishop of Bourges, canonised 1218, drawing pilgrims.

name: William de Fors
description: The count of Aumale who holds the royal castle of Rockingham despite government demands that he surrender it.

name: William de Tancarville
description: Influential Norman noble, cousin of William Marshal's father, who introduced him to the tournament.

name: William du Pont-de-l'Arche
description: Canonist bishop of Lisieux, elected 1218.

name: William of Auvergne
description: Claims to have seen manuals of necromancy as a student at Paris.

name: William of Chartres
description: Grand Master (1210-1219) whose death led to Peter of Montaigu's election.

name: William of Conches
description: A scholar who taught at the cathedral school of Chartres.

name: William of Jerbiton
description: A Jerbiton magus of Rosalba targeted by Diana of Tremere in the 873 Wizards' War; his death began near-constant skirmishing.

name: William of Jumieges
description: Historian (1025-1090), author of Historia Normannorum.

name: William of Newenham
description: English Templar commander (1185-1200).

name: William of Normandy
description: Duke who defeated Harold Godwinson at Hastings.

name: William of Norwich
description: Boy involved in the first blood libel accusation in England in 1144.

name: William of Sens
description: Architect who worked on Canterbury Cathedral.

name: William of Thanet
description: The aging, capable autocrat who has handled the day-to-day operation of Nigrasaxa since its founding.

name: William of Tyre
description: Chronicler who reported the Templar dealings with the Assassins in 1173.

name: William son of Henry I
description: Son of Henry I of England, drowned leaving Barfleur in 1120.

name: William the Marshall
description: Trusted friend of Richard.

name: Willigis
description: A tenth-century archbishop of Mainz from whom onwards the archbishop enjoyed the status of Archchancellor of the Empire.

name: Willow Wicker Dolls
description: Dolls warding against weak faeries.

name: Wilton
description: The stone-built village fifteen minutes from Voluntas that serves as part of the covenant, housing covenfolk and providing an inn for guests.

name: Wimpfen
description: A small fortified city high above the River Neckar with Roman, Frankish, and episcopal history, now a favorite imperial residence.

name: Wind Raising
description: Hagbui power (ReAu 20) raising gale-force winds.

name: Wind at the Back
description: A Rego Auram spell (Level 5) that makes an existing breeze follow the caster as they travel, causing phenomena like fog or haze to follow.

name: Windlass
description: Device used to span arbalests.

name: Winfrida
description: A young, timid Follower of Guernicus (age 27) and Quaesitor at Durenmar whom Murion is grooming; one of only two Guernicus magi in the Rhine Tribunal.

name: Wings of the Soaring Winds
description: A flight spell that lets a maga move at 40 miles per hour, cited in calculations about flying to the moon.

name: Winifred of the Four Oaks
description: Initiate of the Knights of the Green Stone who passed her acceptance by being frozen in fear.

name: Winter (Story Element)
description: Scenery story element of snow and frost representing sterility and patience, a guardian or prison.

name: Winter Solstice
description: Sabbat date and traditional time for casting the Aegis of the Hearth.

name: Winter Tenens
description: Most senior Tenens Occultorum, covering Transylvania, Thebes, Levant and Novgorod.

name: Winter's Icy Grip
description: A Perdo Ignem 30 spell known by Philippus Niger, mastered for Fast Casting.

name: Wisdom
description: Moral (Cardinal) virtue of greatness of soul and understanding of truth, guiding prudent judgment.

name: Wisdom Runes
description: Vitkar magic focus on stone.

name: Wisdom from Ignorance
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue used by certain Egyptian Sufis interested in calligraphy, allowing them to use unreadable books as sources of training for spiritual subjects.

name: Wisdom of Athena
description: Lesser CrMe ritual granting +5 to Folk Ken, Intrigue and Awareness.

name: Wise Folk
description: Faerie-touched wise men and women on society's fringes, favoring Empathy, Ware, Weal, and Woe.
