name: Wise Temper
description: Temper of reason over base desire, tied to Prudence and opposing Lust.

name: Witch Bottle
description: Foundation charm that hexes minor magic users entering a building; can detect cursing power and the Gift and carries a PeCo effect up to level 40.

name: Witch Bottles
description: Folk charms of Yorkshire that repel faeries.

name: Witch of Endor
description: Biblical figure whose secret arts are believed by many to be a source of the Ars Goetia.

name: Witch's Mark
description: Each folk witch's mark revealing her effects, like a magus' sigil.

name: Witches of Reims
description: A folk witch coven in and around Reims, several of whose witches were burned by Archbishop William in the late 12th century.

name: Wittlesbachs
description: Ruling family of Bavaria who gained the Rhenish Palatinate in 1214.

name: Wivere
description: A wingless, legless French dragon whose Sovereign Ward is that it cannot harm naked people.

name: Wizard's Eclipse
description: A Perdo Ignem ritual (Level 35) that eclipses the sun within a target area, suddenly making it as dark as night.

name: Wizard's Leap
description: A ReCo 15 spell that instantly transports the caster up to 50 paces toward a visible destination or Arcane Connection; effective as a fast-cast defense, bringing the caster's Talisman automatically.

name: Wizard's Well
description: A site that Merlin is said to have created, according to the legends of the mage.

name: Wizards' Melee
description: A controversial Flambeau tournament event where teams of one magus and five grogs fight, the goal being to cast a Touch-range spell on the opposing magus.

name: Wolf Clan
description: One of Crintera's six clans; makes up the bulk of the covenant's warriors and servants, fights with axes, and protects the Prima. Its leader is traditionally a wolf skinchanger and the Prima's personal shield grog.

name: Wolf King
description: Being whose domain encompasses all wolves in England, a macrocosm.

name: Wolf of Gubbio
description: Man-eating wolf that besieged Gubbio until tamed by Saint Francis of Assisi.

name: Wolf's Cloak
description: A wondrous cloak made by a furrier that allows the wearer to change into a wolf until the next sunrise or sunset (Craft Level 17).

name: Wolfhound
description: Shaggy-coated Irish hound performing the same role as the greyhound.

name: Wolves in Sheeps' Clothing
description: MuAn 48 effect triggered by Sight of the Wolf that gives the sheep in the enclosure the fangs, claws and ferocity of wolves.

name: Woman of Endor
description: Woman with a familiar spirit consulted by Saul.

name: Women's Abbey
description: Fortified abbey in Caen built by Matilda.

name: Wondrous Items
description: The highest quality of crafted goods, minor enchanted items whose Craft Level is 12 plus the magnitude of effect; the goldsmith Banco is renowned for making them.

name: Woodland Drake
description: A small drake dwelling in a Magic aura woodland threatened by assarting in a test-case seed.

name: Woodpecker of Virtue
description: A bird that makes nails and wedges fall out of any tree it perches on.

name: Woodward
description: Lesser office caring for the lord's plantations.

name: Woolen Cords
description: Templar cords worn as a belt, believed sacred and granting strength of will to remain chaste.

name: Words of the Unbroken Silence
description: A Creo Mentem spell (Level 10) that lets the caster say two words directly to the mind of a target, who recognizes the supernatural origin and the caster's voice.

name: Words that Live in Song
description: Enchantment/Dream 20 rite letting a group understand and join a song in the caster's native language.

name: Working Pony
description: Sturdy pony (Fell or Icelandic) suited for rough terrain and as a pack animal.

name: Workplace Faeries
description: Household or workplace faeries, solitary creatures who help with chores for a traditional due and leave if spied on or overpaid.

name: Workshop Foreman
description: Foreman elf power to command worker elves.

name: Workshop Helper
description: Worker elf power to create magic items and assist Lab work.

name: World Tree
description: Tree beneath the Earth that the kallikantzaroi saw at each year.

name: World of Forms
description: The metaphysical source from which magic draws the details of created things; magi disagree whether it is the realm of Magic, the human mind, or the mind of God.

name: Worlds Within Worlds
description: Theory of the Magic Realm as a collection of cosms each contained within a single thing.

name: Worm Lore
description: The cult Lore of the Disciples of the Worm; a Mystagogue usually has 6 or more.

name: Worm of the Mind
description: Bael's Power turning a sleeping victim into a mindless slave.

name: Worn
description: New duration for amulets, equivalent to Sun, lasting until the amulet is broken or removed.

name: Worship (Seasonal Activity)
description: Free-season activity of fasting, prayer and meditation with Source Quality equal to the church's Divine Aura.

name: Wound
description: Injury category (Light, Medium, Heavy, Incapacitating, Fatal) with penalties.

name: Wounded River
description: Random story element, a river of blood where Arduinna bathes and the Stone Drum is hidden in the example story.

name: Wrath
description: One of the capital vices, opposed by a holy temper.

name: Wrath of the Oceans
description: Rahab's Power duplicating Wrath of Whirling Winds and Water.

name: Writ of Crenellation
description: Covenant Boon: permission to fortify the covenant's residence.

name: Writ of Reprisal
description: A court order allowing a wronged merchant to seize goods from any merchant of a fraudster's home town; such a writ against the Order could trigger Quaesitor review of a covenant's representatives.

name: Wulfram von Eschenbach
description: Minnesinger credited with Parzival, which Gunnar may have passed to him by magic.

name: Wurzburg
description: An influential episcopal city in the middle of Franconia at the center of its largest vineyards; its cathedral houses the shrine of St. Kilian.

name: Wyrd
description: One of the six known lands of Arcadia: the land of the air.

name: Wyrms
description: Creatures found in dark places.

name: Xanten
description: A town on the west bank of the Rhine, formerly the Roman colony Colonia Ulpia Traiana, birthplace of the hero Siegfried and former capital of Nibelungland.

name: Xantippes
description: A magus of House Jerbiton who helped found Treverorum to recover Roman secrets, later found guilty of meddling with the mundanes of Trier using his own Mentem magics for personal enrichment.

name: Xavier
description: A Gifted magus of House Mercere, the Rhine Tribunal's only Gifted Mercere and its archivist, who dwells at Durenmar at one of the two official Mercer Houses.

name: Yallery Brown
description: Faerie released from under a stone who worked in gratitude, then tormented his master to death after being thanked.

name: Yan den Houtkapper
description: Giant of Steenvoorde who made everlasting boots for Charlemagne.

name: Yanartas
description: A site near the Antalya Gulf in Asia Minor, where the mythical Chimera fell and fire leaps from the ground, location of one of Hephaestus's forges.

name: Yannes
description: Parens of Darius.

name: Yarrow of Corpus Vis
description: Yarrow vis (soldier's wort) that heals wounds completely.

name: Yaudet
description: Hilltop with a regio.

name: Yearly Aura Modifier
description: The annual sum of effects on an aura; values beyond +/-3 trigger rolls on the Aura Strengthening or Weakening Tables.

name: Yenghissar
description: A small village along the route to Khashgar plagued every seven years by the Infernal storm spirit known as the Buran.

name: Yeshiva
description: A Jewish school where students learn grammar and Jewish instruction by studying the Talmud and Mishnah from the local rabbi; large ones are in Cordoba and Granada.

name: Yeshivah
description: Advanced school where learned rabbis teach.

name: Yeshivah shel Malah
description: Celestial level 5 regio where the dead study the True Torah under Zagzagel.

name: Yesod
description: Sefirah meaning 'Foundation', level 2 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 2.

name: Yetzirah
description: Third of the Four Worlds (Formation), considered Arcadia or the Invisible World of angels and spirits.

name: Yeun Elez
description: Peat bog.

name: Yezer ha-ra
description: The evil inclination within every person upon which a shedeh feeds.

name: Yezer ra
description: Jewish term for the inclination towards evil, dominating demons.

name: Yezer tov
description: Jewish term for the inclination towards good, absent in demons.

name: Yezidi
description: Real-world Kurdish religion venerating Malak Ta'us, the Peacock Angel, oppressed as devil-worshipers; distinct from the Mulhidun.

name: Yfel spirits
description: Malign landvaettir whose lords take captured Julius for amusement and who can suppress a captive's Gift.

name: Yofiel
description: The Prince of the Torah, an angel summoned after forty days of fasting in the Ma'aseh Merkavah.

name: Yonec
description: The son of a hawk-knight and an imprisoned lady in a Lai of Marie de France; he avenged his father by killing the jealous old lord and took his father's place as king.

name: Yonec's ring and sword
description: Gifts the dying hawk-knight gave his lover: a ring ensuring her husband would remember nothing, and a sword for their son Yonec to avenge him.

name: Yonnlius
description: Bonisagus magus, a Master in the Rhine Tribunal, who caught and studied the cat-fish.

name: Youdig
description: Entrance to Hell in Yeun Elez.

name: Young Henry
description: The eldest son of Henry II at whose court William Marshal served, leading his mesnie at tournaments; he died of dysentery having taken a crusading vow.

name: Young Ladies
description: Some 30 standing stones near Langon.

name: Your One True Friend
description: Patarus' power causing trust in an authority figure.

name: Ypres
description: Major Flemish cloth and linen city.

name: Yr (Futhorc)
description: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Bow", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

name: Ys
description: A kingdom destroyed by the Red Knight after its princess gave him the key to its sea defences.

name: Yuval
description: Senior Redcap of the Mercer House in Barcelona, which is named after him.

name: Yuval's
description: Informal name of the Mercer House in Barcelona, named after its senior Redcap and reputed as a wealthy, slightly sinister house of magic and vice.

name: Zachariel
description: Ruler of Raqia.

name: Zachiel
description: Ruler of Zebul.

name: Zadkiel
description: An archangel listed by Dionysus the Areopagite among the archangels.

name: Zagzagel
description: Angel who presides over the Yeshivah shel Malah.

name: Zakat
description: Alms-tax; Infernal creatures cannot handle goods given as zakat.

name: Zalambur
description: Son of Iblis with dominion over mercantile dishonesty.

name: Zanzibar
description: A rich city, reachable by circumnavigating Africa, where gold is traded by equal weight for salt; a potential reward for an insured speculative covenant expedition.

name: Zara
description: City captured in the Fourth Crusade.

name: Zawiya
description: Sufi home at a saint's tomb.

name: Zebul
description: The Sixth Heaven of icy storms, home of Cherubim and Phoenixes, ruled by Zachiel and Sabath.

name: Zephyrus
description: Air elementals composed of chains of octahedral corpuscles, encompassing wind, cloud, and lightning forms; utterly restless, highly perceptive travelers that crave the dissolution of barriers.

name: Zerachiel
description: An angel named in some lists of the archangels.

name: Zita
description: Future mystic who is an infant in 1220.

name: Zlatorog
description: White chamois with golden horns on Mount Triglav in Slovenia that tricks hunters into falling over precipices and heals by eating the red flower grown from its blood.

name: Zmey
description: A variety of dragon native to the Transylvania Tribunal that guards villages against evil spirits, flies, shapeshifts and charms young women; females are zmeyitsas.

name: Zora
description: The faeblooded priestess who leads the priesthood of Hertha; she gives Crintera Creo vis yearly and is the lover of Istvan Padas.

name: Zoroaster
description: Prophet who founded the Persian faith on monotheism and revealed the Gathas.

name: Zoroastrian Mysteries
description: Mysteries (Realms of Power: The Divine) from which Mithraism is rooted; indifferent to the Legion.

name: Zosimos
description: Late third-century alchemist whose Visions identify the alchemical process with Christ.

name: Zurenzialle
description: An unremarkable magus of the 1100s who vanished from his covenant in the Greater Alps; his sodales discovered he had never been human but was a faerie being impersonating a magus.

name: Zwin
description: Estuary opened by the 1134 tidal wave.

name: Zwin Sea Dragon
description: A sea dragon that created the storm carving the Zwin channel near Brugge in a secret agreement with Derrick of Alsace, now demanding accumulated tolls via drowned-sailor emissaries.

name: Zähringen Family
description: Noble family of the Alps who began the craze of founding new towns to consolidate their lands into a continuous bloc and serve as points of military strength.

name: al-Ash'ari
description: Theologian (d. 935) who shaped mainstream Sunni doctrine; author of Kitab al-Luma'.

name: al-Bukhari
description: Compiler of Sahih al-Bukhari (d. 870).

name: al-Hallaj
description: Early Sufi writer executed for heresy for claiming to be God incarnate (d. 922).

name: al-Hasan al-'Askari
description: Eleventh Twelver imam, died 874.

name: al-Husayn
description: Grandson of Muhammad killed in 680, revered by Shi'is as an imam; holy forbear with Divine Might 75.

name: al-Junayd
description: Early writer at the origins of Sufism (d. 910).

name: al-Kamil
description: Sultan of Egypt, invested by the 'Abbasid caliph, with Magic Resistance 10 from the commanding aura.

name: al-Maturidi
description: Theologian (d. 944) whose doctrines are mainstream Sunni.

name: al-Meraya
description: Moorish port city (Almeria) in southeast Iberia.

name: al-Meraya (spirit)
description: Might 40 Terram Daimon of a thirsty, expanding desert in southern Iberia.

name: al-Musta'li
description: Younger son of al-Mustansir installed as Fatimid caliph over Nizar.

name: al-Mustansir
description: Fatimid caliph who died in 1094 after nominating Nizar.

name: al-Risala
description: Treatise on Islamic jurisprudence by al-Shafi'i.

name: al-Safa and al-Marwa
description: Two hillocks at Mecca between which pilgrims run.

name: al-Sahihan
description: Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim, the two most respected hadith collections.

name: al-Shaykh al-Mufid
description: Author of Kitab al-Irshad (d. 1022).

name: al-Sira al-Nabawiyya
description: Biography of the Prophet by Ibn Ishaq.

name: magical raven cloak
description: A magical cloak carried by the Skinchanger spouse covenfolk character, associated with her raven Skinchanger form.

name: Écuage
description: Payment in lieu of a knight's military service.

name: Évrard de Tours
description: Senior Redcap of the Tribunal who relocated the Mercer House to Cunfin.

name: Île de la Cité
description: The mile-long central island of Paris, its ecclesiastical and administrative core.

name: Ùruisg
description: Tiny satyr of Scotland that serves as a brownie, with a taste for dairy products and dairymaids.

name: Čejkovice
description: Future Templar preceptory in Moravia.

name: Łuków
description: Future Templar site in Prussia.
